Defensie heeft de definitie van de term vacature niet gewijzigd en is niet voornemens om de definitie van de term vacature te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over uitspraken van de Griekse premier Mitsotakis over het Stabiliteits- en Groeipact

An MP asked the Finance Minister about Greek PM Mitsotakis's confidence that EU fiscal rules will be loosened, the coalition formation document's call to 'modernise' the Stability and Growth Pact, and Greece's 207% debt ratio. The minister answered that the SGP's core aim is sustainable public finances, that reform proposals will be judged on that basis, that the SGP should be simplified, and that Greece's debt cannot realistically reach 60% of GDP soon, with the position on reform left to the next cabinet.
The determination of the position on the conclusions of the consultation sessions and any legislative proposals to amend the SGP is left to the next cabinet.
De positiebepaling ten aanzien van de conclusies uit de consultatiesessies en eventuele wetsvoorstellen voor aanpassing van het SGP is aan het volgende kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat een 'Internationale gezant Bosnië waarschuwt voor hervatting oorlog'

An MP from JA21 asked the Foreign Minister about threats by Milorad Dodik to secede Republika Srpska and withdraw from national institutions in Bosnia and Herzegovina, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The minister answered that such unilateral moves are unconstitutional and unacceptable, supported EU and PIC condemnation and backing for the High Representative, and said the Netherlands would push for targeted EU sanctions.
The cabinet is of the view that such unilateral decisions are extremely undesirable and moreover unconstitutional.
Het kabinet is van mening dat dergelijke eenzijdige besluiten buitengewoon onwenselijk en bovendien ongrondwettelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het Wierdense Veld

An MP from JA21 asks the minister about reports that the Wierdense Veld nature targets cannot be met, the role of consultancy Tauw in both advice and research, and the mapping of the area as restoring bog in AERIUS. The minister answers that the province completed its exploration, approved a measures package, and that the mapping and historical interpretation are sound, while declining to verify an anonymous researcher's remark.
Because the researcher, according to the article, only wanted to make this statement anonymously, it is also not possible for me to verify what exactly took place.
Omdat de onderzoeker deze uitspraak – volgens het artikel – alleen anoniem wilde doen, is het voor mij ook niet mogelijk om na te gaan wat er precies heeft plaatsgevonden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het stikstofbeleid

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the uncertainty of the nitrogen deposition calculation at hexagon level, and whether deposition measurements were made after 2015 to validate the AERIUS model. The minister answered that the uncertainty at hexagon level is assumed equal to the one-square-kilometre grid pending further research, and that RIVM measures deposition and will report on model validation with deposition data in the coming year.
While validation of the model based on concentration measurements has been reported regularly, this has not yet been done for the deposition measurements.
Terwijl over de validatie van het model op basis van concentratiemetingen wel regelmatig gerapporteerd is, is dit voor de depositiemetingen tot op heden nog niet gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de aanpak van de stikstofproblematiek naar aanleiding van de beantwoording van schriftelijke vragen van het lid Eppink naar aanleiding van de technische toelichting op 12 mei 20

An MP asks the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the nitrogen policy: whether AERIUS emission data could use 2019 or 2020 rather than 2018, how the foreign deposition reduction is secured, the measurement and model uncertainties, the legal basis under the Habitats Directive, and the sourcing of critical deposition values and pressure factors. The minister answers that 2019 data will be used in AERIUS Monitor 2021, that foreign reduction is assumed without binding targets, that model-based calculation is legally sound, and provides references, while committing to ongoing monitoring studies.
RIVM expects to publish AERIUS Monitor 2021 in December with deposition data based on 2019 emissions.
Het RIVM verwacht in december AERIUS Monitor 2021 te publiceren met depositiedata gebaseerd op de emissies uit 2019.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Eppink over de rechterlijke uitspraken van Azerbeidzjaanse rechters en openbaar aanklagers inzake Azerbeidzjaanse oppositie, en Armeense krijgsgevangenen en burgers

Deputy Eppink (JA21) asked the Foreign Minister about Azerbaijani courts and prosecutors sentencing Armenian prisoners of war and civilians and political opponents, and about detention conditions and NGO blacklists. Minister Knapen answered that the independence of Azerbaijani justice is doubted, that the EU urges release of detainees, and that a sanctions proposal would not find EU support, without committing to new measures.
In general, question marks are placed over the independence of the judicial process in Azerbaijan.
Over het algemeen worden vraagtekens gezet bij de onafhankelijkheid van de rechtsgang in Azerbeidzjan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat 58 Afghanen via Pakistan naar Nederland worden gehaald

An MP asked whether 58 Afghans who crossed into Pakistan would be brought to the Netherlands, whether the government assisted their overland crossing despite advising against it, and whether moving them from Pakistan shows the aim is relocation to the Netherlands rather than regional protection. The minister confirmed the transfers, said travel decisions are personal responsibility, and stated that the government will keep pursuing evacuation of eligible people while preferring regional protection for others.
The cabinet wants to make a special effort for interpreters and persons who had already been called up for evacuation under the Belhaj et al. motion.
Het kabinet wil een bijzondere inspanning leveren voor tolken en de personen die reeds opgeroepen waren voor evacuatie in het kader van de motie-Belhaj c.s.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over mislukte veenvorming in het Wierdense Veld

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the Wierdense Veld peat restoration plans were unsupported, whether 'actief hoogveen' was absent and 'herstellend hoogveen' unrealistic, whether a 30-year peat-forming restoration study exists, whether the Netherlands applies a stricter definition than the EU, and whether the measures are wasteful. The minister rejected each premise, stating that consultant reports showed goals were achievable, that the 30-year criterion remains in the definition, and that the measures are justified.
Recently, the provincial executive of Overijssel decided to resume the area process.
Recent hebben gedeputeerde staten van Overijssel besloten het gebiedsproces te hervatten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het onderzoek ‘Grenzeloze Verzorgingsstaat: De gevolgen van Immigratie voor de Overheidsfinanciën’

Dutch MP Eppink asked the Finance Minister whether he endorses a study claiming immigration cost the Dutch budget 400 billion euros over 1995-2019 and whether the government will measure immigration costs. The minister declined to confirm the study's conclusions, arguing the government does not track costs by population group, and refused to add an immigration cost analysis to the 2022 budget documents or commission its own study.
Ik kan deze conclusie niet bevestigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de evacuaties en repatriëring vanuit Afghanistan

An MP from JA21 asked the Foreign Minister why the count of Dutch passport holders in Afghanistan rose from 700 to 1,250, why registration was incomplete, why many Dutch Afghans stayed despite travel advice, and how evacuation affected other eligible people. The minister explained the count reflects late registrations, that registration is voluntary, that the reasons for staying are unknown, and that the main evacuation challenges were security and airport access.
Your House will be informed prior to the plenary debate on Afghanistan through a status letter, which will include the figures.
Uw kamer wordt voorafgaand aan het plenaire debat over Afghanistan geïnformeerd middels een stand van zakenbrief.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het ondeskundig doden en de daardoor veroorzaakte lijdensweg voor de grote grazers van Stichting Taurus

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the botched killing of large grazers at Stichting Taurus, the legal and inspection framework for such culls, dioxin levels in their meat, and related subsidy and oversight questions. The Minister acknowledged the video showed inadequate killing and said the NVWA is investigating, while stating that no additional structural measures are currently planned and promising a report in early 2022.
I disapprove of the way this cull was carried out, as seen in the footage.
Ik keur de wijze waarop dit afschot is uitgevoerd, zoals te zien op de beelden, af.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink naar aanleiding van de technische toelichting op 12 mei 2021 aan de vaste commissie voor Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit over de aanpak van de stikstofproblematiek

The MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the technical briefing on nitrogen policy, covering the share of foreign nitrogen deposition, sector breakdowns, measurement uncertainty, critical deposition values and drivers of biodiversity loss. Minister Schouten answered each of the 13 questions with data from RIVM and AERIUS, providing substantive figures and explanations while declining to produce some requested overviews by pointing to the absence of a databank or pending reports.
There is no databank showing in which nature areas (including Natura 2000 areas) soil studies have been carried out regularly over the past thirty years.
Er is geen databank waaruit blijkt in welke natuurgebieden (waaronder Natura 2000-gebieden) de afgelopen dertig jaar regelmatig bodemonderzoeken zijn gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de aanwezigheid van de Nederlandse ambassadeur Jaap Werner bij de beëdiging van de Iraanse president Raisi

An MP from JA21 asked the Foreign Minister why the Dutch ambassador attended the inauguration of Iranian president Raisi, given that Hamas, Hezbollah and PIJ representatives were present, and whether this legitimises the regime despite alleged 1988 mass executions. The minister answered that attendance was standard practice shared by all EU states in Iran, that relations allow raising human rights concerns, and that there was no legitimisation or diplomatic blunder.
The ministry instructed the ambassador to attend the inauguration and report back.
Het ministerie heeft de ambassadeur de instructie gegeven de inauguratie bij te wonen en verslag te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht dat experts een bom leggen onder het Amsterdamse erfpachtstelsel

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether leasehold policy in Amsterdam is opaque, unequal and burdensome for residents, and what the government thinks of a report critical of the city. The minister answered that the matter is primarily municipal, denied that Amsterdam neglects leaseholders' interests, and pointed to the city's own transparency steps and ongoing review.
Leasehold policy is determined per municipality and in my view is first and foremost a municipal matter.
Het erfpachtbeleid wordt per gemeente bepaald en is daarmee in mijn ogen in de eerste plaats een gemeentelijke aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over twijfels over verdere samenwerking van Nederland met Iran na de beëdiging van president Ebrahim Raisi

The MP asks whether the government will reconsider cooperation with Iran after Ebrahim Raisi's inauguration, citing his alleged role in 1988 mass executions, UN calls for an independent inquiry, Iranian protest repression, JCPOA prospects, sanctions, EU aid and INSTEX. The minister acknowledges the allegations and the UN request, says accountability is a Dutch priority, rules out a visit, raises human rights concerns, keeps a critical engagement strategy with sanctions, and defends EU aid and INSTEX as serving JCPOA goals.
Accountability and combating impunity for international crimes are important parts of the international legal order and a priority in Dutch human rights policy.

Verantwoording afleggen (accountability) en het bestrijden van straffeloosheid voor internationale misdrijven zijn belangrijke onderdelen van de internationale rechtsorde en een prioriteit in het Nederlandse mensenrechtenbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de protesten in Cuba tegen het communistische regime

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Foreign Minister about the 2021 protests in Cuba, including the regime's use of force, arrests of protesters, and EU policy toward Havana. The minister acknowledged disproportionate force and arbitrary arrests, pointed to economic and freedom grievances, and said the Netherlands and EU had raised concerns and urged reform, while largely declining to comment on the political statements in questions 5 and 10.
There has been disproportionate violence by the Cuban authorities against demonstrators and arbitrary arrests and detentions of peaceful protesters and journalists.
Er is sprake geweest van disproportioneel geweld door de Cubaanse autoriteiten tegen de demonstranten en arbitraire arrestaties en detenties van vreedzame protestanten en journalisten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht ‘Fietspad ‘wordt gevaarlijk’ door nieuwe elektrische voertuigen’

MP Eppink asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether she shares concerns from Veilig Verkeer Nederland and the Fietsersbond that the new light electric vehicle framework makes cycle paths unsafe for traditional cyclists, and what concrete consultation took place. The minister replies that safety was central, that stakeholders including these groups were consulted, and that further research on local customisation and cycle-path crowding will be shared by early next year.
Further research is being conducted into the possibilities and any necessity for local customisation regarding the position on the road.
Er wordt nog nader onderzoek gedaan naar de mogelijkheden en eventuele noodzaak voor lokaal maatwerk ten aanzien van de plaats op de weg.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het onderzoek naar stikstofdepositie en kritische depositiewaarden

An MP from JA21 asked the minister whether soil-based nitrogen fixation, allegedly the largest nitrogen source, is excluded from nitrogen policy, and whether the government would commission further studies. The minister answered that the Antwerp study yields no new insights, that soil nitrogen flows are already accounted for in critical deposition values, and that no further study is needed.
No, the results have not yielded any new scientific insights.
Nee, de resultaten hebben geen nieuwe wetenschappelijke inzichten opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het bericht 'Kaag wilde Kamer informeren over fraudemelding bij stichting, ambtenaren hielden brief tegen'

An MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether senior civil servants obstructed her from informing parliament in time about suspected subsidy fraud at Stichting Mayday Rescue, and about related recovery and internal meetings. The minister denied obstruction, explaining that the policy was to report only proven malversations and to await the independent Grant Thornton investigation, which found no proven fraud; she did not recover the full EUR 3.6 million, only withholding the final payment of EUR 57,435.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over zich, tegen de wil van de Kamer, niet uitspreken namens Armeense krijgsgevangenen

An MP asked why the government did not put the Chamber-supported Eppink motion on releasing Armenian prisoners of war onto the agenda of the 21 June Foreign Affairs Council, and what steps it was taking to implement it. The minister acknowledged the motion, said she raised it through other channels and reported on implementation, and listed bilateral, EU and multilateral appeals to Azerbaijan for release.
During the two-minute debate of 17 June I indicated that I support the intent of the motion.
Tijdens het tweeminutendebat van 17 juni jl. heb ik aangegeven dat ik de strekking van de motie steun.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de berichten 'Weidevogels kunnen door roofdieren  fluiten naar nakomelingen' en 'Goed predatiebeheer behoudt grutto’s in Limburg'

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether predation of ground-nesting birds is a problem requiring national action, whether permit procedures for culling are too slow, and what national steps will be taken. The minister answered that predation is handled by the provinces through area-based management, that the provinces do not recognise the permit delay, and offered to consult the provinces on predation by predators and cats.
The competence to take measures to protect ground-nesting birds against predation lies with the provinces.
De bevoegdheid tot het nemen van maatregelen voor de bescherming van weidevogels tegen predatie ligt bij de provincies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het verbod op pulsvisserij in de Europese Unie

MP Eppink (JA21) asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality whether the Dutch pulse fishing ban should be reversed after the European Court upheld it, and what the government had done to protect Dutch pulse fishers, including whether further research and a regional approach could allow pulse trawling again. Minister Schouten answered that the Court's ruling stands, that the government had long opposed the ban and will keep raising the issue in the technical measures report, but that ICES has already assessed the science, a joint regional recommendation is unlikely, and reopening the debate or funding new research is not opportune.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Segers, Van der Plas, De Roon, Jasper van Dijk, Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder en Eppink over het bericht dat Indonesië dreigt met 'uitroeiing' separatisten op Papoea

MPs from several parties asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Indonesia threatened to 'eradicate' Papuan separatists, the killing of an intelligence officer, fears of disproportionate military violence and displacement, Papuans' political rights, and what the Netherlands would do. The minister answered that Indonesia has security duties but concerns about military presence, civilian harm and rights restrictions are shared, and said the Netherlands raises these issues bilaterally and in EU dialogue without intervening in foreign court cases.
The Netherlands will continue to press the Indonesian authorities for a meaningful dialogue between all parties involved.
Nederland zal bij de Indonesische autoriteiten blijven aandringen op een betekenisvolle dialoog, tussen alle betrokken partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de dominante marktpositie van Vlaamse mediabedrijven

An MP asked the government about the market dominance of Flemish media groups DPG and Mediahuis in Dutch newspapers, alleged Belgian state aid (zero VAT rate, bpost delivery) and whether this distorts competition and political influence. The government answered that the Belgian measures were cleared by the European Commission, that the ACM approved the Mediahuis-NDC merger with sufficient remaining competition, that editorial independence is safeguarded, and that no sector-specific protective measures are planned.

In the context of this takeover, Mediahuis committed to continue delivering morning newspapers for other publishers without their own distribution network, on reasonable terms comparable to its own papers.
Mediahuis heeft in het kader van deze overname toegezegd de bezorging van ochtendbladen van andere dagbladuitgevers zonder eigen distributienetwerk te (blijven) uitvoeren tegen redelijke voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over rechterlijk ingrijpen in het waterbeheer

An MP from JA21 asked whether the courts could force a water crisis after the nitrogen crisis, whether the minister would prevent litigation by action groups, and whether the collective action right should be curtailed. The minister answered that the Water Framework Directive exemptions make court risk low before 2027, that action groups have the same rights as citizens, and that the courts are responsible for reviewing implementation.
I see no reason to amend the collective action right.
Ik zie geen aanleiding het collectieve actierecht bij te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de toekomst van de Nederlandse kottervisserij

An MP from JA21 asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the European Parliament's call to restrict bottom trawling in coastal areas and the threat to the Dutch coastal fleet. The Minister acknowledged the resolution, said stocks have improved but cod and sea bass remain concerning, and promised continued contact with the fishing sector without committing to a concrete new step.
There is intensive contact and consultation with the fisheries sector on the various European dossiers.
Er is over de verschillende Europese dossiers intensief contact en overleg met de visserijsector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink naar aanleiding van het bericht uit het Financieele Dagblad over de winstgevendheid van banken in het klimaat van lage rentes

An MP from JA21 asked the Finance Minister whether low interest rates squeeze Dutch bank margins, whether banks are taking excessive risks in search of yield, and whether European bank consolidation should be prepared for. The minister acknowledged margin pressure and a dilemma for banks, said prudential rules and supervisors can address excessive risk, and said consolidation is hard to predict and should be watched by supervisors and competition authorities.
I will continue to monitor this topic closely and, in answer to written questions from Van Dijk (CDA), have asked DNB to update its 2019 report on negative interest rates.
Ik blijf dit onderwerp dan ook nauwgezet volgen en heb in antwoord op schriftelijke vragen van Van Dijk (CDA) 5 aan DNB gevraagd haar rapportage over negatieve rente uit 2019 te actualiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over negatieve spaarrente

An MP from JA21 asked the Finance Minister about the risk of negative savings rates, whether Belgium-style bans or thresholds should be introduced, tax deductibility, capital flight, pension sector risks and why savers should bear the cost. The minister answered that negative rates are not yet applied to ordinary savers, that DNB sees no signs of large deposit outflows, that a legal ban has mostly disadvantages, and that he will monitor developments and update DNB's analysis this summer.
As I explained above, by far most savers currently do not face a negative interest rate.
Zoals ik hiervoor heb toegelicht hebben veruit de meeste spaarders op dit moment niet te maken met een negatieve rente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over het recent door ABDTOPConsult geschreven rapport ‘Stikstofruimte voor de toekomst’

MP Eppink asked the minister why the ABDTOPConsult report on nitrogen space did not directly cite the studies behind its 70% reduction claim, whether that figure stems from a WNF/Natuurmonumenten study, and whether such policy conclusions are often based on WNF studies. The minister answered that the conclusions rest on RIVM and other established sources, that WNF material was only partly known to the consultants and matched their findings, and that the report was independently produced with traceable references.
The report 'Stikstofruimte voor de toekomst' was carried out independently with traceable source references and conclusions.
Het rapport «Stikstofruimte voor de toekomst» is onafhankelijk uitgevoerd met navolgbare bronverwijzingen en conclusies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Eppink over de mededeling dat Iran voor een volle termijn van vier jaar is verkozen tot lid van de VN-Vrouwencommissie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister how the Netherlands voted on Iran's candidacy for the UN Commission on the Status of Women, on what grounds, and how the decision was prepared, including whether the JCPOA played a role. The minister declined to disclose the vote publicly, referring to secret ballot confidentiality and a confidential annex, and denied that the JCPOA or EU coordination influenced the position.
The Netherlands does not make public statements about voting behaviour in secret ballots, because countries must be able to rely on the confidentiality of the vote they cast.
Nederland doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over stemgedrag bij geheime stemmingen, omdat landen moeten kunnen rekenen op de vertrouwelijkheid van de door hun uitgebrachte stem.

qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Van den Hul over de inzet van sneltests op scholen

MPs Asscher and Van den Hul asked whether rapid tests could be used in schools as a preventive measure, as some European countries do, and about their capacity, priority for vital professions, and turnaround times. Minister De Jonge answered that school testing can add value, that pilots face scalability and legal problems being addressed by an expert panel, that rapid tests are being prepared for self-testing, and that teachers can book priority testing with reported turnaround times of 20 to 25 hours.
In the COVID-19 status letter of 23 March I informed your House about this and explained how I am working towards further rollout of testing in education based on the experts' recommendations.

In de stand van zaken brief COVID-19 van 23 maart heb ik uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd en toegelicht hoe ik met de aanbevelingen van de deskundigen toewerk naar een verdere uitrol van testen in het onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over steun aan de culturele en creatieve sector

MP Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about an EY report showing a 31% shrinkage of the European cultural sector, and whether large public investment, private investment, a supplementary support package and a European guarantee fund are needed. The minister answered that the Netherlands is investing over 1.7 billion euros in the cultural sector, that a 414 million euro package covers the first half of 2021, and that existing EU guarantee instruments are being used, while stating that a complete picture of the crisis effects is still being mapped.
Following the advice of the Council for Culture 'Onderweg naar overmorgen', I remain in discussion about making the cultural and creative sector more agile and resilient.
Naar aanleiding van het advies van de Raad voor Cultuur «Onderweg naar overmorgen» blijf ik in gesprek over het meer wendbaar en weerbaar maken van de culturele en creatieve sector.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de voorbereidingen voor vaccinatie tegen het coronavirus

An MP asked the Health Minister why the Netherlands would vaccinate more slowly than Germany and Spain, why it relies on existing structures, and how infrastructure, personnel, materials and public information for COVID-19 vaccination are being arranged. The minister answered that rollout began in early January, that the strategy builds on existing routes and central sites, and that materials, cold storage and communication are in place or being secured, though one question was not answered in time.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de voorbereiding op een mogelijke toename van besmettingen met de Engelse coronavariant

An MP asked the health minister fourteen questions on preparedness for a possible surge of infections with the English coronavirus variant, covering case numbers, testing and quarantine capacity, hospital supplies, and school reopening. The answer is a reference to a separate letter on the COVID-19 situation, so the questions themselves are not answered in this document.
Can you answer these questions in your letter ahead of the next plenary debate on developments surrounding the coronavirus?
Kunt u deze vragen beantwoorden in uw brief voorafgaand aan het eerstvolgende plenaire debat over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Van der Graaf, Bosman, Bouali, Leijten, Asscher en Van Ojik over het juridische advies van de commissie over de Brexit-deal.

Six MPs and a Green MP asked the ministers whether the Council's Legal Service had put its advice on the Brexit deal in writing, and requested all internal and external legal advice on the deal, plus options for a smooth transition if the deal is mixed. The minister replied that the Legal Service confirmed its view only orally, that the conclusions will be written into the Council decision and a Commission statement, that the EU-only route is a political choice not binding on future deals, and that interim application of mixed parts is not possible, while the legal analysis and a confidential annex were shared with the Chamber.
There are no written opinions from the Council's Legal Service (JDR) on these questions; the JDR confirmed both points orally.
Er zijn over deze vraagstukken geen schriftelijke adviezen van de Juridische Dienst van de Raad (JDR) verschenen; de JDR heeft beide punten mondeling bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de noodgedwongen sluiting van Frascati Producties

MP Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the forced closure of production house Frascati, its effects on young talent and the theatre system, and alternatives to a bridging scheme. The minister pointed to €500,000 per year earmarked for a joint Frascati/Plan Brabant plan, referred to a letter of 7 December 2020 for consequences, and gave no direct answers on substance to most questions.
The aim is to grant this project subsidy in the first quarter of 2021.
Het streven is deze projectsubsidie in het eerste kwartaal van 2021 te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over dreigende tekorten aan testmaterialen

MP Asscher asked the health minister whether shortages of plastic testing materials for COVID-19 tests were looming, which suppliers were used, how stocks are monitored, and why the Chamber was not kept informed despite a motion. The minister replied that critical items such as filter tips are being addressed through procurement and alternative suppliers, that in-house cartridge production is being set up, and that he trusts testing targets can be met.
With the progress report that I send to the House every two weeks, I give your House an update on the state of affairs regarding testing.
Met de voortgangsrapportage die ik tweewekelijks naar de Kamer stuur geef ik uw Kamer een update over de stand van zaken rondom testen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over Omscholing Dansers Nederland

MP Asscher asks the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the financial crisis of the Dutch dancers' retraining fund ODN, including why dance companies struggle to pay premiums and what the government will do to prevent its disappearance in 2021. The Minister says collective training agreements are the responsibility of employers and employees, acknowledges a budget shortfall, and says she is in talks with the sector about a possible one-off repair but gives no firm commitment.
Agreements on training, however, like agreements on wages or working hours, are not a responsibility of the government but of employers and employees.
Afspraken over scholing zijn echter, net als afspraken over loon of werktijden, geen verantwoordelijkheid van de overheid, maar van werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de dreigende sluiting van de bibliotheek in Almelo

An MP asked ministers whether the Almelo public library faced closure due to a municipal subsidy cut and whether they would intervene. The minister acknowledged the importance of library access, said organising it is the municipality's responsibility, and noted the council reduced the cut from 200,000 to 100,000 euros so closure no longer applies.
Given the decentralised character of the library system, the way this is shaped is the responsibility of the municipality.
Gezien het decentrale karakter van het bibliotheekstelsel is de wijze waarop dit wordt vormgegeven de verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Belhaj, Van den Berge, Asscher en Kwint over het bericht ‘Culturele instellingen in chaos na coronamaatregelen

MPs asked the ministers why COVID-19 exemptions for cultural institutions differ between regions, why safety regions were unprepared, and whether a uniform rule set and RIVM-tested pilots are possible. The government answered that exemptions lapsed after the tougher measures of 13 October, that a uniform 30-visitor cap now applies and a routekaart improves predictability, and that a Fieldlab programme and RIVM advice will inform test events.
With these tougher measures, the possibility for the Safety Regions to grant exemptions has lapsed.
Met deze stevigere maatregelen is de mogelijkheid tot het verlenen van vrijstellingen door de Veiligheidsregio’s komen te vervallen.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Asscher over de onduidelijkheid die is ontstaan over het maximum aantal personen dat momenteel is toegestaan in culturele instellingen

Asscher (PvdA) asks the ministers to clarify confusion over whether cultural venues may admit more than 30 visitors after the 13 October tightening, and whether exemptions, criteria, support and quick clear guidelines will be provided. Minister Van Engelshoven answers that the exemption possibility lapsed, a 30-visitor maximum applies to theatres, concert halls and cinemas, she sympathises with the sector, and additional support money is being considered, with the answers mostly referring back to the first answer.
For the answer to this question I refer to my answer to Question 2.
Voor het antwoord op deze vraag verwijs ik naar mijn antwoord op Vraag 2.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Berge, Asscher en Kwint over het bericht ‘Cultuursector meldt met 62 procent relatief grootste omzetverlies bij UWV’

MPs Van den Berge, Asscher and Kwint asked the ministers whether the culture sector's 62 percent turnover loss at UWV, the delay in support, the adequacy of the second support package, the talent drain, the link with the April motion, sector robustness and events-sector compensation were acceptable. The minister responds that substantial support (about 1.3 billion euros in total) has been provided in stages, that the second package covers January to June 2021, and that further measures are under discussion with the sector and the Raad voor Cultuur.
I regret that institutions and businesses in the cultural and creative sector have to decide to dismiss staff because of this crisis.
Ik betreur het dat instellingen en ondernemingen in de culturele en creatieve sector door deze crisis moeten besluiten tot het ontslaan van personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de besluitvorming in de coronapandemie

MP Asscher asked the Prime Minister and the Minister of Health about the decision-making in the COVID-19 pandemic, including the clarity of the approach, the division of responsibilities and crisis structure, the informal Catshuis meetings, the criteria for the latest measures, and the role of behavioural scientists. Minister De Jonge answered that the strategy aims for targeted regional and national measures, described the layered advisory and ministerial decision-making structures, and declined to share the content of informal Catshuis discussions, citing the need for candid exchange.
It concerns informal and exploratory consultation at the initiative of the Prime Minister without a formal agenda.
Het betreft informeel en beschouwend overleg op initiatief van de Minister-President zonder formele agenda.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma, Asscher, Van Otterloo, Van Ojik en Van Wijngaarden over het bericht dat het Verenigd Koninkrijk met nieuwe wetgeving afspraken uit het uittredingsakkoord niet na dreigt te komen

Five MPs asked the government about the UK's planned Internal Market Bill, which would breach parts of the Withdrawal Agreement, and its risks for citizens' rights and Dutch nationals in the UK. The State Secretary answered that the government shares concerns, monitors citizens' rights implementation with the Commission, sees no current signs of further UK legislation undermining citizens' rights, and will consider information measures for Dutch nationals in the UK.

The government therefore monitors, together with the European Commission and in several ways, whether these rights are being honoured, including via the Joint Committee and the Dutch embassy in the UK.
Het kabinet monitort daarom samen met de Europese Commissie op verschillende manieren of deze rechten worden nagekomen, onder meer via het Gemengd Comité en via de Nederlandse ambassade in het VK.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over terugkerende vluchten met besmette reizigers

An MP asked ministers whether returning flights carrying travellers infected with COVID-19 from outbreak areas were adequately monitored, including quarantine and testing, and whether the policy on flying would be reconsidered. The ministers answered that no fellow passengers were infected, that quarantine for travellers from high-risk areas is being legally arranged, and that the general aviation policy would not change beyond offering airport testing.
Therefore, it is also desirable for travellers coming from a high-risk area to have the possibility of imposing a quarantine obligation merely because the traveller comes from such an unsafe area.

Derhalve is het ook voor reizigers die uit een hoog risicogebied komen, wenselijk om de mogelijkheid te hebben om een quarantaineplicht op te leggen vanwege het enkele feit dat de reiziger uit een dergelijk onveilig gebied komt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de oproep tot een mondkapjesplicht

MP Asscher asked the Health Minister whether the government would reconsider mask-wearing requirements in light of mayors' calls, foreign tightening, and a Utrecht study, and whether the OMT would factor in mask distribution in nursing homes. The minister answered that he asked the OMT for advice on the added value of a non-medical mask requirement in specific situations and places, referred to his letter of 30 July, and said scarcity is not relevant to that question.
Following recent developments on wider use of face masks abroad, and to be able to take a well-considered decision, on 24 July I asked the Outbreak Management Team (OMT) for advice

Naar aanleiding van de recente ontwikkelingen over het breder gebruik van mondkapjes in het buitenland en om een weloverwogen besluit hierover te kunnen nemen heb ik op 24 juli jl. het Outbreak Management Team (OMT) gevraagd om advies te geven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de aanvullende maatregelen om het coronavirus te bestrijden

MP Asscher (PvdA) asked Minister De Jonge about local COVID-19 measures, the face-mask obligation, the risk of a patchwork of local rules, wastewater monitoring thresholds, and testing and contact-tracing capacity. The minister answered that regional safety chairs can take proportionate local measures, that the mask decision depends on OMT advice and experiments, and that test and tracing targets are being scaled up, but gave no fixed thresholds or contingency plans.
The cabinet has no plans beyond those shared with the House in various letters to parliament and on rijksoverheid.nl.
Het kabinet heeft geen andere plannen dan in de diverse Kamerbrieven en op rijksoverheid.nl met de Kamer gedeeld zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het bericht dat een ventilatiesysteem het coronavirus verspreidde in een verpleeghuis.

MP Asscher asked the Health Minister why a confidential RIVM report, which reportedly found a ventilation system spread the virus in a nursing home, was not published, and whether ventilation advice and an aerosol expert should be reconsidered. The minister said the document is a confidential surveillance-meeting report that may be traceable to individuals, an investigation by the GGD is ongoing, no new research justifies changes yet, and the ventilation advice was updated on 28 July and published on the government website.
There is no question of a confidential or secret report; it concerns a confidential record of the Signaling Consultation.
Er is geen sprake van een vertrouwelijk of geheim rapport, het gaat om een vertrouwelijk verslag van het Signaleringsoverleg
Antwoord op vragen van lid Asscher over anderhalve meter afstand houden in het theater

An MP asked whether household members must keep 1.5 metres distance from each other in theatres, why this differs from rules in hospitality and transport, and whether the sector can be treated like hospitality. The minister answered that household members do not need to keep distance from each other, including in theatres, and referred back to that answer for the other questions.
No, this is not correct. Members of one household do not need to keep 1.5 metres distance from each other, not even in theatres or other cultural institutions.
Nee, dit klopt niet. Leden van één huishouden hoeven onderling geen 1,5 meter afstand te houden, ook niet in theaters of andere culturele instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de anderhalve meter in de audiovisuele sector

Labour MP Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether actors can work within 1.5 metres, whether they should be treated as contact professions, and whether new business models are needed for culture. The minister answered that a sector protocol now allows work under strict conditions, that acting is not a contact profession, and that fieldlab pilots and an advisory request to the Raad voor Cultuur are underway.
I have asked the Raad voor Cultuur for advice on how the sector can become more agile and resilient.
Ik heb de Raad voor Cultuur om advies gevraagd over hoe de sector meer wendbaar en weerbaar gaat worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het bericht dat bij een slachthuis 1 op de 5 medewerkers besmet is met corona

An MP asked the health minister about reports that one in five staff at a Groenlo slaughterhouse had tested positive for coronavirus, questioning contact tracing speed, quarantine, income protection, data completeness and housing of migrant workers. The government answered that contact tracing largely took place within 48 hours, all staff were tested and quarantined, LCI guidelines were followed, and a risk-based plan for sector outbreaks and a migrant worker protection team were being developed.
It requires a lot of investigative work to establish how many of the 'close contacts' have been tested.
Het vraagt veel uitzoekwerk om na te gaan hoeveel van de «nauwe contacten» getest zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het bericht dat het RIVM geen richtlijnen wil opleggen voor vliegverkeer

MP Asscher (PvdA) asked the health minister why the RIVM would not impose binding COVID-19 rules on air travel, questioning the evidence base, the absence of rules compared with other sectors, and whether economic motives play a role. The minister answered that the RIVM is not guided by economic motives, that aircraft ventilation and sector protocols mitigate risk, that travellers must stay home if symptomatic, and that monitoring and contact tracing will be stepped up.
The RIVM does not allow itself to be guided by economic motives when drawing up guidelines and advice.
Het RIVM laat zich bij het opstellen van richtlijnen en adviezen niet leiden door economische motieven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de Nederlandse strategie in de bestrijding van COVID-19

MP Asscher asked the government about its COVID-19 strategy, including whether it aims for containment or mitigation, the basis for contact tracing and quarantine choices, and advice on masks. Minister De Jonge answered that the strategy aims at maximal control of the virus with two central goals, and that the government will scale up testing, tracing and monitoring, while many questions were answered by reference to earlier letters or dealt with protocols and staffing.
From the start of the outbreak, the cabinet's strategy has been aimed at maximally controlling the virus.
Vanaf het begin van de uitbraak is de strategie van het kabinet gericht op het maximaal controleren van het virus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over een alternatief voor een corona-app

MP Asscher asked the Minister of Health about alternatives to a corona tracing app, including whether manual contact tracing like in Massachusetts is a good approach, how many trained tracers would be needed, and how they could be recruited, and asked for answers before the 22 April debate. The answer is a referral to a separate letter (COVID-19 update) and does not address the questions on substance.
The written questions from MP Asscher (PvdA) to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport (2020Z07145) have been answered by way of the letter 'COVID-19 Update stand van zaken'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Asscher (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport ( 2020Z07145 ) zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over nog steeds bestaande onduidelijkheid over het testbeleid

Labour MP Asscher asks Health Minister De Jonge why testing guidance for healthcare workers remains unclear despite earlier statements that all symptomatic staff could be tested from 6 April 2020, and why hospital and nursing-home guidance differs on symptoms. The minister acknowledges unclear guidance, promises clarifications and to ask RIVM to revise hospital guidance, and sets out testing and contact-tracing capacity measures, though he declines to give a full account on several points.
I will ask the RIVM whether the hospital guideline dated 1 April should be adjusted by analogy with the guideline for healthcare workers outside hospitals.
Ik zal het RIVM vragen of de richtlijn voor ziekenhuizen die van 1 april jl. is in analogie met de richtlijn voor zorgmedewerkers buiten de zorg aangepast zou moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over een noodfonds voor mensen werkzaam in de zorg

Labour MPs Asscher and Kerstens asked the Health Minister whether the ministry had contact with the initiators of a relief fund for healthcare workers infected with COVID-19, and whether the government would support a fund quickly and how much it would contribute. The minister confirmed contact occurred but, on the fund questions, only referred to a commitment in an earlier letter to parliament.
For the answer to the questions posed, I refer to the commitment I made in the letter of 15 April.
Voor het antwoord op de gestelde vragen verwijs ik naar de toezegging die ik heb gedaan in de brief van 15 april jl.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Van den Berge en Kwint over een noodfonds voor de culturele sector

Three opposition MPs asked whether the government will provide extra funds to compensate the cultural sector for lost income during the COVID-19 crisis and whether they support an emergency fund. The minister answered that an additional 300 million euros is being added for key cultural infrastructure, while pointing to general COVID-19 support measures and repeating the same reply to most follow-up questions.
The cabinet is adding 300 million euros in additional funds to the existing instruments to maintain the vital parts of the cultural infrastructure.
Het kabinet voegt € 300 miljoen additionele middelen toe aan het bestaande instrumentarium om de vitale onderdelen in de culturele infrastructuur in stand te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het interview met speciaal gezant Sijbesma bij Buitenhof

An MP asks the Health Minister about a speaker's statements on Dutch COVID-19 testing policy, including whether restrictive testing was a policy choice, how much test material was not delivered, and which suppliers reduced deliveries. The answer states the questions were answered in the weekly COVID-19 update letter, without the substantive detail here.
The written questions from MP Asscher to the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport have been answered in the letter 'COVID-19 Update state of affairs'.
De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Asscher (PvdA) aan de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 Update stand van zaken»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over het bericht 'Turkije zet grenzen open: Syriërs naar Europa'

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Justice and Security and the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkey would open its borders to Syrians heading for Europe, including Dutch diplomatic action on Idlib, the future of EU-Turkey support, and conditions on the Greek islands. The government answered that it considers this unacceptable, sees no signs of large-scale border crossings, supports enforcing the EU-Turkey Statement, and outlined EU and bilateral aid to Greece and humanitarian funding.
It is highly undesirable that people are used in this way for political purposes.
Het is zeer onwenselijk dat mensen op deze manier worden ingezet voor politieke doeleinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ellemeet over het tekort aan openbare bibliotheken

MPs Asscher and Ellemeet asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about the shortage of public libraries, including five municipalities with no library and the Council for Culture's advice to legally require each municipality to have one. The minister says every resident should have access to a full library within reasonable distance, will pursue fixes through a convenant with municipalities, provinces and the library sector, and does not rule out amending the Wsob later, but declines to make municipal libraries a legal requirement for now.
I want to follow a phased approach here. My aim is to close gaps in the system via the convenant with the other governments and the library sector.
Ik wil hier een gefaseerde aanpak volgen. Het is mijn inzet via het convenant met de andere overheden en het bibliotheekveld lacunes in het stelsel te dichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht dat het RIVM het sombere scenario uit ziet komen

Labour MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked the health minister about reports that RIVM now expects the gloomier COVID-19 scenario, and why its ICU length-of-stay and capacity assumptions differ from the 25 March briefing. The minister's reply refers to a separate written answer on the current state of affairs (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200) rather than answering the questions directly.
have been answered by means of the letter 'COVID-19 – Update on the state of affairs' (Kamerstuk 25 295, no. 200)
zijn beantwoord middels brief «COVID-19 – Update stand van zaken» (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 200 )
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over een economisch stimuleringspakket om de gevolgen van het coronavirus zoveel mogelijk op te vangen

Labour MP Asscher asked the Finance Minister whether he would adopt a broad economic stimulus package against the coronavirus, including sector-specific and vulnerable-group measures and a rescue fund, and asked for a reply before the next day. Minister Hoekstra answered that the government is taking far-reaching measures, referred to two earlier letters to parliament for details, and said the emergency package implements the Asscher motion.
That is why on 12 and 17 March two letters to parliament announced far-reaching measures to address the economic consequences of the virus.
Daarom zijn op 12 en 17 maart jl. in twee Kamerbrieven vergaande maatregelen aangekondigd om de economische gevolgen van het virus te ondervangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Gijs van Dijk, Moorlag en Nijboer over ‘de economische gevolgen van het coronavirus’

MPs from the PvdA asked the government about the economic effects of the coronavirus, including supply and demand shocks, short-time work, public investment, support for small businesses, and comparisons with Germany and Italy. The government answered that it is monitoring the situation, has announced a noodpakket of support measures (NOW wage subsidy, BMKB loan guarantees, tax deferrals, self-employed support), says a robust forecast is not yet possible, and defers further details to a CPB scenario publication.
The cabinet of course closely monitors economic developments.
Het kabinet houdt de economische ontwikkelingen vanzelfsprekend nauwlettend in de gaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de bescherming van Nederlands cultureel erfgoed

Asscher (PvdA) asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science how Dutch cultural heritage held by private parties is protected, following the Pechtold committee's finding that protection falls short, and how the Rubens drawings sale and the Collectie Nederland register should be addressed. The minister acknowledges the previous policy was too restrained, refers to her policy response on the committee's advice for concrete measures, and agrees to set up an independent expert committee to inventory and update heritage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over financiële overschotten op de Najaarsnota

Two PvdA MPs asked why a fiscal surplus of nearly 14 billion euros in mid-2019 coexists with shortages in police, healthcare and education, and whether part of it will be spent on those sectors or underspending moved to later years. The Finance Minister replied that the 2019 surplus is largely incidental, that the government has added billions structurally to these sectors, that some underspending will go to priorities such as education and undermining crime, and that underspent investment budgets were shifted to 2022-2024 via a ceiling correction.
The cabinet has now decided to spend part of the 2019 underspending on social priorities such as education, undermining crime, the nitrogen problem, legal aid, and safety and protection.

Inmiddels heeft het kabinet besloten om een deel van de onderuitputting van 2019 uit te geven aan maatschappelijke prioriteiten als onderwijs, ondermijning, de stikstofproblematiek, de rechtsbijstand en veiligheid en beschermen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher, Ploumen en Van den Hul over de rechten van LHBTI-gemeenschap en persvrijheid in Polen

MPs Asscher, Ploumen and Van den Hul asked the Foreign Minister about anti-LGBTI rhetoric by Poland's ruling PiS party, local 'LGBT-free' declarations, and press freedom in Poland. The minister acknowledged concern about the rhetoric, noted the gap between campaign rhetoric and concrete policy, and described Dutch diplomatic engagement and support for Polish civil society, while saying the press remains diverse and Poland's rule-of-law developments are monitored.

The cabinet follows developments in Poland that could affect this diversity and includes them in concerns Netherlands already actively raises bilaterally, in the EU and multilaterally about the rule of law.
Het kabinet volgt ontwikkelingen in Polen die deze diversiteit kunnen raken en betrekt die bij zorgen die Nederland nu al actief uit in bilateraal, EU- en multilateraal verband over de rechtsstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht ‘Russia invites Albania, North Macedonia to join the Eurasian Union’

MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Russia invited Albania and North Macedonia to join the Eurasian Economic Union, and about the Dutch response. The minister replied that no formal invitation was known to have been sent, that Dutch contact with EU partners and the two countries continues, and that Nederland supports their EU accession perspective and reform efforts.
To my knowledge, no formal invitation was sent to Albania or North Macedonia to join the Eurasian Economic Union.
Er is bij mijn weten geen formele uitnodiging aan Albanië of Noord-Macedonië gestuurd om lid te worden van de Euraziatische Economische Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellemeet en Asscher over inclusiviteit in de podiumkunsten en de overige culturele sector

MPs Ellemeet and Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about inclusiveness in performing arts and culture, including accessibility for disabled concert-goers, the new diversity code, funding, and building accessibility. The minister answered that accessibility is a shared sector effort, outlined a sector meeting and follow-up steps including a 2020 accessibility study, and listed government and sector funding while stating that building accessibility is primarily the owner's responsibility under existing rules.
In addition, I will commission a study in 2020 to map the accessibility of the cultural sector.
Daarnaast zal ik in 2020 een onderzoek laten uitvoeren om de toegankelijkheid van de cultuursector in kaart te brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over beleggers die het onmogelijk maken voor starters om een huis te kopen

MPs Asscher and Nijboer asked whether investors pushing up house prices make it impossible for first-time buyers to buy, and what the government will do about buy-to-let investors, owner-occupancy obligations and rent increases. The minister answered that a price effect is suggested but causality is not shown, that the government is exploring a differentiated transfer tax and box 3 changes, and that rent measures will be decided later in the autumn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den  Hul en Asscher over extra geld voor leraren dat mogelijk slechts de loonbijstelling betreft

MPs Van den Hul and Asscher asked whether the 285 million euro for teachers announced by the minister is merely the regular wage adjustment rather than new money, and how the government will address teacher shortages, school closures and the primary-education salary gap. The minister confirmed the funds are available and that solving the shortage needs a broad, shared effort, offering incidental extra money for 2020 only if social partners quickly conclude a collective agreement using the existing 285 million.
It is up to employers and employees to make agreements about this money.
Het is aan werkgevers en werknemers om afspraken te maken over dit geld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de vervreemding van objecten behorende tot het nationaal cultureel erfgoed

MP Asscher asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether she knew that historically significant Dutch objects were offered for sale on a French antiques website, whether they should have been protected, whether the Pechtold committee would advise on already sold heritage, and what current policy is on selling nationally important heritage in private hands and on state-owned heritage. The minister confirmed awareness of the website, said the current protection policy is restrictive and doubts its adequacy, and referred to the Pechtold committee's advice due in October 2019 without committing to specific measures; she described the existing Erfgoedwet framework and rules for state, provincial and municipal heritage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ellemeet over freelancejournalisten die onder het minimumloon werken

MPs Asscher and Ellemeet asked whether freelance journalists earning below the minimum wage, their falling per-assignment income, and calls for collective bargaining and competition-law exemptions are acceptable. The minister says fair pay is important, announces a planned statutory generic minimum rate for self-employed workers, leaves fair practice to the sector, and points to ongoing work on the Ellemeet/Asscher motion and an ACM guideline.
The cabinet therefore intends to introduce a statutory generic minimum rate so that self-employed persons can earn an income sufficient for a subsistence minimum.
Het kabinet is daarom voornemens om een wettelijk generiek minimumtarief in te voeren om zelfstandigen in staat te stellen een inkomen te verwerven waarmee in een bestaansminimum kan worden voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het dreigende faillissement van Utrechts Centrum voor de Kunsten en gevolgen voor diens medewerkers

MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked whether the Utrecht municipality is deliberately steering the Utrecht Centre for the Arts toward bankruptcy, leaving about 200 staff without transition pay, and whether the government will act on this. The ministers answered that the municipality has the power to end subsidies, that the courts rather than the government should judge bankruptcy motives and any disguised self-employment, and that they would not intervene in the municipality's decision.

The municipality of Utrecht has the authority to end subsidies. It is not for us as Ministers of Social Affairs and Employment and of Education, Culture and Science to judge practical situations like this.

De gemeente Utrecht heeft de bevoegdheid subsidies te beëindigen. Het is niet aan ons als Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap te oordelen over praktijksituaties als deze.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over het bericht dat Facebook toch in de fout gaat met politieke advertenties uit het buitenland

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked whether Facebook still lets foreign actors place political ads targeting other countries despite its transparency pledges, and whether self-regulation should give way to legislation. The minister acknowledged the gaps, said the government lacks power to enforce full ad transparency, and promised an inventory of existing rules and expert consultation.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Moorlag over de kabinetsplannen over het klimaatbeleid

PvdA MPs Asscher and Moorlag asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that a draft CO2 levy would largely exempt industry, whether industry would receive the revenue back, and related questions on the Climate Agreement, household energy burdens and planning bureau analyses. The minister answered that the levy is still being explored and that industry revenue will be used to green industry, but refused to send the internal draft note to parliament and gave only general responses on the other points.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher inzake bibliotheken die met sluiting worden bedreigd

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about around 30 public libraries threatened with closure due to rising care costs, and whether the government would act on the motion on small-community libraries. The minister agreed libraries are a basic facility, said municipalities are responsible for local library provision, described the selection process for the stimulation subsidy, and said the Wsob evaluation will map the network later this year.
In line with the administrative relations under the Wsob, municipalities are responsible for local library provision.
Conform de bestuurlijke verhoudingen uit de Wsob zijn gemeenten verantwoordelijk voor de lokale bibliotheekvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Moorlag en Asscher inzake het bericht “Met nieuwe PBL-cijfers daalt CO2-boete naar nul”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether, under the proposed bonus-malus system for industrial CO2 emissions, industry would pay no fine at current ETS price forecasts, and why the industry table did not use updated PBL price projections. The minister confirmed the malus could fall to zero at high ETS prices, said a new CO2 levy proposal would follow, and acknowledged citizens' concerns about energy and climate policy costs.
Once the decision-making on this proposal is complete, I will inform the House about it.
Zodra de besluitvorming over dit voorstel is afgerond zal ik de Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Ploumen over het bericht dat artiesten niet welkom zijn in Nederland

MPs Asscher and Ploumen asked whether artists refused entry to the Netherlands should be allowed to visit more easily, and whether detention of artists on unclear grounds is acceptable. The minister replied that refusals follow EU Schengen rules, that cultural exchange is valued, and that existing facilitation schemes such as Orange Carpet apply, with each visa application still assessed individually.
A decision to refuse entry and place persons in custody is always a decision surrounded by safeguards and reasoned on the basis of national, international and European legal obligations.

Een besluit om de toegang te weigeren en personen in bewaring te plaatsen is altijd op grond van de (inter)nationale en Europese juridische verplichtingen een met waarborgen omkleed en gemotiveerd besluit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over de aanpak van nepnieuws

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Minister of the Interior about the EU disinformation site EUvsDisinfo no longer covering Dutch media, the reported Facebook approval of fake political ads, dialogue with Facebook and other platforms, measures against foreign state-driven political ads, and sanctions for fake ads. The minister replied that the site's approach was adjusted, that Facebook and other firms have committed to the Code of Practice on disinformation which the government will monitor, that research on social media effects will report around summer 2019, and that sanctions exist only where Dutch law is broken since free expression is constitutionally protected.
No minutes were made of the conversations.
Van de gesprekken zijn geen verslagen gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over het met nepnieuws beïnvloeden van verkiezingen

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Interior Minister about EU and Dutch efforts against fake news influencing elections, including platform accountability after a case of a cameraman running a fake news operation on Facebook. The minister said the threat is real but no concrete signals exist for the Netherlands, and that the government relies on the EU Code of Practice on disinformation and monitoring, rejecting binding regulation for now.
The cabinet will critically monitor the implementation of the code of conduct.
Het kabinet zal de uitvoering van de gedragscode kritisch volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Asscher over seksueel overschrijdend gedrag in de cultuursector

MPs Van den Hul and Asscher asked the minister about the Brandpunt+ survey showing widespread sexual misconduct in the cultural sector, including at arts academies, and about complaint handling, action plans and an independent investigation. The minister responded that employers are primarily responsible, pointed to Arbowet obligations and Inspectie SZW enforcement, and announced a meeting with sector parties on 20 December, while declining a separate investigation of the academies or funding an independent study.
I see no reason to conduct further investigation.
Ik zie geen aanleiding nader onderzoek te doen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Verhoeven, Van der Graaf, Leijten, Van Ojik, Maeijer, Asscher, Van Rooijen, Van Raan, Bisschop, Azarkan en Baudet over de rechtsstatelijke aspecten van de machtigingsbepaling van

MPs from many parties asked the Foreign Affairs and Justice ministers whether article X of the Brexit omnibus bill, which lets ministers issue temporary general rules that can depart from existing law, undermines legislative primacy and rule-of-law safeguards, and whether they would add safeguards by amendment. The ministers reject the criticism, argue the power is a narrow, one-year transitional measure justified by Brexit's unprecedented nature and that the Council of State endorsed it, and say they will consider an amendment based on Chamber feedback.
We will, based on the views of the Chamber and further reactions from society, benevolently consider whether an amendment note is appropriate.
Wij zullen op basis van de zienswijze van de Kamer en verdere reacties uit de samenleving welwillend bezien of een nota van wijziging aangewezen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over ‘nepadvertenties op Facebook die onze democratie ondermijnen’

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Interior Minister about fake political ads on Facebook that could undermine democracy, following a Brandpunt report. The minister said she knows of no specific examples, pointed to Facebook's ad review, transparency tools and planned political ad archive, and noted she cannot guarantee such ads will not recur.
Facebook has committed to me to create an archive for political advertisements, which will also contain all removed political advertisements and advertisements that were only briefly visible.
Facebook heeft mij toegezegd een archief voor politieke advertenties te maken, dat ook alle verwijderde politieke advertenties zal bevatten en de advertenties die maar kort zichtbaar zijn geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het stuklopen van het pensioenakkoord

MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked about the collapse of the pension agreement, its contents (including RVU levy cuts, a contribution of about 7 billion euros, reduced AOW-age increase, and easier pension saving for self-employed), and whether memos were shared with MPs. The minister answered that no agreement was reached, describes the proposed package and its costs in general terms, and states that the government shared no separate memos beyond coalition-internal consultation.
Therefore there is no pension agreement.
Er is dan ook geen pensioenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Gijs van Dijk over het mislukken van een pensioenakkoord

Opposition MPs Asscher and Gijs van Dijk asked about the failed pension agreement, including whether the government was ready to decouple AOW age from life expectancy, the effect on fiscal sustainability, RVU-levy cuts and support for self-employed pension building. Minister Koolmees answered that the decoupling would have been studied by an external commission, that the measures would weaken the sustainability balance, that the RVU cut was only an ultimate offer, and that no mandatory pension for self-employed had political support because no total package was agreed.
Since it was not possible to reach agreements on this within a total package, it is not opportune to go further into possible coverage measures.
Aangezien het niet is gelukt om binnen een totaalpakket hierover afspraken te maken, is het niet opportuun om verder in te gaan op mogelijke dekkingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts en Slootweg over de voorbereiding van Nederland op een keiharde Brexit

MPs Omtzigt, Asscher, Geurts and Slootweg asked the government how prepared the Netherlands is for a no-deal Brexit, including whether the added customs, NVWA and justice capacity will be operational by 29 March 2019 and what risks remain. The government answered that NVWA and customs will only partly be staffed by that date, with temporary service reductions expected, and that departments are taking mitigating measures with the Foreign Affairs minister coordinating.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het bericht dat Russische trollen ook actief zijn in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers whether Russian troll activity in the Netherlands is a concern, whether it is criminal, and whether the government will act with platforms and at EU level against foreign influence on public opinion. The government says foreign interference is serious, points to an interdepartmental approach and EU work on online disinformation, and says whether speech is criminal is for the prosecutor to decide, while keeping talks with platforms ongoing.

The cabinet considers unwanted foreign interference very objectionable as it can undermine the political and social system and touches the foundation of the Dutch democratic legal order and open society.

Het kabinet vindt ongewenste buitenlandse inmenging zeer kwalijk aangezien dit het politieke en maatschappelijke systeem kan ondergraven en raakt aan het fundament van de Nederlandse democratische rechtsorde en open samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Van den Hul over het tekort van de VN voor vluchtelingenopvang in de regio

MPs Asscher and Van den Hul asked the government about the UN funding shortfall for Syrian refugee support in the region, Jordanian schools, employment for refugees (including women), the rules of origin, and whether denying aid workers access can be a war crime. Minister Kaag answered that Nederland commits EUR 400 million over four years, contributes to education and job programmes, supports EU flexibilisation of the rules of origin, and that the Wet Internationale Misdrijven now covers starvation and blocking aid in non-international armed conflicts.
The cabinet will allocate at least EUR 400 million over the next four years to improve prospects for refugees and host communities in the Syria region.
Het kabinet trekt de komende vier jaar ten minste EUR 400 miljoen uit voor de verbetering van de perspectieven van vluchtelingen en gastgemeenschappen in de Syrië regio.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Anne Mulder en Asscher over de gevolgen van het no deal-scenario voor Nederlandse en EU-burgers in het Verenigd Koninkrijk

MPs Omtzigt, Mulder and Asscher asked the government about the consequences of a no-deal Brexit for Dutch and EU citizens in the UK, including settled status, the need for a helpdesk, and timely information. The government answered that the UK's Settlement Scheme offers no hard guarantees, that a no-deal scenario is being prepared for, that information is provided via IND and the embassy, and that the Chamber will be briefed in September and a closed technical briefing in October.
However, this Statement of Intent offers no hard guarantees.
Dit Statement of Intent biedt echter geen harde garanties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over het proces rondom afschaffing van de dividendbelasting

An MP asks the Prime Minister why only some documents from the WOB request on the dividend tax abolition were disclosed, who prepared the 'VVD memo' and the redaction of company names, and what the contacts with the State Secretary of Finance involved. The Prime Minister answers that the other documents were withheld under the WOB decision (under court review), that civil servants supported the formation memo but details of the formation process are confidential, and that the contacts cannot be discussed without harming third-party interests.
For other documents there was no reason to depart from the content and reasoning of the WOB decision.
Ten aanzien van andere stukken was er geen aanleiding af te wijken van de inhoud en motivering van het WOB-besluit
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de eerste honderd dagen van het kabinet (gedeelte Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid)

An MP asked the Minister-President about the first hundred days of the cabinet, covering police and public-sector workers' pay and support, burnout and staff shortages, online child sexual abuse legislation, crime reporting and clearance rates, discrimination against LHBT people, sexual intimidation, and police pay demands. The Minister of Justice and Security answered most items on substance, committing to a plan on police sick leave, a consultation on new sex-crime legislation and a strategy on case durations, while declining to pre-empt police pay negotiations and referring defence, care and education questions to other ministers.
For the answers to the questions on defence, care and education, I refer you to the answers of the responsible ministers.
Voor de antwoorden op de vragen over defensie, zorg en onderwijs verwijs ik u naar de antwoorden van de verantwoordelijke ministers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Asscher over de Ien Daleslezing

MP Asscher asked the Prime Minister whether Minister Ollogren's Ien Dales lecture on article 1 of the Constitution expressed the cabinet's position, and whether her spokesperson's remark that it was more a campaign matter than a cabinet position still stood. The Prime Minister answered that the minister spoke as a cabinet member on article 1 of the Constitution, leaving room for personal examples and interpretation in the societal debate, and that the answers were sent on time.
The Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations spoke as a member of the cabinet about article 1 of the Constitution.
De Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties sprak als lid van het kabinet over art. 1 van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Asscher over de blokkade van een demonstratie

MPs Kuiken and Asscher asked the Minister of the Interior about a blockade that prevented a permitted demonstration against Zwarte Piet in Dokkum from proceeding, and whether ministers had signalled understanding for it. The minister replied that the mayor is the competent authority under the Wom, that no cabinet member judged the mayor's decisions, that the prosecution investigation is ongoing, and that she would consult mayors and the VNG on the public-order criterion.
The investigation by the Public Prosecution Service is still ongoing, and nothing further can be reported on this at present.
Het onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie loopt nog, daarover kan op dit moment verder niets worden gemeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Asscher en Nijboer over de afschaffing van de dividendbelasting

Asscher and Nijboer asked the Prime Minister whether Shell, Akzo Nobel, Unilever and Philips lobbied for abolishing the dividend tax, how the formation archive was handled, and what the effects on SMEs, housing corporations and the investment climate would be. The government answered that it talks regularly with business, that the contacts are confidential, that the formation archive contains only the listed documents, and that the effects of abolition are uncertain and not quantified in detail.
My interlocutors must be able to rely on our conversations being in principle confidential.
Mijn gesprekspartners moeten erop kunnen rekenen dat onze gesprekken in beginsel vertrouwelijk zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over "de overname van de Haagse Thomaskerk door een moskee"

PVV MPs asked whether replacing the Thomaskerk in The Hague with a mosque undermines Judeo-Christian culture, whether the municipality should be told not to facilitate Islam, and whether borders should be closed. The minister rejected the cultural-replacement framing, cited freedom of religion, said municipal contacts with religious organisations fall under local autonomy, and declined to close borders.
Maintaining contacts with religious organisations falls under municipal autonomy.
