Het onderhouden van contacten met religieuze organisaties behoort tot de gemeentelijke autonomie.
qn: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Voortman en Voordewind over het bericht ‘Strengere regels inburgering: geslaagde migranten moeten opnieuw toets afleggen’

MPs asked whether migrants who passed the state NT2 language exam must now take extra civic tests (KNM and ONA) before the IND grants a permanent residence permit, and why DUO and the IND apply different rules. The minister answered that the stricter requirement since 2015 applies to the Vreemdelingenwet for applications filed from 1 January 2015, that information for the target group will be improved, and refused to drop the extra test while promising to monitor effects.

It is therefore possible that someone who holds the NT2 diploma and became subject to the civic integration obligation before 1 January 2015 is exempt from the integration obligation under the Wet inburgering but still must pass the KNM and ONA components if they file an application for a stronger residence right after 1 January 2015.

Het is dus mogelijk dat iemand die in het bezit is van het NT2 diploma en vóór 1 januari 2015 inburgeringsplichtig is geworden, is vrijgesteld van de inburgeringsplicht op grond van de Wet inburgering maar nog wel de onderdelen KNM en ONA moet behalen indien hij ná 1 januari 2015 een aanvraag indient voor een sterker verblijfsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de handelwijze en onpartijdigheid van het UWV bij het beoordelen van de aanvragen van uitkeringen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling on the impartiality of UWV-employed medical experts and a Gelderland court finding of détournement de pouvoir in a WIA case. The minister answered that the CRvB stepping-stone plan binds courts rather than the UWV, that no procedural change is needed, that the ZW-WIA link justifies ending ZW benefits, and that the UWV has since accepted the ruling and will decide the other case promptly.
The UWV has in the meantime accepted the ruling.
Het UWV heeft inmiddels berust in de uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht "Het ging taalschool om het geld"

An MP asks the minister why signals about poor lessons and questionable practices at a language school were not acted on sooner, why its lessons continue despite a suspended quality mark, and whether the market-based integration system should be replaced by a public one. The minister explains that complaints led to a swift suspension, that inspection found adequate teaching quality, and that the quality mark was later withdrawn, while defending the current market model and promising a review of the course and exam system.
Blik op Werk received (anonymous) complaints about Maximaal Taal B.V. that were so serious that Blik op Werk took immediate action.
Blik op Werk heeft (anonieme) klachten over Maximaal Taal B.V. binnengekregen die dusdanig ernstig waren dat Blik op Werk onmiddellijk actie heeft ondernomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat een ambtenaar van de gemeente Utrecht statushouders wierf voor zijn eigen taalschool

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that a Utrecht municipal official recruited refugees for his own language school, raising conflict of interest, school quality, certification oversight and the DUO loan system. The minister confirmed the case, called such conduct unacceptable if it occurred, described the school's suspension and the Blik op Werk certification and audit system, and said the government will revise the integration rules.
Bearing in mind that this concerns a vulnerable group of people, this conduct, if it is the case, is unacceptable.
Met in het achterhoofd dat het hier om een kwetsbare groep mensen gaat, is dit gedrag, indien dit aan de orde is, onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, van Dijck en Wilders over de berichten 'Stichtingen steunen terreur' en 'Drinkwater uitgedeeld in Syrië, maar waar dan'?

PVV MPs asked how many people have been convicted in the Netherlands since 2012 for financing Islamist terrorism, whether citizens convicted of such financing can have their Dutch nationality revoked and be deported, and whether bank and money-transfer reporting duties should be tightened. The government answered that no separate figures exist because terrorism financing is not split by ideology, that nationality revocation is possible case by case for dual nationals, and that the existing Wwft reporting system needs no stricter rules.
Figures on how many people in the Netherlands have been convicted for financing Islamist terrorism are therefore not known.
Cijfers over hoeveel mensen er in Nederland zijn veroordeeld voor het financieren van islamitisch terrorisme zijn daarom niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de uitzending van EenVandaag dat het opnieuw klachten regent over supermarktketen Aldi

An SP MP asked the minister about an EenVandaag report on high workload, pressure and intimidation at supermarket chain Aldi, and whether the Labour Inspectorate had been monitoring Aldi since its 2013 enforcement action. The state secretary answered that employers bear primary responsibility, that the Inspectorate can investigate on complaints and found Aldi compliant after 2013-2014 action, and that no further sanctions or changes to the Inspectorate's approach are planned.
It is the responsibility of companies to comply with laws and regulations.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van bedrijven om zich aan wet- en regelgeving te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over het niet zorgvuldig omgaan met het medisch beroepsgeheim door het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV staff without authority accessing and processing confidential medical data, and about privacy breaches and whether promised measures were implemented. The minister answered that the Dutch Data Protection Authority found a violation of Article 16 Wbp, that UWV will introduce a new model under insurance physician supervision by 1 January 2019, and that earlier measures were implemented but did not fully follow the expert advice.

My predecessor informed the House on 16 March 2016 that information was expected from the UWV about the views of the Dutch Data Protection Authority on the processing of data by case management staff.
Mijn ambtsvoorganger heeft uw Kamer op 16 maart 2016 laten weten dat er informatie wordt verwacht van het UWV over de opvattingen van de Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over het bericht 'Werkgevers kunnen niet zomaar om FNV heen'

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that employers cannot simply bypass FNV, and how it squares with earlier answers on the Inretail/Alternatief voor vakbond Sunday allowance, and what it means for CAOs signed with small unions. The minister answered that representativeness is in principle irrelevant for algemeen verbindendverklaring, that the ruling concerns individual contract clauses with specific circumstances and draws no general conclusions, and that no regulatory revision is needed while the case is under appeal.
No general conclusions can be drawn from the specific circumstances of this ruling about CAOs concluded with an employee organisation of limited size.
Uit de specifieke omstandigheden van deze uitspraak zijn geen algemene gevolgtrekkingen te doen over cao's die worden afgesloten met een werknemersorganisatie van beperkte omvang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over het bericht dat Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders in Europa zouden hebben gewerkt aan de bouw van een Deens marineschip

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked whether North Korean forced labour was used to build a Danish navy vessel, a NATO ally's ship, and whether this poses a security risk and has been raised in NATO. The government answered that the issue has not been discussed in NATO, that individual allies bear responsibility for ships they make available, that the Danish government cannot yet confirm or deny the reports, and that the EU has adopted measures to reduce North Korean workers in the EU to zero.
The matter has not been discussed within NATO.
De kwestie is niet in NAVO-verband besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Westerveld over de uitzending ‘Hoe kan het gastouderschap beter?’ van De Monitor

Westerveld (GroenLinks) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about inadequate oversight of childminders (gastouders) after a De Monitor broadcast, including whether GGD inspection of only about 5% of childminders is enough and whether commercial childminding agencies should inspect them. The Minister says municipalities and GGDs are responsible, that inspection shares range from 5% to 30% by municipality, that a Utrecht University quality study is underway, and that the issue is left to his successor, committing to no concrete step beyond informing parliament later.
Supervision and enforcement of childminding is a statutory responsibility of municipalities and GGDs.
Het toezicht en de handhaving op gastouderopvang is een wettelijke verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten en GGD-en.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat maaltijdbezorger Deliveroo alle koeriers in loondienst gaat vervangen door (schijn)zelfstandigen

MP Van Kent asked the minister whether Deliveroo's replacement of employed couriers with (pseudo-)self-employed workers could be addressed, including the bargaining position of couriers, Inspectorate enforcement and the demands of the Riders Union. Minister Asscher answered that he has no insight into the couriers' bargaining position, that he does not comment on specific Inspectorate investigations, and that he finds collective organising by couriers a suitable means.
I do not make any statements about possible concrete investigations by the Inspectorate SZW.
Over eventuele concrete onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Azmani over het bericht ‘Omstreden alFitrah legt 1,7 miljoen euro op tafel en koopt pand alsnog’

MPs Tellegen and Azmani asked the government about reports that the contested alFitrah organisation bought a building with 1.7 million euros, and about its financial transparency, Kuwaiti funding and possible sanctions. The minister said the funds came via a Dutch company, that a criminal investigation is ongoing, that transparency measures such as a foundations publication duty are being examined, and that the municipality of Utrecht uses the three-track approach.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van den Hul en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht dat Amsterdamse werkgevers hun neus ophalen voor MBO’ers

MPs Van den Hul and Gijs van Dijk asked the ministers about a report that Amsterdam employers demand too high qualifications from MBO graduates, and whether this disadvantages low-educated and other groups. Minister Asscher answered that the labour market is improving, that the evidence on higher requirements is qualitative and contested, and pointed to existing policy instruments without committing to a new concrete step.
The UWV gives no quantitative substantiation here, so there is no indication of the size of this difference.
Het UWV geeft hierbij geen cijfermatige onderbouwing, waardoor er geen indicatie voorhanden is van de omvang van dit verschil.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat met asbest besmet straalgrit gebruikt is door 140 bedrijven

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that asbestos-contaminated blasting grit from Eurogrit was used by about 140 firms, including questions on worker safety, exposure norms, and whether one national inspectorate should replace the fragmented oversight. The minister answered that inspectorates are investigating origin and exposure, applying the strictest risk class during cleanup, and cooperating, but declined to commit to merging inspectorates, arguing that merging does not automatically improve inspection.
Merging organisations does not by definition result in a better inspectorate.
Het samenvoegen van organisaties levert niet per definitie een betere inspectie op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Nederland weer een stukje meer Turks: Enschede krijgt joekel van een azaantoetermoskee'

Two PVV MPs asked the government whether it shares their view that Islam should be reduced in the Netherlands and that Turkish state influence via Diyanet and a planned mosque in Enschede should be curbed. The minister answered that islamisation is not occurring, all religions are treated equally, the government will increase transparency of religious institutions, and permit decisions for the mosque are a municipal matter handled after objections were considered.
Granting permits and determining zoning plans is the responsibility of the relevant municipality and therefore a local matter.
Het verlenen van vergunningen, bepalen van de bestemmingsplannen etc. is de verantwoordelijkheid van de desbetreffende gemeente en dus een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Van Brenk over het onderzoek 'De schaduwzijden van Graniet'

MPs Sazias and Van Brenk asked the government about a report on modern slavery, child labour and dangerous conditions in South Indian granite quarries, including what the government is doing with importing firms, procurement and the multi-stakeholder natural stone covenant. The Minister says a covenant is being negotiated with the sector, will raise the issue in the EU-India human rights dialogue and with the ILO, expects companies to carry out due diligence under the OECD guidelines, and notes that public procurement and decentralised governments are being engaged, though no mandatory transparency rules are planned.
Are you prepared to require companies to be fully transparent about their supply chain policy regarding their duty of care to promote human rights?
Bent u bereid bedrijven te verplichten volledig transparant te zijn over hun keten (beleid) op het gebied van hun zorgplicht voor het bevorderen van mensenrechten?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over statushouders die klem komen te zitten tussen Participatiewet en de Wet inburgering 2013

An SP MP asked the minister about refugees (statushouders) being squeezed between the Participatiewet and the integration law, citing a KIS study, long workdays at a reintegration firm in Amstelveen, and whether municipalities are violating the spirit of the law. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible, that the matter is for the municipal council to supervise, that individual cases fall to municipalities, and committed to general cooperation agreements with VNG but no new national action.
First and foremost, it is for the municipal council to supervise the executive board.
Het is allereerst aan de gemeenteraad om het college te controleren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over de relatie tussen Air France en KLM

An SP MP asked the ministers whether Air France KLM's plan to create a low-cost airline (Joon) would rely on weaker labour conditions, whether it would affect KLM routes and Dutch staff, and how the government reacts to a leaked report on the Air France-KLM relationship. The state secretary answered that labour terms are for employers and employees to agree within legal limits, that Joon will not hinder KLM's growth, that no effects on the Dutch labour market are expected, and that KLM and Air France will draw lessons from the report.
It is up to Air France KLM to decide which destinations it will fly to with the new airline Joon and to provide information about this.
Het is aan Air France KLM om te bepalen op welke bestemmingen men gaat vliegen met de nieuwe luchtvaartmaatschappij Joon en daarover informatie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de nieuwe terreurdreiging van rechts komt

An MP asked the ministers whether far-right extremist groups exist within the armed forces, whether the government downplays right-wing extremism, and how much capacity is devoted to countering it. The government answered that the MIVD investigates threats from extremists within defence, that right-wing extremism is addressed generically without separate capacity figures, and that the threat is not underestimated.
It is therefore not possible to provide an overview of deployed capacity or financial resources on extremism with a specific ideological background.
Het is daarom niet mogelijk om een overzicht te geven van ingezette capaciteit of financiële middelen op extremisme met een specifieke ideologische achtergrond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Westerveld en Özdil over het bericht 'FNV: doorgeslagen flex in kinderopvang'

Two GroenLinks MPs asked the minister about union FNV's claim of excessive flexible employment in childcare, and whether public provision could bring more permanent contracts. The minister defended market functioning, attributed flexibility to cyclical demand, and declined to study conversion to a public system, leaving that to a successor.
At this moment I am not willing to examine its effects further, partly because such an assessment is for my successor.
Op dit moment ben ik niet bereid de effecten ervan verder te onderzoeken, mede omdat een dergelijke afweging aan mijn opvolger is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bouali, Groothuizen en Sjoerdsma over de invloed van salafisten in Nederlandse moskeeën

MPs from D66 asked ministers about Saudi-funded study places at the Islamic University of Medina, salafist takeovers of mosques, violence in mosque power struggles, and whether municipalities monitor foreign funding of religious institutions. The government answered that registration data are incomplete, Saudi scholarships are a voluntary choice not disclosed in Notes Verbales, it lacks data on violent incidents or lecture funding, and it promised a tri-track municipal approach and a further handling framework.
The Public Prosecution Service and the police do not register violent incidents at mosques in the context of the power struggle as referred to in the question.
Het Openbaar Ministerie en de politie registreren niet op gewelddadige incidenten bij moskeeën in het kader van de machtsstrijd zoals in de vraag bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten 'Gemeente blind' en 'Bilal L. bleek wolf in schaapskleren te zijn'

PVV MPs asked the Social Affairs and Justice ministers how a convicted terror suspect who recruited for jihad came to be hired as a deradicalisation youth worker by Amsterdam, whether the mayor knew, and whether comparable figures are employed and nationality can be revoked. The government answered that Amsterdam is autonomously responsible, the mayor knew of the hiring, Amsterdam will no longer hire people who went through radicalisation, and nationality revocation is only possible under narrow legal grounds which it does not discuss for individual cases.
Amsterdam municipality is responsible for the local approach to jihadism in Amsterdam and its implementation, and shapes this policy autonomously.
Gemeente Amsterdam is verantwoordelijk voor de Amsterdamse lokale aanpak jihadisme en de uitvoering daarvan en geeft autonoom vorm aan dit beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het bericht dat de helft van de gemeenten nauwelijks iets doet tegen radicalisering

An MP asked whether the government is aware that half of municipalities, especially small and medium-sized ones, do little against radicalisation, and how it will embed the national counter-terrorism policy locally. The minister acknowledges uneven municipal activity, points to regional structures, versterkingsgelden, and national training and support (ROR, ESS), and promises to report on use of funds in response to a motion.

Like the VNG, I consider it important that at regional level the problem is mapped, knowledge and expertise are in order, and cooperation structures exist through which signals can come in and be followed up.

Wel vind ik het, evenals de VNG, van belang dat op regionaal niveau de problematiek in kaart is gebracht, kennis en kunde op orde is en samenwerkingsverbanden en structuren bestaan waarbij bijvoorbeeld signalen kunnen binnenkomen en worden opgevolgd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de werkwijze van de commerciële arbodienst GOED

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the practices of commercial occupational health service GOED, including alleged use of doctors without specialist training, and whether the system is structurally flawed. The minister said the system functions adequately, incidents are handled within existing channels, certificates can be suspended, and eigenrisicodragerschap for sickness benefit should be kept.
I have no enforcement power over occupational health services if a person falsely presents themselves as an occupational physician.
Ik heb geen handhavende bevoegdheid bij arbodiensten indien een persoon zich ten onrechte uitgeeft voor bedrijfsarts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van 't Wout en Koopmans over het bericht “Sollicitant niet meer vogelvrij op internet.”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Justice about an Article 29 Working Party opinion on employers screening job applicants' social media profiles, and how it fits with Dutch privacy law and UWV training. The government answered that the opinion does not change existing rules, that the Wet bescherming persoonsgegevens (and later the AVG) leaves room for a necessary, transparent online check, and that no contradictory signal was given.
If a profile serves a professional purpose, it may more readily be justified than a private profile.
Als er sprake is van een profiel dat een professioneel doeleinde dient, zal daar eerder sprake van kunnen zijn dan als het een privé profiel betreft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat maaltijdbezorger Deliveroo alle koeriers in loondienst gaat vervangen door (schijn)zelfstandigen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Deliveroo replacing employed couriers with (pseudo-)self-employed workers is acceptable, and about the resulting risks and enforcement gaps. The minister answered that individual status is for courts to decide, pointed to existing protections, and announced an independent gig-economy study due in spring 2018 plus minimum-wage and sham-arrangement measures.
It is for a judge, and not for me, to assess the facts and circumstances of an individual case and to rule on whether someone works under an employment contract or not.

Het is aan een rechter, en niet aan mij, om de feiten en omstandigheden van een individueel geval te beoordelen en een uitspraak te doen over de vragen of iemand werkzaam is in dienstbetrekking of niet
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over de arbeidsinkomensquote

The MPs Leijten and Van Dijk (SP) asked why the labour income share has not risen despite falling unemployment, why unused labour supply remains large, whether flexible work suppresses wages, whether profits drive investment, and why purchasing power lags growth. Minister Asscher answers that wage growth is expected to pick up in a tightening labour market, that wage policy is largely a matter for social partners, and that the links between profits, investment and the labour share are not clear-cut.
Wage formation takes place at three levels: at the level of the legislator, at the level of the social partners and at the level of individual employers and employees.
Loonvorming vindt plaats op drie niveaus: op het niveau van de wetgever, op het niveau van de sociale partners en op het niveau van de individuele werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over het bericht “aantal afgekeurde ouderen stijgt sterk; voor zware beroepen komt pensioen te laat”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that disability awards among older workers have risen sharply, especially in heavy occupations where retirement is delayed, and about the lack of progress on a heavy-occupations scheme from the 2011 pension agreement, plus CPB projections and the net fiscal effect of raising the AOW age. The State Secretary answered that the rise reflects more older workers and higher average age rather than a failure of policy, that a heavy-occupations definition has proven difficult and is being explored with social partners, that the AOW age increase still improves public finances, and that flexibility and employer-employee solutions are to be encouraged.
It is known that the chance of entering the WIA disability scheme increases as an employee gets older.
Het is bekend dat de kans om de WIA in te stromen, toeneemt naarmate een werknemer ouder is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de inzet van vrijwilligers bij de jaarwisseling in Den Haag

An MP asked ministers about reports that Salafists were standing watch during New Year's Eve in The Hague's Schilderswijk and about cooperation between the city and the as-Soennah mosque, including whether a Chamber motion to end such cooperation would be implemented. The government replied that local triangle bodies decide on cooperation with organisations, pointed to a normative framework sent to Parliament, and said police and municipality maintain a dialogue with a wide range of organisations.
In the local context, it remains up to the municipality to organise the involvement of organisations when shaping its integrated security policy.
In de lokale context blijft het aan de gemeente om bij de vormgeving van haar integraal veiligheidsbeleid betrokkenheid van organisaties te organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en De Graaf over de inzet van vrijwilligers bij de jaarwisseling in Den Haag

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked ministers whether the Hague mayor's use of volunteers for New Year's Eve, reportedly including salafist-linked actors, breaches public order, whether they will prevent a 'sharia police', and whether the mayor should be dismissed. The government answered that volunteers have no special powers and are supervised by police, and that judging the mayor's performance is a matter for the municipal council.
The judgement on the functioning of the mayor of The Hague is a matter for the municipal council.
Het oordeel over het functioneren van de burgemeester van Den Haag is aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Haatsjeik toch actief in Den Haag'

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Justice whether a convicted Islamic preacher runs an illegal mosque in The Hague, and whether such individuals may act as preachers and should be shut down. The government answered that the leased premises may only be used for commercial activities, that the municipality has ordered the owner to stop the non-conforming use with legal follow-up threatened, and that the Justice minister imposed an area ban on the individual, while freedom of religion precludes 'deislamisation'.
The Hague municipality has meanwhile ordered the owner of the premises on Cilliersstraat to end the non-conforming use.
De gemeente Den Haag heeft de eigenaar van het pand aan de Cilliersstraat inmiddels gesommeerd het strijdige gebruik te beëindigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over het bericht dat een zieke die zijn baan verliest niet ‘gestraft’ mag worden met een lagere WW-uitkering

An MP asked whether the minister would respond to a Centrale Raad van Beroep ruling that sick workers losing their jobs must not receive a lower WW unemployment benefit, and whether benefits wrongly calculated since 2015 would be compensated. The minister announced amended regulations and a one-off compensation scheme, but said UWV systems changes will take time and that corrections will be made only in specific cases the court identified.
At my request, UWV has informed me that it is examining from which date and in what way the new regulations can be applied to new WW benefit applications.

Het UWV heeft mij desgevraagd laten weten dat het de mogelijkheden onderzoekt met ingang van welke datum en op welke manier de nieuwe regelgeving kan worden toegepast op nieuwe aanvragen om WW-uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Von Martels en Geurts over het landelijk asbestvolgsysteem en de programmatische aanpak asbestdaken

CDA MPs asked the State Secretary about recurring faults, slowness and usability problems with the national asbestos tracking system LAVS, and about rules that prevent combining indoor and outdoor asbestos removal on agricultural buildings. The government answers that problems are normal during ICT development, that capacity and user meetings are being improved, and that combined indoor-outdoor removal is not prohibited, with a handbook under review.
In consultation with users, problems are discussed and addressed as quickly as possible.
In overleg met de gebruikers worden problemen besproken en zo snel mogelijk geadresseerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de gevolgen van betaaldata van de WW sinds 1 juli 2015

MP Van Kent asks whether the shift of WW unemployment benefit payments to monthly payment in arrears since July 2015 causes payment problems, and whether a choice between two payment options should be introduced. Minister Asscher replies he knows of no problem signals beyond advance requests, that advances are rare, and that he prefers keeping the existing system, explaining the drawbacks of the alternative option.

Based on information from UWV, apart from requests for advance payment, I am aware of no signals that people are getting into trouble because the WW benefit is only paid after the end of the month to which it relates.

Er zijn mij op basis van informatie van UWV, behoudens verzoeken om bevoorschotting, geen signalen bekend dat mensen in problemen komen doordat de WW-uitkering pas wordt betaald na afloop van de maand waarop deze betrekking heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Islamschool paait jongere met gratis laptop of elektrische fiets'

PVV MPs asked whether Islamic schools should be banned, whether existing ones should be closed, and whether schools should be barred from visiting mosques, following a report on an Islamic school offering pupils gifts. The State Secretary answered that education is free under Article 23 of the Constitution, that schools must meet legal quality requirements including on citizenship and he will act where they do not, and that refused closures and mosque bans, leaving school visits to schools and parents.
Where schools do not comply with statutory quality requirements, including on citizenship, I will of course intervene for that reason.
Waar scholen zich niet houden aan wettelijke kwaliteitseisen, waaronder ten aanzien van burgerschap, treed ik om die reden uiteraard wel op.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht dat een nieuwe islamitische school in Amsterdam bekostigd moet worden door het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap

MPs De Graaf, Beertema and Wilders asked whether the Council of State's ruling obliging the Ministry to fund a new Islamic school in Amsterdam, despite concerns about IS sympathies, could be reconsidered and whether any Islamic education should be allowed. The Secretary of State answered that the ruling is respected and funding has started, that the Inspectorate will supervise the school and may enforce, and that a bill introducing a quality test for new schools is in preparation.
I have already prepared the bill Meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen, which introduces a quality test for approval of a new publicly funded school.
Ik heb reeds het wetsvoorstel Meer ruimte voor nieuwe scholen in voorbereiding, waarmee ik een kwaliteitstoets introduceer voor de goedkeuring van een nieuwe bekostigde school.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Karabulut over het nader antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma c.s. inzake het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religieuze instellinge

MPs Sjoerdsma and Karabulut asked how Saudi Arabia and Kuwait share information via Notes Verbales about funding requests from Dutch religious institutions, when the Labour Minister was informed, and what action has been taken on earlier motions. The government answered that the information is shared confidentially, that since 2016 it goes to several agencies including SZW, and that only one case led to ended funding, with a convenant on transparency under discussion.
This information was obtained through diplomatic channels and is therefore confidential.
Deze informatie is verkregen via diplomatiek verkeer en daarmee vertrouwelijk.
Vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan (beiden DENK) aan de Ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over de demonstraties in Marokko (ingezonden 1 juni 2017).

DENK MPs asked the foreign and social affairs ministers about protests in northern Morocco, the government's stance, the response of Moroccan authorities, arrests, tensions in the Netherlands, contact with Morocco, risks to Dutch nationals and possible de-escalation. The minister answered that peaceful protest is a right, that incidents should be investigated, that exact arrest numbers cannot be verified, that Dutch nationals face no generally increased danger, and that Dutch projects in the region contribute, while the resolution lies with Moroccan actors.
The exact number of arrests cannot currently be verified.
Het exacte aantal arrestaties is op dit moment niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat werkenden een steeds kleiner deel van de koek krijgen

MPs Leijten and Van Dijk asked whether the government would act on reports that workers receive a shrinking share of market-sector income, including what it could do to raise the labour income share and whether public-sector pay could influence private wages. The minister replied that the labour income share is a wage-room indicator, that wage-setting is left to social partners and decentralised bargaining, and that the government gave no concrete new measures, leaving flex-contract and other choices to the next cabinet.
The main conclusion, however, was that wage policy requires tailoring and is therefore a matter for decentralised (collective agreement) parties.
Belangrijkste conclusie was echter dat loonbeleid maatwerk vereist en (dus) aan decentrale (cao-)partijen is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de werkwijze van de commerciële arbodienst GOED

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a private occupational health service (GOED) that pressured sick employees, including breast cancer patients, to return to work and used non-physician 'employability experts'. The minister called the pressure unacceptable, explained the legal role of company doctors and certifying bodies, and reported that a Nivel study on task delegation is underway with legislative changes already made.
Pressuring sick people to return to work when it has not been established that they are able to do so is, in my view, not acceptable.
Het onder druk zetten van zieke mensen om weer aan het werk te gaan wanneer niet is vastgesteld dat zij daartoe in staat zijn, vind ik niet acceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bisschop over de resolutie van het Europees parlement inzake de bestrijding van antisemitisme

An SGP MP asked the government about the European Parliament's resolution on combating antisemitism, including adopting the IHRA working definition, the BDS movement, separate registration, and a national coordinator. The government answered that it supports the non-binding IHRA definition but sees no added value in a binding one, that antisemitism is already registered separately by police, and that it sees no added value in a national coordinator given existing prevention efforts.
At present the cabinet sees no added value in adopting a legally binding international definition, because definitions have different effects in different legal systems.

Op dit moment ziet het kabinet geen toegevoegde waarde in het aannemen van een juridisch bindende internationale definitie, omdat definities een verschillende doorwerking hebben in verschillende rechtssystemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke en Karabulut over Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders in Europa

MPs Ten Broeke and Karabulut asked the government about reports that North Korean workers in Europe, largely in Poland, are subjected to forced labour that funds the North Korean state, and about the government's knowledge, EU subsidies and NATO-ship links. Minister Asscher answered that Poland has found no illegal work or forced labour, that the matter has been raised in the UN, Council and International Labour Conference, that EU subsidy control lies first with member states, and that no North Korean workers were found working on Dutch navy ships at CRIST.
Precise amounts are not known and estimates vary.
Precieze bedragen zijn niet bekend en schattingen lopen uiteen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over belabberde arbeidsomstandigheden in het inburgeringsonderwijs

MP Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about poor working conditions for civic integration teachers, precarious contracts since market liberalisation in 2007, lack of collective agreement coverage, poor facilities, and calls for Inspectorate oversight. Minister Asscher answered that employers must ensure safe conditions, that disputes should be handled internally with the Inspectorate SZW as last resort, that toezicht on lesson quality is being set up with the Inspectorate of Education involved, that changing the system is not on the agenda, and that he sees no reason to sign the petition.
I am working along several lines to improve this.
Ik werk langs verschillende lijnen om dit te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over de resolutie van het Europees parlement over de bestrijding van antisemitisme

The MP Kuzu asks the ministers about the European Parliament's resolution on combating antisemitism and the IHRA working definition, including whether the definition is legally unclear and risks restricting free speech on Israel. Minister Asscher answers that definitions work differently across legal systems, that Dutch criminal law is leading, that expressions about Israel remain protected by free speech, and that existing anti-discrimination instruments are effective.
Statements about Israel are protected by freedom of expression.
Uitlatingen over Israël worden beschermd door de vrijheid van meningsuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Kent over de derde monitor artsencapaciteit UWV

Deputy Van Kent (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UWV's third monitor on physician capacity: whether assessment quality suffers under workload, whether assessments are done by registered insurance physicians or delegated to trainees, the number and duration of delayed claim assessments, and whether Wajong re-assessments should stop until backlogs are cleared. The minister answered that UWV assures quality safeguards apply regardless of workload, registered physicians remain responsible, about 2,188 claim assessments were delayed in April 2017 (up from 1,535 in 2015), no advance-payment delays exist, and he refused to halt Wajong re-assessments.
UWV monitors whether it can carry out its task at the desired quality level and I follow this.
UWV monitort of het zijn taak op het gewenste kwaliteitsniveau uit kan voeren en ik volg dit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Raak over het bericht dat Google gebruikersgegevens in buitenlandse datacentra moet overhandigen aan de VS

Two SP MPs asked whether personal data held by UWV and other government bodies, including data stored abroad, can be guaranteed to stay out of reach of the US government after reports that Google must hand over user data. The government answered that it cannot give such a guarantee because legal bases such as mutual legal assistance treaties allow transfers to the US, and it does not plan extra measures against foreign storage beyond case-by-case risk assessment.
No, I cannot give that guarantee.
Nee, die garantie kan ik niet geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Nijboer over de matige loongroei en flexibilisering

MPs Gijs van Dijk and Nijboer asked the Minister of Social Affairs about moderate wage growth, whether labour market flexibilisation explains it, and whether research and action on flexibility, pensions and insurance for self-employed workers are warranted. The minister said wage growth is moderate mainly because of unused labour supply and that there is no one-to-one proof linking flexibility to wages, and promised to consult the CPB and DNB on whether additional research is needed.
I will discuss this with the CPB and DNB and examine whether additional research is needed.
Ik zal in gesprek gaan met het CPB en DNB en bezien of aanvullend onderzoek nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht 'Den Haag neemt vijftig vluchtelingen in dienst'

An MP asks whether Den Haag's plan to create 50 work-experience places for refugees is scandalous given high unemployment, and whether the municipality's funding should be cut. The minister rejects the criticism, saying statushouders should participate via paid work, that the places are a stepping stone and fall under the municipality's Participatiewet discretion, and that he will not cut the municipal fund.
I do not share your view.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kwint en Van Kent over het bericht dat stageplekken soms ‘verkapte werkplekken zijn, waar je geen cent voor krijgt’

MPs Kwint and Van Kent asked the ministers whether internships are sometimes disguised regular jobs without pay, how often complaints occur, whether complaints are reported to SBB and the Inspectorate, what the rules on allowances are, and whether a study or safeguards are needed. The minister answers that abuse occurs mainly after graduation, that a sector analysis is underway, that complaints are few and under-reported, that the Inspectorate handles individual reports but does not mediate them, and that no extra study of in-school internships is needed.
To better map the extent of internship abuse after graduation in problem sectors, the Minister of SZW is having a study carried out.
Om de omvang van stagemisbruik na afstuderen in probleemsectoren beter in beeld te brengen laat de Minister van SZW een onderzoek uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Kent en Jasper van Dijk over de uitzending van Tros Radar Extra over oudere werklozen die nauwelijks kans op een baan hebben

MPs Van Kent and Jasper van Dijk (SP) asked the ministers about a Tros Radar report on older unemployed people with very little chance of work, including low re-employment odds, income loss from short jobs, home-ownership and benefit rules, the job-search obligation, and basic income. The government said it is acting through the 50-plus action plan, that the re-employment chance is well above 3%, that asset rules allow municipal loans against a home, and that it is not pursuing basic income, while pointing to municipal experimentation powers.
The cabinet also considers unemployment among people over fifty to still be too high.
Het kabinet is eveneens van mening dat de werkloosheid onder vijftigplussers nog steeds te hoog is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Heerma over de indeling van uitzendbureaus en andere organisaties bij de sectorcodes sociale zekerheid, waardoor sociale lasten fors kunnen toenemen

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked why a May 2017 ministerial regulation freezes the option for new temp-work agencies to be classed in a craft sector rather than the temp sector, raising social premiums, and questioned its justification, legal basis and why parliament was not informed. Minister Asscher answered that the freeze is a temporary measure pending a definitive rule by 2019, that sector premium differences of roughly 4 to 7 percentage points result, and that the change was made quickly without prior notice to parliament.
I considered rapid action necessary given the increasing speed with which temp work has shifted away from the temp-agency sector to other sectors.
Ik achtte een snelle actie noodzakelijk gezien de toenemende snelheid waarmee de verschuiving van uitzendarbeid vanuit de sector uitzendbedrijven naar andere sectoren is opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat bedrijven het convenant Werk en Kanker ondertekenen

An MP asked whether the government will sign the Werk en Kanker covenant, what it will do about stigma and discrimination against former cancer patients, and about D66's proposals. The minister said the covenant is a private initiative, the government as employer already ensures equal treatment, and the minister will wait for the results of the no-risk policy experiment and the AFM review of insurers' claim assessment.
I want to await the outcomes of this.
Ik wil de uitkomsten hiervan afwachten.
Antwoord op van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over dagelijkse ramadanlezingen op de website van ‘Instituut Dar el Huda’

PVV MPs asked whether a Dutch public primary school hosting daily Ramadan lectures on a mosque institute's website is acceptable, whether similar cases exist, and whether harsh measures or closure of Islamic schools will be taken. The government replied that the lectures are a rental of a room in the evening by an outside foundation, not a school activity, that no violation of law exists so no measures are warranted, and that closing Islamic schools would violate constitutional freedoms of religion and education.
It is not recorded whether rooms in buildings housing a school are rented out and what these rooms are then used for.
Er wordt niet bijgehouden of ruimtes in gebouwen waar een school in is gevestigd worden verhuurd en waar deze ruimtes dan voor worden ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over fraude met reiskostenvergoedingen voor Oost-Europese uitzendkrachten in de scheepsbouw

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about large travel-cost allowances on payslips of Eastern European agency workers in shipbuilding, suspected of evading social premiums, and whether payslips meet WAS transparency and language requirements. The minister answered that allowances must be specified and that the Inspectorate can fine violations and pass signals to the Tax Authority, but declined to comment on ongoing investigations and did not commit to a new inquiry.
As is customary, I do not comment on any ongoing investigations by the Labour Inspectorate.
Zoals gebruikelijk doe ik geen uitspraken over eventuele lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over de bezorgplannen van McDonald’s en Uber Eats

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about McDonald's partnership with Uber Eats for food delivery, including whether delivery workers, who are self-employed, are adequately insured and whether the government will talk to the companies and prepare a plan for a new cabinet. The minister said companies are responsible for their own arrangements within existing law, noted that self-employed workers can choose to insure themselves, referred to a minimum wage change from 2018 and existing studies, and left the policy choices to a new cabinet.
It is not for the government to prescribe to companies how they should organise their business processes.
Het is niet aan de overheid om bedrijven voor te schrijven hoe zij hun bedrijfsprocessen dienen in te richten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Laçin over schijnzelfstandigheid in de luchtvaart

An MP asked the government about alleged bogus self-employment among pilots at airlines with a Dutch base, citing VNV claims, the definition of 'home base', and comparisons with Germany. The government answered that the Tax Authority has adequate insight, that no labour-law violations were found, that the home-base definition does not affect the findings, and that no further investigation or talks with pilots are needed.
Furthermore, the inventory showed that there are no indications that labour legislation enforced under public law is being violated.
Verder is uit de inventarisatie gebleken dat er geen aanwijzingen zijn dat de arbeidswetgeving die publiekrechtelijk wordt gehandhaafd, wordt overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over inwerkperiodes tegen nultarieven voor zelfstandigen bij Rijkswaterstaat

An MP asked the ministers whether Rijkswaterstaat's contracts with intermediaries that impose zero-cost onboarding periods on self-employed workers shift onboarding costs onto them, and whether the government will stop such arrangements. The ministers answered that the contract places replacement and onboarding costs on the contractor, that the intermediary's zero-tariff wording was a mistranslation it has acknowledged, and that the ministry raised the matter with the contractor, which is reconsidering its approach.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu, Azarkan en Öztürk over het bericht dat er voor de zoveelste keer wordt gediscrimineerd tijdens de sollicitatieprocedure

MPs Kuzu, Azarkan and Öztürk asked ministers about reported job-application discrimination, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens's ruling against Yacht B.V., how such rulings relate to prosecution, whether the College and OM have enough capacity, and whether government contracts and staffing agency oversight should be tightened. The government calls discrimination unacceptable, says the College's equal-treatment track is separate from criminal law, rejects expanding OM capacity and a licensing system for agencies, and points to a study on procurement exclusion and an added Inspectie SZW budget.
On the question of a licensing system for the temporary staffing sector, I am focusing on improving public-private cooperation within the Stichting Normering Arbeid quality mark.
Ten aanzien van de vraag over een vergunningstelsel voor de uitzendbranche zet ik in op verbetering van de publiekprivate samenwerking in het kader van het keurmerk van de Stichting Normering Arbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Özdil over het bericht ‘Arbeidsinspectie komt controleurs tekort’

An MP asked the minister whether inadequate labour inspection capacity (per the Inspectie Control Framework report) would cause accidents and why the shortfall was not anticipated in the budget. The minister answered that accident effects cannot be quantified, acknowledged rising workload pressure, said a new cabinet should decide on capacity, and committed only to providing information rather than immediately expanding capacity.
This cabinet has decided that the government may in principle not grow.
Dit kabinet heeft besloten dat de overheid in principe niet mag groeien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over het bericht 'Amsterdamse politie wil hoofddoekje toestaan bij uniform'

MPs Helder and De Graaf asked whether the Amsterdam police was considering allowing headscarves as part of the uniform and how this fits with police neutrality rules and diversity policy. The minister said the police adheres to the lifestyle-neutrality code, that no concrete plan exists, that diversity policy does not override rules, and that he sees no reason to deviate from the code.
There was no concrete proposal or plan regarding this subject.
Er was geen concreet voorstel of plan met betrekking tot dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kerstens over misstanden bij het ziekteverzuimbedrijf Acture

MPs Karabulut and Kerstens asked the minister about reports of abuses at sick-leave company Acture, including pressure on doctors and re-examinations declaring workers recovered. The minister answered that such pressure is unacceptable, strengthened occupational doctors' independence and a second-opinion right, explained UWV's oversight role, and declined to order an Inspectorate investigation on the broadcast alone.
Sick people may not be pressured to return to work if, for medical reasons, they are not yet able to do so.
Zieke mensen mogen niet onder druk worden gezet om weer aan het werk te gaan indien zij daar – wegens medische redenen – nog niet toe in staat zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Albert Heijn op de vingers is getikt vanwege leeftijdsdiscriminatie

MP Jasper van Dijk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Equal Treatment Commission finding that Albert Heijn discriminated on age in recruitment, and about enforcement, Inspectorate capacity and the youth minimum wage. The minister condemned discrimination, noted the Inspectorate has adequate powers and extra funding, and said the youth minimum wage is no licence to discriminate, while describing planned phased changes to the minimum wage.
The Labour Discrimination team at the Inspectorate SZW has sufficient powers.
Het team Arbeidsdiscriminatie bij de Inspectie SZW heeft voldoende bevoegdheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma, De Graaf en Wilders over de berichtgeving dat er fouten zijn gemaakt bij de vrijstelling voor het inburgeringsvereiste

MPs Fritsma, De Graaf and Wilders asked why the IND failed to apply new rules, wrongly exempting thousands of migrants from the civic integration exam, and questioned the cost, grounds for not revoking permits, and the government's immigration policy. The State Secretary acknowledged the error, said the IND took corrective steps, defended that permits cannot be revoked for legal certainty reasons, and rejected the claim that the errors add burdens on public resources.
I regret that the IND did not test applications for a stronger residence right against the stricter civic integration requirements.
Ik betreur dat de IND bij verblijfsaanvragen om een sterker verblijfsrecht niet aan de verzwaarde inburgeringseisen heeft getoetst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de Wet arbeid vreemdelingen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Dutch foreign workers act (Wav), specifically who counts as an 'other employer' liable for checking identity documents, including private individuals who hire cleaning firms and whether sanctions apply. The minister confirmed that clients including private persons must verify identity and keep copies, that the Inspectorate SZW does not enforce this against private households, and gave fine statistics for 2014-2016.
No copy of the identity document needs to be provided if the foreign national is a national of a country party to the European Economic Area, of the European Union, or of Switzerland.

Er hoeft geen kopie van het identiteitsbewijs te worden verstrekt als de vreemdeling onderdaan is van een land dat partij is bij de Europese Economische Ruimte, onderdaan is van de Europese Unie of van Zwitserland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over het bericht 'Turkije haalt uit: Nederland is xenofoob en islamofoob'

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the Turkish ambassador should be expelled after Turkey accused the Netherlands of xenophobia and Islamophobia, and whether Turkey's human rights record should be taken into account. The government answered that it seeks to de-escalate diplomatic tensions and does not consider sending the ambassador back desirable.
The Cabinet is aiming to de-escalate the diplomatic tensions between the two countries.
Het Kabinet zet in op de-escalatie van de diplomatieke spanningen tussen beide landen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht: 'Stille tocht voor Israël in Rotterdam niet toegestaan'

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked why a silent march supporting Israel in Rotterdam was not permitted while a conference they linked to Hamas was. The minister replied that freedom of assembly is constitutionally protected, a ban requires a concrete risk assessment, and the mayor of Rotterdam is responsible for public order, so he declined to intervene.
I do not intervene in the mayor's powers.
Ik treed niet in de bevoegdheid van de burgemeester.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over misstanden bij Damen Shiprepair

An MP asked the minister about alleged abuses at Damen Shiprepair, including dismissal of permanent staff replaced by cheaper flex workers, poor housing of foreign workers, union access, and an integrated enforcement approach. The minister answered that dismissals replacing staff with cheaper workers would be refused by UWV, pointed to existing housing rules and inspection fines, affirmed union access rights subject to rules, and said existing cooperation among agencies is working.
That permission will not be granted if the intention is to replace permanent employees with cheaper and/or flexible workers while the work in nature and scope does not change at all.
Die toestemming wordt niet verleend als het de bedoeling is vaste werknemers te vervangen door goedkopere en/of flexibele werknemers terwijl het werk naar aard en omvang in het geheel niet wijzigt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marijnissen over de constructie van De Wit thuiszorgorganisatie

MPs Marijnissen and Van Kent asked about thuiszorgorganisatie De Wit employing 'zorg-au pairs' from Eastern Europe under Wlz care, inspection history, language requirements, pay and oversight. The state secretary answered that the inspectorate issued an aanwijzing after repeated non-compliance, that foreign care workers are allowed if qualified, that a WTZi reform bill is in preparation, and that topfunctionaris pay is not publicly disclosed because the organisation lacks a WTZi licence.
It is up to the institution itself whether and how it wants to be transparent about the pay of its top officials.
Het is aan de instelling zelf of en hoe zij transparant wil zijn over bezoldigingen van haar topfunctionarissen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘Overheid moet oog hebben voor shariarecht’

PVV MPs asked whether the government should resist sharia influence, given a university chair studying good parts of sharia law, and asked who funds it. The minister answered that Dutch public order limits foreign law and that existing private international law rules are sufficient, without naming the chair's funder in detail.
The application of foreign law in the Netherlands and the recognition of legal facts or relationships established abroad always find their limit in Dutch public order.

De toepassing van buitenlands recht in Nederland en de erkenning van in het buitenland tot stand gekomen rechtsfeiten of rechtsverhoudingen vinden echter altijd hun grens in de Nederlandse openbare orde.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Kent over de dreigende overname van AkzoNobel door PPG Industries

MPs Hijink and Van Kent asked whether activist investor Elliott's demand that the AkzoNobel supervisory board chair resign, and reported sharing of price-sensitive information with PPG, is realistic as serving the company's continuity and how the government views this conduct. The minister answered that the matter falls under the Dutch corporate law framework (shareholder meetings, 10% and 3% thresholds, Code response times), declined to confirm the information-sharing allegation because the AFM is responsible and bound by confidentiality, and stated that shareholders may pursue their interests within bounds of reasonableness, with greater responsibility for larger stakes.
Because of the confidentiality obligation resting on the AFM, no statements can be made about this.
Vanwege de op de AFM rustende geheimhoudingsplicht kunnen hierover geen mededelingen worden gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Laçin over het bericht dat Hongaarse vrachtwagenchauffeurs die voor een Nederlands transportbedrijf rijden niet betaald hoeven te worden volgens de Nederlandse cao

MPs Van Dijk and Laçin asked whether a Den Bosch appeals court ruling, that Hungarian truck drivers working for a Dutch transport firm need not be paid under the Dutch collective agreement, shows that the wage laws fail in court and whether the ruling opens the door to similar constructions, and what will be done to stop a race to the bottom. The minister declined to comment on the pending case, said equal pay for equal work remains the principle, pointed to existing laws and EU revisions, and said the case's specific facts allow no general conclusions while promising to await European Commission proposals.
As you know, I must be restrained in commenting on cases still under consideration; cassation can still be lodged against this ruling and the referring cantonal judge must still rule.

Zoals u weet moet ik terughoudend zijn uitspraken te doen over zaken die nog in behandeling zijn; tegen deze uitspraak kan nog cassatie worden ingesteld en ook moet de verwijzende kantonrechter nog uitspraak doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gijs van Dijk en Kuiken over ontwikkelingen rondom het Road Package van de Europese Commissie

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the ministers about the European Commission's Road Package on road transport, including fears of social dumping, worse working conditions for truck drivers, and whether the Netherlands will press for tighter cabotage rules and action against letterbox companies. The minister replied that the Commission's proposals were not yet published (expected 31 May), so their content could not yet be assessed, and pointed to a 2014 joint ministerial declaration calling for better implementation of EU law; the answer to the cabotage and Road Alliance questions is largely pending.
Only then will it be possible for me to assess the content of the proposals.
Het is voor mij dan pas mogelijk om de inhoud van de voorstellen te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hijink en Van Kent over de dreigende overname van AkzoNobel door PPG Industries

MPs Hijink and Van Kent asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a possible hostile takeover of AkzoNobel by PPG, the role of the AkzoNobel foundation, competition and job effects, works council protections, and whether the Wet ongewenste zeggenschap telecommunicatie could protect firms of national importance. The minister answered that boards must weigh stakeholder interests, that the priority-share foundation can appoint management in a hostile bid, that competition authorities would review any merger, and that the telecom bill covers only national security and public order, not jobs or headquarters.
It is not possible to state the consequences of a possible split for employment; this depends heavily on what the parties involved agree.
Het is niet mogelijk om de gevolgen van een eventuele splitsing op de werkgelegenheid te geven, dit is sterk afhankelijk van wat de betrokken partijen afspreken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Azarkan over de rellen in Rotterdam van 7 mei 2017

MPs Kuzu and Azarkan asked the Justice Minister about the 7 May 2017 Rotterdam riots after Feyenoord's loss, including prosecution, the mayor's enforcement choices compared with other demonstrations, and integration. The minister condemned the rioters, said prosecution is ongoing, and stated that public order enforcement is a matter for the local mayor and council.
Policy on this and its implementation is tailored and a matter for local authorities.
Het beleid ten aanzien hiervan en de uitvoering daarvan is maatwerk en aan het lokale gezag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Cegerek en Kerstens over de recycling van afgedankte smartphones

MPs Cegerek and Kerstens asked about recycling of discarded smartphones, Greenpeace's call on manufacturers, collection volumes, repair incentives, collection actions and the role of shops, recycling targets, and jobs. The state secretary answered that roughly half of about 900,000 discarded phones yearly are estimated to be recycled through certified channels, that existing producer collection and WEEE targets apply, and that circular-economy measures are under development, with a KPMG jobs study due in 2017.
No recent figures are known for this.
Hier zijn geen recente cijfers van bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Jan Vos over het initiatief van de Stichting Meent van der Sluis voor de oprichting van Het Andere Monument

Three MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a proposed monument ('Het Andere Monument') for victims of Groningen gas-extraction earthquake damage, including municipal land availability and funding for a youth work-learning project. The minister confirmed awareness, expressed appreciation, noted the National Coordinator Groningen mediated, and said the Social Affairs minister would explore a work-learning route.
The Minister of SZW will explore the possibilities for a work-learning project and will contact the foundation about it.
De Minister van SZW zal de mogelijkheden voor een leer-werktraject onderzoeken en daarover in contact treden met de stichting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘RK-scholen passen viering Pasen aan’

PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether Dutch Christian and Catholic schools that adjusted their Easter celebrations to accommodate Muslim pupils were betraying Judeo-Christian culture, how many schools and pupils were affected, and whether school boards and Muslim parents should be summoned or told to assimilate or leave. The state secretary rejected the premise, said the central government does not track school Easter practices or pupil transfers, declined to summon school boards, and said integration rather than assimilation is policy.
The central government does not keep track of whether schools celebrate Easter or how they do so.
De rijksoverheid houdt niet bij of scholen het paasfeest vieren en op welke wijze zij dit doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Becker en Azmani over het bericht “Christelijke scholen zwakken paasviering af”

Two VVD MPs asked the education state secretary whether Christian schools that reportedly scaled back their Easter celebrations were self-censoring, and what the ministry will do to support teachers and promote civic education. The state secretary answered that the schools deny the media account, that he has no signs of self-censorship, that teachers should feel supported by their own boards, and that a legislative tightening of the civic education duty is being prepared.
I am now preparing this legislative amendment. I will submit it to your House as soon as possible.
Ik bereid deze wetswijziging nu voor. Ik leg deze zo spoedig mogelijk aan uw Kamer voor.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Markuszower en Wilders over misstanden in het Zuiderparkbad

MPs from the PVV asked the ministers about reported assaults, harassment and vandalism at the Zuiderparkbad in The Hague, including the ethnicity of perpetrators, whether they should be punished harshly, what has been done and whether national measures would be taken. The minister answered that the matter is a local responsibility, that the municipality has introduced security measures and a review is underway, and that prosecution is for the public prosecutor to decide.
Enforcing order and rules in swimming pools is a local matter.
De handhaving van de orde en regels in zwembaden is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over boetes voor migranten vanwege het niet tijdig slagen voor het inburgeringsexamen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about fines of up to €1,250 imposed on more than 500 refugees and spouse migrants who missed the three-year civic integration exam deadline, questioning course quality and whether debt was a fair sanction. The minister answered that fines are only imposed when the delay is culpable and cannot be excused, that quality oversight of courses is being tightened, and that changes to the system are for the incoming cabinet and the 2018 evaluation, while rejecting the MP's framing of the facts.
Integration participants who, according to DUO's records, culpably failed to meet the integration obligation receive a notice of the deadline overrun from DUO.
Inburgeraars die volgens de bij DUO bekende gegevens verwijtbaar niet aan de inburgeringsplicht hebben voldaan, krijgen een kennisgeving van de termijnoverschrijding van DUO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het korten van nabestaandenpensioen op de IOW-uitkering

MP Van Weyenberg asks why partner income is not offset against the IOW benefit while a survivor's pension is, and whether this is consistent for a minimum-needs scheme. The minister confirms partner income is not counted, explains the IOW's hybrid character as an individual benefit tied to the 2006 WW duration limit, and acknowledges that offsetting survivor's pensions is consistent with other minimum schemes like the Participatiewet.
The income of a partner of an IOW beneficiary is indeed not taken into account when determining the amount of the IOW benefit.
Het inkomen van een partner van een IOW-gerechtigde wordt inderdaad niet meegerekend bij het bepalen van de hoogte van de IOW-uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Wiersma over kinderbijslag in het buitenland

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether child benefit paid to parents with children in other EU countries should be indexed to local price levels, and whether the Netherlands will press Germany and other member states on this. The minister replies that EU law (Regulation 883/2004, art. 67) bars applying the country-of-residence principle within the EU, that there is insufficient support among member states, and that no action will be taken for now, including on a motion asking the government to pursue indexation.
This is not the right moment for that.
Hier is nu het moment niet voor.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gijs van Dijk over "het WIA-stelsel waarbij hoge inkomens eerder een volledige arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering krijgen dan lage inkomens".

MP Gijs van Dijk asked whether under the WIA disability scheme identical health complaints can lead to different disability classes depending on income, and whether this is unfair. Minister Asscher answered that income loss is the basis by design, so a higher earner with the same residual earning capacity can receive a higher percentage, and he sees no reason to change this.
I therefore see no reason to change this.
Ik zie dan ook geen reden om dit aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Karabulut over het bericht dat de politie aangiftes van huwelijkse gevangenschap niet in behandeling neemt

MPs Karabulut and Van Nispen asked whether the government would look into police refusing to record complaints of forced marriage and polygamy, and how many such complaints exist, and whether the government would act further. The minister declined to comment on the individual case citing the ongoing investigation, said the registration cannot separate forced-marriage complaints, pointed to existing expertise bodies, and saw no concrete reason for additional measures.
This concerns an individual case. Caution is required here, in the interest of the investigation and the protection of the privacy of the person concerned.
Het betreft hier een individuele zaak. Hiermee dient terughoudend te worden omgegaan, in het belang van het onderzoek en bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de campagne in Nederland voor het referendum in Turkije

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs about the Turkish referendum campaign in the Netherlands, including bus transport aimed only at Yes or No voters, intimidation of campaigners and a journalist, and where the limit on foreign influence over Turkish Dutch citizens lies. The government answered that transport offers are not unusual and lawful, that intimidation is unacceptable and should be reported to police, that foreign interference is firmly opposed, and that the journalist's case is under police investigation.
The cabinet considers it undesirable that foreign governments openly or covertly try to influence the choices of Dutch citizens.
Het kabinet vindt het ongewenst dat buitenlandse overheden keuzes van Nederlandse burgers openlijk dan wel heimelijk proberen te beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Help, ik woon nog thuis’

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the social security system and the prevalence of flexible contracts leave young starters unable to get permanent jobs or housing, and whether a basic income would help. The minister replies that flexible starts often lead to permanent contracts, that the Wwz aims to curb unnecessary flexible work, that permanent contracts remain the norm, and that the cabinet opposes an unconditional basic income as unrealistic.
I cannot agree with the claim that it is "not feasible" to keep to permanent contracts.
Ik kan me niet vinden in de stelling dat het «niet haalbaar is» om vast te houden aan vaste contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenbergover de vaststelling van het dagloon voor een WIA-uitkering

An MP asked why WW benefits paid after the reference year are excluded from the WIA daily wage calculation, and whether the resulting timing effect (up to about €15.77 lower daily wage in the example given) is an unintended consequence. The minister explained the UWV's loon-in payroll system, said the effect is deliberate under the Dagloonbesluit, and rejected changing the system because it would raise employer administrative burdens.
The Dagloonbesluit werknemersverzekeringen deliberately allows the UWV to use the wages or benefits recorded in the policy administration.
In het Dagloonbesluit werknemersverzekeringen is er bewust voor gekozen dat het UWV gebruik kan maken van het loon dat of de uitkering die in de polisadministratie is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht ‘Het bedrijf moet blijven. FNV voert actie: Ziegler aan de ketting’ van RTV-Noord

MPs Nijboer and Gijs van Dijk asked about the planned relocation of part of Ziegler's fire-engine production from Winschoten to Croatia, its effect on fire-service readiness, union negotiations, jobs and procurement criteria. The minister answered that fire-service procurement and negotiations are matters for the safety regions and employers and unions, that no signals of reduced readiness exist, that about twenty of roughly 75 jobs are affected, and that general employment policy and UWV support apply.
Negotiations over whether to relocate business activities are a matter for employers and employees.
Onderhandelingen over het al dan niet verplaatsen van bedrijfsactiviteiten zijn een zaak van werkgevers en werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Jasper van Dijk over de integratie van nieuwkomers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment and the State Secretary of Security and Justice about delays in integrating asylum seekers and recognised refugees, including whether language and integration training could start earlier. The Minister replied that the government is accelerating integration through earlier voorinburgering, better municipal matching, regional coordinators, and a cohort study, while acknowledging the 2015 backlog and emergency-shelter problems.
Newcomers who are allowed to stay must participate as quickly as possible.
Nieuwkomers die mogen blijven moeten zo snel mogelijk meedoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Edgar Mulder over het artikel 'Gemeente 'viert' islamitische feestdagen'

Three PVV MPs asked whether the municipality of Almelo's promotion of Islamic holidays, through lighting a bridge, is objectionable and whether the minister would advise the mayor against it. The minister answered that Islam is a religion protected like others, that municipalities decide how to reflect pluralism within the law, and that the choice of lighting days is for Almelo to decide.
In this case it is therefore up to the municipality of Almelo to decide on which days the lighting on the bridge is switched on.
In dit geval is het daarom aan de gemeente Almelo om te bepalen op welke dagen de verlichting op de brug aangaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ten Broeke, Azmani en Koopmans over het bericht dat de Turkse AK-partij weer een ronselbrief aan Nederlanders met een Turkse achtergrond heeft gestuurd

VVD MPs asked whether the Turkish AK party again sent a recruitment letter, signed by the Turkish prime minister, to Turkish-Dutch citizens about the referendum, whether it used the same address list as in 2015, and whether the government will raise this with Turkey. The minister confirmed some recipients received the letter, said it is unknown whether the 2015 address list was reused, noted Turkish parties can buy voter address lists, and said the government remains opposed to political campaigning by Turkish officials in the Netherlands.
It is not known whether the AK party used the same address list as in 2015.
Het is niet bekend of de AK-partij gebruik heeft gemaakt van hetzelfde adressenbestand als in 2015.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Jong over het bericht ‘Oost-Europeaan werkt hier voor een hongerloontje'

An MP from the PVV asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of wage pressure and displacement of Dutch workers by Eastern European labour migrants, and whether a work permit requirement should be reintroduced. The minister cites a 2014 SEO study showing displacement in some sectors, describes enforcement measures such as the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies and the enforcement directive, reports the first monitor results, and rejects reintroducing work permits.
I see no reason to revise my views and policy on labour migration.
Ik zie geen reden om mijn mening en beleid over arbeidsmigratie te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Van Kent over werknemersbelangen bij flitsfaillissementen

MPs Van Nispen and Van Kent asked how the government will protect employee interests in 'flash bankruptcies' (pre-pack restructurings), in light of an Advocate-General's opinion on the EU Business Transfer Directive and the Estro case. The minister answered that the opinion is non-binding, the CJEU ruling is awaited, the matter will be discussed with social partners in the WCO III preparations, and he will report back in a summer progress letter.

I am certainly willing to keep your House informed and propose that I will update you in the next progress letter on the bankruptcy law recalibration programme, due in the summer, on the state of affairs.

Ik ben zeker bereid uw Kamer op de hoogte te houden en stel voor dat ik u in de eerst volgende voortgangsbrief in het kader van het programma herijking van het faillissementsrecht die in de zomer zal uitkomen, in zal lichten over de stand van zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Bisschop over de aangescherpte regels voor gebruik van hoogwerkers bij asbestsanering

MPs Dijkgraaf and Bisschop asked whether the Inspectorate's stricter rules on aerial work platforms in asbestos removal make roof replacement impractical, and what support will be given.
