The minister replied that the rules were clarified in a brochure rather than tightened, that the existing exemption for occasional use remains available, and that a programmatic approach with financing options is being developed.
However, there is no question of tightening the rules.
Er is evenwel geen sprake van aanscherping van de regels.
Antwoord op van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht "Turkse Nederlanders kiezen: ’evet’ of ’hayir'’', over het faciliteren van het Turkse referendum in Nederland

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the government about reports that Turkish referendum polling stations were being facilitated in the Netherlands, covering postal voting, costs of traffic signage and police, AK-party representatives posing at a polling station, and whether the stations should be closed. Minister Asscher answered that postal voting is a choice for other states, that costs fall within regular Rijkswaterstaat and police work, that the government cannot confirm the posing claim, and that the polling stations would not be closed because they are permitted under the Vienna Conventions.
The Netherlands does not supervise the polling stations and therefore cannot confirm whether members of the AK Party posed at one of the polling stations.
Nederland houdt geen toezicht in de stemlocaties en kan dus niet bevestigen of er door leden van de AK-partij is geposeerd in een van de stemlocaties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het korten van nabestaandenpensioen op de IOW-uitkering

An MP asked why a survivor's pension is deducted in full from an IOW unemployment benefit when the partner's income is not counted in that benefit's calculation, and how many recipients are affected. The minister confirmed the deduction as overig inkomen under the Algemeen inkomensbesluit, justified it by the IOW's minimum-needs character, and said the number affected is not available from the system.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Bommel over Noord-Koreaanse dwangarbeiders

SP MPs asked whether hundreds of North Korean forced labourers work at a Polish shipyard of CRIST S.A. that repairs Dutch civil vessels, whether such labour occurs elsewhere in Europe or the Netherlands, what Dutch and EU action is taken, and how much of their wages go to the North Korean state. The minister replied that Polish inspections found no forced-labour indicators, that Dutch firms are expected to apply due diligence under OECD guidelines and the 2014 ILO Protocol, and that Netherlands has raised the issue in EU and UN fora.
The cabinet expects Dutch companies to comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises.
Het kabinet verwacht van Nederlandse bedrijven dat zij de OESO-richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen naleven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Bashir over schijnconstructies bij de aanleg van de Centrale As in Friesland

MPs Karabulut and Bashir asked whether sham self-employment and underpayment in building the Centrale As road in Friesland, and the Inspectorate's findings, would be addressed by enforcement, a review of provincial tendering rules, and back pay for workers. The minister replied that the courts must decide on employment status and back pay, that the Tax Authority will not comment on individuals, and that the province as main contractor can be held to account and has pledged to act.
The province of Friesland can be called upon in its role as main contracting authority to put matters in order.
De provincie Friesland kan in haar rol van hoofdopdrachtgever aangesproken worden om orde op zaken te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jacobi over het bericht 'Onderbetaling bij aanleg Centrale As'

MPs Kerstens and Jacobi asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of underpayment and sham constructions on the Centrale As project, and whether the province of Friesland as principal client should act and whether it could hide behind the timing of the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies. The minister said the province had engaged the contractor and FNV, that the Inspectie SZW report is for the complainant only, that liability runs through the employer chain, and that government clients will receive further awareness outreach.
It is therefore not for me to share information from this report with your House.
Het is dan ook niet aan mij om informatie uit dit rapport met uw Kamer te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouten over dubbele kinderbijslag voor ouders met kinderen met autisme

MPs Van Weyenberg and Schouten asked the minister about double child benefit for parents of children with autism, including diagnosis mix, how parents demonstrate intensive care needs, the CIZ assessment framework and evaluation, and handling of parental letters. The minister answered that most approved children have only an autism diagnosis, explained the assessment criteria and procedure, reported a parent meeting, and announced process improvements and a policy review.
Exact numbers cannot be given because the information cannot be retrieved directly from the automated systems.
Exacte aantallen zijn niet te geven omdat de informatie niet rechtreeks uit de geautomatiseerde systemen is te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij de Primark in Groningen

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported working conditions at the Primark store in Groningen, including workload, intimidation, ignored health complaints, unpaid overtime, and missing works councils, and whether the Labour Inspectorate would inspect and act. The minister said he could not confirm the signals, that the Inspectorate has accepted a union request for further investigation, that earlier inspections led to limited action, and that the company has announced it will set up a works council, with the ministry to raise the legal duty with the clothing sector.
FNV has shared its findings with the Labour Inspectorate and recently requested a further investigation into working conditions at Primark.
FNV heeft haar bevindingen met de Inspectie SZW gedeeld en heeft recent aan de Inspectie een verzoek gedaan tot een nader onderzoek naar de arbeidsomstandigheden bij Primark.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de schokkende uitkomsten van de door FNV Handel uitgevoerde Primark-enquête

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a FNV survey reporting humiliation, intimidation over sick leave and camera surveillance at Primark, and asked for enforcement action. The minister said the Inspectorate SZW will investigate at FNV's request, sick-leave questioning is limited by privacy law, and Primark has pledged to set up works councils, which the minister says is the employee's responsibility to enforce.
At FNV's request, the Inspectorate SZW will carry out a further investigation into working conditions at Primark in the coming period.
De Inspectie SZW gaat de komende periode op verzoek van de FNV een nader onderzoek uitvoeren naar de arbeidsomstandigheden bij Primark.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Amhaouch en Pieter Heerma over het bericht dat de installatiebranche een tekort van 15.000 vakmensen in de komende vier jaar verwacht

MPs Amhaouch and Heerma (CDA) asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about reports of a 15,000-worker shortage in the installation sector, including whether this threatens the Energy Agreement, whether training should be made more widely available, and whether training funds should be opened up across sectors. The minister answered that the 3,000 annual vacancies are UNETO-VNI's own projection consistent with UWV expectations, that the Energy Agreement targets remain within reach, and that existing Techniekpact cooperation makes a separate taskforce or cao consultation unnecessary.
The figure of 3,000 annual vacancies cited by the chairman of UNETO-VNI is based by UNETO-VNI on an expected 3% annual growth in employment in the installation sector.

Het door de voorzitter van UNETO-VNI genoemde aantal van 3.000 vacatures op jaarbasis is door UNETO-VNI gebaseerd op een verwachte groei van de werkgelegenheid in de installatiebranche van 3% per jaar
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de werkomstandigheden van heiwerkers in Kampen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of pile-driving workers falling ill from contaminated construction sites in Kampen, asking how often the Inspectorate halts work for this reason, what rules apply, and whether client and contractor compliance will be improved. The minister gave the 2015 and 2016 figures on stop orders, described the Arbeidsomstandighedenbesluit duties of employers and clients, and listed recent measures such as updated building-process rules and a client-responsibility web page.
In 2015 the Labour Inspectorate halted work on contaminated soil nine times.
De Inspectie SZW heeft in 2015 negen keer de werkzaamheden stilgelegd bij werkzaamheden in verontreinigde grond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat uitzendbureaus bereid zijn louter 'wit' personeel te leveren

The MP asks the minister how the government will respond to reports that staffing agencies are willing to supply only white personnel, and whether agencies should be sanctioned or excluded. The minister says discrimination is unacceptable, outlines that the government will not contract discriminating firms only after a final criminal conviction, notes that no contracts have been terminated on that basis, and refers to existing campaigns and a Rijksbrede anonymous application pilot being rejected by a separate ministry.
The cabinet does not accept discrimination and therefore does not want to do business with companies that discriminate.
Het kabinet accepteert geen discriminatie en wil dan ook geen zaken doen met bedrijven die discrimineren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de Al Houda-moskee in Geleen

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government is aware of reports of a Salafist takeover of the Al Houda mosque in Geleen and suspected support for armed jihad via the linked Babycare foundation, whether salafist takeovers threaten democracy, and whether the mosque and foundation will be closed and dissolved. The minister confirmed awareness, described a three-track approach of dialogue, confrontation and enforcement by prosecution and police, and stated that dissolution under Article 2:20 Civil Code is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide.
Under Article 2:20 of the Civil Code, the court may, at the request of the Public Prosecution Service, declare a legal person whose activities conflict with public order prohibited and dissolve it.

Op grond van artikel 2:20 Burgerlijk Wetboek kan de rechtbank op verzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie een rechtspersoon waarvan de werkzaamheid in strijd is met de openbare orde verboden verklaren en ontbinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het Trouw-artikel " Niet iedereen blij met baan plus bijstand "

An MP asked the State Secretary about Flextensie, a scheme where benefit recipients work while keeping their benefit, including an ESF subsidy to Zaanstad, whether agreements with the tax authority existed, and whether wage and social-security rules apply. The government answered that the subsidy is not yet settled and Flextensie costs are not eligible, no agreements were made, benefit recipients are not employees so client liability does not apply, and it will investigate how municipalities apply the instrument and report back.
I will have the way municipalities implement this instrument and the conditions under which it is applied investigated, and will inform you of the outcomes.

Zoals bij antwoord 6 aangegeven laat ik mij nader informeren over de wijze waarop gemeenten invulling geven aan dit instrument en onder welke condities dit instrument wordt toegepast, en zal ik u over de uitkomsten informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Marcouch over discriminatie bij Amsterdamse uitzendbureaus

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported discrimination by Amsterdam temp agencies and whether such agencies could be excluded from public contracts. The minister acknowledged discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to complaint bodies, anti-discrimination contract clauses and awareness campaigns, declined to take specific action on Amsterdam agencies, and said the Inspectorate SZW targets temp agencies by risk without naming inspected agencies.
Following your question, I will specifically draw the attention of the municipality of Amsterdam to this.
Naar aanleiding van uw vraag zal ik de gemeente Amsterdam hier nog specifiek op attenderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Vrouwen werken al op jonge leeftijd vaak in deeltijd’

An MP asked the government about reports that young women work part-time more often than men, reducing their economic independence, and what instruments exist to promote it. The minister said the trend is being studied in a joint OCW-SCP project, outlined existing emancipation and employer measures, and said economic independence is a priority.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pia Dijkstra en Van Weyenberg over jonge vrouwen die vaak in deeltijd werken

MPs Dijkstra and Van Weyenberg asked about young women working part-time more often than men, its causes, its long-term effects on economic independence, and whether the government will act. The minister answers that causes are not yet clear and are being studied in a joint OCW/SCP project, and points to existing awareness and budgeting initiatives and general part-time work rules, without committing to new legislation.
The causes are not yet clear now; that is precisely the subject of the research.
De oorzaken zijn nu nog niet duidelijk, dat is juist onderwerp van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over grote werkgevers die bewust werknemers ‘slapend’ in dienst houden

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether large employers keep sick workers on 'sleeping' contracts to avoid paying the transition payment, and what should be done. The minister agreed it is improper but said courts have not treated it as culpable conduct, and pointed to forthcoming legislation compensating employers for these payments, with a 1 January 2019 start that cannot be brought forward.
I am of the view that keeping an employee on the payroll solely to avoid paying a transition payment yet does not reflect decent employership.
Ik ben van mening dat het enkel in dienst houden van een werknemer om (nog) geen transitievergoeding te hoeven betalen niet getuigt van fatsoenlijk werkgeverschap
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Koolmonoxidevergiftiging kinderen door barbecue in ijskoud huis’

An MP asked ministers about a report of children poisoned by carbon monoxide from a barbecue indoors in a cold home after gas and electricity were cut off, and whether disconnection rules for energy debts should change or a basic income would prevent this. The government says disconnection policy protects vulnerable households and winter disconnections are limited, sees no need to change it, and says neither the current system nor a basic income can guarantee bills are paid.
Based on the current policy described above, the cabinet is of the view that the disconnection policy, particularly for vulnerable households, does not need to be changed.
Op basis van bovenstaand omschreven huidig beleid is het kabinet van mening dat het afsluitbeleid, in het bijzonder het afsluitbeleid bij kwetsbare huishoudens, geen aanpassing behoeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Toorenburg en Pieter Heerma over het bericht 'Omstreden imam terug in Gouda'

MPs Van Toorenburg and Heerma asked why a controversial imam, whose visa had reportedly been revoked earlier, was able to speak in Gouda, and whether investigation, visa denial and withdrawal of the host association's ANBI status were pursued. The minister answered that the imam holds a Belgian (EU) passport so entry can only be refused on strict grounds, that police were present at the event without finding incitement, and that ANBI status can be withdrawn only after an investigation by the Tax Authority.
For preachers holding EU nationality, on the basis of statements made on Dutch soil that conflict with Dutch law, prosecution by the Public Prosecution Service may be possible.

Voor predikers die over een EU-nationaliteit beschikken geldt dat zij op basis van hun uitspraken die zij op Nederlandse bodem doen die in strijd zijn met Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving mogelijk vervolgd kunnen worden door het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht ‘Jihadonderzoeker UvA uitte zelf steun voor strijders van IS’

PVV MPs asked whether a report that a UvA jihad researcher expressed support for IS fighters is used in prosecutions of Syria travellers, and what will be done to stop alleged misuse of education, and whether returnees can be barred. The government said the prosecution has no knowledge of the report being used in court, that academic quality is for the academic community to judge, and that it will act only against clear discrimination or calls to armed jihad; on travellers it described existing prosecution, monitoring and new nationality-revocation powers.
It is for the academic community to assess and qualify the scholarly character of research.
Het is aan de academische gemeenschap om het wetenschappelijk karakter van onderzoek te beoordelen en te kwalificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het bericht ‘Jihadonderzoeker UvA uitte zelf steun voor strijders van IS’ en over een onderzoek naar Europese vrouwen in IS-gebied

Member Marcouch asked the ministers whether the government knew of a UvA study on European women in IS territory, whether it influenced policy or court cases, and whether its conclusions were verifiable. Minister Blok answered that the government was unaware of the study beforehand, that it has no influence on policy, that courts judge the weight of such research, and that the UvA handles methodological reflection itself.
It is up to the judge to weigh how much value the study has in a court case.
Het is aan de rechter om af te wegen hoeveel waarde het onderzoek in een rechtszaak heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over "misstanden in de schoonmaaksector"

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that over half of 156 cleaning companies inspected in 2016 breached labour laws and a third were fined, and asked when full inspection results would be sent, which other sectors are risky, whether additional measures are needed, and what the Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag achieves. The minister confirmed the figures, promised the 2016 annual report around May 2017 and a letter on the cleaning programme in spring, described ongoing sector-level interventions and risk-based inspections, and said the Code appears to have a positive effect while only cautiously concluding so.
On the findings of the 2016 Cleaning Programme I will inform your House this spring.
Over de bevindingen van het Programma Schoonmaak in 2016 zal ik uw Kamer dit voorjaar informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht 'Cel voor gijzelen importbruid'

PVV MPs asked whether a sharia court dissolved a marriage in the Netherlands and whether Dutch law can be supplemented by Islamic law, and whether such organisations should be dissolved. The minister replied that no parallel legal structure is possible, that no sharia courts are known to exist in the Netherlands, and that the Public Prosecution Service will consider a dissolution request under Article 2:20 Civil Code if warranted.
The Public Prosecution Service has indicated that, if there is cause, it will consider filing a request with the court.
Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft laten weten dat indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat, zij de mogelijkheid om bij de rechtbank een verzoek in te dienen zal overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Vaders vinden uitbreiding vaderschapsverlof te krap’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Rutgers study showing fathers find the extension of paternity leave too limited, with many unable to take unpaid parental leave for financial reasons, and about the unequal division of care and work between partners. The Minister answered that the government is promoting a more balanced division of work and care through practical measures, awareness campaigns, a budget tool and the extension of birth leave, but declined to commit to new research or new agreements with sectors beyond existing initiatives.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen, Karabulut en Pieter Heerma over illegale huwelijken in moskeeen

MPs Van Nispen, Karabulut and Heerma asked about illegal religious marriages and forced marriage in mosques following an Undercover in Nederland broadcast, and what the government does about it. The minister says the scale is unknown, the Public Prosecution Service has found insufficient grounds for an investigation into the mosques named, and it is raising awareness among relevant parties while gemeenten handle victim care.
The Public Prosecution Service has judged that there are insufficient concrete grounds for a criminal investigation.
Het OM heeft geoordeeld dat er onvoldoende concrete aanknopingspunten zijn voor een opsporingsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het bericht 'DHL: overheid dwingt ons tot aannemen zelfstandige bezorgers'

MPs Mei Li Vos and Kerstens asked the ministers whether the postal sector's reliance on self-employed couriers, and the postponed enforcement of the Wet DBA, encourages sham self-employment and unfair competition, and what the government will do about it. The minister answered that businesses may freely choose employment forms, that enforcement is postponed to at least 1 January 2018 with a review of criteria planned, and that the low-income employer allowance and Wet werk en zekerheid reduce cost and status gaps, but did not commit to new concrete measures against sham self-employment in postal work.
Enforcement of the Wet DBA is suspended until at least 1 January 2018, unless there are malicious actors.
Handhaving van de Wet DBA is opgeschort tot in ieder geval 1 januari 2018, tenzij sprake is van kwaadwillenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Tanamal "de onafhankelijkheid van UWV-verzekeringsartsen"

MPs Mei Li Vos and Tanamal asked the Minister of Social Affairs how UWV insurance doctors assess WIA eligibility, whether objection and appeal procedures and treating specialists ensure independent review, and how many WIA rejections are objected to or appealed. The minister explained the assessment process, the separation of doctors in objection proceedings, the consultation of treating specialists with consent, and provided 2016 statistics on outcomes.
In an objection procedure against the outcome of the assessment of work capacity, the insurance doctor's assessment is in principle reconsidered.
In een bezwaarprocedure tegen het resultaat van de beoordeling van de arbeidsmogelijkheden, wordt de beoordeling van de verzekeringsarts in beginsel heroverwogen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Leenders over de berichten ‘O’Leary: Ryanair-vliegtickets worden gratis’ en ‘Zwijg of je vliegt eruit’

PvdA MPs asked the government about reports that Ryanair's chief executive said the airline's low fares rest on paying pilots very little, and about pay-to-fly contracts, safety risks and possible sham employment arrangements. The government answered that it opposes poor pay and unfair competition, is working at EU level on pay-to-fly and fatigue rules, joins court cases and investigates cabin crew, but cannot comment on individual taxpayers.
Article 67 of the General Tax Act prevents the Tax Authority from making statements about individual taxpayers.
Artikel 67 van de Algemene Wet inzake Rijksbelastingen belet het de Belastingdienst om uitspraken te doen over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over "salafisten die moskeeën dreigen over te nemen"

An MP asked whether salafist takeovers of mosques, including the Al Ummah incident in Amsterdam, and German bans on salafist organisations warrant concern and a ban in the Netherlands. The minister answered that the government is concerned, supports local partners through a three-track approach, sees no comparable violence in other mosques, and explains that banning a legal entity under Civil Code article 2:20 requires very high thresholds, so signals alone are insufficient.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed me that, if there is reason to do so, it will consider submitting a request to the court, but that signals alone are in any case not sufficient.

Het Openbaar Ministerie heeft mij laten weten dat indien daartoe aanleiding bestaat zij de mogelijkheid om bij de rechtbank een verzoek in te dienen zal overwegen, maar dat enkel signalen daarvoor in ieder geval niet voldoende zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het artikel 'Link Eindhovense moskee met Al-Qaeda financiers'

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a press report linking an Eindhoven mosque foundation (al-Waqf) to Al-Qaeda financiers, and whether it should be dismantled. The minister said no financial flows to the named ASM have been established, pointed to existing terrorism-financing tools and said dissolution under the Civil Code is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide.
It is for the Public Prosecution Service to determine whether that is the case here.
Het Openbaar Ministerie om te bepalen of daar in dit geval sprake van is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de vertrekregeling voor ambtenaren

MP Omtzigt asked about early-retirement schemes for civil servants, RVU levies owed by the Belastingdienst, emails on internal warnings, contracts of the Broedkamer and unauthorised spending of 38 million euro under the Investment Agenda. The government answered that the schemes follow general ARAR rules, that 24 million euro in RVU levy was paid, that the emails are withheld to protect internal advice under Article 68 of the Constitution, and that the contracts will be made available confidentially.
On the basis of this cabinet line I do not provide the emails.
Op grond van deze kabinetslijn verstrek ik de emails niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lodders en Van ‘t Wout over uitbreiding van de werkingssfeer van een cao en/of de uitbreiding van de verplichtstellingsbeschikking van een bedrijfstakpensioenfonds

MPs Lodders and Van 't Wout asked how often and why the scope of collective agreements and pension fund compulsory membership decisions is changed, who decides, and whether 'clarifications' or 'editorial changes' disguise expansions. The ministers answered that scope is set by social partners, that Minister decides on extensions with representativeness rules and objections procedures, and gave counts of 2015-2016 scope-change decisions, while declining to investigate misuse of editorial changes.
Defining and adapting the scope of collective agreements and compulsory schemes is a responsibility of the social partners.
Het definiëren en aanpassen van werkingssferen van cao's en verplichtstellingen is een verantwoordelijkheid van sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Voortman en Karabulut over schoonmakers die werken bij het Ministerie van Buitenlandse zaken

MPs asked whether the government will act on cleaners at the Foreign Affairs ministry who may lose jobs after the move to Rijnstraat 8, including whether the government as client will protect their security, alternative work, and a permanent post at the Rijksschoonmaakorganisatie. The minister says the contractor ISS has no legal obligation to take over staff, no specific employment requirements were set, a social plan with partial takeover (9 of 21) was contractually agreed, and the Social Affairs minister is examining priority placement in other government buildings.
I will have the implementation of this plan supervised.
Ik zal toezicht laten houden op de uitvoering van dit plan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over Eritrese ambassades (Herdruk)

MPs Gesthuizen asked whether the Eritrean embassy's requirements (a repentance form and 2% diaspora tax) for passport renewal, and refusals to help Eritrean women, were acceptable and what the government would do. The State Secretary answered that the government considers linking consular services to repentance forms objectionable, has raised the issue with Eritrea and adopted a sanctions-based ban on tax collection involving coercion, and will raise concerns with European partners.
The Cabinet considers linking consular services to signing repentance forms objectionable.
Het Kabinet acht de koppeling van consulaire dienstverlening aan het tekenen van spijtbetuigingsformulieren laakbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat jongeren op basis van huidskleur of afkomst veelvuldig worden geweerd aan de deur in het uitgaansleven

An SP MP asked the minister how the government will respond to an Undercover in Nederland broadcast showing young people refused at club doors on the basis of skin colour or ethnic origin, and why municipal anti-discrimination measures have not curbed it. The minister condemned the practice, said municipalities are responsible for enforcement and that no national data on the effect of local measures exists, and promised a review of the municipal approach with the VNG and others in mid-2017 along with a repeated survey of experienced discrimination.
Municipalities bear responsibility for effective policy against discrimination in hospitality.
Gemeenten dragen verantwoordelijkheid voor een effectief beleid tegen horecadiscriminatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over maatregelen tegen discriminerende uitlatingen van medewerkers op Facebook

An MP asked ministers whether a PostNL driver's dismissal after a discriminatory Facebook post is being prosecuted, how often employers take measures against racist or discriminatory remarks, and whether employers should correct such conduct. The minister says the prosecutor is still considering prosecution, that no statistics exist on employer measures, that the labour inspectorate found 80-90 percent of 200 inspected firms lacked the legally required anti-discrimination policy and are being followed up, and that employers share responsibility through the Charter Diversiteit and the 2015 action plan.
The public prosecution service (OM) has the case under investigation.
Het openbaar ministerie (OM) heeft de zaak in onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over het bericht dat de Telegraaf Media Groep (TMG) na invoering van Wet deregulering beoordeling arbeidsrelaties (Wet DBA) de verantwoordelijkheid en risico’s van de opdrachtgev

An MP asked whether TMG's new freelancer contract, which shifts damages from false self-employment onto freelancers and imposes tight signing and invoicing deadlines, is compatible with the aims of the Wet DBA. The State Secretary answered that recourse clauses are fiscally irrelevant, that recovering only wage tax and national insurance premiums is lawful while recovering employee insurance premiums is void, and that contract terms are a matter of contractual freedom the government cannot intervene in.
The cabinet cannot intervene in the contractual freedom of parties unless mandatory legal rules are breached.
Het kabinet kan niet in de contractsvrijheid van partijen ingrijpen, tenzij er dwingendrechtelijke regels worden overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over kinderdagverblijven strijden om aanmelding ouders met presentje

An MP asked whether childcare centres use welcome gifts such as lingerie or cinema tickets to attract parents, and whether the minister would agree such gifts are undesirable and agree with brancheorganisaties to stop them. The minister said he has no data on frequency, does not want to ban welcome gifts as long as they stay within the rules, sees no evidence they harm quality, and sees no need for further agreements with the sector.
I have no indications that welcome gifts negatively affect the quality of childcare.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat welkomstcadeaus de kwaliteit van kinderopvang negatief beïnvloeden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht 'Crèche paait ouders'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that childcare organisations lure parents with welcome gifts and asked whether the sector should be regulated or given a code of conduct. The minister said parents should choose on quality, welcome gifts are acceptable within the rules, a quality rating for parents is being piloted, and a code of conduct is not considered necessary.
I do not consider a further code of conduct necessary.
Ik vind een verdere gedragscode niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat kinderopvangorganisaties ouders lokken met cadeaus

An SP MP asked the minister whether childcare providers' use of welcome gifts to attract parents, and their possible indirect use of public childcare allowance funds, was acceptable and should be investigated. The minister said gifts are not a problem if within the rules, declined to investigate or guarantee no public funds were used, and pointed to the quality reform bill and planned quality pilots instead.
No, I cannot do that. I have no insight into the internal business operations of private parties.
Nee, dat kan ik niet. Ik heb geen zicht op de interne bedrijfsvoering van private partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het Meldpunt Discriminatie Internet (MiND) dat stelt gewelddadige homohaat mag op grond van de islam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether MiND (Meldpunt Discriminatie Internet) was right to say that violent anti-gay hatred based on Islam is not discrimination, and whether it should be subsidised. The Minister acknowledged a serious error by MiND, which has apologised and had the posts removed, but said the Public Prosecution Service is the body that judges criminal conduct and that he will talk with MiND without ending the subsidy for now.
MiND's response to the posts submitted to them was a serious error.
De reactie van MiND op de aan hen voorgelegde uitingen was een ernstige fout.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Vermeij over de afwijzing als Gamze Gül en de uitnodiging als Hanneke bij Pathé Arnhem

MPs Marcouch and Vermeij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Pathé Arnhem rejecting Gamze Gül but inviting 'Hanneke' with identical application materials. The minister confirmed the facts as reported, said discrimination is unacceptable but that judging individual cases is for the ADV, the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or courts, and described the Inspectie SZW's existing discrimination-team role and industry initiatives such as the Charter Diversiteit.
Given this division of competences, it is not for me to pass a substantive judgement on this or to hold Pathé to account for it.
Het is gelet op deze bevoegdheidsverdeling niet aan mij om hierover een inhoudelijk oordeel over te vellen dan wel Pathé hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oosenbrug en Kerstens over de berichten ‘Helft websites overheid onveilig’ en ‘Veel overheid websites onnodig onveilig’

MPs Oosenbrug and Kerstens asked the ministers whether government websites are insecure, whether over half lack encrypted connections, and what risks this poses, and whether UWV's sites are affected. Minister Plasterk answered that organisations are responsible for securing their sites, that agreed targets require HTTPS on sensitive pages by end 2017, that progress is being measured, and that UWV sensitive data is adequately protected.
Each government organisation is ultimately itself responsible for securing its own government websites.
Elke overheidsorganisatie is uiteindelijk zelf verantwoordelijk voor het beveiligen van de eigen overheidswebsites.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Martin Bosma en De Graaf over het anti-Zwarte Pietenberaad

The MPs Bosma and De Graaf asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the round tables on Zwarte Piet, including attendees, how they were selected, how often they were held, and why participants were asked to sign a statement. The Minister answered that the round tables were convened by him, listed the participating organisations and dates, noted that the Chamber was informed in 2014, and said the statement was drafted at the initiative of participants.
The statement was drawn up at the initiative of the group of participants in the round table.
De verklaring is opgesteld op initiatief van de groep deelnemers aan de ronde tafel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de protestactie van ouders met autistische kinderen die geen dubbele kinderbijslag kunnen krijgen

An MP asked whether parents of autistic children who previously received the TOG allowance are losing double child benefit, how many were affected, and what the government will do. The minister says the total number of children receiving intensive-care double child benefit stayed roughly constant, that a shift in target group cannot be excluded, and that he will consult CIZ and SVB on whether parent information on the procedure is adequate.
I am therefore consulting with CIZ and SVB to see whether the information provided to parents about the procedure is sufficiently adequate.
Ik overleg daarom met CIZ en SVB om te bezien of de voorlichting aan ouders over de procedure voldoende adequaat is.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het afschaffen van de Tegemoetkoming Ouders Gehandicapte kinderen (TOG) en problemen met het recht op dubbele kinderbijslag bij ouders met kinderen met autisme

An MP asked whether abolishing the TOG allowance for parents of disabled children and the new intensive-care criteria for double child benefit unfairly exclude parents of children with autism, and how assessments and appeals work. The minister defended the new assessment framework, said autism cases are not refused more often, noted that appeals are possible, and said he sees no reason to revise the criteria now.
Based on the foregoing, I currently see no reason to revise the current assessment framework.
Op basis van voorgaande beantwoording zie ik op dit moment geen aanleiding om het huidige beoordelingskader te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over dubbele kinderbijslag voor uitwonende minderjarige leerlingen die een beroepsopleiding volgen die op weinig plekken in Nederland wordt aangeboden

An SP MP asked whether the list of rare vocational courses qualifying for double child benefit for students living away from home for education should be widened, including Media Management and Music Industry Professional. The minister replied that the under-10-institutions criterion is applied as set, that the lists are updated annually, that the two courses were excluded for 2016-2017 because they had more than 10 institutions in 2015, and that hardship cases are handled by the SVB.

The courses Media Management and Music Industry Professional are not included in the annex to the Regulation on double child benefit for educational reasons for the 2016-2017 school year because on 1 October 2015 these courses had participants enrolled at 10 institutions.

De opleidingen Media Management en Music Industry Professional zijn niet opgenomen in de bijlage bij de Regeling dubbele kinderbijslag om onderwijsredenen voor het schooljaar 2016–2017 omdat voor deze opleidingen op 1 oktober 2015 op 10 instellingen deelnemers stonden ingeschreven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het artikel 'België zet haatprediker uit naar Nederland'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether the government would bar, denaturalise or expel a Belgian-expelled Dutch imam who preaches hatred. Minister Asscher answered that Dutch citizens cannot be refused entry or expelled, that Dutch national security shows no current threat so far, and that the government will monitor him and act against incitement.
Dutch nationals cannot be refused access to the Netherlands. Nor can they be expelled.
Nederlanders kan de toegang tot Nederland niet worden geweigerd. Evenmin kunnen zij worden uitgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Kerstens over de gemeente Haarlem en Tilburg die op basis van payrolling mensen in dienst nemen

MPs Vermeij and Kerstens asked about municipalities such as Haarlem and Tilburg hiring staff via payrolling for structural work and whether the government will act. The minister answered that municipalities are responsible for their own employment policy, that social partners are already examining the issue, and that the central government sees no need for further action; payrolling rose slightly among municipalities and has ended in central government.
Municipalities are themselves competent and responsible, within the framework of general legislation and collective agreements, for their employment conditions policy and business operations.
Gemeenten zijn namelijk zelf bevoegd en verantwoordelijk binnen de kaders van algemene wetgeving en cao's voor hun arbeidsvoorwaardenbeleid en bedrijfsvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en De Roon over het artikel "Qatar financiert omstreden Deense moskee via Den Haag"

PVV MPs De Graaf and De Roon asked whether the government knows of an NRC report that Qatar channels funding for a controversial Danish mosque via its Hague embassy, whether embassies should finance Islamic infrastructure, and whether other cases exist and the Qatari ambassador should be expelled. The minister answered that transparency rules on foreign religious funding are being drafted, that the embassy is also accredited to Denmark so the matter is bilateral, and referred to a separate letter.
The cabinet is therefore drawing up further rules on the transparency of financing flows.
Het kabinet stelt daarom nadere regels op over de transparantie van financieringsstromen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Hoe Ajax en Feyenoord flirten met te jonge buitenlandse talenten’

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked whether Ajax and Feyenoord evade FIFA and Dutch rules when recruiting very young foreign football talents, and whether rules should change. The minister replied that FIFA article 19 and the Wav already give strict safeguards, no unlawful transfers are known, a referee-style intermediary quality mark is being developed, and no further talks are needed.
Moreover, I am not aware of any cases of unlawful transfers of (too) young talented football players.
Overigens zijn bij mij geen gevallen bekend van onrechtmatige transfers van (te) jonge talentvolle voetbalspelers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘GGD bezorgd over ruim helft kinderdagverblijven’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Volkskrant report that GGD inspection risk profiles flagged many childcare centres in low-income neighbourhoods, questioning the conclusions, the adequacy of unannounced inspections, quality ratings for parents, and links between neighbourhood income and quality. The minister rejects the newspaper's conclusions, says risk profiles are not quality ratings, commits to a public quality assessment pilot in 2017 and to asking the Inspectorate to examine any income-quality link.
To gain better insight into this, I will ask the Inspectorate of Education to investigate this further together with GGD GHOR Nederland.
Om hier beter zicht op te krijgen zal ik de Inspectie van het Onderwijs vragen om dit – samen met GGD GHOR Nederland – verder uit te zoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de geheime moskeelijst van het kabinet

Two MPs asked whether a list of mosques and Islamic organisations receiving Saudi funding exists, why parliament was allegedly misinformed, and whether anything is being withheld. The government refers to earlier answers on the matter, says there is nothing further it is withholding, and states that the overview was shared confidentially with parliament.
The cabinet has shared the relevant overview with your House on a confidential basis.
Het kabinet heeft het betreffende overzicht vertrouwelijk met uw Kamer gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken- de Haan, Van ’t Wout en Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht ‘Baan via gemeente of UWV? Vergeet het maar!’

MPs from the VVD asked the ministers about a Trouw report based on an Inspectorate SZW study showing weak cooperation between municipalities and UWV in placing jobseekers, and about knowledge management, the knowledge programme 'Vakkundig aan het werk', and how to raise employer uptake. The government acknowledged the cooperation problems, described existing and planned measures (knowledge programmes, Kandidatenverkenner, Programmaraad activities) and committed to a progress letter before 15 March 2017.
As promised during the Participation Act committee debate of 27 October, your House will be informed by letter before 15 March about progress.
Zoals toegezegd tijdens het AO Participatiewet van 27 oktober jl., zal uw Kamer voor 15 maart per brief geïnformeerd worden over de voortgang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten ‘Salafisten Rotterdam hebben omstreden geldschieter’ en ‘Hoe salafistengeld naar Nederland stroomt’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Salafist groups in Rotterdam were funded by a controversial donor (Eid Charity) and asked whether the foundation should be kept out of the Netherlands or its property purchase reversed. The minister said the Rotterdam municipality is negotiating a sale of the building after the foundation pledged to stop its activities there, and that it is for the Public Prosecution Service to decide whether to request a court ban on the Al Nour foundation.

It is for the Public Prosecution Service to assess whether there are facts and circumstances that give cause to file a request for a civil-law prohibition or dissolution under art. 2:20 BW with the court.

Het is aan het Openbaar Ministerie om te beoordelen of er feiten en omstandigheden aanwezig zijn die aanleiding vormen om een verzoek tot civielrechtelijke verbodenverklaring of ontbinding ex art. 2:20 BW bij de rechtbank in te dienen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Martin Bosma en De Graaf  over de actieve bemoeienis van de minister van Sociale Zaken met Zwarte Piet

PVV MPs asked why the Minister of Social Affairs is involved in the Sinterklaas and Zwarte Piet debate, which other feasts he engages with, who attended his round table and why a declaration was requested. The minister answered that the government sees a role in facilitating respectful dialogue but rejects a state ban, and listed the round-table participants and said the declaration originated with the participants.
The cabinet is of the view that a state ban on Zwarte Piet is not the way out.
Het kabinet is van mening dat een verbod op Zwarte Piet van staatswege niet de uitweg is
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het al dan niet algemeen verbindend verklaren van de cao besloten busvervoer

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the new collective agreement for private bus transport should be declared generally binding, given shifting union and employer representation and an early start date. The Minister answers that no request for general binding declaration has been received yet, that representativeness rules and the consultation procedure will be applied if one is filed, and that declining representativeness after adoption does not affect the decision.
Only when a concluded collective agreement is registered with the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment is the government formally informed which parties have contracted.
Pas door aanmelding van een eenmaal afgesloten cao bij het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid wordt de overheid formeel op de hoogte gesteld welke partijen gecontracteerd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Kerstens over het arrest van de Hoge Raad dat payrolling synoniem staat voor uitzendwerk

MPs Vermeij and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Supreme Court ruling that payrolling falls under the temporary-agency rules and whether this will lead to more insecure contracts. The minister confirmed awareness, said the rules apply to triangular relations and that legislative change is needed but will not come in this cabinet period, deferring to a future coalition agreement.
However, a legislative amendment will not be achievable within this cabinet period.
Een wetswijziging zal echter niet meer in deze kabinetsperiode verwezenlijkt kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Kerstens over flexwerkers die aanzienlijk minder verdienen dan collega’s in vaste dienst

MPs Vermeij and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about CBS findings that flex workers earn much less than permanent staff, and whether this violates equal pay. The minister acknowledged the gap, noted that controlling only for hours and tenure leaves differences, said equal pay for equal work is legally required but that courts, not the minister, judge violations, and said the Wwz reforms will be evaluated in 2018 and 2020.
Whether the above legal provisions are being violated, I cannot assess on the basis of the outcomes of this research.
Of in strijd wordt gehandeld met bovengenoemde wettelijke bepalingen kan ik aan de hand van de uitkomsten van dit onderzoek niet beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Van ’t Wout over het bericht "Weinig Nederlanders zoeken een baan over de grens"

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the slow start of the cross-border job placement plan 'Grenzeloos Werken', the status of a related motion, and UWV's separate Limburg-Germany placement plan. The minister said the plan has not started yet due to difficulty raising private co-financing, that subsidy rules will be adapted to allow more public funding, and that the UWV cross-border work is financed from its regular budget and is distinct from the sectoral plan.
For the specific situation involving employers across the border, I am therefore willing to adjust the scheme and thereby create room for more public financing.
Voor de specifieke situatie waarbij men te maken heeft met werkgevers over de grens ben ik dan ook bereid de regeling aan te passen en daarmee ruimte te creëren voor meer publieke financiering
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de uitspraak van de Raad van State over de uitbuiting van zeelieden

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Council of State ruling that the seafarers' union Nautilus is an interested party entitled to appeal the rejection of its enforcement request concerning exploitation of seafarers. The minister said the ruling concerns standing rather than exploitation itself, that the Inspectorate found a violation by a different company and fined it, and that the ruling will be applied immediately.
The ruling makes clear that Nautilus must be regarded as an interested party within the meaning of the General Administrative Law Act (Awb) regarding the enforcement request.
De uitspraak maakt duidelijk dat Nautilus moet worden beschouwd als belanghebbende in de zin van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht (Awb) bij het handhavingsverzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Omtzigt over het VVD-filmpje over de Wet Deregulering Beoordeling Arbeidsrelaties

MPs Van Weyenberg and Omtzigt asked about a VVD video implying the DBA law was postponed, the legal status of enforcement suspension, and plans to change labour law and communicate with clients. Staatssecretaris Wiebes answered that enforcement was postponed (not the law itself), that a separate policy decision is not issued, that a labour-law review is underway with a timeline, and that enforcement will focus on about ten malicious cases.
What has been postponed is, of course, the enforcement.
Wat is uitgesteld is natuurlijk de handhaving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Kerstens over het recht op een werkloosheidsuitkering voor Nederlanders die in Caribisch Nederland werkzaam zijn geweest

Two MPs asked whether Dutch nationals whose last job was on Bonaire, Sint Eustatius or Saba can claim unemployment benefit under the Werkloosheidswet, and whether this should be changed. The minister confirmed that such workers are excluded from the European-Dutch unemployment insurance, pointed to the one-off Cessentiawet BES benefit on the islands, and refused to change the rules.

No. Employees whose last work was in Caribbean Netherlands can claim a one-off benefit under the Cessentiawet BES, if they become unemployed through no fault of their own and meet the other conditions.
Nee. Werknemers die laatstelijk werkzaam zijn geweest in Caribisch Nederland kunnen aanspraak maken op een eenmalige uitkering op grond van de Cessentiawet BES
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het persbericht van Promovendi Netwerk Nederland dat 10% van alle promovendi een dubieuze aanstelling aangeboden krijgt

MPs Mei Li Vos and Kerstens asked the ministers about a PNN press release claiming 10% of PhD candidates receive dubious short or part-time contracts that may evade the Wwz. The minister replied that such contracts are lawful, reflect tailored PhD tracks, and that she will keep talking with PNN and send a letter on careers.
The PNN research concerns vacancy texts.
Het onderzoek van het Promovendi Netwerk Nederland (PNN) heeft betrekking op vacatureteksten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuzu over het bericht dat slechts een kwart van de aangiften van discriminatie in behandeling wordt genomen door het openbaar ministerie

An MP asked the ministers about reports that only a quarter of discrimination complaints reach the public prosecution service, and what is being done to raise reporting and improve handling, including online discrimination. The government denies the figures as stated, says it shares concern about reporting and is reviewing the Discrimination Directive with police and OM, but refuses a racism register, a racism police unit, and dedicated extra budget, pointing to existing action programmes.
For an explanation of this, I refer to the answer to questions 2 and 3 from Member Marcouch.
Voor een verklaring hiervoor verwijs ik naar het antwoord op de vragen 2 en 3 van het lid Marcouch
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Van Dekken over het ziek worden van sporten op kunstgrasvelden

MPs Tanamal and Van Dekken asked whether artificial turf rubber infill poses health risks to players and to workers who install the fields, and whether RIVM and the labour inspectorate will investigate. The minister maintains RIVM's view that exposure poses no health risk, but has asked RIVM for a literature review and a representative sampling study, and will await those results before deciding further steps.
Because the broadcast caused considerable public unrest, the Minister of VWS asked RIVM to conduct a technical literature review.
Omdat de uitzending de nodige onrust in de samenleving heeft veroorzaakt heeft de Minister van VWS het RIVM gevraagd om een technisch literatuuronderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over discriminatie van autochtonen door een Haagse wethouder

Two MPs asked the ministers whether a The Hague alderman's plan to give preference to candidates of migrant background in hiring, when equally qualified, amounts to discrimination against natives and whether the alderman should be called to account. The minister answered that such preferential policy is permitted under strict conditions of the Algemene wet gelijke behandeling, that municipalities bear their own responsibility, and that he sees no reason to intervene for now, while promising to inform the House on follow-up action after an anti-discrimination monitor.
A municipality has in principle its own responsibility, and the municipal executive must account for this to the municipal council.
Een gemeente heeft in beginsel een eigen verantwoordelijkheid en het gemeentebestuur dient hierover rekenschap te geven aan de gemeenteraad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht ‘langer verlof? vergeet 't maar

Parliamentarian Pieter Heerma (CDA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that the multiple-birth leave scheme can shorten leave for mothers of twins or triplets when delivery is early, and whether this produces savings. The minister answered that the shortfall is an unintended effect, that UWV has received few complaints, and committed to amend the Wet arbeid en zorg via a nota van wijziging while deferring the question of retroactive correction.
I will include this as a nota van wijziging in the forthcoming bill on extending maternity leave.
Ik zal dit als nota van wijziging meenemen bij het nog in te dienen wetsvoorstel betreffende de uitbreiding van het kraamverlof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes  en Kerstens over Uitbuiting van personeel bij de Qatarese ambassade

MPs Servaes and Kerstens asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs about reported labour exploitation of staff at the Qatari embassy and how the government supervises working conditions at embassies. The minister said privacy prevents discussing individual cases, described a monitoring system for domestic staff and a mediation practice for local staff, noted that embassies cannot be forced to comply with court rulings, and said staff can access legal aid.
Due to privacy considerations, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs cannot address individual cases.
Vanwege privacyoverwegingen kan het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken niet ingaan op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat de nieuwe verlofregeling voor de moeder van een meerling in de praktijk tegenvalt

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the extended 20-week leave for mothers of multiples works in practice, given that some mothers of multiples get less total leave than mothers of singletons after preterm birth. The minister acknowledged the unintended effect and committed to amending the Wet arbeid en zorg, with timing to be communicated later.

Now, however, in practice it appears that women pregnant with multiples in many cases end up with less leave overall than before, which can be regarded as an unforeseen and unintended effect of the scheme, I am prepared to amend the Wet arbeid en zorg on this point.

Nu in de praktijk echter blijkt dat vrouwen bij de zwangerschap van een meerling in veel gevallen per saldo minder verlof genieten dan voorheen, hetgeen als onvoorzien en onbedoeld effect van de regeling kan worden beschouwd, ben ik bereid de Wet arbeid en zorg op dit punt aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Poolse vrouwen te maken hebben met scheldpartijen, bedreigingen en aanrandingen

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister of Social Affairs and Employment how the government responds to reports from Stichting Fairwork that Polish women working in factories and agriculture face insults, threats and sexual harassment, and whether the Inspectorate will investigate, check complaints, and bring the campaign on unwanted behaviour to migrant workers in their own language. Minister Asscher replied that the Inspectorate has a risk-based approach to these sectors and will report soon, that the campaign will not be translated but targets employers and includes a migrant worker testimonial, and that information for migrant workers will be provided in origin countries such as Poland.
She will report to me soon, after which I will inform your House.
Ze bericht mij hier binnenkort over, waarna ik uw Kamer zal informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht ‘Computers UWV crashen elke dag en info raakt zoek’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether around 14,000 messages and reports were lost due to recurring UWV IT crashes, whether citizens' privacy is safeguarded, and how the service quality will be improved in the short term. The minister answered that about 1,000 client messages were lost (clients were contacted or notified), 13,000 reports were processed late, no privacy breach occurred, and ongoing ICT updates and prioritised stability projects are underway.
According to UWV, disruptions on UWV's server caused 1,000 messages entered by clients via the Werkmap on Werk.nl to be lost.
Volgens UWV zijn door verstoringen op de server van UWV 1.000 berichten verloren gegaan die klanten via de Werkmap op Werk.nl hebben ingevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat zwangerschapsdiscriminatie niet afneemt en dat de meldingsbereidheid is gehalveerd

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister for Social Affairs how to respond to reports that pregnancy discrimination is not declining and that women's willingness to report it has halved, and whether the Inspectorate SZW should be given powers to detect and sanction it. The minister says existing action plans are being given time, a roundtable with the Human Rights Institute and stakeholders was held, further measures are being explored, and the Inspectorate already has a role but individual cases are for the courts or the College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Where necessary, additional measures will be taken.
Waar nodig zullen daarbij aanvullende maatregelen worden opgepakt.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat asielzoekers een onvoldoende geven aan de inburgeringscursussen die worden aangeboden en dat gemeenten ontevreden zijn dat zij niet meer verantwoordelijk zijn

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that asylum seekers rate civic integration courses poorly and that municipalities are dissatisfied with losing responsibility for integration. The minister acknowledged that three hours a week is insufficient, announced an external quality supervision arrangement for courses, and pointed to ongoing dialogue, a forthcoming evaluation and an Algemene Rekenkamer report expected in early 2017.
Therefore, in close consultation with BoW, the Inspectie SZW and OCW, it was decided to have the supervision carried out by an external expert party.
Daarom is er met BoW – in nauw overleg met de Inspectie SZW en OCW – besloten het toezicht uit te laten voeren door een externe deskundige partij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma en Van Meenen over het bericht “meer uitkeringen door Syriërs en en Wajongeren”

MPs Sjoerdsma and Van Meenen asked about reports of rising benefit claims by Syrians and Wajong recipients, including data on Syrian welfare recipients, costs, language training and diploma recognition. The minister answered with CBS figures, describes pre-integration courses and volunteer training, and says a letter on the motion for language lessons from day one will follow before the budget debate.
The realised costs of increased welfare benefits for Syrians are not registered separately.
De gerealiseerde kosten van toegenomen bijstand door Syriërs worden niet afzonderlijk geregistreerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat drie moskeeën zijn aangevallen

An MP asked ministers about reports that three mosques were attacked, the security of Islamic buildings, the rise in anti-Muslim incidents and whether protection should match that for Jewish sites. The government answered that violence against mosques is unacceptable, that compensation would be sought through civil or criminal channels, that no generic preventive measures are advised at present, and that an anti-discrimination action programme and a working group on mosque security are in place.
Violence against Muslims and mosques is unacceptable.
Geweld tegen moslims en moskeeën is onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat dat de Kinderombudsman wordt bedreigd vanwege haar mening over Zwarte Piet

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about reports that the Children's Ombudsman was threatened over her views on Zwarte Piet, and about discrimination children experience and whether the tradition breaches the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. The government condemned the threats, said security measures are taken when needed without detailing them, declined to take a cabinet position on Zwarte Piet, and offered facilitation of dialogue plus a planned new research study.
However, I cannot provide information about the content of any security measures.
Ik kan echter geen informatie verstrekken over inhoud van eventuele beveiligingsmaatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en De Lange over het bericht “Amsterdam krijgt ‘Turks’ ziekenhuis”

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers about reports of a 'Turkish' hospital in Amsterdam, including its funding, whether it respects equal treatment, patient rights and gender norms, and when the inspectorate will visit. The minister answered that funding is for the hospital to disclose, that patient choice and anti-discrimination rules apply equally, that the hospital holds a WTZi licence and has been sent the inspectorate's questionnaire, and that a visit depends on the information received.
If there are signals that a hospital is not complying with the rules, action will be taken against it.
Indien er signalen zijn dat een ziekenhuis zich niet aan de regels houdt dan zal hier tegen worden opgetreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Miltenburg over het bericht dat ‘De overheid discrimineert’

An MP asked the ministers whether government and companies discriminate through job application forms that ask for age, sex or marital status, and whether that is unlawful. The minister answered that asking for such information is not per se discriminatory, that the central government's vacancy site does not require those fields and does not ask marital status, and that no research is currently planned.
There is currently no clear reason to start such an investigation.
Er is op dit moment geen duidelijke aanleiding om een dergelijk onderzoek te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klever en De Graaf over de komst van een Turks ziekenhuis in Amsterdam

PVV MPs Klever and De Graaf asked whether they object to a Turkish hospital opening in Amsterdam, whether Turkish influence should be resisted, and whether the Inspectorate will check the clinic, including on circumcision and medication. The minister replied that she has no objection while the clinic meets Dutch standards, that the IGZ and NZa supervise it, and that it will be inspected like other new entrants.
The IGZ treats and inspects the Stichting Acibadem International Medical Center as it inspects all new entrants to check whether they meet the standards applicable in the Netherlands.
De IGZ behandelt en inspecteert de Stichting Acibadem International Medical Center zoals zij alle nieuwe toetreders inspecteert of aan de in Nederland geldende normen wordt voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het afschaffen van de logeerregeling voor statushouders

SP MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked the State Secretary about abolishing the guest-family arrangement for status holders, including usage numbers, costs, integration effects, and confusion over whether the scheme was ended. The State Secretary answered that the scheme remains open, the self-care arrangement ended by law, no data exists on integration effects, and the scheme's future is under review.
No data is available on the effect that a status holder's stay with a guest family has on their civic integration.
Er zijn geen gegevens beschikbaar over het effect dat het verblijf van een vergunninghouder in een gastgezin heeft op zijn/haar inburgering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Zelf taal leren en integreren mislukt”

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that self-directed language learning and integration had failed, that refugees borrow more under the new civic integration law than ROCs used to receive, and about the cost of waivers and debt forgiveness. The minister acknowledged disappointing results, said a study into the causes would report in autumn, and gave debt-forgiveness and loan figures while cautioning that the cost comparison is only a preliminary indication.
At present it is being examined what the reasons are that integration candidates fail the civic integration examination.
Op dit moment wordt onderzocht wat de redenen zijn waardoor inburgeraars niet slagen voor het inburgeringsexamen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat DuPont honderden kilo’s formaldehyde heeft gelekt

Two SP MPs asked the government about a reported leak of 2,730 kg of carcinogenic formaldehyde at DuPont, whether it was allowed to keep using the substance despite a claimed European ban, what the effects on workers, residents and the environment are, and how the company's safety culture would be addressed. The state secretary answered that no ban exists but a minimisation duty applies, that a criminal complaint and joint provincial and Inspectie SZW investigations are underway, that an initial indication shows no harm to health or environment, and that some production lines were halted at the province's urging, while declining to pre-judge the investigation outcomes.

Because a criminal complaint about this incident has been filed with the Public Prosecution Service on behalf of the province of Zuid-Holland, the competent authority for this company, I do not consider it appropriate to give a further judgment at this time.

Omdat er van dit incident namens de provincie Zuid-Holland, het bevoegd gezag voor dit bedrijf, aangifte is gedaan bij het Openbaar Ministerie acht ik het niet gepast op dit moment een nader oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over de door Turkije verspreide lijst van zogenaamde Gülenorganisaties in Nederland

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked the government about a list of Dutch organisations labelled as Gülen-linked that Turkey's state news agency circulated, and whether the government would act against Turkish interference and protect those named. The Minister of Foreign Affairs condemned such lists, said he had conveyed to Turkish officials that direct interference in domestic affairs is unacceptable, and referred to letters and the government's existing protection arrangements for those under threat.
The cabinet strongly disapproves of lists circulating in any form, regardless of who is on them.
Het kabinet keurt ten zeerste af dat er lijsten circuleren, in welke vorm dan ook en ongeacht wie daarop staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Bommel en Karabulut over het bericht dat de Turkse staatsmedia een lijst met Gülen-organisaties in Nederland heeft gepubliceerd

Two SP MPs asked the government about a Turkish state media list of Gülen-linked organisations in the Netherlands, including whether agreements were made with Turkey to stop intimidation and political export, whether Zaman Nederland and HOGIAF are labelled terrorist, whether extradition or prosecution requests exist, and whether Dutch research was shared with Turkey. The minister replied that the government firmly rejects such lists, has conveyed that Turkish tensions must not be exported, has received no evidence of direct involvement of the named organisations, has received one extradition request under review, and has not directly shared the Dutch research with Turkish authorities.
The cabinet strongly disapproves of lists circulating, in whatever form and composition, and by whomever.
Het kabinet keurt het ten zeerste af dat er lijsten circuleren, in welke vorm en samenstelling dan ook, en door wie dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Turkse Grijze Wolven door de straten van Arnhem marcheren

MPs Karabulut asked whether an Arnhem Turkish festival parade linked to the Grey Wolves was acceptable, whether the municipality and a mosque were connected to the organisers, and whether the municipality should have known. The government answered that the parade had a folkloric character and a permit, that the municipality's only link was facilitating the festival, that free expression has limits but people are judged on conduct, and that the municipality chose to be present at the festival.
It is up to the municipality of Arnhem to decide whether it wants to be represented at a multicultural event in its municipality.
Het is aan de gemeente Arnhem om te bepalen of zij vertegenwoordigd willen zijn in een multicultureel evenement in hun gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over spanningen binnen de Turkse gemeenschap in Nederland

An MP asked ministers about attacks on a Turkish mosque and intimidation of a Kurdish family, possible cross-border involvement, and tensions between Turkish, Kurdish and Alevi communities, and what was being done about reported incidents. The minister answered that criminal investigations are ongoing and details cannot be shared, that incidents are reported to police rather than a central registry, and that dialogue meetings with community organisations continue.
In the interest of this ongoing investigation, no further substantive statements can be made.
In het belang van dit lopende onderzoek kunnen geen verdere inhoudelijke mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over bedreigingen en geweld tegen de Hizmet gemeenschap in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers about threats and violence against the Hizmet community in the Netherlands and what the government was doing to register, investigate and protect targets and to address online hate. The ministers answered that police handle criminal cases, that a special police team now collects reports, that local authorities bear primary responsibility with national support available, and that agreements exist with social media companies.
Given the large concentration of reports in the Rotterdam unit, it was decided to temporarily set up a special team at the police for this purpose.
Gezien de grote concentratie van aangiften in de eenheid Rotterdam is besloten om hiervoor tijdelijk een speciaal team in het leven te roepen bij de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over doodsbedreigingen aan adres Nederturken door Erdogan-aanhangers

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the ministers about threats, boycott lists and demonstrations by Erdogan supporters against critical Turkish-Dutch people, and about foreign influence via Diyanet. The government condemns intimidation and refers to earlier letters, says foreign funding of mosques is not banned but is watched for undue influence, and states that Turkish-Dutch integration is a concern to be discussed with communities.
The Netherlands has no ban on foreign financing of mosque associations, general religious associations or institutions.
Nederland kent geen verbod op buitenlandse financiering van moskeeverenigingen, algemene religieuze verenigingen of instellingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Turkse Nederlanders en journalisten worden bedreigd

MP Karabulut asked the Dutch government about threats against Turkish-Dutch people and journalists after the 2016 Turkish coup attempt, including vandalism, boycott lists and calls by the Turkish consulate to support Erdoğan, and about integration policy. The government condemned threats, vandalism and boycott lists, said local authorities use an integrated approach, and referred to earlier letters and consultations for the rest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Leijten over het bericht “Je laat je kind niet in de steek”

MP Leijten asked ministers about a newspaper report on a psychotic, addicted unemployed man left without support, asking for analysis, cost data, housing figures, and coordination between agencies. Minister Schippers acknowledged fragmented, cross-domain service delivery, stated she lacks overviews on costs and discharges without housing, and said she will urge regional parties to act but cannot resolve the individual case.
I do not have such an overview.
Ik beschik niet over een dergelijk overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het artikel over jongeren die niet meer kunnen rondkomen

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a newspaper report that young people can no longer make ends meet, citing falling economic independence and rising youth unemployment. The minister replies that the decline mainly reflects longer education, outlines measures on youth unemployment, internships and a lower youth minimum wage, and rejects an unconditional basic income.
To improve the income position of young people, the cabinet is working on a legislative amendment to lower the statutory age threshold for the adult statutory minimum wage to 21.

Om de inkomenspositie van jongeren te verbeteren werkt het kabinet dan ook aan een wetswijziging om de wettelijke grens voor het ingaan van het volwassen wettelijk minimumloon te verlagen tot de leeftijd van 21 jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten en het lid Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat weinig Nederlanders werk vinden in Duitsland

MPs from ChristenUnie and CDA asked about a report that few Dutch people seek work in Germany, and about the Actieteam grensoverschrijdende economie en arbeid, INTERREG funding and cross-border information points. The minister acknowledges untapped cross-border job potential, describes ongoing Actieteam work with results promised in Q1 2017, and notes that border information point funding is temporary with an SZW evaluation planned for 2018.
As far as can now be seen, the cabinet will inform you of the results of the Actieteam by the first quarter of 2017 at the latest.
Naar het zich nu laat aanzien, wordt u uiterlijk in het eerste kwartaal 2017 door het kabinet geïnformeerd over de resultaten van het Actieteam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk inzake het bericht dat een 'Gülenschool' in Amsterdam wordt beveiligd

MPs Karabulut and Van Dijk asked about extra security at Gülen-linked schools in Amsterdam, possible foreign funding of schools, and whether political conflicts should stay out of schools. The state secretary said extra security was temporary and local, that inspection found no sign of external funding, and that schools should not become a political arena, while supporting schools and municipalities.
I am aware that at various schools security was present at the beginning of this school year.
Het is mij bekend dat op verschillende scholen aan het begin van dit schooljaar beveiliging aanwezig was.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bergkamp over huwelijksdwang en huwelijkse gevangenschap

An MP asked the minister about forced marriage and marital captivity in the Netherlands, including figures, research gaps, effectiveness of interventions, recognition of Dutch divorces abroad, and embassy support.
