The minister acknowledged the problem, said no new figures or research into prevalence will be done and that prevention will be emphasised, referred prosecution figures to a later report, and said he will raise recognition of Dutch divorces with third countries and that embassies can only refer such cases to local authorities.

I am willing, in my contacts with third countries and in appropriate fora such as the Hague Conference on Private International Law, to draw attention to the importance of recognition of divorces pronounced in the Netherlands.

Ik ben bereid in mijn contacten met derde landen en in daartoe geëigende gremia, zoals de Haagse Conferentie voor Internationaal Privaatrecht, aandacht te vragen voor het belang van de erkenning van in Nederland uitgesproken echtscheidingen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de stijging van topinkomens door bonussen aan de ene kant en de laagste loonkostenstijging van de afgelopen twintig jaar aan de andere kant alsmede het bericht dat de volgend

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about rising top incomes through bonuses, the lowest wage-cost growth in twenty years, a McKinsey claim that 70% of Dutch people lost disposable income, and inequality, asking about caps, the Corporate Governance Code, transitional law for the Wet Normering Topinkomens, flexibilisation and the labour income share. The minister answered that pay policy is primarily a company matter, pointed to works council powers and the WNT and financial-sector bonus caps, disputed the McKinsey figure, and said no further policy change was needed.
The fact that pay policy is primarily a matter for the company itself does not change that.
Het feit dat het beloningsbeleid primair een aangelegenheid is voor de onderneming zelf doet daar niets aan af.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over een bezoek van een Turkse minister aan Nederland

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked whether a visiting Turkish minister made inflammatory remarks about Gülen supporters and whether he should be denied entry to the Netherlands. The minister replied that the statements were the Turkish minister's responsibility, that the government had raised concerns with Turkish authorities and that it does not consider entry bans appropriate.
The cabinet does not share that view. We must remain in dialogue with the Turkish authorities.
Het kabinet deelt die opvatting niet. We moeten in gesprek blijven met de Turkse autoriteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht dat Golfstaten Nederland informatie over financiële steun aan religieuze instellingen verstrekken

Four MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Gulf states share information on financing of religious institutions in the Netherlands, including whether a list of Saudi-financed institutions exists and why it is withheld. The answer refers to the oral questions asked on the same topic, so no substantive answers to the written questions are given here.
The written questions from MPs Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) and Karabulut (SP) (question number 2016Z14749, submitted 13 July 2016) have been answered through oral questions.
De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Sjoerdsma (D66), Azmani (VVD), Knops (CDA) en Karabulut (SP) (vraagnummer 2016Z14749 , ingezonden 13 juli 2016) zijn beantwoord middels mondelinge vragen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘Winkelpersoneel McGregor dupe van doorstart’

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether McGregor's doorstart, which replaced older long-serving staff with temporary agency workers, was acceptable and whether bankruptcy law was misused. The minister said assessing the case is for the curator and courts, noted limits on age discrimination and workers' remedies, and said the bankruptcy law review and labour position of workers in insolvency will be examined in consultation with the Justice Minister.
It is not for me but for the curator and possibly the court to give a judgement on this concrete practical case.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan de curator en eventueel aan de rechter om hierover in dit concrete praktijkgeval een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de toename van dodelijke ongevallen in de bouw

Kerstens (PvdA) asked the minister why fatal accidents in construction rose, how flexible labour and language barriers affect safety, and what the sector and government will do. The minister answered that the rise is provisional, linked to higher construction output and fragmented site responsibilities, and promised tighter construction-process rules and continued monitoring.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de berichten “McGregor werkt oudgedienden eruit: 200 ontslagen” en “Een zaak waar je zo wordt ingeruild”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the dismissal of about 200 senior staff at McGregor after bankruptcy and replacement with cheaper temporary workers amounts to age discrimination, and whether bankruptcy law should be tightened to protect older workers. The minister said assessing the specific case is for the curator and possibly the courts, that older workers should have a place in a restart, and that the employment position of workers in bankruptcy is being studied with stakeholder consultation to follow.
It is not for me as Minister of Social Affairs and Employment to assess this specific practical situation.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid om deze specifieke praktijksituatie te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel 'Oudere werknemers de dupe bij doorstart door nieuwe wet'

Krol (50PLUS) asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Wwz makes older workers more costly in a doorstart after bankruptcy, and whether McGregor staff with 7+ years' service were excluded and how workers' protection can be improved. The minister says the Wwz keeps accrued service through successor-employer rules, that the choice was deliberate, and that he will consult stakeholders on the curator's role in protecting workers' interests.
I am aware that a company bankruptcy can have considerable consequences for employees, even when the bankrupt company makes a doorstart.
Ik ben me ervan bewust dat een faillissement van een onderneming aanzienlijke gevolgen kan hebben voor de werknemers, ook wanneer de failliete onderneming een doorstart maakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel ‘Meer dan honderd regelingen voor ouderen slecht benut’

MP Krol asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that companies miss out on large sums of premium discounts and subsidies for older and disabled workers, and asked how the government would ensure firms know about and can navigate these schemes. The minister declined to judge the unseen Aon study, said existing schemes are already communicated through several channels, and stated that unused funds generally return to the treasury.
I cannot give a judgement on findings that I do not know.
Ik kan geen oordeel geven over bevindingen die ik niet ken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Recourt over oudere werknemers die de dupe zijn bij een doorstart na faillissement

MPs Vermeij and Recourt asked whether older employees are disadvantaged in going-concern takeovers after bankruptcy and whether the Work and Security Act affects this, and whether curators should weigh employees' interests. The minister answered that employers may select staff but may not discriminate on age, that a comparative study on employee positions in insolvency was sent to parliament, and that consultation with stakeholders on curators' role for employees will follow.
No figures are available on how many and which employees are taken on by the acquiring party in a going-concern takeover after bankruptcy.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over hoeveel en welke werknemers bij een doorstart na faillissement in dienst treden bij de overnemende partij.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Bosman over het bericht "Ministerie overweegt kwijtschelding subsidiefraude bij Movimientu Antiano i Arubano pa Provomé Partisipashon MAAPP (beweging ter bevordering van

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Bosman (VVD) asked why a 2010 subsidy to MAAPP was not recovered or fined after a former chair misappropriated funds, and how the ministry controls subsidy spending. The minister answered that only EUR 47,934 of EUR 159,608 was accounted for, the ministry holds a claim of EUR 79,752, no legal basis exists for a fine, and the claim was written off under the 2014 remission rules.
The chair did not spend this amount on behalf of MAAPP, so the foundation could account for only EUR 47,934.
Dit bedrag heeft de voorzitter niet ten behoeve van MAAPP besteed waardoor de stichting slechts een bedrag van € 47.934 heeft kunnen verantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Bommel over het bericht dat bedienden van diplomaten uitbuiting op ambassades in Nederland melden

MPs Karabulut and Van Bommel asked whether exploitation of domestic staff of diplomats at embassies in the Netherlands is acceptable, whether further investigation and sanctions are possible, and whether staff are informed of their rights. The minister replied that Dutch labour law applies, but inspection and enforcement bodies lack legal competence on embassy premises, so BZ relies on semi-annual monitoring interviews, a sanction of withdrawing the domestic-staff privilege, and rights briefings.

Based on the Vienna Conventions on Diplomatic and Consular Relations and the headquarters agreements with international organisations, Dutch inspection and investigative services have no legal authority to investigate or enforce on the premises of embassies, consulates or international organisations.

Op basis van het Verdrag van Wenen inzake Diplomatiek Verkeer, het Verdrag van Wenen inzake Consulaire Betrekkingen en zetelverdragen tussen hier gevestigde internationale organisaties en Nederland hebben Nederlandse inspectie- en opsporingsdiensten geen wettelijke bevoegdheid om onderzoek te doen op het terrein van ambassades, consulaten en/of internationale organisaties of om daar handhavend op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over mogelijk etnisch profileren van ondernemers

An MP asks several ministers whether inspection and licensing bodies may be ethnically profiling entrepreneurs through risk models, large joint enforcement teams and the 'slecht levensgedrag' licence criterion. The minister answers that ethnicity is not a selection variable, that the government opposes profiling and points to existing measures, but declines to provide lists, case-level quickscans or a fundamental investigation, pointing to municipal responsibility.
No, a list of fined companies alone cannot support any conclusion about how companies are selected.
Nee, uit alleen een overzicht van beboete bedrijven valt geen conclusie te trekken over de selectie van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de stand van zaken bij het Bureau Kwaliteit Kinderopvang

An SP MP asked the minister about the status of quality assurance of BKK-approved language and interaction training for childcare staff, whether its effectiveness has been scientifically proven, and what improvements BKK has made since 2014 and how the minister supervises them. The minister answered that monitoring is ongoing, that effects are well-founded but not yet independently studied, that an independent effectiveness study is planned for autumn with results promised in spring 2017, and that the ministry follows progress through regular consultation.
I intend to commission an independent study this autumn into the effects of the training courses.
Ik ben voornemens om dit najaar een onafhankelijk onderzoek te laten uitvoeren naar de effecten van de trainingen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en van Dekken over de ‘Soldiers of Odin’

MPs Marcouch and Van Dekken asked the ministers about the Soldiers of Odin group, a far-right street patrol in Winschoten, including whether a man allegedly assaulted by the group had been properly investigated and whether the police response was too lenient. The minister answered that the group is limited in size, opposes intimidation, that police investigated the injuries and the man's conduct, and that no criminal offences were yet established.
Intimidating or discriminating against groups or persons is prohibited.
Het intimideren en/of discrimineren van groepen of personen is verboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders, Fritsma en De Graaf over (Integratie) over de kosten van asiel en immigratie

MPs Wilders, Fritsma and De Graaf asked for year-by-year net costs of asylum and immigrant groups, and the costs of the 2014-2015 asylum cohort over 30 years including family migration. The State Secretary refused both, stating the government does not keep accounts of costs and benefits by group or origin and only evaluates policy, not citizens.
This cabinet also does not keep accounts of (groups of) citizens.
Ook dit kabinet houdt geen boekhouding van (groepen) burgers bij.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over het signaal dat steeds minder ROC’s bereid zijn om Eerder Verworven Competenties (EVC’s) te beoordelen

The VVD MP Lucas asks whether vocational colleges (ROCs) are refusing to assess prior-learning certificates (EVCs) and whether a convenant and a transition to a validation route are causing confusion, along with questions on fees, Servicepunt support and language/maths test recognition. Minister Bussemaker answers that no such instruction exists, that a transition to a two-route validation system is underway with Servicepunt support for two years, that the convenant is still being finalised, and that there are no standard EVC fees.
I have asked the Servicepunt Examinering to support educational institutions in recognising prior acquired competences for two years from the beginning of 2016.
Ik heb het Servicepunt Examinering gevraagd om vanaf begin 2016, gedurende twee jaar, onderwijsinstellingen te ondersteunen bij de erkenning van eerder verworven competenties.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries en Bosman over de berichten “Antilliaanse verzekeraar leeg getrokken”, “Balletje-balletje op de Antillen met reserves van verzekeraar Ennia” en “Spin in het Antilliaanse web

MPs Aukje de Vries and Bosman asked the Finance and Interior Ministers about press reports on insurer Ennia on Curaçao, supervision by the Dutch and local central banks, and Dutch liability for failing Caribbean financial institutions. The ministers answered that prudential supervision of Ennia lies with the Curaçao central bank, that DNB's powers over BES branches are limited, that DNB's 2015 report is confidential so details cannot be given, and that the Dutch state is not guarantor for Caribbean financial institutions.

Because of, among other things, DNB's duty of confidentiality, which aims to limit possible harmful consequences for the institution concerned, and because of my systemic responsibility as Minister, under which in principle I do not receive information on individual supervised institutions from DNB, it is not possible for me to answer the questions about the content of the report and about any earlier warnings and actions.

Vanwege onder meer deze geheimhoudingsplicht van DNB – die als doel heeft om eventuele schadelijke gevolgen voor de betrokken instelling te beperken – en vanwege mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid als Minister – waarbij geldt dat ik in principe geen informatie over individuele onder toezicht staande instellingen van DNB ontvang – is het voor mij niet mogelijk om de vragen over de inhoud van het rapport en over eventuele eerdere waarschuwingen en acties te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de  stakingen bij PostNL in Nijmegen

An SP MP asked whether PostNL strikes in Nijmegen also involved non-payment of worked hours, whether employers must pay worked rather than rostered hours, and what powers the Inspectorate SZW has over rostering and treatment of staff. The minister confirmed media reports of non-payment as one reason for the strike, said the wage question is for the civil court to decide, and described the Inspectorate's inspection and enforcement powers and complaint routes.
It is not for me or the Minister of Economic Affairs but for the civil judge to give a ruling on this.
Het is niet aan mij of de Minister van Economische Zaken maar aan de burgerlijke rechter om hierover een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht ‘FNV: Slachterij Hilckmann weigert vergoeding aan ex-werknemers’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Hilckmann slaughterhouse closed, dismissing about 300 workers, and refused to pay transition allowances despite earlier agreements with Nijmegen municipality. The minister said the courts, not government, must judge the alleged agreements, noted that about 50 workers have settled and the owner is willing to pay the remaining transition allowances, and described UWV's reemployment support for former workers.
It is not for me, but for the court, to judge whether alleged agreements between the company and the municipality of Nijmegen were honoured.
Het is niet aan mij, maar aan de rechter, om te oordelen over het wel of niet naleven van vermeende afspraken tussen het bedrijf en de gemeente Nijmegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over flexibele bekostiging van de kinderopvang

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether childcare billing must follow fixed time units, whether overbilling for partly used sessions is tracked, and whether per-hour or per-half-hour billing would save childcare allowance. The minister replied that contract freedom governs billing units, that no data exist on allowance paid for unused hours, and that he sees no need for new measures on flexible billing.
It is not known how much childcare allowance is paid for hours that are billed to the parent but when the child is not at the childcare.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel kinderopvangtoeslag wordt uitgekeerd voor uren die wel in rekening worden gebracht aan de ouder, maar waarbij het kind niet op de opvang is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de uitstoot van kankerverwekkende stof door Chemours

An SP MP asked the ministers whether the Chemours plant emits a carcinogenic substance (FRD-903/GenX) and whether animal tests showing effects like PFOA require consequences. The state secretary replied that FRD-903 is classified as toxic and persistent but not as carcinogenic, that RIVM is studying it further, and that workers' exposure falls under employers' duty of care supervised by the Inspectorate SZW.
I have therefore asked RIVM to report to me in more detail on what is known about the persistence, bioaccumulation, toxicity, carcinogenicity, mutagenicity and reprotoxicity of FRD-903.

Ik heb daarom het RIVM inmiddels gevraagd mij uitgebreider te rapporteren over wat bekend is over de persistentie, bioaccumulatie, toxiciteit, carcinogeniteit, mutageniteit en reprotoxiciteit van FRD-903.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Veldhoven over het bericht ‘Dordste fabriek stoot giftige stof uit

An MP from D66 asked the State Secretary about reports that the Dordrecht Chemours (ex-DuPont) plant emits GenX, a substance linked to health risks, and asked about the evidence, the regional environmental service's assessment, and whether the substance should be listed as a Substance of Very High Concern. The government answered that RIVM confirmed the substance is persistent and toxic, that bioaccumulation remains uncertain, that RIVM will do further research with a report promised by November, and that it will raise the issue at EU level.
I have therefore now asked RIVM to report to me in more detail on what is known about the persistence, bioaccumulation, toxicity, carcinogenicity, mutagenicity and reprotoxicity of FRD-903.

Ik heb daarom het RIVM inmiddels gevraagd mij uitgebreider te rapporteren over wat bekend is over de persistentie, bioaccumulatie, toxiciteit, carcinogeniteit, mutageniteit en reprotoxiciteit van FRD-903.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Monasch en Jacobi over de verscherpte Stempelplicht Opvarenden van de Zeehavenpolitie Rotterdam

MPs Kerstens, Monasch and Jacobi asked whether the Rotterdam Seaport Police has tightened application of the Schengen Borders Code, shortening stays of foreign crew and limiting shipowners' freedom to deploy their crews, and why existing practice was abandoned. The government answers that the police apply the Code no more strictly than before, that exit stamps are given only when departure is imminent (about 300 persons were not stamped), and that it will work with the sector until 1 October to reach a workable implementation.
The Rotterdam Seaport Police does not apply the Schengen Borders Code more strictly than before.
De Zeehavenpolitie Rotterdam past de Schengengrenscode niet strikter toe dan voorheen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over het antiracisme advies van de Europese Commissie tegen Racisme en Intolerantie (ECRI)

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about ECRI's 2016 report criticising the Netherlands on anti-racism policy, follow-up to its 2013 recommendations, racism as a sentencing aggravator, and exploitation of temporary agency workers. The minister replied that the government sees the report as useful, rejects a separate anti-racism strategy in favour of a broad anti-discrimination programme, sees no need for racism as a statutory aggravating factor because prosecutors already seek 50-100% higher sentences, and relies on self-regulation of the temp sector rather than licence withdrawal.
The cabinet regards the ECRI report as a valuable instrument for improving citizens' protection against discrimination.
Het kabinet beschouwt het ECRI rapport als een waardevol instrument om de bescherming van burgers tegen discriminatie te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over antisemitische bedreiging na tonen Israëlische vlag

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether they recognise that Jewish citizens are threatened for displaying an Israeli flag, whether they share concern about rising antisemitism and its causes, and what measures the government will take. The minister says such threats are unacceptable, cites research linking Middle East tensions to antisemitism, and points to the existing National Action Programme against Discrimination, with a progress report promised for early 2017.
The cabinet takes the feelings of fear and unease within the Jewish community seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de gevoelens van angst en onbehagen binnen de joodse gemeenschap serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten over "over het ontbreken van het beroep ‘leraar basisonderwijs’ op de kansberoepenlijst van het UWV "

MPs Bruins and Schouten asked why primary-school teacher is not on UWV's list of opportunity occupations despite projected shortages from 2016 and 2020, and whether the government will consult stakeholders and answer quickly. The minister replied that current supply is sufficient (about 7,800 unemployed in primary education in 2015), so the occupation is excluded, that the list is updated twice yearly and could be revised, and that he will inform parliament in November.
I will inform your House in November about the latest state of affairs on the education labour market.
Ik zal uw Kamer in november informeren over de laatste stand van zaken op de onderwijsarbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Ulenbelt over de politie die actievoerende brandweerlieden intimideert

MPs Kerstens and Ulenbelt asked whether police contacting, phoning or visiting firefighters ahead of a union action intimidates them and whether this is acceptable given the right to strike. The government confirmed that police may seek information about planned actions as part of public order duties, denied that the approach was intimidation, and condemned any intimidation of strikers as a breach of the right to strike.
Actively contacting the persons involved in response to such signals by the police is one of the possibilities for this and forms part of normal police work.
Het actief contact opnemen door de politie met betrokkene(n) naar aanleiding van dergelijke signalen is daartoe een van de mogelijkheden en maakt deel uit van het normale politiewerk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de subsidie-imam angst zaait

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the Expertise Unit Social Stability (ESS): planned staffing and budget, the 2015 external contracts and how they were awarded, selection of staff and network partners, and the training and advice given. The minister answers in detail on staffing (20 FTE for 2017-2019), budget breakdown (about EUR 2.1 million), the list of 59 municipalities, contracts totalling about EUR 180,000 awarded without public tender, and declines to name individual officials or network members.
I cannot make statements about individual civil servants.
Over individuele ambtenaren kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over de uitbuiting van Filipijnse truckers door een Limburgs transportbedrijf

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked the Minister of Social Affairs about exploitation of Filipino truck drivers by a Limburg transport company, including whether Dutch firms rely on them due to a driver shortage, the use of a foreign-based subcontracting construction, and possible exclusion from public tenders. The minister said the sector is recruiting young Dutch drivers, pointed to the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies and a bill extending chain liability to road transport, declined to comment on the inspection investigation, and stated no current plans to change public procurement rules.
I do not make statements about individual investigations by the Inspectorate SZW, in line with the normal procedure.
Over individuele onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW doe ik conform de normale werkwijze geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over “grote onrust bij Tata Steel"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment how he would respond to reports that a merger between Tata Steel Nederland and ThyssenKrupp could cause large job losses, whether he shared union and staff concerns, and what he would do to preserve jobs and the blast furnaces. The minister answered that the outcome of the talks is unclear, that the company is responsible for its personnel policy, and that the Ministry of Economic Affairs now acts as the government's contact point.
First of all, every company is responsible for its business operations and personnel policy.
Voorop staat dat iedere onderneming verantwoordelijk is voor zijn bedrijfsvoering en personeelsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht "Aanpassen website SVB na druk Marokko".

An MP asked whether the SVB website was changed after Moroccan pressure to drop the 'excluding Western Sahara' qualifier for social security treaty coverage, and whether this amounts to a dictate from Morocco. The minister confirmed the change, said it followed Morocco's objection in treaty talks, stated the export policy for Western Sahara is unchanged, and denied any dictate.
Thereupon it was decided to adjust the wording.
Daarop is besloten om de formulering aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de racistische en discriminatoire gebeurtenissen in de weken 22 en 23

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about racist incidents in Geesteren and elsewhere, victim support, police reporting practices, specialisation in discrimination cases, rising racist violence, and non-implementation of ECRI recommendations. The Minister said victim support follows standard procedure, the motorcop case is under investigation so no comment is possible, police reporting uses a multichannel approach, discrimination training is being strengthened, and the ECRI recommendations are partly addressed through the National Action Programme with a progress report due January 2017.
This case is currently being investigated. While the investigation is ongoing, I cannot make any statements about it.
Deze zaak wordt momenteel onderzocht. Lopende het onderzoek kan ik hier geen uitspraken over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over de uitbuiting van Nederlandse voetbaltrainers in China

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked whether reports that Dutch football coaches in China receive little pay and return disillusioned, and any related exploitation, corruption or deception, warrant government action and whether the KNVB should warn coaches of the risks. The minister said the individual case is unknown, coaches should prepare themselves, Dutch embassy advised seeking a lawyer, the government sees no direct role beyond the courts, and the KNVB will be consulted on informing coaches.
Since I do not know the individual case, I cannot make a statement about it.
Aangezien ik de individuele casus niet ken kan ik hier geen uitspraak over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Jacobi en Monasch over het bericht ‘Grote misstanden bij aanleg Friese autoweg’

MPs Kerstens, Jacobi and Monasch asked Minister Asscher about FNV reports of systematic underpayment of workers on the Friesland road project 'De Centrale As', and about the responsibilities of contracting authorities under the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies. The minister said he could not judge the allegations, pointed to social partners and the Inspectorate SZW as the proper investigators, and described contractor liability and existing information efforts for lower governments, while committing to monitoring the law but not to new action.
It is extremely difficult for me to form a judgement on the FNV's allegations of underpayment by parties involved in the construction of 'De Centrale As'.
Het is voor mij buitengewoon lastig om mij een oordeel te vormen over de door de FNV gedane beweringen t.a.v. onderbetaling door partijen die bij de aanleg van «De Centrale As» zijn betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat Japanners vanaf 1 oktober 2016 een tewerkstellingsvergunning moeten aanvragen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an interpretive declaration to the Dutch-Swiss treaty that would require Japanese nationals to obtain work permits, and why Parliament was not informed earlier. The minister answered that the declaration restores the original intent of both states, that a transition period extends the work-permit requirement to 1 January 2017, and that Parliament was not informed because effects were expected to be limited.
I have answered the questions as quickly as possible.
Ik heb de vragen zo snel als mogelijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over huishoudelijke hulpen die vaker zwart werken

MPs Kerstens and Van Dijk asked whether domestic helpers increasingly work informally and why the RDaH scheme has little uptake and weaker legal protection for short-hours workers. The minister said informal work is not known, described an information campaign on RDaH, defended the scheme's differentiated rules, and noted municipal use of the Huishoudelijke Hulptoelage.
Whether there is undeclared work involved is not known to us.
Of hierbij sprake is van zwart werk, is ons niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de armoedeval voor eenverdieners

An SGP MP asked the State Secretary of Finance and the Minister of Social Affairs about the poverty trap for single-earner households, citing a report that a 11,000 euro gross rise could mean a net loss, and asked for a net-income table and the marginal tax rates. The government answered with a table, acknowledged high marginal pressure between roughly 20,000 and 35,000 euro from the phasing out of benefits and allowances, and pointed to the 5-billion package to make work pay.
Phasing out allowances is inherent in a system of targeted income support for low-income households as we know it in the Netherlands.
Het afbouwen van toeslagen is inherent aan een systeem met gerichte inkomensondersteuning voor huishoudens met lage inkomens zoals wij dat in Nederland kennen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bezoek van een antisemitische geweldsimam

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a preacher with antisemitic violent rhetoric would speak in the Netherlands and why he was not barred, and urged dissolving the inviting organisation. The minister said there was no confirmation of a Dutch appearance, declined to comment on individual cases, pointed to visa and entry-refusal tools and the courts' power to dissolve organisations, and considered current practice consistent with the Bontes motion.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht “Alternatieve arbeidsinkomensquote is momenteel relatief laag”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that the alternative labour income share (AIQ) is low and wages lagged behind, asking for the cause, whether the government will press employers, and for AIQ series under various exclusions. The minister explains the AIQ is a macro indicator affected by the crisis and self-employment income, says wage space is for social partners, and provides charts for the alternative cases while promising a hearing and a uniform method.

I therefore follow with interest the hearing on wage developments and the AIQ that will take place after the recess at the initiative of Member Voortman, and I invite the parties involved to come up with a uniform method for presenting the AIQ.

Ik volg dan ook met interesse de hoorzitting over de ontwikkeling van de lonen en het AIQ die op initiatief van het lid Voortman zal plaatsvinden na het reces, en nodig de betrokken partijen uit om met een uniforme methode te komen om de AIQ te presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het bericht dat de alternatieve arbeidsinkomensquote momenteel relatief laag is

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the government about DNB's finding that the alternative labour income share is currently low, its historical position, the role of self-employment, and whether wages lag productivity. Minister Asscher answered that the measures differ mainly due to bank mortgage profits and self-employed income treatment, that a longer series and a common method are needed, and that wage-setting is for social partners, while the government will keep urging them to use available wage room.

I therefore follow with interest the hearing on wage developments and the labour income share to be held after the recess at the initiative of MP Voortman, and I invite the parties involved to agree on a uniform method for presenting the labour income share.

Ik volg dan ook met interesse de hoorzitting over de ontwikkeling van de lonen en het AIQ die op initiatief van het lid Voortman zal plaatsvinden na het reces, en nodig de betrokken partijen uit om met een uniforme methode te komen om de AIQ te presenteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over "Asbestkennis bij Bakkersland".

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about asbestos incidents at Bakkersland, the timeline of the incidents, whether workers were informed, the risk of inhalation and any asbestos-related occupational diseases. The minister answered that three incidents were known to the Inspectorate, no violations were found, air measurements stayed below the norm, workers were informed via the works council, and only a small number of asbestos victims are linked to the bakery sector.
No violations were found, and the way the company handled the incidents met the requirements for a proper asbestos inventory and remediation.
Er zijn geen overtredingen geconstateerd en de wijze waarop de incidenten door het bedrijf zijn aangepakt voldeed aan de eisen die horen bij een deugdelijke asbestinventarisatie en sanering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over asbest bij Bakkersland

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about asbestos in bakery ovens at Bakkersland, raised by a Zembla broadcast, including inspection timing, inspection coverage, sanitation duties and support for victims. The minister answered that the Inspectorate SZW was informed in 2012 and 2014, that the ILT inspects companies with pre-1994 installations that report them, that there is no legal duty to remove asbestos from ovens, and that victims can turn to the Instituut Asbestslachtoffers.
Regarding the first incident, which occurred in 2011 at a Bakkersland branch in Wateringen, a municipal inspector contacted the Inspectorate SZW on 1 February 2012.
Over het eerste incident, dat in 2011 plaatsvond bij een vestiging van Bakkersland in Wateringen, nam op 1 februari 2012 een gemeentelijke inspecteur contact op met de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Moors over het bericht ‘Schotschrift tegen asbesthysterie’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a critical pamphlet claiming asbestos policy is overly alarmist and that the asbestos roof ban is poor value for money. The State Secretary rejected the alarmism claim, defended the cost-benefit analysis and the 2024 roof-removal deadline, and outlined subsidies, a programme office and enforcement measures while declining to quantify victim numbers precisely.
No, I do not endorse that conclusion. The central government takes a sober and pragmatic approach to asbestos in the residential, working and living environment.
Nee, die conclusie onderschrijf ik niet. De rijksoverheid staat voor een nuchtere en pragmatische benadering van asbest in de woon-, werk- en leefomgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over veiligheid in de elektrabranche

An MP asked the ministers about alarming safety conditions in the electrical installation trade, citing reports of incompetent electricians and falling installer skill levels. The government replied that electrocution risks in homes are rare, that working conditions and training in the branch are adequately organised, and that the response to the Safety Board's carbon monoxide report and the Building Quality Act would follow separately.
Safety-oriented training instructions are available for installers in the form of the ARBO handbook "Blauwe Boekje".
Voor installateurs zijn op veiligheid gerichte scholingsinstructies beschikbaar in de vorm van het ARBO handboekje «Blauwe Boekje»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over de verhoging van de kinderopvangtoeslag

The MP asks the government about the increase in childcare allowance: its budgetary effects, whether it distorts competition with single and one-earner households, and updated welfare comparisons across household types. The minister replies that the effect on labour supply is limited, that the allowance is a subsidy on work, and that the cabinet monitors one-earner household purchasing power closely.
Because the effect is limited, it is not possible to give a quantitative estimate of the extra tax revenue resulting from the increase.
De beperkte omvang van het effect maakt dat het niet mogelijk is om een kwantitatieve schatting te geven hoeveel extra belastinginkomsten als gevolg van de verhoging worden gerealiseerd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Visser over het bericht “Docu over haatimams schokt Denen”

Two MPs asked whether foreign imams preaching hatred could also speak in Dutch mosques, what the government does to prevent incitement, and why Denmark's measures such as a watchlist and entry bans cannot be applied in the Netherlands. The minister responded that local authorities and institutions bear primary responsibility under a three-track approach, that visa-required preachers can be refused and EU alerts shared via the Schengen system, and that Denmark's measures are still being drafted so their applicability cannot yet be judged.
The Netherlands closely follows developments in Denmark and contact takes place at expert level.
Nederland volgt de ontwikkelingen in Denemarken nauwgezet en op expertniveau vindt contact plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over een racistische aanval in Zwolle

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government about a racist attack in Zwolle, victim support, rising racist violence, stronger penalties such as an educational sentence for discrimination, police specialisation in discrimination complaints, and budgets for combating discrimination and radicalisation. The government replied that victim support follows the regular procedure, existing sentencing options suffice, police already have discrimination contact persons, and gave the budget figures, but declined to answer the questions before the plenary debate.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht 'Samenscholingsverbod na 'Marokkaanse' onlusten in Ede'

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a ban on gatherings after riots in Ede, the arrests made, and whether Moroccan youth over-representation in crime and military-style discipline should be pursued. The government answered that 10 suspects were arrested and released, that youth crime risk factors are social and spatial rather than ethnic, and that it does not support military discipline, favouring tailored interventions.

So far 10 suspects have been arrested for violating the gathering ban, resisting officers, insult, failure to obey an official order, deliberately violating the area ban, violating the Identification Act, rowdiness, or a combination of these offences.

Er zijn tot nu toe 10 verdachten aangehouden voor respectievelijk overtreding van het samenscholingsverbod, wederspannigheid, belediging, niet voldoen aan een ambtelijk bevel, het opzettelijk overtreden van het gebiedsverbod, overtreding van de Wet op de Identificatieplicht, baldadigheid of voor een combinatie van deze feiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de Edese burgemeester die Marokkaanse autoriteiten inschakelt om jongeren onder controle te krijgen

Karabulut (SP) asked about unrest among youths in Ede's Veldhuizen district, reported involvement of Moroccan authorities, and integration policy. The minister relayed the municipality's account of the disorder and measures taken (emergency orders, dispersal bans, extra policing), said the Moroccan consul's involvement was addressed in an earlier answer, and stated that local integration policy is a municipal matter and no additional policy is needed for now.
Neighbourhood and district policy is a local matter.
Wijk- en buurtbeleid is een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het inroepen van hulp van de Marokkaanse consul bij rellen Ede

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether calling in the Moroccan consul to restore order among rioting youths in Ede undermined Dutch authority, and what the government would do to restore order. The minister replied that the consul only sought talks at the mayor's request, that Dutch authorities alone hold authority, and that maintaining public order is a local responsibility with no further central measures announced.
Maintaining public order is a local responsibility.
Het handhaven van de openbare orde is een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins en Schouten over het ontbreken van het beroep ‘leraar basisonderwijs’ op de kansberoepenlijst van het UWV

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked why the profession of primary school teacher is absent from UWV's list of opportunity occupations, despite expected shortages in 2017-2019. The minister answered that teacher shortages are expected mainly in the four big cities, that current job losses and available unemployed teachers mean enough qualified candidates exist, and that UWV will reassess the list twice yearly.
If it turns out that the profession of primary school teacher meets the criteria, it will be included on the list of opportunity occupations.
Indien daarbij blijkt dat het beroep «leraar basisonderwijs» aan de criteria voldoet, zal dit op de lijst met kansberoepen worden opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ‘Gelijke rechten voor Poolse truckers’

MP Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a court ruling granting equal pay to Polish truck drivers would lead UWV and the Tax Authority to collect premiums and taxes, and whether there is a standard procedure for recovering premiums after wage-claim judgments. The minister declined to comment on the merits of the FNV case, stated that higher wages lead to higher wage and premium liability, and explained that premium collection lies with the Tax Authority, which handles it through the normal payroll process.
I will not go further into the substance of the case brought by the FNV based on the Inspectorate SZW investigation supporting collective agreement compliance.
Op de inhoud van de zaak die de FNV heeft aangespannen op basis van onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW ter ondersteuning van cao-naleving, ga ik verder niet in.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een gesubsidieerd haatfeest

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether The Hague municipality sponsors a Ramadan festival that allegedly features gender segregation and glorification of terrorists, and whether the government will stop such support or cut the municipal fund. The minister answered that The Hague gave no sponsorship or other support to the event, that the municipality has a policy of not subsidising religious gatherings, that subsidy decisions are a local matter, and that cutting the municipal fund is not possible.
Furthermore, the decision whether or not to subsidise initiatives is a local matter.
Voorts is het zo dat de afweging om wel of niet over te gaan tot het subsidiëren van initiatieven een lokale aangelegenheid is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over de blijdschap over de arrestatie van Ebru Umar in Turkije

MP Azmani asked the Minister of Social Affairs about social media celebration of the arrest of Ebru Umar in Turkey, whether this signals failed integration of second and third generation Turkish Dutch, and what measures would be taken. The minister answered that freedom of expression applies to all but threats and intimidation are punishable, that the reactions worry him and reflect weak identification with Dutch society, and listed a three-point integration agenda and a follow-up study into Turkish religious organisations.
At the request of your House, a follow-up study is also being launched into the role Turkish religious organisations play in this process.
Ook wordt er op verzoek van uw Kamer een vervolgonderzoek uitgezet naar de rol die Turks religieuze organisaties in dit proces hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Agnes Mulder over het bericht van de Consumentenbond dat hotelkamers in Nederland vaak vies zijn

MPs Heerma and Mulder asked the ministers whether a Consumentenbond finding that many hotel rooms are dirty is linked to reported exploitation of hotel cleaners, what hygiene criteria apply, and what the latest data on one- and two-star hotels show. The minister answered that no link is known, that no legal cleaning criteria exist beyond food-hygiene rules enforced by the NVWA, that no hygiene statistics are available, and that the market and review sites should handle hygiene transparency.
There are no figures known about the hygiene of hotels.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over de hygiëne van hotels.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘Halal zwemmen trekt veel volk naar zwembad in Breda’

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a halal swimming evening for Muslim women at a Breda pool promotes segregation and undermines emancipation, and whether the minister would raise this with the municipality or VNG. The minister called segregation undesirable and pressure on women unacceptable, but said private rentals of public pools outside public hours are permitted and declined to raise the matter with Breda or the VNG.
I see no reason myself to raise this with the VNG and/or the municipality of Breda, but am willing to engage in discussion if these parties feel the need.
Ik zie zelf geen aanleiding om dit aan te kaarten bij de VNG en/of gemeente Breda maar ben bereid het gesprek aan te gaan indien hier bij deze partijen behoefte aan bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en De Graaf over de brief van het Haagse college van B&W over de huisvesting van asielzoekers in een vleugel van verpleeghuis De Lozerhof

MPs Agema and De Graaf asked about housing asylum seekers in a wing of nursing home De Lozerhof, including expected work by residents, staffing impacts and who is responsible for care quality and safety. The Secretary of State said the arrangement is voluntary-work oriented with careful consultation, that the nursing home itself is responsible for care quality, and that the Inspectorate is following up on previously identified shortcomings.
Care institutions are themselves responsible for the quality and safety of the care provided and for the staff and volunteers in their institution.
Zorginstellingen zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor de kwaliteit en veiligheid van de geleverde zorg en voor het personeel en vrijwilligers in hun instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het bericht dat de kinderopvang een eigen kredietunie gaat starten

Opposition MP Siderius asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government regrets that childcare providers can no longer obtain bank finance and must turn to a credit union or EU subsidies, and whether government childcare allowance policy caused this. The minister answered that the sector is private, that the government supports credit unions in principle, and that bank tightening stems from general SME credit conditions, while noting recent childcare funding increases and refusing to contribute to the credit union's start-up costs.
I see this as a natural movement in a market sector, in which supply and demand move towards each other.
Ik zie dit als een natuurlijke beweging in een marktsector, waarbij vraag en aanbod naar elkaar toe groeien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over overtreding van de Arbowet door PostNL

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether PostNL's use of self-employed parcel couriers to circumvent Arbo rules is common in the parcel sector, what the general state of compliance is, and whether sector-level agreements are appropriate. The minister confirmed the reported violations, said other operators also use self-employed couriers to varying degrees, noted ongoing Inspectorate enforcement tracks including one at PostNL, and said further action would be considered if improvements remain insufficient.
If these do not lead to sufficient improvement, I will consider further action.
Mochten die niet leiden tot voldoende verbetering, dan zal ik nadere actie overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht ‘Natuurlijk mislukt het inburgeringsbeleid, dat hadden we kunnen weten’

An MP asked whether the Wet inburgering 2013 rested on untested assumptions and whether its design reflected budget cuts rather than expected results. The minister rejected the claim that the assumptions were doubtful, said the law partly implemented a budget cut, and noted that participation effects can only be assessed around end-2017.
I do not share the conclusion of the research that the tenability of the assumptions behind the Wet inburgering 2013 were already questionable in advance.
Ik deel de conclusie van het onderzoek niet dat de houdbaarheid van de aannames achter de Wet inburgering 2013 al op voorhand discutabel zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Smaling over het bericht ‘Zwangerschapsproblemen bij oud-medewerkers DuPont’

MPs Ulenbelt and Smaling asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of pregnancy problems among former DuPont workers, the role of the company health service and the labour inspectorate, whether to commission investigations, and whether to ask the Safety Board to investigate. The minister said the situation is serious, that he wants the facts laid out first with the Audit Dienst Rijk involved, and that a Safety Board investigation is not currently appropriate.
I now want to lay out the facts and will involve the Audit Dienst Rijk (ADR) in this.
Ik wil nu de feiten op een rij zetten en zal de Audit Dienst Rijk (ADR) daarbij betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Smaling over het bericht “dat er onderzoek komt naar de Arbeidsinspectie inzake DuPont”

MPs Ulenbelt and Smaling asked the minister whether the Labour Inspectorate's handling of the DuPont Lycra plant is being investigated and what the inquiry covers. The minister answered that the inquiry examines the use of DMAC, work processes and risk controls from the 1970s until the substances were no longer used, with the Audit Dienst Rijk involved and results due in November 2016.
In November 2016 you will receive the results of the investigation.
In november 2016 ontvangt u de resultaten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat basisartsen worden ingezet om personen met een WIA uitkering te herbeoordelen

The SP MP Ulenbelt asks whether deploying inexperienced junior doctors at UWV to clear the WIA re-assessment backlog compromises assessment quality, how they are recruited, and what responsibilities they carry. The minister answers that junior doctors receive a two-month WIA training, are supervised and co-signed by registered insurance physicians, and are not trained to full insurance-physician status for this operation.
A junior doctor receives a two-month training specifically aimed at carrying out WIA re-assessments.
Een basisarts krijgt een opleiding van twee maanden die specifiek gericht is op het doen van WIA-herbeoordelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ‘Honderden Tilburgers mogelijk blootgesteld aan chroom-6’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Labour Inspectorate was involved in a Tilburg reintegration project where workers may have been exposed to chromium-6, and whether protective measures were checked. The Minister said the Inspectorate was not involved, that inspection on site is no longer possible, and that the Inspectorate will approach relevant sectors this year and provide guidance on chromium-6 protection.
The Labour Inspectorate was not active in this project.
De Inspectie SZW is niet actief geweest bij dit project.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over het gebruik van chroom-6 verf bij de NS-Werkplaats in Tilburg

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked the ministers about chromium-6 paint exposure among re-integration participants at the NS workshop in Tilburg, including health symptoms, protection, liability and an independent medical examination. The minister answered that the employer is primarily responsible, that liability is for civil courts, that a medical consultation is available via CAOP, and that NedTrain's internal review found chromium-6 risks at several current sites with additional measures taken.
Who is civilly liable for any damage suffered in this case is a matter that can be assessed by the civil judge.
Wie er in dit geval civielrechtelijk aansprakelijk is voor eventueel geleden schade is een kwestie die door de civiele rechter kan worden beoordeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kooiman over het bericht over een bedreigd Rotterdams gezin

MPs Karabulut and Kooiman asked whether honour-related violence against a Rotterdam family is being recognised and acted on in time, and whether knowledge should be strengthened at police units. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because a criminal investigation is ongoing, defended the existing police and LEC EGG structure, and agreed knowledge should be present in all regional units while saying existing arrangements already provide for it.
However, I cannot go into the details of an individual case, because of the privacy of those involved and in the interest of the criminal investigation that is still ongoing.
Ik kan echter niet ingaan op de details van een individuele casus, vanwege de privacy van betrokkenen en in het belang van het strafrechtelijk onderzoek dat momenteel nog gaande is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een ongeval met een hoogwerker

An MP from the PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a fatal accident with a boom lift in Zaltbommel, how many similar serious accidents occurred, what training and certification rules apply, and whether further safety research and industry consultation would follow. The minister answered that no comparable incidents are known, described the general Arbo rules on instruction and competence, said no mandatory certificate exists for operators, and stated that the Inspectie SZW is investigating and it is too early to announce measures.
The Labour Inspectorate is investigating the accident. It is too early now to give an explanation of the cause of the accident or to make statements about any actions or measures to be taken.
De Inspectie SZW onderzoekt het ongeval. Het is nu te vroeg om duiding te geven over de oorzaak van het ongeval en uitspraken te doen over eventueel te ondernemen acties of te treffen maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het bericht dat de subsidie-imam angst zaait

MPs Öztürk asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Justice about a subsidised imam's warnings of an imminent attack in Amsterdam and about government funding of his organisations and of the Expertise-unit Sociale Stabiliteit (ESS). The minister declined to discuss the imam's motives, said police and the municipality saw no new information, and described ESS budget, projects, and hiring procedures, stating that some organisations receive subsidies or contracts.
I will not go further into individual contract awards here.
Ik ga hier verder niet in op individuele opdrachtverleningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de toekenning van kinderopvangtoeslag voor vierjarige kinderen met een beperking die een wenprogramma doorlopen

An SP MP asked whether children with disabilities starting a transition ('wen') programme at age four are registered as school pupils, which cuts off daycare allowance, and whether this discourages parents from working. The minister answers that the rules are clear, that BSO allowance applies once a child attends primary school, and that municipalities can provide supplementary support through social medical indication, so no structural change is planned.
Where necessary, an additional provision can be made for children with a disability via the municipality.
Daar waar nodig kan er voor kinderen met een beperking een aanvullende voorziening worden getroffen via de gemeente
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over zieke werknemers die ten onrechte geen vakantiedagen opbouwen en hiervoor schadevergoeding ontvangen

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about sick workers who wrongly accrue no leave days and receive compensation claims for this. The minister answered that about 1,300 claims have been filed, that the agency does not have full individual data so workers must file claims themselves, and that the agency aims to process claims filed by February 2016 before summer, with processing time depending on completeness of files.
The Agency aims to have substantively processed all claims submitted up to February 2016 before the summer.
Het Agentschap streeft ernaar om alle claims die tot februari 2016 zijn ingediend voor de zomer inhoudelijk in behandeling te hebben genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over de gevolgen voor gedupeerde ouders van de uitspraak in de fraudezaak met kinderopvangtoeslag door eigenaar van kinderopvang de Parel

MP Heerma asked whether victims of the De Parel childcare fraud, who face repayment demands and fines, can be treated as victims and offered a payment or victim arrangement. The State Secretary answered that the Tax Authority must recover benefits paid to parents who did not meet the rules, that no fines were imposed, that standard and personal payment arrangements exist, and that the victim scheme has been checked proactively without any eligible parent found, while promising to examine the possibility of holding parents liable.
Regarding the criminal trajectory, it does not befit me to give a judgment on this.
Ten aanzien van het strafrechtelijke traject past het mij niet om hierover een oordeel te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de berichten over een kwikvergiftiging bij AkzoNobel

MPs Ulenbelt asked the minister whether Inspectie SZW or the occupational health service had investigated mercury exposure at AkzoNobel in Hengelo, what led to a settlement over suspected mercury poisoning, and whether such settlements should be registered against the company. The minister answered that the Inspectie had no specific investigation beyond a 2003 routine inspection with a record-keeping warning, that the facts of the settlement were unknown to him, and that settlements are private matters for the government.
A company can reach a settlement with an injured party to avoid a lengthy procedure that may be burdensome for both parties.
Een bedrijf kan met een benadeelde tot een schikking komen om een lange procedure te vermijden die voor beide partijen belastend kan zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Voortman en Karabulut over de arbeidsomstandigheden van de beveiliging op Schiphol

Three MPs asked whether working conditions for airport security staff at Schiphol had improved despite earlier promises, whether TNO's dwell-time recommendations were implemented, and whether Schiphol as client should be held to account, including whether security should return to a public body. Minister Asscher answered that employers and CAO parties are responsible, that the Inspectorate has received no complaints, that a new TNO report recommends a 120-minute dwell limit under review by June, and that no public body is needed.

Schiphol and the security companies have indicated that, until the new TNO report's recommendations are translated into practical and feasible dwell-time agreements, the current CAO norm of a maximum dwell time of 150 minutes is strictly observed.

Schiphol en de beveiligingsbedrijven hebben aangegeven dat, totdat de aanbevelingen uit het nieuwe TNO-rapport zijn vertaald in praktische en haalbare afspraken over statijden, de norm die in de huidige CAO staat – een maximale statijd van 150 minuten – strikt wordt nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Ulenbelt en Van Raak over riante beloning van de top van UWV

MPs Voortman, Ulenbelt and Van Raak asked why UWV top officials earn above the WNT pay cap, whether transitional rules and side jobs can be stopped, and whether the transitional arrangement should end. Minister Asscher answered that UWV complies with the WNT, that remaining above-cap pay is protected by transitional law and European property rights, and that side functions are permitted if done in own time.
UWV has informed me that it will enter into discussion with the non-top officials concerned about their remuneration relative to the WNT maximum.
UWV heeft mij laten weten met betrokken niet-topfunctionarissen het gesprek aan te gaan over hun bezoldiging in verhouding tot het vastgestelde bezoldigingsmaximum van de WNT.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over inburgeringsplicht

MP Potters asked how people who had not met the civic integration requirement within three years are identified quickly by the IND and by municipalities, and whether residence permits or welfare benefits are reviewed right away. Minister Asscher answered that failure to integrate culpably normally leads to withdrawal of residence rights or other sanctions, that the IND relies on DUO data, and that municipalities no longer have an integration task and apply the Participation Act language requirement, while noting the question on tracking numbers is answered in a separate letter.

Culpable failure to integrate in principle always has consequences for the right of residence: unless international and national laws and regulations stand in the way, the residence permit is withdrawn in case of culpable exceeding of the term.

Verwijtbaar niet inburgeren heeft in principe altijd consequenties voor het verblijfsrecht: tenzij internationale en nationale wet- en regelgeving in de weg staat, wordt de verblijfsvergunning ingetrokken bij verwijtbare termijnoverschrijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de uitspraak van de rechter over het dagloonbesluit

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asks the minister of Social Affairs whether the government will close the 'WW-lek' after the court ruled the daily-wage decree (Dagloonbesluit) conflicts with the WW income-loss principle, and whether it will drop an appeal and admit the change was careless. The minister acknowledges the interim ruling but declines to react because the case is still before the court and appeal remains possible.
Because the case is still before the court (it is not a final ruling and appeal is still possible), I refrain, as is customary, from any response.
Omdat de zaak nog onder de rechter ligt (het is geen einduitspraak en daarna is nog hoger beroep mogelijk) onthoud ik me, volgens goed gebruik, van elke reactie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over de oproep van het Turkse consulaat aan Turken in Nederland om beledigingen te melden

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked ministers about a Turkish consulate call for Turks in the Netherlands to report insults against Turkey, its president and flag, and whether this undermines free speech and intimidates critics. The government response is a cross-reference to a letter answering a related Karabulut question, so the substance is not given in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sjoerdsma over het bericht “Zorgen om inburgering”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs when the provisional, very low civic integration pass rates were known in his ministry, and whether he would answer before the plenary debate. The minister replied that DUO supplied the figures on 1 April 2016, that they were shared with parliament in his letter of 20 April, that additional measures and a deeper investigation were started, and that he agreed to answer the questions before the debate.
I share your concern about the low pass rate, and that is also why I have taken additional measures and started an in-depth investigation into the civic integration process.
Ik deel uw zorg over het lage slagingspercentage en dat is ook de reden dat ik aanvullende maatregelen heb genomen en een verdiepend onderzoek heb gestart naar het inburgeringsproces.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Rog over het ontzeggen van een tolkvoorziening aan een dove student aan een Hogeschool

MPs Heerma and Rog asked why a deaf unemployed student at Fontys was denied a Dutch Sign Language interpreter for having reached age 30, and whether the WOOS age limit should be dropped in line with the new student loan system. The government defends the age-30 limit as a shift of individual responsibility, points to UWV and municipal routes for interpreter funding, and promises a policy response with OCW and VWS by summer.
From age 30 there is a question of individual responsibility.
Vanaf 30 jaar is er sprake van een individuele verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht "Sjoemeltransporten bij Mercedes blootgelegd"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of cheating transport arrangements at Mercedes involving low pay, per-kilometre pay and deductions for a damage fund, and whether the state would investigate and act. The minister said enforcement largely rests with workers and social partners, that the Inspectorate SZW does not comment on ongoing investigations, and promised legislative changes on piece-rate pay and deductions while committing to European-level action.
In line with normal practice, I do not make statements about ongoing investigations by the Inspectorate SZW.
Conform de normale werkwijze doe ik geen uitspraken over lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over het bericht dat de afgelopen maanden 60 kindbruiden Nederland zijn binnengekomen

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked about reports that around 60 child brides had entered the Netherlands in recent months, the number of Syrian child brides, and how minors' safety and registration would be ensured. The state secretary confirmed roughly 60 married minor girls entered independently between September 2015 and January 2016, said the IND would not separately register child marriages, and described existing guardianship and reception measures while declining to discuss individual cases for privacy reasons.
For privacy reasons I cannot go into the individual circumstances.
Vanwege privacyaspecten kan ik niet ingaan op de individuele omstandigheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Tanamal over de Klachtenregen over zzp-verzekeringen arbeidsongeschiktheid

MPs Mei Li Vos and Tanamal asked the ministers about complaints over disability insurance for self-employed workers, including whether premiums should be refunded when insurers refuse benefits over non-disclosed medical history and why premium restitution under the old Commercial Code was dropped. The government answered that insurers may refuse claims only where the non-disclosed information was material, that premium restitution is limited under article 7:938 BW, and that it will review the rule with stakeholders and report after the summer.
In view of the above, I see sufficient reason to review, in consultation with the relevant stakeholders, article 7:938 of the Civil Code and the scope of the right to premium restitution.
In het voorgaande zie ik voldoende aanleiding om in overleg met de relevante stakeholders artikel 7: 938 BW en de reikwijdte van het recht op premierestitutie tegen het licht te houden.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over "zieke werknemers die ten onrechte geen verlofdagen opbouwen, hiervoor schadevergoeding ontvangen en daarom gekort worden op hun uitkering in het kader van de Wet werk en inkom

An MP asked the minister about sick employees who did not accrue leave days, received damages for this, and had their WIA benefit reduced because the damages were treated as income. The minister confirmed the 2009 CJEU ruling and the Hoge Raad case, and said the damages are not treated as wage for WIA offsetting, so no benefit reduction follows.
No. The relevant compensation is not classified as social insurance wage and therefore is not offset against a WIA benefit.
Nee. De betreffende schadevergoeding wordt niet als sv-loon aangemerkt en daarom niet verrekend met een WIA-uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij, Pieter Heerma en Van Weyenberg over schoonmakers in de hotelbranche die zwaar onderbetaald worden door middel van stukloon

MPs asked whether the government knew of and would act on reports that hotel cleaners are underpaid through piece-rate pay, and whether the Inspectorate had checked the hotel sector and whether government contracts with implicated hotel chains would end. The minister said the Inspectorate checked hotel cleaning in 2015 (94 cases opened, 16 violations found in closed cases), that government contracts run through intermediaries under generic social conditions with possible stricter clauses in future, and that cleaning in hotels remains under the Inspectorate's focus.
In 2015 the Inspectorate SZW carried out inspections of cleaning in the hotel sector.
In 2015 heeft de Inspectie SZW controles uitgevoerd naar schoonmaak in de hotelbranche.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Verhoeven over minimumtarieven voor zelfstandigen zonder personeel in collectieve arbeidsovereenkomsten

MPs Van Weyenberg and Verhoeven asked whether cao rate agreements for self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers) in the architects' cao breach the Dutch cartel prohibition, and whether such rules should be declared generally binding. The minister answered that competition enforcement belongs to the ACM, that the avv-procedure is still ongoing, that the cao rules are not generally binding for now due to competition risk, and that no further guidelines on bogus self-employment are needed.
It is therefore only up to the ACM to make statements in individual cases.
Het is dan ook slechts aan de ACM om uitspraken te doen in individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de stijging van topinkomens door bonussen

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the 23% rise in AEX executive bonuses is excessive and whether the Corporate Governance Code should cap variable pay at 10%, and asked for research into top versus lowest incomes and action on ABN Amro's CEO pay. The minister called the trend a wrong signal but said pay is primarily for companies and shareholders, declined to research or impose a cap, and promised a Works Councils Act amendment requiring boards to discuss pay with the works council.
In principle shareholders, supervisory directors and executives decide on pay policy, not the cabinet.
In beginsel gaan aandeelhouders, commissarissen en bestuurders over het beloningsbeleid, niet het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "de gemeente Rotterdam die kinderopvangaanbieders zelf de hoogte van de ouderbijdrage laat vaststellen"

The MP asked whether Rotterdam letting childcare providers set and collect parental contributions raises privacy, fraud and proportionality concerns. The minister answered that setting parental fees for children without childcare benefit is a municipal responsibility, that the Rijk handles the childcare allowance and that the new funding system does not give providers access to parents' income data, and promised a study on municipal practices around summer.
It is up to municipalities to decide how the parental contribution is set for children without entitlement to the childcare allowance.
Het is aan gemeenten om te bepalen hoe de ouderbijdrage wordt vastgesteld voor kinderen zonder recht op kinderopvangtoeslag.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat vijftig schoonmakers in Dordrecht worden ontslagen en dat hun werk wordt overgenomen door mensen met een uitkering en/of werkers van de sociale werkvoorzienin

An SP MP asked whether Dordrecht's outsourcing of cleaning work to people on benefits and sheltered-employment workers, replacing dismissed regular cleaners, amounts to displacement of paid work and what the government will do. The State Secretary answered that municipalities are responsible for preventing displacement, that the Inspectorate SZW supervises only aggregate municipal performance, and that municipalities may choose how to contract cleaning, without committing to new action.
Responsibility for adequately monitoring the prevention of displacement of paid work lies expressly with the municipality.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het adequaat toezien op het voorkomen van verdringing van betaalde arbeid ligt uitdrukkelijk bij de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de uitbuiting van Roemeense scheepsbouwers

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the minister about Romanian shipyard workers paid around 1 euro per hour via A1 posting certificates, questioning the legality and fairness of wage gaps and the scale of posting. The minister said the case may be a sham construction, that wage-cost differences under the posting directive are undesirable, and outlined EU-level work on A1 misuse while noting the system does not record sector and a meldingsplicht is planned.
An A1 certificate cannot record which sector an employee or self-employed person is active in.
Op een A1-verklaring kan niet worden ingevuld welke sector een werknemer of zelfstandige actief is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karabulut over de opbouw van schulden naar aanleiding van gedwongen opname in een ggz-instelling

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked why people compulsorily admitted to psychiatric facilities may lose benefits and face debts, and whether this gap was known and remains unfixed. The state secretary answered that such persons are eligible for special assistance (bijzondere bijstand) under the Participatiewet, which was amended in 2008 with retroactive effect, leaving municipalities to decide case by case; she did not provide figures on affected people.
I do not have figures on this matter.
Ik beschik niet over cijfers op dit vlak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Jacobi over de handhaving van cao’s

MPs Yücel and Jacobi asked whether all childcare and early-education staff should be paid under the Peuterspeelzaalwerk collective agreement, whether the government monitors salary developments during municipal harmonisation, and what tools it has to enforce collective agreements. The minister answered that several collective agreements apply, that salary agreements are for social partners, and that the Inspectie SZW can investigate enforcement only at the request of social partners, with compliance being primarily their responsibility.
It is up to social partners to make agreements on salaries in the harmonisation of child care facilities.
Het is aan sociale partners om afspraken te maken over de salarissen bij de harmonisatie van de kindvoorzieningen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘Gesjoemel met islamitisch fonds’

An MP from the VVD asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of irregularities and opaque foreign funding flows linked to the Kuwaiti Islamic fund Europe Trust Nederland, including whether they supported Salafist currents. The minister answers that the newspaper issued a correction, that Kuwaiti authorities found the funding procedures correct and without irregularities, that the funds built the Blue Mosque, and that foreign funding is not problematic per se but must not carry messages contrary to the rule of law.
Financing from other countries is not problematic in itself.
Financiering vanuit andere landen an sich is niet problematisch.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het gebruik van de Cyprusroute door AFMB Limited

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about continued use of the Cyprus route and sham constructions by AFMB Limited, including past SVB action, possible new investigation, NIWO licence withdrawal and EU measures. The minister said the pending court case limits information, AFMB has no NIWO licence to withdraw, and the government is pursuing enforcement tools and EU reforms.
In the interest of the ongoing appeal case and possible follow-up actions, no information can be provided on the content of possible investigations.
In het belang van de lopende beroepszaak en eventuele vervolgacties kan over de inhoud van mogelijke onderzoeken echter geen informatie worden verstrekt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de afrekencultuur en slechte arbeidsomstandigheden bij Pegatron in Breda
