An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a penalty-point system, a sudden dismissal of 86 agency workers and poor working conditions at Pegatron in Breda. The minister answered that the company must follow the law, that penalty points for sick leave are undesirable, that the Inspectorate found no current violations, and that the Inspectorate will assess any complaint carefully.
At the most recent inspection, no shortcomings were found.
Bij de laatste recente inspectie waren geen tekortkomingen geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over een nazistisch “pamflet” dat aan moskeeën in Nederland is gestuurd

An MP asked the ministers whether they knew of a Nazi-themed pamphlet with anti-Islam text sent to many mosques, how many mosques received it, and what was being done about its authors and the safety of mosques. The minister confirmed the pamphlet is condemnable, reported 33 mosques had filed complaints, said the OM considers it punishable and a criminal investigation is ongoing, and committed to renewed talks with mosque leaders and heightened vigilance.
In the interest of the investigation, I cannot provide further information on this matter.
In het belang van het onderzoek kan ik hierover verder geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman en Siderius over het bericht dat de werkgelegenheid in welzijn, jeugdzorg en kinderopvang fors afneemt

MPs Kooiman and Siderius asked the ministers about a projected fall in employment in youth care, welfare and childcare, its effects on care quality, waiting lists, costs of unemployment benefits and support for affected workers. The government answered that the outlook is uncertain, that waiting lists cannot be tracked nationally because municipalities organise access differently, that childcare employment is expected to recover, and that sector plans and extra funding support retraining.
It is not possible to establish nationally in a uniform way the size of the waiting lists because municipalities have organised access to youth care differently.
Het is niet mogelijk om landelijk op eenduidige wijze vast te stellen wat de omvang van de wachtlijsten is omdat gemeenten de toegang tot de jeugdhulp verschillend georganiseerd hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal, Hoogland en Kerstens over het verloren gaan van 45 duizend gezonde levensjaren als gevolg van het VW-schandaal

Three PvdA MPs asked whether the Volkswagen emissions scandal really caused 45,000 lost healthy life-years, and what it means for public health and mechanics' occupational risk. The State Secretary disputes that conclusion, says the extra NOx emissions are not quantified, notes that air quality limits are largely met, and points to the Air Quality Action Plan and EU efforts on real-driving emissions testing.
It is not known how much the emission of nitrogen oxides increases as a result of the software fraud as found at Volkswagen.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel de emissie van stikstofoxiden toeneemt als gevolg van de softwarefraude zoals die bij Volkswagen is geconstateerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het artikel ‘Amsterdamse extremisten maken gebruik van El Tawheed moskee’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the El Tawheed mosque should be closed because a group that supports armed jihad uses it. The government declined to comment on the concrete case, said criminal investigation is possible if offences are indicated, and explained that courts can ban an organisation on Public Prosecution Service request and that closing a building for safety violations is a local authority matter.
In addition, a building as such can be closed if there is, among other things, non-compliance with fire and safety regulations.
Daarnaast kan een gebouw als zodanig gesloten worden indien er, onder andere, sprake is van niet-naleving van brand- en veiligheidsvoorschriften.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat 2.000 chauffeurs in het streekvervoer dreigen met stakingen

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked whether drivers' threatened strikes over volunteers replacing paid bus drivers in regional transport are justified, and how provinces handle the Brede doeluitkering and bus line cuts. The State Secretary says provinces are responsible for public transport concessions, that volunteer arrangements are possible where no employment relationship or cao applies, and that she will consult provinces and metropolitan regions before reporting back to parliament.
Specifically regarding public transport, the provinces are responsible for the supply and the concession contract.
Specifiek met betrekking tot het openbaar vervoer (OV) zijn de provincies verantwoordelijk voor het aanbod en het concessiecontract.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over de uitspraak van een gemeenteraadslid dat de Islam “weggevaagd” mag worden

Marcouch (PvdA) asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a Hague councillor's statement that Islam may be wiped away, asking whether criminal law applies, whether a complaint was filed, and whether the law on group insult should cover religion. Minister Van der Steur replied that the municipality distanced itself from polarising statements, a complaint was filed on 8 February and is being studied by the Public Prosecution Service, and that case law shows such statements may be criminal depending on circumstances, so no change to the law is needed.
A complaint was filed on 8 February, and this complaint is currently being studied by the Public Prosecution Service (OM).
Op 8 februari jl. is aangifte gedaan, deze aangifte wordt momenteel door het Openbaar Ministerie (OM) bestudeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht «Asscher: jaarlijks 250 kindhuwelijken in Nederland»

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether child marriages occur in the Netherlands, whether the 2015 marriage-coercion law guarantees both partners are 18, and whether communities practising child marriage will be addressed. The minister confirmed awareness, stated that marriage with minors is now impossible domestically and foreign child marriages are not recognised until both are 18, and described prevention and awareness measures without committing to zero cases.
Since last year, a marriage with a minor is not permitted under any condition in our country.
Sinds vorig jaar is in ons land een huwelijk met een minderjarige dan ook onder geen enkele voorwaarde toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over het schenden van de hoorplicht bij bezwaarprocedures inzake kinderopvangtoeslag

An SP MP asked the government to respond to two court rulings finding that the Belastingdienst/Toeslagen repeatedly violated the duty to hear taxpayers in childcare benefit objection procedures, and asked whether this discouraged objectors and whether an investigation and compensation would follow. The Staatssecretaris accepted the rulings as guidance, said there was no active discouragement and no need for an investigation, but committed to adjusting the procedure in similar cases; he also said the Belastingdienst does not record how often hearings were held or not held.
If the judge finds that the duty to hear has been violated, he can refer the case back and compensate the court fees and/or costs of proceedings.
Constateert de rechter dat de hoorplicht is geschonden, dan kan hij de zaak terugwijzen en het griffierecht en/of de proceskosten vergoeden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over de situatie bij het Europees Octrooibureau

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked about the dismissal of union members who criticised conditions at the European Patent Office, the letter from the Administrative Council chair to the EPO president, and whether the Netherlands will support it. The State Secretary confirmed Dutch concern, said the Netherlands co-sponsors a draft resolution to be voted on in the Administrative Council, and reported a meeting with the EPO president that did not change his position, while declining to share the confidential letter's details.
Dit document heeft de status confidentieel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Sjeikwatch: Osama-fan en 9/11-verheerlijker Anas Noorani Siddiqui in 020’

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked why a preacher they called an incitement-to-violence figure was allowed into the Netherlands and whether he would be expelled. The ministers did not discuss the individual case, stated that visa-required and visa-free preachers spreading hatred or violence can be refused or confronted, and pointed to the three-track approach and a recent Eindhoven mosque ban as examples.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Mohandis over "misleidende informatie van opleidingen over de arbeidsmarktpositie van hun afgestudeerden"

MPs Kerstens and Mohandis asked about study programmes presenting misleading labour-market outcomes for graduates, and about abuse of internships. The minister acknowledges an error in the Studie in Cijfers indicator, promises a repaired version, and says internship abuse will be examined based on concrete reports.
It is regrettable that this happened, because the study fact sheet was only recently established.
Het is betreurenswaardig dat dit gebeurd is, want de studiebijsluiter is pas recent tot stand gekomen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het gehanteerde uurtarief in de kinderopvang

Parliamentarian Pieter Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about childcare hourly rates exceeding the government maximum, citing a Kassa/BOink study, and about the effects on lower-income families and planned measures. The minister said the Tax Administration data show lower shares above the maximum than the study, that the government will investigate rate developments and low-income childcare use this spring, and pointed to added childcare allowance funding.
I intend to start a study this spring into the development of hourly rates, including the maximum hourly rates.
Ik ben voornemens dit voorjaar een onderzoek te starten naar de ontwikkeling van de uurprijzen, inclusief de maximum uurprijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Gesthuizen over het bericht dat gevluchte Eritrese vrouwen zijn gedwongen tot seks

Two SP MPs asked the government about reports that Eritrean refugee women were forced into sex, including how many are pregnant and whether they are in asylum centres. The minister answers that about 25 women report unwanted pregnancy and three report rape, that COA took preventive measures and reported signals to police, and that no formal complaints have yet been filed and no criminal offences established.
COA cannot assess the seriousness and truthfulness of these signals and has reported them to the police and the Expertise Centre on Human Trafficking and Smuggling (EMM).
Het COA kan de ernst en het waarheidsgehalte van deze signalen niet inschatten en heeft deze signalen gemeld bij de politie en Expertisecentrum Mensenhandel en Mensensmokkel (EMM).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de erkenning van non-EU rijbewijzen en certificaten in de sector transport en logistiek

An MP asks why Turkish truck driver licences and certificates are not recognised in the Netherlands, whether they can be exchanged, and whether this harms the transport sector's labour shortage. The ministers explain that non-EU licences are recognised only for temporary driving, that exchange requires a bilateral agreement, and that there is currently sufficient EU driver supply, and they decline to add the issue to the transport sector plan.
Turkish driving licences cannot be exchanged in the Netherlands for a Dutch driving licence.
Turkse rijbewijzen kunnen in Nederland niet omgewisseld worden tegen een Nederlands rijbewijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Pieter Heerma over de voortslepende zaak rondom de voormalige kinderopvang de Parel

MPs Siderius and Heerma asked whether the childcare benefit system's past vulnerability to fraud, the reliance on recommendations from schools and municipalities, the unpaid parental contributions, enforcement and recovery, and the hardship faced by parents affected by the De Parel case justified changes or relief. The State Secretary replied that the 2011 DigiD loophole was closed, that parents remain responsible for their applications, that recovery follows legal obligations with objections and payment arrangements available, and that he cannot discuss individual cases or the municipal costs of hardship.
Because of the duty of confidentiality, individual cases cannot be discussed.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht kan niet ingegaan worden op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma en het lid Potters over de radicalisering van jonge kinderen

MPs Heerma and Potters asked the minister about reports that young children from Muslim families in The Hague are showing radical ideas, and what the government will do to support schools in recognising and countering radicalisation. The minister replied that such incidents are rarely signs of radicalisation, pointed to a handbook and support for schools, and described existing and planned measures such as citizenship education, without providing national figures.
No registration is kept of these kinds of incidents.
Van dit soort incidenten wordt geen registratie bijgehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat het bedrijf Raet de bovenwettelijke aanvullingen op de WW gaat uitvoeren

MP Van Weyenberg asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that private firm Raet would administer supplementary unemployment benefits, including the data sharing with UWV, privacy safeguards and costs. The minister answered that ssocial partners are responsible for the scheme's design, premiums and data arrangements, that no UWV-Raet agreement yet exists, and that privacy and cost questions will be clarified later.
I am not aware of how exactly social partners intend to shape the supplementary WW benefits.
Het is mij niet bekend op welke wijze sociale partners de bovenwettelijke WW-aanvullingen exact willen vormgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de aanbevelingen van de commissie Gunning

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the implementation of the Gunning commission's recommendations on childcare safety, including governance, complaint handling in inspections, the definition of quality, and public disclosure of quality data. The minister said an evaluation of the recommendations will be commissioned, that the sector's governance code exists and financial oversight is being reviewed, that complaint-handling figures are not available, and that quality ratings are not yet given, with the new inspection framework under development.
Precise figures on how often GGD inspectors have taken note of complaint handling during inspections are not known.
Precieze cijfers over hoe vaak GGD inspecteurs kennis hebben genomen van de behandeling van klachten bij het afnemen van inspecties zijn niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over verdringing van vast personeel door vrijwilligers

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked the state secretary about volunteers replacing paid staff at the Dukenburg swimming pool, and what rules prevent such displacement of paid work. The state secretary said existing Participation Act rules and guidance already address displacement, that the local council must judge the risk case by case, and that no stronger national rules are needed for now.
It is not for me to interfere in the local discussion about how the swimming pool is operated.
Het is niet aan mij om me te mengen in de lokale discussie over de wijze van exploitatie van het zwembad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over de radicalisering van jonge kinderen

An MP asked whether criminalising glorification of terrorist violence would make it easier to act against recruiters targeting young people, and whether the law would be amended. The minister answered that existing law already allows action where statements incite violence or hatred, so extending criminal law is not necessary.
Within current legislation it is possible to act when statements occur in a context of incitement to violence and incitement of hatred against other population groups.
Binnen de huidige wetgeving is het mogelijk om op te treden wanneer uitingen geschieden in een context van opruiing tot geweld en het aanzetten tot haat jegens andere bevolkingsgroepen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht dat een onderzoek van het SCP en de Universiteit Utrecht aantoont dat het kabinetsbeleid aangaande zorg contrair is aan de voorkeur van de meerderheid van de Nederlan

An MP asks whether a study showing the cabinet's care policy diverges from majority public preferences means those views obstruct policy, and whether the policy should change. The state secretary replies that citizens' views on care are diverse, that parents are not obliged to use formal childcare, and that the government does not see public opinion as obstructing its care policy, pointing to ongoing mantelzorg measures and an SER advisory request due in September 2016.
The cabinet does not believe that parents' views on childcare stand in the way of cabinet policy.
Het kabinet is niet van mening dat de opvattingen van ouders rondom kinderopvang het kabinetsbeleid in de weg zit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Kerstens naar aanleiding van berichten in de media over misstanden bij kinderopvang De Sterrenberg in Arnhem

MPs Yücel and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported serious misconduct and safety problems at childcare centre De Sterrenberg in Arnhem, including its history of inspections and why sanctions were not imposed immediately. The minister answered that municipalities and their GGD inspectors are responsible for supervision and enforcement, outlined the eleven inspections since 2011 and the warnings and instructions issued, and explained the enforcement instruments available to municipalities.
As Minister of SZW, I do not concern myself with specific cases.
Als Minister van SZW ga ik niet over specifieke gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Pieter Heerma over het bericht ‘Een nieuwe baan en tóch het UWV op je dak: ‘Het lijkt verdorie wel Kafka’

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs why WW unemployment benefit recipients who have already found a new job still face job-search obligations, and whether this discourages keeping small benefits and risks losing accrued employment history. The minister replied that job-search duties attach to benefit receipt, that the Wwz gives a three-month exemption for same-hours work, that the mismatch with employment history is likely a misunderstanding because prior work counts again in a new WW claim, and that the effectiveness of these duties for employed recipients has not been studied.
Even before the Wwz took effect, WW recipients who received a benefit alongside a job were subject to a job-search obligation.
Ook voor de inwerkingtreding van de Wwz was sprake van een sollicitatieplicht voor de WW-gerechtigde die een uitkering ontving naast een baan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over geweld op het werk

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about workplace violence and bullying, its costs, how workers can seek protection, and whether a concrete follow-up to government action is planned. The minister answered with survey figures, outlined complaint routes via the Labour Inspectorate and courts, rejected extending the LKOG complaints commission's powers, and committed to informing parliament before summer 2016 on further measures.
I will inform the House before summer 2016 on how employers and employees can be further encouraged and facilitated to take timely measures to effectively counter bullying at work.

Ik zal de Tweede Kamer voor de zomer 2016 informeren op welke wijze werkgevers en werknemers verder gestimuleerd en gefaciliteerd kunnen worden om tijdig maatregelen te nemen om pesten op het werk effectief tegen te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de aantrekkelijkheid van Nederland voor buitenlandse investeerders

MP Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment whether Dutch talent attraction and technical skills shortages deter foreign investors, the student numbers in technical fields, and whether the knowledge migrant scheme should be widened. The minister acknowledged a mid-ranking index position, pointed to existing technical education and technology pacts, reported growth in technical student intake, and announced measures to make the Netherlands more attractive to knowledge workers.

That is why the cabinet recently announced that the admission scheme for foreign investors will be changed as of 1 July 2016 to attract more foreign investors who contribute positively to the Dutch economy.

Daarom heeft het kabinet onlangs aangekondigd dat de toelatingsregeling voor buitenlandse investeerders per 1 juli 2016 gewijzigd wordt om meer buitenlandse investeerders aan te trekken die positief bijdragen aan de Nederlandse economie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Dik-Faber over het onderzoek naar tienerzwangerschappen

MPs Van der Staaij and Dik-Faber asked the ministers about a Rutgers study on teenage pregnancies, including whether abortion is rejected by many pregnant teenagers, whether support for young mothers is adequate, and whether prevention and counselling should stress abortion's negative consequences. The State Secretary answered that girls' choices are respected, that doctors judge whether decisions are free and informed, that existing funding for support organisations is sufficient, and that counselling covers all options and consequences of abortion.
It is up to the doctor to determine whether a woman who comes to him for an abortus has made this choice freely and well informed.
Het is aan de arts om te bepalen of een vrouw die bij hem komt voor een abortus deze keuze in vrijheid en goed geïnformeerd heeft gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Mei Li Vos en Tanamal over het bericht ‘Klachtenregen over zzp-verzekeringen arbeidsongeschiktheid’

MPs Mei Li Vos and Tanamal asked the ministers of Finance and Social Affairs about reports that self-employed contractors in construction struggle to get disability insurance from private insurers, and about insurers invoking medical non-disclosure to restrict or reclaim benefits. Minister Asscher answered that self-employed workers are responsible for arranging their own coverage, pointed to fallback options such as the private safety-net policy and voluntary UWV insurance, announced an awareness campaign, and said the insurers' association is modernising the health declaration form.
I consider it important that all self-employed workers, including those in construction, are aware that they are themselves responsible for arranging coverage against the risk of incapacity.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat alle zzp’ers – dus ook in de bouw – zich er bewust van zijn dat zij er zelf verantwoordelijk voor zijn
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over basisartsen die met een ‘spoedcursus’ bedrijfsarts kunnen worden

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked whether Arbobutler's plan to deploy unqualified junior doctors as occupational health providers after a short course is acceptable and how the shortage of occupational physicians will be addressed. The minister replied that junior doctors lack the registered qualifications required under the Arbo Act, so employers cannot satisfy their duty with them, that employers are responsible for verifying provider quality, and that a campaign and a kwartiermaker will be launched to boost training intake.
The junior doctor does not have the same qualifications as the registered occupational physician.
De basisarts heeft niet dezelfde kwalificaties als de geregistreerde bedrijfsarts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders inzake het bericht 'Vrije dag Suikerfeest bespreekbaar voor Amsterdamse schoolbesturen'

PVV MPs asked whether Islamic celebrations such as Eid al-Fitr (Suikerfeest) should be excluded from Dutch schools and whether replacing Western holidays threatens national culture. The State Secretary answered that schools decide on celebrations themselves, that schools may use a four-day week up to seven times a year with parental consent, and rejected the assimilation framing and any intention to block Islamic events.
A school itself decides whether, and in which cases, celebrations or commemorations take place at school.
Een school bepaalt zelf of, en in welke gevallen, op school vieringen of herdenkingen plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de komst van een haat- en geweldprediker naar Utrecht

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government would bar Haitham al-Haddad, a British cleric they say preaches stoning and rejects the democratic legal order, from entering the Netherlands for an Utrecht conference. The minister confirmed awareness, said EU free-movement rules allow refusal only for a genuine, serious threat based on personal conduct, declined to comment on the individual case, and referred to strafrechtelijke handhaving and separate answers on intolerant behaviour.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een  geweldsprediker naar Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a violent preacher (al-Haddad, who reportedly calls for killing adulterers and apostates) should be denied entry to the Netherlands, how this fits the Bontes motion, whether foundations inviting such preachers could be banned, and whether a database of such preachers exists. The government answered that intolerant preachers are unwelcome and that visa or entry refusal depends on individual assessment and legal status (for this UK national, entry can only be refused on an actual, serious threat), that a study on the 'danger criterion' for banning associations is underway, and that no blacklist exists, only an alert list.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele casuïstiek doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Asscher: goud in handen bij twee dagdelen kinderopvang’

An MP asked Minister Asscher about his comments on childcare, the timing of a government response to the SER advice on childcare, whether short-term SER proposals will be acted on in this cabinet term, and whether medium- and long-term advice will be carried into the next cabinet. The minister answered that a full cabinet response will be sent before summer 2016, covering both labour participation and child development goals, and that he will consider taking up medium- and long-term recommendations.
I intend to send your House a cabinet response to the SER advice before the summer.
Ik ben voornemens om uw Kamer voor de zomer een kabinetsreactie op het SER-advies te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de Al Fitrahmoskee en daaraan verbonden organisaties leven als een profeet in Utrecht Overvecht

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the Al Fitrah mosque and linked organisations in Utrecht Overvecht operate as a parallel community, including questions on financing, possible criminal investigation, and safeguards for children and residents. The government answered that local authorities agreed with Al Fitrah on greater openness and monitoring, declined to say whether a criminal investigation exists, and referred to a forthcoming letter on salafism and to local action plans against radicalisation and poverty.
The cabinet makes no statement about whether a criminal investigation is ongoing.
Over het al dan niet lopen van een strafrechtelijk onderzoek doet het kabinet geen mededeling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Banden tussen moskee Utrecht en aan Al Qa’ida gelieerde instelling’

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reported links between a Utrecht mosque (Al Fitrah) and an Al Qaida-linked institution, what concrete action had been taken, how many mosques are foreign-funded, and whether mosques and preachers linked to dubious foundations would be closed or expelled. The minister answered that the mayor agreed transparency and funding-openness commitments with Al Fitrah and an evaluation was agreed, declined to give an overview of foreign-funded mosques citing that intelligence services do not publicly disclose concrete cases, and explained the legal limits on closing buildings and expelling persons.
If persons or organisations pose a threat to national security because of their conduct, the AIVD investigates them.
Indien personen of organisaties vanwege hun gedragingen een bedreiging vormen van de nationale veiligheid, dan doet de AIVD daar onderzoek naar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat de Al Fitrah-moskee dubieus geld heeft ontvangen

MPs Karabulut and Van Raak asked whether the Al Fitrah mosque's funding from Kuwait, including ties to an entity once on a US sanctions list, was checked by intelligence and tax authorities, what the municipality knew, and what action the government would take. The minister declined to comment on the specific case, said the municipality had known of the Kuwaiti funding since 2014, and deferred the mosque-funding question to a forthcoming letter on salafism.
In general, I do not make statements about specific cases.
In zijn algemeenheid doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bruins Slot, Van Toorenburg en Pieter Heerma over de Al Fitrah-moskee in Utrecht

CDA MPs asked whether the Al Fitrah mosque in Utrecht received funding from Kuwaiti organisations linked to Al-Qaida, whether tax and intelligence services checked its income, whether it publishes accounts, and what the mayor has done about it. The government largely declined to comment on specific cases citing confidentiality and procedural secrecy, while describing a three-track approach of dialogue, confrontation and enforcement and promising a forthcoming salafism letter.
In general I do not make statements about concrete cases.
In zijn algemeenheid doe ik geen uitspraken over concrete casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over de toename van het aantal beroepsziekten

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about two companies sued over occupational disease, whether these cases reflect a pattern, and about market competition in occupational health services, measurement of occupational disease targets, and Inspectorate powers. The minister answered that the Inspectorate runs a multi-year programme on hazardous substances, learns lessons from inspections and complaints, and will publish reports, while defending the private occupational health system and committing only to better monitoring of occupational disease figures.
Systematic learning from the findings has therefore already been implemented by the Inspectorate SZW.
Het systematisch leren van de bevindingen is door de Inspectie SZW dus reeds geïmplementeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over langdurig zieken die zes tot acht weken moeten wachten op uitbetaling van de vergoeding van woon-werkverkeer door het UWV

An MP asked whether chronically ill or disabled people must pre-finance commuting costs while UWV decides on transport allowances, which can take 8 to 14 weeks, and whether reimbursement takes 6 to 8 weeks. The minister explained that transport allowances cover only extra costs linked to the functional limitation, that UWV's statutory decision period is 8 or 14 weeks, that pre-financing may occur, and that UWV's policy is to pay declarations within 4 weeks, denying the 6 to 8 week payment period.
UWV aims to keep the processing time for declarations and the payment as short as possible.
UWV streeft er naar de verwerkingstermijn van declaraties en de uitbetaling zo kort mogelijk te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermeij en Mei Li Vos over universiteiten en hogescholen die de Wet werk en zekerheid ontduiken met knutselcontracten

MPs asked whether universities and universities of applied sciences use combined permanent-plus-temporary 'knutselcontracten' to evade the Wwz and whether this breaches the cao, and what the government will do. The minister says the cao and Wwz have already curbed such contracts, that cao compliance is for the parties and courts, and that the government agrees permanent contracts should be the norm, while noting some combinations will remain legitimate.
It is not for us to judge whether these contracts comply with the provisions of the cao, but for the cao parties themselves and ultimately the courts.
Het is niet aan ons om te oordelen of deze contracten in overeenstemming zijn met de bepalingen uit de genoemde cao maar aan cao-partijen zelf en uiteindelijk aan de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Kerstens over het bericht Pakket kopzorgen PostNL

Two MPs from the PvdA asked whether the Tax Authority (Belastingdienst) favours PostNL by failing to enforce against false self-employment of its parcel couriers, and whether UWV and PostNL are linked. The State Secretary answered that enforcement has been ineffective under the VAR regime, that the Wet DBA will allow stricter enforcement from 2016-2017, and that UWV and PostNL have no referral arrangement.
Enforcement by the Tax Authority at the client is therefore currently futile.
Handhaving door de Belastingdienst bij de opdrachtgever is nu dus vruchteloos.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Eritreeërs in Nederland slecht integreren

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Eritrean immigrants in the Netherlands integrate poorly under influence of the Eritrean regime, including questions on interpreters, Eritrean schools and organisations, trauma care and the diaspora tax. The minister answered that intimidation is unacceptable, that IND interpreters undergo vetting and can be replaced, that no Eritrean schools exist, that trauma is addressed in the asylum procedure, and that extortion would be investigated by police and prosecutors.
Intimidation, however, is unacceptable. Restriction of the freedom of Dutch citizens by the Eritrean government is not tolerated.
Intimidatie is echter uit den boze. Beperking van de vrijheid van Nederlandse burgers door de Eritrese overheid wordt niet getolereerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het antisemitisch Nieuwjaarsgeweld

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about antisemitic violence during New Year's Eve 2015 in Amsterdam, the scale of antisemitism, Holocaust teaching and security needs of Jewish institutions. The minister answered that the suspects were sent home with a conduct order, that the government rejects antisemitism, and listed measures such as teacher support, a dialogue with community leaders and recording of incidents.

Early 2016 SZW therefore organises a consultation with key figures from the Jewish and Islamic communities on their efforts to reduce the impact of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict in the Netherlands.

Begin 2016 organiseert SZW daarom een overleg met sleutelfiguren uit de Joodse en islamitische gemeenschap over hun inzet om doorwerking in Nederland van het Israelisch-Palestijnse conflict te verminderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over respect voor het stakingsrecht in het grootmetaal

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he would condemn alleged intimidation and implicit dismissal threats against striking metal-sector workers and have the Labour Inspectorate investigate. The minister said the collective agreement is a matter for social partners, that the Inspectorate had received no reports of strike-right violations, and so saw no reason for an investigation.
No reports have been made to the Labour Inspectorate that the right to strike has been violated. I therefore see no reason to have the Labour Inspectorate investigate.
Er zijn bij de Inspectie SZW geen meldingen gedaan dat het stakingsrecht zou worden geschonden. Ik zie daarom geen aanleiding om de Inspectie SZW onderzoek te laten doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de teruglopende vraag naar kinderopvang onder lagere inkomens

Yücel (PvdA) asked the minister why childcare use fell among lower-income families despite government investment, and about segregation in childcare and the motion on integrated child centres. The minister acknowledged concern, announced a study on low-income childcare use, said causes are not yet clear, and promised a response on the motion before summer 2016.
That is why I intend to conduct a study this spring into the use of childcare among low-income groups.
Daarom ben ik voornemens om dit voorjaar een onderzoek te doen naar het gebruik van kinderopvang onder lage inkomens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat de kinderopvang honderden euro's duurder wordt ondanks hogere toeslag

An MP asks the Minister whether childcare price rises despite higher subsidies undermine the intended affordability for working parents, and asks for an inventory of price increases and a review of maximum hourly rates. The Minister agrees the subsidy aims to lower costs, says providers set their own prices subject to competition and parent committee advice, plans a research study in spring, and declines to intervene now.
I intend to conduct a study this spring into childcare use among low-income groups and the background of possibly declining use.
Ik ben voornemens dit voorjaar een onderzoek te gaan doen naar het gebruik van kinderopvang onder lage inkomens en achtergronden van het mogelijk afnemend gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk inzake het bericht dat een presentatrice is gediscrimineerd bij RTL Nieuws

Deputies Kuzu and Öztürk asked about reports that a RTL Nieuws presenter was discriminated against, and about diversity and representativeness in Dutch media and the public broadcaster NPO. The Secretary of State said RTL denies discrimination, that media diversity is ultimately the responsibility of broadcasters, that data limits exist due to privacy rules, and that he will urge media organisations and the NPO to improve diversity without committing to binding action.
It is unacceptable if someone is treated differently on the basis of their skin colour than another person.
Het is onacceptabel als iemand op basis van zijn/haar huidskleur op een andere manier wordt behandeld dan een ander persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van verschillende geweldspredikers naar Eindhoven

Two MPs asked whether preachers who legitimise suicide bombings and call for the death penalty for homosexuals should be denied entry, why such visits keep being allowed despite a motion to bar them, and whether foundations inviting them should be dissolved under Book 2 of the Civil Code. The government answered that visas are refused or withdrawn for preachers threatening public order, that each case is assessed individually and some visas were withdrawn, that it is pursuing a three-track approach, and that dissolution of legal persons is a matter for the courts on request by the public prosecutor.
Each individual case is assessed on its own merits and tested against these principles.
Elk individueel geval wordt op zijn eigen merites beoordeeld en getoetst aan deze uitgangspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het aan werk helpen van bijstandsgerechtigden

An MP asked the minister whether unemployed welfare recipients could fill jobs currently filled by Eastern European workers, and whether a Nijmegen approach and a parliamentary motion on employing disabled workers were being followed up. The state secretary answered that case-by-case matching applies, that Nijmegen's outreach is welcomed as part of municipal duties, and that the 2013 motion is implemented through the social accord and the Participation Act and quota law, with progress monitored.
The efforts are continuously monitored by me; of course the House of Representatives will be informed about this.
De inspanningen worden door mij voortdurend gevolgd; uiteraard wordt uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de aangekondigde islamitische conferentie in Eindhoven

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether a visa should be granted to a preacher who endorses suicide bombings and whether the Al Waqf/Al Fourqaan mosque in Eindhoven should be closed after inviting a violent preacher to a December 2015 conference. The minister replied that visas can be refused or revoked for threats to public order, that some visas were revoked, and that there is no basis under current law to dissolve or close the foundation.
I do not comment on individual cases.
Over individuele gevallen doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht ‘In Nederland dreigt nieuwe onderklasse van vluchtelingen te ontstaan’

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the government how it will prevent a new underclass of refugees, including waiting times, early language and labour-market preparation, and allowing work or study during the asylum procedure. The minister replies by pointing to existing letters on integration, early language courses, and an expanded pre-integration programme, without committing to new measures such as working during the procedure.
Are you willing, for the integration of newcomers, to let asylum migrants work and study already during their procedure?
Bent u bereid, ten behoeve van de integratie van de nieuwkomers, asielmigranten al tijdens hun procedure te laten werken en studeren?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Vermeij en Monasch over het faillissement van Dolcis, Invito, Manfield, Pro Sport en Steve Madden

Three PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about the bankruptcy of Dolcis, Invito, Manfield, Pro Sport and Steve Madden, and whether the government would help preserve jobs and engage the retail sector. The minister said the ministry is actively involved behind the scenes, that sales of much of the Macintosh group are advanced, and that retail partners are exploring acceleration of the Retailagenda and transition support for workers.
My ministry has been involved in the bankruptcy process since late December and takes an active stance behind the scenes.
Mijn ministerie is sinds eind december betrokken bij het faillissementsproces en neemt achter de schermen een actieve houding aan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ‘Klokkenluider aan de grond’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a news report on a whistleblower blacklisted after exposing unpaid wages on the A2 tunnel project, and about whether affected workers received what they were owed. The minister said the misconduct is undesirable, that the Belastingdienst is in contact with the whistleblower, that the blacklisting is a matter between employer and employee for civil proceedings, and that the employer has not yet paid the court-ordered back wages under appeal.
This concerns a matter between employer and employee. It is therefore up to the employee to assess whether there are sufficient grounds to start civil proceedings against Rimec/Mecra's conduct.

Het betreft hier een zaak tussen werkgever en werknemer. Het is dan ook aan de werknemer om de afweging te maken of er voldoende aanknopingspunten zijn om tegen de handelwijze van de Rimec/Mecra een civielrechtelijke procedure te starten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat veel beginnende ggz-krachten werken voor een onkostenvergoeding

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether young mental health professionals working only for an expense allowance are owed the minimum wage or collective agreement wage, with retroactive effect, and whether the Labour Inspectorate will investigate. The minister answered that whether wage is owed depends on the facts, that retroactive payment would apply if it is, and that the Inspectorate will investigate the institution and report when finished.
The Labour Inspectorate will investigate the institution concerned.
De Inspectie SZW gaat onderzoek doen naar de betrokken instelling.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Maij over arbeidsmigratie binnen Europa

MPs Kerstens and Maij asked the minister whether intra-EU labour migration problems such as underpayment, unfair competition and displacement should be tackled urgently at EU level, how the Posting of Workers Directive revision would be advanced, and what the Netherlands would do on bogus self-employment, the temporary agency convention and the A1 form. The minister answered that the Commission shares the concern, that the Netherlands will push the Labour Mobility Package once published, and that these issues are complex with no easy solutions, promising to inform parliament once clarity exists.
As soon as there is clarity on this, I will inform the House of Representatives together with the State Secretary of Finance.
Zodra er duidelijkheid over is zal ik, samen met de Staatssecretaris van Financiën, de Tweede Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de gevolgen van de prijsstijging van de Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) voor de kinderopvangbranche

An SP MP asked the minister about the financial impact of the VOG price rise on the childcare sector, whether a 38 percent increase is excessive given budget cuts, what measures prevent extra childcare funds flowing back to the state via fees, and whether the VOG will be made free or supported. The minister estimates the extra sector cost at about 0.6 million euro per year (falling to 0.4 million after the personal register is introduced), says the rise is sizeable but limited for the sector, sees no reason for measures or free VOGs, and commits to no action.
As answered in response to the first question.
Zoals bij de eerste vraag is geantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over miljoenenfraude in de kinderopvang

MP Pieter Heerma (CDA) asked the government about the scale, type and organisation of childcare-allowance fraud, including whether organised fraud with collusion by providers is rising and whether the planned digital-wallet legislation will help. The minister gave annual figures on cases accepted for criminal investigation from 2012 to 2015, described three fraud patterns, said enforcement has intensified, and argued the new payment structure will give government more monitoring options.
Also in the new situation, alongside these additional options, enforcement and investigation will continue to take place.
Ook in de nieuwe situatie zullen, naast deze aanvullende mogelijkheden, handhaving en opsporing blijven plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Vermeij over de Duitse arbeidsmarkt die geen schade leidt door de invoering van het minimumloon

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether the absence of employment damage from Germany's minimum wage, introduced in 2015, should inform the review of the Dutch minimum wage law, and whether a comparison with the Dutch labour market will be made. The minister answers that early effects appear limited, notes that employment effects can show with delay, and commits to considering German outcomes in the review.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij, Kerstens en Nijboer over de oud -eigenaar Sun Capital die mogelijk betrokken is bij een doorstart van V&D

MPs Vermeij, Kerstens and Nijboer asked about former owner Sun Capital's possible role in a V&D going-concern restart after bankruptcy, and whether bankruptcy was misused against staff and creditors. Minister Asscher answered that the court and curators are responsible, that the curators' report will show Sun Capital's role, and that research into works council positions in takeovers will be completed before summer.
It is not for me to make statements about the background to this bankruptcy and the financial situation of the company.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over de achtergronden bij dit faillissement en de financiële situatie van de onderneming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "het bericht dat buschauffeurs worden vervangen door medewerkers van de sociale werkplaats"

An MP asked whether Meppel replacing bus drivers with social workplace and benefit recipients, including unpaid 'tegenprestatie' riders, is desirable and whether it displaces paid work. The government answered that the choice lies with the municipality and its council, that the Inspectie SZW will not investigate individual municipalities, and that displacement means unfair competition causing job loss.
No, it is not the task of the Inspectie SZW to supervise individual municipalities. The municipal council has a supervisory task here.
Nee, het is geen taak van de Inspectie SZW om toezicht te houden op individuele gemeenten. De gemeenteraad heeft hier een controlerende taak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over de cao Besloten Busvervoer 2015-2016

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the CAO for Private Bus Transport (article 48) should be amended and whether its general binding declaration should be withdrawn, given a court ruling on self-employed workers. The Minister replied that amendment and withdrawal were not necessary because article 48 was declared generally binding with the reasoning in the declaration decision, and that social partners should clarify the provision in a future request.

It is not necessary to withdraw the general binding declaration of article 48, because article 48 was declared generally binding taking into account the considerations made regarding that article in the declaration decision.

Het is niet noodzakelijk om de algemeenverbindendverklaring van artikel 48 in te trekken, omdat artikel 48 algemeen verbindend is verklaard met inachtneming van de overwegingen die ten aanzien van dat artikel in het avv-besluit zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de misstanden bij distributiecentra

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions at distribution centres exposed by a current-affairs broadcast, including whether the Labour Inspectorate would stop work over immediate danger, whether it knew of the complaints, and whether it would check other centres. The minister answered that the inspectorate can act on its own observations or complaints, that the broadcast's cases were not reported to it, that an accident investigation at a Jumbo site started in December 2015, and that broadcast signals will feed into planned inspections.
The signals from the EenVandaag broadcast will be taken into account in preparing the upcoming (re)inspections.
De signalen uit de uitzending van EenVandaag worden meegenomen bij de voorbereiding van de komende (her) inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij de distributiecentra van Albert Heijn en Jumbo

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about poor working conditions, pressure and intimidation, and unsafe situations at Albert Heijn and Jumbo distribution centres after a broadcast, and about the position of flexible workers and possible sanctions. The minister said there is no evidence of a structural problem, that complaints will be considered in upcoming inspections, and that sanctions range from warnings to closure and fines, but committed to no specific inspection of the distribution centres.
The signals from the EenVandaag broadcast will be taken into account in the preparation of (re)inspections.
De signalen uit de uitzending van EenVandaag zullen meegenomen worden in de voorbereiding van (her)inspecties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de hoge registratiekosten voor de verplichte geschillencommissie in de kinderopvang en het 'klachtengeld' dat betaald moet worden

An SP MP asked the minister about high registration costs for the new mandatory childcare dispute commission and a 25 euro complaint fee for parents, asking whether this creates barriers. The minister said membership replaces the old complaints obligation, fees are based on registered childcare places and set by the sector, the 25 euro fee is refundable if the complainant wins, and the free Klachtenloket remains available.
It has been agreed that the level of membership contributions will remain an important point of attention for the steering group in 2016 and will be monitored.
Afgesproken is dat de hoogte van de aansluitbijdragen ook in 2016 een belangrijk aandachtspunt zal zijn voor de Stuurgroep Geschillencommissie Kinderopvang en dat dit gemonitord zal worden.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Oosenbrug en Vermeij over de relatie tussen het UWV en IBM

MPs Oosenbrug and Vermeij asked about the relationship between UWV and IBM, including reported failures of the werk.nl platform, whether UWV considered switching vendors, and whether open standards would give UWV more freedom in choosing suppliers. Minister Asscher answered that UWV is broadly satisfied with IBM, that switching vendors was considered but rejected for cost and continuity reasons, that open standards help but do not by themselves determine switching ease, and listed planned open-standards measures.
UWV decided to continue the cooperation with IBM and other involved suppliers.
UWV heeft besloten de samenwerking met IBM en andere betrokken leveranciers te continueren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht van Techzine van 2 december

MP Klein asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Techzine report that UWV may have leaked personal data via MijnUWV, and how this happened. The minister answered that 20 reports of clients seeing others' data on werk.nl were received, caused by a firewall software fault, now fixed with an interim replacement and an update under testing, and that no client damage is known.
UWV took action immediately after the first report, contacted the reporter, and together with the suppliers started an investigation into the cause of the problem.
UWV heeft meteen na de eerste melding actie ondernomen, heeft contact opgenomen met de melder en heeft in samenwerking met de leveranciers het onderzoek gestart naar de oorzaak van het probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Tanamal over de vondst van werkgevers om de transitievergoeding te omzeilen

Two PvdA MPs asked Minister Asscher about a court ruling in which an employee sought dissolution of the contract after two years of incapacity and a UWV wage sanction, and about how wage continuation works in dormant employment and what counts as seriously culpable conduct by employers under the Wwz. The minister confirmed the ruling, explained the two-year wage obligation and the sanction mechanism, pointed to case law examples, and declined to endorse the court's finding that the employer was not seriously culpable, noting that appeal remains possible.
I do not endorse this judgment.
Ik treed niet in dit oordeel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over enorme loongroei van topbestuurders

MP Karabulut asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a sharp rise in pay for top executives of listed companies in 2014, whether the 28% and 24% increases were excessive, how to reduce the pay gap with workers, and whether pay ratios and the Corporate Governance Code could be regulated. The minister said pay is a matter for shareholders and boards, that the government will widen works council powers and supports EU proposals for shareholder influence and pay-ratio transparency, but declined to disclose pay ratios or legally cap them.
With this legislative amendment the government wants to stimulate precisely this discussion and companies' awareness of it.
Met deze wetswijziging wil de regering juist deze discussie en het bewustzijn van bedrijven hieromtrent stimuleren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de groeiende geldnood

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about rising household debt arrears and proposed a flat tax, lower VAT and corporate tax, and phasing out allowances, arguing this would reduce the state's role. Minister Asscher answered that arrears reflect income losses, defended the progressive tax and allowance system, rejected the flat tax, and said the government had not accepted the claim that large redistribution necessarily curbs growth.
I do not share this view. The current tax system is individual and progressive and aimed at stimulating labour participation.
Deze mening deel ik niet. Het huidige belastingsysteem is individueel en progressief en gericht op het stimuleren van arbeidsparticipatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Fritsma en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vluchtelingen ingezet voor nijpend personeelstekort’

PVV MPs asked why a project placing refugees in jobs against a staff shortage does not consider unemployed Dutch workers, whether it should be ended, and whether borders should be closed to asylum seekers. The minister replied that the shortages are sector-specific and long-standing, that refugees with residence permits bring useful skills, that the project fits government policy, and that asylum claims are assessed individually.
I do not intend to end this project, because it fits government policy of having refugees contribute to society.
Ik ben niet van plan dit project te laten beëindigen, want het past binnen het kabinetsbeleid om vluchtelingen een bijdrage te laten leveren aan de samenleving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Duisenberg over de Wet werk en zekerheid

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister why the Wet werk en zekerheid prevents young researchers from carrying out their grant-funded research at their own university, and whether the law will be amended. The Minister attributes the problem to the growth of project funding, notes that the cao Universiteiten limits chained temporary contracts to four years, and says that UWV or mutual consent can end open-ended contracts when projects finish, so no amendment is planned and the issue will be raised with the VSNU.
We therefore see no reason to amend the Wwz, more specifically the so-called chain provision.
Wij zien dan ook geen aanleiding om de Wwz, meer in het bijzonder de zogenoemde ketenbepaling, aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Vermeij over het weigeren van een stageplaats vanwege de seksuele geaardheid

MPs Yücel and Vermeij asked the ministers about a reported refusal of an internship because of sexual orientation, and about government support and diversity policy. The minister condemns discrimination, points to the existing action plan on labour-market discrimination, existing complaint channels (College voor de Rechten van de Mens, local anti-discrimination services) and the diversity charter, without assessing the specific case.
The assessment of whether discrimination occurred in this specific case is for the College voor de Rechten van de Mens or the judge.
De beoordeling of in deze specifieke casus sprake is van discriminatie is aan het College voor de Rechten van de Mens (College) of de rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermuë over een werkbezoek aan sw-bedrijf Dethon

MPs Kerstens and Vermue asked whether the ban on wage deductions in the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies would unintentionally hinder sheltered-employment firms from deducting rent from workers' pay, and whether action would be taken. Minister Asscher answered that the ban is not meant to harm sheltered workers, that he will seriously consider an exception, and that deductions remain permitted until 1 July 2016, with a letter to parliament promised in early 2016.
Therefore I will also seriously consider an exception for this group.
Daarom zal ik een uitzondering voor deze groep ook serieus overwegen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht “UWV verbaasd over ingrijpen Asscher”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of UWV backlogs in reassessments of disability benefit recipients (25,000 awaiting reassessment, 47,000 awaiting reintegration, 9,000 five-year checks in 2016, and a capacity gap of 60,000 versus 40,000 reassessments). The minister explains the backlog figures (11,500 professional reassessments), prioritisation of client-driven reassessments, and promises a plan of action in March 2016 to clear the backlog.
As you noted earlier, I did not include figures on the five-year check in the letter to your House, because they are surrounded by great uncertainty and UWV has not confirmed these figures.
Zoals u eerder medegedeeld, heb ik geen cijfers over de vijfdejaarstoets opgenomen in de brief aan uw Kamer, omdat deze met grote onzekerheid zijn omgeven en UWV deze cijfers niet heeft bevestigd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over Noorse investeerders die oprukken in de Nederlandse kinderopvang

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is desirable that a Norwegian investor (Norlandia Care Group) expands in Dutch childcare, profiting from state-funded childcare allowances, and whether such foreign takeovers, scale growth and profit transfers abroad should be restricted. The minister answered that private investment is welcome as it expands choice for parents, that he has no insight into private companies' operations or profit use, and that childcare quality and compliance with rules matter most.
I have no insight into the business operations of private companies.
Ik heb geen inzicht in de bedrijfsvoering van private ondernemingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over de belemmeringen van BBL-trajecten als gevolg van sectorfondsen

An MP asked whether the sector training fund and sector plan for transport and logistics unfairly favour BBL pupils placed through the sector institute STL over those placed through other temp agencies. The minister replied that STL is not a temp agency, that the funding is open to all approved training firms, and that the sector social partners chose this placement model.

The subsidy from the sector's training and development fund (SOOB) and the co-financing from the sector plan benefit all approved training companies in the transport and logistics sector that offer work placements to BBL pupils.

De subsidie uit het Opleidings- en Ontwikkelingsfonds van de sector (SOOB) en de cofinanciering uit het sectorplan komen ten goede aan alle erkende leerbedrijven in de sector Transport en Logistiek die BBL-leerlingen een leerwerk plaats bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over jongeren die na het afstuderen geen baan kunnen vinden en onderbetaald aan de slag gaan

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether graduates are being underpaid through internships and work placements that amount to regular employment, and whether enforcement against such misuse is adequate. The minister answered that genuine internships need no pay but work without a learning focus must pay at least the minimum wage, that the Inspectie SZW has opened 12 investigations since December 2014 with two fines issued, and that a letter on handling reports from FNV Jong's complaint point will follow before 1 April.
The misuse of work placements has the attention of the Inspectie SZW.
Het misbruik van werkervaringplekken heeft de aandacht van de Inspectie SZW.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de gevolgen van het verdwijnen van 1.800 vrijwilligers uit het peuterspeelzaalwerk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the consequences of about 1,800 volunteers leaving childcare playgroups, including costs, funding cuts, rural impacts, free childcare hours and the role of volunteers. The minister answered that the playgroup organisational form is for organisations to decide, that the 2018 harmonisation with childcare stands, that municipalities will not receive extra money for rural staffing, and that a concrete follow-up on the 60 million development entitlement will come in spring 2016.
I will inform you further on the elaboration and the consultation with the VNG no later than spring 2016.
Ik zal u nader informeren over de verdere invulling en het overleg met de VNG uiterlijk in het voorjaar van 2016.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht ‘Bijna geen mannen meer werkzaam in de kinderopvang’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether male staff in childcare have nearly disappeared, why, and what action will be taken to increase their numbers. The minister answered that the share of men is low, gave reasons such as parental preference and employer selection, said the national government has not pursued active policy and sees limited room, but committed to equal opportunities and to cooperating on a cultural change in training and recruitment.
I am of the view that men can work in childcare just as well as women.
Ik ben van mening dat mannen net zo goed in de opvang kunnen werken als vrouwen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut inzake het bericht 'Gülen runt nieuw lectoraat Inholland'

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked about reports that the Gülen movement runs a new lectorate at Inholland via the business association Hogiaf, and whether this is desirable and whether the school knew Hogiaf's background. The minister answered that Inholland guarantees the lectorate's independence, that the school will consider ending the cooperation if members actively promote Gülen ideology, and that the government has no overview of Gülen-linked organisations, with a parliamentary motion for further research pending.
The Dutch government does not have an overview of organisations operating under, or affiliated with, the Gülen movement.
De Nederlandse overheid beschikt niet over een overzicht van organisaties die opereren onder, of gelieerd zijn aan, de Gülen-beweging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over een verbod op kamperende vrachtwagenchauffeurs

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked whether Dutch truck drivers are forced to spend weekend rest in their cabs at unserviced parking areas, whether stricter rules in neighbouring countries drive them to Dutch parking spots, and whether the government will adopt a national ban on sleeping in trucks as proposed by CNV, or pursue harmonised EU enforcement. The minister answered that no figures exist on forced cab rest, that a ban conflicts with the policy of using secured truck parkings, and that the government supports EU harmonisation, with a Commission road package expected in 2016.
The cabinet is in favour of clear European policy, so that uniform interpretation and enforcement is achieved across the various EU member states.
Het kabinet is voorstander van een duidelijk Europees beleid, zodat eenduidige interpretatie en handhaving in de diverse EU-lidstaten wordt bereikt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Ziengs over het artikel 'Brede cao biedt zekerheid voor alle werkenden”

Two VVD MPs asked whether minimum rates for self-employed workers (zzp'ers) set in collective labour agreements, as proposed by FNV and agreed in the architecture sector, are acceptable and lawful under competition rules. The minister answered that such clauses likely fall under the cartel prohibition, that the ACM supervises this, and that the government is not aware of consultation with zzp'ers, without committing to any new action.

Collective labour agreement provisions concerning self-employed persons without staff who qualify as undertakings under competition law, and which contain tariff agreements for them, will most likely fall under the cartel prohibition of the Competition Act.

Cao-bepalingen die zien op zelfstandigen zonder personeel die kwalificeren als ondernemer in de zin van het mededingingsrecht en die afspraken bevatten over tarieven voor deze zelfstandigen zullen hoogstwaarschijnlijk onder het kartelverbod uit de Mededingingswet vallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Verhoeven over minimumtarieven voor zzp'ers in cao’s

MPs Van Weyenberg and Verhoeven asked whether collective agreements may set minimum fee rates for self-employed workers without staff, and how this relates to bogus self-employment, competition law and tax treatment. Minister Asscher answered that such clauses likely fall under the cartel prohibition unless the workers are bogus self-employed, that the ACM decides on bogus self-employment, and that the agreement has no effect on tax deductions or the Belastingdienst's assessment.
Whether or not there are bogus self-employed workers does not appear from this collective agreement provision.
Of al dan niet sprake is van schijnzelfstandigen blijkt niet uit deze cao-afspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over discriminatie van jongeren bij het vinden van een bijbaan of stageplaats

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked ministers about discrimination against young people, including migrant youth, when seeking part-time jobs or internships, and about the measures taken. The minister acknowledged that discrimination is unacceptable and that migrant youth need more applications for internships, described programmes such as the City Deal, Werkakkoorden and training initiatives, and said the anti-discrimination action programme would be updated in early 2016.
The revision of the action programme will work across specific policy tracks.
De herijking van het actieprogramma zal overkoepelend werken ten aanzien van specifieke beleidstrajecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht dat de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) de Roemernorm omzeilt door uitzendkrachten twee weken naar huis te sturen

Green Left MP Voortman asked whether the Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) is evading the Roemer norm (a cap on temporary agency workers) by sending agency staff home for two weeks, and whether other ministries and bodies do the same and whether DUO will be addressed. The government answered that it sees no reason to conclude DUO is concealing a breach, no reason to investigate other bodies, and no reason to address DUO, referring to earlier answers to Van Raak.
Do you share the view that DUO is trying to conceal by this means that it is breaching the agreed percentage of flexible workers?
Vraag 1 Deelt u de mening dat DUO hiermee probeert te verhullen dat het de gemaakte afspraken over het percentage flexwerkers schendt?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Van Dekken over het bericht dat uitzendkrachten die bij de Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) werken twee weken onbetaald thuis moeten blijven

PvdA MPs Vermeij and Van Dekken asked whether DUO temporary agency workers were being sent home unpaid for two weeks, and whether this was acceptable. The minister denied that workers were sent home unpaid, explaining that agency staff were rostered only where needed and that many took leave, while committing to gradually reduce flexible staffing under a union agreement.
Sending home employees without a permanent contract is not the case.
Van naar huis sturen van medewerkers zonder vast contract is geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat vrouwen nog steeds minder verdienen dan mannen

MPs Karabulut and Siderius asked the ministers how they react to reports that women still earn less than men for equal work, why women over 35 earn less, what the pay gaps are, what agreements exist with social partners, and what role the government sees for itself. The ministers answer that pay discrimination is unacceptable, that much of the gap stems from different labour-market positions, cite CBS findings and ongoing actions and studies, and promise further updates in early 2016.
Nowadays it is not explainable that it still occurs that women earn less than men for equivalent work.
Het is heden ten dage niet uit te leggen dat het nog altijd voorkomt dat vrouwen minder verdienen dan mannen voor gelijkwaardig werk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ark over het werkprogramma van de Europese Commissie en de routekaart voor een betere ‘werk-privé balans’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether EU work-life balance legislation is needed and whether it fits the EU's less-regulation agenda; the minister answered that a roadmap and planned package are only at consultation stage, that subsidiarity will decide the Dutch position, and that work-life balance is primarily a matter for partners and employers. The answers are largely referrals to future BNC fiches and restate the subsidiarity principle without committing to concrete steps.
On these proposals and the Dutch position on them, the cabinet will inform you in due course in the usual way via BNC fiche(s).
Over deze voorstellen en het Nederlandse standpunt daarover zal het kabinet u te zijner tijd op de gebruikelijke wijze via BNC fiche(s) informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Anne Mulder en Straus over de vervangersproblematiek

MPs Mulder and Straus asked whether the minister knew of a Catholic primary school foundation's letter to parents saying children might be sent home because substitute teachers can now only be engaged three times for a half-day under the new law, and what the government would do. The minister says sending children home is undesirable, notes the sector's cao runs until 1 July 2016 so current rules still apply, and says the substitute problem will be addressed in cao negotiations.
That is why collective labour agreement parties can make agreements deviating from the law, both for on-call contracts (zero-hours or min/max contracts) and for temporary contracts.
Daarom kunnen cao-partijen van de wet afwijkende afspraken maken, zowel als het gaat om oproepcontracten (nuluren- of min/max contracten) als om tijdelijke contracten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij Klesch Aluminium Delfzijl

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions and reduced pay after the Klesch Aluminium Delfzijl rescue of a bankrupt firm, and about similarities to pre-pack bankruptcies like Estro and Princen. The minister declined to judge the individual case, said the Labour Inspectorate sees no reason to investigate, and pointed to pending legislation (Wet continuïteit ondernemingen I) to regulate pre-pack practice.
I do not judge the concrete facts and circumstances of the individual case.
Ik oordeel niet over de concrete feiten en omstandigheden van het individuele geval.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "toeslagpartners van ernstig zieke mensen die geen kinderopvangtoeslag ontvangen"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether parents of seriously ill partners who receive no childcare allowance should be able to get childcare support, and about numbers and compensation. The minister said municipalities handle this through social-medical indication (SMI) with discretionary case-by-case support, reported about 3,300 SMI grants in 2012, saw no legal inequality problem, and will review SMI in 2016 without changing national rules or compensating affected families.
I have no figures available on the number of partners who, due to illness, are no longer able to participate in work and for whom the other parent is not entitled to childcare allowance.
Ik heb geen cijfers beschikbaar over het aantal toeslagpartners die vanwege ziekte – langdurig of in het geheel – niet meer in staat zijn om deel te nemen aan het arbeidsproces
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Voortman over de uitzending van Radar ‘Kinderopvangtoeslag’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Voortman asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is fair that families with a fully disabled parent receive no childcare allowance when the other parent works, and whether a hardship clause or other flexibility should be introduced. The minister answered that the Sociaal Medische Indicatie (SMI) lets municipalities compensate such families, that municipalities are best placed to judge individual cases, that no new statutory route for the Belastingdienst is foreseen, and that the matter is for municipalities under their duty of care.
It is up to the municipal council to monitor the mayor and aldermen on the implementation of SMI.
Het is aan de gemeenteraad om het college van burgemeester en wethouders te controleren inzake de uitvoering van SMI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de verwachte lange termijnkosten van de asielinstroom

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about child benefit paid to refugees, the expected share of Syrian and Iraqi asylum seekers who will stay permanently, and long-term costs of asylum inflow. The minister answered that child benefit went to about 9,000 households in Q2 2015 (around EUR 4.6 million), that long-term stay cannot be forecast so no long-term cost estimate is possible, and that benefits from participation should also be considered.
Because the development of that situation cannot be predicted, no quantitative calculation can be made either.
Omdat de ontwikkeling van die situatie niet valt te voorspellen, kan evenmin daarover een cijfermatige doorrekening plaatsvinden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Ten Broeke over de oproep van World Wide Relief-woordvoer Ouaali om Israëlische toeristen aan te vallen

Two VVD MPs asked the government about public calls by World Wide Relief spokesperson Ouaali to attack Israeli tourists, including whether the group is state-funded and what is being done against rising antisemitism. The government answered that the statements are condemned and under criminal investigation, that the group receives no Dutch state funding, that antisemitism incidents rose in 2014, and outlined existing police and anti-discrimination measures.
World Wide Relief receives no financial support from the Dutch government.
World Wide Relief ontvangt geen financiële ondersteuning van de Nederlandse overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Pieter Heerma over de uitlatingen gedaan op Facebook om Israëlische toeristen 'total loss' te slaan

MPs Oskam and Heerma asked whether Facebook calls by Youness Ouaali to attack Israeli tourists are punishable, whether a criminal investigation is underway and whether pre-trial detention could apply. The Minister of Justice answered that the statements are condemned, that a criminal investigation is ongoing and no further details can be given for its sake, and that pre-trial detention requirements are set out in law without pre-judging the case.
A criminal investigation into Mr Ouaali is currently ongoing. In the interest of the investigation, no further statements can be made at this time.
Op dit moment loopt er een strafrechtelijk onderzoek tegen de heer Ouaali. In het belang van het onderzoek, kunnen op dit moment verder geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Kuiken over de mogelijkheid tot het inzetten van mensenrechtenambassadeurs op AZC’s

MPs Yücel and Kuiken asked whether human rights ambassadors could be deployed in asylum centres to explain Dutch fundamental values, after reports of threats to religious freedom and safety for vulnerable residents.
