Minister Asscher answered that COA receives such signals, applies rules on religious practice and discrimination, provides civic information, and is discussing with organisations how to expand this, including the VON proposal.
COA therefore willingly enters into discussion with VON to explore the possible contribution these human rights ambassadors could make.
Het COA gaat daarom graag het gesprek aan met VON om te bespreken welke mogelijke bijdrage de genoemde mensenrechtenambassadeurs kunnen leveren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over het bericht dat bedrijfsartsen onder druk worden gezet door werkgevers

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that company doctors are pressured by employers not to diagnose burn-out, and whether the NZa is investigating. The minister confirmed the NZa is examining the complaint within its remit, committed to a bill strengthening the company doctor's independence, and said diagnosis fraud is addressed via the Rechtmatige Zorg programme and tort liability.
In it I informed you of my intention to strengthen the position of the company doctor by law.
Hierin heb ik u mijn voornemen kenbaar gemaakt om bij wet de positie van de bedrijfsarts te versterken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Karabulut over minderjarige Syrische bruiden

MPs Gesthuizen and Karabulut asked how the government will prevent forced child marriages of Syrian girls who come to the Netherlands to reunite with husbands, what steps follow arrival, how many child brides have arrived, and what support is offered. The government answered that the Wet Huwelijksdwang will set the minimum marriage and recognition age at 18, that Nidos, IND and COA watch for signs of forced marriage, that research on informal marriages is underway, and that tailored psychological support and specialist shelter are available.
Child brides are not separately registered in the IND registration system.
Kindbruiden worden niet apart geregistreerd in het IND-registratiesysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yucel over de sociale kloof in de EU

Two MPs asked the ministers about a Bertelsmann Stiftung report showing a widening social gap in the EU, its figures on unemployment and poverty, and the effectiveness of the EU Youth Guarantee for young people. The government answered that the figures match Eurostat and CBS data, that structural reforms and sharing of best practices are the priority, that it is too early to judge the Youth Guarantee's effectiveness, and that the Netherlands performs well on youth unemployment and poverty; it promised a further explanation during the budget debate.
As previously promised, you will receive the further elaboration of the plans before the SZW budget debate.
Zoals eerder toegezegd ontvangt u voor de begrotingsbehandeling van SZW de nadere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over vermoedens van malversaties bij Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked about alleged misconduct at Vluchtelingenwerk Nederland, including unfair competition, the director's salary, a possible monopoly, volunteers in language courses and a cooperation with a commercial firm. Minister Asscher answered that the allegations are disputed, the salary follows the Balkenende norm, there is no monopoly, volunteers only complement paid teachers, and the cooperation is not unfair.
I do not share your concern.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over jonge ouder te weinig toegerust

An MP asked whether the government would revisit the 2010 family note and act on proposals to better prepare young parents, including a mandatory parenthood pledge. The state secretary replied that no new family note is needed, that municipalities now hold preventive and youth-care responsibilities under the Jeugdwet, and that parents cannot be obliged to use such services.
At this moment there is no reason to draft a new family note.
Op dit moment is er geen aanleiding om een nieuwe gezinsnota op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het vergoeden van een doventolk door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why people over 30 are denied a sign-language interpreter for study, and how that fits with policy easing study for older adults. The government explains the 30-year limit for education funding, notes that UWV can fund interpreters for work-related training under conditions, and says a study has been started.
The outcome of the consultation is that a study will be started on behalf of the Ministries of Education, Culture and Science, Health, Welfare and Sport, and Social Affairs and Employment.

Uitkomst van het overleg is dat er in opdracht van het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap (OCW), het Ministerie van VWS en het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (SZW) een onderzoek wordt gestart.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over declaratieproblemen tolken gebarentaal

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked why UWV introduced a new centralised invoicing system for sign-language interpreters, leaving deaf users and interpreters without timely payment, and how future communication will be improved. The state secretary acknowledges the late and incomplete notification, admits about 2400 misrouted invoices were paid, restores the old process temporarily, and promises a review with the Dovenschap, though she gives no figures on September declarations.
Up to and including 9 October, 2400 invoices that had ended up in the wrong place were traced.
Tot en met 9 oktober zijn er 2400 facturen achterhaald die verkeerd terecht waren gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht ‘Zieke niet meer aan het werk’

An MP asked the minister whether employers make it hard for chronically ill or disabled workers to return to work, whether employers are sufficiently incentivised to reintegrate sick workers, and whether methods from an APE study could help. The minister denied that the picture is confirmed by policy or evaluations, described the financial incentives and Poortwachter/WVP rules, and declined to discuss the APE study in detail because talks with social partners were ongoing.
I would be getting in the way of the social partners if I now went into this study and the reintegration methods discussed in it in detail.
Ik zou sociale partners voor de voeten lopen als ik nu uitgebreid in zou ingaan op dit onderzoek en de re-integratiemethoden die daarin aan de orde zijn gekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over camerabeelden die in het kader van het vier-ogen-principe in de kinderopvang door iedereen ingezien kunnen worden

MP Siderius asks whether unsecured internet cameras in childcare groups, viewable worldwide, are acceptable, who has viewed the footage, and what measures will be taken on camera use, privacy and procedures. Minister Asscher says such viewing is undesirable and must be prevented through secured connections, refers to the sector body's guidance, but declines to take further measures or hold data on viewers.
No, I have no data on this.
Nee, ik heb hierover geen gegevens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over bedreigingen, geweldsdelicten en brandstichtingen gericht tegen Turkse of Koerdische buurthuizen

Marcouch asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about threats, violence and arson against Turkish or Kurdish community centres, and whether Turkish-Kurdish tensions are spilling over to the Netherlands. The minister said police do not record incidents by target type so no reliable figures exist, described tensions linked to Turkey and outlined dialogue efforts and possible security measures.
The police record numbers of incidents such as threats, violent offences and arson, but do not routinely record which type of object they were directed against.
De politie registreert aantallen incidenten zoals bedreigingen, geweldsdelicten en brandstichtingen, maar registreert daarbij niet standaard tegen welk soort objecten dit is gericht.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat de Turkse premier Davutoglu mede namens zijn AK partij een brief heeft verstuurd naar Turkse Nederlanders over de Turkse verkiezingen van 1 november a.s.

An SP MP asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Social Affairs about a letter from Turkish PM Davutoglu to Turkish Dutch citizens urging a vote for the AK party, including how he obtained their data, Dutch data-protection concerns, and Turkish-language bilingual education. The government answered that political activity by foreign parties is permitted within legal limits, that the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) has requested information and its outcome awaited, and that Turkish-language primary education is not permitted.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) has sent a request for information.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) heeft een verzoek om inlichtingen uitgestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat minder nieuwkomers inburgeren

The MP Karabulut asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that integration of newcomers is stalling, including inadequate websites, unclear English-language information, and a falling pass rate. The minister replies that most integration obligees are actively pursuing their courses, that existing support via municipalities and Vluchtelingenwerk is adequate, that the pass-rate drop is partly due to the 2015 exam change, and that no additional measures are planned.
For now I see no reason to take additional measures.
Ik zie vooralsnog geen reden om aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur over Inburgering en de zijn brief over diverse onderwerpen betreffende inburgering

An MP asked the minister about a Nieuwsuur report on integration-exam barriers, the language accessibility of information for newcomers, and the fairness and pass rates of the reading-comprehension exam. The minister denied that newcomers struggle to find information, pointed to existing support and brochures in 15 languages, reported pass rates, said exam content was checked against level A2, and promised to report on exam changes after summer 2016, withholding the full research report as confidential.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat Koerden in heel Europa en ook in Nederland worden belaagd

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of attacks and threats against Kurds in the Netherlands, the government's response to Kurdish appeals for protection, and its engagement with Turkish and Kurdish organisations to prevent tensions. The minister confirmed incidents at Kurdish association buildings in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, called violence and intimidation unacceptable (leaving enforcement to police and prosecutors), and described planned dialogue meetings with Turkish and Kurdish organisations.
It is for the police and the Public Prosecution Service to act on this.
Het is aan de politie en het Openbaar Ministerie om hierop te acteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van ’t Wout en Anne Mulder over de uitspraak van het Europees Hof van Justitie dat reistijd gezien moet worden als werktijd

Two VVD MPs asked whether the European Court of Justice ruling that travel time for workers without a fixed workplace counts as working time will raise labour costs and weaken employment, and how much room it leaves for social partners and member states. The minister answered that no significant employment effect is expected in the Netherlands, that the ruling covers only workers without a fixed or habitual workplace and does not regulate pay, and that wage-setting remains with the social partners, so no national action is planned.
The ruling does not in any way limit the possibilities social partners have to make further agreements on the pay for travel time.
De uitspraak vormt geen enkele inperking van de mogelijkheden die sociale partners hebben om nadere afspraken te maken over de beloning van reistijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman en Ulenbelt over onveiligheid en beroepsziekten bij de brandweer

MPs Kooiman and Ulenbelt asked whether the government will act on a broadcast reporting that about 130 fire stations fail safety requirements and that occupational cancer risks among firefighters are poorly monitored. The minister answered that the safety regions as employers are responsible, that the Labour Inspectorate has given them six months to remedy shortcomings, and that a national 'clean work' guideline and further research are underway, while further action rests with the regions.
The Labour Inspectorate has given the safety regions 6 months to remedy the shortcomings.
De Inspectie SZW heeft de veiligheidsregio’s 6 maanden de tijd gegeven om de tekortkomingen op te heffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ulenbelt over de omstandigheden bij het Europees octrooibureau in Rijswijk en de inzet van Nederland

SP MPs asked why the Dutch representative on the EPO Administrative Council supported 2013 strike restrictions and 2015 sick-leave rules, whether Dutch privacy and labour inspection apply to the EPO, and what Netherlands is doing about labour conflict. The State Secretary answered that the rules were modelled on ILO standards, that Netherlands pushed for safeguards and review, that the Netherlands joined the Supreme Court appeal on EPO immunity, and that the social dialogue has so far produced no concrete results.
However, if it turns out that intervention by a third party, for example through mediation, is indeed desirable, I would like to commit to that, in consultation with other countries.
Als echter blijkt dat interventie door een derde, bijvoorbeeld via mediation, inderdaad wenselijk wordt, dan wil ik mij daar graag, in samenspraak met andere landen, voor inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over de schokkende uitspraken op Twitter van een persoon die werkzaam is bij een onderwijsinstelling

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked ministers about a discriminatory tweet by a school employee, rising internet discrimination reports, and whether a racism register, educational measure, and stronger reporting channel would be introduced. The government answered that online speech is protected within legal limits, cited rising MiND reports, announced an expert meeting with platforms and promised to report results in the budget debate, but rejected a racism register and a new educational measure.
I am not in favour of a separate racism register as advocated by MPs Kuzu and Öztürk.
Ik ben geen voorstander van een apart racismeregister zoals dat wordt voorgestaan door de leden Kuzu en Öztürk
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over arbeidsomstandigheden bij het Europees Octrooibureau (EOB)

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked about working conditions and reported suicides at the European Patent Office, including whether a social dialogue has improved things and whether an independent Inspectorate SZW investigation can be arranged. The Staatssecretaris answers that the dialogue is difficult and not yet producing results, that the Inspectorate lacks powers due to EPO immunity and would only inspect at the request of management, and that the Administrative Council has no independent power to order such an investigation.
The labour inspectorate is willing to carry out an inspection at the EPO should a request be received, provided management asks for it and commits to it.
De inspectie SZW is bereid een inspectie uit te voeren bij het EOB mocht een verzoek daartoe ontvangen worden vooropgesteld dat het management daarom vraagt en zich eraan committeert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over de overgangssituatie hybride WGA-markt

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Telegraaf report that employers switching back to UWV could cost hundreds of millions, and about HR advisers urging firms to exploit a gap in the WGA transition rules. The minister disputed the cost figures, called such switching undesirable, and announced a bill requiring three years of public UWV insurance before an employer can again become self-insured.
That is why in the same letter I also announced a measure to prevent this.
Daarom heb ik in diezelfde brief ook een maatregel aangekondigd om dit te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het moment van openbaarmaking van het rapport ‘Nederlandse Moslimjongeren en de Arabische herfst’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why the Motivaction report on Dutch Muslim youth was published without the additional research Motivaction reportedly advised, and whether the earlier answers still hold. The minister states that the answers remain current, that the matter was discussed with FORUM and Motivaction, that no party objected to publication before further research, and that he announced follow-up research in January 2015.
No signals were given by either party indicating that they were opposed to publication before first conducting additional in-depth research.
Er zijn geen signalen afgegeven door beide partijen waaruit is gebleken dat zij tegen openbaarmaking waren alvorens eerst aanvullend verdiepend onderzoek te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk naar aanleiding van de uitzending van Medialogica Motivaction

MPs Öztürk and others asked Minister Asscher how the Motivaction survey on Turkish-Dutch youth was published by FORUM, who had access beforehand, and whether his interview with NU.nl fuelled a hype and stigmatisation. The minister denied orchestrating the publication, said the survey was flawed and regretted its effects, but refused an external inquiry and any apology, and rejected the claim that he had sought to shape the debate.
An external investigation therefore does not seem useful to me.
Een extern onderzoek vind ik daarom niet zinvol.
Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het meerekenen van stakingsdagen bij vaststelling van het dagloon (ingezonden 11 september 2015)

MP Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether UWV will stop automatically counting strike days when setting the daily wage after a court ruling, and whether the rule should be changed. The minister answered that the court confirmed the wage was correctly calculated, that the ruling only bars retroactive reductions of WW benefits, and that he intends to amend the Dagloonbesluit while assessing implementation consequences with UWV and the Tax Authority.
During the General Consultation of 23 September on WW daily wages, I informed the House that I intend to amend the Dagloonbesluit on this point.
Tijdens het Algemeen Overleg op 23 september jl. over WW-daglonen heb ik uw Kamer gemeld dat ik voornemens ben om het dagloonbesluit hierop aan te passen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Oosenbrug over het gebruik van open standaarden in de informatievoorziening van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) en het departement van Veiligheid en Ju

MPs Gesthuizen and Oosenbrug asked whether UWV PDF documents could be read by open-source readers, what UWV's open-standards rules are, and whether the government will follow the motion favouring open standards and open-source software. The minister answered that UWV switched some letters to a more advanced PDF version that failed in open-source and mobile readers, so it reverted to simpler PDFs, and promised to inform the House on the motion's implementation.
Following these signals, UWV has meanwhile reverted to using the less advanced PDFs for the most frequently used letters to customers.
Naar aanleiding van die signalen is UWV voor de meest gebruikte brieven aan klanten inmiddels weer overgegaan op het gebruik van de minder geavanceerde PDF's.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Thieme over uitkeringsgerechtigden die vanwege ethische of gewetensbezwaren werk weigeren en hun uitkering dreigen te verliezen

An MP asked whether benefit recipients with ethical objections (such as to slaughterhouse work) can refuse jobs without losing benefits, and whether the UWV job bank CBBS should drop poultry slaughterhouse jobs. The minister answered that the law allows conscientious objection in reintegration and fitness-for-work assessments, but declined to remove the job or add ethical criteria to the CBBS.
Within reintegration, a beneficiary is obliged to accept suitable work.
In het kader van de re-integratie is een gerechtigde verplicht om passende arbeid te accepteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over de sociale dimensie van de EU

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about what a 'social dimension' of the EU means, whether it conflicts with Dutch calls for less Europe, and whether a social Eurozone group should exclude non-euro countries. The minister answered that social policy remains primarily a member-state competence, that Dutch support is limited to coordination and best-practice exchange, and that non-euro countries should not be excluded from such discussions.
Social and employment policy is primarily a competence of the member states themselves.
Sociaal en werkgelegenheidsbeleid is primair een competentie van de lidstaten zelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Potters aan over import van imams uit Marokko en Turkije en bondgenootschap met de Marokkaanse en Turkse overheid voor integratie en de-radicalisering

Two MPs asked the minister about importing imams from Turkey and Morocco, Turkish state links to mosque organisations, and cooperation with the Moroccan and Turkish governments on integration and de-radicalisation. The minister answered at length, defending continued contact with the foreign states, stating he is not in favour of foreign imams, and promising a follow-up letter on the Turkish organisations by 15 November.
I will inform you no later than 15 November about how the motion adopted at the integration debate of 2 July will be implemented, concerning follow-up research into these organisations.
Ik informeer u uiterlijk 15 november over de wijze van uitvoering van de motie die is aangenomen bij het VAO integratieonderwerpen van 2 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over een conflict tussen PostNL en zijn pakketbezorgers

MP Mei Li Vos asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about a conflict between PostNL and its parcel couriers, including the NIWO permit, the bargaining agreement, rates, and whether couriers are genuinely self-employed. The government answered that it is not a party to the conflict, was not involved in the agreement, appointed an explorer whose report is sent to parliament, and left the self-employment assessment to the Tax Authority and courts.
The cabinet is not a party to this.
Het kabinet is hierin geen partij.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Potters over het bericht ‘Integratiesubsidies weggesluisd’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that integration subsidies were diverted, including how the Moroccan-Dutch youth team and FORUM were funded, how grantees were selected and monitored, and what will be done to prevent fraud. The minister said the matter is under Public Prosecution Service investigation and recovery will await its outcome, that the ministry checks lawfulness via reports, the work plan and the accountant's statement, and that fraud can never be fully excluded.

Whether the account of the 2002 Interactieteam, funded ultimately by the Ministry of Social Affairs, was used for fraudulent purposes with the funds made available in 2014 is currently the subject of investigation by the Public Prosecution Service.

Dat de betreffende rekening van het in 2002 door de Minister voor Grote Steden- en Integratiebeleid en de Staatssecretaris van Justitie ingestelde Interactieteam met de uiteindelijk van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid afkomstige subsidiemiddelen gebruikt zou zijn voor frauduleuze doeleinden met de beschikbaar gestelde middelen van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid in 2014, is thans onderwerp van onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Integratiesubsidies weggesluisd’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that integration subsidies to FORUM were diverted to a account used for private spending, and whether fraud signals played a role in dismantling FORUM. The minister declined to comment on the fraud allegations pending a Public Prosecution Service investigation, described the timeline of the criminal complaint and the dismissal decision, and rejected a broader audit as not opportune.
Since this specific matter is under investigation by the Public Prosecution Service, I refrain from commenting on the fraud allegations raised in this report.
Aangezien deze specifieke zaak onderwerp is van onderzoek door het Openbaar Ministerie onthoud ik mij van commentaar over de beschuldigingen van fraude die geuit zijn in dit bericht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht: Artsen: 150.000 onterechte uitkeringen

The MP asks whether 150,000 disability benefit recipients receive benefits wrongly because they are not re-assessed, and how the minister will prevent a growing group of people stuck on benefits who could work. The minister rejects the 150,000 figure, defends the UWV re-assessment policy as a balanced, effective approach, and explains that re-assessments happen only when most useful.
The cited figure of 150,000 disability recipients who could be declared fit if they were simply re-assessed, I absolutely do not recognise.
Het genoemde getal van 150.000 arbeidsongeschikten die geschikt kunnen worden verklaard als zij maar herbeoordeeld zouden worden, herken ik absoluut niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het gebrek aan herkeuringen door het UWV

A CDA MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the UWV conducts too few re-assessments of WGA disability beneficiaries, citing a claim of about 150,000 wrongly paid beneficiaries. The minister gave figures showing re-assessments rising since 2011 and expected to reach at least 40,000 in 2015, but rejected the 150,000 figure as implausible and saw no need for new measures.
I do not recognise the figure of 150,000 and the UWV cannot explain this figure either.
Ik herken het cijfer van 150.000 niet en ook het UWV kan dit cijfer niet verklaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Merkies over de toename van de kloof tussen arm en rijk in Amsterdam

MPs Karabulut and Merkies asked the ministers about a report showing rising rich-poor segregation in Amsterdam, the role of the state, housing liberalisation and possible action with the municipality. Minister Asscher answered that Amsterdam ranks relatively low on segregation among the 13 cities studied, that government focuses on equal opportunities in education and the labour market, and that the municipality shares responsibility for affordable housing.

Moreover, a further study into the spatial distribution and mixing of different groups in the Netherlands is currently being carried out on behalf of the Minister for Housing and Central Government Reform.
Overigens wordt momenteel, in opdracht van de Minister voor Wonen en Rijksdienst, een nader onderzoek uitgevoerd naar de ruimtelijke spreiding en menging van verschillende groepen in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over de inkomensbescherming van slachtoffers van arbeidsongevallen en beroepsziekten

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked whether Dutch income protection for victims of workplace accidents and occupational diseases falls short of international standards, and whether the WIA meets ILO Convention 121 and whether employers take enough safety measures. The minister answers that Dutch protection compares favourably with other EU countries, that the ILO committee's 2011 findings of breaches on eight points were disputed by the previous government on six of them, and that employers and workers are encouraged through existing programmes.
With policy and inspection I will continue to encourage employers and workers to make more or better efforts on healthy and safe work.
Met beleid en inspectie blijf ik werkgevers en werknemers aansporen om meer of beter werk te maken van gezond en veilig werken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat één op de vier vaders ouderschapsverlof opneemt

MP Yücel asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that few fathers take parental leave, and whether the government would act on fathers' limited use of leave and extend paternity leave. The minister said fathers' leave-taking is rising but remains low, that the choice lies with parents, that paternity leave will be extended to 5 paid days with a bill in 2016, and that the SER advice on work and care is pending.
The cabinet has therefore decided to extend paternity leave for partners to 5 days of paid leave.
Het kabinet heeft dan ook besloten om het kraamverlof voor de partners uit te breiden tot 5 dagen betaald verlof.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Kerstens en Voortman over de risico’s voor het personeel als gevolg van de nieuwe beveiliging op Schiphol

MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of dangerous situations, overtime breaches, and poor working conditions for security staff at Schiphol after a new central security concept, and whether the tender cut hours despite rising workload. The minister said working conditions are the employer's responsibility, the Inspectorate SZW saw no reason for project research, and that Schiphol decides on tendering and contractors while the private Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag and CAO partners handle enforcement.
The Inspectorate SZW has recently not conducted any investigation into security companies at Schiphol or elsewhere in the country.
Er heeft recentelijk geen onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW plaatsgevonden naar beveiligingsbedrijven op Schiphol of elders in het land.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Burg en Potters over de opvang van geradicaliseerde meisjes en jongens in jeugdzorginstellingen

Two VVD MPs asked how many minors have been intercepted or returned from Syria or Iraq, where radicalised youths are housed, and whether separate deradicalisation facilities exist. The government answered that about 35 Dutch jihadists have returned, that radicalised youths can be placed in regular youth care without separate facilities, and that a new exit facility with tailored trajectories will open in September 2015, with more detail promised in the next progress report.
On individual cases or further breakdown, the cabinet makes no statements.
Over individuele gevallen of verdere uitsplitsing doet het kabinet geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tanamal en Kerstens over het verruimen van de regels voor vrijwilligerswerk

MPs Tanamal and Kerstens asked why unemployed people receiving WW benefits may only do traditional volunteer work, why the ANBI/SBBI status requirement applies, and how police volunteers and the Tour de France exception relate to benefit rules. The minister defended the restrictions against displacement of paid work, said the rules will be evaluated with results expected in early 2016, but did not provide quantitative effectiveness measures.
I will evaluate whether the said regulation indeed does what is intended.
Ik zal evalueren of genoemde regeling inderdaad doet wat is beoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over de overgangssituatie in de hybride Werkhervatting Gedeeltelijk Arbeidsgeschikten (WGA)

An MP asked whether transition rules for the hybrid WGA disability insurance market prevent employers from leaving the public scheme with public tail costs or switching back to private insurance after one year at the minimum premium. The minister confirmed the loopholes exist, stated that the rules apply to employers from 1 July 2015 and that the one-year exploitation effect cannot be solved without undue complexity.
However, I see no solution to this undesirable and one-time effect.
Ik zie echter geen oplossing voor dit ongewenste en eenmalige effect.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Leijten en Karalabut over het bericht dat ouderen afzien van zorg vanwege geldgebrek

MPs Leijten and Karabulut asked the ministers of health and social affairs about reports that elderly people forgo care due to money problems, including questions on rising out-of-pocket costs, dental care, municipal co-payments, and income losses for pensioners. The minister answered that no evidence shows growing numbers forgoing Wmo or Wlz care because of co-payments, that a study on care avoidance will be sent to parliament before the budget debate, and that income measures will be weighed in the August decision-making.
Research into the nature and extent of care avoidance is currently being carried out.
Op dit moment wordt nader onderzoek verricht naar de aard en omvang van zorgmijding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat sommige werkgevers zieke werknemers onbetaald in dienst houden om de ontslagvergoeding te ontlopen

An SP MP asked the minister whether employers keeping sick workers unpaid on payroll to avoid transition payments is a problem, what measures will be taken, whether UWV can track such cases, and whether the law should let such workers terminate and claim the transition payment. The minister found this not decent employment practice but considered existing rules (re-integration duties and the court route under the Wwz) sufficient, said UWV lacks data to identify such cases, and referred back to his answer on question 2 for question 4.
I do not consider additional measures necessary.
Aanvullende maatregelen acht ik niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Tanamal over de nieuwe vondst van werkgevers om de transitievergoeding te omzeilen

MPs Vermeij and Tanamal asked the minister whether employers keep sick workers on unpaid employment to avoid the transition payment, how widespread this is, its effect on reintegration and WIA benefits, and what measures the government will take. The minister said there is no sign of frequent use, that keeping employment for other reasons is legitimate, and that existing rules (court-ordered dissolution with a transition payment for serious fault) are sufficient without new measures.
I believe this is sufficient and that no additional measures are needed.
Ik meen dat hiermee kan worden volstaan en er geen aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over de voorlopige raming van het Centraal Planbureau (CPB) gepubliceerd op 11 augustus 2015 ten behoeve van de afronding van de besluitvorming over de ontwerpbegroting en het belastin

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked why pensioners and benefit recipients must bear purchasing-power losses in 2016 while workers do not, whether at least 1 billion euro can be found for pensioners, and what can be done about long-term unemployment among over-45s. The minister answered that the CPB projection is preliminary and that the cabinet will weigh the full purchasing-power picture in August decision-making, presenting outcomes on Prinsjesdag, and listed existing measures and unemployment statistics for older workers.
The overall purchasing-power picture for the coming year is then weighed and the cabinet takes measures where necessary, within the available budgetary room.
Daar wordt het integrale koopkrachtbeeld voor het komende jaar gewogen en treft het kabinet zo nodig, binnen de beschikbare budgettaire ruimte, maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Tellegen over het bericht ‘terrorist sprak in moskee’

Two VVD MPs asked why authorities were not informed about a convicted terrorist speaking at a mosque in Geleen, and what the government would do against mosque boards inviting such speakers, including whether mosques should be closed and whether a blacklist of hate preachers is appropriate. The government declined to discuss specifics of information sharing, said mosque boards inviting speakers with intolerant messages is unacceptable, pointed to criminal prosecution and the local triangle, and said no blacklist exists but an alerting list maintained by the NCTV for visa assessment.
No statements can be made publicly about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Gerven over "de (h)erkenning van endometriose"

MPs Siderius and Van Gerven asked whether endometriosis is grounds for UWV to refuse sickness benefit or disability assessment, and why Netherlands has not formally recognised it as an illness. The government answered that a diagnosis alone does not determine entitlement; the insurance physician assesses functional limitations, guided by an international ESHRE guideline, and that recognising diseases is the task of professional bodies, not the state.
Recognising illnesses is not a government task.
Het erkennen van ziekten is geen overheidstaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ark en Van ‘t Wout over het bericht ‘ Timmermans wil Brusselse afspraken om meer vrouwen aan het werk te helpen’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the EU should regulate women's labour participation and work-care balance, and whether the government would resist such regulation. The minister answered that the Commission is only at the roadmap and consultation stage, that subsidiarity applies, that work-care division is primarily a matter for partners, and that the government will inform Parliament via BNC fiches and a planned SER advice and 2016 consultation.
On these proposals and the Dutch position on them, the cabinet will inform you in due course in the usual way via BNC fiches.
Over deze voorstellen en het Nederlandse standpunt daarover zal het kabinet u te zijner tijd op de gebruikelijke wijze via BNC fiche(s) informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het bericht dat het vaderschapsverlof verlengd moet worden

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch paternity leave (2 days paid, 3 days unpaid) is too short compared with other European countries, and whether a paid extension to ten days would be considered. The minister acknowledged Dutch leave is below average, pointed to other arrangements for combining work and care, and said a further extension is desirable but gave no commitment on new measures, referring to a pending SER advice.
An extension of leave at the birth of the child is therefore desirable.
Een verruiming van het verlof bij de geboorte van het kind is dan ook wenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht dat het Uitvoeringsinstitituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) fraudemeldingen opzij legt

An MP asked whether UWV leaves fraud reports older than twenty weeks unexamined, whether a large backlog should prompt more rather than less enforcement, and how this fits with the priority on black-work fraud. The minister replied that UWV triages signals by actionability, that about 3,000 old external reports were re-assessed and 140 of them will be investigated, and that black-work fraud remains a priority.
UWV decided to remove about 3,000 old external reports from the backlog, which its risk analysis judged would likely yield little.
UWV heeft besloten om circa 3.000 externe, oude meldingen waarvan UWV op basis van risicoanalyse heeft beoordeeld dat deze waarschijnlijk weinig opleveren, uit de werkvoorraad te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het stimuleren om aan het werk te gaan door werken vanuit de WW lonend maken

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether unemployed people should be encouraged to work by making work pay from WW benefits, why the new income offset applies only to new WW claimants from 1 July 2015 rather than existing ones, and whether similar offsets should apply to other benefits. The minister answered yes to the principle, said existing WW rights are respected for technical implementation reasons with one exception for overlapping benefits, and promised to inform parliament after the summer on other benefits.
Your House will be further informed about this topic after the summer.
Uw Kamer wordt na de zomer over dit onderwerp nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het onderzoek naar jodenhaat onder islamitische jongeren

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Minister of Social Affairs about research on antisemitism among Muslim youth, including a 12% negative view of Dutch Jews, and contrasting surveys. The minister said the study finds no inherent link between Islam and antisemitism, rejected the Motivaction survey as methodologically flawed, and pointed to school-based prevention measures.
The research provides no support for the view that antisemitism is inherent to Islam or to Muslims in the Netherlands.
Het onderzoek levert geen ondersteuning voor het beeld dat antisemitisme inherent is aan de islam of moslims in Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het schrappen van een boete voor ‘illegaal’ werk door de rechtbank Zeeland-West Brabant

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a court ruling that struck down fines for illegal work by Bulgarian and Romanian workers, and about its consequences, the transitional labour regime and measures against exploitation. The minister said the state has appealed, the question is pending before the Council of State, the transitional regime is justified by high unemployment, and listed further anti-abuse measures.
I have therefore lodged an appeal against the aforementioned ruling.
Ik heb dan ook hoger beroep ingesteld tegen de voornoemde uitspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dijkgraaf en Ulenbelt over het feit dat Inretail een principeakkoord fashion en sport heeft gesloten met Alternatief voor vakbond

MPs Dijkgraaf and Ulenbelt asked whether a collective agreement between Inretail and the small union Alternatief voor vakbond could set terms for most workers in the sector, how extension (avv) is assessed, and how disproportionate effects can be prevented. The minister answered that such agreements bind non-members only indirectly, that membership numbers play little role in representativeness, that extension is discretionary and can be refused, and that the government does not decide which unions should sign.
In principle it is not for the Minister to "intervene" in collective agreements or to have a view on their content.
Het is in principe niet aan de Minister om «in te grijpen» in cao’s of om een oordeel te hebben over de inhoud daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Oproep tot ‘jihadbendes’ in Europa

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the ministers of Interior, Security and Justice, and Social Affairs about a report of calls for Muslim 'jihad gangs' in Europe, including calls to arm, attack police and recruit children, and whether the NCTV's dismissal of the material was adequate, and asked whether Islam is a problem requiring 'de-Islamisation'. The government answered that it takes jihadist violence seriously under its integrated action programme, that the NCTV rightly labelled the material jihadist propaganda with no reason to revise that view, and that Islam enjoys the same constitutional and human rights protection as other religions.
The cabinet takes the threat posed by violent jihadism extremely seriously.
Het kabinet neemt de dreiging die van het gewelddadig jihadisme uitgaat uiterst serieus.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over zieke werknemers die samen met de FNV aangifte doen tegen hun werkgever

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about sick workers filing criminal complaints against their employer over occupational health rules, and whether the Labour Inspectorate had investigated the company over the past ten years and would make its findings available. The minister answered that workers may report to police, that the Inspectorate visited the company three times in ten years, that its findings can be viewed confidentially by the House, and that it has now started an investigation into how workers are protected against hazardous substances.
The Inspectorate has now started an investigation into how workers are currently protected against the hazardous substances present.
De Inspectie is inmiddels een onderzoek gestart naar de wijze waarop werknemers nu worden beschermd tegen de aanwezige gevaarlijke stoffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht “EU: Wij willen meer politieke islam in Europa”.

PVV MPs asked the government whether it agrees with EU foreign policy chief Mogherini's claim that Islam belongs in Europe, whether the EU endangers national identity, whether Netherlands should leave the EU, and whether she should be expelled to Saudi Arabia. The minister answered by citing EU treaty values and the Charter on religious freedom, rejected leaving the EU and rejected the expulsion request.
No. The cabinet considers continued membership of the European Union to be in the direct interest of Dutch citizens and businesses.
Nee. Het kabinet acht blijvend lidmaatschap van de Europese Unie in het directe belang van Nederlandse burgers en bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht 'Arabisch op Blerickse scholen'

PVV MPs asked whether Arabic lessons in Dutch primary schools should be stopped, arguing the language is irrelevant and linked to radicalisation. The minister rejected these claims and stated that schools may offer Arabic as an extracurricular activity, while within school hours only English, German and French (plus Dutch and Frisian) are legally permitted.
Within school hours, primary schools are legally permitted to offer only English, German and French, alongside Dutch (and Frisian in Friesland).
Binnen de onderwijstijd is het in het basisonderwijs wettelijk alleen toegestaan de talen Engels, Duits en Frans aan te bieden, naast het Nederlands (en het Fries in Friesland).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van ’t Wout over de fraude met en ineffectiviteit van Europese subsidies ten behoeve van sociale inclusie van Roma

An MP asked the ministers about a broadcast alleging waste and fraud in EU subsidies for Roma social inclusion in Romania, and whether the subsidies should be halted and recovered. The government said it relies on existing EU control rules, awaits the European Court of Auditors' investigation, and will not yet demand recovery of the subsidies.
The government, however, does not have specific (control) data on the projects mentioned in the broadcast or any controls on them.
Het kabinet beschikt echter niet over specifieke (controle-)gegevens over de in de uitzending genoemde projecten en eventuele controles daarop.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Van Nispen over een uitzending van Brandpunt waaruit blijkt dat miljoenen aan EU-subsidies voor kwetsbare groepen niet goed terecht komen

SP MPs Van Bommel and Van Nispen asked, following a Brandpunt broadcast, why EU subsidies meant for Roma and Sinti were spent improperly, who checks such projects, and whether the EU should prevent this rather than create a European Public Prosecutor. The government answered that the Roemenian authorities and the Commission are responsible for spending and control, that a full audit chain exists, that new 2014-2020 rules stress performance, and that withdrawing subsidies and a European Prosecutor are distinct tools, while declining to judge specific projects before audits conclude.

Before the cabinet can make statements about a specific case or individual project, it is important to await further investigation by the responsible bodies (in this case the European Commission and European Court of Auditors).

Voordat het kabinet uitspraken kan doen over een specifieke casus of een individueel project, is het van belang om nader onderzoek door de verantwoordelijke instanties (in dit geval de Europese Commissie en Europese Rekenkamer) af te wachten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over de beslissing van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) om een uitkeringsgerechtigde vrijwilligerswerk als chauffeur op de buurtbus te verbieden, terwijl een

Our MP Voortman asked follow-up questions about a UWV ban on a jobseeker volunteering as a bus driver while bijstand recipients may do so, and whether the 2015 WW volunteering rules change will be evaluated. The minister answers that the rules aim to give WW recipients more room for volunteering while preventing displacement of paid work, and commits to an evaluation with results to parliament by early 2016.
I am willing to evaluate whether the said regulation indeed does what is intended.
Ik ben bereid om te evalueren of genoemde regeling inderdaad doet wat is beoogd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de uitvoering van de motie-Van Weyenberg om de aanmeldtermijn voor de vrijwillige verzekering te verlengen

MP Van Weyenberg asked the minister why he has not announced implementation of the adopted motion to extend the enrolment period for voluntary disability insurance to at least 26 weeks, despite his earlier objections. The minister acknowledges the motion and its adoption but declines to give an implementation date, saying the cabinet will address it in its response to the interdepartmental policy study on self-employed workers after the summer.
Despite the fact that the motion was adopted by a large majority of the House, I cannot yet inform you about the implementation of the motion.
Ondanks het feit dat de motie is aangenomen door een ruime meerderheid van de Kamer, kan ik u nu nog niet informeren over de uitvoering van de motie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Arbeidswet bedreigt Nederlandse speelfilms”

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs about planned changes to the rules exempting children from the child labour ban for film, television, musical and ballet work, including a cut from 24 to 18 performance days and limits on two shows per day, and how these compare with other countries and sports schools. The Minister answered that practice has outgrown the rules, that the aim is clarity and a child-first approach, that the proposal counts days rather than performances, that consultation responses are still being assessed, and that no negative experiences are known.
I am currently studying the input and intend, insofar as relevant, to invite parties to further explain their input.
Ik bestudeer thans de inbreng en heb het voornemen, voor zover relevant, partijen uit te nodigen voor een nadere toelichting op hun inbreng.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over het bericht dat er grote onrust is onder schoonmakers van de Roeterseilandcampus (Universiteit van Amsterdam)

Two SP MPs asked ministers about reports of unrest among cleaning staff at the UvA Roeterseiland campus after a new contract with cleaning firm Hago, raising workload, intimidation, procurement quality and possible Arbowet violations. The minister says the UvA and the contractor are in constructive talks with staff, has added temporary cleaners and more time, sees no basis yet to judge Arbowet breaches, and says the Inspectorate would investigate any complaints received.
If the Inspectorate SZW receives complaints from the works council about violations of the Working Conditions Act, the Inspectorate SZW will investigate these complaints.
Als de Inspectie SZW klachten ontvangt van de OR vanwege overtredingen van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet, dan zal de Inspectie SZW deze klachten onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voortman en Van Meenen over het bericht UvA probeert CAO te omzeilen

MPs Voortman and Van Meenen asked whether the University of Amsterdam planned to circumvent the new collective labour agreement by avoiding conversion of temporary contracts into permanent ones, as suggested in a leaked email. The minister answered that the executive board rejects such circumvention, will comply with the CAO and Wwz in letter and spirit, and has created an individual-rights ombudsperson whose opinions are binding, while noting the email was one employee's idea rather than university policy.
The Executive Board of the UvA has explicitly distanced itself from the idea that it plans to circumvent the new CAO Universiteiten.
Het College van Bestuur van de UvA (CvB) heeft laten weten nadrukkelijk afstand te nemen van het idee dat het van plan is de nieuwe CAO Universiteiten te omzeilen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de aanhoudende onrust in de Schilderswijk

Two MPs asked whether the government shares outrage over riots in The Hague's Schilderswijk after a death in custody, whether it will distance itself from racism accusations against police, how many rioters were arrested and how damage will be recovered, and why the mayor allegedly failed to restore order and whether a curfew and marechaussee deployment will be pressed. The minister answered that the Rijksrecherche investigation is ongoing and cannot be commented on, that 246 suspects were arrested, that municipal damage is EUR 77,600 with recovery being explored, and that the mayor acted as competent authority and did not fail.
Since the investigation into the acts of violence is still ongoing, the number of arrested suspects may increase further.
Het onderzoek naar de geweldplegingen nog in volle gang is, kan het aantal aangehouden verdachten verder oplopen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over de berichten ‘Boete voor wachtende chauffeurs’ en ‘Verstopt tussen bloemen en wasmachines; Hoek van Holland geliefde startplaats gelukszoekers’

MPs Hoogland and Kerstens asked whether truck drivers are fined under driving and rest-time rules although the stowaway problem at Calais and Hoek van Holland makes compliance unreasonable, and what is being done about port controls and infrastructure. The government says enforcement of rest times is a priority, that exceptional situations allow deviation, that the minister has raised concerns with the EU Commissioner and French and British counterparts, and that enhanced intelligence-led controls by the Marechaussee are in place without infrastructure measures for now.
It is up to the carrier to draw up a schedule within the limits of this regulation.
Het is aan de vervoerder om binnen de grenzen van deze regelgeving een planning te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Marcouch over allochtone studenten die volgens de stagemonitor minder stagevergoeding krijgen en vaker moeten solliciteren voor ze een stageplek vinden

MPs Jadnanansing and Marcouch asked whether the National Internship Monitor shows that students with foreign-born parents receive lower internship pay, must apply more often, and get lower grades, and whether this amounts to discrimination, and what institutions and employers should do. The minister answers that the monitor shows more applications and lower pay for this group but cannot establish systematic differences or discrimination given sample and confounder gaps, acknowledges possible discrimination as a serious concern, and points to existing policy programmes and a forthcoming ROA study without committing to new concrete action.
On the basis of this monitor I cannot establish whether allochtone students are discriminated against in internships.
Op basis van deze monitor kan ik niet vast stellen of allochtone studenten worden gediscrimineerd bij stages.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het bericht ‘Excuses om weigeren vrouw met nikab in bus’

An MP asked whether a bus driver who refused a woman wearing a niqab was right, whether staff may refuse face-covering clothing before a ban exists, and whether the government will defend such staff. The government answered that a ban on face-covering clothing in education, care, government buildings and public transport is being prepared, that no legal ban exists yet, and that the driver breached company rules and the company apologised.
No, at this moment there is no legal ban on face-covering clothing, and under the carrier's company rules the niqab wearer should have been treated the same as all other passengers.

Nee, op dit moment is er geen wettelijk verbod op gezichtsbedekkende kleding en volgens de bedrijfsregels van de vervoerder had de niqaab draagster op dezelfde manier behandeld moeten worden als alle andere reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Schut-Welkzijn en Ziengs over het bericht “Negen manieren om je als zzp-er goedkoper te verzekeren”

Three VVD MPs asked the ministers whether the disability insurance market for self-employed workers offers enough cheaper 'adapted' policies, whether rules or advice obligations block them, and whether the 13-week registration deadline for voluntary insurance should be extended. Minister Asscher replied that many options exist, that no legal barriers are known, that the AFM sees room for better advice, and that extending the deadline is not favoured because of adverse selection, promising to return to the issue after the IBO zzp.
In the context of the IBO zzp and the Weyenberg motion, I will return to the insurability of the disability risk.
In het kader van het IBO zzp en de motie Weyenberg 3 , zal ik terugkomen op de verzekerbaarheid van het arbeidsongeschiktheidsrisico.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Pieter Heerma over de uitspraak van de burgemeester van Hilversum, die “de noodzakelijke emancipatieslag voor moslims” waarnaar wordt verwezen, vergelijkt met “emancipatiebeweging

CDA MPs asked the ministers about the Hilversum mayor's comparison of Muslim emancipation with the Catholic labour movement, and whether such statements and radicalisation figures were appropriate. The minister answered that the mayor may freely express his opinion, that the city council has already received his explanation, and that national agencies monitor departures to Syria/Iraq and inform municipalities when needed.
In addition, administrators are accountable to a representative body.
Daarnaast zijn bestuurders verantwoording schuldig aan een vertegenwoordigend lichaam.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over sociale uitkeringen voor Nederlanders woonachtig in illegale nederzettingen in bezet Palestijns gebied

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked whether the government will apply the Wet BEU consistently to Dutch residents of Israeli settlements in occupied Palestinian territory, in line with 2002 policy, and whether the SVB's position on the territories is correct. The government answered that the new AOW policy is consistent with the 2002 position: current recipients keep the single-person AOW up to 70% of the minimum wage, while from 1 January 2016 new single recipients in occupied areas receive the married-person norm of 50%.
This decision will be published and communicated as soon as possible.
Dit besluit zal zo spoedig mogelijk worden bekendgemaakt en gecommuniceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht 'Bewijs voor onderbetaling bouwvakkers aan Sontbrug'

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of underpayment of construction workers at Sontbrug and Groningen Forum, and about the role of the Labour Inspectorate and contracting authorities under the new anti-sham-construction law. The minister answered that the Inspectorate runs an average eight-month investigation process on union requests, that contracting authorities are expected to address misconduct through contracts, and that a civil procedure may follow for the Groningen case.
My ministry will do what is necessary to support them in this.
Mijn ministerie zal het nodige doen om hen daarbij te ondersteunen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht 'Rector Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam ziet Joods Armeens complot tegen Erdogan en AKP'

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government about inflammatory statements by the rector of the Islamic University Rotterdam and what oversight bodies and the ministers would do. The minister says she has lost confidence in the rector, that the inspectorate's enhanced supervision continues, and that she will use a planned legal power to act once the bill takes effect, which is expected late this year.
At present I myself have no legal means to take further measures.
Zelf heb ik op dit moment geen juridische middelen om verdere maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over discriminatie door de Inspectie SZW

An MP asked the minister about discrimination by the Inspectie SZW after the Raad van State annulled an inspection decision because identity checks were triggered by dark hair and skin tone, and whether such practices are standard. The minister condemned the remark, said it is not an inspection method or risk indicator, and announced training, a written instruction and the start of a discrimination inspection team.
This case gives rise to the following measures.
Deze zaak geeft aanleiding om de volgende maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hoogland over het bericht ‘Angstcultuur bij vervoersbedrijf Hermes’

MPs Kerstens and Hoogland asked about reports of a fear-based culture at bus operator Hermes, the government's responsibilities, and whether concession-holders can be selected on social criteria. The minister replied that the report is not yet published, that personnel policy is the operator's responsibility, that the province and Inspectie SZW can act if concession terms or labour law are breached, and that social aspects may be included in tenders within legal limits.
At this moment the report has not yet been published, so it is not yet known what the facts are regarding the corporate culture of bus operator Hermes.
Op dit moment is het rapport nog niet gepubliceerd en is het dus nog niet bekend wat de feiten zijn rondom de bedrijfscultuur van het vervoersbedrijf Hermes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een extremistische moslimprediker in Almere

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a preacher linked to jihadist groups, invited by an Almere mosque, could be stopped from spreading extremist messages in the Netherlands, including via visa refusal and revoking the mosque's ANBI tax status. The minister answered that the preacher holds Belgian nationality so no visa applies, that he cannot be pinned to jihadism, that non-visa preachers can be addressed through criminal law, and that ANBI status can be withdrawn without legislative change if activities conflict with the public interest.

Regarding non-visa-required preachers who call for hatred and violence, the letter of 3 March stated that if they lawfully reside in the Schengen area, they can be assessed on the message they spread during their stay.

Ten aanzien van niet-visumplichtige predikers die oproepen tot haat en geweld is in de brief van 3 maart gesteld, dat indien zij rechtmatig in het Schengengebied verblijven, zij beoordeeld kunnen worden op de boodschap die zij tijdens hun verblijf uitdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kerstens over de conclusie in een Europese rapport dat er wijdverbreid in de EU ernstige uitbuiting van werknemers plaatsvindt

MPs Maij and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an EU FRA report finding widespread severe labour exploitation, and what the government will do about enforcement, victim protection, the Posted Workers Directive and EU action. The minister accepts the risk sectors, declines to estimate prevalence, and outlines training, prevention, enforcement, victim support and planned EU initiatives, including the Dutch EU Presidency priorities.
The report, however, makes no statements about the extent of labour exploitation.
Het rapport doet echter geen uitspraken over de omvang van arbeidsuitbuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Agema en De Graaf over het reclamespotje van Stichting Moslimpleegkind

PVV MPs asked whether the government would stop a recruitment ad by Stichting Moslimpleegkind that implies white parents are poor foster carers and promotes Islam. The state secretary replied that foster placements are carefully screened and that the Jeugdwet requires considering a child's religious and cultural background, and that diversification campaigns exist, but declined to judge the interpretation of the ad and did not commit to stopping it.
Furthermore, it is not for me to judge the interpretation of a commercial by Stichting Moslimpleegkind.
Verder is het niet aan mij om een oordeel te hebben over de interpretatie van een reclamespotje van de Stichting Moslimpleegkind.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over werken als zelfstandige in relatie tot een WW-uitkering (artikel 8 WW)

An MP asks whether WW unemployment benefit should be permanently reduced when benefit recipients work as self-employed, leaving them without full benefit even after reducing self-employed hours, and whether the law should change. The minister defends the current hours-offset system as a worker insurance rule, points to the starter scheme, and refuses to change the law.
No, I am not willing to do that.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over 375 ontslagen bij FrieslandCampina in Beilen en Leeuwarden

An MP asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about 375 layoffs at FrieslandCampina in Beilen and Leeuwarden, including the lack of early notice to local government and plans for reemployment. The minister answered that the company's internal decision-making comes first, that the sector and regional plans support job transitions, and that the Dutch Dairy Chain programme continues unchanged.
I trust that FrieslandCampina will actively, together with the parties involved such as the trade unions and regional governments, work to help employees move from job to job.

Ik heb er vertrouwen in dat FrieslandCampina zich actief, samen met de betrokken partijen als de vakorganisaties en de regionale overheden, zullen inzetten om werknemers van werk naar werk te begeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Potters over het bericht dat de invloed van ultraorthodoxe moslims in Nederlandse moskeeën toeneemt

MPs Tellegen and Potters asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and Social Affairs about reports that ultra-orthodox Muslim influence in Dutch mosques is growing, and how mosque boards could better resist radical influences and prevent salafist ideas spreading among Dutch-speaking preachers. The minister answered that the government is religiously neutral but combats active intolerance in concrete cases, that a NCTV/AIVD analysis of salafism will follow after the summer, and that the AIVD has observed increasingly audible intolerant voices.
Within a democracy, all persons and groups are bound by the applicable frameworks of the democratic legal order.
Binnen een democratie zijn alle personen en groepen gehouden aan de geldende kaders van de democratische rechtsorde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over een uitspraak van de rechter over het al dan niet korten van de ZVW-premie op de WW-uitkering

MP Ulenbelt asked whether a court ruling on whether ZVW contributions should be deducted from a WW benefit gives reason to change the law. The minister declined to amend the law, arguing gross income netting is standard and a change would increase administrative costs.
I see no reason to change this gross-gross offsetting.
Ik zie geen aanleiding deze brutobruto-verrekening te wijzigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Siderius over het bericht dat het toelatingsbeleid in Amsterdam scholen weer zwart maakt

Two SP MPs asked how the government responds to reports that Amsterdam admission policy is re-segregating schools, and about funding for parent initiatives to mix schools. The State Secretary answered that schools' quality matters, that existing disadvantage measures apply, that school mixing by ethnicity is not desired at national level, and that the only role for municipalities is the statutory annual consultation on segregation.
I see no further role for the national government.
Ik zie geen verdere taak weggelegd voor de rijksoverheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het algemeen verbindend verklaren van de cao Besloten Busvervoer

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs why article 48 of the Besloten Busvervoer collective agreement was declared generally binding without clarifying that it does not apply to self-employed contractors, as a Tilburg court ruled, and how enforcement distinguishes sham self-employed from genuine ones. The minister answered that the generally binding declaration includes the explanatory interpretation in the decree, that the court ruling and CJEU case law guide its scope, and that the FSO enforces the agreement, with no change to the text required.
Article 48 of the Besloten Busvervoer collective agreement was declared generally binding with due regard to the considerations made about that article in the general-binding decree.
Artikel 48 van de cao Besloten Busvervoer is algemeen verbindend verklaard met inachtneming van de overwegingen die ten aanzien van dat artikel in het avv-besluit zijn gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Ulenbelt over ongelukken in praktijklokalen op vmbo-scholen

MPs Siderius and Ulenbelt asked why safe machine use in vmbo practical rooms remained non-compliant in 64% of inspections since 2009, what measures were taken, how many pupils and teachers were harmed, how many fines and closures occurred, and whether unsafe rooms would be closed directly. The minister answered that schools bear primary responsibility, listed sector support measures, reported fines (6 in vmbo, 2010-2014), and said inspections show schools improving, so immediate closure was not planned.
According to the Inspectorate, schools that did not have health and safety in order are now on the right track in improving safety.
Volgens de Inspectie zijn de scholen die de gezondheid en veiligheid niet op orde hadden inmiddels op de goede weg bij het verbeteren van de veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Weekcontracten: de nieuwe schijnconstructie van uitzendbureaus’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that staffing agencies use rolling weekly contracts to get around the chain-contract rule, which ends in a permanent contract after a set period. The minister answered that no law or collective agreement is broken, explained how the 26-week period and the Wwz changes work, and said structural work should preferably be done under a direct permanent or fixed-term contract rather than through agency contracts.
I cannot infer from this that the law or the collective agreement has been violated.
Ik kan hieruit niet opmaken dat in strijd met de wet of de cao is gehandeld.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid De Graaf over het feit dat 64,2% van de in Nederland woonachtige Turken bij de laatste Turkse parlementsverkiezingen op de islamitische AK-partij van president en wannabe-sultan Erdogan hee

The PVV MP De Graaf asked whether it is known that 64.2% of Turkish voters in the Netherlands voted for Erdogan's AKP, and what this means for integration, citing Erdogan's statements on sharia, minarets and mosques under Diyanet supervision. Minister Asscher answered that the statements are no basis for judging integration, that voting freely is acceptable, that he will raise transparency and possible Turkish influence with Turkey and religious organisations, and that he will inform parliament.
Where there is group pressure in any way, I consider that undesirable and inappropriate.
Wanneer er sprake is van groepsdruk op welke manier dan ook, vind ik dat ongewenst en ongepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over het opleggen van een werkstraf aan een uitkeringsgerechtigde vanwege het niet opgeven van vrijwilligerswerk

MP Schouten asks whether a benefit recipient given a community-service sentence for not reporting unpaid volunteer church work should prompt a review of the anti-fraud law, and whether guidance to volunteers should be improved. The Secretary of State answers that no review is needed because volunteering involves no income so cannot be fraud, though failing to report it can breach reporting duties, and sees no reason for new guidance with municipalities.
I see no reason in this context to examine how the fraud law works.
Ik zie in dit verband geen reden om naar de werking van de fraudewet te kijken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een bijstandsgerechtigde is veroordeeld tot een voorwaardelijke gevangenisstraf vanwege vrijwilligerswerk

Karabulut (SP) asked the minister whether it is acceptable that a welfare recipient doing unpaid volunteer work received a suspended prison sentence, and how this fits with the principle that recipients should influence their voluntary activities. The state secretary answered that welfare obligations such as the duty to inform apply, that the case appears to involve prolonged non-disclosure above the prosecution threshold for the public prosecutor and courts, and that fine levels should reflect severity and culpability, with the Fraud Act amendments to be submitted to the Council of State before summer 2015.
I am of the view that the height of the fine must be tailored to the seriousness of the violation, the degree of culpability and the circumstances of the case.
Ik ben van mening dat de boetehoogte moet zijn afgestemd op de ernst van de overtreding, de mate van verwijtbaarheid en de omstandigheden van het geval.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Aukje de Vries, Van der Linde en Anne Mulder over bericht “proef flexwerkershypotheek uitgebreid”

VVD MPs asked whether the perspective-statement pilot for flexworkers and self-employed mortgage applicants should be broadened and made permanent, and whether mortgage rules should change. The Minister replied that the pilot falls within existing rules (Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet), that current rules already allow tailored assessments, and that no regulatory change is planned.
The approach taken with the perspective statement falls within the current possibilities of the Temporary Regulation on Mortgage Credit.
De gevolgde werkwijze met de perspectiefverklaring valt binnen de huidige mogelijkheden van de Tijdelijke regeling hypothecair krediet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Leerwerkplekken in de knel door ontslagregels’

D66 MPs asked whether apprenticeship (BBL) contracts are exempt from the chain-employment rule and the transition payment, and how the transition payment affects training places. The minister answered that BBL contracts are exempt from the new chain rule, that they are not exempt from the transition payment but employers may deduct training costs under a new decree, and that the effect on training places will be monitored.
This has partly led the cabinet to decide, by general administrative order, that training costs may be deducted from the transition payment.
Dat heeft er mede toe geleid dat het kabinet heeft besloten om bij amvb te bepalen dat kosten van de opleiding in mindering kunnen worden gebracht op de transitievergoeding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers, Potters, Oskam en Karabulut over het bericht dat een omstreden sjeik naar Eindhoven komt

MPs from ChristenUnie, VVD, CDA and SP asked ministers whether a controversial sheikh who was to visit Eindhoven had received a visa, how entry bans and SIS alerts work, whether the mayor and foreign partners were consulted, and whether a list of hate preachers exists. The government answered that the Italian visa was withdrawn so the sheikh may not stay in the Netherlands, that the mayor consulted the NCTV, that entry-ban and SIS procedures are explained in general terms, and that an alert list of preachers is in use but numbers are not disclosed.
I cannot provide any information on the number of persons on this list.
Over het aantal personen op deze lijst kan ik geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Omstreden haatsjeik donderdag naar Eindhoven’

Two PVV MPs asked whether a cleric calling for throat-cutting and skull-smashing should receive or keep a visa, and whether the Al Fourqaan mosque should be closed for hosting him. The government answered that Italy issued and then withdrew the visa so the speaker may not stay in the Netherlands, and that closing a building is only possible for building-safety violations, drug trade, or if the organisation's aims breach public order, while criminal incitement is prosecuted by the Public Prosecution Service.
This speaker therefore may not reside in the Netherlands.
Deze spreker mag dan ook niet in Nederland verblijven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bezoek van weer een haatsjeik, ditmaal aan een moskee in Helmond

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether a preacher who allegedly called for violence against Jews, Christians and Shiites should be allowed to speak at a Helmond mosque and whether his visa and the mosque should be blocked. The government answered that free speech is limited when incitement to hatred or violence threatens public order, that visas are refused to preachers calling for hatred, and that after local consultation the mosque cancelled the invitation.
By refusing visas to preachers from visa-requiring countries who call for hatred and violence, the government seeks to temper polarisation and radicalisation.
Door middel van het weigeren van visa aan predikers uit visumplichtige landen, die oproepen tot haat en geweld, tracht de overheid polarisering en radicalisering te temperen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over ‘Portugese timmerlieden Waalbrug jarenlang onderbetaald’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that Portuguese carpenters on the Waalbrug project were underpaid through a staffing agency with questionable history, including whether government as client should check certification, exclude the firm, and whether the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies would have prevented this. The minister answered that certification gives no guarantee and is not checked during contract execution, that exclusion grounds exist and new EU-based rules are being implemented, that the new law would have given workers joint liability and payment controls, and that the Binnenhof renovation tender will follow current rules.
I am not aware whether checks were carried out on these construction projects.
Het is mij niet bekend of controle bij deze bouwprojecten is uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Klever en Wilders over het bericht 'Medische raad bij ramadan'

Three PVV MPs asked whether patients who fast during Ramadan knowingly endanger their health and whether insurers should bear the extra advice and care costs of those who become medically unstable. Minister Schippers answered that the Health Insurance Act requires care decisions to rest on care-content criteria, that she does not intend to amend it, and that no registrations exist to determine the extra costs.
I am not aware of any records from which these extra costs could be derived without further ado.
