Er zijn mij geen registraties bekend waar deze extra kosten zonder meer uit af te leiden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Lucas en Anne Mulder over het bericht 'Leerwerkplekken in de knel door ontslagregels'

MPs Lucas and Anne Mulder asked whether the transition payment (transitievergoeding) under the new dismissal rules would discourage employers from offering learn-work places (leerwerkplekken) in vocational education, and whether apprentices should be excluded. The government answered that the payment applies in principle to apprentices, but employers may deduct training costs from it under an order in council, and it promised to consult social partners on collective agreements and to evaluate a pilot combined learning route.
At the same time, it is of course not intended that the introduction of the transition payment leads to fewer learn-work places being offered.
Tegelijkertijd is het uiteraard niet de bedoeling dat de introductie van de transitievergoeding leidt tot het aanbieden van minder leerwerkplekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Verhuur sloopwoningen lonend voor Avenue2’

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that a subcontractor charged excessive rent for housing to underpaid workers, and whether the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies would stop such deductions. The minister said the deductions are too high and he dislikes employers profiting from worker housing, but explained the law only requires payment of the statutory minimum wage in full and does not prohibit deductions above it, relying on enforcement and social partners.
Legislation alone, however, is not enough to tackle abuses.
Wetgeving alleen is echter niet genoeg om misstanden aan te pakken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht ‘Analyse financiering moskeeën gestaakt’

An MP asked the ministers whether Rand Europe's study on foreign financing of mosques was blocked by non-cooperation and what would be done to obtain the missing information. The government replied that the feasibility study used only public data, that some mosques are not obliged to publish accounts until 2016, and that it will pursue a transparency register and diplomatic and local engagement rather than new compulsory powers.
Islamic institutions were therefore not approached to provide information that was not already public.
Islamitische instellingen zijn dus niet benaderd om informatie te geven die niet reeds openbaar was.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het bericht ‘Leerling naar huis door invallerlimiet’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why school boards still resist replacing teachers despite the Wwz flexibility options, and whether the Wwz's entry into force in primary education should be delayed if the PO-Raad and unions fail to agree by 1 July 2015. The minister answers that board reactions stem from unfamiliarity with Wwz options, that the current CO primary education cao continues until 1 July 2016 under transitional law, and that boards may keep existing temporary-contract and min/max arrangements until then.
Reports from the PO-Raad and the unions of 1 May show that the parties have agreed not to conclude a new primary education collective agreement at this time.
Uit de berichtgeving van de PO-Raad en de bonden van 1 mei jl. blijkt dat partijen hebben afgesproken om op dit moment geen nieuwe cao voor het primair onderwijs af te sluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de reportage ’Rust rond de wieg’

MP Yücel asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a TV report claiming the Netherlands ranks with Guatemala and Rwanda on parental leave, whether a comparative study was underway, and whether leave should be extended to support infant care. The minister rejected the comparison, pointed to a pending SER advisory report on work and care, said parental leave choice is for parents, and ruled out extending leave or introducing baby leave for now.
I expect to receive the SER's advice at the end of the year.
Ik verwacht het advies van de SER aan het einde van het jaar te ontvangen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht ‘Sociaal rechercheurs slaan alarm: bijstandsfraude loont’

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about social investigators' claim that benefit fraud pays and that large fraudsters go unpunished. The minister partly disagreed, pointed to existing civil and criminal sanctions, cited an Inspectorate report on uneven municipal enforcement, and described meetings with the LCSR and funding for municipal guidance and a national address-quality investigation.

Research by the Inspectorate SZW shows that some municipalities do this well and act in line with the Fraud Act, while a number give priority to terminating benefits and make no effort to recover overpayments.
Uit onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW 2 blijkt dat er gemeenten zijn die dat goed doen en conform de Wet aanscherping handhaving en sanctiebeleid SZW-wetgeving (Fraudewet) handelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het heroverwegen van boetes die op grond van de te versoepelen Fraudewet zijn opgelegd

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether municipalities should reconsider fines imposed under the Fraud Act, now being relaxed, and whether the minister would ask implementing bodies not to reopen final fine decisions. The minister answered that municipalities may reconsider decisions at their own cost but that there is no legal obligation to reopen final fines, and that doing so would create a precedent and be costly.
There is no legal obligation to reassess previously imposed fines against which no remedy (objection or appeal) remains open.
Er is geen juridische verplichting om eerder opgelegde boetes waar geen rechtsmiddel meer tegen open staat (bezwaar of beroep) opnieuw te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de vermeende Sharia-driehoek in de Schilderswijk in Den Haag

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the alleged 'Sharia triangle' in The Hague's Schilderswijk, a 2013 Trouw story later found fabricated, and about stigmatisation of the neighbourhood and hate letters to residents. The minister says the article was false and Trouw dismissed the journalist, but sees no need for new measures beyond existing integration policy.
I see no need to take additional measures, but will instead continue to work on implementing existing initiatives and actions.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om extra maatregelen te nemen, maar zal mij juist in blijven zetten voor de uitvoering van bestaande initiatieven en acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over concrete ervaringen van discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked ministers about a reported case of a qualified Moroccan-origin applicant being rejected in favour of a less experienced candidate, and about discrimination in hiring generally. The government answered that complaints go to the College voor de Rechten van de Mens, courts or police, that the Inspectie SZW only supervises employer anti-discrimination policy and not recruitment, and that it set up a new team on labour-market discrimination without committing to a wider role.
No police records specifically on discrimination in job applications can be derived from the police systems.
Aan de politiesystemen zijn geen aangiftecijfers specifiek over discriminatie bij sollicitaties te ontlenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over concrete ervaringen van discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports that a man was turned away by police when trying to file a discrimination complaint after applying for jobs under different names. The minister acknowledged the officer wrongly refused the report, said police contact him for a new appointment, and stated that complaints must be taken seriously and officers are trained on discrimination law.
When he told the police station that he had applied under different names, the police officer wrongly stated that they could not take a report about this.

Toen hij op het politiebureau vertelde dat hij onder verschillende namen heeft gesolliciteerd, heeft de betrokken politieambtenaar ten onrechte aangegeven dat zij hier geen aangifte over op kon nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over een beloningsanalyse door adviesbureau Focus Orange en het Financieel Dagblad

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp 2014 pay rise of listed-company CEOs compared with modest wage growth for average earners, and what could be done about it. The minister called the gap undesirable, urged firms to align top pay with shop-floor wages, and announced an amendment to the Works Councils Act requiring an annual pay-ratio discussion between board and works council, while declining to explain pay-setting decisions in firms.
The Works Councils Act (WOR) will be amended for this purpose.
De Wet op de ondernemingsraden (WOR) zal daartoe worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over "screening door de SVB van ouderen met een Turkse achtergrond op buitenlandse bezittingen"

MP Öztürk asked whether the SVB's assets-abroad checks on AIO recipients, which since 2013 include people with Turkish background, amount to discriminatory screening, and asked about costs, cross-border investigation methods, and privacy safeguards. The State Secretary answered that all AIO recipients are checked in rotating annual batches by country of origin, that the checks are lawful and cost-effective, that no commercial parties are used, and that no discrimination is involved.
I see no conflict with Article 1 of the Constitution.
Ik zie geen strijd met artikel 1 van de Grondwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat de helft van de Somaliërs in de bijstand zit

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government shares concern about the over-representation of Somalis in welfare, schooling and crime statistics, whether current immigration and integration policy is failing, and whether Australia's immigration model should be adopted. Minister Asscher replied that integration is primarily the responsibility of immigrants, that the government keeps a restrictive asylum policy bound by international obligations, that it does not accept the policy is failing, and that regional reception is preferred but a full Australian-style model is complicated and hard to realise.

The cabinet acknowledges that migrant arrivals can bring important challenges, including in integration, but does not share that this leads to the conclusion that current immigration and integration policy is failing.

Het kabinet onderkent dat de komst van migranten belangrijke uitdagingen met zich mee kan brengen, mede op het terrein van integratie, maar deelt niet dat daaruit de conclusie kan worden getrokken dat het huidige immigratie- en integratiebeleid faalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Utrecht vreest komst Belgische martelsjeik’

PVV MPs asked why a Belgian sheikh with alleged terrorist links and torture-related convictions was offered a visa for an Utrecht event, and whether the Al Fitrah foundation and its mosque should be dissolved or closed and a blacklist of hate preachers created. The government answered that the sheikh did not attend and held lawful residence in Belgium, that no visa was issued to him, that dissolution or closure is not warranted given free speech limits enforced through criminal law, and that no blacklist exists though an NCTV alert list and Schengen alerts are used.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Recourt over "het flitsfaillissement bij Princen Transmission"

MPs Kerstens and Recourt asked the ministers about the Princen TransMission flash bankruptcy, the pre-pack method, the alleged selection of workers by health records, and whether the planned bankruptcy fraud law should address this misuse. Minister Asscher answered that pre-pack is a court practice aimed at preparing bankruptcy, that dismissal protection is lost through bankruptcy rather than pre-pack, that the curator and judge-commissioner should safeguard creditors including workers, and that a study on workers in bankruptcy will be sent before summer.
I will send that study to your House before the summer.
Dat onderzoek zal ik voor de zomer aan uw Kamer toezenden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bouw van een nieuwe moskee in Gouda

An SP MP asked the ministers of Security and Justice and Social Affairs whether a 2014 meeting report on a mosque complex in Gouda showed the government helping segregate women in public space, and whether the report was removed from the municipal website. The minister answered that the report remains online, that segregation by sex is undesirable, and that the planned physical separation of the entrance was requested by a special school and day-care centre for their pupils, not to separate men and women.
The report of 8 May 2014 is known to me. The report was made public by the municipality of Gouda and can still be found on the municipality's website.
Het verslag van 8 mei 2014 is mij bekend. Het verslag is door de gemeente Gouda openbaar gemaakt en is nog altijd terug te vinden op de website van de gemeente Gouda
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Aukje de Vries aover het artikel “Verzekeraar kansloos in concurrentie met het UWV”

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Aukje de Vries asked whether the unequal playing field between the UWV and private insurers under the WGA hybrid system, and the UWV's reassessment and independence practices, were acceptable. Minister Asscher answered that the government monitors the system, is analysing premium adjustments, and will inform parliament before the summer recess, but declined to answer nine questions in time for the scheduled debate.
At present I am examining whether and how the premium setting at the UWV can be adjusted to improve the balance in the hybrid market.
Op dit moment onderzoek ik of en op welke manier de premiestelling bij het UWV aangepast kan worden om zo het evenwicht op de hybride markt te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij en Voordewind over het korten van het pensioen van een holocaustoverlevende, omdat zij woont op de West Bank

MPs Van der Staaij and Voordewind asked why a Dutch Holocaust survivor's AOW pension was cut after she moved to the West Bank, and whether it would be reversed and prevented in future. The government answered that the cut was based on the Wet BEU and Israel's lack of treaty competence in occupied territory, that the SVB has reversed the decision, and that people living in occupied areas will keep 70% AOW from now on, while from 1 January 2016 new single residents there will get the 50% rate.
The cabinet regrets how matters unfolded. For the person concerned, the situation has now been corrected and she has been informed of this.
Het kabinet betreurt de gang van zaken. Voor betrokkene is de situatie nu aangepast en zij is daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Segers over het bericht ‘Gezamenlijke ketenactie tegen arbeidsuitbuiting en mensenhandel’

MPs Van Laar and Segers asked about a joint enforcement action against labour exploitation and trafficking on Bonaire, including how few addresses were checked, why action came only now, victim shelter, and prostitution policy. The minister reported no arrests and no finding of underpayment or exploitation, promised recurring joint checks at least four times a year, and said a revised MoU is expected in June 2015.
Agreements have been made to act jointly at least four times a year, with prostitution being one of the sectors that will regularly be checked.
Er zijn afspraken gemaakt om ten minste vier keer per jaar gezamenlijk op te treden waarbij prostitutie een van de sectoren is die regelmatig zullen worden gecontroleerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht “Kritiek op aanpak radicalisering”

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked the government how it responds to criticism of its approach to radicalisation, the role of schools, the causes of radicalisation including discrimination, and whether schools can get specialist social workers. The government answered that schools play preventive, curative and repressive roles, describes existing support such as a hotline, training and the Stichting School en Veiligheid, rejects a dedicated social worker in every school as a matter of tailored support, and notes that research on causes is ongoing.
We have taken note of the criticism.
Wij hebben kennis genomen van de kritiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat er drie ultraorthodoxe sjeiks uit België in Utrecht komen spreken

Two MPs asked the ministers about reports that three ultra-orthodox Islamic preachers from Belgium would speak in Utrecht, including whether a preacher had a criminal conviction, the visa status of speakers, the foundation alFitrah's role and its recognition as a training company, and its subsidies and ANBI status. The government answered that free speech is protected and the event was not licensable, that the preacher named was not present and visa/criminal information could not be checked under the Schengen rules, that alFitrah is recognised as a training company only by the vocational education centre and the placement is being reassessed, and that the foundation received no subsidies and has no ANBI status.
Requesting this information is only possible insofar as it is in the interest of combating future criminal offences
Het opvragen van deze informatie kan alleen voor zover dat in het belang is ter bestrijding van toekomstige strafbare feiten

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over de uitspraak van een lid uit een coalitiefractie dat de korpschef van de Nationale Politie er goed aan doet sollicitanten te checken op PVV-achtige opvattingen

Two PVV MPs asked whether a coalition MP's remark that the police chief should screen job applicants for PVV-like views was acceptable and whether he would distance himself from it. The government answered that selecting applicants on political views is not permitted under the Constitution and the ECHR, that political affiliation plays no role in selection, and that it would not judge individual MPs' opinions.
Selecting applicants on political views is not permitted under Article 1 of the Constitution, Article 14 of the European Convention on Human Rights and other treaties.

Het selecteren van sollicitanten op politieke opvattingen is niet toegestaan op grond van artikel 1 van de Grondwet, artikel 14 van het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens en andere verdragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Oskam over het bericht ‘Utrecht vreest komst Belgische martelsjeik’

Two MPs (Segers and Oskam) asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that Utrecht feared a visit by a Belgian preacher and about possible blacklists, visa measures, and cooperation against hate preachers. The minister answered that the local triangle found no legal grounds to act, that no blacklist exists though an alerting list is kept, and that the answers on intelligence and foreign contacts are limited.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Merkies en Karabulut over het bericht dat de vermogensongelijkheid in Nederland recordhoogtes bereikt

MPs Merkies and Karabulut asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Finance about reports that wealth inequality in the Netherlands had reached record levels, and whether the government would act to reduce it. The minister replied that the CBS figures show rising wealth concentration mainly due to falling house prices, that the government sees no need for action since social security cushions risks, and that it will keep monitoring wealth distribution.
The cabinet therefore attaches no consequences to the current development in wealth distribution, but will continue to follow wealth distribution in the coming years.
Het kabinet verbindt daarom geen consequenties aan de huidige ontwikkeling in de vermogensverdeling, maar blijft de vermogensverdeling de komende jaren wel volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een radicale prediker naar Almere

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether the government knew of a radical preacher's arrival in an Almere mosque, whether his anti-Western, jihad-linked message should be countered, and how security services and municipalities coordinate on such preachers. The minister acknowledged the preacher's past inflammatory statements, said the message undermines social cohesion, noted that the AIVD investigates only individuals or organisations posing a threat rather than mosques generally, and pointed to existing cooperation with municipalities under the jihadism action programme.
The AIVD does not monitor mosques in general, but investigates persons or organisations for which there are indications that they pose a threat to the democratic legal order and/or national security.

De AIVD houdt niet moskeeën in algemene zin in de gaten, maar doet onderzoek naar personen of organisaties waarover aanwijzingen bestaan dat zij een bedreiging vormen voor de democratische rechtsorde en/of staatsveiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over de komst van radicale sjeiks naar Utrecht

An SGP MP asked whether radical preachers were given a platform in Utrecht, whether one was convicted for inhuman treatment and another linked to the Hofstad investigation, whether visas, permits and Schengen travel restrictions apply, and how they are monitored. The government answered that the local tripartite found no criminal or administrative ground to act, that one speaker was not present, that a visa was issued only to one visa-required speaker, that the event needed no permit, and that visa withdrawal and criminal prosecution remain available, so no change to Schengen rules is planned.

The local tripartite in Utrecht, based on police investigation and consultation with the National Coordinator for Counterterrorism and Security (NCTV), concluded there was no criminal or administrative ground to act.

De lokale driehoek in Utrecht heeft op basis van politieonderzoek en na overleg met de Nationaal Coördinator Terrorismebestrijding en Veiligheid (NCTV) de conclusie getrokken dat er geen strafrechtelijke of bestuurlijke grond was om op te treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijkerken-de Haan en Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht “Fraude loont”

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that welfare fraud goes unpunished, including inconsistent enforcement by municipalities, the criminal reporting threshold, the recovery rate of fraud fines, and a Rotterdam court ruling on information duties for suspects. The minister acknowledged the concern, said municipalities must apply the law and that he will keep raising enforcement with the VNG and municipalities, and gave partial answers, noting that national data on recovery and benefit termination are not available.
The cabinet does not have a national picture.
Het kabinet beschikt niet over een landelijk beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over het bericht 'Klagende' Polen niet meer op bouwplaats'

An MP asked whether the minister would investigate why Polish construction workers who had complained about low wages at the Deventer city hall site no longer worked there, and whether they had been underpaid. The minister said an assessment requires fact-finding, that the Inspectorate SZW's special team on sham constructions will look into the situation and is considering an investigation, but will not comment on ongoing inspections.
The Inspectorate SZW will, with its special team dealing with sham constructions, look into the situation and is considering a possible investigation into the facts and circumstances.
De Inspectie SZW zal zich met het speciale team dat zich bezig houdt met de aanpak van schijnconstructies op de hoogte stellen van de situatie en beraadt zich op een eventueel onderzoek
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over "Drama oude werklozen"

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister of Social Affairs about a newspaper piece on rising long-term unemployment among older job seekers, and whether a dedicated agenda, wage-cost relief, or ICT training should be adopted. The minister replies that existing measures such as the mobility bonus, proefplaatsing and the 50pluswerkt action plan are effective, promises to monitor them and report in autumn, but rejects the wage-cost reduction and broad ICT training as ineffective and costly.
In the autumn I will inform the House again about the progress of these measures.
In het najaar zal ik de Kamer opnieuw informeren over de voortgang van deze maatregelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt over het artikel “Werkgevers klagen over ‘straf’ op sociaal plan

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked whether the RVU levy on voluntary early-retirement severance payments discourages employers from using voluntary schemes and pushes toward forced dismissals, and whether the rules should be relaxed. The state secretary answered that the levy applies only outside objective criteria, that a 10% efficiency margin applies to voluntary schemes, and that the government will not relax the levy because it has raised average retirement age, though it denied that the Tax Authority tightened its advance-ruling practice.
Within the package of labour market measures, the cabinet does not consider it desirable to relax the RVU levy.
Het kabinet vindt het binnen het pallet van arbeidsmarktmaatregelen niet wenselijk de RVU-heffing te versoepelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Marcouch over radicalisering in de Somalische gemeenschap

An MP asked the ministers about radicalisation in the Somali community, including returns to Somalia and whether Dutch Somalis radicalise there. The minister said no return figures or reasons are systematically recorded, radicalisation abroad cannot be ruled out, and prevention work such as the POLRAD project is ongoing.
The reasons for their return are not recorded by the government, because there is no ground or reason to do so.
De redenen voor hun terugkeer worden niet door de overheid geregistreerd, omdat hier geen grond of aanleiding voor is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de berichten dat mantelzorgers overbelast raken

An MP asks whether working carers overburdened by combining paid work with caregiving face health risks and what barriers and remedies exist. The minister answers that intensive caregiving raises reported health complaints and sick leave, cites prevention campaigns, expanded leave rights from July 2015, and an upcoming SER advisory request and awareness campaign.
Government policy is therefore aimed at preventing people from becoming exhausted and overburdened by combining work and care and subsequently possibly stopping work.
Het kabinetsbeleid is er dan ook op gericht te voorkomen dat mensen door de combinatie van werk en zorg oververmoeid en overbelast raken en vervolgens mogelijk stoppen met werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pechtold, Van Haersma Buma, Slob, Van Ojik, Van der Staaij en Roemer over het bed, bad, brood compromis

MPs from several parties asked the government to explain its reliance on the Council of Europe's Committee of Ministers resolution rejecting the ECSR findings on basic provision for irregular migrants, the conditional 'bed, bath, bread' shelter scheme tied to return cooperation, the funding and sanction mechanism for municipalities, and the buitenschuld permit system. The government answered that the ECSR findings have no basis in the treaty, that Article 3 ECHR sets the floor, that shelter in pre-VBL locations will be time-limited and tied to return efforts, and that details will be settled with the VNG.
It is not for the ECSR to pronounce on the rights of persons residing illegally in our country.
Het is dan ook niet aan het ECSR om zich uit te spreken over de rechten van illegaal in ons land verblijvende personen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de beslissing van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) om een uitkeringsgerechtigde vrijwilligerswerk als chauffeur op de buurtbus te verbieden, terwijl een

An MP asked the minister why UWV barred an unemployment-benefit recipient from volunteering as a bus driver while a social-assistance recipient may do similar volunteer work, and whether this inconsistency is undesirable. The minister declined to comment on the individual case, explained the criteria for volunteering with retained WW benefit (non-commercial organisation, allowance below the tax-office cap of 150 euro per month), and said that municipalities and UWV are responsible for supervising these rules.
It is not for me to go into individual cases.
Het is niet aan mij om in te gaan op casuïstiek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht dat het UWV vrijwilligerswerk verhindert

MP Pieter Heerma (CDA) asked whether the UWV (employee insurance agency) blocks unemployed people receiving WW benefits from doing volunteer work, such as driving a neighbourhood bus under a municipal participation project, and how this fits with earlier promises of more flexibility. Minister Asscher replied that UWV assesses volunteer work case by case under the rules, that the rules were loosened from 1 January but remain restricted to non-commercial organisations to prevent displacement of regular workers, and that he sees no reason to change them.
It is up to the UWV to apply the rules in concrete situations.
Het is aan het UWV om de regels in concrete situaties toe te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Otwin van Dijk over "gedwongen zzp-erschap bij Sensire"

MPs Kerstens and Otwin van Dijk asked the ministers about reports that care provider Sensire wanted to dismiss 600 home-care workers and rehire them as self-employed, questioning whether this amounts to disguised self-employment and whether unions should be involved. Minister Asscher answered that pressuring employees into self-employment is undesirable, that UWV and courts assess individual cases, that UWV refuses dismissal permits where the aim is to avoid employee status, and pointed to the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies and the 2013 action plan.
In general terms, it is for the courts to assess the facts and circumstances of the individual case and rule on them.
In algemene zin is het aan de rechter om de feiten en omstandigheden van het individuele geval te beoordelen en daar een uitspraak over te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Siderius over de financiële en sociale gevolgen van de wet hervorming kindregelingen voor de kinderalimentatie

Two SP MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice, Social Affairs and Finance about the financial and social effects of the Wet hervorming kindregelingen on child maintenance, including whether recipients lose out and whether the scheme leads to conflicts and a flood of maintenance cases. The minister answers that most recipients gain, that effects depend on individual cases, that the Raad voor de rechtspraak expects some extra change requests, and that no compensation is planned.
The exact consequences for child maintenance depend heavily on the facts and circumstances of a specific case.
De exacte gevolgen voor kinderalimentatie zijn sterk afhankelijk van de feiten en omstandigheden in een specifiek geval.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt (over het wetsvoorstel „Hervorming Kindregelingen” waarin het woord alimentatie in de memorie van toelichting slechts een keer voorkwam en wel in de artikelsgewijz

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked the government about the Hervorming Kindregelingen bill, its limited treatment of child maintenance (alimentatie), the promised standard calculation rule and advice from the judiciary, and the effects on divorced parents' incomes. The minister replied that the Raad voor de rechtspraak advice is attached, that existing alimentatienormen serve as the basis, that parents can seek advice from the Juridisch Loket, mediators or lawyers, and that a further analysis of the bill's consequences was being prepared, without providing a new calculation tool.
I asked the Council for the Judiciary to advise on the House's request to develop a standard calculation rule for child maintenance.
Ik heb de Raad voor de rechtspraak gevraagd advies uit te brengen over het verzoek van de Tweede Kamer om te komen tot een standaardrekenregel inzake de berekening van kinderalimentatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Nispen en Ulenbelt over het niet respecteren van de rechten van vakbonden

MPs Van Nispen and Ulenbelt asked whether the European Patent Organisation in The Hague violates union rights, and why Dutch bailiffs were ordered not to enforce a court ruling against it because of its immunity. The minister said he cannot confirm the alleged conflict, that immunity rules mean the court ruling cannot be enforced in the Netherlands, that internal appeal routes exist, and that the Netherlands will raise the matter with the organisation and its governing council.
The cabinet cannot make substantive statements about court rulings.
Het kabinet kan inhoudelijk geen uitspraken doen over gerechtelijke uitspraken.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Potters en Duisenberg over de aanpak van radicalisering en de rol van het onderwijs, en de gezamenlijke verklaring van de EU-onderwijsministers in Parijs van 17 maart 2015

Two VVD MPs asked why radicalisation is framed within school social safety, why the minister signed the EU education ministers' Paris declaration without consulting parliament, and why the declaration omits explicit condemnation of radical ideology and EU democratic values, and who is responsible for follow-up. The minister answered that the approach is an integrated, sector-specific one, that parliament was informed in advance and a debate is offered, that the preamble stresses shared EU values, and that follow-up goes to the OJCS Council with subsidiarity as the guiding principle.
Your House was informed in advance of my intention to attend the conference in Paris to sign the declaration.
Uw Kamer is vooraf geïnformeerd over mijn voornemen om bij de conferentie in Parijs aanwezig te zijn om daar de verklaring te tekenen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Oskam over de taak van gemeenten in relatie tot radicalisering en uitreizende jihadisten

MPs Heerma and Oskam asked how municipalities are supported by central government in tackling radicalisation and jihadist departures, including the expert unit and the claim that municipalities lack clarity. The minister replied that the expert unit became operational in February 2015 and is being built up, that a range of support tools exist, and that a 10-point plan was drawn up for municipalities.
Central government assists municipalities in preventing radicalisation and managing social tensions.
Het Rijk staat gemeenten bij in de preventie van radicalisering en de beheersing van maatschappelijke spanningen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Jan Vos over de brandveiligheid van windmolens

Two PvdA MPs asked about fire safety of wind turbines after a fire at Ooltgensplaat, and whether investigations were still pending. The government answered that forensic, fire brigade and labour inspectorate investigations are ongoing, with results expected around summer 2015, and that the Chamber will be informed of outcomes.
Publication of the reports will follow as soon as possible, insofar as the Public Prosecution Service does not object because of criminal law aspects.
Publicatie van de rapportages volgt zo spoedig mogelijk, voor zover het Openbaar Ministerie dit niet bezwaarlijk acht vanwege de strafrechtelijke aspecten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Gouds bestuur lost vrouwenkwestie op’

Two PVV MPs asked whether a planned wall separating women from view of Muslims in a Gouda redevelopment amounts to sharia-based apartheid, and whether the government will ban mosque construction and the planned Gouda mega-mosque. The minister answered that the wall is a site-entrance separation requested by a special school and a child day-care centre, and that the mosque has offered to reduce its size, with an independent facilitator starting a new consultation; he reiterated that Muslims may build mosques within zoning rules and the law.
The mosque board of the new mosque planned in Gouda recently (mid-March) offered to substantially reduce the size of the mosque.
Het moskeebestuur van de nieuw te bouwen moskee in Gouda heeft recent (half maart) het aanbod gedaan om de moskee qua omvang substantieel te verkleinen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de megamoskee in Gouda

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a Gouda mega-mosque: a reported refusal to host a crèche due to women, the planned layout, foreign financing, and whether democratic local decision-making is being bypassed. The government answered that the layout plan keeps the school and daycare on site, that foreign financing was checked (0.05% from other Schengen countries), that property decisions are a local responsibility, and that foreign financing of places of worship is not to be banned in principle.
This is and remains a local responsibility.
Dit is en blijft een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het bericht dat er een scheidingsmuur wordt gebouwd bij het Goudse moskeecomplex

Two MPs asked whether a dividing wall at the Gouda mosque complex, to block visual contact between mosque visitors and women, undermines gender equality and sends the wrong signal, and what the government will do. The minister replied that equality is a core value, that the separation is a local design request from co-tenants, that the mosque has offered to shrink, and that the matter is a local responsibility, and he rejected the view that newcomers must adapt or leave.
This is and remains a local responsibility.
Dit is en blijft een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over het steeds moeilijker worden van het bouwen van moskeeën

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is becoming harder to build mosques, whether parking concerns should block them, and whether political climate and fear of Islam drive opposition. The minister answers that objections are a legal right decided by municipalities, that freedom of religion covers worship in any building, and that existing anti-discrimination initiatives suffice without new measures.
I see no need to take additional measures, but rather want to continue working on implementing existing initiatives and actions.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om extra maatregelen te nemen, maar wil mij juist in blijven zetten voor de uitvoering van bestaande initiatieven en acties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het bericht dat de gemeente Arnhem zelfstandigen zonder personeel (zzp)-schijnconstructies creëert

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the municipality of Arnhem dismissed civil servants and rehired them as self-employed contractors, and what the government thinks of such bogus self-employment. The minister declined to judge the individual case, said such practices are undesirable and that combating sham self-employment is a government priority, and pointed to the 2013 action plan and the newly adopted Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies.
As Minister of SZW, I cannot make statements about individual cases.
Als Minister van SZW kan ik geen uitspraken doen over individuele casus.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht "Uitzendbureau werkt onderzoek Arbeidsinspectie tegen"

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that a temp agency obstructed an Inspectorate investigation into underpayment at construction projects in Groningen, and about contractor responsibility. The minister answered that clients must ensure lawful supply chains, that the pending Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies adds chain liability, that the agency's SNA certificate was withdrawn, and that the evaluation of self-regulation is expected before summer.
I do not make statements about a specific case.
Over een specifieke casus doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de bouw van een moskee in Gouda

An SP MP asked ministers about foreign financing, the role of imam Tarik ibn Ali, possible salafist involvement, and the mosque's gender separation and segregation effects in Gouda. The government answered that the municipality commissioned a PWC audit finding 0.05% of funds from two other Schengen countries, that the Bibob advice is pending, and that the mosque's size and related decisions are a local responsibility.
I cannot make statements about individual ongoing investigations.
Over individuele (lopende) onderzoeken kan ik geen uitspraken doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Straus en Anne Mulder over de gevolgen van de nieuwe Wet werk en zekerheid (Wwz) voor het onderwijs

MPs Straus and Anne Mulder asked whether the new Wwz limit of three flexible contracts would cause problems replacing teachers and substitutes in primary and secondary education, and whether a sector exception to the chain rule was needed. The minister answered that substitution remains feasible through internal flexibility, substitute pools, on-call and min/max contracts, and cao deviations, so no sector exception is needed, though he will provide information and help find solutions.
An exception for education is therefore not necessary.
Een uitzondering voor het onderwijs is daarom niet nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het effect van de Wet Werk en Zekerheid op invalkrachten in het primair onderwijs

D66 MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Wwz labour law reform leaves primary schools without enough flexibility to cover sick-leave substitutes, and what guidance schools received. The minister said schools were informed via newsletters, listed available flexibility instruments (substitute pools, zero-hours and min/max contracts, CAO derogations), and stated pool membership and sizing figures while acknowledging it is not exactly determinable how large pools should be.
To let the transition around the amendment of the chain provision proceed smoothly, I have therefore also committed to providing information to education
Om de overgang rondom de wijziging van de ketenbepaling vloeiend te laten verlopen heb ik daarom ook toegezegd om voorlichting te geven aan het onderwijs
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt over kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked whether a working father whose wife is in a nursing home in a coma can receive childcare allowance for his three children, and whether divorce or municipal social-medical support could solve this. The minister confirmed no entitlement under current rules, pointed to municipal social-medical indication (SMI) support and contact already made with the municipality, and rejected amending the childcare act.
I understand that first contact between Mr K. and his municipality to find a solution has now been made.
Ik heb begrepen dat het eerste contact tussen de heer K. en zijn woongemeente om tot een oplossing te komen inmiddels is gelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de belangenverstrengeling in verband met de megamoskee in Gouda

An MP asked whether two PvdA council members' ties to the Gouda megamosque (fundraising, a school directorship, a board member brother) amount to conflict of interest, and whether an inquiry should be requested. The minister replied that council members may choose their own contacts, that the Gemeentewet's rules were not breached, and that any inquiry is a matter for the Gouda municipal executive.
The question of whether it is necessary to launch an inquiry into the case outlined lies with the Gouda municipal executive.
De vraag of het al dan niet noodzakelijk is om een onderzoek in te stellen naar de geschetste casus ligt bij het gemeentebestuur van Gouda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bevallingsverlof dat per dit jaar flexibel kan worden ingezet

An MP asked the minister whether most workers were unaware of the new flexible leave rules in force since 1 January 2015 and what information campaign was planned. The minister replied that information was already distributed via websites, press releases and intermediaries, and that a broader campaign would start in May 2015.
In May an information campaign starts.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat bijna twee op de drie docenten in het voortgezet onderwijs getuige zijn van moslimdiscriminatie in de klas

MPs Karabulut and Jasper van Dijk asked about a report finding that 61% of secondary school teachers witnessed discrimination of Muslims in class, its rural-urban pattern, and whether more education on homosexuality and Islam is needed. The minister says discrimination is taken seriously, points to existing support tools (SLO, Centrum School en Veiligheid, teacher training efforts) and an ITS study on teacher needs, without committing to new measures.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Keijzer, de Rouwe en Pieter Heerma over de mantelzorgboete

MPs from the CDA asked the ministers about the AOW cost-sharing norm, the municipal rules and evidence required for exempt mantelzorg (care-related) dwellings, and related questions on house numbers and social security treatment. The government answered that the AOW household norm is postponed to 1 July 2016 with a report on care effects expected before summer 2015, that municipalities assess mantelzorg needs with open-ended evidence, and that social security uses the actual living situation rather than the building rule.
The decision-making on the cost-sharing norm in relation to its effects on informal care is expected to be sent to your House before summer 2015.
De besluitvorming over de kostendelersnorm in relatie tot de effecten op mantelzorg zal naar verwachting voor de zomer van 2015 naar uw Kamer worden gezonden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Smaling over berichtgeving omtrent het schandaal bij AquaPurga in Den Bosch

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary of Economic Affairs and the Minister of Social Affairs about working conditions, health risks, subsidies, and liability at manure processor AquaPurga following press reports. The government answered that it cannot disclose individual inspection or bankruptcy information, found no known health risks to residents, and stated that liability for workplace health damage lies between employer and employee, with courts deciding if they disagree.
The Labour Inspectorate does not make the results of an inspection at an individual company public.
Inspectie SZW maakt de resultaten van een inspectie bij een individueel bedrijf niet openbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het onderzoek ‘Nederland en de islam: onbegrepen en moeizaam’

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the minister about an EO survey finding widespread lack of contact with Muslims, perceived threat and negative views, and what government will do about Islamophobia and integration. The minister answered that the EO poll's robustness is unclear, pointed to the SCP and SIM research and to anti-discrimination initiatives, and gave Eurobarometer comparisons while denying integration policy has failed.
There is no insight into the robustness of the results of the survey conducted by the EO.
Er is geen zicht op de robuustheid van de resultaten van de peiling die is uitgevoerd door de EO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Jaarcontract niet verlengen bij ziekteverlof’

An MP asked whether insurers may condition sickness-absence insurance on not renewing fixed-term contracts of sick employees, and whether the minister will engage insurers. The minister replied that contract renewal is for employer and employee, that insurers may set coverage conditions which reportedly lapse after 28 days of full work, and declined to talk to insurers, noting they usually negotiate with employers.
Insurers should not interfere in that.
Verzekeraars dienen daar niet tussen te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bashir en Karabulut over de ANBI-status van Stichting Rohamaa

MPs Bashir and Karabulut asked why the ANBI status of Stichting Rohamaa was granted, whether it complies with transparency rules and international law, and whether it should be revoked and the ANBI list cleaned up. The government answered that the status was granted in 2011 under neutral criteria, declined to discuss the specific case citing legal confidentiality, said status can be revoked if an entity no longer serves the general interest, and stated the Tax Administration conducts risk-based supervision of about 65,000 ANBIs.
I cannot make any statements about the specific aspects of granting the ANBI status to Stichting Rohomaa on the basis of the statutory duty of confidentiality.
Over de specifieke aspecten van het verlenen van de ANBI-status aan Stichting Rohomaa kan ik geen mededelingen doen op grond van de wettelijke geheimhoudingsplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Rebel over het bericht dat actiegroep "Zij Is Hier" een pand kraakt voor de opvang van kwetsbare en verborgen vrouwen

MPs Yücel and Rebel asked about a women's shelter set up by activist group Zij Is Hier in a squatted building in Amsterdam Nieuw West, whether abandoned women with insecure residence status can access municipal shelters, and what measures and human rights ambassadors could provide. The state secretary answered that the municipality could not verify the number of occupants, that eight people were later housed in Nieuw West, that Amsterdam shelter options remain available regardless of residence status, and that trained volunteers could be deployed on rights and referral.
At our request, the municipality of Amsterdam sent us a factual account of the report that an activist group had squatted a building in Amsterdam.
De gemeente Amsterdam heeft ons op ons verzoek een feitenrelaas doen toekomen over het bericht dat een actiegroep een pand heeft gekraakt in Amsterdam.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Mohandis over de aanpak van radicalisering en de handelingsverlegenheid van scholen om de actualiteit naar aanleiding van de gebeurtenissen in Parijs bespreekbaar te maken in d

MPs Marcouch and Mohandis asked how the government addresses radicalisation and why schools struggle to discuss the Paris attacks in class, including training, teaching materials and teacher education. The minister answers that schools are expected to act on their civic mandate, that training and portals exist, that a Jihadism intervention team is being discussed with municipalities, and that further studies and reports will follow.
We will return to this in the spring when we report on progress on citizenship education.
Wij zullen hier nader op ingaan als we in het voorjaar rapporteren over de voortgang op burgerschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat moeders minder zijn gaan werken door de bezuiniging op de kinderopvang

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that mothers worked less after the childcare subsidy cut, and about the conflicting findings of the CBS and CPB analyses. The minister explained methodological differences, said participation has moved in line with the general population, and promised to inform parliament on any additional measures in the budget.
I will inform you about this during the budget debate.
Ik informeer u hierover bij begroting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het verbeteren van de mogelijkheden voor zzp'ers om zich te verzekeren tegen arbeidsongeschiktheid

An MP asked why self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers) have low uptake of voluntary sickness and disability insurance through UWV, why access is limited to former employees, and why the 13-week enrolment deadline exists. The minister said UWV has improved information without planned additional measures, explained the restriction as continuation of prior coverage and the risk of adverse selection if the deadline were extended or access widened, and said the cabinet's IBO on zzp'ers will address the issue and be sent to parliament before summer.
The cabinet expects to present the IBO to the House of Representatives before the summer.
Het kabinet zal het IBO naar verwachting voor de zomer aanbieden aan de Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Rebel over de dood van de Rotterdamse Yasmeen Dad

MPs Yücel and Rebel asked the ministers about the death of Yasmeen Dad, who lived in isolation, and whether police had signals of her oppression and what help exists for such women. The minister says criminal investigation limits disclosure, refers to police methods for honour-related violence and to the Rotterdam pilot with community key figures, and does not commit to a new investigation.
Beyond that, no statements can be made because of the interests of investigation and prosecution connected to the criminal investigation into this case.
Voor het overige geldt dat geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging die verbonden zijn aan het strafrechtelijk onderzoek naar deze zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de samenwerking tussen de Haagse politie en een salafistische moskee

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked why the Hague police again cooperated with the salafist As-Soennah mosque in the New Year's Eve neighbourhood project, and whether this partnership should be ended given the mosque's views. The minister answered that participants, including mosques, act under police supervision within legal limits with no more powers than ordinary citizens, and that the local authority sees no reason to end the cooperation.
The participants do so under police supervision and within the framework of the law, and have no more powers than any other citizen.
De deelnemers doen dat onder toezicht van de politie en binnen de kaders van de wet en hebben niet meer bevoegdheden dan iedere andere burger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het nieuwe meetinstrument van de GGD dat de kwaliteit van de kinderopvang moet gaan meten

The MP asks whether the GGD's new childcare quality instrument was properly validated, whether inspectors were trained and worked independently, whether the statistics were sound, and how the ministry handled journalists' questions. The minister confirms the instrument was compared only with a self-composed alternative, says he trusts the research, admits the research justification could have been clearer, provides the tender specification, and rejects the claim of evasive communication while committing to answer substantively.
I note that questions have arisen about the research methods and the pros and cons of the choices made.
Ik constateer dat er vragen zijn ontstaan over de onderzoeksmethoden en de voor- en nadelen van de hierbij gemaakte keuzen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Veldhoven over de veiligheid van wegwerkers

D66 MPs asked the ministers about the safety of road workers, including fatal accidents over ten years, whether the union's concerns are shared, trade-offs with traffic, and links to maintenance budgets. The ministers answered that safety follows CROW guidelines, a covenant and inspections are in place, and no link to budgets exists.
At the end of 2014 I concluded a covenant with the construction and infrastructure sector to work more safely.
Eind 2014 heb ik een convenant afgesloten om met de bouw- en infrabranche te komen tot veiliger werken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het dreigende ontslag van een militair wegens haar relatie met een Turk

MPs Kuzu and Öztürk asked the Defence and Social Affairs ministers about a female soldier facing dismissal because of her relationship with a Turkish partner, whom the MIVD cannot screen. The Defence minister answered that a tailored solution can prevent dismissal, that the MIVD has done what is required, that the commander's view is weighed, and that personnel will receive more information on partner policy.

As I explained in my letter of 21 May, no list can be released of the countries with which the intelligence and security services have a cooperation relationship on the basis of which personal data are exchanged.

Zoals ik heb toegelicht in mijn brief van 21 mei jl., kan geen lijst worden vrijgegeven van landen met wie de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten een samenwerkingsrelatie hebben op basis waarvan persoonsgegevens worden uitgewisseld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut "over het bericht dat vijf gemeenten sociale werkvoorziening AM Groep willen sluiten"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary about five municipalities' plans to close the AM Groep sheltered employment firm, including whether the Participatiewet caused the problems and whether they would negotiate to keep it open. The State Secretary said the councils have not yet decided, that gemeenten keep discretion over sw-bedrijven, and that she could not provide data on which municipalities decided to close and offered no commitment to intervene.
Municipalities have policy freedom in how they organise helping people with a work disability back to work.
Gemeenten hebben beleidsvrijheid bij de wijze waarop zij het aan de slag helpen van mensen met een arbeidsbeperking organiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat vier vijfde van de verplichte veiligheids- en gezondheidsplannen (V&G) niet op orde is bij de aanbesteding van infraprojecten

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that most safety and health plans (V&G-plannen) for infrastructure tenders are inadequate, and whether the minister would address contracting authorities and ask the Labour Inspectorate to prioritise them. The minister called the reports disappointing, said the Inspectorate checks clients on risk-based grounds and that employers bear primary responsibility, and promised to inform parliament by mid-2015 on a chain approach to safe work.
Where there is cause for this, in supervising compliance with the Working Conditions Act, the Inspectorate SZW holds clients to their obligations.
Als daar, bij het toezicht op naleving van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet, aanleiding toe is, worden opdrachtgevers door de inspectie SZW op hun verplichtingen aangesproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Inburgeringsplicht niet meer na vijf jaar en de conclusie van de advocaat generaal in zaak C-579/13, Europees Hof van Justitie’

An MP asks the minister how the Advocate General's opinion in case C-579/13 (no mandatory civic integration exam for long-term residents after five years) affects Dutch policy. The minister disagrees with the opinion on the exam, argues integration exams aid participation, and says the Court's ruling will be awaited before the Council of State decides.
The Advocate General's conclusion is an advice. The European Court of Justice is independent in forming its judgment.
De conclusie van de Advocaat Generaal is een advies. Het Europese Hof van Justitie is onafhankelijk in zijn oordeelsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Kerstens over het wegnemen van belemmeringen om over de grens te werken

MPs Nijboer and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs how the motion on mapping the fiscal and social security consequences for cross-border workers is implemented, what information is available to residents of the border region, and whether regional initiatives such as a helpdesk for working in Germany will be supported. The minister points to the grensinfo.nl website, the Belastingtelefoon and the cross-border tax team, Benelux information portals, and periodic cabinet reporting to parliament, and says the cabinet will consult VNG on whether a border counter is needed.
You will be further informed about the outcome of this consultation.
U wordt over de uitkomst van dit overleg nog nader geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat steeds meer bedrijven onbetaalde stagiairs inzetten op een startersfunctie

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether unpaid interns doing the same work as paid staff are in fact employees entitled to minimum wage, whether a trend exists, and what action will be taken. The minister answered that the line between internship and work depends on the learning element and actual circumstances, that no sufficient evidence of a trend exists, and that workers can complain to the Inspectorate SZW or civil courts, with no new proposals planned.
Currently the Inspectorate SZW has four reports on record in which work may have been performed instead of a work-experience placement or internship.
Momenteel zijn er bij de Inspectie SZW vier meldingen bekend waarbij mogelijk sprake is van werk in plaats van een werkervaringsplek of stage.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de komst van een islamitische geweldsprediker naar Rijswijk

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether a Salafist preacher, Muhammad Hassan, invited to a Rijswijk fundraiser, has links to the Muslim Brotherhood, poses a public-safety threat, and whether preachers calling for violence should be barred and mosques calling for violence closed. The minister answered that Hassan is a Salafist with an ambiguous link to the Brotherhood, that visas of three speakers were withdrawn on public-order grounds, that the foundation cancelled the event in its original form, and that closing a mosque is only possible for building-safety or drug violations or if a legal entity's aims breach public order.
The visas of three speakers were withdrawn with a view to public order, against the background of social unrest.
De visa van een drietal sprekers zijn ingetrokken met het oog op de openbare orde, tegen de achtergrond van de maatschappelijke onrust.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Krol over het artikel “CBS: Werkgelegenheid trekt aan”

MP Krol (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about CBS reports that unemployment fell mainly among under-45s while long-term unemployment among over-45s rose, and about whether the Work-Beyond-AOW bill and the 50pluswerkt action plan would cause displacement and whether the plan would be extended. The minister answered that the recovery is positive, that rising long-term unemployment is normal in recovery, that the bill is expected to raise older employment without long-run displacement, that the plan will not be extended, and that the relevant age-group figures are published and will be included in progress reports.
The figures for this age group will also be included in the next progress report on the 50pluswerkt action plan.
Ook in de volgende voortgangsrapportage over het «Actieplan 50pluswerkt» zullen deze cijfers meegenomen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouw over het beleid ten aanzien van haatpredikers en de handhaving daarvan

An MP asked the government about its policy toward hate preachers, including whether any were expelled or refused entry and how it judged speakers at a March 2015 event. The minister replied that no preachers had been expelled or refused entry in advance, that three speakers' visas were withdrawn on public order grounds, and that free speech is protected except where it incites hatred, violence or threatens public order.
The visas of three speakers were withdrawn in the interest of public order, against the background of social unrest.
De visa van een drietal sprekers zijn ingetrokken met het oog op de openbare orde, tegen de achtergrond van de maatschappelijke onrust.

Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Oskam (beiden CDA) aan de Ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de Staatssecretaris van Financiën over een bijeenkomst in Rijswijk op 8 maart 2015

MPs Omtzigt and Oskam asked the ministers about a planned March 2015 event in Rijswijk featuring preachers linked to extremist views, including visa revocations, whether the organiser's ANBI status could be withdrawn, and the list of speakers. The government answered that visas for three speakers were revoked on public order grounds, that the event was scaled back, and that the tax authority could investigate ANBI status if signals warranted, but gave no commitment to a specific investigation.
Without going into individuals, it can be said that seven preachers had been invited to give lectures on 8 March.
Zonder in te gaan op individuen kan verteld worden dat zeven predikers waren uitgenodigd voor het geven van lezingen op 8 maart.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Staaij over het bericht ‘Imams hebben visum voor benefiet in Rijswijk al binnen’

An SGP MP asked whether imams invited to a Rijswijk event had already received visas, whether visas could be refused or withdrawn for radical preachers, and whether criteria should be tightened and EU-level action taken. The government confirmed three visas were withdrawn on public order grounds, said current Schengen criteria suffice, and saw no reason to tighten them or raise the issue in the EU.
I see no reason to do so.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het door de Nederlandse Kamer van Koophandel georganiseerde seminar over buitenlandse uitzendkrachten

An MP asked ministers about a seminar on importing foreign temporary agency workers for agricultural firms, promoted as 'free staff from Slovakia', and whether it fits the fight against sham constructions. The minister answered that the seminar was organised by the bilateral Netherlands Chamber of Commerce in Slovakia, not the Dutch KvK, and that the government supports the country-of-work principle and a targeted review of the posting directive.
The seminar in question was not organised by the Dutch Chamber of Commerce but by 'The Netherlands Chamber of Commerce in The Slovak Republic'.
Het genoemde seminar werd niet georganiseerd de Nederlandse Kamer van Koophandel, maar door «The Netherlands Chamber of Commerce in The Slovak Republic»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over het conflict over pensioengeld bij woningcorporaties

SP MPs asked whether housing corporations keep the pension premium reduction instead of passing it on to employees, and whether the government will ensure the reduction reaches workers. The minister replied that wage and pension arrangements are for social partners, that the government is not a party to the corporation-sector talks, and that the wider enquiry does not concern this matter.
Employers and employees, and their organisations, are themselves responsible for making working-conditions agreements.
Werkgevers en werknemers, en hun organisaties, zijn zelf verantwoordelijk voor het maken van arbeidsvoorwaardelijke afspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over nadelige gevolgen voor werkgevers van de wetgeving bij ziekte van werknemers

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether Dutch sick-pay rules unfairly burden small employers and whether the employer obligation should be cut to one month as in Belgium. The minister rejected the claim of unfair burden, pointed to a pending CPB study and a broader review, and declined to commit to a change before a further letter in spring.
I do not share this view.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "een overgangsregeling voor de couveuseregeling bij vroeggeboorte"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether mothers of premature babies born in December 2014, still hospitalised, should get a transitional arrangement for the extended maternity leave for hospitalised infants that takes effect 1 January 2015. The minister answered that about 250 cases per month are expected, refused a transitional arrangement to avoid abrupt effects on employers and UWV, and estimated its cost at about 250,000 euro.
I am therefore not willing to make a transitional arrangement or provision.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid om een overgangsregeling of voorziening te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Öztürk over de vermeende Sharia-driehoek in de Schilderswijk in Den Haag

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the reported 'Sharia triangle' in The Hague's Schilderswijk, a Trouw article later shown to be fabricated, and whether the minister took action on it, restored trust, sought damages, or filed a complaint. The minister answers that the article only prompted integration-policy measures, that the neighbourhood's problems are real but separate from the article, that the media outlet itself must repair trust, and that a complaint filed against the journalist is being assessed by the prosecution service.
The Trouw article has undoubtedly reinforced the negative image of the Schilderswijk.
Het artikel in Trouw heeft de negatieve beeldvorming rond de Schilderwijk ongetwijfeld versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de enorme steun van Turkse jongeren voor jihadistisch geweld tegen niet moslims

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a poll showing strong support among Turkish-Dutch youth for jihadist violence against non-Muslims, and whether there is a link to Islam. The minister disputed the Islam link, said a structural budget increase of EUR 25 million was given to the AIVD, and pointed to existing measures in the jihadism action programme, without addressing the questions on Fortuyn's remarks in full detail.
The cabinet has decided on a structural addition of EUR 25 million to the budget of the AIVD.
Het kabinet heeft besloten tot een structurele toevoeging van € 25 miljoen euro aan het budget van de AIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Segers over het bericht dat de Turks-Nederlandse vereniging DIDF niet welkom is in een buurthuis in Zaandam vanwege kritiek op de Turkse president Erdogan

MPs Karabulut and Segers asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it was acceptable that a Zaandam community centre excluded the Turkish-Dutch association DIDF over criticism of President Erdogan, and whether such exclusion rules and the centre's contract clause on foreign politics were compatible with freedom of expression. The minister answered that this is a private dispute between two organisations, that the municipality mediated and has no formal responsibility, and that the conflict has been resolved by agreement.
This is a dispute in social-community relations. The two parties are independent organisations and will have to agree between themselves to reach a solution.
Dit is een geschil in sociaal maatschappelijk verkeer. De twee partijen zijn zelfstandige organisaties en zullen het samen eens moeten worden om tot een oplossing te kunnen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de Oostenrijkse islamwet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether Dutch law should restrict foreign funding of mosques and imams, and whether Austria's Islam law elements should be adopted to curb Turkish state influence. The government answered that foreign funding of worship is not to be banned in principle, that Austria's model does not transfer to the Dutch church-state context, and that talks with Turkish authorities on transparency are ongoing.
Banning foreign funding of religious practice as such is not at issue, except where it finances violence or unlawful or criminal practices.

Het als zodanig verbieden van buitenlandse financiering van geloofsuitoefening is niet aan de orde, behalve voor zover er sprake is van financiering van geweldsuitoefening of onrechtmatige dan wel criminele praktijken.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Van Veen en Anne Mulder over het artikel "Meer nadelen dan voordelen"

Two VVD MPs asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about the effects of the new Wet werk en zekerheid's chain-contract rule on amateur sports clubs, and about an exemption for professional football. The minister explains the tighter chain rule, grants a cao-based exemption for professional football contract players and coaches by ministerial regulation, and says he does not expect amateur clubs to struggle to recruit staff.
For the time being I do not expect amateur sports associations to experience more difficulty in recruiting staff.
Vooralsnog verwacht ik niet dat amateursportverenigingen meer moeite zullen ondervinden bij het aantrekken van personeel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de voortgaande misstanden bij moskee-internaten

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked whether three Rotterdam mosque boarding schools still fail national quality standards, whether other schools comply, and whether they should be closed. The minister said the Rotterdam schools do not yet meet all standards but are working on improvement, that municipalities are responsible for enforcement, closure is not justified, and a bill giving municipalities supervision powers has been submitted.
It is primarily the responsibility of municipalities to assess whether individual boarding schools meet the required standards.
Het is primair de verantwoordelijkheid van gemeenten om te beoordelen of individuele internaten voldoen aan de gestelde eisen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over eerste deelnemer aan de “Meesterbeurs”

MPs Ulenbelt and Karabulut asked about the 'Meesterbeurs', a Tilburg work-with-benefit scheme for over-50s, including employer costs, insurance coverage, training, displacement of regular workers and whether a systematic study of work-experience placements should be commissioned. The State Secretary answered that re-integration policy and instrument choice lie with municipalities, that the scheme is lawful work-with-benefit without an employment contract, that vacancies are checked for displacement, and that she supports municipalities commissioning effectiveness research without committing to such a study herself.
Responsibility for re-integration policy lies with municipalities, as does the choice of instruments.
De verantwoordelijkheid voor het re-integratiebeleid ligt bij gemeenten, net als de instrumentskeuze.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Segers over het bericht ‘Polderjihadisten ‘oer-Nederlands’

An MP asked the government whether the AIVD has enough funding and capacity to handle returning jihadists, why it was reportedly overwhelmed, and how border controls on departing youths can be improved. The government replied that the AIVD is adequately resourced with extra funding for research capacity, that the surge in travelers was foreseen rather than unexpected, and it outlined existing passport-signalling and EU information-sharing measures.
There was no question of being overwhelmed.
Er was geen sprake van overrompeling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Klein over het bericht “Nibud: koopkracht 2015 minder positief dan loonstrookje”

MP Klein asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Nibud report on lower 2015 purchasing power than shown on payslips warrants a response and policy adjustment. The minister replied that the report adds nothing new, explained that payslips omit inflation and changes in allowances, and said no policy correction is needed though purchasing power will be monitored.
These developments give no reason to adjust policy.
Deze ontwikkelingen geven geen aanleiding voor bijsturing van het beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over de invoering van het minimumloon en de eerstedagmelding in Duitsland en de gigantische administratieve lasten die dat oplevert voor Nederlandse werkgevers

Omtzigt (CDA) asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about Germany's minimum wage law and its first-day notification requirement, which he said burdens Dutch employers and workers with heavy administrative obligations, including German-language documents, high fines, and questions about EU law compliance. The State Secretary answered that the obligations exist, that the German customs authority is the competent body, that the Netherlands considers the administrative burden a restriction on free movement of services but leaves final judgement to the EU Court of Justice, and that no exemption or EU-level challenge is planned for now.
The answer to the question of whether there is an unjustified trade barrier is ultimately for the European Court of Justice.
Het antwoord op de vraag of sprake is van een ongerechtvaardigde handelsbelemmering is uiteindelijk aan het Europese Hof van Justitie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat afgestudeerde jongeren voor 50 euro in de maand werken bij de gemeente Winterswijk

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether having recent graduates work for 50 euro a month at the municipality of Winterswijk is good employment practice, whether it evades the minimum wage, and whether it displaces paid jobs. The minister said the distinction between internship and employment depends on the facts and that the Inspectorate SZW has taken the signal under review, so he could not judge the case himself.

Because the actual circumstances are decisive, I cannot judge whether in the case of the municipality of Winterswijk there is work or work experience without the learning aspect being central, and whether there is displacement or poor employer conduct.

Omdat de feitelijke omstandigheden leidend zijn, kan ik niet beoordelen of er in het geval van de gemeente Winterswijk sprake is van werk of werkervaring zonder dat het leeraspect centraal staat en of er sprake is van verdringing of slecht werkgeverschap.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over het SOMO-onderzoek naar misstanden op bouwprojecten waarvan Rijkswaterstaat de opdrachtgever is

MPs Hoogland and Kerstens asked whether Rijkswaterstaat, as client, checks compliance with labour rules and minimum wage/cao obligations in subcontracting chains on road projects, and whether standard contracts should refer to them. The minister replied that Rijkswaterstaat requires compliance with statutory rules and checks Arbeidsomstandighedenwet and foreign-worker rules, but lacks powers over cao wage compliance, which lies with cao parties, the Inspectie SZW and sectoral bodies, so no change to standard contracts or project screening is planned beyond supporting competent authorities.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuzu en Öztürk over het bericht dat de rechter opnieuw heeft bepaald dat het korten van kinderbijslag onwettig is

Two MPs asked the ministers whether the government will keep litigating over the export-residence principle (woonlandbeginsel) after courts repeatedly ruled that cutting child benefit for children in Morocco is unlawful, and asked about legal costs, Moroccan project funding, and diplomatic fallout from terminating the social security treaty with Morocco. The minister answered that the law was passed by parliament, that the government respects rulings and continues litigation where needed for clarity, that legal costs are budgeted within structural implementation costs, that a Moroccan funding freeze is Morocco's own decision, and that the government will seek to revise the treaty and submit a termination approval bill to parliament.
