Where it turns out that the export-residence principle cannot be applied, the cabinet has of course respected those rulings.
Waar blijkt dat woonlandbeginsel niet kan worden toegepast, heeft het kabinet deze uitspraken uiteraard gerespecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Duisenberg en Azmani over het kort geding dat is aangespannen door twee vrouwen tegen de Islamitische Universiteit Rotterdam

MPs Duisenberg and Azmani asked about a summary-proceedings lawsuit by two women against the Islamic University of Rotterdam, the grounds for expelling students from non-funded programmes, and whether the institution's conduct should affect its accreditation. The minister answered that civil law governs non-funded institutions, that the court ordered the students reinstated, and that the Inspectorate and NVAO are conducting enhanced supervision and a visitation, with new legislation planned.
I have asked the Inspectorate to proceed with what in practice amounts to enhanced supervision.
Ik heb de Inspectie gevraagd om over te gaan tot wat in de praktijk neerkomt op verscherpt toezicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het aanbieden van vacatures voor de functie van softdrugs verkoper door het UWV

An MP asks whether the UWV sent job vacancies for a cannabis-shop seller to jobseekers, how it treats jobseekers who refuse such posts on conscience grounds, and how it handles such objections generally. The minister answers that such vacancies are not actively offered as suitable work, that the post was wrongly included and has been removed, and that jobseekers with conscientious objections are handled case by case with UWV.
UWV filters these functions out of the offer to jobseekers.
UWV filtert genoemde functies uit het aanbod aan werkzoekenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kerstens over het ontslag van bijna 2000 medewerkers van Thebe

MPs Wolbert and Kerstens asked about the bankruptcy of home-care provider Thebe, which left nearly 2,000 workers jobless, and what municipalities and the Wmo framework do to keep clients and workers in place. The state secretary answered that the curator, municipalities and other providers (TSN, Tzorg) are securing continuity for most clients and offering jobs, that some municipalities have revised their policies, and that the government is following developments closely without committing to new measures.
We closely follow the efforts and progress of the municipalities concerned.
Wij volgen de inspanningen en vorderingen van de betrokken gemeenten nauwgezet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over "de toespraak van de Britse premier Cameron en de berichtgeving ‘Cameron presenteert strengere regels voor EU-migranten"

The Azmani MP questions asked the Minister of Social Affairs about UK Prime Minister Cameron's speech proposing stricter rules for intra-EU migrants, including job offers before migration, a six-month job-search limit, a welfare phase-in model, export limits on child benefit, and reform of EU social security coordination. The Minister answers that the Netherlands values free movement and will not back restrictions on it, notes existing EU limits, argues a seven-year welfare waiting period conflicts with international obligations and EU rules, and says it is pursuing reform of the unemployment provisions of Regulation 883/2004 with like-minded states.
The Netherlands will not support initiatives that restrict this fundamental principle for specific groups of EU citizens.
Nederland zal geen steun verlenen aan initiatieven die dit fundamentele beginsel voor specifieke groepen EU-burgers beperken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de vergrote kans op buikgriep bij kinderdagverblijven

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a RIVM/UMC Utrecht study linking childcare centres to higher risk of stomach flu, and what measures would improve hygiene. The minister said hygiene is already part of mandatory risk assessments and GGD inspections, that the RIVM guideline will be revised in 2015 with the sector, and that a possible healthy-childcare quality mark has not yet been decided.
In 2015 the regular revision of the guideline on health risks in a childcare centre or playgroup will take place.
In 2015 zal de reguliere herziening plaatsvinden van de richtlijn «gezondheidsrisico’s in een kindercentrum of peuterspeelzaal»
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wolbert en Kerstens over het sluiten van de Philipsvestiging te Emmen

Two MPs asked the ministers about Philips' decision to close its Emmen site and move work to Poland and Spain, including tax benefits, regional jobs support, and reshoring. The government regrets the closure but says companies must decide location on business grounds, cannot comment on individual tax matters, and will work through employer federations and reshoring initiatives.
Because of the tax confidentiality obligation, the cabinet cannot make statements about the tax affairs of individual taxpayers such as Philips.
Op grond van de fiscale geheimhoudingsplicht kan het kabinet echter geen uitspraken doen over belastingaangelegenheden van individuele belastingplichtigen zoals Philips.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hoogland en Kerstens over het bericht ‘Poolse werknemers uitgebuit ; vakbond FNV Bouw meldt flinke reeks misstanden bij verbreding A15’

Two PvdA MPs asked the Infrastructure and Environment and Social Affairs ministers about reports of exploitation of Polish workers on the A15 widening, including underpayment, lack of insurance and unpaid overtime. The minister said the allegations could not yet be confirmed, that the Labour Inspectorate had inspected the site in April 2014 without finding minimum-wage or working-time violations, and that investigations and new contractor-liability rules were underway.

These cases are currently being investigated by the special team of the Labour Inspectorate responsible for tackling sham constructions and supporting social partners in enforcing collective agreement conditions.

Deze zaken worden thans onderzocht door het speciale team van de Inspectie SZW dat belast is met de aanpak van schijnconstructies en de ondersteuning van sociale partners bij de handhaving van de cao-voorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Bergkamp over het artikel ‘culturele topinstellingen worstelen met regels bij aantrekken van talent van buiten EU’

Two D66 MPs asked why cultural institutions such as the Rijksmuseum, Concertgebouworkest and Nationaal Ballet struggle to hire non-EU talent under work-permit rules, and whether the rules should be relaxed. The minister defended the EU-first principle but acknowledged that the arts need international talent, pointed to existing lower salary thresholds for performing arts, said he would consult the museum sector, and offered talks with the orchestra and ballet, reporting back to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius en Yücel over de medewerking van het kabinet aan het plan om de werkloosheid in Twente aan te pakken

MPs Omtzigt, Schouten, Siderius and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether the cabinet will cooperate with the Twente 'Twente Werkt' action plan against high unemployment, and referred to earlier motions on regional economic renewal and border regions. Minister Kamp replied that the ministries already participate in the plan, pointed to earlier letters, acknowledged a skills mismatch in Twente and said no substantial changes to government jobs in the region are foreseen, while leaving the specific contribution per action line to a later letter.
The ministries of Social Affairs and Employment and Economic Affairs are already actively participating in the 'Twente Werkt!' action plan.
De ministeries van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Economische Zaken werken al actief mee aan het Actieplan «Twente Werkt!.»
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over de premiekortingsregeling voor oudere werknemers

An MP asked the minister whether employers abuse the premium discount for hiring older workers by having staff leave via termination agreements and be rehired, and whether the rules should be tightened. The minister acknowledged signals of such abuse, called it an unintended loophole, and committed to amending the regulations as soon as possible.
I therefore intend to amend the regulations as soon as possible in response to this signal and to hold employers to account.
Ik ben daarom voornemens om naar aanleiding van dit signaal de regelgeving zo spoedig mogelijk aan te passen en de werkgevers hierop aan te spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Religies in gesprek in Ridderzaal’

Two PVV MPs asked why Islamic representatives were invited to a government dialogue in the Ridderzaal, a symbol of freedom, given their view of Islam as a totalitarian ideology. The minister answered that Islam is a religion protected by freedom of religion, that the dialogue aimed to bridge differences in a pluralistic society, and that such conversations should continue.
Islam is a religion. Like other religions, this religion falls under freedom of religion and is subject to the same rules.
De Islam is een godsdienst. Deze godsdienst valt net als andere religies onder de vrijheid van godsdienst en is met dezelfde regels omgeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Anne Mulder over de transitievergoeding voor seizoenwerkers

An MP asked whether the transition payment (transitievergoeding) for seasonal workers would be inflated by applying it retroactively to pre-July 2015 employment periods and a 6-month break rule, and why no transitional law applied. The minister answered that the scheme has immediate effect, that pre-July 2015 service counts by design to avoid worsening existing entitlements, and that the 6-month rule is intended, so no change is planned, though he will publicize the rules via government websites and social partners.
Yes. I will do that via government websites, as well as via and in consultation with social partners.
Ja. Dat zal ik doen via websites van de rijksoverheid, alsmede via en in samenspraak met sociale partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat een imam tientallen religieuze huwelijken sloot zonder voorafgaand burgerlijk huwelijk

An MP asked whether an imam who conducted dozens of religious marriages without prior civil marriage, and the mosque board's knowledge of it, would be investigated, and what the government would do about such marriages and the women affected. The Minister answered that the Public Prosecution Service investigated, found five provable cases, and imposed conditional fines, that the government has no overview of how many such marriages occur, and that it will inform parliament on a possible study before the end of 2014 and is strengthening support and awareness measures.
The cabinet has no insight into the scale on which Islamic marriages without a prior civil marriage are concluded.
Het kabinet heeft geen zicht op de schaal waarop islamitische huwelijken, waarbij geen sprake is van een voorafgaand burgerlijk huwelijk, worden afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Kerstens over de kritiek van de vakbonden op TNT

MPs Gesthuizen and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about union criticism of TNT, including reports that dismissed workers were rehired via subcontractors while receiving unemployment benefits. The Minister said he had no evidence of rule violations, pointed to ongoing Inspectorate monitoring and the pending anti-sham-construction bill, and deemed TNT's voluntary-departure policy a matter for employers.
I currently have no indications that the rules are being broken. I am therefore awaiting the further findings of the Inspectorate SZW.
Ik heb vooralsnog geen aanwijzingen dat de regels overtreden worden. Ik wacht daarom de nadere bevindingen van de Inspectie SZW af
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het door het UWV herkeuren van (uitbehandelde) kankerpatiënten

An MP asked the minister about UWV re-assessments of terminally or long-term cancer patients receiving disability benefits, including appeal rates, alleged targets, and guidelines. The minister said no outcome targets exist, appeal data show cancer patients appeal less often but win more often without indicating mistreatment, and a working group on the issue will report in spring 2015.
No requirements or targets are set regarding a desired or undesired outcome in re-assessments concerning the degree of work incapacity.
Er worden geen eisen c.q. targets gesteld ten aanzien van een al dan niet gewenste uitkomst bij herbeoordelingen met betrekking tot de mate van arbeidsongeschiktheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over "haperende ICT blokkeert inburgeren"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about failing ICT that prevented 716 people from taking the basic civic integration exam abroad, asking about compensation, reasons for delay, and structural fixes. The minister acknowledged the problem, described DUO and IND measures for affected people, and said offline laptop-based exams resumed from 1 December with an online solution in preparation.
Following this finding, various experts were deployed to work towards a technical solution.
Naar aanleiding van deze constatering zijn diverse deskundigen ingezet om tot een technische oplossing te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het toezicht op de gastouderopvang

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about inspection of childminding (gastouderopvang), including how often childminders are checked, whether many have never been inspected, and whether safety and quality are adequately guaranteed. The Minister answers that new childminders are inspected before registration and existing ones are checked by risk-based sampling of at least 5% yearly, that an analysis of uninspected new registrants will follow in 2015, and that a bill extending continuous screening is forthcoming.
All new childminders are inspected before registration.
Alle nieuwe gastouders worden vóór registratie geïnspecteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welzijn over "het privacy lek van het UWV"

An MP asked the minister and state secretary about reported weak privacy protection at UWV and the municipality of 's-Hertogenbosch regarding access to the Suwinet data system, including missing security plans and incomplete logging. The government admits the security requirements are not fully met, says UWV and the municipality are remedying the shortcomings, and promises formal adoption of plans and procedures in early 2015 and an inspection follow-up reported in April 2015.
We find that not all of the required security standards are being complied with and that the risks are therefore too great.
Wij stellen vast dat niet alle gestelde beveiligingseisen worden nageleefd en dat daarmee de risico's te groot zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over het bericht “UWV stuurt werkzoekenden naar oplichters”

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs how a fraudulent staffing agency could advertise on the UWV job site werk.nl, what screening applies, and how identity fraud is being addressed. The minister explained that directly posted vacancies are checked for signs of abuse but identity of web-crawled vacancy providers is not verified, and announced a disclaimer on crawled vacancies and continued reporting of the fraud case.
However, UWV does not check the identity of the vacancy provider(s).
UWV controleert echter niet de identiteit van de aanbieder van de vacature(s).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Tanamal over een onderneemster met een arbeidsongeschiktheidsuitkering

Two MPs asked the minister about a Rotterdam entrepreneur who worked two years on a disability benefit without income being properly accounted for, and whether UWV warned people starting businesses about changing rules and how profits are offset. The minister said he cannot intervene in individual cases, that UWV reminds beneficiaries of their duty to report income, and that UWV uses the profit reported to the tax authority, with the offset method aligned between ZW and WIA since 2011.
First of all, I cannot interfere in individual cases.
Allereerst kan ik mij niet mengen in individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over het onderzoek van Imtech naar fraude bij de bouw van de energiecentrale van Essent in de Eemshaven

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Labour Inspectorate has investigated labour abuses in building the Essent power plant at Eemshaven, whether it has contact with Imtech about the company's fraud probe, and whether it will investigate further. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has no targeted inspections of Essent, has no contact with Imtech, which is a competition matter referred to the ACM, and has no independent role in cao compliance beyond requests from cao parties.
However, no inspections have taken place that were specifically aimed at Essent, because Essent itself was not a responsible party in the chain of clients for the construction.
Er hebben echter geen inspecties plaatsgevonden die specifiek waren gericht op Essent, omdat Essent zelf geen verantwoordelijke partij was in de keten van opdrachtgevers van de bouw.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht 'Asschers banenplannen: 200.000 euro per baan

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that sector employment plans cost 200,000 euro per job and create few genuinely new jobs, and whether the plans had really put people back to work. The minister replied that most participants receive coaching, training, apprenticeships or health checks, that over 300,000 people are reached, and that progress will be monitored through quick scans and a 2016 evaluation.
Twice a year (spring and autumn) a quick scan will be carried out to monitor the progress of the implementation of the sector plans.
Twee maal per jaar (voorjaar en najaar) zal een quick scan worden uitgevoerd om de voortgang van de uitvoering van de sectorplannen te monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie tegen de plaatsing van het Armeens herdenkingsmonument

MPs asked the government about a demonstration against an Armenian genocide memorial in Almelo, alleged Turkish state involvement, verification of claims, and whether the government will take a clearer stance on the commemoration. The government answered that there was no direct Turkish state involvement in the demonstration, that it has raised the matter with Turkish authorities, that it does not keep lists of all contacts, and that it sees no need for special research, while declining to say when the prosecutor will decide on the complaints.
The Public Prosecution Service has informed the Ministry of Security and Justice that it cannot currently give certainty about when the assessment of the complaint will be completed.
Het openbaar ministerie heeft het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het nu geen uitsluitsel kan geven over het moment waarop de beoordeling van de aangifte zal zijn afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kerstens en Vermeij over de app Helpling voor de schoonmaakmarkt

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked whether the Helpling app, which matches households with cleaners, falls under the domestic-services regulation and how workers' minimum wage, sick pay, liability and collective agreements are protected. Minister Asscher said courts decide employment status case by case, referred the tax aspect to the Tax Administration, and saw no reason to consult the Labour Foundation.
It is for the court to give a legal characterisation of an employment relationship in individual cases.
Het is aan de rechter om in individuele gevallen een juridische duiding aan een arbeidsrelatie te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over een advertentie van BDU Media waarin zij ‘werkervaringsplekken’ als verwerkend redacteur aanbieden

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a BDU Media advert offering unpaid-or-low-paid 'work experience' editor posts at 350 euro, questioning whether such posts must pay the statutory minimum wage. The minister explained the stage versus employment distinction, said the advert lacked learning structure, and pointed to the Inspectorate SZW for enforcement and complaints.
The Inspectorate SZW is charged with supervising compliance with the Minimum Wage and Minimum Holiday Allowance Act.
De Inspectie SZW is belast met het toezicht op de naleving van de Wet minimumloon en minimumvakantiebijslag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over het sectorplan primair onderwijs

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why the Jong en Oud subsidy in the primary education sector plan excludes young teachers who had a regular paid job in the previous six months, and whether this conflicts with teacher shortage goals. The minister answered that the condition is intended to target labour-market-vulnerable youth, that uptake so far is lagging (25.3 fte applications), and that changing the rules retroactively is undesirable.

An amendment of the Regulation as proposed is not desirable to me, because the measures for hiring vulnerable workers are specifically intended to offer opportunities to people at a distance from the labour market.

Een aanpassing van de Regeling zoals voorgesteld acht ik niet gewenst omdat de maatregelen voor indienstneming van kwetsbare werknemers, bij uitstek zijn bedoeld om personen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt kansen te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat mensen met terminale kanker door het UWV worden goedgekeurd voor werk

An SP MP asked the minister whether UWV pressures terminally ill cancer patients to return to work and whether specific policy exists for them. The minister said terminally ill patients (expected to die within months) are not approved for work, that prognosis-based guidelines and the Schattingsbesluit apply, and that UWV does not aim to pressure patients.
I cannot go into individual cases.
Op individuele gevallen kan ik niet ingaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht “Jihadronselaar Bilal is nu jongerenwerker in Amsterdam”

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a convicted jihad recruiter now working as a youth worker in Amsterdam is truly deradicalised, whether he should be expelled, and whether his sister should be sent to ISIS. The minister said deradicalisation cannot be guaranteed, pointed to the Dutch citizenship-deprivation option and the integrated jihadism action programme, and refused to send the person or his sister away.
Deradicalisation, however, remains human work, so no one can give a guarantee about the degree of deradicalisation.
Deradicalisering blijft echter mensenwerk, waardoor niemand garantie kan geven over de mate van deradicalisering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het mislukken van het zoveelste ICT-project bij het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the halted UWV ICT project with supplier Be Informed after its bankruptcy, including money spent, recovery, procurement and timeline. The minister answered in detail: the project was ended early due to supplier bankruptcy, about €10.2m was paid for the licence and €5.9m for the WW sub-project, recovery was judged not promising, and UWV will not re-tender for now.
UWV terminated the project early because the relevant ICT supplier went bankrupt.
UWV heeft het project vroegtijdig afgebroken vanwege faillissement van de betrokken ICT-leverancier.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mishandeling van een anti-Zwarte Piet-demonstrant

An MP asked whether a woman was assaulted over an anti-Zwarte Piet demonstration and whether the perpetrator was arrested, and how the government would prevent violence over this debate. The minister said no complaint was filed, the parties reconciled, no criminal investigation followed, condemned violence, and said local authorities are responsible for the peaceful conduct of the festival.
Although this is the responsibility of local authorities, I can imagine that extra efforts will be made in the coming period to ensure the peaceful course of the Sinterklaas festival.
Hoewel dit aan de lokale autoriteiten is, kan ik mij voorstellen dat er de komende tijd extra inspanningen worden verricht om het vredige verloop van het Sinterklaasfeest te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Van Dekken over het bericht dat op bouwplaatsen van de NAM en Shell mogelijk sprake is van het ontduiken van de cao in de steigerbouwsector

MPs Kerstens and Van Dekken asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that collective agreement (cao) evasion may occur in scaffolding construction at NAM and Shell sites, including cao-shopping by temp agencies. The minister said cao compliance is primarily the responsibility of social partners, that SNCU investigations found roughly EUR 1 million in underpayment with recovery payments and a director-liability procedure, that the Inspectorate has received no formal request under article 10, and that a bill on sham constructions with chain liability is forthcoming.
The Labour Inspectorate supports the cao parties in the civil-law enforcement of the cao through compliance investigations.
De Inspectie SZW ondersteunt de cao-partijen bij de civielrechtelijke handhaving van de cao met nalevingsonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Kerstens over het bericht van onderbetaling van uitzendkrachten bij bouwprojecten die door de gemeente Groningen zijn aanbesteed

MPs Van Dekken and Kerstens asked the minister whether the Inspectie SZW would investigate reported underpayment of temp workers on Groningen municipal construction projects and whether the municipality should be held accountable as client. The minister replied that cao compliance is primarily for cao parties and the Inspectie can only investigate minimum wage evasion, and promised the forthcoming Wet aanpak schijnconstructies would address underpayment in the chain.
Supervision of compliance with collective labour agreements is primarily a matter for the cao parties.
Toezicht op de naleving van cao’s is in eerste plaats een zaak van cao-partijen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Fokke over het bericht ‘Pestcultuur onder ambtenaren komt door gouden kooi’

MPs Kerstens and Fokke asked about a report attributing bullying among civil servants to job security and a 'golden cage', and about mobility, top-down anti-bullying measures and financial sanctions for bullies. Minister Plasterk answered that bullying is a workplace matter for individual employers, cited survey figures, outlined mobility initiatives and existing disciplinary options, but declined a top-down approach.
It is primarily up to employers to ensure the safety and health of employees.
Het is primair aan de werkgevers om zorg te dragen voor de veiligheid en gezondheid van werknemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Omtzigt over conflicten over kinderalimentatie als gevolg van de Wet hervorming kindregelingen

MPs Heerma and Omtzigt asked whether the abolition of the child-maintenance tax deduction (LOK) from 2015 would cause disputes over alimony and what parents should do. The minister says the reform may affect existing alimony, points parents to advice channels and to courts, and notes the Raad voor de Rechtspraak will advise on a calculation rule early next year.
The request in the motion to develop a standard calculation rule for changing child maintenance amounts due to the child benefits reform has been placed with the Council for the Judiciary.

Het verzoek in de motie om te komen tot een standaardrekenregel voor wijziging van het kinderalimentatiebedrag als gevolg van de Wet hervorming kindregelingen is neergelegd bij de Raad voor de rechtspraak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over het buigen van de kunstwereld voor islamitische radicalen

MPs asked whether the government shares concern that an artist's work was not exhibited out of fear of Muslim radicals, and what measures will protect freedom of expression. The minister answered that artistic choices belong to museum professionals, that concrete threats can be reported to police, that he sees no concrete evidence of extremists undermining artistic expression, and that current law adequately guarantees freedom of expression.
In our current legislation and regulations, freedom of expression is already sufficiently guaranteed.
In onze huidige wet- en regelgeving wordt de vrijheid van meningsuiting reeds voldoende gewaarborgd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Kuiken over de integratie van vluchtelingen naar aanleiding van de Integratiebarometer van Vluchtelingenwerk

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about the poor labour-market and poverty outcomes of refugees shown in the Vluchtelingenwerk Integratiebarometer 2014, and whether current integration instruments and municipal support are adequate. The government acknowledges the weak outcomes, points to language, education and recognition gaps and to Somali refugees doing worst, and cites new labour-market orientation in civic integration from January 2015, but makes no concrete new commitments.
The civic integration policy was recently changed and needs time to prove itself.
Het inburgeringsbeleid is recent gewijzigd en heeft tijd nodig om zich te bewijzen.
Antwoord op vragen van het Karabulut over het bericht "Ontsnapt uit Islamitische schoot"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the government would intervene with Saudi Arabia to protect Alya and secure her passport and Dutch naturalisation, and why the government is active in the Meriam Ibrahim case but not here. The minister declined to comment on individual cases for privacy reasons, said naturalisation without the usual requirements is only for exceptional cases, and provided figures on abandonment and forced marriage calls and consular assistance.
The cabinet does not comment on individual cases, out of regard for the privacy of the persons concerned.
Het kabinet gaat niet in op individuele zaken, vanuit het oogpunt van bescherming van de persoonlijke levenssfeer van de betrokkenen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "het flitsfaillissement van Triodus Kinderopvang"

An SP MP asked the minister about the pre-pack bankruptcy and sale of childcare organisation Triodus, including its consequences for children, staff and locations, the sale conditions, and whether tougher rules are needed. The minister answered that continuity was secured for parents and children, most staff were offered permanent contracts, and that the curator will report on the sale conditions later while he sees no need for new legislation.
The curator will shortly account for the prepack period through the first public report.
De curator zal binnenkort middels het eerste openbare verslag verantwoording afleggen over de prepack periode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over misbruik van de bijstand

An MP asks the government about benefit abuse, claiming the welfare state breeds idle citizens, and asks whether a flat tax would be preferable to benefits and allowances. The Secretary of State replies that municipalities have more tools to enforce work obligations and that the flat tax question is answered by a separate budget letter.
Under that bill, municipalities have more options in cases where people try to evade their duty to do everything possible to stay out of or leave benefits.

Gemeenten hebben op grond van dat wetsvoorstel meer handelingsmogelijkheden in die gevallen dat mensen zich zouden proberen te ontrekken aan hun plicht om zelf al het mogelijke te doen om uit de bijstand te blijven of te komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over gesubsidieerde Turks-Marokkaanse apartheid in een zwembad

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the minister whether he knows of, and will act against, a Amsterdam-subsidised swimming activity reserved for Turkish and Moroccan men, and whether the EUR 55,000 subsidy should be withheld. The minister answered that the activity is part of a municipal programme for socially isolated men over 50, uses a separate pool only for guided sessions, is open to all men per the foundation, and that municipalities decide their own subsidy policy within the law.
As regards subsidy policy, municipal authorities are free to determine their own position, within the applicable laws and regulations.
Wat betreft het beleid ten aanzien van subsidieverleningen zijn gemeentelijke overheden, binnen de geldende wet- en regelgeving, vrij hun eigen standpunt te bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Jan Vos over het in surseance verkerende staalbedrijf Nedstaal

MPs Vermeij and Jan Vos asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs whether they would engage with Nedstaal, a steel company in suspension of payments, about a scaled-down restart, press for preserving regional jobs, and ensure UWV takes extra action for dismissed workers. The minister reports ongoing contact with management, the curator and the municipality, a takeover by Andus Group preserving 200 of 280 jobs, and a regional steering group with UWV and sector support for the 80 workers losing their jobs.
Together with the sector it is being examined whether support can be offered to Nedstaal's employees from the sector plan and what that support would consist of.
Samen met de sector wordt onderzocht of er ondersteuning geboden kan worden aan de werknemers van Nedstaal vanuit het sectorplan en waaruit deze ondersteuning bestaat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de betrokkenheid van jihadisten  bij onderwijsorganisaties

Two MPs asked ministers about jihadist involvement in a private Arabic-language and Islamic education foundation, including oversight, funding and whether such bodies can be shut down. The government said it finds extremist messaging unacceptable, that the foundation falls outside inspection as non-recognised education, and that it will act if laws are broken, while declining to give details on specific persons or organisations.
No public statements will be made about investigative information on specific persons or organisations.
Over onderzoeksgegevens over specifieke personen of organisaties worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Van Raak over het bericht dat jihadist Jermaine W. een onderwijsorganisatie leidde

Two MPs asked whether a jihadist who reportedly left for Syria led an education foundation despite surveillance, whether extremist teachers are allowed to teach children, and whether such foundations receive subsidies or foreign funding and should be inspected. The government said it cannot comment on individual investigations, that private unrecognised education falls outside the Inspectorate's supervision, that foreign funding is not illegal, and that it will push for more transparency under its anti-jihadism action programme.
That does not alter the fact that we will intervene when there are signs of practices that are not acceptable.
Dat neemt niet weg dat wij zullen ingrijpen wanneer er tekenen zijn van praktijken die niet door de beugel kunnen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een anti-joodse mishandeling in Arnhem

Two MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about an anti-Jewish assault in Arnhem and whether they would act on an anti-antisemitism action plan. The minister said a criminal complaint was filed and under investigation, that the government is convening dialogue and educational initiatives, but sees no added value in the proposed action plan beyond existing policy.
Because of the interests of investigation and prosecution, I cannot provide any information on that.
Vanwege de belangen van opsporing en vervolging kan ik daar geen mededelingen over doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat Sociale Zaken mogelijk de privacywetgeving schond

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt asked who authorised linking personal data for fraud detection without a legal basis, whether the Dutch data protection authority (CBP) supervised this, and why a statutory basis was only created in 2013. Minister Asscher answers that the Wbp and the WWB/SUWI provided a basis for data linking, that the CBP was consulted and informed parliament via letters in 2005, 2007, 2009 and 2011, and that the 2013 SUWI amendment (SyRI) was chosen for transparency rather than because the earlier practice was unlawful.

Although the bureau concludes that the Wbp provides a sufficient legal basis to work within a 'Black Box' environment, a separate statutory basis is chosen for reasons of transparency and a clear division of tasks and responsibilities.

Ofschoon het bureau concludeert dat de Wbp voldoende juridische basis heeft om binnen een «Black Box» omgeving te werken, wordt er om redenen van transparantie en heldere taak- en verantwoordelijkheidsverdeling voor gekozen een aparte wettelijke basis te creëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouw over het bericht ‘Sociale Zaken overtrad mogelijk de privacywetgeving’

MPs Van Weyenberg and Schouw (D66) asked Minister Asscher whether SZW linked and analysed databases without a legal basis in its 'Black Box' fraud-detection programme, whether unlawfully obtained evidence was used, and how the CBP supervised it. The minister answered that the linking rested on the Wbp, WWB and SUWI, that the Black Box had been adjusted after CBP findings, and that individuals are not personally informed about the processing.
The number of fraud cases detected with this is not available in aggregated form.
Het aantal fraudegevallen dat hiermee is opgespoord is niet in geaggregeerde vorm beschikbaar.

Antwoord op vragen van leden Pieter Heerma en Van Hijum over de grote zorgen bij bouwondernemers in Overijssel over de grotere inflexibiliteit in de relatie tussen werkgever en werknemer als gevolg van de aangescherpte k

MPs Heerma and Van Hijum asked whether the minister knows of concerns among Overijssel construction firms that the tightened chain-contract rule in the Wwz will reduce flexibility, and whether the start date or the rule itself will be changed. The minister acknowledges the concerns but rejects calling the rule unnecessary, refuses to postpone or extend the chain-contract limit, and promises to send the results of the study on a multi-year second contract before the budget debate.

Before the budget debate of the Ministry of SZW, I will send the Chamber the outcomes of the study into the advantages and disadvantages of a multi-year second contract, as well as the outcome of the consultation with social partners on this.

Voor de behandeling van de begroting van SZW zal ik de uitkomsten van het onderzoek naar de voor- en nadelen van een meerjarig tweede contract alsmede de uitkomst van het overleg hierover met sociale partners aan uw Kamer zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Rebel over de omstandigheden waaronder politiemensen drugslaboratoria en -afval moeten opsporen en opruimen

MPs Marcouch and Rebel asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about the working conditions of police and inspectors who detect and clean up drug labs and dumped drug waste, citing a union letter on unsafe conditions, the LFO team's capacity and falling numbers of green BOAs. The minister said the Inspectie SZW will investigate working conditions with no timeline, that LFO capacity has been doubled with new staff expected by 1 January 2015, and that green BOA numbers fluctuate without a structural downward trend.
The Inspectie SZW has since confirmed that it will carry out this investigation.
De Inspectie SZW heeft inmiddels bevestigd dat zij dit onderzoek gaat uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Cegerek over louche asbestverwijderaars.

MPs Kerstens and Cegerek asked whether the government can stop asbestos removal firms that re-apply for certification through new legal entities after losing a certificate, and whether certification rules and oversight should change. Minister Asscher acknowledged about five firms tried to circumvent the rules, committed to tightening the certification scheme and intensifying Inspectorate enforcement, while rejecting a shift to a different oversight system for now.
I find it unacceptable that companies or persons, after a certificate has been withdrawn, continue their work in the same way under another certificate.
Ik vind het onaanvaardbaar dat bedrijven of personen na het intrekken van een certificaat onder een ander certificaat hun werkzaamheden op dezelfde manier voortzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat het ministerie het lek in asbestregels erkent

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a certificate-holding asbestos removal firm could continue its work through a related BV after its certificate was withdrawn, and how certification bodies handled such cases. The minister declined to discuss the individual case because procedures were ongoing, acknowledged loopholes in the certification rules, and promised to tighten the certification schemes and information-sharing with Ascert and certification bodies, with measures under discussion.
The problem identified makes clear that the certification schemes need to be adjusted.
Het gesignaleerde probleem maakt duidelijk dat aanpassing nodig is van de certificatieschema's.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Graus, De Graaf en Wilders over het Islamitisch Offerfeest op Werelddierendag

Three PVV MPs asked whether the Islamic Feast of Sacrifice falling on World Animal Day, and the ritual slaughter it involves, was acceptable and whether the practice should end. The minister answered that the government respects religious traditions within the rule of law, that unstunned ritual slaughter is governed by law and enforced by the NVWA, and that it sees no reason to end the practice.
The manner in which unstunned ritual slaughter may take place is laid down in Dutch laws and regulations.
De wijze waarop onbedwelmde rituele slacht mag plaatsvinden is vastgelegd in de Nederlandse wet- en regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over het gegeven dat er een ‘Pietoverleg’ zal plaatsvinden

Two MPs asked the government about a reported meeting on Sinterklaas and Zwarte Piet, which organisations attended, and whether the government would oppose the 'Zwarte Piet' criticism and accept the political-correctness pressure. The minister listed the attending organisations, stated that the feast is a societal tradition with no government rule on how it is celebrated, and said the government appeals to everyone's responsibility rather than imposing terms.
There is no law, guideline or other form of obligation imposed by the government regarding the way the Sinterklaas feast is celebrated.
Er is geen sprake van een wet, richtlijn of andere vorm van verplichting die door de overheid wordt opgelegd als het gaat om de wijze waarop het Sinterklaasfeest wordt gevierd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Smaling inzake het wonen op antikraakcontracten

Two SP MPs asked why people on low incomes increasingly live without legal protection under anti-squatting (antikraak) contracts, and what the government will do about asbestos risks, oversight, the Wet Kraken en Leegstand, and tenant protection. The minister answers that he will not impose statutory requirements on antikraak contracts, sees the choice as voluntary, will evaluate the squatting and vacancy law in early 2015, and points to a voluntary keurmerk for vacancy managers.
For that reason I will not develop proposals to impose further statutory requirements on antikraak contracts.
Om die reden zal ik geen voorstellen ontwikkelen om verdere wettelijke eisen te stellen aan antikraakcontracten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over een uitspraak van het Europese Hof van Justitie over een boete voor energieleverancier Essent

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a European Court ruling (Essent) that work permits for third-country workers posted by an EU-based provider are not required, and how enforcement under the Wav and the Posting Directive would be affected. The minister said the ruling removes the permit requirement under conditions, will extend the notification duty to cover these workers to aid enforcement, and that Dutch room to amend the Posting Directive is limited, though efforts will continue.
To be able to check these conditions, I am extending the notification obligation, which already applies to other forms of service provision, to the category of workers covered by the Essent ruling.

Om deze voorwaarden te kunnen controleren, breid ik de notificatieplicht zoals die nu al geldt voor andere vormen van dienstverlening, uit tot de categorie van werknemers die door het arrest Essent wordt bestreken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouw en Van Weyenberg over het hoge ziekteverzuim bij de Rijksoverheid

MPs Schouw and Van Weyenberg asked why sick leave in the central government (5.2% in 2013) is above the national average and the highest of all sectors, whether a target exists, what it costs, and how re-integration and wage sanctions by the UWV can be improved. Minister Blok confirmed the figures, argued that the comparison with the national average is misleading because of age and job-type differences, declined a separate study, set no single sector target, and promised further re-integration measures and a review of sick-pay agreements.
In 2013, a wage sanction was imposed in 23% of WIA applications submitted by employees in the central government, police and judiciary sector.
Bij 23% van de WIA-aanvragen die zijn ingediend door werknemers in de sector «rijksoverheid, politie en rechterlijke macht», is in 2013 een loonsanctie opgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Werkgevers vernietigend over ziektewet tijdelijk personeel’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about employers' criticism of the sickness benefit rules for temporary staff and about risk-avoidance and selection under the Wet BeZaVa, and when it will be evaluated. The minister defends the activation measures, says the survey findings on employer behaviour are not yet proven, and promises a monitor and survey by end 2015 and an effect study by late 2016.
I think it is too early to make a statement now about the effects of the Wet BeZaVa, precisely because I expect this law to lead to behavioural changes.
Ik vind het te vroeg om nu al een uitspraak te kunnen doen over de effecten van de Wet BeZaVa, juist omdat ik verwacht dat deze wet zal leiden tot gedragsveranderingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over de brief ‘Beleidsreactie op het WODC rapport over de au-pairregeling’

An MP from the VVD asks why the au pair scheme is being tightened on the basis of a 2012/2014 WODC study, given that the 2013 Modern Migration Policy Act already tightened enforcement, and why the government wants to cut weekly hours, require a Dutch course and limit cultural exchange. The State Secretary and Minister reply that the study shows widespread overwork and heavy household tasks contrary to the scheme's cultural-exchange purpose, that intensified enforcement and a declaration of commitment will be used, that the Dutch course is encouraged rather than mandatory, and that the letter sent with the answers contains the decision.
Therefore we are intensifying enforcement with the aim of improving compliance with the rules and detecting more violations.
Daaarom intensiveren wij de handhaving met als doel de naleving van de regels te verbeteren en meer overtredingen op te sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam,Omtzigt en Segers over de radicale prediker ‘Tarik ibn Ali’ uit België die naar Gouda

Three MPs asked the ministers whether a Belgian imam with radical messages, invited by a Gouda mosque board, would be barred and whether criminal action was underway. The minister answered that no hateful content is currently expected, the local authority has agreed no incitement will occur, criminal action would follow if it did, and no Belgian investigation is known.
At this moment we have no indications that this person is coming to the Netherlands to proclaim a hateful or inciting message.
Op dit moment hebben wij geen aanwijzingen dat deze persoon naar Nederland komt om een haatzaaiende of opruiende boodschap te verkondigen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat steeds meer buschauffeurs worden vervangen door vrijwilligers

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether replacing bus drivers with volunteers constitutes job displacement and whether volunteers should be used on regular bus lines. The minister said displacement is only unacceptable when caused by unfair competition, that local and provincial governments are responsible for public transport, and that he is working with the UWV on defining volunteer work under the WW unemployment rules.
I speak of job displacement when employees lose their jobs through unfair competition.
Ik spreek van werkverdringing als werknemers door oneerlijke concurrentie hun baan verliezen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk, Siderius en Van Gerven over sluikreclame op scholen

MPs from the SP asked the government whether food companies' so-called educational visits to schools (such as Ronald McDonald Shows and Blue Band lesson packs) amount to disguised advertising and should be banned. The Secretary of State answered that the Reclamecode voor Voedingsmiddelen permits such campaigns only with approval from a recognised authority, promised tightened rules by end 2014 and a letter in spring 2015, but rejected a statutory ban.
I expect the intended tightening to be in place by the end of this year. In spring 2015 I will inform you about this and give you my response.
Ik verwacht dat de beoogde aanscherpingen uiterlijk aan het einde van dit jaar tot stand zijn gekomen. In het voorjaar van 2015 zal ik u hierover informeren en u mijn reactie hierop geven.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Kerstens en Karabulut over het bericht dat een ondernemer een boete heeft gekregen van €12.000,- , omdat hij niet beschikte over de vereiste tewerkstellingvergunning

MPs Schouten, Kerstens and Karabulut asked why a Veenendaal employer was fined €12,000 for employing a Bulgarian worker without a work permit, although UWV had mediated the worker, and whether the fine should be withdrawn and the fraud law amended. The Minister says UWV should have warned the employer, the fine was reduced by 100% on objection, UWV has agreed to flag permit requirements, and a warning option will be introduced in the Wav.
It would have been desirable if UWV WERKbedrijf had pointed the employer, in the July 2012 conversation, to the obligation to apply for a work permit.
Het was wenselijk geweest als UWV WERKbedrijf de werkgever in het gesprek in juli 2012 had gewezen op de verplichting een tewerkstellingsvergunning aan te vragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Kerstens en Karabulut over het bericht dat een ondernemer een boete heeft gekregen van €12.000,- , omdat hij niet beschikte over de vereiste tewerkstellingvergunning

MPs Schouten, Kerstens and Karabulut asked why a Veenendaal employer was fined €12,000 for employing a Wajong beneficiary without a work permit even though UWV had mediated the placement, and whether the fine would be waived and the law changed. Minister Asscher explained the fine was reduced 100% on appeal, acknowledged UWV should have warned the employer, agreed measures with UWV, and promised a warning option in the Wav this autumn.
It would have been desirable if UWV WERKbedrijf had pointed the employer, in the July 2012 conversation, to the obligation to apply for a work permit.
Het was wenselijk geweest als UWV WERKbedrijf de werkgever in het gesprek in juli 2012 had gewezen op de verplichting een tewerkstellingsvergunning aan te vragen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schouten, Kerstens en Karabulut over het bericht dat een ondernemer een boete heeft gekregen van €12.000,- , omdat hij niet beschikte over de vereiste tewerkstellingvergunning

MPs Schouten, Kerstens and Karabulut asked why a Veenendaal employer was fined 12,000 euro for employing a Wajong youth without the required work permit, although UWV had mediated the placement, and whether the fine should be waived or the law changed. The minister acknowledged UWV's error, reduced the fine by 100% on objection, agreed with UWV to alert employers, and promised a warning option in the Wav.
I regret this state of affairs. It would have been desirable if UWV WERKbedrijf had pointed the employer, in the July 2012 conversation, to the obligation to apply for a work permit.
Ik betreur deze gang van zaken. Het was wenselijk geweest als UWV WERKbedrijf de werkgever in het gesprek in juli 2012 had gewezen op de verplichting een tewerkstellingsvergunning aan te vragen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Dikkers over het bericht dat uitzendkrachten in de pluimveesector structureel worden onderbetaald

MPs Kerstens and Dikkers asked Minister Asscher about reports that temporary agency workers in the poultry sector are structurally underpaid, and whether the Inspectorate SZW and the SNCU have acted. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has run 229 poultry inspections since 2009 with fines mainly for working conditions, none for minimum wage violations, that the SNCU lacks jurisdiction over agencies mainly active in poultry, and that the Inspectorate will investigate three recent formal cao-compliance requests and may discuss the issue with sectoral social partners.
The Inspectorate SZW recently received three formal requests to start a cao-compliance investigation in the poultry sector.
Recentelijk heeft de Inspectie SZW een drietal formele verzoeken ontvangen om een cao-nalevingsonderzoek te starten in de pluimveesector.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Kerstens en Karabulut over overtredingen van de TNO-normen voor statijden bij de luchthavenbeveiliging op Schiphol

MPs asked the minister whether maximum standing times for airport security staff at Schiphol, based on TNO norms, are an adequate protection against health risks and whether the state as shareholder should press Schiphol after FNV found an average overrun of 81 minutes per worker per day. The minister said responsibility lies primarily with security firms as employers, that TNO norms are useful, and that he is exploring ways to encourage clients to consider safe work, promising further discussion with parliament.
I am exploring options to encourage clients to take healthy and safe working by contractors into account.
Ik ben bezig met een verkenning van mogelijkheden om opdrachtgevers te stimuleren om rekening te houden met gezond een veilig werken bij de opdrachtnemers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de islamitische bedreiging van een christen

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about reports of a Christian man being spat on and threatened by Muslims, whether the perpetrators were arrested, whether Yezidis are also threatened, and what measures will prevent escalating violence linked to returning jihadists. The minister answered that a complaint was filed, no arrests yet, no indications of threats to Yezidis, and pointed to the integrated jihadism action programme for measures.
The criminal investigation has not yet led to arrest(s).
Het strafrechtelijk onderzoek heeft nog niet tot aanhouding(en) geleid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, De Roon en Wilders over de berichten ‘Werknemers pro forma tot de islam bekeerd’ en ‘werknemers bekeerd voor klus’

PVV MPs asked whether reports that Dutch workers were pro forma converted to Islam for a job in Saudi Arabia were known, and how their safety and the Saudi restrictions on non-Muslims were viewed. The minister confirmed awareness, said there were no indications the workers were at risk, declined to judge Saudi policy or the company director's stance, and said the matter would be raised in regular contacts.
The matter will be raised in the regular contacts between Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands.
De kwestie zal opgebracht worden in de reguliere contacten tussen Saoedi-Arabië en Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Madlener over het bericht 'Moldaviërs halen Roemenen in'

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs, Foreign Affairs and Infrastructure about reports of Dutch transport firms 'flagging out', foreign drivers, lorry parking and the sale of passports and driving licences, and whether borders should be closed to Eastern European workers. The government answered that data on flagged-out firms and job losses is unavailable, that it cannot track non-EU nationality entitlements, that enforcement is being strengthened in cooperation with the ILT and Inspectie SZW, and that closing the labour market is not a realistic option.
It is not known how many Dutch lorry drivers have lost their jobs since the labour market was opened to Romanians, Bulgarians and Poles.
Het is niet bekend hoeveel Nederlandse vrachtwagenchauffeurs sinds de openstelling van de arbeidsmarkt voor Roemenen, Bulgaren en Polen hun baan hebben verloren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de bevinden van FNV Bondgenoten, dat op de Nederlandse wegen opmerkelijk veel vrachtwagenchauffeurs van buiten de EU zijn aangetroffen.

An MP asked the ministers whether FNV's finding of many non-EU truck drivers on Dutch roads is accurate, whether they hold Polish work permits and whether this is a sham construction, and what enforcement, cooperation and legislative steps are planned. The government replies that no data show such numbers, gives Polish permit figures without knowing how many worked in the Netherlands, and points to expanded ILT enforcement, Inspectie SZW support for collective agreement enforcement, EU-level action and the forthcoming Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies.
There are no figures available showing that a remarkably large number of truck drivers from outside the European Union are driving on Dutch roads.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar waaruit blijkt dat opmerkelijk veel vrachtwagenchauffeurs van buiten de Europese Unie op de Nederlandse wegen rondrijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smaling en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat IKEA de Nederlandse wet omzeilt met Slowaakse chauffeurs

MPs Smaling and Ulenbelt asked whether the government will act on reports that IKEA circumvents Dutch law using Slovak drivers, and whether the inspectorate will check the Slovak carrier's operations. The minister says the inspectorate supervises Dutch carriers, has met the FNV about its reports, and cannot itself investigate a foreign company but could request action from the foreign authority.
The ILT has no authority to conduct its own investigation at a company established abroad.
De ILT heeft geen bevoegdheid om zelf onderzoek te doen bij een in het buitenland gevestigd bedrijf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over het omzeilen van de Nederlandse wet door IKEA

MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether IKEA circumvents Dutch wage law by using Slovak drivers paid partly through allowances, and whether the minister will hold principal clients like IKEA accountable and have the Inspectorate investigate. The minister said the Inspectorate lacks a legal basis to examine clients, that the client's responsibility is being studied within the anti-sham-constructions action plan, and pointed to planned measures in the Wet Aanpak Schijnconstructies.
The ILT has no legal basis for conducting such an investigation.
De ILT heeft geen wettelijke basis voor het doen van dergelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jadnanansing en Vermeij over het bericht dat er banen verdwijnen voor mbo-niveau 2 en 3 leerlingen

MPs Jadnanansing and Vermeij asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs about a news report that 500,000 MBO level 2 and 3 jobs would disappear permanently, and how education and labour market links would be ensured. The minister rejected the claim as poorly supported, acknowledged technological and globalisation pressure on middle-skilled jobs, and pointed to labour market information, the study guide, the macro-efficiency bill and a planned career-route experiment as responses.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de bonussen van de top van Estro kinderopvang

An MP asked the ministers whether they condemn bonuses paid to Estro childcare's top management shortly before its bankruptcy, and about the pre-pack restructuring and the role of shareholders. The ministers said the curator will examine whether the bonuses can be recovered, and that the curator's findings on the pre-pack and shareholders will be reported to parliament.
The curator will of course investigate this.
De curator van Estro zal dit vanzelfsprekend onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "bonussen voor de top van kinderopvangorganisatie Estro"

An SP MP asked the ministers about bonuses paid to Estro's top executives shortly before its bankruptcy, the secret takeover by investor HIG, the lack of serious market testing, and dismissal and severance for staff. The government answered that the curator is examining whether bonuses can be recovered, that the courts rather than ministers judge the specific case, and that a legal framework for pre-pack bankruptcies is being prepared.
At the outset, it must be stated that it is not for us as ministers of Social Affairs and Employment and of Security and Justice to assess this specific practical situation.
Voorop gesteld moet worden dat het als ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en Veiligheid en Justitie niet aan ons is om deze specifieke praktijksituatie te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over achterstallige vergoedingen en declaraties van werknemers van kinderdagopvangorganisatie Estro

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why employees of childcare organisation Estro were not paid their outstanding expense claims through the UWV wage guarantee scheme while directors reportedly received bonuses before the bankruptcy, and what would be done about it. The Minister disputes the description, says UWV is processing about 3,600 bankruptcy benefit claims with most already paid on account, and says the curator is examining whether the pre-bankruptcy bonuses can be recovered, with conclusions expected in December 2014.
The lawfulness of bonuses paid shortly before the bankruptcy is the subject of investigation by the curator.
De rechtmatigheid van bonussen, die vlak voor het faillissement zijn uitgekeerd, is onderwerp van onderzoek door de curator.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ’Poolse chauffeurs raken op’

An MP asked whether non-EU lorry drivers are being brought in while Dutch drivers are unemployed, and whether weekend rest in lorry cabs at parking areas should be banned. The ministers answered that enough EU labour is available, very few work permits for drivers were issued, and a bill against sham constructions is planned, while stating that weekend rest at service areas is undesirable but not prohibited by EU rules and that the inspectorate will act against structural violations.
No more work permits are issued for drivers, because there is sufficient priority-entitled supply available.
Voor chauffeurs worden geen tewerkstellingsvergunningen meer afgegeven, omdat er voldoende prioriteitgenietend aanbod aanwezig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over de teruggave van kinderopvangtoeslag in 2012

An SP MP asked whether it is acceptable that some parents still lack clarity from the Tax Administration about 2012 childcare benefit repayments, and whether they may face financial hardship, plus whether lost interest will be repaid. The State Secretary answered that about 8,000 post-2012 applications exist with 3,700 final decisions so far, that parents bear responsibility for accurate applications, and that statutory interest is paid on back payments.
Naturally I consider it desirable that benefit applicants obtain certainty as quickly as possible about the lawfulness of their application and the resulting award.
Vanzelfsprekend vind ik het gewenst dat aanvragers van toeslagen zo snel mogelijk zekerheid krijgen over de rechtmatigheid van hun aanvraag en de daarop gebaseerde toekenning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Van Ojik over teveel uitgekeerde kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Siderius and Van Ojik asked how parents facing childcare allowance recovery over missing child address data or administrative errors can reverse it, and whether an independent body should review such cases. The State Secretary replied that recovery only occurs when legal conditions are unmet, that parents can object or provide documents, that the Auditdienst Rijk and objection and appeal routes already exist so extra review is unnecessary, and refused to suspend recovery before the 24 September debate.
Given the safeguards mentioned above, I am of the view that additional investigation is not necessary.
Ik ben gezien de hiervoor genoemde waarborgen van mening dat aanvullend onderzoek niet nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over de berichten ‘Nederlandse Marokkanen nu ook in Marokko berecht’ en ‘Luxe auto’s en appartementen: daar gaat het geld naartoe’

PVV MPs asked about reports that Dutch-Moroccan dual nationals are detained and prosecuted in Morocco, how many dual nationals are detained and still receive benefits, and whether citizenship, assets, and benefits should be withdrawn or repatriation encouraged. The minister confirmed about 150 dual nationals detained in each country, explained benefit termination via data exchange, rejected the claim of hundreds involved in killings, noted existing asset-seizure and Moroccan benefit-check powers, and declined denaturalisation and benefit restrictions based on work history.
If a person is in detention and receives a benefit from the Dutch state, this benefit is terminated.
Indien een persoon in detentie verblijft en een uitkering van de Nederlandse staat ontvangt, wordt deze uitkering beëindigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Voordewind, Van der Staaij, De Roon en Van Bommel over de demonstratie op 1 juni tegen het Armeens herdenkingsmonument in Almelo

MPs from several parties asked the government about a June 2014 demonstration in Almelo against an Armenian genocide memorial, including alleged Turkish state involvement, slogans, and whether the Turkish consul or Diyanet mosques were involved. The government answered that the claims could not be verified in several cases, that demonstration rights were respected, that a criminal complaint was under assessment by the Public Prosecution Service, and that the issue would be considered in a separate parallel-communities study.
The cabinet is aware of these reports, but they could not be verified.
Deze berichtgeving is het kabinet bekend, maar deze was niet te verifiëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten ‘Ouders top-25 geven niet thuis’ en ‘Aanpak top-24 zaak van lange adem’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government will strip Moroccan criminals and their families of Dutch nationality and deport them, arguing that the soft approach to crime yields nothing and that parents should bear responsibility. The Minister rejects shifting responsibility to parents, explains that deprivation of nationality is only possible for state-undermining offences with sentences of 8+ years, and refuses to move neighbourhood officers to Morocco.
Revoking Dutch nationality and deportation following a conviction for ordinary offences is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit en uitzetting wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de overdracht van de pensioenen van oud-mijnwerkers aan Aegon

The SP MP Ulenbelt asked the minister how she judges transferring the pensions of former miners from the Mijnfonds AFM and BFM to insurer Aegon, whether this is necessary, what it means for members, and how the age profile, benefit levels and indexation history look. The State Secretary answered that social partners decide on the pension provider, that she declines to judge individual cases, and that the ministry lacks fund-level data, which DNB cannot disclose under the Pensioenwet.
Because supplementary pensions are a matter of employment conditions, social partners decide which pension provider the scheme is placed with.
Vanwege het arbeidsvoorwaardelijke karakter van de aanvullende pensioenen besluiten sociale partners bij welke pensioenuitvoerder de pensioenregeling wordt ondergebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de angst van joodse burgers in de Haagse Schilderswijk

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about fear among Jewish residents of The Hague's Schilderswijk after recent antisemitic incidents, including whether extra protection and an investigation into those planning to leave were warranted. Minister Opstelten answered that additional protective measures are being taken at Jewish institutions, that no separate investigation will be carried out, and that the government will raise the issue at a roundtable on antisemitism.
We do not intend to carry out an investigation as suggested in the question.
Wij zijn niet voornemens tevens een onderzoek zoals in de vraag wordt gesuggereerd te verrichten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht «Vrouw uit Nederland hielp al-Shabaab met geld»

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked about a report that a Dutch woman financed al-Shabaab, whether other cases of jihad fundraising in the Netherlands are known, and whether the government will investigate Islamic funding flows and detain, denaturalise and deport those financing jihad. The minister answered that suspicious transactions are passed to investigative services without disclosing details, that a WODC study on foreign funding of Islamic institutions is underway (Somalia not included), and that terrorism financing is punishable with prosecution decided case by case, while citizenship can be revoked after a final conviction and that possibility is being extended.
Since the reports concern personal or investigative data, I cannot say anything about the content of the reports.
Aangezien de meldingen persoonsgegevens dan wel opsporingsgegevens betreffen, kan ik over de inhoud van de meldingen geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Oskam over de doorstart van het kinderdagverblijf Estro

Two CDA MPs asked whether investment firm HIG, a part-owner of bankrupt childcare company Estro, arranged a pre-packaged sale and re-start in which it effectively negotiated with itself, and whether directors or HIG should be held liable. The Minister answered that the curator's report describes a lawful pre-pack process, that HIG was the highest bidder after other bids were sought, that liability is for the curator and courts, and that creditors generally benefit from pre-packs.
It is for him to assess whether there are indications that the directors were guilty of mismanagement in the run-up to the bankruptcy.
Het is aan hem om te beoordelen of er aanwijzingen zijn dat de bestuurders zich in de aanloop naar het faillissement schuldig hebben gemaakt aan wanbeleid.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het feit dat openbare school De Tweemaster in Duindorp (Scheveningen) leerlingen halalvoedsel heeft voorgeschoteld tijdens schoolkamp, zonder dat de oude

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether they knew that a Scheveningen public school served halal food on a school camp without informing parents, which other Hague schools did the same, who initiated it, and whether the mayor would be urged to combat such practices. The government confirmed awareness, said it does not centrally register camp meals and that the school is responsible, explained the camp site offered one halal-compliant evening meal for practical reasons, and declined to direct the mayor, referring questions to the school.
I am not aware which schools spent their school camp in Vledder.
Het is mij niet bekend welke scholen hun schoolkamp in Vledder hebben doorgebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over ongewenste gevolgen van de premiekorting voor oudere werknemers

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about possible adverse effects of the wage-tax premium discount for older workers, including whether employers dismiss older staff to replace them with subsidised older jobseekers and whether a taxi-sector vacancy form asking about benefit status is acceptable. The Minister answered that the discount is meant to help older benefit recipients find work, that data on individual employers are unavailable, that dismissals for subsidy purposes are unlikely to be rational, and that no regulatory change or new evaluation is planned beyond the 2019 review.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Cameron beperkt uitkeringen voor EU-migranten’

An MP asked whether the Netherlands could follow the UK in halving the period EU migrants may claim benefits, after UK Prime Minister Cameron announced such a cut. The minister replied that Dutch jobseekers get no social assistance so a halving is not applicable, and that EU workers keep worker status for at least six months under the free movement directive, with equal treatment required under Regulation 883/2004.
Distinguishing between migrants and Dutch nationals in benefit conditions is not permitted under the anti-discrimination rule.
Onderscheid binnen de uitkeringsvoorwaarden tussen migranten en Nederlanders is op grond van het discriminatieverbod niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht 'Haatimam in de ban'

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report on a hate-preaching imam, asking whether Islamic teaching should lead to closures and expulsions, whether Turkey's influence via imam appointments should be stopped, how mayors should respond, and whether migration and citizenship should be restricted. The minister answered that religion is not for the government to judge, that the state is neutral on imam appointments provided Dutch law is respected, that visas are refused to preachers calling for hate, that citizenship deprivation for terrorist offences is being expanded, and that the state acts where the rule of law is breached.
Where the limits of the rule of law are exceeded, the government acts, regardless of what inspired certain acts or statements.
Waar de grenzen van de rechtsstaat worden overschreden, treedt de overheid op, ongeacht waardoor bepaalde handelingen of uitspraken zijn geïnspireerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de  'radicaliseringsaanpak' van dit kabinet

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about the government's approach to radicalisation, including meeting hate imams with mayors, the failure of the earlier 2007-2011 programme, the link between jihadism and Islam, and closing mosques or expelling imams and returning Syria fighters. The ministers answered that hate preachers are denied visas and can be handled administratively, that prior programme lessons are kept in a knowledge bank, that violent jihadism conflicts with the rule of law, and that nationality revocation for terrorist offences is being prepared.
Preachers or imams from visa-required countries who are known to call for hatred and violence are refused a visa.
Aan predikers of imams uit visumplichtige landen en van wie bekend is dat zij oproepen tot haat en geweld, wordt een visum geweigerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Schouw over het bericht dat haatimams moeten worden aangepakt

Two D66 MPs asked how the government intends to stop hate preachers (haatimams), whether criminal law or a conversation with mayors is the right tool, how often such cases occurred and whether visas or residence permits were refused, and why the focus is on imams rather than other radicalising channels. The ministers answered that visa refusal, administrative measures and criminal law (art. 137d) apply, that no imam-related residence permits were refused on national security grounds in 2012-2014, and that a broader multi-year programme with mosques and local government on radicalisation is planned.
Criminal law applies (article 137d of the Criminal Code) to public statements that incite hatred against people because of their race, religion or belief.
Het strafrecht is van toepassing (artikel 137d Wetboek van Strafrecht) op openbare uitspraken die aanzetten tot haat tegen mensen wegens hun ras, godsdienst of levensovertuiging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, De Graaf en Bosma over alinea's uit het AIVD-rapport "Transformatie van het jihadisme in Nederland"

MPs asked whether the government knows of AIVD passages describing a salafist preacher and others passing intolerant and jihadist views to children, and whether the preacher will be detained, expelled and his institution closed. The minister declined to name the preacher or the institution citing operational secrecy, said administrative detention is not deemed necessary given existing criminal and administrative tools, and pointed to an integrated action programme and the Agenda Integratie.
I cannot make public statements about operational matters.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over operationele aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Siderius over "durfkapitalisten in de kinderopvang"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about private equity involvement in childcare chain Estro's bankruptcy, job losses, locations not taken over, profit margins, market concentration and whether to ban such ownership and restore cuts. The minister replied that the fiscal construction has been closed, about 30 locations closed, quality is being monitored, and that a ban on resale and a restoration of cuts will be decided in integrated budget deliberations.
From the government's side, the fiscal construction that made this kind of investment attractive has now been made impossible.
Vanuit de overheid is de fiscale constructie die dit soort investeringen aantrekkelijk maakte inmiddels onmogelijk gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over “verslechterde arbeidsvoorwaarden na de overname van Estro”

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about worsened employment conditions after the Smallsteps takeover of childcare provider Estro, including whether older permanent staff were replaced by young temporary workers and what rights transferred employees have.
