The minister answered that employees received unchanged terms from Smallsteps, that the transfer-of-undertaking rules do not apply after bankruptcy (a question the courts may decide, as FNV plans litigation), and that the curator is investigating the causes of the bankruptcy with no completion date.
A judgement on this specific situation is reserved for the court, should FNV indeed ask the court for one.
Een oordeel over deze specifieke situatie is voorbehouden aan de rechter mocht deze daarom inderdaad door de FNV worden gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Madlener en De Graaf over het bericht dat een buschauffeur een persoon in een boerka heeft geweigerd

MPs Madlener and De Graaf asked the government about a report that a bus driver refused a woman wearing a burqa, and whether burqa bans should be pursued given security concerns. The State Secretary answered that the government considers face-covering clothing undesirable where communication is seriously hindered, that a legal ban in education, care, public transport and government buildings is being prepared, and that the driver's refusal was contrary to the carrier's rules, so apologies were offered.
According to the carrier's company rules, the burqa wearer should have been treated in the same way as all other passengers.
Volgens de bedrijfsregels van de vervoerder had de boerka-draagster op dezelfde manier behandeld moeten worden als alle andere reizigers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de stelselmatige terreur tegen joden in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked how the government will respond to reported systematic intimidation and threats against Jewish people in the Netherlands, including antisemitism linked to anti-Israel demonstrations, and who pays for security costs. The minister condemns antisemitism, outlines dialogue and an interfaith meeting, explains the limits of the mayor's powers over demonstrations, and says the state covers security measures it imposes while individuals are first responsible for their own protection.

The cabinet will, as also announced in the joint statement after consultation with Jewish organisations on 4 August, take the initiative with all relevant parties to discuss the rising tensions between groups and intervene where necessary.

Het kabinet zal, zoals ook is aangekondigd in de gemeenschappelijke verklaring na het overleg met de Joodse organisaties op 4 augustus jongstleden, in navolging van verschillende gemeenten, het initiatief nemen met alle betrokken partijen om de oplopende spanningen tussen groepen te bespreken en waar nodig te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs en Lucas over het bericht ‘Chinese horeca onder druk door gebrek aan koks’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about shortages of Chinese cooks and UWV's handling of work permits and job-matching for the Asian catering sector. The minister defended the labour-market test and UWV procedures, said the UWV project placed few workers, and promised further talks with the sector and UWV on a temporary solution.
I am willing to talk with UWV to examine whether the application can be simplified on a number of aspects, provided this information can be obtained in advance in another way.
Ik wil wel met UWV in gesprek gaan om te onderzoeken of op een aantal aspecten de aanvraag kan worden vereenvoudigd, mits deze informatie dan wel op een andere wijze vooraf verkregen kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over antisemitische incidenten in Nederland

An MP asked the ministers about the rise in antisemitic incidents in 2013 (147 vs 114 in 2012), measures against online antisemitism, and whether the government would investigate perceptions of Israel. The minister called the figures worrying, outlined round-table and education initiatives, said research on perceptions of Israel would not be commissioned, and committed to further meetings and reviews.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat er gigantische onrust heerst onder alleenstaande ouders met een bijstandsuitkering vanwege fors inkomensverlies in 2015

Karabulut (SP) asked whether the government would reverse the income losses for single parents on social assistance caused by the 2015 child benefit reform and how many would be affected. Minister Asscher answered that the reform removes the single-parent supplement, that about 78,500 single parents on benefits are affected, that the income effects will be shown in the 2015 budget, and that the reform is expected to have only small effects on poverty and to be monitored.
No figures are available on the realised purchasing power development of single parents on social assistance.
Er zijn geen cijfers beschikbaar over de gerealiseerde koopkrachtontwikkeling van alleenstaande ouders in de bijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een stijgend aantal stagiairs fulltime werkt zonder enige vergoeding

MP Karabulut asked the minister whether unpaid full-time internships are increasing, what criteria define a stage, how many internships and pay levels exist, and whether rules or Inspectorate checks should follow. The minister said he lacks data to confirm the trend, set out criteria distinguishing a stage from work, declined to add new rules, and said the Inspectorate will act only on concrete complaints.
Performing an internship without any financial reward is as such not an offence.
Het verrichten van een stage zonder dat daar een financiële beloning tegenover staat is als zodanig geen overtreding.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Siderius en Yücel over diabeteshandelingen op het kinderdagverblijf

MPs Siderius and Yücel asked the Minister whether parents of children with diabetes face a gap in childcare, since regular daycare staff will not administer insulin and children lack a medical daycare indication, and whether the medical-act classification could be revisited. The Minister acknowledged the problem, pointed to wijkverpleegkundige arrangements, and declined a separate study while awaiting an education-ministry review due in October.
For that reason I see no need to carry out a separate exploration.
Ik zie om die reden geen noodzaak om een aparte verkenning uit te voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Klaveren over “het groeiende antisemitisme en anti-Israëlsentiment”

The MP asks the ministers about a Sparta goalkeeper calling the CIDI a criminal organisation, the KNVB's response, why Muslim communities do not condemn conflicts abroad, and whether antisemitism is growing. The minister deplores the remark, notes the KNVB and Sparta see no role for themselves, and defers the question on growing antisemitism to a parallel answer given to the Prime Minister.
Both the KNVB and football club Sparta see no role for themselves in this.
Zowel de KNVB als voetbalclub Sparta zien hierin geen rol voor zichzelf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over de groei van het anti-homogeweld

MPs Van Klaveren and Bontes asked about a reported rise in violence against gay people in Amsterdam, whether it is structural, the ethnic background of suspects, and whether repressive measures should replace prevention. The minister acknowledged a modest rise in registered incidents (176 to 189), declined to record suspects' ethnicity, and restated a combined prevention and repression approach included in the Veiligheidsagenda 2015-2018.
The national police does not record the ethnic background of suspects or perpetrators.
De Nationale politie registreert niet op de etnische achtergrond van verdachten of daders.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de artikelen 'Nederlandse Joden huren bewaking in', 'Angst onder Rotterdamse joden na bedreiging op straat', 'Gesprek moet helpen' en 'Antisemitisme: 'Zo doen wij

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the government about press reports on Jewish security, antisemitism, a housing association's letters ordering removal of an Israeli flag, Muslim discrimination, and revoking Dutch nationality from jihadist travellers. The minister answered that the housing association regretted its letters and no action is planned, an antisemitism study is due in early 2015, and nationality can only be revoked after a terrorism conviction under limited conditions.
A study into possible breeding grounds and triggering factors for antisemitism ... will be delivered in early 2015.
Een onderzoek naar mogelijke voedingsbodems en triggerfactoren voor antisemitisme ... zal begin 2015 worden opgeleverd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Siderius over "zorgmedewerkers die na ontslag als vakantiekracht bij hun oude werkgever aan de slag moeten gaan"

SP MPs asked whether care workers dismissed by employers are rehired as cheaper holiday staff, questioning UWV's dismissal permits, the lower pay, and the consequences for care quality. The minister replied that UWV grants permits only for structural job loss, that no evidence of wrongful permits exists, that counts are not held, and that employers and UWV bear responsibility, pointing to new transition measures.
I have no indications that UWV wrongly granted dismissal permits.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat UWV ten onrechte ontslagvergunningen heeft verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Anne Mulder over de rechterlijke uitspraak dat de FNV vakbondsleden voortrekt.

MPs Van Weyenberg and Anne Mulder asked whether a court ruling that FNV unfairly gave union members higher severance under a social plan breaches good employer conduct, whether the Postcodeloterij comparison is apt, what legal framework allows union-member benefits, whether courts or the Inspectie SZW should review such agreements, how the government acted on a motion against disadvantaging non-members, and what measures it would take. The minister answered that contractual freedom permits distinctions only within limits of good employer conduct and equal pay, that courts rather than the government review such clauses, that social partners say existing law suffices, and that no measures are planned.
A ruling on the legal validity of a collective agreement provision such as in the above-mentioned lawsuit is reserved for the civil court.
Een oordeel over de rechtsgeldigheid van een cao-bepaling zoals bedoeld in de bovengenoemde rechtszaak, is voorbehouden aan de burgerlijke rechter.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de demonstratie van ISIS-aanhangers

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about reports of an ISIS-supporter demonstration in The Hague, including alleged Hitler salutes, racist chants, and a threatened journalist. Minister Opstelten answered that police observed no hate-inciting or offensive texts, that investigations found no Hitler salute, and that prosecution decisions rest with the public prosecutor.
It is for the public prosecutor to judge whether criminal limits were exceeded in this case.
Het is aan het OM om te oordelen of er in dit geval strafrechtelijke grenzen zijn overschreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Bontes over een demonstratie in de Schilderswijk

Two MPs asked the ministers about a demonstration in the Schilderswijk in The Hague, including why police rerouted an anti-ISIS march, how many people were arrested, whether such neighbourhoods undermine state authority, and whether a billion euros should be invested in the police. The government answered that six people were arrested, referred to earlier answers on the policing and order questions, rejected the call for an extra billion euros for the police, and said the police have sufficient resources.
During the demonstration of 10 August, six persons were arrested.
Tijdens de demonstratie van 10 augustus jl. zijn er 6 personen aangehouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Oskam en Pieter Heerma over de onrust tijdens de IS-betoging in Den Haag

CDA MPs asked whether a counter-demonstration disrupting an anti-IS march in The Hague, allegedly by sympathisers with IS, is worrying, how many arrests were made, and what the government will do to prevent further incidents. The minister condemned IS and stressed fundamental rights, explained that mayors under the Public Manifestations Act cannot ban demonstrations for their content, and said the Public Prosecution Service had not been informed of other incidents.
The Public Prosecution Service has not been informed of incidents other than those in The Hague during demonstrations.
Het Openbaar Ministerie is niet op de hoogte gesteld van incidenten – anders dan die in Den Haag – tijdens demonstraties.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht van de Inspectie SZW dat in de sector zorg en welzijn 50% van het arbeidsgerelateerde ziekteverzuim wordt veroorzaakt door psychosociale arbeidsbelasting

Pieter Heerma (CDA) asked the minister about an Inspectorate SZW report that psychosocial workload causes 50% of work-related sickness absence in care and welfare, and whether self-employed people with burn-out are denied disability benefits because insurers do not treat it as a medical cause. The minister replied that burn-out is not excluded under standard private disability insurance, that exclusions occur only in some budget policies and individual cases, and that he sees no reason for further research or measures.
I therefore see no reason to conduct research into the number of self-employed persons who cannot insure themselves against burn-out.
Ik zie dan ook geen aanleiding om onderzoek te doen naar het aantal zelfstandigen dat zich niet kan verzekeren tegen het krijgen van een burn-out.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de voorgenomen nieuwbouw van de Tevhit-moskee in Venlo-Zuid

MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked whether the government knows of the planned new Tevhit mosque in Venlo, its links to the Turkish Diyanet foundation, its financing, and whether it will block construction. The government confirmed the plan, noted the mosque appears on the foundation's list of branches, said it does not interfere in financing of religious buildings absent suspicion of illegal acts, and pointed to freedom of religion under Article 6 of the Constitution while stating construction is allowed if Dutch law is respected.
The construction of new mosques or other places of worship is permitted in the Netherlands, on condition that Dutch rules and laws are not violated.
De bouw van nieuwe moskeeën of andere gebedshuizen is in Nederland toegestaan, op voorwaarde dat de Nederlandse regels en wetten niet worden overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Maij over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij het Europees Octrooibureau

MPs Kerstens and Maij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alleged harsh working conditions at the European Patent Office in Rijswijk, including limits on strikes, communication with unions and suspensions. The minister said he could not confirm the characterisation, that the EPO has functional immunity and its own staff rules, and that the Labour Inspectorate cannot inspect the premises without the President's consent, so it held only a talk with management.
The European Patent Office is an international organisation with the corresponding diplomatic immunity.
Het Europees Octrooibureau is een internationale organisatie met de bijbehorende diplomatieke immuniteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over het niet-uitvoeren van verplichte inspecties bij kinderopvang

Tellegen (VVD) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the roughly 7.3% of childcare centres not inspected as legally required, and whether municipal inspection and staffing shortfalls were due to too little central funding. Minister Asscher answered that municipal inspection has improved, that funding is sufficient, and that planning tools, a best-practice guide and improvement trajectories are being introduced, with an evaluation and a fuller report to follow.
I dispute the picture that the current supervision is not in order.
Ik bestrijd het beeld dat het huidige toezicht niet op orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over "Verhoging Ziektewetuitkeringen uitzendkrachten"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a reported 7% rise in sickness benefits for temporary agency workers was an unforeseen cost burden on employers caused by the 2013 change in daily wage rules, and whether it was tied to reintegration failures. The minister said the rise was an unforeseen effect of the new daily-wage rules, not of the Ziektewet modernisation, that UWV monitoring found no trend break, and that no measures would be taken beyond continuing the monitor.
I will inform the House of Representatives about the results of the monitor and the evaluation of the law.
Ik zal uw Kamer informeren over de resultaten van de monitor en de evaluatie van de wet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Helder en De Graaf over straatcoaches

The MPs asked whether street coaches, subsidised by municipalities, conceal crimes from police, whether police agreements with them obstruct information flow, and what the government will do given a Movisie study finding them ineffective. The minister said local authorities are responsible for such arrangements, that no national agreements exist, and that he will discuss the Movisie findings with the VNG and report to the House.
It is the responsibility of the local authority to make agreements on the deployment of street coaches and cooperation with the police.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van het lokaal bestuur om afspraken te maken over de inzet van straatcoaches en de samenwerking met de politie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over het bericht dat Eritreërs in Nederland onder grote druk staan van de Eritrese regering

Two SP MPs asked whether the government would back Eritrean residents pressured to pay a diaspora tax, enable anonymous reporting, investigate the tax, and close the Eritrean consulate. The government answered that the tax is not illegal per se if voluntary, that anonymous reporting is possible case by case, that the issue is being pursued at EU level, and that closing the embassy is not currently on the table.
To establish abuses, the public prosecution service and police depend substantially on reports and complaints from victims.
Om misstanden vast te kunnen stellen zijn het OM en politie in belangrijke mate afhankelijk van aangifte en melding door slachtoffers.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het verstrekken van het burgerservicenummer

MP Azmani asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the municipality of Rotterdam's idea of withholding citizen service numbers (BSN) from EU migrants in cases of overcrowded housing is acceptable, and what can be done about overcrowding and nuisance. The minister answered that EU law does not allow withholding or refusing a BSN for this purpose, pointed to municipal instruments and pilots on registering residence addresses, and said the cabinet will seek allies in Europe against abuses of free movement.
Although I find this an interesting idea, European regulations leave no room for no longer issuing or temporarily withholding the BSN when there is overcrowding.
Hoewel ik dit een interessante gedachte vind, biedt de Europese regelgeving geen ruimte voor het niet meer verstrekken of het tijdelijk aanhouden van het BSN wanneer er sprake is van overbewoning.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Ojik over "het bericht dat een gezin de dupe is geworden van een bedrag aan teveel ontvangen kinderopvangtoeslag dat terugbetaald dient te worden”

MPs Van Ojik and Ulenbelt asked about a family forced to repay childcare allowance after an administrative error, and whether repayment is applied for mere paperwork gaps. The government answered that missing address data alone does not trigger repayment, that parents can supplement data before repayment, and that individual cases cannot be discussed due to confidentiality.
Due to the duty of confidentiality, I, the State Secretary of Finance, cannot address the situation of the people from the Hart van Nederland report.
Vanwege de geheimhoudingsplicht kan ik, de staatssecretaris van Financiën, hier niet ingaan op de situatie van de mensen uit de reportage van Hart van Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over de berichten «Islamists infiltrating schools in Hamburg» en «Engelse scholen in greep van moslimradicalen»

PVV MPs asked the government whether Dutch schools face Islamist infiltration like reported cases in Hamburg and England, and whether Islamic schools should be closed. The government answered that the Inspectorate has found no signs of such infiltration, that radicalisation incidents are monitored through the biennial social safety monitor, and that closing Islamic schools is not warranted beyond the legal grounds of public order.
The inspectorate has not received any indications that Dutch education currently faces the Islamic infiltration you cite.
Vanuit de inspectie zijn geen aanwijzingen gekomen dat er in het Nederlandse onderwijs op dit moment sprake is van de door u aangehaalde islamitische infiltratie
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over een islamitische geweldsprediker

An MP asked the ministers whether preacher Al-Haddad's activities in Almere, a municipality labelled a jihad town, are monitored and whether such preaching harms integration. The minister stated that hateful or violence-inciting statements are unacceptable, that individual monitoring cannot be disclosed, and that the mayor had publicly distanced herself from the preacher and reminded the inviting group of its responsibilities.
I cannot make public statements about the application of measures on an individual basis.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen over de toepassing van maatregelen op individuele basis.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Wilders en Helder over de ronselfilm ‘Fighting Journalists, Oh Oh Aleppo “De spookstad”

Three PVV MPs asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers whether they knew of a jihadist recruitment film targeting Dutch youth, whether it aimed at recruiting for jihad, how they view the fact that the people involved are third-generation Dutch-born, and whether they would prosecute the makers and strip citizenship from dual nationals. The minister confirmed knowledge of the film, said it intends to radicalise and recruit youth, stated that recruitment for jihad is a crime with prosecution decided case by case by the Public Prosecution Service, and noted citizenship can be revoked after a final terrorism conviction where dual nationality exists.
Recruiting for jihad is a crime. The Public Prosecution Service decides case by case on possible prosecution.
Het ronselen voor de jihad is een misdrijf. Het openbaar ministerie beslist per geval over eventuele vervolging.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Nijboer en Hamer over de berichten 'Aardschokken ook een kans' en 'Laat het werk niet weglopen'

MPs Van Dekken, Nijboer and Hamer asked about reports that small Groningen builders are losing repair work to large firms, the labour needed for earthquake-damage repair, and the new facilities company 'Groningen versterkt'. Minister Kamp answered that homeowners freely choose contractors, expects a positive economic impulse, notes labour estimates vary pending the executing organisation, and cannot yet assess the initiative because the framework is not yet set.
However, I cannot currently confirm that these numbers of construction workers are needed.
Ik kan echter op dit moment niet bevestigen dat deze aantallen bouwvakkers nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het stimuleren van grensoverschrijdende arbeid door het slechten van barrières

Kerstens (PvdA) asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he agrees that unemployment in border regions could largely be solved by removing cross-border barriers, and when the Chamber will receive the response to the Bruls advisory report and the 16 December 2013 conference results. The minister answered that the government sent its reaction on 13 June, which incorporates the conference results, and that a GROS progress report will follow later this year.
The cabinet sent the Chamber its response on 13 June regarding the Bruls advice on removing practical obstacles to cross-border labour.
Het kabinet heeft op 13 juni jl. een reactie naar uw Kamer gestuurd over het advies «wegnemen praktische belemmeringen bij grensoverschrijdende arbeid» van de heer Bruls.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de berichten ‘Moskee moet plaats bieden aan duizenden’ en ‘Moslims onder druk om bijdrage moskee’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Wilders asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports on a Gouda mosque expansion, including alleged pressure on members to contribute 1,500 euro and past fundraising for Syria. The minister answered that mosque construction is a matter of religious freedom, that contributions must be voluntary and that pressure is rejected, while stating no evidence was found that funds went to jihad and that financing falls within Dutch law.
The board is entitled to ask mosque visitors for a financial contribution toward the construction of a new mosque.
Het bestuur is gerechtigd om de bezoekers van de moskee een financiële bijdrage te vragen ten behoeve van de bouw van een nieuwe moskee.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de stand van zaken in Irak en de opmars van ISIS

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about returned Syria jihadists, recruiters, terror financing, mosque closures and denaturalisation/detention of returnees. The government answered that about thirty returnees are known, that operational details and locations are not disclosed, that prosecutors and services monitor them, and that mosque closure and nationality revocation are possible under specific legal conditions.
Operational matters and specific cases cannot be disclosed publicly.
Over operationele aangelegenheden en concrete gevallen kunnen in het openbaar geen mededelingen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Schouten over het bericht dat miljardenwinst door dwangarbeid en seks behaald wordt

MPs Segers and Schouten asked the ministers of Social Affairs and of Security and Justice how the government responds to an ILO report on forced labour profits, its size in the EU and the Netherlands, migrant share, enforcement capacity, and international cooperation. Minister Asscher answered that the government is doing all it can, cites rising human trafficking prosecutions, says reliable victim estimates are lacking, and states support for the new ILO forced labour protocol.
It is my intention to ratify the new instrument as soon as possible, after going through the usual procedure.
Het is mijn intentie om het nieuwe instrument, na daartoe de gebruikelijke procedure te hebben doorlopen, zo spoedig mogelijk te ratificeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut over segregatie in het onderwijs

MPs Jasper van Dijk and Karabulut asked the government about falling school segregation, the end of the twelve city pilots, the lack of structural municipality-school consultation, and parents' initiatives for mixed schools. The Secretary of State answered that segregation is declining, the pilots' effects were modest so they will not be continued (municipalities may continue on their own), and that the matter is a decentralised municipal responsibility, so the outcome was passed to the VNG.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Pieter Heerma over het bericht ‘Duitsland mag EU-burgers uitkering weigeren’

MPs Azmani and Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a German court ruling allowing benefits to be refused to EU citizens, its consequences for a motion on refusing assistance to EU job seekers, and whether they would exchange experiences with German and Belgian counterparts. The minister replied that the case concerns an economically inactive person and an Advocate General's opinion rather than a ruling, that job seekers from other EU states already have no right to assistance so no bill is needed, and that consultation with Germany and Belgium takes place where relevant.
As regards job-seeking citizens from other EU countries, it already applies in the Netherlands that they have no right to assistance.
Voor wat betreft werkzoekende burgers uit andere landen van de Europese Unie geldt in Nederland al dat zij geen recht hebben op bijstand.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over de uitzending van Nieuwsuur over de mislukking van het anti-radicaliseringsbeleid

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Nieuwsuur broadcast on the failure of anti-radicalisation policy, including its cost (around 30 million euros), how the money was spent, and whether Islam is the root cause. The minister confirmed the broadcast, gave a budget breakdown (14.46 million spent over 2007-2011, with 78 projects funded and oversight via subsidy conditions), and rejected the link between Islam and radicalisation.
Decentralisation grants were paid out via the municipal fund. There was consultation about this, but no formal review or control applies.
Via het gemeentefonds zijn de decentralisatie-uitkeringen uitgekeerd. Daarover is wel overleg geweest maar is een officiële toetsing/controle niet van toepassing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bontes en Van Klaveren over Turkse rellen in Rotterdam

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked why only one person was arrested after riots by Turkish football supporters in Rotterdam, how costs would be recovered, and whether the riots reflect failed integration. The minister said the response focused on restoring public order, camera footage would be used to investigate offenders, damage recovery would be pursued through criminal and civil routes if damage is identified, and the incidents were treated as isolated.
Based on camera footage, further investigation will be carried out into persons who committed criminal offences.
Op basis van camerabeelden zal nader onderzoek worden gedaan naar personen die strafbare feiten hebben gepleegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bisschop en Dijkgraaf over het plan van het platform Bewust moslim om op de dag van dodenherdenking een symposium te houden over een zogenoemde schaduw Holocaust

MPs Bisschop and Dijkgraaf asked whether the government would try to stop a planned symposium on a so-called 'shadow Holocaust' and what powers the municipality had to prevent it. The Minister replied that the municipality and mosque cancelled the event, that ministers do not intervene in municipal matters or judge organisers' views, and that mayors may act only on public order grounds, not on the content of the meeting.
It is not for me as Minister to intervene in municipal affairs, nor is it for me to judge the views of people organising a meeting such as the questioners describe.

Het is niet aan mij als Minister om in gemeentelijke aangelegenheden te treden noch is het aan mij om de opvattingen te beoordelen van mensen die een bijeenkomst organiseren als door de vragenstellers bedoeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hilversumse moskee tart herdenking’

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government shares their revulsion at a Hilversum mosque comparing the Holocaust to the Arab attempt to prevent Israel's creation, and whether the mosque should be closed and its land rezoned. The minister confirmed awareness and said closure or dissolution is only possible under narrow legal conditions (public order, fire/safety violations, drug trade) and that zoning is a municipal responsibility, none of which apply here.
The zoning of land is a municipal responsibility.
De bestemming van gronden is een gemeentelijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over het beleid van kinderdagverblijven t.a.v. inentingen van kinderen waar zij zorg voor dragen

An MP asked whether parents have a right to know how daycare centres handle unvaccinated children and whether GGD inspections should cover this, and whether daycares may refuse unvaccinated children. The minister answered that parents may be informed and daycares may voluntarily register vaccination status, that outright refusal lacks a legal basis and could breach anti-discrimination law absent a justification, and that the minister will consult the GGD about raising vaccination registration in inspections.
The Minister of SZW will consult with the GGD on whether, in line with the RIVM advice, attention can be given during GGD inspections to registering the vaccination status of children in care.

De Minister van SZW zal in overleg met de GGD bezien of bij de GGD-inspectie – conform het advies van het RIVM – aandacht kan worden gegeven aan het belang van een registratie van de vaccinatiestatus van de opgevangen kinderen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken, Hamer en Nijboer over de berichten ‘Mobiliteitscentrum schiet tekort’ en ‘Er zijn juist heel heldere afspraken gemaakt’

MPs Van Dekken, Hamer and Nijboer asked about former Aldel workers at the Delfzijl mobility centre who complain about limited training options, UWV rules, sanctions, age discrimination and sick workers' access to the training fund. The minister answers that training is tailored, the EUR 2,500 cap was agreed as an average, 70 of 340 candidates have found work, and the government sees no evidence of targeted exclusion.
It was agreed that the amount of EUR 2,500 is used as an average available amount for training per candidate rather than as a maximum amount.
Hierbij is afgesproken dat het bedrag van € 2.500 als een gemiddeld beschikbaar bedrag voor scholing per kandidaat wordt gehanteerd in plaats van als maximum bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Beertema en Wilders over het bericht ‘In Nederland studerende Saoediër opgepakt in Kenia’

PVV MPs asked why the Netherlands contributes to the education of students from Islamic countries such as Saudi Arabia, and whether such students should be barred or expelled after a Saudi student was arrested in Kenya. The minister answered that internationalisation policy does not distinguish by religion, declined to comment on the individual case, and refused to bar or expel students from Islamic countries.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Ik doe geen mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het zoveelste anti-joodse incident

An MP asked the ministers about an antisemitic defacement of an Anne Frank poster, the causes of rising antisemitism, and whether the perpetrators have been caught. The government condemned the act, pointed to a planned follow-up study on triggers of antisemitism among youth due early 2015, and reported that police investigated but no suspect has been arrested.
To be able to combat antisemitism better, I previously promised a follow-up study examining the trigger factors that contribute to the emergence of antisemitism.
Om antisemitisme beter te kunnen bestrijden heb ik eerder een vervolgonderzoek toegezegd, waarin de triggerfactoren, die bijdragen aan het ontstaan van antisemitisme, worden onderzocht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over kermisgeweld door allochtone jongeren

An MP asked the ministers about youths harassing fairground visitors and shoppers in IJmuiden, whether the offenders would be arrested, and how to prevent them escaping with community service. The state secretary answered that police investigation is ongoing, that the local authority decides on measures, and that sentencing is for the judge, who may impose community service alone only in limited circumstances.
The police investigation into this incident has not yet been concluded.
Het politieonderzoek naar dit incident is nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Karabulut over de inzet van stakingsbrekers door de NS

MPs Ulenbelt and Karabulut asked whether the labour inspectorate is investigating alleged strikebreaking by NS (Dutch Railways) and whether it approved another firm cleaning trains. Minister Asscher answered that the inspectorate has received an FNV complaint but needs more information before investigating, that it never grants permission to break strikes, and that no strikebreaking by NS has been established.
The Inspectorate SZW received a report from the FNV that there would be strikebreaking.
De Inspectie SZW heeft een melding ontvangen van de FNV dat er sprake zou zijn van stakingsbreking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Van Meenen over leerlingen in het vmbo en praktijkonderwijs die geen stage mogen lopen

MPs Van Weyenberg and Van Meenen asked why students without a permanent residence permit can only do compulsory internships in BOL vocational courses and not in vmbo, praktijkonderwijs or hbo. The minister acknowledged the exemption was an omission, said he would extend the exemption to praktijkonderwijs, vmbo maatwerk routes and similar tracks, but not to hbo.
This is an omission. Besides mbo, there are other secondary education routes specifically aimed at acquiring work-placement experience, so that an internship is an essential part of the course.

Dit is een omissie. Naast het mbo zijn er andere onderwijsroutes in het voortgezet onderwijs die specifiek gericht zijn op het opdoen van beroepspraktijkvorming waardoor stage een essentieel onderdeel van de opleiding vormt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Potters over het artikel “Bouwplaats onveiliger door fraude”

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports of certificate fraud on construction sites, including threats against a whistleblower and the risk to safety. The minister condemned intimidation, said the risk depends on circumstances, listed enforcement and private certification measures, and reported three completed criminal investigations and one administrative case over four years.
That is why I have made inspection capacity available for investigations following reports of fraud.
Daarom heb ik inspectiecapaciteit beschikbaar gesteld voor onderzoeken naar aanleiding van meldingen van fraude.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Lucas over het nieuwsbericht “Zelfstandigen niet voor de klas”

An MP asked the ministers whether the Tax Authority is actively questioning the self-employed status of freelance teachers in education, how it decides who counts as self-employed, and whether this threatens practical expertise in classrooms. The government answered that status is judged case by case under law and case law, that talks with education federations aim for national criteria, and that genuine self-employment will be protected while sham arrangements are tackled.
The Tax Authority is continuously in discussion with clients and their interest organisations about when self-employed persons without staff meet the criteria for self-employment.
De Belastingdienst is voortdurend in gesprek met opdrachtgevers en hun belangenorganisaties over de vraag wanneer zzp'ers aan de criteria voor zzp'er-schap voldoen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over het bericht over Europese sancties bij werkloosheid boven de 5%

An MP asked the Social Affairs minister about a proposed EU werkloosheidsnorm (unemployment norm) with sanctions above 5% unemployment, whether it could create jobs, its link to the budget norm, and whether it would require transfers between countries. The minister said member states, not Brussels, bear responsibility for unemployment, that the government will press for faster structural reform without copying the 3% deficit sanction mechanism, and declined to comment on hypothetical norms outside current EU policy.
I will not comment on possible consequences of norms that are currently not part of European policy or of the cabinet's position.
Ik ga niet in op eventuele gevolgen van normen die op dit moment geen deel uitmaken van het Europese beleid of van de kabinetsinzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li  Vos en Hamer over het bericht "TNT bespreekt reorganisatie pakketdienst"

Two MPs asked ministers about TNT Express's plan to replace permanent drivers and parcel couriers with subcontractors, and whether this constitutes bogus self-employment and whether the Tax Authority should refuse VAR declarations. The minister answered that such replacement is undesirable if used to evade employment protection, that UWV will judge any dismissals, that the Tax Authority cannot verify VAR applications by former employees, and that the Inspectorate SZW's sector exploration is being followed up with planned talks with the sector.
If employees in permanent employment are replaced by self-employed contractors in order to cut costs, that is extremely undesirable.
Als werknemers in vaste dienst worden vervangen door zzp’ers om op die manier de kosten te drukken, dan is dat uiterst onwenselijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het bericht “Zeker 10.000 ongelukken door slecht Nederlands”

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether language barriers undermine safety rules and whether regulation should give way to practical feasibility, citing reports of thousands of workplace accidents linked to poor Dutch. The minister answered that employers must assess and address language-related risks under the performance-based Arbowet, supported by sector guides and arbocatalogi, and announced plans to agree with employers on improving workplace language.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Weyenberg over “het feit dat het UWV vrijwilligerswerk onmogelijk maakt”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs why the UWV's rules on volunteering while receiving unemployment benefit (WW) led to a local bus line in Zaanstreek being at risk, and whether a neighbourhood bus driver counts as volunteer work and whether displacement of paid jobs is at stake. The Minister says each case is assessed by the UWV under existing rules, displacement of paid work must be avoided, and he will propose loosening the rules before the summer recess.
I am therefore examining how the current rules can be loosened and will inform the House before the summer recess of the outcome.
Ik bekijk daarom hoe de huidige regels verruimd kunnen worden en informeer uw Kamer voor het zomerreces over de uitkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mishandeling van een gehandicapte bejaarde

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about a reported assault and robbery of a disabled elderly man, including the suspects' background, whether arrests were made, and whether criminal foreigners should be expelled for violent crimes. The minister says the Public Prosecution Service found the report to be a false complaint and explains the existing rules for expelling foreign offenders.
Research by the Public Prosecution Service shows that there was a false complaint.
Uit onderzoek van het Openbaar Ministerie blijkt dat er sprake is van een valse aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Hamer over het bericht dat de grenzen wagenwijd open staan voor buitenlandse bouwers

MPs Monasch and Hamer asked whether German administrative requirements imposed on Dutch construction firms, such as prior registration of workers and posting of deposits, conflict with EU free movement and whether Dutch SMEs can be protected, including via a LIMOSA-type register. The minister replied that host-state rules must be necessary and proportionate, that the government will push for reduction of disproportionate requirements, and that a registration system and identity passes are being considered in implementing the new enforcement directive.
The Netherlands is currently examining which control measures it wishes to adopt and will make a proposal for this when implementing the Enforcement Directive.
Nederland beziet thans welke controlemaatregelen zij wenst over te nemen en zal hiervoor een voorstel doen bij de implementatie van de Handhavingsrichtlijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Ojik over de stijgende werkloosheid en de mogelijke komst van een banenplan

An MP from GroenLinks asked the Prime Minister and Minister Asscher about rising unemployment at 8.7%, the withdrawal of young people from the labour market, and reported talks on a jobs plan with social partners. The government answered that unemployment is the top priority, attributed the levelling-off to discouragement effects, outlined existing measures, and said proposals from social partners would be considered in budget discussions.
The cabinet is willing to discuss any proposals from social partners with them and will then seriously consider them in the context of the budget discussions for the coming year.
Het kabinet is bereid om eventuele voorstellen van sociale partners met hen te bespreken en zal ze dan serieus bezien in het kader van de begrotingsbesprekingen voor het komende jaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Raak over de inzet van onbevoegd personeel op Schiphol tijdens de nucleaire top (NSS)

An MP asked whether temporary agency workers without standard screening or Schiphol passes were deployed airside at Aviapartner Cargo during the nuclear security summit, and whether this amounted to strike-breaking. The minister answered that the Royal Marechaussee found all agency workers were screened and held passes, that the ban on strike-breaking applies to all employers, and that the Inspectie SZW investigation into possible strike-breaking was still ongoing.
The Inspectorate SZW supervises the Waadi (the Act on the allocation of labour through intermediaries).
De Inspectie SZW houdt toezicht op de Waadi (de Wet allocatie arbeidskrachten door intermediairs).
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Helder en Wilders over het bericht ‘Buurtvader Gestel: “Ik ga derde overvaller Deurne niet aangeven”

PVV MPs asked why no action was taken against a neighbourhood father who said he would not name the third robber of a Deurne jeweller, and whether he should be arrested and whether Moroccans distrusting the Dutch should give up benefits and leave. The minister declined to comment on the ongoing investigation and rejected the claim of a failed integration and parallel society, and rejected the benefit-surrender idea by restating that everyone has equal rights and duties.
The investigation into the robbery in Deurne – and therefore also the investigation into all possible suspects – has not yet been concluded.
Het onderzoek naar de overval in Deurne – en daarmee ook het onderzoek naar alle mogelijke verdachten – is op dit moment nog niet afgerond.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het onverminderd doorzetten van offshoring

MP Pieter Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether offshoring by Dutch firms is rising, what the job losses are, and what measures will curb offshoring and promote reshoring. The minister replied that offshoring is part of globalisation without clear job-loss figures, pointed to existing investment-climate and participation-law measures, and promised to monitor a total-cost-of-ownership model and report to the Chamber before summer.
Before the summer I will inform the Chamber further about progress on reshoring.
Voor de zomer zal ik de Kamer nader informeren over de voortgang rondom reshoring.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Yücel over de mogelijke postcodediscriminatie bij energiebedrijf Oxxio

Two MPs asked the ministers whether energy company Oxxio's creditworthiness checks and deposit demands amount to postcode discrimination under the Equal Treatment Act, and whether the minister would act against Oxxio or other energy firms. The minister replied that Oxxio does not decide on postcode alone, that the postcode plays only a limited role, that no direct discrimination was found, and that the ACM and the Equal Treatment bodies are the proper channels, so no further steps were planned.
Oxxio states that no increased risk is established on the basis of the postcode alone.
Oxxio geeft aan dat er geen verhoogd risico vastgesteld wordt op basis van enkel de postcode.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders over het bericht ‘Vorig jaar twintig doden door eergerelateerd geweld’

PVV MPs asked the government about a report of twenty honour-related deaths in 2013, probing the role of Islam, shelter data, whether victims relocate for safety, and deportation or denaturalisation of perpetrators. The minister answered that the figures are being collected and the LEC EGG network continues, that culture rather than religion drives honour codes, that shelter nationality data is not kept, and that denaturalisation for common crimes is not permitted under the Dutch law and the European Nationality Convention.
Nationality and religious background are not recorded by the Federatie Opvang.
Nationaliteit en religieuze achtergrond worden niet bijgehouden door de Federatie Opvang.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de groei van het aantal eerwraakmoorden

An MP asks the ministers of Security and Justice and Social Affairs about the reported growth in honour killings, whether this is linked to immigration from Islamic countries, what measures will be taken, and whether perpetrators should be deported after serving their sentences. The minister confirms awareness of the reported figures and refers the MP to earlier answers to parallel questions, without substantive answers in this document.
I refer to my answers to the written questions from members De Graaf and Wilders of your House.
Ik verwijs naar mijn antwoorden op de schriftelijke vragen van de leden De Graaf en Wilders van uw Kamer
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Tanamal over het onderzoek van Panteia naar het bezit van een arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering onder zzp’ers

MPs Mei Li Vos and Tanamal asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Panteia study showing most self-employed without staff lack disability insurance, whether this is undesirable, its cause (premium levels), whether they would require social assistance, and whether mandatory insurance should be reintroduced. The minister answered that choice is free, that a broad interdepartmental policy study on self-employed social security will report by year-end, and that data on benefit recipients is unavailable.
Based on the IBO, I want to examine, among other things, whether there is reason and scope to increase the insurance rate.
Op basis van het IBO wil ik onder meer bezien of er aanleiding is en mogelijkheden zijn om de verzekeringsgraad te verhogen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de integratie van Somaliërs

An MP asked the minister about the poor integration outcomes of Somali Dutch people, the effects of abolishing target-group policy, and whether a dedicated action plan and study support for older refugees are possible. The minister acknowledged the concerning picture, defended the generic integration approach with room for tailored measures, pointed to existing stakeholder meetings, and described municipal and student-finance options.
I recognise the findings of the research and share your view that it shows a worrying picture of the position of Somalis.
Ik herken de uitkomsten van het onderzoek en deel met u dat dit een zorgelijk beeld laat zien van de positie van Somaliërs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Potters over het bericht «Fraude Marokkanen aangemoedigd»

Two VVD MPs asked whether a Euro-Mediterranean centre (Emcemo) was right to urge elderly Moroccans not to hand over their Moroccan CIN number to the SVB, whether this breaks the law, and what consequences it has for fraud investigation. The government replied that not providing the CIN number at this stage does not violate the WWB, that Emcemo breaks no legal provision, that the CIN number will only be requested if follow-up research in Morocco is needed, and that refusal could lead to benefit suspension case by case.
People who have now been asked for the number do not need to send it anymore.
Mensen aan wie het nummer nu gevraagd is, hoeven het niet meer mee te sturen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over Verklaring arbeidsrelatie (VAR) voor zzp’ers

MPs from D66 asked the government how the Tax Authority can grant and then withdraw VAR-WUO declarations for care freelancers working through agencies, and how many were reviewed and reclassified. The minister explained that VARs are assessed on submitted facts, that roughly 900 of about 1,500 reviewed cases were reclassified as employment, and that the pilot was extended to address the problem.
The cabinet will shortly start an interdepartmental policy study on freelancers to examine whether laws and regulations for freelancers and employees are sufficiently in balance.

Het kabinet zal op korte termijn een Interdepartementaal Beleidsonderzoek (IBO) starten met betrekking tot zzp'ers om te bezien of wet- en regelgeving voor zzp'ers en werknemers voldoende in balans zijn
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het groeiende verschil in inkomens tussen werknemers en bestuurders van bedrijven

The SP MP Karabulut asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the growing pay gap between top executives and workers, whether smaller income gaps improve national performance, the absolute pay figures for several firms, and whether collective agreements should cover executive pay. Minister Asscher answered that executive pay is a matter for the social partners, that the government will strengthen works council involvement in executive pay via a WOR amendment and the Corporate Governance Code remains the main instrument, and that he has no company-level pay data, while citing the WNT pay cap for public and semi-public sector executives.
The cabinet will amend the WOR so that each year a conversation takes place between the executive and the works council about the development of pay ratios, including those of the board.

Het kabinet zal de WOR zodanig aanpassen dat jaarlijks een gesprek tussen bestuurder en de ondernemingsraad plaatsvindt over de ontwikkeling van de beloningsverhoudingen, inclusief die van het bestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over het bericht dat een bedrijf voor een vacature “mensen van Hollandse bodem” zoekt

Two PvdA MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a company advertising for staff 'of Dutch soil' and whether this constitutes employment discrimination by origin. The minister called such discrimination unacceptable, explained that vacancy texts fall under the Equal Treatment Act and that assessment rests with the courts or the Equal Treatment Commission, and promised an action plan on labour market discrimination in May.
Whether there is discrimination in this job advertisement is for the judge or the Equal Treatment Commission to assess.
Of er in deze personeelsadvertentie sprake is van discriminatie staat ter beoordeling aan de rechter of het College voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Kuiken over het besluit van Philip Morris om 90% van het personeel van haar fabriek in Bergen op Zoom te ontslaan

Two MPs asked ministers how they judge Philip Morris's plan to dismiss 90% of its Bergen op Zoom workforce, whether they will act quickly, and whether reshoring and a mobility centre are being pursued. The minister answered that the decision is a commercial one, that the ministry has contacted the firm, that a mobility centre financed by Philip Morris is being prepared, and that a regional economic strengthening plan and a study of reshoring will follow.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over discriminatie van zwangere vrouwen op de arbeidsmarkt

MP Karabulut asked the Minister of Social Affairs what he would do about pregnancy discrimination in the labour market after the College for Human Rights called for action and 45% of pregnant women reported possibly discriminatory experiences. The minister answered that discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to information gaps among employers and employees, said the government will await an SER advisory report and then present an action plan that may include measures against pregnancy discrimination.
I indicated, including during the General Consultation on Integration of 12 March, that following the SER advice I will come with an action plan on tackling discrimination in the labour market.

Ik heb, onder andere tijdens het Algemeen Overleg Integratie van 12 maart jl., aangegeven dat ik naar aanleiding van het SER advies met een actieplan met betrekking tot de aanpak van discriminatie op de arbeidsmarkt zal komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht 'Zorg dat migranten onder de CAO vallen'

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether EU posted-worker rules let migrant workers be paid less than domestic staff for equal work, and whether the Posting of Workers Directive should change. The minister replied that posted workers are entitled only to a core set of conditions, that the government is pursuing a broad anti-abuse approach and a bill with civil liability for wages, and that the Enforcement Directive is the main EU response.
The cabinet therefore combats unfair competition on working conditions with a broad approach to sham constructions.
Het kabinet bestrijdt daarom met een brede aanpak van schijnconstructies de oneerlijke concurrentie op arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ‘Buitenlandse uitzendkrachten worden genept met goedkope zorgpolis”

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that employment agencies deduct health insurance costs from foreign temp workers' wages, possibly benefiting employers and insurers, and whether this is lawful. The minister answered that employers may negotiate shares of collective discounts, that acting as an insurer without a licence would be unlawful and was referred to De Nederlandsche Bank, that the SNA certification does not check such deductions, and that the minister lacks the requested insurer data but will talk with sector parties.
I have brought the CNV note to the attention of De Nederlandsche Bank.
Ik heb de notitie van de CNV onder de aandacht gebracht van De Nederlandsche Bank.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Bruins Slot over het bericht “buitenlandse uitzendkracht genept met goedkope zorgpolis”

An MP asked whether health insurance tied to temporary agency workers' contracts is being used against them, including employers keeping collective discounts, unclear policy terms, and loss of cover on dismissal. The minister answered that workers are free to decline employer-offered policies, that employers must not withhold policy information, and that she will discuss the matter with employment agencies, employers and unions.
It is not intended that the employer or the health insurer profit from this at the expense of the migrant worker.
Het is niet de bedoeling dat de werkgever of de zorgverzekeraar daar ten koste van de arbeidsmigrant voordeel uit haalt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over allochtone homohaters uit Amersfoort

MPs asked the ministers about reports that a gay man in Amersfoort was driven out of his neighbourhood by harassment from young men, and whether mass immigration and Islamisation hinder gay emancipation and whether perpetrators should be expelled or punished more harshly. The ministers condemned discrimination, said perpetrators must be tackled and victims protected, rejected expulsion of Dutch nationals, and listed existing local and national support measures without new concrete commitments.
Perpetrators must be tackled and victims protected.
Daders moeten worden aangepakt en slachtoffers beschermd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Tellegen en Rutte over inenten op de kinderopvang

Two VVD MPs asked whether childcare centres may refuse unvaccinated children and what can be done about unvaccinated children in childcare. Minister Asscher answered that there is no legal basis for a blanket refusal, that refusal is only justified case by case under proportionality rules judged by the College voor de rechten van de mens or courts, and that the sector will discuss the matter with RIVM.
There is no legal basis for a blanket refusal to admit unvaccinated children to childcare facilities.
Er is geen juridische basis voor een algehele weigering om niet ingeënte kinderen toe te laten tot kinderopvangvoorzieningen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut en Kooiman over het idee om agenten vrij te maken die zich alleen bezig moeten houden met criminaliteitsbestrijding onder Tilburgers van Marokkaanse en Antilliaanse afkomst

MPs Karabulut and Kooiman asked whether the government endorses a Tilburg VVD proposal to assign police specifically to crime-fighting among residents of Moroccan and Antillean descent, and whether there is a police capacity problem in Tilburg. The minister says targeted youth policy was used in the past and is now part of regular policy, stresses effectiveness and warns against unjustified ethnic distinction, and says he has no signals of a capacity problem in Tilburg, with the mayor able to request more capacity.
We must of course guard against a targeted approach toward these groups leading to unjustified distinction.
We moeten er uiteraard voor waken dat een gerichte aanpak op deze groepen zou leiden tot het maken van ongerechtvaardigd onderscheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Gesthuizen over de aanpak van vacaturefraude

An SP MP asked the Ministers of Justice and Social Affairs about vacancy fraud (money mule schemes), its scale, the measures taken against it, and whether victims who became unwitting money launderers could receive leniency. The Minister described the scheme, reported complaint and report figures, the UWV's screening and registration measures, and said leniency must be judged case by case by the prosecutor and courts.
No figures are available on the number of criminal cases concerning this specific form of fraud.
Er zijn geen cijfers over het aantal strafzaken aangaande deze specifieke verschijningsvorm van fraude beschikbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over de informatie voor grensarbeiders over het doolhof aan regelgeving

MPs Van Weyenberg and Sjoerdsma asked about complex cross-border rules for frontier workers, the shift from personal to electronic service at the Bureaus Belgische/Duitse Zaken, and funding for a central back office. The state secretary said digital information is adequate, that personal services are a regional responsibility, and that a back office at the SVB will be funded through 2018 at EUR 700,000 per year.
We will therefore ensure that a back office run by the SVB through the Bureaus is possible until the end of 2018.
Wij zullen er daarom voor zorg dragen dat uitvoering van een back office door de SVB via de Bureaus tot eind 2018 mogelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de uitspraak dat het aantal leerbedrijven met 10.000 gestegen zou zijn

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether his tweet about 10,000 new training companies despite the crisis accurately reflects the UWV/SBB report, and questions the causes of slower growth, the effect of youth unemployment policy and whether the report calls for intensified policy. The minister defends the tweet as accurate, notes 9,200 companies dropped out, attributes the shift to bol-track internships and states the policy will continue with concrete sector plans and monitoring.
I can imagine that confusion arose because at the same time more than 9,000 companies also dropped out.
Ik kan me voorstellen dat er verwarring is ontstaan omdat er tegelijkertijd ook ruim 9.000 bedrijven zijn afgevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het toenemende antisemitisme

An MP asked the minister about rising antisemitic incidents, whether they relate to mass immigration and Islam, and how the government will respond to a professor's claim about Islamic antisemitism. The minister confirmed the rise in reported incidents, denied a link to immigration, pointed to research on youth antisemitism, and said the government will focus on combating youth antisemitism.
No, I do not see that relationship.
Nee, die relatie zie ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg, Bergkamp en Koolmees over VAR-verklaringen voor zzp’ers

Three D66 MPs asked the ministers about the Belastingdienst's handling of VAR declarations for self-employed workers (zzp'ers), including reports of fewer VAR-WUO grants in healthcare and revocations for 250 people tied to care intermediaries. The government replied that the criteria have not changed, that enforcement against false self-employment has increased, and that a planned joint-liability rule for clients and an online VAR module are under development.
The statutory confidentiality obligation means that no statements can be made about individual cases.
De in de wet verankerde geheimhoudingsverplichting maakt dat over individuele gevallen geen mededelingen kunnen worden gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over ‘jihadbruiden’

An MP asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers about female jihadist travellers to Syria, including passport measures, administrative detention and stripping dual nationals of Dutch citizenship. The minister answered that case-by-case criminal and administrative measures apply, that administrative detention is not considered necessary, and that citizenship can be revoked only after a final terrorism conviction for dual nationals.
I therefore do not consider it necessary to create additional administrative detention powers for counterterrorism.
Ik acht daarom het creëren van aanvullende administratieve detentiemogelijkheden ten behoeve van terrorismebestrijding niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht “Sjoemelen met moskeeën”

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether EU structural subsidy for a multifunctional centre in Amsterdam was misused to fund a mosque and gender-segregated Koran lessons. The minister answers that the mosque and the subsidised centre were separate parts of the building, that the EU fraud office OLAF is investigating the use of the subsidy and its outcome is awaited, and that the projects were checked by an accountant and the Auditdienst.
The outcome of the investigation cannot be anticipated.
Er kan niet worden vooruitgelopen op de uitkomsten van het onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over antisemitische propaganda door organisatie 'Stop de Bezetting'

An MP asked the ministers whether they were aware of antisemitic articles on the website of Stop de Bezetting, whether they condemn them, what they will do about the group's past funding from Oxfam Novib, and whether they will investigate antisemitic propaganda by subsidised organisations. The government condemned antisemitism, said the articles were not found on the site (one was found elsewhere), noted no subsidy relationship with the ministry, and said that only a court can determine discrimination, so filing a complaint is the appropriate route.
Whether there is discrimination under the criminal code can only be determined by the judge.
Of er sprake is van discriminatie op grond van het wetboek van strafrecht kan alleen de rechter bepalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Pieter Heerma over het bericht “België wil af van ‘arme’ Nederlanders”

MPs Azmani and Heerma asked the Minister of Social Affairs about Belgian reports on expelling EU nationals who become an unreasonable burden on social assistance, and whether Dutch practice and data-sharing with the IND and Belgian systems should change. The minister replied that the Netherlands already follows a similar course, that the Azmani/Hamer motion and the Rotterdam pilot are being worked on, that Dutch data exchange is not automated, and that the Belgium cooperation declaration focuses on integration rather than the Belgian control system.
Work is currently under way on implementing the Azmani/Hamer motion (dated 28 May 2013).
Op dit moment wordt gewerkt aan de uitwerking van de motie Azmani/Hamer (d.d. 28 mei 2013).

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht dat een vrijwilliger met een WW-uitkering in Steenbergen geen toestemming van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) krijgt om met een buurtbu

An MP asked the minister about UWV refusing a WW benefit recipient permission to volunteer as a driver for a local bus association, citing displacement of paid work, and how this fits the participation society and the tegenprestatie. The minister said he cannot comment on individual UWV decisions, that the person can appeal, and that volunteering by benefit recipients must not displace regular jobs, with UWV and municipalities responsible for oversight.
The person concerned can of course file an objection and also an appeal against the UWV decision to withhold permission for these activities.
Betrokkene kan uiteraard bezwaar en ook beroep aantekenen tegen het besluit van UWV om toestemming voor deze activiteiten te onthouden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schouten over de berichten dat het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) geen toestemming geeft voor vrijwilligerswerk

Member Schouten (ChristenUnie) asks the minister whether UWV's restrictions on volunteer work by benefit recipients are too strict and whether they will be loosened. The minister agrees volunteering can help job prospects, says benefit recipients must still meet job-search obligations, and announces proposals before summer to widen the possibility of volunteering while keeping WW benefits.
I will make proposals before the summer for widening the possibility of performing volunteer work while retaining WW benefits.
Ik zal voor de zomer voorstellen doen voor verruiming van de mogelijkheid om vrijwilligerswerk te verrichten met behoud van WW-uitkering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Van Dekken over het bericht ‘aangifte tegen hoofdaannemer centrale RWE/Essent’

MPs Hamer and Van Dekken asked the ministers whether the Public Prosecution Service would act on FNV's report that a main contractor at the Eemshaven RWE/Essent plant systematically underpaid subcontractors, and whether other subcontractors should be heard. The minister said a police report and criminal complaint were filed and are being assessed by the prosecutor, and described enforcement measures, a planned liability-for-wages bill and a pending cao-enforcement advisory request.
This complaint is being assessed by the Public Prosecution Service and its outcome cannot be anticipated.
Deze aangifte wordt beoordeeld door het openbaar ministerie en op de uitkomsten daarvan kan niet vooruit worden gelopen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Turkse campagnes tijdens de gemeenteraadsverkiezingen 2014

An MP from the PVV asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether campaigns for Dutch municipal elections should be conducted in Dutch, questioning the credibility of a minister responsible for integration who campaigned in Turkish. The minister answered that everyone has the same rights and duties, that political parties may reach non-Dutch speakers through campaigns, and that no measures are planned.
Political parties are free to reach these people and actively involve them in our democracy through a campaign.
Het staat politieke partijen vrij deze mensen te bereiken en actief te betrekken bij onze democratie door middel van een campagne.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over "de levenslange uitkering van remigranten"

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether it is fair that migrants who return under the Remigration Scheme receive a lifelong benefit, health insurance allowance and no job-seeking obligation, and whether the PVV proposal to abolish these will be adopted. The minister answered that the scheme targets long-term benefit-dependent migrants who voluntarily return, that payments are based on living costs in the country of origin and are lower than Dutch benefits, and that the amended Remigration Act takes effect on 1 July, referring to parliamentary debate for further detail.
On 1 July the amendment to the Remigration Act takes effect.
Op 1 juli aanstaande treedt de wijziging van de Remigratiewet in werking.
Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema (beiden PVV) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over indoctrinatie door de islamitische Gülenbeweging (ingezonden 3 februari 2014).

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the Gülen movement is anti-Western and indoctrinates children in Gülen study houses, and what measures will be taken. The minister answered that there is no evidence of Islamisation aims, could not confirm the 100-study-house figure, said parents may send children to such institutions provided they follow the law, and saw no need for measures.
I see no need to take measures.
Ik zie geen noodzaak om maatregelen te treffen.

Vragen van het lid Karabulut (SP) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het bericht dat de Gülen beweging in Nederland minimaal 100 studiehuizen heeft (ingezonden 4 februari 2014).

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the Gülen movement runs at least 100 study houses where Turkish-Dutch youths live without supervision, and whether these are successors to Gülen boarding schools. The minister answered that the source of the 100 figure cannot be traced, that the houses appear to be small shared student homes for adults, that the state has no overview of Gülen-linked organisations, and that the study houses fall under local authorities and private initiative outside school inspection, so no new action was committed.
The study houses fall under the responsibility of the local authorities.
De studiehuizen vallen onder de verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale autoriteiten.
Vragen van het lid Azmani (VVD) aan de Minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over «Minimaal 100 studiehuizen Gülen-beweging in Nederland» (ingezonden 5 februari 2014).

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of at least 100 Gülen-movement study houses in the Netherlands, including whether they fall under education inspection, whether they indoctrinate youth and whether they promote segregation. The minister said such private residences are not education under the inspection law, that the government finds isolation of youth undesirable, and that the studied Amsterdam houses had residents attending regular Dutch institutions.
Private initiatives such as these study houses do not fall under that.
Private initiatieven zoals deze studiehuizen vallen daar niet onder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over Haagse loyaliteit aan Al-Qaida

An MP asked whether the government recognises the violent character of a jihadist pledge made in The Hague, what links exist to Al-Qaida, and whether recruiting for jihad should be punished by denaturalisation and deportation. The minister declined to discuss individual cases, cited the existing criminal provision on recruitment and the limited grounds for revoking nationality, and said the government rejects such conduct while treating Islam as a religion and jihadist radicalisation as a security and integration issue.
I do not make concrete public statements about individual cases.
Ik doe in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen over individuele gevallen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de aanhoudende Marokkaanse straatterreur in Helmond

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked about youth street crime in Helmond, its harsh enforcement, the over-representation of Moroccan-Dutch youths in crime statistics, and why criminal non-citizens and dual nationals are not deported or stripped of nationality. The minister replied that policing has been intensified with a zero-tolerance approach, that the approach does not distinguish by ethnicity, that sentencing is for the prosecution service, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
The share of suspects among Moroccan-Dutch boys under 23 is indeed much higher than the share of suspects among native Dutch youths.
Het aandeel verdachten onder Marokkaans-Nederlandse jongens tot 23 jaar is inderdaad veel hoger dan het aandeel verdachten onder autochtone jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over “islamitische geweldsprediking”

An MP asks whether mosques calling for violence should be closed immediately and whether Islam is inherently violent, and urges action against 'Islamisation'. The ministers answer that incitement to violence is prohibited and the Public Prosecution Service can ask a court to close an institution acting against public order, but they reject judging a religion by a violent minority and do not commit to new measures.
Calling for hatred or inciting violence is explicitly not permitted.
Het oproepen tot haat of het aanzetten tot geweld is nadrukkelijk niet toegestaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over uitstel van het rapport van de commissie Dienstverlening aan huis

An MP asked why the mandate of the Commission Dienstverlening aan huis was extended and when its final report would reach parliament, and whether the report should be awaited before the Wmo 2015 bill proceeds. The minister gave reasons for the delay, promised the report by 30 April, and rejected the view that the Wmo 2015 bill must wait for the report.
The establishing decree has been extended to 30 April. I expect to be able to share the final report with the House by that date.
Het Instellingsbesluit is verlengd tot 30 april. Ik verwacht voor die datum het eindverslag met de Kamer te kunnen delen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Klever en Wilders over het zwichten van voetbalclub Vitesse voor de Jodenhaat van de VAE (Verenigde Arabische Emiraten)

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether Vitesse's decision to travel to the UAE without Jewish player Dan Mori, who was unwelcome there, reflects antisemitism and dhimmitude, and what measures would follow. The minister called the decision a bad signal, acknowledged concern about contemporary antisemitism and announced a study into its causes, but declined any measures against the club and noted that the question about admitting the player was moot after the team's return.
It was a bad signal from Vitesse to travel to the United Arab Emirates without its own player Mori.
Het was een slecht signaal van Vitesse om zonder haar eigen speler Mori af te reizen naar de Verenigde Arabische Emiraten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over het bericht ‘Vrouw en Turks, dus lagere vergoeding’ en ‘Familie: Rechter uit de jaren ‘50’

An MP asked the minister whether a court ruling that assumed a young Turkish-Dutch woman would have children at 26 and leave work for ten years, lowering her damages, amounts to sex or ethnic discrimination. The minister declined to comment on the specific ruling, citing separation of powers, noted the Equal Treatment Commission's 2012 findings on indirect sex discrimination, and pointed to government policy on combining work and care.
A Minister may not interfere in the judgment of an independent judge and must respect the separation of powers.
Een Minister mag niet in het oordeel van een onafhankelijke rechter treden en moet de scheiding der machten respecteren.
