Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paulus Jansen en Ulenbelt over de controle op kwartsstofemissies op bouwplaatsen

Two SP MPs asked how the Inspectorate SZW checks compliance with the quartz dust exposure limit on construction sites, including inspection frequency, filter and vacuum rules, and the value of real-time dust monitoring. The minister describes about 2,000 yearly site inspections with attention to hazardous substances, a six-week 2013 inspection campaign with 441 checks and 23 fines, reliance on general performance-based rules rather than equipment specifications, and rejects portable fine-dust meters as unsuited for quartz exposure assessment.

In doing so, the Inspectorate SZW checks, based on a visual inspection, whether the nature, extent and duration of quartz dust exposure has been assessed and whether the appropriate measures have been taken on the basis of that assessment.

Daarbij controleert de Inspectie SZW op basis van een visuele inspectie of de aard, mate en duur van de blootstelling aan kwartsstof is beoordeeld en of op basis van die beoordeling de juiste maatregelen zijn genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Kuiken over het plan van het Zweedse verpakkingsbedrijf Tetra Pak om zijn fabriek in Moerdijk eind dit jaar te sluiten

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about Tetra Pak's plan to close its Moerdijk factory, questioning the decision given strong 2013 results and asking what tools exist to keep investment in Dutch plants. The minister answers that the closure is a business decision the government cannot intervene in, lists existing innovation and investment subsidy instruments, and says the company is supporting affected workers through a social plan and talks with potential buyers of staff.
The plan to close the Moerdijk factory at the end of 2014 is based on business and strategic choices. The government cannot intervene in those.
Het voornemen om de fabriek in Moerdijk eind 2014 te sluiten is gebaseerd op bedrijfsmatige- en strategische keuzes. Daar kan de overheid niet in treden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Hamer over het bericht dat er weer veel banen verdwijnen bij MSD in Oss

MPs Jan Vos and Hamer asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about the loss of around 440 jobs at MSD in Oss, including how affected workers will be helped and what is being done with the municipality. Minister Kamp answered that a social plan with retraining support and an external job-placement firm is in place, that he is already in talks with MSD, Oss and the province, and that the Pivot Park offers opportunities for starters.
In cooperation with the municipality, province, Brabant Development Agency and MSD, I will examine what the possibilities are.
In samenwerking met de gemeente, provincie, Brabantse Ontwikkelingsmaatschappij en MSD zal ik bekijken wat de mogelijkheden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het AOW-gat voor studenten van de BES-eilanden

MP Van Weyenberg asked whether students from the Caribbean Netherlands lose AOW/AOV pension accrual when studying in the European Netherlands, whether voluntary AOW insurance is impossible abroad, and whether the government will seek a solution with the islands. The state secretary explained when AOV coverage ends and when students remain insured, confirmed no voluntary AOV option exists, and committed to discussing a solution with the island governments in June.
I am willing to jointly seek an appropriate solution with the administrative boards of the Caribbean Netherlands for the issue at hand.
Ik ben bereid gezamenlijk met de bestuurscolleges van Caribisch Nederland naar een passende oplossing te zoeken voor de onderhavige problematiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Hamer en Yücel over het voornemen van het concern AKZO om de productieafdeling van de vestiging Deventer naar het buitenland te verplaatsen

MPs Kerstens, Hamer and Yücel asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Social Affairs about AkzoNobel's plan to move production from Deventer abroad, costing about 215 jobs, and what the government could do. The minister replied that the decision is a business-economic one the government cannot interfere with, pointed to general business-climate policy and R&D retention in Deventer, and said the ministry had discussed the decision with the company's management.
However, the cabinet cannot interfere in the business-economic decisions of companies.
Het kabinet kan zich echter niet mengen in bedrijfseconomische beslissingen van bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat werkeloze jongeren de Nederlandse staat miljarden kosten

Karabulut (SP) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a report that unemployed youth cost the state billions, including FNV Jong's claim that discouraged youth are leaving the labour market and that the state's response is too small. Minister Asscher answered that the government shares concern, explained how youth unemployment is measured and that discouragement and return to education explain part of the drop in labour force, disputed FNV Jong's cost assumptions, and listed the Aanpak Jeugdwerkloosheid measures.
The cabinet does not agree with the remark of the chairman of FNV Jong.
Het kabinet is het niet eens met de opmerking van de voorzitter van FNV Jong.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Karabulut, Hamer en Ojik over verslechterde arbeidsomstandigheden van schoonmakers bij de Belastingdienst

MPs asked whether the government would intervene after cleaners at several Belastingdienst sites complained of worsened working conditions, including higher workload, refused sick notices, and alleged intimidation, and whether the Inspectie SZW would investigate. The State Secretary answered that a yearly workload monitor and talks with contractors and cleaners will address the complaints, that Apeldoorn capacity was increased, and that no Inspectie SZW investigation is warranted.
Given the aforementioned measures, I see no reason to ask the Minister of SZW to involve the Inspectie SZW.
Ik zie, gezien de voornoemde maatregelen, geen aanleiding om de Minister van SZW te vragen de Inspectie SZW in te schakelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht ‘Situatie rond gastouderopvang is onveilig’

An SP MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about reports of unsafe childcare by host parents (gastouders), including inspection rates, employment status, and whether host parents should be employed by agencies. The minister says safety measures have been strengthened, inspection rates meet legal requirements, and he sees no need to raise minimum inspection percentages or require employment contracts.
At present I see no reason to raise the minimum percentage of host parents to be inspected.
Momenteel zie ik geen aanleiding voor het verhogen van het minimale percentage te controleren gastouders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Fritsma en De Graaf over Oost-Europese overlast op vakantieparken

Three PVV MPs asked the ministers about nuisance and overcrowding caused by Eastern European migrant workers housed on holiday parks, including whether a deterrence policy should replace the national housing declaration and whether work permits should be reintroduced. The government answered that municipalities enforce nuisance rules, that regional agreements have added 31,000 housing places, that free movement of workers cannot be reversed under the accession treaties, and that permanent occupation of recreational homes is a municipal matter.
Statistics Netherlands examined, in the municipalities of the 9 regions of the Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten programme, how many migrant workers are housed in which municipality.
Het CBS heeft onderzocht in de gemeenten uit de 9 regio’s van het programma Flexwonen Arbeidsmigranten hoeveel arbeidsmigranten er in welke gemeente gehuisvest zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het vrijkomen van asbest bij bakkersbedrijf Bakkersland

MP Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs about asbestos incidents at bakery company Bakkersland, including inspection follow-up, a worker's mesothelioma, exposure risks for oven workers, and whether ingesting asbestos fibres poses health risks. The minister answered that three incidents were known, that Bakkersland removed asbestos from affected ovens and planned remediation of the rest, and that the RIVM found no clear link between ingestion and cancer, while noting the causal link cannot be excluded.
However, I am not aware whether the occupational health service made a report of an occupational disease to the NCvB in this individual case.
Mij is evenwel onbekend of de arbodienst in deze individuele casus een melding heeft gedaan als beroepsziekte bij het NCVB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Tellegen over het bericht dat de kinderbijslag niet mag worden verlaagd in het buitenland

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Tellegen (VVD) asked the Social Affairs minister how the government would respond to a court ruling that the residence-country principle cannot lower child benefit for children living in Morocco, whether it would appeal, how other EU states export child benefit, the state of treaty talks with Morocco, and whether export of child benefit outside the EU should be stopped. The minister confirmed appeals in the Moroccan and Egyptian cases, described other states' practices, said the Morocco talks had not yet produced results, and committed to pursuing a bill ending export to 14 non-EU countries.
The Netherlands' aim is to amend the treaty so that export of child benefits to Morocco stops entirely.
Inzet van Nederland is om het verdrag zodanig aan te passen dat de export van kinderbijslagen naar Marokko geheel stopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Fritsma en Van Klaveren over Arabische informatiebrieven van woningcorporaties

PVV MPs Fritsma and Van Klaveren asked whether housing corporations send information letters in Arabic, whether others do so, and what measures will stop it. The minister said one letter about waste collection in Leeuwarden was sent in Dutch, English and Arabic on behalf of the municipality, that no national overview exists, and that communication should be in Dutch with exceptions; he committed to no new measures.
No national overview exists of the information housing corporations provide, or in which language they do so.
Er bestaat geen landelijk overzicht van de informatie die door corporaties wordt verstrekt noch in welke taal zij dit doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de arbeidsvoorwaarden en –omstandigheden van buitenlandse werknemers die aan de A4 werken

MP Ulenbelt asked the Minister of Social Affairs about working and housing conditions of Portuguese and Spanish workers on the A4 motorway project, including unpaid wages, housing oversight and the government's role as client. The minister answered that the Labour Inspectorate investigation is ongoing, that employers are responsible for housing with municipalities and a private certification body supervising, and that the Inspectorate can impose penalties for unpaid minimum wage while no separate Rijk investigation into the contractor is planned.
The investigation is currently in full swing.
Het onderzoek is op dit moment in volle gang.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf, Madlener en Wilders over het bericht ‘Hundreds of thousands from outside EU could head for UK in passport loophole’

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that Bulgaria and Romania issue passports to non-EU nationals, enabling them to reach Northern Europe, and about expected Romanian and Bulgarian labour migration. The government replied that nationality law is a member-state competence, that it expects other states to act with due care, that predicting numbers is uncertain, and that the Netherlands has taken measures with municipalities to manage arrivals and tackle abuse.
Nationality legislation is not a competence of the European Union, and each member state therefore has its own legislation determining who is entitled to the nationality in question.
Nationaliteitswetgeving is geen bevoegdheid van de Europese Unie en iedere lidstaat heeft derhalve eigen wetgeving op basis waarvan vastgesteld wordt wie recht heeft op de betreffende nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het subsidiëren van een aan Milli Gorus gelieerde islamitische stichting

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether a Milli Gorus-affiliated youth foundation (MGT) receiving municipal subsidy should lose its funding after its annual report was written 'in the name of Allah', and what measures the government would take. The minister answered that the Amsterdam-West district is responsible for subsidy decisions, that MGT received about EUR 21,725.50 in 2013 for two project subsidies with no 2014 subsidy so far, and that the subsidies do not violate church-state separation, so no further measures were announced.
In this case it is up to the Amsterdam-West district to weigh the granting of subsidies.
Het is in dit geval aan het stadsdeel Amsterdam-West om een afweging te maken ten aanzien van het verstrekken van subsidies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over een voorstel voor cheques voor witte werksters

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Belgian-style service voucher scheme to move domestic cleaners out of undeclared work and about the timing of the Kalsbeek commission report. The minister answered that the commission report is nearly finished, the government reaction is expected this spring, and the Amsterdam alderman has been asked to wait for it.
As soon as possible after that, I will send you the cabinet's response.
Zo spoedig mogelijk daarna zal ik u de reactie van het kabinet doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over opgepakte jihadisten in Turkije

The MP asked whether Turkey had arrested jihadists with Dutch nationality, what happened to those returned to the Netherlands, and why the government does not apply harsher repression and deportation. The minister replied that no information is available from the OM or police on such cases, that AIVD assesses each returnee and OM considers prosecution case by case, and that no further public statements on concrete cases will be made.
About any information provided by the Turkish intelligence and security services to the AIVD, I make no further public statements.
Over eventuele informatie verstrekt door de Turkse inlichtingen-en veiligheidsdiensten aan de AIVD doe ik in het openbaar geen verdere mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hamer over het bericht “Kabinet dwingt werklozen WW in”

An MP asked the minister whether abolishing the dagloongarantie (daily wage guarantee) for unemployment benefit when switching jobs forces workers to claim WW first, and whether this hinders work-to-work transitions. The minister says such switches involve other factors, acknowledges a dilemma, and commits to reintroducing a revised daily wage guarantee via a Dagloonbesluit amendment after the Wet werk en zekerheid.
Yes. The Wet werk en zekerheid amends the Unemployment Insurance Act.
Ja. Met het wetsvoorstel Wet werk en zekerheid wordt de Werkloosheidswet gewijzigd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Tongeren en Van Ojik over het onderbreken van een project voor jonge werkzoekenden bij de politie Assen

MPs Van Tongeren and Van Ojik asked why a Assen police project offering work experience to young jobseekers was halted and whether a national rollout would be pursued. The minister answers that the original training project ended this year, a national working group is examining options, and 5 to 10 placements will be set up at two police units with an ambition of 100.
Last January, in implementation of the Marcouch motion, I indicated that I would research national possibilities for the national police to offer work experience places to unemployed young people.

Afgelopen januari heb ik ter uitvoering van de motie Marcouch aangegeven onderzoek te gaan doen naar landelijke mogelijkheden voor de nationale politie om werkervaringsplaatsen aan te bieden aan werkloze jongeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema over de voortgaande islamisering van het universitaire onderwijs

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether a VUmc workshop on treating patients of the other sex and related Islam-linked activities at a Dutch university are acceptable and whether measures will be taken against 'Islamisation' of higher education. The minister answered that the event is a legitimate diversity activity within institutional autonomy, that education remains accessible and lawful, and that she will take no measures.
I do not intend to take measures.
Ik ben niet voornemens maatregelen te treffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Potters over het kabinetsstandpunt ratificatie ILO verdrag 170

Potters (VVD) asks why the cabinet reversed its earlier position on ratifying ILO Convention 170 after a RIVM study had claimed costs for businesses, and how this fits with its stance against additional EU regulation. Minister Asscher answers that further analysis and the SER advice showed existing Dutch rules already meet the convention's obligations, so ratification adds no burden and no new national rules are needed, and he explains the SER's reasoning.
Advice given by the SER is always taken into account by the cabinet in the policy choices it makes.
Adviezen die door de SER worden gegeven, worden door het kabinet altijd worden meegenomen in de te maken beleidskeuzes.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van geweldsimam Al Haddad

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether the minister knew of reports that Islamist preacher Al-Haddad called for stoning adulterers and death for apostates, whether he posed a public-order threat, and whether he should be expelled. The minister said such statements would be reprehensible but prosecution is for prosecutors and courts, that Al-Haddad may voice his views, and that under EU rules a British citizen can only be refused entry for a genuine, serious threat to public order, which was not established; the event was reported cancelled.
The assessment of criminal liability must in an individual case first be made by the public prosecutor and ultimately by the criminal court.
De beoordeling van de strafbaarheid dient in een individueel geval in eerste instantie door het openbaar ministerie en uiteindelijk door de strafrechter te geschieden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Hijum en Pieter Heerma over de overdracht van bevallingsverlof bij het overlijden van de moeder

MPs Van Hijum and Heerma asked whether a father whose wife died during childbirth should be able to take over the mother's maternity leave, as in Belgium, and whether such a right would be added to the zorgverlof modernisation bill. The minister answered that work-life arrangements should be settled between employer and employee, that he will first consult social partners on the issue without anticipating solutions, and that amendments to the bill are targeted for spring.
I will first discuss this subject with the social partners and therefore do not want to anticipate possible solutions.
Ik zal over dit onderwerp eerst in gesprek gaan met sociale partners en wil dan ook niet vooruitlopen op eventuele oplossingsrichtingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Hachchi over de ongelijke behandeling van Defensie medewerkers die geen vakbondslid zijn bij het kandideren voor de Ondernemingsraad

Two D66 MPs asked why Defence staff who are not union members face a 30-signature requirement and a one-year employment threshold for works council candidacy, and whether this unequal treatment will be changed. The minister answered that the Defence co-determination decree mirrors the former WOR rules, that the minister will review the decree with unions after the WOR was amended, and that the SER will consider the one-year threshold.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Slob en Segers over afschaffing slavernij

MPs Slob and Segers asked why the Netherlands did not sign the 1949 UN Convention on trafficking and prostitution, whether it will do so, what anti-trafficking goals exist, and how the government addresses the legacy of slavery such as discrimination. The government answered that it will not join the convention because it would criminalise exploitation of adult voluntary prostitution, that regulation is preferred, and outlined trafficking task force and referral mechanism plans plus commemoration and anti-discrimination actions.
The Netherlands does not intend to become a party to the UN Convention.
Nederland is niet van plan partij bij het VN-Verdrag te worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over het verbeteren van de mogelijkheden van werkzoekenden in de Nederlandse grensregio’s om over de grens te werken

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about institutional barriers to cross-border work in the Dutch border regions, how regulation could be simplified, how job vacancies in neighbouring Germany and Belgium are made known to Dutch jobseekers, and whether an inventory of regional needs would be carried out. The minister answered that barriers are acknowledged, pointed to existing information websites, the EURES network and earlier inventories, and said a further inventory is not needed now but a conference and an advisory report will be followed up with the Chamber in spring.
The Chamber will be further informed in the spring about this advice, the results of the conference of 16 December and the cabinet's response to it.
De Kamer wordt in het voorjaar nader geïnformeerd over dit advies, de resultaten van de conferentie van 16 december en de reactie van het kabinet hier op.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sjoerdsma over het artikel ‘Asscher ziet wel iets in boud plan Cameron’

Two D66 MPs asked the Social Affairs and foreign ministers about Cameron's plan to delay free movement for new EU members until they reach a certain economic level, and whether Minister Asscher's reported openness to it conflicts with EU free movement. The government calls the idea a potentially interesting contribution to building support for free movement, citing exploitation of lower-income workers, and says reciprocity depends on future accession negotiations while transitional restrictions are compatible with free movement.
Whether the possibility of reciprocity will also be included in the accession treaties with new members depends on negotiations with those countries, which is not yet on the agenda.

Of de mogelijkheid tot wederkerigheid ook in de toetredingsverdragen met nieuwe toetreders wordt opgenomen, hangt af van de onderhandelingen met deze landen, hetgeen voorlopig nog niet aan de orde is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Graaf en Beertema over het bericht “Hulp mentor bij studiekeus allochtone jongere”

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers whether the Link2Work project for jongeren, which they described as aimed at allochtone youth, discriminates against autochthonous youth, and demanded an apology and its termination. Minister Asscher replied that Link2Work is open to all youth needing extra help in Amsterdam and Rotterdam, makes no distinction by ethnicity or origin, and that many participants are expected to have a migrant background due to the population of those cities.
No distinction is made on the basis of ethnicity or origin.
Er wordt geen onderscheid gemaakt naar etniciteit of afkomst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Yücel over het bericht dat werkloze allochtone jongeren niet worden bereikt

MPs Hamer and Yücel asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether reports that unemployed migrant youths are not being reached are accurate, how large that group is, and what measures will ensure they find training or work. The minister said the nationally small group of youths without work, school or benefits is about 1.2%, but is markedly higher among migrant youths in the G4, and listed existing programmes and the implementation of a related motion, while declining to answer the questions before the 2014 budget debate.
No, more time was needed to answer.
Nee, voor beantwoording was langer de tijd nodig.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Pieter Heerma over het gebruik van overheidsvorderingen

CDA MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked the State Secretary of Finance about the Tax Authority's use of government claims (overheidsvordering) to debit taxpayers' bank accounts, including the protection of the attachment-free minimum, usage and complaint figures, evaluations, and consultation with debt-relief and bailiff bodies. The government answered that the instrument is lawful and efficient, that a correction for the attachment-free minimum has been added since November 2013, that complaints have been rare, and that consultations and a bailiffs' register are underway.
As of 1 November 2013 the Collection Guidelines 2008 have been amended.
Met ingang van 1 november 2013 is de Leidraad Invordering 2008 gewijzigd
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Pieter Heerma over boetes die zijn opgelegd in verband met een stage van een vreemdeling bij een supermarkt

MPs Maij and Heerma asked why the Inspectie SZW imposed maximum fines in a case of an asylum-status foreigner's internship at a supermarket, despite no exploitation, and how mitigation and proportionality work. Minister Asscher explained the mitigation policy (about 20% of fines mitigated 2010-2012), that first offences can still be fined, and that the proportionality principle allows exceptions, while committing to report further on mitigation in the 2013 annual report.

As promised in my letter of 4 December regarding the budget debate, I will inform your House further on the current mitigation possibilities and their application in practice in the 2013 Annual Report.

Zoals toegezegd in mijn brief van 4 december jl. naar aanleiding van de begrotingsbehandeling, zal ik uw Kamer bij het Jaarverslag 2013 nader informeren over de huidige matigingsmogelijkheden en de uitwerking daarvan in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Schouten over de realisatie van de doelstelling om te komen tot 5000 politievrijwilligers in 2015

Two ChristenUnie MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about reaching the target of 5,000 police volunteers by 2015, including recruitment, retention, displacement of paid work, unemployment-benefit rules, allowances, and volunteers' powers. The minister answered that recruitment is on track through planned campaigns, that the government will align volunteer status and powers with policy, and that displacement of paid labour must be avoided.
The deployment of police volunteers must not lead to displacement of paid labour.
Het inzetten van politievrijwilligers mag niet leiden tot verdringing van arbeid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tellegen over visiedocument kwaliteit gastouderopvang

An MP from the VVD asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a quality vision document for childminding (gastouderopvang) and why its quality standards are lower than for day-care centres and out-of-school care. The minister welcomed the sector's initiative, explained the smaller training requirements by the small scale of childminding, and announced a quality measurement and a language/interaction training subsidy.
In preparation for this quality survey, a valid and reliable measurement instrument will be developed in 2014 to map the pedagogical quality of childminding.
In aanloop naar deze kwaliteitspeiling zal in 2014 een valide en betrouwbaar meetinstrument worden ontwikkeld waarmee de pedagogische kwaliteit van de gastouderopvang in kaart kan worden gebracht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Bommel, Jasper van Dijk en Ulenbelt over investeringen in de kernwapenindustrie

MPs from the SP asked whether the government would discourage or ban investment by Dutch banks and pension funds in nuclear weapons producers, following an IKV Pax Christi report. The minister replied that financial institutions are responsible for their own investment policies, that the government will not amend the legal framework, and that no ban is being considered.
Pension funds and banks are primarily themselves responsible for their investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen en banken zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor hun beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Tanamal over het bericht dat het UWV slordig omgaat met medische dossiers

MP Tanamal asked the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports that the UWV handles medical files carelessly, including an external report by Sjef Gevers on access to medical records and the role of insurance physicians. The minister said UWV has adopted the report's recommendations, which are to be implemented in December 2013, to keep medical information within the medical file and to restore physicians' responsibility in the process.
UWV has informed me that there has been no situation in which medical files were accessible to anyone other than those who, by virtue of their function, have access to them.
UWV heeft mij laten weten dat er geen sprake van is geweest dat medische dossiers toegankelijk zijn voor anderen dan zij die daar toe uit hoofde van hun functie toegang toe hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over de afnemende deelname aan inburgering

Parliamentarian Heerma asked the minister about the low take-up of loans for civic integration (inburgering) among newcomers since January 2013, and whether the government has sufficient oversight of who is integrating and through which providers. The minister confirmed the figures, said information exchange between IND and DUO is largely in order, and argued existing instruments give adequate oversight, promising a report to Parliament in spring 2014.
I will inform the House in more detail in spring 2014 about the efforts and results of integration for new integration obligors in 2013.
Ik zal de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2014 nader informeren over de inspanningen en resultaten van de inburgering van nieuwe inburgeringsplichtigen in 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht dat al bijna een jaar nauwelijks wordt ingeburgerd

An MP asked the minister about reports that almost no newcomers have been completing civic integration in the year since responsibility shifted to them, and about the lack of municipal oversight of integration progress. The minister replied that only 1,084 loans had been granted, that the number of loans is not a reliable measure, that municipalities no longer have any role, and that DUO and surveys will provide oversight, with a report to parliament promised for spring 2014.
I will inform the House in spring 2014 in more detail about the efforts and results of civic integration of new integration obligation holders in 2013.
Ik zal de Kamer in het voorjaar van 2014 nader informeren over de inspanningen en resultaten van de inburgering van nieuwe inburgeringsplichtigen in 2013.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de afnemende deelname aan inburgering

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp drop in participation in civic integration courses in 2013 after the revised Integration Act, and about how integration obligations are monitored and enforced. The minister acknowledges fewer participants, attributes it to the narrower target group, says full data are not yet available and promises to inform parliament in spring 2014.
At this moment I do not yet have full insight into the number of new civic integration obligees who participate in an integration programme.
Op dit moment heb ik nog geen volledig inzicht in het aantal nieuwe inburgeringsplichtigen dat deelneemt aan een inburgeringsprogramma.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over jongeren die stage lopen na het afronden van een opleiding

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asks the Minister of Social Affairs about young graduates doing unpaid or low-paid 'internships' that may in fact be regular jobs, and whether the Inspectorate will investigate. The minister says whether a placement is a stage depends on the facts, that the Inspectorate uses criteria and enforces minimum wage, and that it has started three investigations, one of which found no violations.
Will you have the Inspectorate SZW investigate the occurrence of underpayment and violation of labour law in the case of internships after completing an education, and take enforcement action?
Wilt u de Inspectie SZW onderzoek laten doen naar het voorkomen van onderbetaling en schending van het arbeidsrecht in het geval van stages na het afronden van een opleiding en handhavend optreden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens, Kuiken en Fokke over uitbuiting van werknemers die werken aan de A2-tunnel in Maastricht

MPs from the PvdA asked the Ministers of Social Affairs and of Infrastructure about exploitation of foreign workers on the A2 tunnel project in Maastricht, and about whether public bodies should screen contractors and prevent unfair competition. The minister says the Inspectorate SZW is investigating, an expert committee found likely violations of the Bouw cao, and he points to planned chain liability and a study on displacement, while rejecting a change to selection criteria and the Rijkswaterstaat procurement role.
Now that there is a report from the expert committee, it is becoming clearer what is going on.
Nu er een rapport ligt van de expertcommissie wordt inzichtelijker wat er aan de hand is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Paulus Jansen over de externe en interne veiligheid van windturbines

An MP asked the government about the safety of wind turbines after the storm of 28 October 2013 and a fatal accident at Ooltgensplaat, including damage overviews, applicable safety and occupational health rules, and inspection practice. The minister answered that no national damage overview exists, that existing Arbo and Warenwet rules apply, that the Inspectie SZW is investigating the Ooltgensplaat accident and may adjust rules, and that inspections occur only in response to signals.
The Inspectie SZW investigation will determine whether the applicable provisions of the Working Conditions Act and the Consumer Goods Act have been adequately complied with.
Het onderzoek van de Inspectie SZW zal uitwijzen of de van toepassing zijnde voorschriften van de Arbeidsomstandighedenwet en Warenwet adequaat zijn nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het ontslag na melding misstanden moskee-internaten

An MP asks the ministers how they view the dismissal of a civil servant who reported serious misconduct at a mosque boarding school, and whether that employee deserves reinstatement and action against the responsible administrator. The minister declines to comment on individual employment decisions, says the dismissal is the responsibility of the municipality of Rotterdam and a matter for the courts, and states no intention to intervene.
I do not intend to interfere in a matter that falls under the own responsibility of the municipality of Rotterdam.
Ik ben niet voornemens te interfereren in een zaak die tot de eigen verantwoordelijkheid van de gemeente Rotterdam moet worden gerekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over het verbod op de intocht van Zwarte Piet

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government shares a view that Dutch traditions such as Zwarte Piet should be protected against multicultural objections, and what it will do given moves to ban the Piet arrival and remove Piet from schools. The minister answered that the Sinterklaas celebration is a matter for society and local committees and schools, and declined to take national action.
The arrival is a local matter. School boards are free to celebrate festivities and shape them as they see fit.
De intocht is een lokale aangelegenheid. Schoolbesturen zijn vrij om naar eigen inzicht feesten te vieren en deze vorm te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Segers en Van Raak over het ontslag van de klokkenluider moskee-internaten

MPs Segers and Van Raak asked the minister why a whistleblower at mosque boarding schools was dismissed, whether they acted in good faith, whether Rotterdam complied with the whistleblower scheme, and how the proposed House for Whistleblowers bill would have applied. The minister declined to comment on individual employment matters or the facts, saying the courts will judge the dismissal, and said the bill's protections are hypothetical to assess.
It is now up to the court to assess that dismissal.
Het is nu aan de rechter om dat ontslag te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kerstens over de brandveiligheid van windmolens in Nederland

An MP from the Labour party asked the Ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about the fire safety of wind turbines in the Netherlands and whether training, permitting and sector measures should change. The minister replied that Inspectie SZW, the forensic institute, police and the Rotterdam fire service are investigating, that improvements will be considered after those findings, and that the findings will be sent to parliament.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Huizing en Van Dekken over betaling van spelersmakelaars

MPs Huizing and Van Dekken asked whether football players rather than clubs should pay player agents, and whether agent intermediation falls under the WAADI labour-intermediary law. The minister answered that only pure labour-contract brokerage falls under WAADI, that the cost ban applies only to those brokerage costs, and that parties may agree who pays other agent services, so no exemption is planned.
To protect the employee, WAADI prohibits charging the costs of labour intermediation to the employee.
Ter bescherming van de werknemer is in de Waadi een verbod opgenomen om de kosten van arbeidsmiddeling in rekening te brengen bij de werknemer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de beveiliging van joodse instellingen

An MP asked the ministers whether they would act against the roughly 800,000 euro yearly security costs borne by Jewish institutions and about research on antisemitism among Muslim youth. The minister replied that security is risk-based and applied equally to all institutions, that no new measures are currently warranted, and that antisemitism is addressed as a priority and a Dutch study is planned.
For every citizen, cultural, religious or educational institution, security measures are taken in the same way on the basis of threat and risk.
Voor iedere burger, culturele, religieuze of onderwijsinstelling worden op gelijke wijze beveiligingsmaatregelen genomen op basis van dreiging en risico.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de bouw van een moskee in Groningen

An MP asked the ministers whether they know of plans for a new mosque in Groningen, how it is financed and by which foreign actors, and whether they will stop its construction given alleged antisemitic and misogynistic content. The minister answered that the mosque is financed by its own foundation and congregation, that the municipality contributes nothing, and that building new mosques is permitted under the constitution unless laws are broken, refusing to halt construction.
The construction of new mosques is permitted in the Netherlands, on condition that Dutch rules and laws are not violated.
De bouw van nieuwe moskeeën is in Nederland toegestaan, op voorwaarde dat de Nederlandse regels en wetten niet worden overtreden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over het bericht dat de SER-Commissie Arbeidsomstandigheden positief heeft geoordeeld over ratificatie van ILO-verdrag 170

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he had noted the SER Working Conditions Committee's positive advice on ratifying ILO Convention 170 on chemicals, and whether he would adopt it and when ratification would follow. The minister confirmed he had noted the advice and said the decision rests with the Council of Ministers, which would be presented with the government's position as soon as possible.
The intentions regarding this advice will be submitted to the Council of Ministers as soon as possible.
De voornemens met betrekking tot dit advies zullen zo spoedig mogelijk aan de Rijksministerraad worden voorgelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pieter Heerma over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij de Aldi

The MP Heerma asked the minister whether the labour inspectorate's criticism of working conditions at Aldi (high workload, improper behaviour, neglect of health damage) is accurate and whether an improvement plan will be started and reported to Parliament. The minister replied that the inspection is still ongoing, the company has been allowed to submit a response to preliminary findings, and Parliament will be informed of the conclusions once the investigation and any interventions are settled.
Once the investigation is concluded and the deployment of interventions has been determined, I will inform the House, as previously promised, about the conclusions regarding the complaint examined.
Zodra het onderzoek is afgerond en de inzet van de interventies is bepaald, zal ik de Kamer zoals al eerder toegezegd informeren over de conclusies ten aanzien van de onderzochte klacht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de jihad vlag op een Haags veld

An MP from the PVV asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers how to interpret a jihad flag displayed on a The Hague football pitch, what the danger of jihadist ideology is, and whether sharia exists in The Hague. The minister called the incident an expression of support for jihadist ideas, described jihadism as the core of the terrorist threat, and said there is no separate sharia-based legal system competing with the democratic legal order in The Hague.
There is no separate legal system in The Hague competing with the democratic legal order.
Er is in Den Haag geen sprake van een aparte, met de democratische rechtsorde concurrerend rechtssysteem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de Marokkaanse groepsmishandeling van een vrouw

MPs from the PVV asked about a reported group assault on a woman by Moroccan men, whether the perpetrators had been arrested, whether the government would acknowledge a 'Moroccan problem' and expel convicted offenders, and whether group liability should be extended. The minister replied that police found the woman admitted to fabricating the account, a false-report procedure was started, and that group participation in violence is already punishable under article 141 of the Criminal Code, referring to earlier answers for the rest.
Following this confession, the police drew up an official report against her for filing a false complaint.
Naar aanleiding van deze bekentenis heeft de politie proces-verbaal tegen haar opgemaakt wegens het doen van een valse aangifte.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Hamer over onbetaalde stages

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether unpaid internships are being misused as disguised employment and what the legal criteria for a stage are. The minister set out criteria distinguishing a learning internship from regular work, said the Inspectie SZW enforces the minimum wage and fines firms that wrongly claim stagiair status, and stated that work without a learning focus requires at least the minimum wage.
The Inspectorate SZW imposes a fine on companies that claim the workers are interns while the facts and circumstances show it is work and legally an employment contract exists.

De Inspectie SZW legt een boete op aan bedrijven als zij claimen dat het om stagiairs gaat, terwijl uit de feiten en omstandigheden blijkt dat het gaat om werk en juridisch gezien sprake is van een arbeidsovereenkomst.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de bekendheid en toepassing van het Besluit bijstandsverlening zelfstandigen (Bbz) voor zzp’ers

An MP asked whether ZZP self-employed workers know about the Bbz assistance scheme and what the government will do to raise awareness. The state secretary answered that data on financial distress is lacking, that awareness is only indicative, and listed existing and planned outreach measures with municipalities and Divosa/VNG.
From this department I intend to grant subsidy to Divosa and VNG to organise various activities in autumn 2013 and the first and second quarters of 2014 that will raise awareness of the Bbz.

Ik ben vanuit dit departement voornemens subsidie te verlenen aan Divosa en VNG om in het najaar van 2013 en het eerste en tweede kwartaal van 2014 diverse activiteiten te organiseren die meer bekendheid aan het Bbz zullen geven.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij en Pieter Heerma over “boetes die zijn opgelegd in verband met een stage van een vreemdeling bij een supermarkt”

MPs Maij and Heerma asked the minister whether the Inspectorate SZW's fine for a refugee's unpaid internship at a supermarket, imposed after a police raid and a missing work permit, was proportionate and consistent with its enforcement practice. The minister defended the inspection as routine, said the fine policy allows mitigation only in limited cases, and saw no need for further measures.
In view of the answers to the previous questions, I see no need to take any measures.
Gelet op de antwoorden op voorgaande vragen, acht ik geen noodzaak aanwezig om maatregelen te nemen.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de Ministers van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de bouw van de grootste moskee van Nederland (ingezonden 16 september 2013

Two PVV MPs asked the ministers about the financing of the Ulu mosque in Utrecht, the wages of its board and imam, and how to stop new mosque construction. The minister answered that the mosque was funded by donations, board members are unpaid, the imam is paid by ISN, and that building mosques is lawful under freedom of religion, while urging mosques to be transparent about financing.
I generally do not have information on the financing of mosques or houses of worship and/or their administrators.
Ik beschik in het algemeen niet over informatie over de financiering van moskeeën of gebedshuizen en/of de bestuurders daarvan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht van FNV en Voor Werkende Ouders: ‘Uitval kinderopvang niet door crisis’

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asked the minister to respond to an FNV and Voor Werkende Ouders survey claiming parents are leaving the labour market because of childcare cuts, and to explain plans to reinvest in childcare. The minister disputes the survey's conclusions citing CBS figures, notes a EUR 100 million structural reinvestment in childcare allowance, says informal childcare falls under parental choice, and promises a childcare policy letter this autumn.
The SCP, commissioned by the Ministry of SZW, is conducting research examining the reasons parents enter and exit childcare and how they then organise work and care.
Het SCP voert, in opdracht van het Ministerie van SZW, een onderzoek uit waarin naar de instroom- en de uitstroomredenen van ouders in de kinderopvang wordt gekeken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de voortgaande buitenlandse islamitische inmenging in Nederland

An MP asked the government about foreign Islamic financing of a Rotterdam foundation (reportedly 380,000 USD from the Islamic Development Bank), the risks to integration, and measures against foreign funding of mosques. The minister said foreign funding is permissible but intervention is warranted where core democratic values are at stake, that the state cannot intervene in mosque boards or finances due to church-state separation, and that mosques should be transparent, with additional instruments under review.
I therefore call on mosque boards receiving money from abroad to maximise openness in their financial relations with foreign countries.
Ik roep de moskeebesturen die geld ontvangen vanuit het buitenland dan ook op om maximale openheid te betrachten in de financiële relaties met het buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Bergkamp en Van Weyenberg over het bericht “Mishandeling Marokkaanse kinderen onderschat”

MPs Bergkamp and Van Weyenberg asked about a news report claiming child abuse among Moroccan-Dutch families is underestimated, based on a PhD study by Lahlah. The state secretary replied that the study adds knowledge to existing findings, pointed to existing prevention programmes and municipal responsibilities, and said the government will continue its approach to child abuse and juvenile crime.
The research by Ms Lahlah underlines that specific attention to intercultural differences is still needed.
Het onderzoek van mevrouw Lahlah onderstreept dat specifieke aandacht voor interculturele verschillen nog steeds nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over gesprek met verzekeraars over schending van persoonlijke levenssfeer bij overdracht van medische gegevens bij verzuimbegeleiding

MP Ulenbelt asked whether the minister had met insurers about privacy violations in sharing medical data for sickness absence management and what concrete steps would follow. The minister reports a meeting with the Verbond van Verzekeraars where excuses were offered, an informal consultation with stakeholders and a commitment that insurers will bring their procedures in line with privacy rules, though implementation is left to the sector.
I expect them to put matters in order so that employers and employees no longer encounter violations of the laws and regulations on medical data.
Ik verwacht van hen dat zij zodanig de zaken op orde stellen dat werkgevers en werknemers niet meer met schending van de wet- en regelgeving omtrent medische gegevens te maken krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat steeds meer jongeren gratis stage lopen

MP Ulenbelt asked whether the growing number of unpaid internships taken by young graduates displaces paid work, whether employers can avoid paying minimum wage, and whether such employers should be tackled. The minister answered that unpaid internships are not displacement since places are additional, that interns need not receive minimum wage because learning is central, and that employers are not obliged to pay internship allowances; he pointed to the SBB internship offensive instead.
There is no displacement because it generally concerns additional places.
Er is geen sprake van verdringing omdat het doorgaans gaat om additionele plaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt, Jasper van Dijk en Bashir over misbruik van de Wet vermindering afdracht loonbelasting en premie voor de volksverzekeringen (WVA)

SP MPs asked the ministers of Education and Social Affairs and the state secretary of Finance about firms and training institutions abusing the wage-tax reduction for education (AV onderwijs), including whether unqualified teachers and sham courses were used and whether the responsible parties would be punished. The minister answered that the Inspectorate found shortcomings at several institutions, that investigations continue at two, that the AV onderwijs is being abolished in favour of a new subsidy scheme, and that the Tax Service and FIOD can act, while declining to name firms or give tax-recovery estimates for confidentiality reasons.
Under the duty of confidentiality, no statements are ever made about individual taxpayers in tax matters.
Op grond van de geheimhoudingsplicht worden wat betreft fiscale aangelegenheden nimmer uitspraken gedaan over individuele belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Kanslozenkaravaan uit Balkan komt eraan’

MP Azmani asked the Minister of Social Affairs about media reports of Romanian police encouraging unemployed people with criminal records to migrate to richer EU states, and asked whether the minister would contact Romanian and other counterparts and the Commission to stop it. The minister answered that he has no signals of such an encouragement policy, describes bilateral cooperation with Romania and Bulgaria on labour exploitation and malafide agencies, and says no further contact is warranted on that basis, while outlining existing options to expel or refuse Romanian offenders.
I have no indications that the Romanian government sees this differently.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat de Roemeense overheid dit anders ziet.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over ‘een uitspraak van de Raad van State over schijnconstructies met zogeheten MOE-landers’

The MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked the minister how the Inspectorate SZW will respond to a Council of State ruling on sham constructions using Polish workers, and whether the ruling makes such constructions unacceptable. The minister answered that the ruling clarified the distinction between genuine cross-border services and posting of workers, that the Inspectorate has incorporated its criteria into its working method, and that the action plan on sham constructions addresses service-based constructions.
The Inspectorate SZW has incorporated the criteria from this ruling into its existing working method.
De Inspectie SZW heeft de criteria uit deze uitspraak verwerkt in de bestaande werkwijze.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het artikel ‘Samsom staat op nivelleren’

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the employment effects of the coalition agreement's levelling measures, the marginal tax burden for low and middle incomes, and the reported Samsom remarks on job losses. The minister answered that the agreement is a coherent whole, that CPB calculations show a 0.6% structural rise in employment, that no separate figures for individual measures are known, and that the rise in marginal burden for higher incomes is a defensible trade-off for restoring public finances.
The coalition agreement consists of many different measures, but forms a coherent and inseparable whole.
Het regeerakkoord bestaat uit veel verschillende maatregelen, maar vormt een samenhangend en onlosmakelijk geheel.

Vragen van het lid Ulenbelt (SP) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid over het persbericht van het asbestverwijderingsbedrijf ASB in Veenendaal met de kop «Specialisten luiden noodklok over misstanden in

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a press release from asbestos removal firm ASB alleging conflicts of interest and quality problems in the asbestos sector, including laboratory testing. The minister rejected the claim that control should fall entirely to government, said Inspectorate enforcement is being intensified, and promised targeted inspections of laboratories in 2014 and a forthcoming study of certification bodies.
The Inspectorate SZW will carry out targeted inspections in 2014 on how laboratories perform final measurements and clearances.
De Inspectie zal in 2014 gerichte inspecties uitvoeren op de wijze waarop bij eindmetingen/vrijgaven door laboratoria worden uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, De Roon en Wilders over "de islamitische inmenging van Koeweit in Nederland"

MPs Van Klaveren, De Roon and Wilders asked whether Kuwaiti state involvement in the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam, including funding and board links, should be tolerated, and whether the mosque should be closed and the Kuwaiti ambassador expelled. The minister said the state cannot intervene in mosque boards or funding absent national security concerns, asked the mosque board for openness on financing, and rejected closure and expulsion.
I do not have information on Kuwait's funding of mosques and/or their administrators.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de bekostiging door Koeweit van moskeeën en/of de bestuurders.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schut-Welkzijn en Neppérus over vertraging bij het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Neppérus (VVD) asked about delays at the UWV in providing employers with information needed to decide on becoming self-insured for sickness benefits in 2014, and about the tight Tax Administration deadline. The minister replied that higher-than-expected demand for benefit decision copies slowed processing, that the UWV has added capacity, and that the Tax Administration will allow case-by-case extensions to 1 December.
The UWV has deployed extra capacity to provide the copies to employers as quickly as possible.
Het UWV heeft extra capaciteit ingezet om de kopieën zo snel mogelijk aan werkgevers te verstrekken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "over het huren van kantoren door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) van bedrijven die niet in Nederland gevestigd zijn"

MP Ulenbelt asked whether UWV leases offices owned by foreign investors such as Fortress and whether UWV should run integrity checks on landlords. Minister Asscher confirmed the landlords are registered owners in the Netherlands and Germany, said UWV can now use the Bibob integrity law and is drafting a policy, and said no integrity screening of buyers happens when public property is sold.
UWV is currently drawing up a Bibob policy line and will apply this policy when leasing premises.
UWV stelt hiervoor momenteel een Bibob-beleidslijn op en zal deze beleidslijn toepassen bij de huur van panden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de ramenwas-service in Arnhem

An SP MP asked the State Secretary whether Arnhem's window-cleaning project places welfare recipients on minimum-wage contracts below the glazier CAO, and whether it displaces regular work. The State Secretary answered that the municipality is responsible, that the work is not comparable to the CAO, that 3 of 13 participants moved to regular jobs, and that the project will be evaluated in autumn 2013.
The municipality is responsible for monitoring the legal conditions of the various re-integration instruments.
De gemeente is verantwoordelijk voor het bewaken van de wettelijke voorwaarden van de verschillende re-integratie-instrumenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Van Hijum over het terughalen van productie uit lagelonenlanden door Nederlandse bedrijven (reshoring)

MPs Heerma and Van Hijum asked whether reshoring of production from low-wage countries is a trend, how the 600 million euro for sector plans would stimulate it, and about a Tilburg total-cost-of-ownership model. The government answered that it is too early to speak of a trend, described sector plan co-financing and NFIA outreach, and said it will assess whether a national model is desirable.
Of course the cabinet is monitoring whether reshoring will occur on a larger scale.
Uiteraard wordt door het kabinet gevolgd of «reshoring» zich op grotere schaal gaat voordoen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over het stimuleren van «reshoring» en de mogelijkheden daarbij in het kader van de Participatiewet

PvdA MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether reshoring of production to the Netherlands creates jobs for people with a distance to the labour market under the Participatiewet and what measures could stimulate it. The ministers replied that reshoring complements the Participatiewet, pointed to wage-cost subsidies and sector plans, and said the government will promote reshoring's job potential during implementation.

In implementing the Participatiewet, the State Secretary for Social Affairs will explicitly promote the opportunities reshoring offers for creating employment, particularly for people with a distance to the labour market.

Bij de implementatie van de participatiewet gaat de Staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken expliciet uitdragen welke kansen «reshoring» biedt voor het creëren van werkgelegenheid, met name voor mensen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het keurmerk eerlijke teelt champignons

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the Fair Produce certification for mushroom farms, the difference with the Grasp assessment, and whether labour inspection would expand scrutiny of the sector. The minister stood by Fair Produce, said Grasp is only a first administrative check, committed to continued cooperation with the sector, and reported that the inspectorate had visited 54 non-certified farms and was already intensifying enforcement in the sector.
The intervention team carried out various types of inspections at the growing companies that are not certified according to the Fair Produce list.
Het interventieteam heeft verschillende soorten inspecties uitgevoerd bij de teeltbedrijven die volgens de lijst van Fair Produce niet zijn gecertificeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kooiman over het bericht dat er problemen zijn met de site Werk.nl

MP Kooiman asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the Werk.nl website was unreachable after a July 2013 release, including the cause, prevention measures, client communication and staffing costs. Minister Asscher answered that the site was unstable from 29 July to 8 August due to a release overloading the ICT platform, that a crisis team and evaluation are in place, that alternative paper and telephone channels and deadline extensions were offered, and that external costs are still being invoiced.
An evaluation of the release is taking place.
Er vindt een evaluatie plaats van de release.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over de storing op de website van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

An MP from the VVD asked the minister about outages on the UWV website Werk.nl, ICT spending of about 3 billion euro since 2002, the cost and handling of telephone help, sanctions on benefit recipients who could not report on time, and how future outages will be prevented. The minister answered that the outage problems were resolved, that claimants face no penalties for missed obligations, that ICT spending is needed for efficiency with a modernisation and savings programme, and that a new platform is planned for 2015 without a guarantee of no future disruption.
Customers will suffer no financial disadvantage if, as a result of the instability, they cannot meet their obligations on time.
Klanten ondervinden er geen financieel nadeel van als zij als gevolg van de instabiliteit hun verplichtingen niet tijdig kunnen nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat het UWV te traag is met het uitbetalen van loon bij faillissementen in Noord-Holland

MP Ulenbelt (SP) asked the minister whether UWV was too slow paying wage claims after bankruptcies in Noord-Holland, and about the causes, prevention and staffing cuts. Minister Asscher confirmed about 500 late payments were made good via advances, attributed the delay to an unexpected surge in bankruptcies, and said UWV would improve early signalling and redeploy staff.
UWV will in future pay more attention to signalling such large increases so that the necessary extra staff can be deployed in good time.
UWV zal in het vervolg nog beter aandacht besteden aan het signaleren van dergelijke grote stijgingen zodat vroegtijdig het benodigde extra personeel kan worden ingezet.

Vragen van de leden Hamer en Otwin vanDijk (beiden PvdA) aan de minister van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de staatssecretaris van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over nulurencontracten in de zorg (ingezonden 27

Two Labour MPs asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Health about zero-hour contracts in care, including variants, whether workers should get contracts reflecting average hours, and how the government will hold care employers to the care accord. The minister answered that he is in talks with social partners on implementing the Social Accord and expects parties to honour the Care Accord, without committing to a specific step.
I assume that the parties will abide by the agreements in the care accord.
Ik ga er van uit dat partijen zich aan de afspraken uit het zorgakkoord houden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Graaf en Van Klaveren over het bericht ‘Asscher’s hypocriete waarschuwing tegen EU-arbeidsmigranten’

PVV MPs De Graaf and Van Klaveren asked the ministers of Social Affairs and Foreign Affairs about a news report on Asscher's warning regarding EU labour migrants, questioning Polish, Romanian and Bulgarian crime and welfare figures and calling for the closure of borders and reintroduction of work permits. Minister Asscher answered that the crime and welfare figures are relatively elevated but must be nuanced, announced a pilot on residence-rights and benefits and a governmental summit on EU labour migration, and stated the transitional restrictions cannot be extended after 1 January 2014.
Under the Accession Treaties, a Member State of the European Union may (under conditions) impose restrictions on the free movement of workers from new member states.
Op basis van de Toetredingsakkoorden kan een lidstaat van de Europese Unie (onder voorwaarden) beperkingen stellen aan het vrij verkeer van werknemers met nieuwe lidstaten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht dat het UWV een ontslagvergunning heeft verleend aan thuiszorgorganisatie Sensire om 1.100 thuiszorgmedewerkers te ontslaan

PvdA MPs asked the government about UWV granting a dismissal permit to home-care organisation Sensire to lay off 1,100 workers, including whether more care providers would seek preventive dismissals and whether a convenant with the sector was planned. The state secretary replied that talks with municipalities and stakeholders took place, that UWV does not grant preventive dismissal permits while tendering is uncertain, and that a convenant has little added value; instead municipalities will be informed about timely tendering.
In that case the policy line, under current regulations, is that UWV does not grant a dismissal permit because there is no certainty about the structural loss of jobs.
In dat geval is de beleidslijn, op basis van de huidige regelgeving, dat UWV geen ontslagvergunning verleent omdat er geen zekerheid bestaat over het structureel vervallen van arbeidsplaatsen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over berichten dat vrijwilligerswerk ouderen aan een nieuwe baan kan helpen

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked whether volunteering helps older people find paid work, whether government policy should change, and whether the Inspectorate's review of reintegration and tegenprestatie should consider it. State Secretary Klijnsma acknowledged volunteering can help job seekers but said existing reintegration tools are sufficient, and promised to inform the House after the Inspectorate's findings expected in October.
I am of the view that the current range of reintegration instruments is sufficient to guide people to work.
Ik ben van oordeel dat het huidige palet aan re-integratie-instrumenten voldoende is om mensen naar werk te begeleiden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Beertema en Van Klaveren over het plan van een imam-opleiding op het Ibn Ghaldoun

Two PVV MPs asked whether a Turkish-linked imam training programme at the Ibn Ghaldoun school, funded in part by the Diyanet network, should be allowed and whether public money is involved. The state secretary answered that the school is funded only for secondary education, that the imam training is paid for by a foundation and not public funds, that freedom of religion and educational choice apply, and that the inspectorate's investigation into the school's governance will determine its future.
Ibn Ghaldoun is funded by the national government for providing education within the meaning of the Secondary Education Act.
Het Ibn Ghaldoun wordt door het Rijk bekostigd voor het verzorgen van onderwijs in de zin van de Wet op het voortgezet onderwijs.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Geurts over het bericht van de aangifte tegen Odfjell wegens het verzwijgen van een groot Methanol-incident

Opposition MPs Omtzigt and Geurts asked the government about reports that Odfjell concealed a major methanol incident in 2009, including whether it was reported, whether confidential dossiers can be made public, and whether management can be trusted. The state secretary said the incident should have been reported to the DCMR, that a criminal complaint has led to a prosecutor's assessment, that the dossier was released after a balancing test, and that Odfjell is under heightened supervision.

The public prosecution service informed the Minister of Security and Justice that it is currently considering whether, in view of this complaint, there is reason to launch a criminal investigation against Odfjell.

Het openbaar ministerie heeft de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie meegedeeld dat het momenteel beziet of er, gezien deze aangifte, aanleiding bestaat een daarop gericht strafrechtelijk onderzoek in te stellen tegen Odfjell.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over "kinderopvangtoeslag".

An SGP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs why childcare allowance is tied only to the least-working partner's hours, why a court ruling distinguishing childcare from playgroup care was set aside, and how municipalities may redirect playgroup care into registered daycare to make parents eligible. The minister replied that the hours link adequately ensures the allowance supports work-care combination, that playgroup and childcare are distinct and municipalities bear responsibility for their policy, and that financing of playgroups will be moved under the Childcare Act with a letter to parliament in autumn.
I will inform your House about this in the autumn and hope thereby to answer your questions sufficiently.
Ik zal uw Kamer hierover in het najaar informeren en hoop daarmee uw vragen in voldoende mate te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kooiman, Leijten en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat zorginstelling Aafje uit voorzorg ontslag heeft aangevraagd voor honderden thuiszorgmedewerkers

MPs Kooiman, Leijten and Ulenbelt asked whether care provider Aafje's precautionary dismissal request for hundreds of home-care workers was premature and whether the UWV should grant it, and about municipal tendering practices. The state secretary replied that the dismissal request is not expected to proceed, explained the UWV's approach to dismissal permits tied to tenders, the rules on taking over staff, and that municipalities are responsible for tendering and must follow the law.
I have since understood that the dismissal request will not go ahead, at least for the time being.
Inmiddels heb ik begrepen dat de ontslagaanvraag er – in ieder geval voorlopig – niet gaat komen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voortman over “een arbodienst die medische gegevens doorgegeven heeft aan werkgevers”

An MP asked the ministers whether they would act on a privacy regulator finding that an occupational health service and a sickness-absence firm passed unnecessary medical data to employers, and how doctor independence and worker privacy can be guaranteed. The minister says the company's breaches have ended, the regulator will check the occupational health service, and the government awaits SER advice on arbeidsgerelateerde zorg by March 2014 before considering further measures.
I therefore regret that these two companies acted carelessly.
Ik betreur het dan ook dat deze twee bedrijven onzorgvuldig hebben gehandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Tanamal over "het bericht dat arbobedrijven vertrouwelijke informatie van zieke werknemers delen met hun werkgever"

MPs Kerstens and Tanamal asked the minister about reports that occupational health companies shared confidential information on sick employees with employers, and about the privacy tension with the Wet verbetering poortwachter. The minister said the CBP is considering enforcement against one arbodienst, that the verzuimbedrijf has adjusted, and that he will write to the sector to urge compliance with the Wbp.
The Dutch Data Protection Authority (CBP) is considering enforcement measures against the occupational health service concerned.
Het College Bescherming Persoonsgegevens (CBP) overweegt handhavende maatregelen bij de betreffende arbodienst.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Groot over de verkoop van vakantiedagen

MPs Hamer and Groot asked the ministers about a report that businesses hold about 16 billion euro in unused leave and whether a lower tax rate on buying out leave days would boost the economy. The government answered that the 16 billion figure rests on a small, uncertain survey, that only above-statutory leave can be bought out, and that a reduced tax rate is undesirable because of unequal treatment, revenue loss and tax arbitrage.
For tax purposes, the buyout of holiday days is treated as wages taxed at the rate applying to the employee who buys out.
Fiscaal wordt de afkoop van vakantiedagen beschouwd als loon dat belast wordt naar het tarief zoals dat geldt voor de werknemer die afkoopt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Keijzer over discriminatie van zwangere vrouwen op de werkvloer

MPs Heerma and Keijzer asked about the College voor de Rechten van de Mens finding that 45% of pregnant or new-mother workers had possibly discriminatory experiences, and whether the government would act. The minister replied that discrimination is unacceptable, pointed to information provision and an SER advisory request due late 2013, and said pregnancy discrimination will be considered in the work-and-care summit.
Following this advice it will be considered whether, and if so which, follow-up actions on labour market discrimination are needed.
Naar aanleiding van dit advies zal worden bezien of en zo ja welke vervolgacties op het gebied van arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat een werkloze straatveger voor 400 euro minder salaris moet straatvegen

An SP MP asks whether it is acceptable that an unemployed street sweeper must sweep streets for €400 less per month under a municipal work-with-benefit arrangement, and whether this constitutes exploitation and displacement, and asks for legislative action. The state secretary replies that instruments are a municipal responsibility, that the council should supervise, that the specific case is for the alderman and council to judge, and that the inspectorate will study tegenprestatie implementation with results expected in autumn 2013.
The decision on the use of instruments to help people into work is for the municipalities.
De beslissing over de inzet van de instrumenten om mensen aan het werk te helpen is aan gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Agema over gesegregeerde ouderenzorg

MPs Van Klaveren and Agema (PVV) asked whether a care centre for dementia patients organised by cultural background (De Beukelaar, Laurens) is acceptable, how much public money it receives, and whether it should be stopped. The minister said the centre is funded like any AWBZ provider, that cultural background matters for dementia care, that residents mix, and that he will not stop the project.
No, I am not going to do that.
Nee, dat ga ik niet doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "de mededeling op de site van de Sociale verzekeringsbank dat na 2015 een eenmalige uitkering zoals een afkoopsom kan leiden tot intrekking van de partnertoeslag AOW"

Ulenbelt (SP) asked why the SVB website stated that a one-off payment such as a lump sum to the partner after 2015 could end the AOW partner allowance permanently, and whether this was premature given the pending bill. Secretary of State Klijnsma answered that the notice was separate from the pending bill, was premature because incidental income was not explicitly addressed, and that the SVB has since amended the notice.
The notice on the SVB website was in that sense premature.
Het bericht op de SVB-site was in die zin voorbarig.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over het totaal mislukte Vogelaarbeleid

An MP from the PVV asks ministers whether they recognise the link between immigrant overrepresentation in crime and neighbourhood decline in the Vogelaar districts, why hundreds of millions were spent without results, and how future waste and lawlessness will be prevented, including deportation of offenders. The minister replies that the districts were selected on 18 indicators, that evaluations show mixed results, that the structural funding is ended except for nurses, and that further information on liveability will follow in autumn.
In the vision on liveability that you will receive this autumn, I will go into this further.
In de visie op leefbaarheid die u dit najaar ontvangt, zal ik hier verder op in gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over “de schoolverlaterskorting in de bijstand”

An SP MP asks whether the six-month 20% reduction for school leavers claiming social assistance is fair, and whether single parents with minor children should be exempt. The state secretary defends the reduction as matching the lower living costs of students, says municipalities can account for family circumstances, and declines to create an exception under article 28 WWB.
The college can take the applicant's family situation into account.
Het college kan rekening houden met de gezinssituatie van de aanvrager.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over de resultaten van het onderzoek van FNV naar het functioneren van Werk.nl

An MP asked the minister about FNV survey results showing dissatisfaction with the UWV website werk.nl, including low availability, sanctions for failing digital obligations, and reduced face-to-face service. The minister acknowledged shortcomings, defended the digital-service policy and budget cuts, described fixes and an extra check before sanctions, and said sanctions would not be imposed when the site was unavailable.
It cannot be that sanctions are imposed when benefit recipients could not meet their obligations because the website was not working.
Het kan niet zo zijn dat sancties worden opgelegd als uitkeringsgerechtigden niet aan hun verplichtingen hebben kunnen voldoen omdat de website niet werkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over herkeuring van jonggehandicapten

An MP asks the state secretary why she publicly claimed Wajong beneficiaries would not be mass re-assessed, then announced re-assessments, and why figures on beneficiaries moving to welfare were given in the media but not in the letter to parliament. The secretary answers that re-assessment will follow the social accord, the detailed design is still being worked out, the figures are UWV projections, and the figures were disclosed later to avoid unrest.
Why did you omit to report this in the letter to the House of Representatives?
Heeft u verzuimd dit in de brief aan de Tweede Kamer te melden?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over werknemers van PostNL die tijdens de staking het werk van de zelfstandige pakketbezorgers overnemen

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether PostNL was right to call on its staff to deliver parcels with private cars during the strike by self-employed couriers, whether this breaches the right to strike, and how staff were insured. The minister said the parties reached an agreement, that the right to strike is for courts to weigh case by case, and that PostNL insures its staff and would be held liable as client in case of third-party damage.
It is therefore not for me but, where applicable, for the court to judge any possible conflict with the right to strike.
