Het is dus niet aan mij maar in voorkomend geval aan de rechter om een oordeel te vellen over eventuele strijdigheid met het stakingsrecht.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het laffe Marokkaanse geweld tegen twee zusjes

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked the ministers about a violent incident against two sisters by Moroccan youths, the over-representation of Moroccan Dutch in violent crime statistics, the government's seriousness on the issue, and whether offenders should be prosecuted, denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that the SCP explains only part of the gap, that the approach targets risk behaviour without ethnic distinction, that local authorities handle public order, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common crimes is not possible.
Revoking Dutch nationality following a conviction for common offences is not possible.
De intrekking van de Nederlandse nationaliteit wegens een veroordeling voor commune misdrijven is niet mogelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaver en Voortman over onterecht betaalde belasting door zwangere zzp’ers

Two GroenLinks MPs asked whether self-employed women (zzp'ers) who paid income tax on pregnancy benefits from their insurer can recover it, whether earlier years are covered, and what measures will prevent future over-taxation. The State Secretary answered that affected taxpayers can request ex officio reduction until five years after the tax year, that these benefits are not taxable, and that the Tax Administration will add a note on this to general information and the income tax return guidance.
The self-employed person can therefore still submit a request for ex officio reduction throughout 2013 for the years 2008 and onward.
De zzp’er kan gedurende het hele jaar 2013 dus nog een verzoek om ambtshalve vermindering indienen over de jaren 2008 en volgende.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de belachelijke militaire multiculti-oefening in Amsterdam

MPs Van Klaveren and Helder asked about child abuse at a Tilburg Koran school, why the complaint did not lead to prosecution, how many complaints against Islamic institutions led to cases, and whether schools promoting hatred should be closed. The minister said the prosecutor found too few leads for further investigation, data cannot be split by institution type, and closure is possible only where needed for public order or building-safety violations.
The Public Prosecution Service assessed the complaint and concluded it offered too few leads for further criminal investigation.
Het OM heeft de aangifte beoordeeld en is tot de conclusie gekomen dat deze te weinig aanknopingspunten biedt voor een nader strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord vragen Hamer en Otwin van Dijk over het bericht dat het UWV een ontslagvergunning heeft verleend aan thuiszorgorganisatie Sensire om 1.100 thuiszorgmedewerkers te ontslaan

Two PvdA MPs asked why UWV granted Sensire permission to dismiss 1,100 home-care workers despite the care accord and whether the works council and unions were overruled. The minister said UWV applied the dismissal rules on business-economic grounds, that the decision is for UWV and the municipalities, and that the state secretary will contact the parties shortly.
UWV acted in application of the dismissal and policy rules.
UWV heeft gehandeld met toepassing van de ontslag- en beleidsregels.
Antwoord vragen Kooiman en Ulenbelt ver over het bericht dat thuiszorgmedewerkers massaal ontslagen worden

MPs Kooiman and Ulenbelt asked why UWV granted dismissal permits for about 1,100 home-care workers at Thuishulp Sensire and whether the state will intervene. The state secretary answered that the dismissals are the employer's own business decision on economic grounds, that UWV acted within its rules, that most work should remain in 2014 and that he will contact the parties and report on transition plans.
UWV acted in accordance with the dismissal and policy rules.
UWV heeft gehandeld in overeenstemming met de ontslag- en beleidsregels.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren,  Bontes en Wilders over 'Ramadandiensten' bij de politie

PVV MPs asked whether police receive extra Ramadan shifts, whether Ramadan and Eid generate more reported nuisance and crime, whether police adapt to Islamic practice, and whether extra deployment could be recovered from convicted offenders. The state secretary confirmed the news report, said police and prosecutors do not record Ramadan-related incidents, stated that the mayor decides deployment based on safety needs, and saw no reason to recover costs.
Neither the police nor the Public Prosecution Service records how many reports are related to Ramadan or the Eid festival.
Er wordt door de Politie of OM niet bijgehouden hoeveel meldingen gerelateerd zijn aan de Ramadan of het Suikerfeest.
Antwoord vragen Dik-Faber en Schouten over mantelzorgers die weinig steun hebben aan hun baas

MPs Dik-Faber and Schouten asked whether the government recognises that informal carers receive little support from their employers, whether it will convene social partners to improve workplace arrangements, and what further measures it will take. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to a planned labour-and-care summit with social partners in autumn and to extended leave rules, and said the carers letter would address the work-care link only briefly.
In the coming period we will work together with the minister and state secretary of OCW to prepare a 'labour-and-care summit' which is expected to take place in the autumn.
De komende tijd werken wij samen met de minister en staatssecretaris van OCW een «arbeid-en-zorgtop» uit die naar verwachting in het najaar zal plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Wilders en De Roon over de belachelijke militaire multiculti-oefening in Amsterdam

PVV MPs asked the Defence minister about a military exercise in Amsterdam neighbourhoods, questioning its purpose, whether soldiers should be taught about Islam, and whether mosque construction is facilitated abroad. The minister replied that contact with local populations is standard training, that cultural customs are respected where needed, and that soldiers do not interfere in local opinions, though infrastructure reconstruction may occur on missions.
Soldiers train daily for all possible deployments and missions of the armed forces within their legal tasks at home and abroad.
Militairen oefenen dagelijks voor alle mogelijke inzet en missies van de krijgsmacht in het kader van de wettelijke taken in binnen- en buitenland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Omtzigt over het artikel “Terugvorderen opbrengst belastingfraude moeilijk”

An MP asked the State Secretary for Finance and other ministers about reports that recovering proceeds of tax and benefit fraud is difficult, including fraud amounts and fines in a Deventer case, foreign childcare allowances, unregistered persons receiving allowances, Polish recipients, and EU residence and coordination rules. The government answered in detail, providing figures, explaining controls, and acknowledging some untraceable recipients and data limitations, while promising maatregelen to improve pre-payment checks and a later overview.
The correct amount cannot be given.
Het juiste bedrag is niet te geven.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Madlener over het bericht: ‘Rutte: werkloze jongeren naar Nederland halen’ van de website van de Telegraaf

Wilders and Madlener asked the Prime Minister whether he is aware of a news report that Rutte wants to bring unemployed youth to the Netherlands, and insulted him with a rhetorical question. The government replied that the report is known and that it will respond in answer to a separate request from the Social Affairs committee.
The cabinet will respond to this news report in reply to the request of the standing committee for Social Affairs and Employment of 9 July.
Het kabinet zal op deze berichtgeving reageren in antwoord op het verzoek van de vaste commissie voor Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid van 9 juli jl.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over "kinderopvangtoeslag"

An SGP MP asks the minister why childcare allowance can be paid for peuterspeelzaal-type care delivered in a registered daycare centre, despite a court ruling and the law's intent, and whether this weakens the standalone peuterspeelzaal. The minister replies that eligibility rests on registration and on the hours worked by the least-working parent, that the law's scope is unchanged, that municipalities are responsible for peuterspeelzalen, and that no change to the legal distinction was made.
I have no data on the extent of this specific form of organisation.
Over de omvang van deze specifieke vormgeving zijn mij geen gegevens bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden vr Van Dekken en Kuzu over het duurder worden van sportbeoefening

Two PvdA MPs asked whether rising sports fees threaten children's and low-income participation in sport and what the government will do. The minister says local authorities are primarily responsible, points to the Sport en Bewegen in de Buurt programme, Sportimpuls, Jeugdsportfonds funding and poverty-policy funds, and commits to discussions with VNG and the Jeugdsportfonds.
Encouraging sport and exercise is primarily a local responsibility.
Het stimuleren van sporten en bewegen is primair een lokale verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Wilders en Van Klaveren over de wens van het Nederlandse volk de voortgaande islamisering te stoppen

PVV MPs Wilders and Van Klaveren asked the government whether it would stop mosque construction, introduce a constitutional ban on sharia, halt immigration from Islamic countries, and apologise for mass immigration and Islamisation. The minister answered that freedom of religion is a core democratic right, that municipalities decide on new mosques, that nationality is not relevant to residence permits, and that the government does not recognise mass immigration or Islamisation.
People are free to adhere to and profess any religion they choose.
Het staat mensen vrij welk geloof dan ook aan te hangen en te belijden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over het artikel ‘meer kans op een baan met een Nederlandse naam’

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister about a report that job applicants with non-Dutch names are less likely to be invited to interviews, and whether anonymous application should be promoted, with government as a leader. The state secretary found the finding disappointing, noted discrimination must be fought where proven, pointed to a pending SER advisory report, and declined to promote anonymous applications, saying employers bear primary responsibility.
Following this advice, I want to examine whether and what follow-up actions on labour market discrimination are needed.
Naar aanleiding van dit advies wil ik bezien of en zo ja welke vervolgacties op het gebied van arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Dekken en Hamer over het bericht ‘NOM wil bemiddelaar om PPG te redden’

Two Labour MPs asked the Social Affairs and Economic Affairs ministers about reports that the Northern Development Company (NOM) wanted a mediator to save fibre-optic firm PPG, which faced closure threats amid union action. Minister Asscher answered that PPG management and union FNV Bondgenoten reached a deal through mediation by the Drenthe Commissioner of the King, that the closure threat is lifted, and that the dispute is a private matter so no further government action is needed.
The negotiations between PPG's management and FNV Bondgenoten are primarily a private matter and have since led to a good outcome.
De onderhandelingen tussen de directie van PPG en FNV Bondgenoten betreffen in eerste aanleg een private aangelegenheid en hebben intussen tot een goede uitkomst geleid.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over "het huren van kantoren door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) van bedrijven die niet in Nederland gevestigd zijn"

MP Ulenbelt asked whether UWV should avoid renting offices from landlords that may avoid Dutch tax, and whether the government will investigate the ownership and tax residence of those landlords' groups. The minister answered that UWV's role is limited to concluding a lawful lease, that investigating the landlord's corporate structure is the landlord's responsibility, and that fraud falls to police, prosecutors and the FIOD, so no investigation is planned.
The design of the organisational and financing structure is the responsibility of the landlord.
De inrichting van de organisatie- en financieringsstructuur is de verantwoordelijkheid van de verhuurder.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Bontes en Helder over de Nederlandse politie als islamitische huwelijksbemiddelaar

Three PVV MPs asked whether police and the subsidised organisation Fier Fryslân helped arrange an Islamic marriage of minors, how many police hours this cost, how many Islamic marriages occur, the link between Islam and honour-related violence, and whether perpetrators should be denaturalised. The minister replied that both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor, that no data exist on Islamic marriages, that honour codes are cultural rather than religious, that prosecution was suspended in favour of mediation, and that the Nationality Act does not allow denaturalisation for these offences.
That is not correct. Based on the factual account requested from Fier Fryslân and the official police report, both organisations did not assist in a religious marriage of a minor.

Dit klopt niet. Op basis van het bij Fier Fryslân opgevraagde feitenrelaas en het bij de politie opgevraagde ambtsbericht blijkt dat beide organisaties niet hebben meegewerkt aan een religieus huwelijk van een minderjarige.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht ‘Politie hielp minderjarigen met islamitisch huwelijk’

An MP from the VVD asked the government whether police, Fier Fryslân and youth care helped minors enter a religious-only Islamic marriage to prevent honour-related conflict, and what consequences should follow. The minister answered that these bodies were involved only for safety and did not broker the marriage, that such marriages are prohibited, and that nationality withdrawal is not possible under current law.
The police only ensured the safety of the person involved.
De politie heeft slechts gezorgd voor de veiligheid van betrokkene.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de rol van ondersteunende organisaties bij het sluiten van een religieus kindhuwelijk

An MP asked the government how it reacted to reports that police and Fier Fryslân helped arrange a religious child marriage, and how agencies handling honour-related cases weigh cultural background against law and women's rights. The minister denied that the law was broken, said the police withdrew once safety was no longer at stake, stated that LEC-EGG was not involved in imam marriages, and held that the victim's interest comes first with no concessions to laws that conflict with Dutch law.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over het bericht dat een moskee in Amsterdam Slotervaart onder ‘Koeweits gezag’ staat

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about reports that a Kuwaiti government-linked official chairs the foundation owning the Blue Mosque in Amsterdam Slotervaart, its foreign funding, its orientation, and whether subsidies or oversight apply. The minister answered that foreign funding of mosques is permitted within integration limits, that the Rijksoverheid gives no subsidy for religious practice, that the Blue Mosque received no municipal subsidy, and that the Openbaar Ministerie and a motion-based study address oversight of foreign financing.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Kerstens over de opleiding van heftruckchauffeurs

MPs Kuiken and Kerstens asked the minister whether forklift training is of poor quality and whether minimum standards, certification or legal obligations are needed given many forklift accidents. The minister acknowledged the seriousness of the signals but said no widespread problem was reported, relied on employers and industry bodies (including a quality-criteria handbook), and only committed to raising the issue with sector organisations.
However, the ministry has not received signals that the mentioned problems with forklift training are widespread.
Het ministerie heeft echter geen signalen ontvangen dat de genoemde problemen met heftruckopleidingen wijdverbreid zijn.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en De Graaf over het zwichten voor islamitisch antisemitisme

PVV MPs asked whether a memorial plaque for Jewish WWII victims was dropped after Muslim residents objected, and about combating Islamic antisemitism and a national study of it. The minister says the earlier Joods Lyceum memorial debate was not a concrete initiative and no objections were known, and points to existing research and a round table rather than a new national study.
I am prepared to commission specific follow-up research if the expected research results provide too little knowledge
Ik ben bereid om specifiek vervolgonderzoek te laten uitvoeren als de te verwachten onderzoeksresultaten te weinig kennis opleveren
Antwoord vragen Van Weyenberg en het lid Pieter Heerma over "een miljoenenstrop voor werkgevers door gebruik van onjuiste UWV-gegevens voor de nieuwe ziektewet "

MPs Van Weyenberg and Heerma asked the minister about press reports that over a third of UWV data used to set Ziektewet premiums is wrong, and whether employers could face large unjustified costs. The minister does not recognise the percentage, says employers should check the data and object annually, and points to UWV's data quality efforts and the 2014 flex-worker financing reform without committing to new measures.
No, I do not recognise the percentage that is mentioned.
Nee, het percentage dat wordt genoemd herken ik niet.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren over de bouw van een Turkse enclave in Rotterdam

An MP from the PVV asks the ministers whether they will stop a planned Turkish-only neighbourhood in Rotterdam, whether ethnic segregation is undesirable, and whether Turks should be advised to leave the Netherlands. The minister answers that a neighbourhood exclusive to one ethnic group would be undesirable and that the municipality says it will be open to all, but that the project is a local matter and no national measures will be taken, and that return is an individual choice.
I will not take any measures. The possible development of this project and projects like it is a local matter.
Ik zal geen maatregelen nemen. De eventuele ontwikkeling van dit project en projecten als deze zijn een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over de steun van Nederlandse moslims voor jihadgangers naar Syrië

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether a survey showing that nearly three-quarters of Muslims view jihadist travellers to Syria as heroes reflects Islamic approval of violence, and what the government will do about the supposed large-scale support among Muslims for jihadists. Minister Asscher answered that the research confirmed emotional engagement and broad support for fighters against the Syrian regime, but did not examine support for jihadist motives, so the conclusion of majority support for jihadist travellers cannot be drawn.
Support for jihadist motives and jihadist factions in the Syrian conflict was not examined in this research.
De steun voor jihadistische motieven en jihadistische facties in het Syrische conflict is in dit onderzoek niet onderzocht.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Yücel over de verdenking van mishandeling op koranscholen in Tilburg

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about suspected physical abuse at Quran schools in Tilburg, whether such incidents are more common at religious schools, and whether teachers using corporal punishment should be sanctioned. The minister reported six signals of possible child abuse at two Quran school organisations, said corporal punishment is not permitted in schools or the social environment, and noted that Quran schools fall outside Inspectorate supervision and that local authorities are responsible for acting on such signals.
For non-formal education, part of children's social environment, it is the responsibility of local authorities to address the institutions concerned when there are signals of physical punishment.

Voor niet-formeel onderwijs, onderdeel van de sociale leefomgeving van kinderen, geldt dat het de verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale autoriteiten is om bij signalen van fysieke bestraffing betreffende instellingen aan te spreken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yücel en Ypma over het bericht dat allochtone leerlingen vaak niet welkom zijn op een 'witte school'

MPs Yücel and Ypma asked whether primary schools refuse ethnic minority pupils and what the government will do about it and about school segregation. The state secretary said the small study does not support the conclusion, that OCW has no data showing ethnic background plays a role in admissions, that further research and dialogue with school boards are not needed, and that segregation is tackled locally with quality measures.
No such conclusion can be drawn from the small-scale study.
Uit het kleinschalige onderzoek kan deze conclusie niet worden getrokken.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Karabulut inzake scholen die allochtone leerlingen weigeren

MPs Van Dijk and Karabulut asked about reports that schools refuse pupils of immigrant origin, and about a Forum study on admission barriers faced by migrant parents. The state secretary answered that the small-scale study cannot establish a clear pattern, that refusing pupils on ethnic grounds is unacceptable, and that desegregation is tackled locally, without a large-scale study.
Het tegengaan van segregatie is lokaal belegd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de komst van  de imam al Mutawa

Two PVV MPs asked whether the minister would act against a cleric they described as a hate preacher who called for stoning women, including by denying him entry and questioning the Islamic University Rotterdam that invited him. The minister condemned calls to violence but said there were no indications the cleric incites violence, that visa applications are assessed under the Visa Code, and that the inviting institution has not shown itself harmful to integration.
However, I have no indications that the person in question calls for violence.
Ik heb echter geen aanwijzingen dat genoemde persoon oproept tot geweld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman inzake risico's van de bezuinigingen voor de kwaliteit van de kinderopvang

An MP asked the minister about an Abvakabo survey showing quality pressures in childcare, staffing ratios not being met, growth in zero-hour contracts, and underspending on childcare allowance. The minister acknowledged the concerns, pointed to GGD inspection and municipal enforcement, and declined to reinvest the underspent funds given the economic situation.
Locations where frequent and/or serious violations (such as on the staff-child ratio) are found are visited more often by the GGD.
Locaties waar veelvuldig en/of zware overtredingen (zoals op de beroepskracht-kindratio) worden geconstateerd, worden extra vaak bezocht door de GGD.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de band tussen de Moslimbroederschap en een Amsterdamse moskee

An MP asks whether the owner of an Amsterdam mosque is linked to the Muslim Brotherhood, whether the government will bar foreign-funded mosques or Islamic-cooperation-linked funding, and which mosques receive foreign funding. The minister answers that the government does not track such affiliations, that religious freedom limits intervention, that AIVD can investigate threats, and that a Parliament motion on foreign financing is being followed up.
This is not known to us. The government does not keep an overview of which individuals are affiliated with which organisations.
Dit is bij ons niet bekend. De overheid houdt geen overzicht bij van welke individuen aan welke organisaties zijn gelieerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Groot en Kerstens over zzp'ers die door de Bbz-regeling in de knel raken

MPs asked whether self-employed people on Bbz benefits are being pushed into financial trouble when a Bbz loan is converted into a non-repayable benefit, causing loss of allowances, and how the tax office and municipalities handle the annual statement and this conversion. The minister answered that the conversion is taxed in the year of definitive determination, that individual cases fall to municipalities and the tax secrecy duty, suggested adjusting income estimates for allowances, and said he will ask the state secretary to explore options and inform the House.
However, I have persuaded the state secretary of Finance to explore other options to mitigate or remove the described effects.
Wel heb ik de staatssecretaris van Financiën bereid gevonden andere mogelijkheden te onderzoeken om de geschetste effecten te matigen dan wel weg te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Meenen en Van Weyenberg over het bericht ‘Wachtlijsten op de voorschool groeien’

Two D66 MPs asked the state secretary and minister about reports that waiting lists for pre-school education for children at risk of language delay are growing, and about how many such children are affected and what will be done. The government calls the growing waiting lists worrying, says it cannot determine how many target-group children are waiting, estimates about 45,000 target children, and places the duty to provide places on municipalities, with the Inspectorate of Education supervising, promising a joint letter before summer.
It is up to the municipalities to organise this; they also hold the instruments to resolve this at local level.
Het is aan de gemeenten om dit te organiseren; zij hebben ook de instrumenten in handen om dit op lokaal niveau op te lossen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kuiken en Hamer over rijopleidingen en het opleiden van rijinstructeurs door het UWV

MPs Kuiken and Hamer asked about high dropout from UWV-funded driving instructor training, selection of trainees, recovery of training costs, a bankruptcy that disrupted 255 trainees, and how many have been trained. The government answered that dropout is in line with average re-integration training, selection followed protocol, cost recovery occurs in some cases via sanctions, affected trainees were placed in other training, and only 144 of 391 tracks ended in placement.
The number of dropouts from the driving instructor training does not differ from the average dropout rate for training within the re-integration of benefit recipients.
Het aantal uitvallers bij de opleiding rijinstructeur wijkt niet af van de gemiddelde uitval bij de opleidingen in het kader van de re-integratie van uitkeringsgerechtigden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Marcouch en Yücel over de gemeente Venray die in gesprek is met de Marokkaanse overheid over criminele jongeren

MPs Marcouch and Yücel asked whether the municipality of Venray has received help from the Moroccan government in tackling criminal youths of Moroccan origin, and whether this is appropriate. The minister replied that the mayor only had informal, informative contacts with Moroccan officials, no agreements were made, that the problem is a Dutch responsibility, and that his ministry has itself provided support.
There is, however, no question of cooperation or assistance in tackling this problem.
Van samenwerking en hulp bij de aanpak van dit probleem is echter geen sprake.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Kuiken over giftige gassen in vliegtuigen

MPs Kerstens and Kuiken asked the state secretary whether the Zembla broadcast on toxic gases in aircraft cabins and cockpits warranted further investigation, what was done after the 2010 broadcast, and whether the issue would be raised internationally. The government answered that EASA is primarily responsible, that prior inquiries found no grounds for new rules, that REACH analysis of TCP is scheduled for 2014, and that EASA will report semi-annually and Parliament will be informed of developments.
I note that various parties continue to want to be kept informed about developments regarding TCP.
Ik constateer dat er bij diverse partijen behoefte blijft om op de hoogte te blijven over de ontwikkelingen in het kader van TCP.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over ‘het verbod in de cao Besloten Busvervoer om zzp’ers in dienst te nemen’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the clause in the collective agreement for private bus transport that bars carriers from using drivers not employed under an employment contract, and similar CAO clauses excluding self-employed workers, are undesirable, incompatible with the Competition Act and the general-binding-declaration test, and whether action will follow. The minister replied that such clauses are permitted under the Collective Agreements Act and competition law, do not bar self-employed workers from working or founding their own companies, are not contrary to the public interest, and that no action is warranted.
There is no ground to refrain from declaring this provision generally binding.
Er is geen grond om deze bepaling niet algemeen verbindend te verklaren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Gerven en Ulenbelt over nieuwe technieken voor asbestverwijdering

MPs Van Gerven and Ulenbelt asked the ministers how the new Foamshield asbestos-containment technique was assessed, whether workers and residents will be protected, who supervises the trial, and what the products and costs are. The government answered that the work meets existing Arbo rules, that exposure will stay below limit values, that Inspectie SZW will inspect alongside local bodies, and that the certification body Ascert is still studying whether the technique can be validated.
Yes, I am aware of the planned application in Zeist of a new technique, under the name Foamshield.
Ja, ik ben bekend met de voorgenomen toepassing in Zeist van een nieuwe techniek, onder de naam Foamshield.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "het huren van kantoren door UWV van bedrijven die niet in Nederland gevestigd zijn

Mr Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether UWV rents offices from landlords with foreign, possibly tax-avoiding structures and how much tax the state loses as a result. The minister replied that UWV does not investigate the ownership chains of landlords, that 132 buildings are rented from Dutch and five German owners at about 81 million euro a year, that rental income from Dutch property is taxed in the Netherlands, and that tax information on individuals cannot be disclosed.
UWV does not investigate the organisational and financing structure of the group to which a landlord may belong.
UWV voert geen onderzoek uit naar de organisatie- en financieringsstructuur van de groep waartoe een verhuurder eventueel behoort.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Dijkgraaf over "kinderopvangtoeslag".

MP Dijkgraaf (SGP) asks the Social Affairs minister whether childcare allowance has been extended to peuterspeelzaal users through the December 2012 letter, whether the Tax Authority received guidance, and how this fits the Wet OKE and the court ruling in Middelburg. The minister denies any extension, says the allowance is still excluded for peuterspeelzalen, defends the minor-partner hours criterion, and promises to inform the Chamber before summer on financing plans.
Care in peuterspeelzalen does not give entitlement to childcare allowance.
Opvang in peuterspeelzalen geeft geen recht op kinderopvangtoeslag.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Omtzigt over "harde eisen van de arbeidsinspectie aan Odfjell na ernstige overtredingen" (De bijlage is ter vertrouwelijke inzage gelegd, alleen voor de leden, bij het Centraal I

MPs Geurts and Omtzigt asked whether the Labour Inspectorate's 2007 letter with eleven hard demands to Odfjell was complied with, and asked for the full file and all inspectorate letters to Odfjell over ten years to be made public. Minister Asscher confirmed the letter, listed the inspection visits and which violations were resolved, noted that the ATEX violation led to a criminal report and court ruling, and made the file and letters available only for confidential inspection by MPs due to the company's commercial interests.
Given Odfjell's commercial interests, I make this data available to your House only for confidential inspection.
Gelet op het bedrijfsbelang van Odfjell stel ik u deze gegevens vertrouwelijk, alleen ter inzage aan uw Kamer, ter beschikking.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Helder over het mislukken van de linkse methode van 'pappen en nathouden'

Two PVV MPs asked whether the government will stop funding social prevention projects such as street coaches, neighbourhood barbecues and combat sports in favour of harsher repression, after a study found such interventions did not reduce neighbourhood nuisance. The minister answered that the study will be shared with municipalities, that local authorities are primarily responsible for choosing combinations of preventive and repressive measures, and that the government will not change course toward minimum sentences or wider expulsion powers beyond existing policy.
It is therefore up to the local government and its partners to assess which (combinations of) measures are deployed.
Het is dan ook aan het lokaal bestuur en zijn partners om te beoordelen welke (combinaties van) maatregelen worden ingezet.
Antwoord vragen Potters over het bericht dat er in de bouwsector de afgelopen jaren veel meer doden en gewonden zijn gevallen in verhouding tot andere sectoren

MP Potters asked the minister about reports that construction has far more deaths and injuries than other sectors, and whether limited Dutch language skills of foreign workers contribute to accidents. Minister Asscher said no causal link between language and construction accidents has been demonstrated, but announced a language requirement limited to certification-bound high-risk occupations, with employers responsible for ensuring understandable instructions.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over het onderzoek van FNV naar het functioneren van Werk.nl

An SP MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about FNV research finding that users rate the Werk.nl job-matching website poorly, and about UWV's shift to digital services, automatic sanctions, job-vacancy coverage, staff cuts and closure of regional offices. The minister acknowledged the criticism, said UWV is improving digital services and that sanctions are preceded by a warning, a werkcoach assessment and a right to respond, and said the office reduction is needed for budget cuts and aligns with the Werkbedrijven.
Before a sanction is imposed, the client always first receives a pre-notification with an opportunity to respond.
Voordat een sanctie wordt opgelegd krijgt de klant altijd eerst een vooraankondiging met mogelijkheid tot verweer.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Kerstens en Hamer over aan het werk gaan vanuit de bijstand

MPs Kerstens and Hamer asked whether bureaucratic obstacles deter benefit recipients from accepting temporary agency work and whether temporary work is a good stepping stone to a permanent job. The state secretary acknowledged knowledge bottlenecks in rules and municipal practice, said the government is working with municipalities and agencies to reduce them, and said measures on flexible work and payrolling will be pursued.
We are currently working with municipalities, as announced in the cover letter to this study, to examine the bottlenecks they experience in this area, with temp agencies also involved.

Momenteel zijn wij, zoals aangekondigd in de aanbiedingsbrief bij dit onderzoek, samen met gemeenten bezig de door hen ervaren knelpunten op dit terrein te bezien, waarbij ook uitzendorganisaties zijn betrokken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Vermeij over het nieuwe voorstel van de Europese Commissie voor een financiële transactiebelasting

MPs Nijboer and Vermeij asked the Finance and Social Affairs ministers about the Commission's new financial transaction tax proposal, including its effect on Dutch pension funds, extraterritorial reach, a de minimis exemption, next steps, and compensation for non-participating states. Minister Dijsselbloem answered that the Netherlands will not join the enhanced cooperation yet because pension funds are still taxed, that the impact cannot yet be reliably calculated, and that compensation is not provided but will be raised in negotiations.
Therefore the Netherlands will for now not join the enhanced cooperation.
Nederland zal daarom op dit moment niet toetreden tot de nauwere samenwerking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Geurts en Bruins Slot over het bericht “Uitstoot van ammonia bij BASF De Meern”

MPs Geurts and Bruins Slot asked whether BASF De Meern was shut down over safety concerns after an ammonia and nitrogen oxide emission, and requested inspection histories, violations, sanctions and emission data. The government answered that the municipality halted the plant temporarily by administrative coercion, that the Inspectorate SZW found no worker safety risk, and listed past exceedances and inspection results, while noting that the ILT does not supervise the BRZO and that the answers needed more time.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over tot geweld bereide moslima’s

PVV MPs asked whether Islam calls on Muslims to use violence, how large the group of Muslim women willing to commit violence is, and what measures will counter the long-term risk. The minister says the research sample is not representative so no extrapolation is possible, and refers to the terrorism threat assessment and existing counter-radicalisation measures.
Based on the study 'Radicaal (On)zichtbaar' referred to in the cited newspaper article, no estimate can be made here.
Op basis van het onderzoek «Radicaal (On)zichtbaar» waar het geciteerde krantenartikel naar verwijst kan hier geen schatting van gemaakt worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over het bericht «Jeugd naar Syrië gelokt voor djihad»

An MP asked the government about reports that Dutch youth were recruited to jihad in Syria, including foreign influence on youth, the number involved, follow-up with families and youth care, Morocco's deradicalisation projects, and imams from Lebanon and Syria. The government answered that it is concerned, has no evidence of foreign state recruitment, will not say how many radicalised youths or preachers are active and cannot give figures, and described existing AIVD and prosecution tools while leaving case-by-case handling open.
I have no indications that foreign powers are recruiting for the jihadist struggle.
Ik heb geen aanwijzingen dat er sprake is van ronseling voor de jihadistische strijd door vreemde mogendheden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Bontes en Wilders over de enorme toename van het aantal «Nederlandse» jihadisten

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice and of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in Dutch jihadists, whether the government has oversight of them, their dual nationality, Islam's teaching on jihad, and deportation or denaturalisation of jihadists with dual nationality. The minister said the AIVD keeps as much oversight as possible, declined to give numbers or individual cases, noted most have a second nationality (mainly Moroccan or Turkish), and explained that citizenship can be revoked only for those with another nationality who are finally convicted of terrorism.
I cannot make concrete public statements about numbers or individual cases.
Ik kan in het openbaar geen concrete mededelingen doen over aantallen of individuele gevallen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Yücel over de oorzaken en voedingsbodem van de radicalisering van bijvoorbeeld de Nederlandse islamitische 
jongens die zich inzetten voor de jihad in Syrië

An MP asked the government about the causes and breeding ground of radicalisation of young Dutch Muslims travelling to Syria for jihad, and whether organisations contribute to it. The minister answered that radical movements such as Sharia4Holland and Behind Bars created environments for radicalisation, that the precise breeding ground is hard to pinpoint, and that returnees are assessed and may receive tailored support, while declining to give specific intelligence on persons or organisations.
I cannot make public statements about specific research data on persons or organisations.
Over specifieke onderzoeksgegevens over personen of organisaties kan ik in het openbaar geen mededelingen doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Heerma over de kinderopvangtoeslag

MPs Omtzigt and Heerma asked whether working lone parents living with a parent lost childcare allowance after the 2012 partner rules change, whether they were warned, whether allowance remains for shared households, and whether they will compensate affected parents. The minister confirmed the partner rule can strip allowance, that notification was given via general communication and personal letters, and that compensation is not proposed without a parliamentary decision because of budgetary consequences.
Het gaat dan om ca. 4,6 miljoen belastingplichtigen.
Antwoord vragen Van Nieuwenhuizen - Wijbenga over het gesjoemel met loon door Europese bedrijven in de bouwsector

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs about reports of European construction firms, including Strabag, allegedly cheating on wages and wage declarations in the Netherlands, and asked who enforces social premium payment, whether enforcement is adequate, and what measures will be taken. The minister said cross-border posting rules are a deliberate EU choice, that oneerlijke concurrentie must be fought, and that an integrated approach against schijnconstructies has been started and reported to parliament.
I cannot go into the way specific companies file declarations for wage and premium levies given the duty of confidentiality.
Op de wijze van aangifte doen voor de loon- en premieheffing door specifieke bedrijven kan ik gelet op de geheimhoudingsplicht niet ingaan.
Antwoord vragen Kerstens en Hamer over fraude bij de inzet van buitenlandse arbeidskrachten

Two PvdA MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs about press reports of wage fraud through cross-border posting of foreign workers, including whether a single lead enforcement body should be created. The minister answered that whether such arrangements are unlawful depends on the facts, that enforcement bodies cooperate where needed, and that a broader integrated approach will consider prevention and responsibility allocation among agencies.
Part of the integrated approach is first to examine how illegal or undesirable constructions can be prevented.
Onderdeel van de geïntegreerde aanpak is ten eerste dat wordt bezien op welke wijze illegale of ongewenste constructies kunnen worden voorkomen.
Antwoord vragen Bashir en Ulenbelt over gesjoemel met lonen in de bouw

MPs Bashir and Ulenbelt asked the ministers how foreign construction firms use constructions to underpay social premiums, which controls apply, whether the NMa, FIOD and Belastingdienst are involved, and what measures will follow. The minister answered that inspectorates are cooperating and have broad powers, pointed to an action plan on sham constructions with intensified supervision, and withheld Belastingdienst findings citing confidentiality.
As you have seen in the action plan, we will intensify this supervision.
Zoals u heeft gezien in het actieplan zullen we dit toezicht gaan intensiveren.
Antwoord vragen Öztürk over het kennisgebrek ten aanzien van verplichtingen van MKB-ondernemers

An MP asked the ministers whether a survey finding that half of SME owners do not know they must pay sick wages for up to two years, absent insurance, signals a dangerous knowledge gap, and what causes and remedies exist. The minister replied that about 80% of small employers hold sickness insurance, so most are informed, that information is widely available, and no new measures were announced.
In particular, the fact that 80% of small employers have insurance indicates that most employers have informed themselves well (or had themselves informed).
Met name het feit dat 80% van de kleine werkgevers een verzekering heeft, duidt er op dat de meeste werkgevers zich goed (hebben laten) informeren.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over "mogelijk misbruik van de tegenprestatie bij het aan het werk helpen van bijstandsgerechtigden"

An SP MP asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about municipalities exceeding norms for the 'tegenprestatie' (required reciprocal work) for welfare recipients, following a court ruling, and whether the scheme should be scrapped, clarified, or tied to written agreements and works council information. The State Secretary refused to scrap the tegenprestatie, said the legal conditions are clear, and left implementation to municipalities without new rules or commitments.
In response to this case, I see no reason to take further steps.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus zie ik geen reden om verdere stappen te ondernemen.
Antwoord vragen Marcouch en Hamer over het bericht “Vraag geen verlof aan voor staking DJI!

MPs Marcouch and Hamer asked whether the Ministry of Justice and Security's circular on union actions wrongly required staff to request leave for strike participation, and whether those staff should have leave reversed. The state secretary acknowledged the wording wrongly suggested leave was required, clarified that pay is withheld only when working time is used without leave, and issued a corrected letter with a special arrangement for the 25 April action.
With this wording, the suggestion was unintentionally created that action may only be taken if leave has been taken.
Met deze formulering is onbedoeld de suggestie gewekt dat alleen actie mag worden gevoerd als verlof is opgenomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over sluiting van peuterspeelzalen die draaien op vrijwilligers

An MP asks whether a Sneek playgroup run only by volunteers must close because the law requires paid staff, and whether an exemption granted to parent-run crèches should extend to such playgroups. The minister replies that closure is a matter for the municipality and the playgroup, that at least one paid professional per group is required with municipalities funded to meet it, and that no exemption will be given.

No. In light of implementing the quality improvement of playgroups planned in 2010, there are currently no new facts that would justify such an exceptional position for playgroups run exclusively by volunteers.

Nee. In het licht van het uitvoering geven aan de in 2010 voorgenomen kwaliteitsverbetering van peuterspeelzalen, zijn er geen nieuwe feiten om een dergelijke uitzonderingspositie voor peuterspeelzalen, die uitsluitend draaien op vrijwilligers, op dit moment te rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Yüçel en Jadnanansing over het optreden van een imam in de aula van een middelbare school in Vlissingen

MPs Yüçel and Jadnanansing asked how a controversial imam came to give a talk in a Vlissingen secondary school hall without the school knowing its content, and whether the school was put in an embarrassing position. The minister answered that the school rents out space without vetting event content, the organising group did not specifically report the speaker, the school will now assess rental requests on content, and the speech is publicly available online.
In future it will also assess rental requests on their content.
In de toekomst verzoeken van verhuur ook inhoudelijk zal beoordelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het niet controleren van werkgevers en opleiders door het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV) bij het plaatsen van een vacature

MP Ulenbelt asked the minister why UWV refers jobseekers to a driving instructor training run by a dubious provider, whether all providers should be vetted, what requirements apply to post vacancies on werk.nl, and whether such training should be subsidised. Minister Asscher answered that an investigation into the provider is ongoing, that pre-listing checks exist (account verification, the 2011 Inkoopkader scholing) but no ongoing checks of business conduct, and that the offending courses have been removed from the site.
UWV has started an investigation at the company concerned to establish whether there has been action in breach of the general terms and conditions.
UWV is een onderzoek gestart bij het betrokken bedrijf om vast te stellen of er sprake is van handelen in strijd met de algemene voorwaarden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over veiligheidscontroles bij medische kinderdagverblijven

An MP asked whether safety and quality controls at medical day-care centres for young children are adequate and why stricter rules for regular childcare (staff screening, four-eyes principle) do not apply to them. The state secretary replied that medical day-care falls under youth care law and health inspectorate oversight, that the four-eyes principle is impractical in youth care, that screening is being studied, and that no new legislation extending the childcare act is planned.
For youth care, it is currently being examined whether permanent screening of staff is possible and advisable.
Voor de zorg voor jeugd wordt momenteel onderzocht of permanente screening van medewerkers mogelijk en opportuun is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Ypma over toezicht op de medische kinderopvang

MPs Yücel and Ypma asked about the supervision of medical childcare after reports that no checks are carried out, including screening of staff and the four-eyes principle. The state secretary answered that the Inspectorate for Youth Care and the Health Care Inspectorate apply risk-based supervision, that no serious concerns emerged from visits, and that a four-eyes principle is impractical in youth care, without committing to new steps.
Taking further steps is not necessary in view of the above.
Het nemen van verdere stappen is gezien bovenstaande niet nodig.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Bommel en Karabulut over in Turkije opgepakte vakbondsleden

MPs Van Bommel and Karabulut asked about the arrest of trade union members in Turkey after the February 2013 embassy bombing, including KESK members, and about Turkish union and anti-terrorism law. The minister replied that 68 KESK members remain detained on terrorism membership suspicion without a known charge, that Turkey is reforming its laws, and that the Netherlands will raise the issue in dialogue but not interfere in Turkish legal proceedings.
The Netherlands does not interfere in the Turkish judicial process, but will follow the proceedings with interest.
Nederland mengt zich niet in de Turkse rechtsgang, wel zal Nederland de processen met belangstelling volgen.
Antwoord op Vragen van de leden Öztürk en Mei Li Vos over de heffing door het Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel voor het jaar 2013

MPs Öztürk and Mei Li Vos asked why the Hoofdbedrijfschap Detailhandel raised its 2013 levy above the previous year's level, how this relates to the planned abolition of the product and trade boards, and whether levy payers are properly informed. Minister Kamp replied that the increase reflects provisioning for the wind-down, higher purchasing costs and lost subsidies, that the board holds reserves insufficient to cover closure costs including a social plan, and that existing information duties suffice so no additional measures are needed.
I am of the view that, beyond the applicable statutory obligations and the supervision exercised over them, no additional measures are necessary.
Ik ben van mening dat er, naast de geldende wettelijke verplichtingen en het daarop gehouden toezicht, geen aanvullende maatregelen nodig zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Vermeij en Hamer over misbruik van ziekte door werkgevers

Two MPs asked the minister about reports that employers misuse sick leave to cut wage costs or push out staff, including keeping recovered workers registered as partially sick, limited access to occupational doctors, and oversight of medical information. The minister disapproves of registering fully recovered workers as sick, points to occupational doctors' advice and UWV or court routes for disputes, and says no cases are known of UWV dismissals of workers already back at work.
I do not approve of a worker who has fully resumed the agreed work after a period of sickness remaining administratively registered as partially incapacitated for one or a few percent.

Ik keur het niet goed dat een werknemer die na een ziekteperiode de bedongen arbeid volledig heeft hervat, administratief voor één of enkele procenten als arbeidsongeschikt geregistreerd blijft staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Heerma over het ontslaan van “ziek” personeel

MP Heerma (CDA) asked whether employers keep recovered workers registered as partially sick on paper so they can later obtain dismissal permission and whether such workers have been wrongly dismissed. Minister Asscher said he disapproves of administrative registration that does not match reality, but has no data and sees no need for research or compensation given existing dismissal protection and the UWV expert-opinion and appeal routes.
I see no reason to research this data or compensation options.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om onderzoek te doen naar deze gegevens c.q. naar compensatiemogelijkheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Azmani over de toename van het gebruik van sociale uitkeringen door arbeidsmigranten

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about rising social benefit use by EU labour migrants and what the government would do, including whether such migrants should be entitled to benefits within a year of arrival. The minister answered that the increase is mainly linked to a larger migrant population and the crisis, that EU migrants with a right of residence as workers may claim assistance without losing residence rights in all cases, that the IND assesses residence consequences case by case, and that the government is pursuing EU-level changes such as a seven-year waiting period.
I intend to ask the SCP to pay attention, in the context of the Integration Annual Report 2013, to benefit use by migrants compared with comparable native Dutch people.
Ik ben voornemens het SCP te vragen in het kader van het Jaarrapport Integratie 2013 aandacht te besteden aan het uitkeringsgebruik van migranten in vergelijking met vergelijkbare autochtonen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Klaveren over de mishandeling op Koranscholen

The MP asked whether the government knew of reports of abuse at Koran schools in Tilburg, which schools were involved, whether a national inquiry would be launched, and whether all schools using violence should be closed. The state secretary confirmed the reports concern two Tilburg-North venues, declined a new national study pointing to the 2012 inventory, and stated that corporal punishment is prohibited and closure is possible only under specific legal conditions.
We currently see no reason to repeat such a study.
Wij zien nu geen reden om een dergelijk onderzoek 3 te herhalen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Smits en Ulenbelt over het bericht dat steeds meer gemeenten honderden euro’s vragen voor het registeren van gastouders

MPs Smits and Ulenbelt asked minister Asscher about municipalities charging hundreds of euros in fees to register childminders. The minister said excessive fees are undesirable, that three municipalities charge about 1000 euros, he is banning fees for mutations in the register, he will evaluate the financial arrangements with the VNG, and he will examine the one-childminder-per-address rule.
Excessively high fees of about 1,000 euros, such as those charged by the three aforementioned municipalities, I consider undesirable.
Excessief hoge leges van circa € 1.000, – zoals de drie hiervoor genoemde gemeenten heffen, acht ik ongewenst.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Van Gerven over het bericht  “met vaststellen van nieuwe blootstellingsnormen voor asbest per 1 juli 2013 de bestaande voorzorgsmaatregelen onvoldoende bescherming bieden”

Two SP MPs asked whether new asbestos exposure limits effective 1 July 2013 would leave existing precautions insufficiently protective, and questioned the sector's safety awareness, respirator adequacy, and inspection compliance. The minister acknowledged that current methods will need adjustment, postponed the new limits to 1 January 2014, committed to a TNO study and an Inspectorate report around summer, and reported high rates of enforcement at asbestos removal sites.
Because I attach importance to a careful implementation, I have decided in response to postpone the introduction of the new limit values until 1 January 2014.
Omdat ik hecht aan een zorgvuldige uitwerking heb ik naar aanleiding daarvan besloten de invoering van de nieuwe grenswaarden uit te stellen tot 1 januari 2014.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Pieter Heerma en Rog over de verplichte taaltoets voor hbo-ers

MPs Heerma and Rog asked why higher-vocational (hbo) graduates must also pass the Dutch language test for pre- and early-school education (VVE) and whether municipalities may dismiss staff who refuse it. The state secretary answered that the test covers all VVE staff in the G37 cities regardless of qualification, that the test is needed to assess actual language levels, and that municipalities set subsidy conditions while employers decide on dismissal.
For all these reasons, it was chosen to test all pedagogical staff regardless of their prior education.
Om al die redenen is ervoor gekozen om alle pedagogisch medewerkers te toetsen ongeacht de vooropleiding.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over "de dagelijkse imperialistische moskeeoproep"

PVV MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked whether daily mosque calls to prayer are harmful to integration and whether mosques should be prevented from broadcasting them. Minister Asscher answered that religious freedom and church-state neutrality protect such calls, that municipalities may set rules on duration and volume under the Wet openbare manifestaties, and that no ground exists for banning them.
There is no ground for that.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Hamer en Jacobi over het dreigende collectieve ontslag bij Prins Dokkum en een reactie op de situatie bij het bedrijf Prins Dokkum waar gestaakt wordt tegen overplaatsing naar het buitenla

MPs Hamer and Jacobi asked the minister of Social Affairs about the threatened collective dismissal at Prins Dokkum after parent company Saferoad changed policy, including the legal force of employment guarantees given at the 2010 takeover and how such guarantees are weighed by UWV. The minister answered that the legal value depends on the guarantee's wording, that the UWV procedure is at an early stage, that guarantees are considered in the economic-necessity assessment, and that group-level profitability does not automatically defeat the subsidiary's dismissal case.
It is not for me to make further statements about the legal value of the employment guarantee in this individual case.
Het is niet aan mij om verdere uitspraken te doen over de juridische waarde van de werkgarantie in dit individuele geval.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos, Kerstens en Hamer over ‘het onderzoek naar de arbeidsomstandigheden in de Nederlandse pakketdienstensector’.

MPs Mei Li Vos, Hamer and Kerstens asked ministers about working conditions and bogus self-employment among parcel couriers, including PostNL subcontracting, VAR certificates, and whether the Inspectorates and competition authority should intervene. The government acknowledged the problems are undesirable, said bogus self-employment should be prevented and an action plan would follow, announced inspections and an exploratory study, and declined to disclose details of agreements with specific taxpayers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over "het bericht dat Nederland voor het Europees Hof wordt gedaagd wegens onvoldoende bescherming van zwangere vrouwen tegen discriminatie".

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that the European Commission would take the Netherlands to the EU Court over inadequate protection of pregnant women against discrimination at work. The state secretary replied that existing law is sufficient, the problem being awareness rather than regulation, that the infringement procedure is not yet before the Court, and that the Netherlands opposes extending maternity leave to 18 weeks with full pay.
I am of the view that this is sufficiently regulated by law.
Ik ben van mening dat dit voldoende wettelijk is geregeld.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over de toetreding van Kroatië

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about the planned postponement of free movement of workers for Croatia, the consistency with the Foreign Minister's remarks, Croatian qualifications, and the effects of posted-worker constructions and bogus constructions. The minister defended the postponement by pointing to rising unemployment and the need to activate domestic labour potential, and provided tables on permits and notifications for Bulgarian and Romanian workers while promising an action plan against bogus constructions.
I am not aware of how many Croatians have completed a technical degree.
Het is mij niet bekend hoeveel Kroaten een technische studie hebben gevolgd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Wilders, Tony van Dijck en Van Vliet over de sombere CBS-cijfers over de werkloosheid, de huizenprijzen en het consumentenvertrouwen

Opposition PVV MPs asked whether the minister would relax the 3% deficit ceiling and reconsider labour, housing and pension reforms in light of gloomy CBS figures on unemployment, house prices and consumer confidence. The minister replied that the 2013 deficit will exceed 3%, citing a housing package and business stimulus, that the government keeps its spending rules and will not add cuts in 2013, and that it will push ahead with reforms and targeted support for unemployed workers and youth.
The cabinet will further maintain the budget rules for 2013; any overruns will be resolved within the budget, and the spending ceiling will be respected.
Het kabinet zal verder voor 2013 de begrotingsregels handhaven; eventuele overschrijdingen zullen binnen de begroting worden opgelost, het uitgavenplafond wordt gerespecteerd.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hoogland en Hamer over ‘het algemeen verbindend verklaren van de cao Railinfra’

MPs Hoogland and Hamer asked whether the Railinfra collective labour agreement should be declared generally binding quickly, whether staff should transfer with concessions, and whether Dutch language skills of rail workers are ensured for safety. The minister replied that the new CAO is for social partners to request, that the government will not intervene in the rail contracting market, and that the Inspectorate found no evidence language problems caused unsafe situations, while noting existing working conditions rules.
However, the State Secretary for Infrastructure and the Environment and I do not wish to intervene in the market of rail contractors.
De Staatsecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu en ik willen echter niet interveniëren in de markt van spooraannemers.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over "minder vrije dagen voor niet-vakbondsleden"

An MP from D66 asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether collective agreements that give union members an extra study day and training budget over non-members are compatible with equal treatment, and whether the union dues and extension of collective agreements should be abolished. The Minister answers that such differentiation is a matter for private parties and ultimately for the courts, that agreements distinguishing members from non-members cannot be declared generally binding, and that he has asked the SER to consider the issue.
How much scope there is to make agreements that apply only to union members is a matter for the judgment of the court.
Hoe groot de ruimte is om afspraken te maken die alleen gelden voor vakbondsleden is aan het oordeel van de rechter.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Nieuwenhuizen-Wijbenga over "het bericht dat vakbondsleden voorgetrokken worden"

An MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether collective agreements that give union members extra leave or training, and the legality, fairness and effect of such distinctions between members and non-members. The minister answered that unequal cao terms are a matter for private parties, that courts decide on legality, and that the SER was asked to consider the support base of cao agreements.
On the scope to make agreements that apply only to union members, a judgment can be requested from the court.
Over de ruimte om afspraken te maken die alleen gelden voor vakbondsleden kan een oordeel aan de rechter worden gevraagd.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over hoogopgeleide arbeidsgehandicapten, die noodgedwongen in de Wajong terecht komen

An MP asked the state secretary about highly educated disabled people who end up on the Wajong benefit because employers do not hire them, including a blind lawyer's case, and asked about government targets, UWV re-integration practice and benefit levels. The state secretary acknowledged the problem, pointed to planned quota rules from 2015, ongoing government initiatives, individual tailoring by UWV, and rejected any cut to the Wajong benefit.
The policy aims to increase the labour market participation opportunities of people with a disability.
Het beleid is gericht op het vergroten van de mogelijkheden tot arbeidsdeelname van mensen met een handicap.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Beertema over de eis dat Nederland betaalt voor Turkse les op school

MPs Van Klaveren and Beertema asked whether the government agrees that a migrant organisation demanding Turkish-language lessons in Dutch schools at taxpayers' expense is absurd, and whether it will urge members to speak Dutch at home and leave for Turkey if they want Turkish lessons. The State Secretary replied that OALT was abolished in 2004 and that the matter is before the court so he will not comment further, while stressing that Dutch-language skills matter and that the ministers will work with migrant organisations, including Turkish ones, on improving children's Dutch.
Since the matter is now before the court, I will refrain from further comment.
Aangezien het nu onder de rechter is, onthoud ik mij verder van commentaar.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over ‘arbeidsmarktbeleid in Albert Heijn distributiecentra’

An SP MP asked the minister about a union dispute over workload and temp-agency practices at Albert Heijn distribution centres, including bonuses, conversion to permanent contracts, and intimidation. The minister declined to intervene in the dispute, called bonus and deployment policy an internal company matter, and pointed to employers' Arbo-law duties for intimidation.
As long as there is no reason for me to suppose that laws and regulations are being broken, I do not wish to interfere in this dispute.
Zolang er voor mij geen aanleiding is te veronderstellen dat wet- en regelgeving wordt overtreden, wil ik mij niet mengen in dit geschil.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over ‘het toepassen van opjaagbonussen bij Albert Heijn’

An MP asks whether Albert Heijn's distribution centres use bonuses that pressure temp workers into error-free work, whether other supermarkets do the same, and whether on-call and helper workers' rights are covered by a forthcoming report. The minister confirms the report but says pay policy is an internal company matter, offers little on other supermarkets or on-call workers, and promises a study of collected complaints later in 2013.
Pay policy is an internal matter for a company.
Het beloningsbeleid is een interne aangelegenheid van een bedrijf.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Van Vliet over de mogelijke komst van duizenden Marokkanen naar Nederland

Two PVV MPs asked whether the cessation of Dutch child benefit for children living abroad could drive thousands of Moroccan teenagers to the Netherlands, and asked about dual nationality and measures to prevent it. The minister replied that parents freely choose where their children live, that child benefit is only partial support, that the number of affected teenagers is about 1500, and that no measures to prevent such moves are planned.
I do not intend to take measures to prevent children currently living in Morocco from possibly moving to the Netherlands.
Ik ben niet van plan om maatregelen te treffen om te voorkomen dat kinderen die op dit moment in Marokko wonen eventueel in Nederland gaan wonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de nieuwe salafistische moskee van imam Fawaz

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked how the AIVD monitors imam Fawaz after his departure from the As Soenna mosque, whether they agree that a new salafist mosque is unwelcome, whether he should be denaturalised and expelled for calls to violence, and what measures will prevent the mosque opening. The minister declined to comment on individual AIVD investigations, defended religious freedom, explained that calls to violence alone are not grounds for losing Dutch nationality, and said the opening of a prayer house is a municipal zoning matter for The Hague.
No public statements are made about AIVD investigations in individual cases.
Over onderzoek van de AIVD in individuele zaken worden in het openbaar geen mededelingen gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Azmani en Yücel over moskee-internaten

MPs Azmani and Yücel asked ministers about moskee-internaten (mosque boarding schools), including Rotterdam's fire-safety enforcement, reports of corporal punishment, integration concerns, and whether legal tools exist. The ministers answered that local authorities are responsible, that the Rotterdam fire-safety conclusion is accepted, that a quality framework and supervision proposal will be developed by May, and that no full picture of indirect subsidies exists yet.

Therefore it has been agreed that central government and municipalities, in consultation with the internaten concerned and other parties, will develop a quality framework focusing on, among other things, pedagogical policy, safety and the welfare of children at these boarding schools.

Daarom is afgesproken dat rijk en gemeenten in afstemming met de betrokken internaten en eventuele andere partijen zullen komen tot een kwaliteitskader met aandacht voor onder andere het pedagogisch beleid, de veiligheid en het welzijn van kinderen op deze internaten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Karabulut over het bericht dat moskee internaten vaak niet veilig zijn en toezicht van de overheid ontbreekt

Karabulut (SP) asked about reports that mosque boarding schools were unsafe and that government oversight was lacking, including Rotterdam's inaction despite warnings. The ministers replied that Rotterdam found the schools fire-safe, that oversight of such boarding schools has shifted to provinces, that a quality framework with municipalities is being developed for pedagogical climate and safety, and that closure is not justified given current findings.

Therefore it has been agreed that central government and municipalities, in consultation with the boarding schools concerned and other parties, will develop a quality framework addressing among other things pedagogical policy, safety and the welfare of children at these boarding schools.

Daarom is afgesproken dat rijk en gemeenten in afstemming met de betrokken internaten en eventuele andere partijen zullen komen tot een kwaliteitskader met aandacht voor onder andere het pedagogisch beleid, de veiligheid en het welzijn van kinderen op deze internaten.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Van Gerven over misstanden bij Pleyade

Two SP MPs asked the State Secretary for Health and the Minister of Social Affairs about understaffing, neglect and union access at care provider Pleyade, including a staff diary sent to the Inspectorate. The government answered that the Inspectorate monitors the institution, that the care provider is primarily responsible for staffing and quality, and that the Inspectorate will revisit and gather information, without committing to new extra inspections.
Following the diary, the IGZ requested information from Altenova. Once the IGZ has received the information it will visit Altenova again.
De IGZ heeft naar aanleiding van het dagboek informatie opgevraagd bij Altenova. Als de IGZ de informatie heeft ontvangen zal zij Altenova nogmaals bezoeken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het invoeren van arbeidstijdverkorting om werkloosheid te bestrijden

An SP MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether working-time reduction should be introduced to fight unemployment, whether work should be shared more fairly, whether encouraging older workers to keep working harms young people, and whether the government will address the abolition of ADV days. The minister answered that past evidence shows working-time reduction did not raise employment, that employment and participation should rise instead, and that working time and ADV days are primarily for social partners, while he will discuss the labour market with them.
It is primarily up to the social partners to make agreements on working hours and pay, and therefore also on whether ADV days are abolished or not.
Het is primair aan de sociale partners om afspraken te maken over werktijden en beloning, en dus ook over het al dan niet afschaffen van ADV-dagen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Smits over “het bericht dat ouders massaal kinderopvang opzeggen”

An SP MP asked Minister Asscher about reports that parents were cancelling childcare en masse after the 2013 subsidy cut, including the claimed 30 percent drop, job losses and quality risks. The minister disputed the 30 percent figure (citing about 10 percent in the first three quarters of 2012), attributed reduced demand to the cuts and the economy, and promised further analysis in the second quarter of 2013 without committing to new measures.
I do not have exact figures on the number of employees in childcare who have lost their jobs.
Exacte cijfers over het aantal werknemers dat in de kinderopvang zijn/haar baan is kwijtgeraakt heb ik niet tot mijn beschikking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ulenbelt en Bashir over “premieshoppen op Cyprus”

MPs Ulenbelt and Bashir asked about Dutch lorry drivers employed through Cypriot agencies to pay social premiums in Cyprus, and about SVB and inspectorate controls. The minister says the SVB applies EU coordination rules, has had slow information exchange with Cyprus, will ask Cyprus to investigate, and promises an integrated approach to sham constructions by 1 May.
By 1 May at the latest I will inform you about an integrated approach to curbing sham constructions.
Uiterlijk 1 mei zal ik u informeren over een integrale aanpak voor het terugdringen van schijnconstructies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Voordewind over het rapport ‘sociaal economische gevolgen van echtscheiding’

An ChristenUnie MP asked the state secretaries and minister about a report on the socio-economic costs of divorce, including its effects on health, well-being, public finances, poverty risk and family policy. The government answered that the report does not directly establish effects on public finances and that a further cost study would not isolate causal links, pointed to work participation and social safety nets against poverty, and described the handreiking and planned evaluations on relationship support and family policy.
In view of the above, further research into the total societal costs of divorce will be insufficient to demonstrate causal relationships.
Gezien het voorgaande zal nader onderzoek naar de omvang van de totale maatschappelijke kosten van echtscheiding onvoldoende oorzakelijke verbanden kunnen aantonen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over de angstcultuur bij ALDI

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs and Employment about reports of an intimidation culture and suppression of staff at ALDI supermarkets, including a former company doctor's claims of many physical complaints among employees. The minister confirmed the reports, said the Labour Inspectorate has contacted the union CNV and will investigate its complaints, and agreed to the union's request for an inspection.
The Labour Inspectorate has been in contact with the union CNV and will investigate the CNV's complaints.
De Inspectie SZW heeft contact gehad met de vakbond CNV en gaat de klachten van het CNV onderzoeken.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over "het bericht dat nul-urencontracten zo snel mogelijk tot het verleden moeten gaan behoren"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that zero-hour contracts should be abolished quickly, including whether flex workers should have pension accrual and social security and whether the minister would legislate. The minister agreed flex workers' position should be strengthened, said they already have equal statutory social security and pension rights, and will present a policy outline in spring rather than commit to a bill.
In the cabinet's consultations with social partners on the social agenda, options for better balancing flexible and permanent work are also being discussed.
In het overleg van het kabinet met sociale partners over de sociale agenda wordt ook gesproken over de mogelijkheden om flexibele en vaste arbeid beter met elkaar in balans te brengen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Gesthuizen en Ulenbelt over de beveiliging van de website van het UWV

MPs Gesthuizen and Ulenbelt asked about an expired security certificate on the UWV complaints webpage, its risks, whether data was intercepted, and UWV's security policy. Minister Asscher answered that the outdated certificate was in use from 21 January to 1 February 2013, was fixed once discovered, that no misuse or intrusion was found, and that UWV's security measures are regularly audited.
Unfortunately, the outdated certificate was mistakenly used in that process.
Helaas is daarbij abusievelijk het verouderde certificaat gehanteerd.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Beertema over de ziekmeldingen van islamitische leerlingen met carnaval

PVV MPs asked whether Islamic objections to carnival can justify children staying away from school, whether parents should be fined, and whether the Netherlands has a Judeo-Christian and humanist tradition excluding Islam. The minister answered that such objections are no legal ground for leave or exemption under the Compulsory Education Act, that prosecution is for the courts, and that he rejects excluding Islam from the national tradition.
Objections to carnival do not constitute grounds for which leave and/or an exemption from compulsory education can be granted.
Bezwaren tegen carnaval vormen geen grond waarvoor verlof en/of een vrijstelling van de leerplicht kan worden verleend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over de mogelijke komst van een moskee op de Pier in Scheveningen
