Two MPs from the PVV asked whether a mosque on the Scheveningen pier was being planned by a foundation called Al Sahab, and whether such a mosque should be prevented. The government answered that the foundation does not exist (the report was a joke by a broadcaster) and that municipalities decide on building permits within zoning rules.
It is up to municipalities to judge possible applications for building permits; these must in any case fit within the zoning plan.
Het is aan gemeenten om te oordelen over mogelijke aanvragen voor bouwvergunningen; deze dienen in ieder geval te passen binnen het bestemmingsplan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Wilders over een petitie tegen de mogelijke bouw van een moskee in Enschede

PVV MPs asked whether the government received a petition against a mosque in Enschede, whether growing opposition should halt construction, and whether the Turkish state controls the Islamic Stichting Nederland. The minister acknowledged the petition, said citizens' wishes matter but that the municipality must judge them, and explained that the mosque will join the ISN network founded under Turkish religious authority, which is permitted within Dutch law.
Everyone in the Netherlands has the right to freedom of religion.
Iedereen in Nederland heeft het recht op vrijheid van godsdienst.
Antwoord op vragen Karabulut en Ulenbelt over arbeidsmarktbeleid in de Rotterdamse haven

MPs Karabulut and Ulenbelt asked minister Asscher about collective dismissals at Rotterdam Port Services, precarious temporary contracts for port workers, the ketenregeling, on-call work, and whether ILO convention 137 should be re-ratified. The minister answered that the ketenbepaling is not automatically circumvented, that the government is consulting social partners on flexible work protection, and that re-ratifying ILO 137 is not warranted, while many youth-employment answers were referred to municipalities.
The outcome of these talks will be presented to the House in a main-lines memorandum in the spring.
De uitkomst van deze gesprekken zal in het voorjaar in een Hoofdlijnennotitie aan de Kamer worden aangeboden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Vermeij over "de kwetsbare positie van jongeren op de werkvloer

MPs Kerstens and Vermeij asked the minister whether young workers are more often victims of workplace accidents and whether flexible employment explains this, and asked what extra attention is given. The minister disputes the claim using the TNO Monitor showing no higher accident risk for young workers, notes existing youth-focused safety measures and campaigns, and reports no clear link between flexible contracts and accidents.
I do not reach the same conclusion.
Ik kom niet tot dezelfde conclusie.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Albert de Vries over het bericht «Geen doorstart voor fosforfabrikant Thermphos»

MPs Vos and De Vries asked the ministers about the failure to find a buyer for Thermphos's Vlissingen plant, job losses, and who bears liability for dismantling and remediating the site. The minister answered that no buyer or going-concern prospect exists, government actively supported the curators, job losses are being addressed regionally, and liability questions remain with the curators, with no commitment to new legal measures beyond exploring them with the infrastructure minister.
For licence holders of nuclear reactors there is currently a statutory obligation to ensure funds are available for dismantling and remediation under all circumstances.

Voor vergunninghouders van kernreactoren bestaat er op dit moment een wettelijke verplichting om ervoor te zorgen dat er onder alle omstandigheden gelden beschikbaar zijn voor ontmanteling en sanering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn over de fraude met kinderopvangtoeslag

An MP asked the minister about a reported 6 million euro childcare benefit fraud case, how long it went undetected, whether fraud is more widespread, and what regulatory measures are planned. The minister confirmed the facts, explained the 2011 detection and the 2012 rule change limiting retroactive claims, and said no additional measures are planned for now.
I do not intend to take additional measures for now.
Ik ben niet voornemens om nu al aanvullende maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Hamer en Van Dekken over het verdwijnen van banen bij Menzis in Groningen

MPs Hamer and Van Dekken asked the minister whether he would act on the dismissal of 175 Menzis staff in Groningen, a region with high unemployment, and why the company targets that region disproportionately. The minister replied that corporate location and staffing decisions are private, that unions and works councils represent employees, and that municipalities and UWV handle local job support, with a social plan already agreed.
The location and personnel policy of individual companies is a private consideration that the cabinet does not get involved in.
Het vestigingsplaats- en personeelsbeleid van individuele bedrijven is een private overweging waar het kabinet niet in stapt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Hamer over oneigenlijk gebruik van de kinderopvangtoeslag

Two PvdA MPs asked the ministers about reported multi-million euro fraud with childcare allowances in 2009-2010 and why measures announced in 2011 did not prevent it. The minister answered that the measures took effect in 2012, that roughly 40 million euro of fraud had been established with a further 40 million under prosecution, that the effectiveness of the measures cannot be precisely demonstrated, and that no additional measures are planned for now.
I do not intend to take additional measures at this stage. When I see reason to do so, the House will be informed.
Ik ben niet voornemens om nu al aanvullende maatregelen te nemen. Wanneer ik daar aanleiding toe zie, zal de Kamer daar over informeren.
Antwoord vragen Potters en Schut-Welkzijn over de nieuwe Wajong

Two VVD MPs asked the state secretary about the new Wajong disability benefit, including UWV's handling of transitions from the old scheme, the 14-week decision period, and criteria for transferring. The state secretary answered that transition is voluntary, UWV published information in advance, the 14-week period is a statutory maximum, and she will evaluate the first three months before informing the House.
I want to form a picture based on the experiences of the first three months and consultation with UWV, and then inform the House.
Ik wil mij op basis van de ervaringen van de eerste drie maanden en overleg met het UWV hierover een beeld vormen en de Kamer aansluitend informeren.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over de sterke stijging van het aantal failliete kinderdagverblijven in 2012

An MP from GroenLinks asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the sharp rise in childcare bankruptcies in 2012, whether budget cuts are to blame, and what the government will do about employment and parents' ability to keep working. The minister attributes the bankruptcies to several causes including the economic crisis, higher parental fees and more competition, sees no need for further research, promises an analysis on usage of childcare in Q2 2013, and is willing to discuss childcare with the social partners if they wish.
Further research I do not consider necessary.
Een verder onderzoek acht ik niet noodzakelijk.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Madlener en Van Vliet over het bericht ‘Oudere mannen vaker werkloos’

Two PVV MPs asked the minister about a report that older men are increasingly unemployed and how this fits with raising the AOW age, the planned easing of dismissal law, the job-continuation bonus, and the bridging scheme for those unable to prepare for the higher AOW age. The minister replied that unemployment among men aged 45-65 remains the lowest of age groups, that dismissal criteria and the selection principle are retained, that the bonus supports working longer, and that bridging scheme contours were sent to parliament with implementation planned for 2013.
On 23 January a letter was sent to the House of Representatives outlining the contours of the bridging scheme.
Op 23 januari jl. is een brief verstuurd aan de Tweede Kamer waarin de contouren van de overbruggingsregeling zijn geschetst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over de storing op de website van het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MP Ulenbelt asked the minister whether affected people should be compensated for call costs during the UWV website outage and whether calls to the UWV call centre should be free in future outages. The minister said he is satisfied with UWV's handling, has asked UWV to limit inconvenience from future disruptions, and considers compensation of the small call costs unrealistic given administrative costs.

Although I am satisfied with the way UWV handled the recent calamities, I have asked UWV to consider how to prevent customers from experiencing as little inconvenience as possible from possible future disruptions.

Hoewel ik tevreden ben over de wijze waarop UWV de recente calamiteiten heeft opgevangen, heb ik UWV gevraagd te bezien op welke wijze kan worden voorkomen dat klanten zo min mogelijk hinder ondervinden van mogelijke toekomstige verstoringen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de vermoedelijke eerwraak op een 16-jarig meisje

PVV MPs asked whether an apparent honour killing of a 16-year-old in IJsselstein was honour-motivated, how many honour killings occurred in ten years, whether immigration from Islamic countries is linked to them, and whether perpetrators with dual nationality should be deported. The state secretary declined to comment on the motive during the ongoing investigation, provided registration figures, rejected the links to religion and immigration, and explained the sliding-scale deportation rules without addressing individual cases.
The investigation into the death of the 16-year-old schoolgirl from IJsselstein is still in full swing.
Het onderzoek naar de dood van de 16-jarige scholiere uit IJsselstein is nog in volle gang.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Yücel over de onmogelijkheid om te slagen voor het inburgeringsexamen

Yücel (PvdA) asked the ministers about a Kassa broadcast showing a candidate repeatedly failing the civic integration exam over a pronunciation error, and asked about failure rates, feedback to candidates, and a hardship clause. Minister Asscher answered with figures on repeat test-takers, announced feedback letters and preparation tips, noted an existing exemption route for candidates showing demonstrable effort, and said he will examine whether human assessors could re-review repeat candidates' spoken test results.

That is why I will examine whether and how the results of a candidate who has failed the Dutch Spoken Language Test several times can also, even when the speech computer directly assessed the answers, still be assessed by human assessors.

Daarom zal ik onderzoeken of en hoe de resultaten van een kandidaat die meerdere malen voor de Toets Gesproken Nederlands is gezakt in Nederland, óók als de spraakcomputer de antwoorden van een kandidaat direct heeft kunnen beoordelen, alsnog door menselijke beoordelaars beoordeeld kunnen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Karabulut over problemen met het examen Toets Gesproken Nederlands (TGN) als onderdeel van het inburgeringsexamen

An MP asked the minister about problems with the computer-scored spoken Dutch test (TGN) in the civic integration exam, including candidates who are fluent enough but fail repeatedly, and proposed human examiners after three failures. The minister defended the test's accuracy, offered a route via an exemption for candidates with proven effort, and said he will examine whether results can be reassessed by human raters for repeat failures.

I will examine whether and how the results of a candidate who has failed the Spoken Dutch Test several times in the Netherlands can also, even if the speech computer was able to assess the answers directly, be reassessed by human raters.

Daarom zal ik onderzoeken of en hoe de resultaten van een kandidaat die meerdere malen voor de Toets Gesproken Nederlands is gezakt in Nederland, óók als de spraakcomputer de antwoorden van een kandidaat direct heeft kunnen beoordelen, alsnog door menselijke beoordelaars beoordeeld kunnen worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over het bericht dat er problemen zijn met de website van het Uitvoeringsinstituut Werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MP Ulenbelt asked about outages of the UWV website and the mijnUWV portal in 2012 and January 2013, their causes, consequences for clients, and whether independent evaluation of UWV systems would be commissioned. Minister Asscher explained the technical causes, listed 2012 outage statistics, described interim measures and an external review, but declined to commission a new independent evaluation.
I am of the view that more (external) advice does not currently contribute to lower outage sensitivity of UWV's systems.
Ik ben van mening dat meer (extern) advies nu niet bijdraagt aan een lagere storingsgevoeligheid van de systemen van UWV.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Schut-Welkzijn en Potters over de storing op de website van het Uitvoeringsinstituut werknemersverzekeringen (UWV)

MPs Schut-Welkzijn and Potters (VVD) asked the minister about the prolonged outage of the UWV website (mijnUWV), the resulting call centre surge and waiting times, compensation for affected clients, and structural fixes. The minister acknowledged the outage lasted 7 to 17 January, reported call volumes and waiting times, described alternative service channels, and rejected compensation because no sanctions would be imposed on affected clients.
Nevertheless, it remains unpleasant that the outage has lasted so long.
Desondanks blijft het vervelend dat de storing lang heeft voortgeduurd.
Antwoord vragen Ulenbelt over het te laat uitbetalen van Werkloosheidswetuitkeringen (WW-uitkeringen) in december 2012

Ulenbelt (SP) asked whether WW unemployment benefits for December 2012 were paid late and, if so, how many recipients were affected, why, how recurrence will be prevented, and whether affected people will be compensated for tax changes. Minister Asscher replied that about 59,000 payments were made on 3 January 2013 as the earliest possible date after year-end system closure, that this was not a late payment, that UWV has adjusted its test protocol, and that compensation is not applicable.
It is correct that part of the WW benefit payments for December 2012 was paid in early January 2013.
Het is juist dat een deel van de WW-uitkeringen van december 2012 begin januari 2013 is uitbetaald.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘Steeds minder bedrijfsartsen’

MP Voortman asked the ministers of Health and Social Affairs about a report on the declining number of occupational physicians, including why intake is low, whether the specialty should be publicly funded, and whether statutory access to occupational physicians should be restored. Minister Asscher answered that responsibility for worker health lies first with workers and employers, that the cause of low intake is not yet explained, that the Arbowet deregulation keeps access to occupational physicians a matter for social partners, and that the government will consider the points in its response to the SER advice.
The Minister of SZW will further take your question into account in preparing the cabinet position on the cited SER advice and on the question of occupational health services in the longer term.

De Minister van SZW zal uw vraag voorts betrekken bij de voorbereiding van het kabinetsstandpunt naar aanleiding van genoemd SER-advies en bij het vraagstuk van de bedrijfsgezondheidszorg op de langere termijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over de onstuitbare opmars van de Marokkaanse crimineel

PVV MPs asked whether Moroccan youth are an unstoppable rise in crime and whether the government will confront a 'Moroccan problem' head-on. The minister rejects the claim in general terms, notes overrepresentation in specific crimes, says policy applies no ethnic distinction and points to existing prevention and enforcement measures.
The cabinet acknowledges that certain groups cause more nuisance and crime than others.
Het kabinet onderkent dat bepaalde groepen meer overlast en criminaliteit veroorzaken dan andere.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over het openen van een Islamitische gebedsruimte in pretpark Walibi.

Two PVV MPs asked whether Walibi amusement park would open an Islamic prayer room and whether the government would act against Islamisation. The minister replied that it is a quiet room open to all faiths, that the government does not oppose it, and that the park is a private company whose activities are not for the cabinet to comment on.
It is not for the cabinet to comment on activities that take place there, as long as they stay within the bounds of the law.
Het is niet aan het kabinet zich uit te laten over activiteiten die zich daar voltrekken, zolang deze binnen de grenzen van de wet plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen Heerma en Van Hijum over "de inzet van werkloze leermeesters in opleidingsbedrijven in de bouwsector"

Two CDA MPs asked the minister of Social Affairs whether unemployed workers in the construction sector could keep their benefits while serving as temporary instructors in training companies to cover the apprenticeship shortage caused by the crisis. The minister answered that WW benefits cannot be combined with paid instructor work except in a temporary trial placement, that sector plans and a Techniekpact are being explored instead, and gave no commitment to a pilot.
In my view, however, it is not desirable to use WW unemployment benefit money for this.
Het is in mijn ogen echter niet gewenst om hiervoor WW-geld in te zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders over het racistische Marokkaanse geweld

Three PVV MPs asked whether the government shares a claim that Moroccan-origin youths cause a structural problem of violence, asked for the causes of police contact among young Moroccan men, and asked whether dual-nationality offenders could be denaturalised and deported. The minister answered that socio-economic and demographic factors explain over-representation in crime, that enforcement applies no ethnic distinction, and that revoking Dutch nationality for common offences is not possible.
Of course, it is the case that the groups that more often cause problems will accordingly come into contact with this approach more often.
Wel is het uiteraard zo dat de groepen die vaker problemen veroorzaken navenant meer met deze aanpak in aanraking zullen komen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Monasch en Yücel over de renovatie van woningen door corporatie Eigen Haard

Two PvdA MPs asked ministers about a housing corporation renovating a flat building for Muslim residents, including whether religious wishes should be funded from guaranteed public loans and whether allocation should avoid segregation. The minister answered that corporations may consider residents' wishes but that housing must not become suitable for only one religious group, that the extra tap cost is minor and pragmatically accepted, and that allocation stays with the top of the waiting list.
It is good that housing corporations take residents' wishes into account. However, this may not lead to homes being suitable only for residence by a single religious or philosophical group.

Het is goed dat woningcorporaties rekening houden met wensen van bewoners. Dit mag er echter niet toe leiden dat woningen enkel nog geschikt zijn voor bewoning door één religieuze of levensbeschouwelijke groep.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Visser en Azmani over het bericht “Woningen speciaal voor Moslims in Amsterdam”

MPs Visser and Azmani asked whether housing corporation Eigen Haard's renovation of 188 flats in Amsterdam was tailored to Muslim residents' wishes (shoe cabinets, ritual-washing taps, sliding doors, satellite reception) and whether this constitutes misuse of public funds and segregation. Minister Blok answers that the reported details are largely inaccurate, the extra cost was only about 25 euro per tap, the flats are allocated under regular rules, and he finds religion-specific housing undesirable and will raise it with Aedes and, if needed, use legal instruments.
I will discuss this with Aedes.
Ik zal hierover met Aedes in contact treden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden De Roon, Van Vliet en Wilders over het protest van Marokko tegen het korten van Nederlandse uitkeringen voor Marokkanen

PVV MPs asked whether the Dutch ambassador was summoned by Morocco over cuts to Dutch benefits paid to Moroccans, whether the ambassador was told to stay out of Dutch legislation, and whether new benefits to return migrants could be frozen. The minister replied that the ambassador met the Moroccan minister at Dutch request on a previously scheduled matter, that no summoning took place, and that freezing new benefits requires a treaty amendment, pointing to the residence-country principle and planned ending of child benefit export.
No. The Dutch ambassador met with the Moroccan Minister of Employment and Vocational Training on 9 January.
Nee. De Nederlandse ambassadeur heeft op 9 januari jl. gesproken met de Marokkaanse minister van Werkgelegenheid en Beroepsopleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beertema, Van Klaveren, Helder en Wilders van uw Kamer inzake het aftuigen van buurtbewoners door Marokkaanse leerlingen

PVV MPs asked the government whether schools refusing police help after pupil violence should be held to account, why Moroccan girls are increasingly suspects of crime, and whether harsh punishment and denaturalisation should address the Moroccan problem. The state secretary answered that schools must take necessary measures, the mayor decides on police deployment, a joint safety team was set up, there are no figures showing rising crime among Moroccan girls, and sentencing is for judges while denaturalisation for common crimes is not possible.
Educational institutions facing a violence problem must take the measures they consider necessary.
Onderwijsinstellingen die kampen met een geweldsprobleem moeten de maatregelen nemen die zij noodzakelijk achten.
Antwoord vragen Bontes en Van Klaveren over een politiesnoepreisje naar Marokko

MPs Bontes and Van Klaveren asked whether Dutch police trips to Morocco, reported as a costly study trip, were necessary and whether police diversity policy was absurd. Minister Opstelten answered that the trip's necessity is tested by the Landelijke korpschef under a new Gedragscode Buitenlandse Dienstreizen, and that non-operational trips are reported in advance to his ministry.
The starting point of this code of conduct is that foreign business trips undertaken by the police must always be integrity-based, useful and necessary.
Het vertrekpunt van deze gedragscode is dat buitenlandse dienstreizen die door de politie worden ondernomen altijd integer, nuttig en noodzakelijk dienen te zijn.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over de jacht op schoonmaaksters

MP Karabulut asks about a Zembla broadcast alleging that the Kennemerland aliens police stop cleaners based on skin colour, whether this is ethnic profiling, whether the police ignore Supreme Court rulings on the bus project, and what will improve domestic workers' position. The state secretary denies that skin colour alone triggers checks, says the police complied with the Council of State ruling, promises a general vision on aliens supervision, and points to a forthcoming advisory commission on domestic workers.
After the Council of State ruled that there were insufficient grounds for a reasonable suspicion of illegal residence in the case concerned, the police adjusted their approach on this point.

Nadat de Raad van State heeft geoordeeld dat er in de betreffende zaak onvoldoende gronden waren voor een redelijk vermoeden van illegaal verblijf, heeft de politie haar handelwijze op dit punt aangepast.
Antwoord vragen Smits over de problemen die ouders ondervinden bij het aanvragen met terugwerkende kracht van de kinderopvangtoeslag

An MP asks whether parents who missed the new rule limiting retroactive childcare benefit claims to one month, and who were not clearly warned, should get an exception. The minister says information was given widely, refuses an exception and refuses to restore annual claims because retroactive claims enabled large-scale fraud.
There are no figures on the number of people who did not claim the childcare benefit in time.
Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over het aantal mensen dat niet tijdig de kinderopvangtoeslag heeft aangevraagd.
Antwoord vragen Hamer over het bericht ‘twee miljard euro helpt ouderen niet aan het werk’

An MP asked the minister of Social Affairs whether about two billion euros of subsidies for keeping older workers employed are pointless, as a news report claimed, and what would be done about low employer awareness of the schemes. The minister says the budget is now under one billion, defends the remaining schemes as effective for some groups, and promises to raise employer awareness and consider co-financing sector plans.
The SEO Economic Research study indeed shows that 40% of the employers surveyed are not aware of schemes that make it financially attractive to hire older workers.
Het onderzoek van SEO Economisch Onderzoek laat inderdaad zien dat 40% van de ondervraagde werkgevers niet bekend is met regelingen die het financieel aantrekkelijk maken om ouderen aan te nemen.
Antwoord vragen Kerstens over ‘Mogelijke schijnconstructie met Poolse arbeiders’

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs whether a scheme combining low wages with a tax-free expense allowance for Polish workers breaches equal pay and whether the minister will end such constructions and intensify action against malicious temp agencies. The minister says the news report is too thin to judge, the scheme may or may not breach the law depending on the allowance, and announces an intensified approach to sham constructions with an integrated plan to parliament by 1 May 2013.
As I wrote to you in my letter of 14 January, I will intensify the approach to sham constructions.
Zoals ik u in mijn brief van 14 januari jl. heb geschreven ga ik de aanpak van schijnconstructies intensiveren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Smits en Karabulut over het bericht dat de pilot “In de buurt naar school“ in de gemeente Tilburg is stopgezet

MPs Smits and Karabulut asked the ministers about the city of Tilburg ending its 'In de buurt naar school' pilot against school segregation and whether the national government still funds integration in schools. The state secretary replied that Tilburg decided itself, that national pilot subsidies were phased out in 2011, that the government sees segregation as undesirable but prioritises quality and language support, and that municipalities retain local discretion.
The national government has no power to assess the content of the municipality's policy.
De rijksoverheid heeft geen bevoegdheid tot het beoordelen van het inhoudelijk beleid van de gemeente.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Klaveren en Helder over de dodelijke schietpartij bij een kickboksgala

Two PVV MPs asked about a fatal shooting at a kickboxing gala, the suspect's reported school-shooter background, the overrepresentation of Moroccan and Turkish youths in violent crime statistics, and whether a suspect with a serious criminal record should be deported. The minister said the overrepresentation is partly explained by demographic and socioeconomic factors, declined to comment on individual cases, and described the general rules on deportation after conviction and a planned tightening of the sliding scale.
I will not comment on individual cases.
Ik ga niet in op individuele gevallen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over uitbuiting van medewerkers in champignonkwekerijen

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Social Affairs about labour exploitation of workers in mushroom farms, the causes of Polish-style constructions, why the Labour Inspectorate struggles to enforce, and whether retailers and the Fair Produce certification can be held responsible. The minister answered that the sector bears primary responsibility, outlined enforcement through the Interventieteam Champignon and criminal investigations, announced talks with supermarkets and support for Fair Produce, and gave no specific timeline for enforcement results.
For that reason I will shortly enter into discussions with the supermarkets to see how we can jointly put an end to these abuses.
Om die reden zal ik op korte termijn met de supermarkten in gesprek gaan om te kijken op welke manier we gezamenlijk aan deze misstanden een eind kunnen maken.
Antwoord vragen Heerma over het bericht “Eigen risicoperiode Vorst WW verlaagd naar 17 dagen”

Heerma (CDA) asks the minister whether the reduction of the frost waiting period in the construction sector to 17 days is defensible, given that firms bear normal business risk and the economic crisis is hitting harder. Minister Asscher answers that frost is a normal business risk that should not be socialised, that a uniform waiting period will replace sector-specific arrangements under the new calamity scheme, and that he will consult social partners before summer.
I intend, in implementation of the Heerma motion and in good time before the planned entry into force on 1 September 2013, to engage in discussion with social partners.
Ik ben voornemens ter uitvoering van de motie Heerma, tijdig voor de beoogde inwerkingtreding van de regeling per 1 september 2013, in gesprek te gaan met sociale partners.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Voortman over het bericht ‘pensioengeld belegd in kernwapens’

The MP asked whether the government will act on Dutch pension funds investing about 830 million euro in nuclear weapons makers, including the ABP's 50 percent increase, and whether it will require funds to disclose abandoned exclusion policies. The state secretary replied that funds are primarily responsible for their own investment policy, declined to motivate exclusion, and pointed to a pending bill requiring funds to disclose how they account for ESG factors.
Pension funds are primarily themselves responsible for the investment policy.
Pensioenfondsen zijn primair zelf verantwoordelijk voor het beleggingsbeleid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Wolbert over het bericht dat de voedingsindustrie via internet de regels over reclame voor kinderen omzeilt

An MP asked the minister whether food industry advertising circumvents the rules on advertising to children online and what could be done about it. The state secretary replied that under the Dutch advertising code food ads aimed at under-7s are prohibited, that an industry monitoring report found compliance good on TV and cinema but with concerns on websites, and that the industry federation is expected to address its members.
I expect the FNLI to hold its members to account for their responsibility and that the next report shows parties, including on digital media, complying with the agreed RvV rules.

Ik verwacht van de FNLI dat zij haar leden aanspreekt op hun verantwoordelijkheid en dat in de volgende rapportage (over het jaar 2013) blijkt dat partijen, ook op digitale media, de afgesproken regels van de RvV naleven.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over het bericht bankroet van bedrijven vaak onnodig

An MP from the CDA asked the Justice and Social Affairs ministers whether a single dissenting creditor can block a viable company's restructuring plan under Dutch bankruptcy law, and whether a judge should be able to force such a creditor to accept a reasonable plan as in England. Minister Opstelten answered that the government will broaden its bankruptcy law reform programme, including a power to impose binding arrangements on individual creditors, and will report on progress next spring.

To this end I announced in my letter a series of legislative initiatives, including facilitating agreements outside bankruptcy and silent administration, as well as introducing the possibility of an agreement that can be imposed on individual creditors.

Daartoe heb ik in mijn brief een reeks aan wetgevende initiatieven aangekondigd, waaronder de vergemakkelijking van de totstandkoming van akkoorden buiten faillissement en de stille bewindvoering alsmede de invoering van de mogelijkheid van een akkoord dat dwingend opgelegd kan worden aan individuele schuldeisers.
Antwoord vragen Karabulut over het bericht dat moskee-internaten vaak niet veilig zijn en toezicht van de overheid ontbreekt

An SP MP asked the minister about reports that mosque boarding schools for children are often unsafe and unsupervised, including a Rotterdam case of girls living in an unsafe attic and alleged corporal punishment. The minister said integration concerns exist, that municipalities are responsible for building permits, fire safety enforcement and dialogue, that no national register of such boarding houses exists, and that the Education Inspectorate and Youth Care Inspectorate have no supervisory role over them.
The number of children specifically staying in mosque boarding schools is not registered.
Het aantal kinderen dat specifiek in moskee-internaten verblijft wordt niet geregistreerd.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren en Wilders over de vele moskee-internaten in Nederland

MPs Van Klaveren and Wilders asked the minister how many mosque boarding schools exist in the Netherlands, what legal steps will be taken against them over reported corporal punishment and illegal shops, and how they will be closed. The minister said no national overview is known, that local authorities are responsible, that he will consult affected municipalities on whether existing instruments suffice, and that no legal measures are currently warranted.
It is the responsibility of the local government to have insight into the presence of boarding schools within the municipal boundary.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de lokale overheid om inzicht te hebben in de aanwezigheid van internaten binnen de gemeentegrens.
Antwoord vragen Bergkamp over ‘illegale internaten in moskeeën’

An MP asked whether unlicensed boarding schools for children, reportedly in mosques, exist, how they are enforced, and what role municipalities, the GGD and youth care bodies have in oversight. The minister answered that the national government does not know how many exist, that municipalities enforce fire-safety use permits under the Wabo, and that no formal grounds for welfare oversight exist, so he will consult municipalities on whether existing instruments suffice.
I do not know how many boarding schools there are in the Netherlands.
Mij is niet bekend hoeveel internaten er in Nederland zijn.
Antwoord vragen het lid Van Klaveren over de mishandeling van een man bij een voetbalwedstrijd tussen Neptunus-Schiebroek en Kocatepe in Rotterdam

The PVV MP Van Klaveren asked the minister whether he would act on an assault on an elderly man over a ham sandwich at a Rotterdam football match, including whether the club's licence should be withdrawn and whether perpetrators could be denaturalised and deported. The minister said the case is with the Public Prosecution Service, condemned all violence, and stated that the KNVB is autonomous on licensing and the club had already expelled the perpetrator, so no licence withdrawal was warranted.
From the Ministry of Security and Justice I have learned that the case is with the Public Prosecution Service and that no further statements can be made about it at this time.
Van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie heb ik vernomen dat de zaak bij het Openbaar Ministerie ligt en dat er op dit moment geen verdere mededelingen over kunnen worden gedaan.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over het bericht dat pensioenfondsen weigeren premies te verlagen

MP Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the government about reports that pension funds refuse to lower premiums when the accrual cap is cut, and whether lower accrual should translate into lower premiums and what the budgetary and generational effects are. The state secretary answered that funds must set premiums at least covering costs but have discretion over how freed-up room is used, that the government expects no one-sided burden on workers, that DNB supervises balanced interest representation, and that premium developments will be monitored, while declining to legally guarantee premium cuts.
The cabinet intends to closely monitor the premiums applied by pension funds.
Het kabinet is voornemens de door pensioenfondsen gehanteerde premies nauwlettend te monitoren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Leijten en Voortman over de acties in de verpleeghuiszorg van 3 november jl

MPs Kuzu, Leijten and Voortman asked whether care provider Amsta received intensification funds for extra staff yet did not hire them, and questioned executive pay and strike-related measures. The state secretary answered that Amsta received about 4.1 million euros, reported on its use via a progress report, and that the government does not intend to request an overview from each institution; he also stated the right to strike is not in question.
Beyond the oversight of the care office, I monitor the progress of the realisation of the extra funds at macro level.
Naast het toezicht van het zorgkantoor monitor ik op macroniveau de voortgang van de realisatie van de extra middelen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Ulenbelt over "het bericht dat leden van AbvaKabo FNV zijn aangehouden in zorginstelling Pleyade"

An SP MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs about police removing AbvaKabo FNV union members and an MP from a care home in the Pleyade group while they tried to distribute union leaflets, and whether the employer violated union rights. The minister said police asked them to leave because they were in or near residents' private rooms rather than for union activity, that unions must coordinate access with employers, and declined to judge the employer's conduct, noting the right to collective action can be limited by a court.
It is not for me to pass judgment on that.
Het is niet aan mij om daarover een oordeel uit te spreken.
Antwoord vragen Hamer en Van Dekken over het verdwijnen van banen bij Menzis in Groningen

Two MPs (PvdA) asked the minister whether the loss of 165 jobs at Menzis in Groningen, and the concentration of insurer work, is disproportionate for the northern labour market and whether the government will act. The minister acknowledges the impact on affected workers, states that regional labour market policy lies with municipalities and UWV, that location and staffing decisions are a private matter, and that the government sees no evidence the north performs worse, promising only to consult social partners.
The location and staffing policy of individual companies is ultimately a private matter.
Het vestigings- en personeelsbeleid van individuele bedrijven is uiteindelijk een private aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Mei Li Vos over de inkomenspositie van zzp’ers

An MP asked the ministers whether self-employed workers without staff (zzp'ers) are increasingly turning to food banks, which municipalities are affected, whether they are informed about social assistance and local tax relief, and how their income has changed. The minister replied that food-bank client data is not kept by government, pointed to information portals and municipal duties, noted that the rules for local-tax relief for small entrepreneurs are being amended, and cited CBS and EIM data showing a diverse group with a small average income decline in 2011.
Data on the client base of food banks are not kept by the government.
Gegevens over het klantenbestand van voedselbanken worden door de overheid niet bijgehouden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Yücel over de leidster/kind-ratio in de kinderopvang

An MP asked the state secretary about the new childcare staff-to-child ratio tool and reports that it was interpreted differently across the sector, and whether the Gunning commission's recommendations are being followed. The minister defended the tool as bringing clarity, said the 81 exceptions were agreed with sector bodies, committed to evaluating the tool six months after entry into force, and noted the four-eyes principle and continuous screening measures.
To assess the effects of the calculation tool on group compositions in practice, I will evaluate the tool six months after it takes effect.
Om te bezien welke gevolgen de rekentool heeft op de groepssamenstellingen in de praktijk zal ik de rekentool een half jaar na inwerkingtreding evalueren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Karabulut en Jasper van Dijk over “het bericht dat de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen schoonmakers uit het zicht wil houden”.

Two MPs asked ministers whether the University of Groningen's plan to have cleaners work only when no one is present, and sanctions against a cleaner, were acceptable under the Code Verantwoordelijk Marktgedrag. The minister reports that the university, union and cleaning firms reached an agreement that keeps working hours, lifts sanctions and commits the university to sign the Code, but largely declines to take further action against the board.
I am pleased that the RUG, as client, together with the other partners, has reached this agreement.
Ik ben verheugd over het feit dat de RUG als opdrachtgever, samen met de andere partners, tot dit akkoord is gekomen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Krol over het bericht ‘Eenzaamheid onder ouderen neemt toe’

An MP asked the government about reports that loneliness among older people is rising, its health effects, support for local initiatives, the role of internet use, and whether cuts threaten efforts against loneliness. The state secretary answered that combating loneliness is primarily a local matter, that central government will stimulate and facilitate through funding a coalition, tools and a national debate, and that municipalities will be given more room under decentralisation.
Combating loneliness is primarily a local matter.
Bestrijding van eenzaamheid is primair een lokale aangelegenheid.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Heerma over "verdere bezuinigingen kinderopvangtoeslag negatief effect op participatie en emancipatie"

MP Heerma (CDA) asked the minister about a survey showing many parents would stop or reduce work if childcare subsidies were cut further, and whether funds would reverse the 2013 cuts and keep the minimum one-third subsidy for the first child. The minister calls the signal worrying but notes intentions do not equal behaviour, that participation has been stable so far, that no funds are available to reverse the cuts, and that the minimum subsidy is being phased out so high incomes contribute to savings.
I will carefully continue to monitor the developments and send the House a letter every quarter with the most recent figures on childcare use and labour participation.

Ik zal de ontwikkelingen zorgvuldig blijven monitoren en elk kwartaal een brief aan de Kamer sturen met de meest recente cijfers over de ontwikkelingen in het gebruik van kinderopvang en de arbeidsparticipatie.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Van Weyenberg over "het onderzoek van DNB en AFM waaruit blijkt dat de helft van de herstelplannen van pensioenfondsen van onvoldoende of slechte kwaliteit is "

Van Weyenberg (D66) asked the minister about a DNB/AFM study finding that half of pension funds' recovery plans are of insufficient or poor quality, and about the rules and enforcement for such plans. The state secretary replied that the study concerns financial crisis plans rather than recovery plans, described the statutory requirements for recovery plans and annual DNB review, noted a planned tightening of information duties in 2014, and did not give concrete targets or enforcement commitments beyond existing supervision.
Contrary to what the questioner assumes, the study does not concern recovery plans but so-called financial crisis plans.
In tegenstelling tot hetgeen de vragensteller veronderstelt, heeft het onderzoek geen betrekking op herstelplannen, maar op zogenoemde financiële crisisplannen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Keijzer en Heerma over de impact van voorgenomen bezuinigingen in het regeerakkoord voor de langdurige ouderenzorg in Nederland

CDA MPs Keijzer and Heerma asked whether the government accepts Gupta's finding that proposed long-term care cuts could cut purchasing power by up to 63% for heavy care users, and whether older people and middle/higher-income groups would be disproportionately hit. State Secretary Van Rijn answered that outcomes depend on how cuts are implemented, that no income guarantees are given, and that the proposals will be worked out with municipalities and target groups.
The cabinet never gives purchasing-power guarantees, so it cannot do so in this case either.
Het kabinet geeft nooit koopkrachtgaranties, dus kan dit in dit geval ook niet doen.

m: Motie van de leden Maij en Gesthuizen over meer rust en ruimte in de procedure voor asielzoekers met trauma's
Asks the government, where asylum seekers show signs of trauma, to allow more rest and room in the procedure, add medical examination, or handle the application in the extended procedure.
to build in more rest and room in the procedure and possibly carry out additional medical examination
meer rust en ruimte in de procedure in te bouwen en mogelijk aanvullend medisch onderzoek te doen
Motie van het lid Maij over hindernissen die generaalpardonners ondervinden
Asks the government, with VluchtelingenWerk, to examine obstacles facing general-pardon holders seeking Dutch naturalisation and report to the House.
also requests the government to inform the House of the outcomes of this consultation
verzoekt de regering tevens, de Kamer over de uitkomsten van dit overleg te informeren
Motie van het lid Maij over de uitvoering van de toezegging inzake het kinderpardon
Asks the government to inform the House on the implementation and results of its commitment to individually review rejected kinderpardon cases.
requests the government to inform the House, after all objections to rejected kinderpardon applications are settled, on the implementation, elaboration and results of this commitment
verzoekt de regering, de Kamer, na het afdoen van alle bezwaarschriften tegen afgewezen kinderpardonaanvragen, te informeren over de uitvoering, uitwerking en resultaten van deze toezegging
Motie van de leden Azmani en Maij over bekorten van de doorlooptijden van vreemdelingenzaken

Asks the government to consult the Raad voor de rechtspraak and the Raad van State on measures to shorten appeal times in immigration cases without harming asylum seekers' legal protection, and to inform the House.

requests the government to consult the Council for the Judiciary and the Administrative Jurisdiction Division of the Council of State to introduce measures that shorten processing times without undermining the legal protection of foreigners

verzoekt de regering om in overleg te treden met de Raad voor de rechtspraak en de afdeling bestuursrechtspraak van de Raad van State om, zonder het aantasten van de rechtsbescherming van vreemdelingen, te komen tot maatregelen die de doorlooptijden verkorten
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 27 over het inzetten van 2,5 miljoen euro via de maatschappelijke organisaties in Rwanda
Shifts 2.5 million euro from sectoral budget support to Rwanda into civil society organisations in Rwanda, a foreign aid allocation without bearing on executive checks.
This amendment aims to deploy 2.5 million euro via civil society organisations in Rwanda (art 2.5).
Dit amendement beoogt € 2,5 miljoen in te zetten via maatschappelijke organisaties in Rwanda (art 2.5).
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 23 over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Shifts €10 million within the development budget from Mali budget support to the FLOW fund for women and girls in developing countries in 2013.
Coverage is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Motie Maij c.s. over een nationaal comité van UN Women in Nederland
Asks the government to investigate options and costs for facilitating a Dutch national committee of UN Women and inform the House before the 2014 budget.
requests the government, before the 2014 budget debate, to examine the options for facilitating a national committee of UN Women in the Netherlands
verzoekt de regering, voor de behandeling van de begroting voor 2014 te onderzoeken wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de vestiging van een nationaal comité van UN Women in Nederland te faciliteren
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor FLOW met € 10 miljoen in 2013
Amendment moving 10 million euros to the FLOW fund for women in developing countries in 2013, financed by cutting budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by a reduction of article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden door een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Amendement van het lid Maij c.s. over het in 2013 eenmalig verhogen van de beschikbare middelen voor UN-Women met € 2 miljoen
Increases funding for UN Women by 2 million euros in 2013 by reducing budget support for Mali.
Funding is provided by reducing article 4.2 Effective poverty policy of developing countries.
Dekking wordt geboden via een verlaging van artikel 4.2 Effectief armoede beleid van ontwikkelingslanden.
Amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. over het inzetten van € 1,5 miljoen via maatschappelijke organisaties in Rwanda
Proposes moving €1.5 million within the foreign aid budget to civil society organisations in Rwanda and stopping sectoral budget support to Rwanda.
sectoral budget support should now be stopped
zou sectorale begrotingssteun nu moeten worden stopgezet
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat medische zorg op Lesbos ondermaats is

MP Maij (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports that medical care for migrants on Lesbos is inadequate, and whether the government would act on the situation and press EU partners to send asylum experts and share the burden. The government answered that it had received no direct signals of shortages, pointed to existing medical providers and EU emergency funding, said Greece bears primary responsibility, and reported that it was pressing other member states for more relocations and EASO/Frontex capacity.
The cabinet has not received any direct signals regarding shortages of medical care, medicines and treating doctors in the reception facilities.
Het kabinet heeft geen directe signalen ontvangen met betrekking tot de tekorten aan medische zorg, medicijnen en behandelend artsen in de opvangfaciliteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over gezinshereniging voor Surinaamse ouderen

An MP asked the State Secretary whether the 2012 abolition of the family reunification scheme for elderly people left behind in Suriname disproportionately affects Surinamese elderly, whether the scheme should be restored, and how many such applications were made. The State Secretary said there is no nationality distinction, that Article 8 ECHR and discretionary appeals remain available, that no reintroduction is planned, and that 20 applications by Surinamese aged 65+ were filed in 2015-2016.
However, I cannot estimate the size of the group of Surinamese single elderly aged 65 or older who have not submitted an application.
Ik kan echter geen inschatting geven van de omvang van de groep Surinaamse alleenstaande ouderen van 65 jaar of ouder die geen aanvraag hebben ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over naturalisatie van kinderen van RANOV vergunninghouders

An MP asked the State Secretary about naturalisation of children of RANOV permit holders, including identity document requirements and the Swedish model. The government answered that Dutch rules balance identity checks with flexibility, rejected easing for children of pardon-permit holders, and declined to adopt the Swedish approach while noting case-by-case exceptions.

I assess the Dutch regulations as sufficiently balanced between the foreigner's interest in obtaining Dutch nationality and preventing, as far as possible, naturalisation based on incorrect personal details and/or incorrect nationality.

Ik beoordeel de Nederlandse regelgeving als voldoende afgewogen tussen het belang van de vreemdeling op het verkrijgen van de Nederlandse nationaliteit en het zo veel mogelijk voorkomen dat naturalisatie tot Nederlander plaats vindt op onjuiste persoonsgegevens en/of onjuiste nationaliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Maij over het wegduiken van lidstaten bij gevoelige kwesties in Europa

MPs Van der Velde and Maij asked the Foreign and Economic Affairs ministers about member states avoiding contentious EU decisions on GMOs and pesticides, and whether the Commission's proposal to shift comitology responsibility to member states is adequate. Minister Koenders answered that impasses arise over health and safety questions, Dutch positions follow stated policy, the appraisal of the proposal is still being formed, and the next steps are not yet known.
That is why he announced that he wanted to present the proposals now on the table to place political responsibility for decisions on implementing acts more with the member states.

Daarom kondigde hij aan met de nu voorliggende voorstellen te willen komen om de politieke verantwoordelijkheid voor besluitvorming over uitvoeringshandelingen in grotere mate bij de lidstaten neer te leggen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ünver en Maij over het bericht dat in Turkije geen televisieberichtgeving over aanslagen is toegestaan

MPs Ünver and Maij asked the Foreign Minister about a reported Turkish ban on television coverage of terrorist attacks, its legality, Turkey's wider press freedom restrictions, and Dutch action in the Council of Europe and ECtHR. The minister confirmed the ban was government-ordered during the state of emergency, listed journalist detentions and media closures, and described Dutch support for independent Turkish media and Council of Europe engagement.
By issuing this instruction from the government, Turkish media are, in the period immediately following an attack, only permitted to pass on official government communications to the public.

Met het van overheidswege uitvaardigen van deze instructie wordt het Turkse media in de periode direct volgend op een aanslag uitsluitend nog toegestaan om officiële regeringsmededelingen door te geven aan het publiek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yücel en Maij over het bericht dat het COA niks zou doen tegen homo-hatende asielzoekers

Two MPs asked the State Secretary whether COA staff fail to intervene against asylum seekers who threaten LGBT residents, and how such conduct is addressed, protected and prevented. The government denies the picture, describes its sanctions, reporting and staff-coordination measures, and sees no reason for additional measures.
The picture that COA staff would not intervene against residents threatening LGBT residents is, however, not one I recognise.
Het beeld dat medewerkers van het Centraal Orgaan opvang asielzoekers (COA) niet zouden ingrijpen richting bewoners die LHBT-bewoners bedreigen herken ik echter niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat door de extreme kou in vluchtelingenkampen, de situatie onhoudbaar is geworden

An MP from the Labour Party asked the State Secretary whether the government would act urgently on reports that cold weather had made conditions in Greek refugee camps unbearable, and what Dutch and EU support was being provided. The government answered that the Netherlands contributes through the EU emergency aid instrument (part of EUR 198 million in 2016) plus an extra EUR 100,000 to local Greek NGOs, and that the European Commission and UNHCR are working on shelter for vulnerable migrants.
The Netherlands contributes via the European emergency aid instrument to the reception of migrants in Greece.
Nederland draagt via het Europese noodhulpinstrument bij aan de opvang van migranten in Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Ünver over de blokkade van de website en app van de NOS in Turkije

MPs Maij and Ünver asked the Foreign Minister about the Turkish blocking of NOS website and app, its cause, the government's response, and whether Turkey's press freedom is being restricted. The minister replied that the Netherlands objected to Turkish authorities and requested clarification, that the block followed NOS publishing footage of the Russian ambassador's murder and was upheld by a court, and that press freedom is raised regularly in bilateral and EU contexts.
The Netherlands has, following the blocking, objected to the Turkish authorities and requested clarification.
Nederland heeft naar aanleiding van de blokkade bezwaar aangetekend bij de Turkse autoriteiten en om opheldering gevraagd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jan Vos en Maij over Europese subsidie voor nieuwe kolencentrales in Griekenland

Two MPs asked the State Secretary why Greece should receive 1.75 billion euro in EU ETS allowance-based support for two new lignite plants, how this fits EU climate goals, and what can be done. The State Secretary said she opposes extending the derogation group, will push for CO2-free-only subsidy criteria and competitive bidding, but cannot stop the Greek request directly.
I therefore focus on strict criteria for the use of the funds.
Ik richt me daarom op scherpe criteria voor het gebruik van de middelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de arrestatie van twee democratisch gekozen co-burgemeesters van oppositiepartij HDP in Diyarbakir (Turkije)

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the arrest of two elected HDP co-mayors of Diyarbakir, whether it was linked to the post-coup purge, how many people had been detained, and the humanitarian situation in the southeast. The minister confirmed the arrests on terrorism-related charges, said the government is seriously concerned, pushed for an EU statement and Council of Europe involvement, but gave no link-free assessment of the purge and no firm commitment beyond diplomatic pressure.
The Netherlands therefore pressed for a joint EU member state response, which was issued as a statement on 8 November.
Nederland heeft dan ook aangedrongen op een gezamenlijke reactie van de EU lidstaten, zoals is uitgegaan per verklaring van 8 november.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Verhoeven, Grashoff, Voordewind en Thieme over het bericht dat EU-Turkijerapporteur Kati Piri wordt geweerd uit Turkije

MPs asked the Foreign Minister whether Turkey had barred EP Turkey rapporteur Kati Piri from entering the country, what reasons were given, and what the government was doing to secure her access and support her criticism of arrests of HDP parliamentarians. The minister confirmed the report, referred to an earlier letter, said Turkey had cancelled her scheduled meetings rather than denying entry, and stated the Turkish reasons were unknown while promising to keep raising the issue with Turkey.

The matter is primarily a matter between the European Parliament and Turkey, but the Netherlands will continue to bring to the attention of the Turkish authorities the importance of dialogue with the EP and access for its rapporteurs.

De kwestie is primair een zaak tussen het Europees parlement en Turkije, maar Nederland zal het belang van een dialoog met het EP en de toegang van haar Rapporteurs bij de Turkse autoriteiten onder de aandacht blijven brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over het bericht dat de Hongaarse regering vluchtelingen mishandelt en hen maandenlang zonder redenen opsluit

MPs Maij and Kuiken asked the government about reports that Hungary abuses and arbitrarily detains refugees, and what the Netherlands would do about it. The government called the reports worrying, said Hungary must respect European and international obligations, noted that the Commission has opened an infringement procedure whose outcome is expected in September 2017, and referred to its earlier assessment instead of a separate one.

The cabinet's position that the treatment of refugees must be in line with European treaties and agreements, including the European Convention on Human Rights, the European acquis and international refugee law, remains unchanged.

Het kabinetsstandpunt dat de behandeling van vluchtelingen in lijn moet zijn met Europese verdragen en afspraken, waaronder het Europees Verdrag voor de Rechten van de Mens en het Europese acquis, evenals internationaal vluchtelingenrecht, blijft onveranderd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Wolbert over het bericht dat de Poolse regering abortus wettelijk wil verbieden en strafbaar stellen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Poland would criminalise abortion, including for women and doctors, and about risks to women's health and rights under European law. The minister said the concerning bill, a citizens' initiative, was rejected by the Polish lower house, that Dutch policy promotes access to safe abortion as part of sexual and reproductive rights, and that it will keep raising these issues in the EU.
The cabinet finds this report worrying.
Het kabinet vindt dit bericht zorgelijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over de door Turkije verspreide lijst van zogenaamde Gülenorganisaties in Nederland

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked the government about a list of Dutch organisations labelled as Gülen-linked that Turkey's state news agency circulated, and whether the government would act against Turkish interference and protect those named. The Minister of Foreign Affairs condemned such lists, said he had conveyed to Turkish officials that direct interference in domestic affairs is unacceptable, and referred to letters and the government's existing protection arrangements for those under threat.
The cabinet strongly disapproves of lists circulating in any form, regardless of who is on them.
Het kabinet keurt ten zeerste af dat er lijsten circuleren, in welke vorm dan ook en ongeacht wie daarop staan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over kindermisbruik in Griekse vluchtelingenkampen

Two MPs asked the government about reports of rising child and women abuse in Greek refugee camps, the Red Cross's role, and what Netherlands and the EU will do to protect residents and deport perpetrators. The minister said Greece is responsible, the issue was raised with Greek authorities and at EU level, EU funding has been given to improve camps, and the Greek government denies abuse reports were filed, without giving exact figures.
The Greek government is responsible for the reception of migrants, in line with European legislation and international law.
De Griekse overheid is verantwoordelijk voor de opvang van migranten, in lijn met Europese wetgeving en het internationaal recht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat de Duitse regering meent dat Turkije islamitische organisaties en terreurgroepen steunt

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that leaked German government documents say Turkey supports Islamist organisations and terrorist groups, and whether the Netherlands would consult Germany, reassess cooperation, or halt EU accession talks and the migration deal. The minister replied that the government stands by Turkey as a partner against terrorism, sees no need for consultation with Germany, does not consider the leaks a reason to halt accession talks or the EU-Turkey statement, and will keep cooperating with Turkey.
The cabinet underlines, like the German government, that Turkey is and remains a partner in the fight against terrorism.
Het kabinet onderstreept, net als de Duitse regering, dat Turkije een partner is en blijft in de strijd tegen terrorisme.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken, Maij en Marcouch over het bericht “Frontman Pegida Nederland jaagt in Bulgarije op vluchtelingen”

MPs Kuiken, Maij and Marcouch asked whether a Dutch Pegida frontman hunting refugees in Bulgaria is a matter for private citizens, whether his conduct is punishable, whether a private army is criminal, and whether a passport ban could apply. The minister replied that border control is for the competent authorities, he has no knowledge beyond media reports, Dutch criminal law may apply extraterritorially under article 7 Sr, and he sees no current grounds for passport revocation.
I am not aware of the activities of the Dutch man mentioned in the report, other than what emerges from media coverage.
Ik ben niet op de hoogte van de activiteiten van de in het bericht genoemde Nederlandse man, anders dan uit de berichtgeving in de media naar voren komt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Van Bommel over het bericht dat Turkse parlementsleden voortaan vervolgd kunnen worden

MPs Maij and Van Bommel asked whether the Turkish move to lift parliamentary immunity, which mainly affects pro-Kurdish HDP members, is concerning, and whether it breaches the ECHR. The minister said the development is worrying, raised concerns with President Erdogan, and noted that the measure could have a discriminatory effect, while stating that parliamentary immunity is not itself a human right.
The Prime Minister expressed his concern to President Erdogan on 23 May, on the margins of the World Humanitarian Summit, about the lifting of parliamentary immunities.

De premier heeft in zijn gesprek met president Erdoğan op 23 mei jl. en marge van de World Humanitarian Summit zijn verontrusting kenbaar gemaakt over de opheffing van de immuniteiten van de parlementsleden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over de oproep van het Turkse consulaat aan Turken in Nederland om beledigingen te melden

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked ministers about a Turkish consulate call for Turks in the Netherlands to report insults against Turkey, its president and flag, and whether this undermines free speech and intimidates critics. The government response is a cross-reference to a letter answering a related Karabulut question, so the substance is not given in this document.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Verhoeven, Maij en Segers over het gebruik door GeenPeil van de subsidieregeling referendum

MPs Verhoeven, Maij and Segers asked the Minister of the Interior whether the referendum subsidy scheme was being misused by GeenPeil, where natural persons applied for subsidies while a legal entity stood behind them and purchased services from it. The Minister replied that the independent Referendum Commission assesses applications only against the scheme's criteria, that over 40 applicants bought services from GeenPeil and disclosed this, and that he cannot judge the application himself.
It is not for me to comment on the extent to which subsidy applications and related circumstances are acceptable and permissible.
Het is niet aan mij om mij uit te laten over de mate waarin subsidieaanvragen en/of met die aanvragen samenhangende omstandigheden acceptabel en geoorloofd zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Fokke over Eurochild

MPs Maij and Fokke asked the Foreign Minister about child rights organisation Eurochild's recommendations to the Dutch EU Presidency on children's interests, including child poverty, unaccompanied minors and youth involvement. The government answered that it will address radicalisation of youth, involve young people through EU and school programmes, treat poverty mainly as a member state responsibility, and promise a general report on the Presidency afterwards.
After the EU Presidency a general report will follow to inform the House about the activities and outcomes of the Presidency.
Na afloop van het EU voorzitterschap volgt een algemene rapportage om de Kamer te informeren over activiteiten en uitkomsten van het voorzitterschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat de Geen Peil-campagne voor een referendum over het samenwerkingsverdrag met Oekraïne mogelijk onterecht met Europees geld is betaald

An MP asked whether an anti-referendum-campaign group's signature drive on the Ukraine association agreement was possibly paid for with misused EU subsidy, and what would be done. The minister said the matter is for the European Parliament and the EU subsidy provider to judge, that the referendum decision is final, and that safeguarding EU subsidies is primarily the EU provider's task.
Safeguarding the proper use of European subsidies is primarily a task of the European subsidy provider.
Het waarborgen van de zuivere besteding van Europese subsidies is primair een taak van de Europese subsidieverstrekker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht “Thierry Baudet’s Forum voor Democratie lanceert manipulatieve stemwijzer voor referendum Associatieverdrag Oekraïne”

An MP asked the Interior Minister whether a voting aid for the Ukraine association referendum, allegedly linked to Forum voor Democratie and possibly funded by neutral-campaign subsidy, is biased and who runs it. The minister said he has no information on the initiators, that the Referendum Commission subsidised Forum voor Democratie's 'against' campaign but cannot confirm the funding of this tool, and that neutrality is for the public and the Referendum Commission to judge.
I do not have information about the initiators of this website.
Ik beschik niet over informatie over de initiatiefnemers van deze website.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Maij over het mogelijk strafbaar stellen van vrijwilligerswerk ten behoeve van asielzoekers op Griekse eilanden

Two MPs asked whether a leaked EU Council draft on migrant smuggling would criminalise NGOs and volunteers helping asylum seekers on Greek islands, and whether the Netherlands would act against such criminalisation. The State Secretary replied that the draft conclusions contain no new legislation, do not criminalise humanitarian volunteers, and that existing EU law allows member states an exemption clause for humanitarian assistance, with no further action needed.
The accusation that the Council Conclusions on migrant smuggling lead to the criminalisation of NGOs and volunteers is incorrect.
Het verwijt dat de Raadsconclusies inzake mensensmokkel tot criminalisering van NGO’s en vrijwilligers leidt is onjuist.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over de penibele situatie van gestrande migranten bij de Griekse grensplaats Idomeni

Two PvdA MPs asked the government about stranded migrants at Idomeni on the Greek-Macedonian border, including lack of shelter, whether a closed Greek camp could be reopened, and EU hotspot implementation. The government answered that it monitors the fluid situation, the camp has reopened, Dutch humanitarian funding has been provided, and it is working on hotspots and coordination within the EU.
The cabinet is attentive to the situation in Idomeni, which is very fluid, and follows developments closely.
Het kabinet heeft aandacht voor de situatie in Idomeni, die zeer fluïde is, en volgt de ontwikkelingen op de voet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yücel over de eis van de Turkse justitie van levenslange gevangenisstraf voor twee journalisten

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister about the Turkish prosecution's demand for life imprisonment for two journalists, the charges against them, and the wider trend of journalist arrests in Turkey. The minister said Nigeria... no: the minister said the court must decide, called the demand exceptionally harsh, stressed that press freedom must improve in Turkey, and said the Netherlands raises this bilaterally and in the EU, while giving only a rough count of about seventeen jailed journalists.
The Netherlands and the EU attach importance to freedom of expression and press freedom in Turkey.
Nederland en de EU hechten aan vrijheid van meningsuiting en persvrijheid in Turkije.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het verwijderen van een reclamespotje door de Poolse overheid vanwege de aanwezigheid van een homoseksuele acteur

An MP asked the Foreign Minister whether a Polish government decision to pull an environmental commercial featuring a gay actor reflects anti-LGBT bias, and what the government will do about it. The minister says the Netherlands opposes any role for sexual orientation, that the Polish minister attributed the removal to costs rather than sexuality, and that Dutch officials raised the matter directly and follow the situation, though the EU has no specific competence in individual member states.
The Netherlands is of the view that the sexual orientation of actors should play no role in such decisions.
Nederland is van mening dat de seksuele oriëntatie van acteurs bij dergelijke beslissingen geen rol mag spelen
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Maij over arbeidsmigratie binnen Europa

MPs Kerstens and Maij asked the minister whether intra-EU labour migration problems such as underpayment, unfair competition and displacement should be tackled urgently at EU level, how the Posting of Workers Directive revision would be advanced, and what the Netherlands would do on bogus self-employment, the temporary agency convention and the A1 form. The minister answered that the Commission shares the concern, that the Netherlands will push the Labour Mobility Package once published, and that these issues are complex with no easy solutions, promising to inform parliament once clarity exists.
As soon as there is clarity on this, I will inform the House of Representatives together with the State Secretary of Finance.
Zodra er duidelijkheid over is zal ik, samen met de Staatssecretaris van Financiën, de Tweede Kamer informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Maij over de detentie en deportatie van vluchtelingen in Turkije

MPs Kuiken and Maij asked the state secretary about reports by Amnesty International of detention and deportation of Syrian and Iraqi refugees by Turkey, including chaining and mistreatment, and whether the EU-Turkey action plan funds such centres and whether Turkey's geographic limitation breaches the Refugee Convention. The government answered that it is aware of the reports, the EU delegation in Ankara has asked Turkish authorities for an investigation, it will await that investigation before judging legal compliance, EU support in the past funded some detention centres, and it does not share the view that Turkey's geographic limitation justifies the returns.

The EU delegation in Ankara is in close contact with the Turkish authorities and Amnesty International to clarify the abuses described in the report, and has asked the Turkish authorities to launch an investigation.

De EU-delegatie in Ankara staat in nauw contact met de Turkse autoriteiten en Amnesty International om opheldering te krijgen over de in het rapport beschreven misstanden en heeft de Turkse autoriteiten verzocht een onderzoek in te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat Turkije tientallen Koerdische rebellen heeft gedood

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Turkish forces killed 54 Kurdish rebels, and about escalation, possible Dutch or EU mediation, and human rights. The minister confirmed awareness, shared the concern, and referred the substantive questions to a separate letter to parliament's European Affairs committee.
For these answers I refer further to the letter on the current situation in south-eastern Turkey
Ik verwijs verder voor deze antwoorden naar de brief over de actuele situatie in Zuidoost-Turkije

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Servaes over het bericht dat de Russische president een wet heeft bekrachtigd om uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens (EHRM) niet te hoeven navolgen

Two PvdA MPs asked the Foreign Minister how he views Russia's law letting its Constitutional Court declare ECHR judgments unenforceable, and what diplomatic steps are being taken. The minister called it very worrying, said Russia is bound to implement ECtHR judgments, and said Russia is being raised in the Council of Europe, while stating the Netherlands wants Russia to remain a member.
All member states of the Council of Europe are obliged to implement judgments of the European Court of Human Rights.
Alle lidstaten van de Raad van Europa zijn verplicht tot het ten uitvoer leggen van uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kuiken over de mogelijke oprichting van een ‘mini-Schengen’ zone

Two MPs from the PvdA asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reported plans for a 'mini-Schengen' zone, including its cause, progress, design and the EU decision-making process. The State Secretary answered that the high asylum influx is straining Schengen, that informal talks with similarly pressured countries are ongoing on border control and returns, and that the matter will be discussed at the 4 December JHA Council and reported on through the usual agendas.
As usual, I will inform you of European developments via the annotated agendas and reports of the JHA Council.
Zoals gebruikelijk zal ik u informeren over de Europese ontwikkelingen via de geannoteerde agenda's en verslagen van de JBZ-raad.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yucel over de sociale kloof in de EU

Two MPs asked the ministers about a Bertelsmann Stiftung report showing a widening social gap in the EU, its figures on unemployment and poverty, and the effectiveness of the EU Youth Guarantee for young people. The government answered that the figures match Eurostat and CBS data, that structural reforms and sharing of best practices are the priority, that it is too early to judge the Youth Guarantee's effectiveness, and that the Netherlands performs well on youth unemployment and poverty; it promised a further explanation during the budget debate.
As previously promised, you will receive the further elaboration of the plans before the SZW budget debate.
Zoals eerder toegezegd ontvangt u voor de begrotingsbehandeling van SZW de nadere uitwerking van de plannen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de inval van de Turkse politie bij een mediaconcern in Turkije

An MP from the Labour party asked the Foreign Minister about a Turkish police raid on a media group in Istanbul, including its press-freedom implications, its effect on democracy before elections, and the EU's options to press Turkey. The minister answered by referring to a separate letter to parliament on recent developments in Turkey and the raid, without answering the questions on substance here.

The written questions from MP Maij (PvdA), question number 2015Z20077, have been answered by means of the letter 'Current developments in Turkey and raid by Turkish police on a media group' (Parliamentary paper 32 623, no. 156).

De schriftelijke vragen van het lid Maij (PvdA) vraagnummer 2015Z20077 , zijn beantword middels de brief «Huidige ontwikkelingen in Turkije en inval van Turkse politie bij een mediaconcern» (Kamerstuk 32 623, nr. 156 )
