Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het onderzoek van de Europese Ombudsman naar de transparantie van trilogen tussen Europees Parlement, Europese Raad en Europese Commissie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the European Ombudsman's inquiry into transparency of EU trilogues and the Council's position that the Ombudsman lacks competence. The minister replied that Netherlands agreed with the Council's response, stating the Ombudsman's powers are set by Article 228 TFEU, while saying transparency of trilogues can be improved and that the Netherlands is pushing for it.
For the Netherlands too, Article 228 of the TFEU and the Statute of the European Ombudsman are decisive for the Ombudsman's powers.
Ook voor Nederland geldt dat artikel 228 van het EU-Werkingsverdrag en het statuut van de Europese Ombudsman leidend zijn voor de bevoegdheden van de ombudsman.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kuiken en Maij over de erbarmelijke omstandigheden voor vluchtelingen in Hongarije

MPs Kuiken and Maij asked the State Secretary and Foreign Minister about degrading conditions for refugees in Hungary, including police food-throwing, detention conditions, and whether the Netherlands should stop Dublin transfers there. The government answered that the situation is worrying, that Dublin transfers remain possible under individual case review by the IND and courts, that the Commission is monitoring Hungary, and that it has raised concerns bilaterally.
From the above it appears that individual Dublin procedures contain sufficient safeguards to carefully examine the admissibility of the transfer.
Uit het vorenstaande blijkt dat er in een individuele Dublinprocedure voldoende waarborgen zijn ingebouwd om de toelaatbaarheid van de overdracht zorgvuldig te toetsten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de uitzetting van journaliste Fréderike Geerdink

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the expulsion of journalist Fréderike Geerdink from Turkey and what the government did to prevent it and secure her return. The minister answered that the embassy provided consular assistance and raised concerns with Turkish authorities, that she left voluntarily, and that any challenge to the circumstances is a matter for her and civil law.
Ms Geerdink left the country on a voluntary basis.
Mevrouw Geerdink heeft op basis van vrijwilligheid het land verlaten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Servaes over het bericht dat Rusland uitspraken van het Europees Hof voor de Rechten van de Mens negeert

MPs Maij and Servaes asked the Foreign Minister about reports that Russia's Constitutional Court allowed Russia to ignore European Court of Human Rights rulings conflicting with its constitution, and what this means for Russia's Council of Europe membership and human rights obligations. The minister answered that such non-implementation violates the ECHR, that Russia remains bound to implement rulings, that Russia's relations with the Council of Europe are strained but there are no signs of withdrawal, and that the Netherlands will continue to raise the issue.
The Netherlands shares this concern and will continue to raise this issue.
Nederland deelt deze bezorgdheid en zal aandacht blijven vragen voor deze kwestie.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes, Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma, Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over de gezette stappen een jaar na de moord op de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis

MPs asked whether the government will keep pressing Libyan authorities for a thorough investigation into the murders of activists Salwa Bugaighis and Fariha Al-Barqawi, and what has been done on protecting female human rights defenders. The minister answers that investigations never got off the ground because Libya lacked effective central authority, that the embassy supported women's organisations and raised protection in EU, UN and bilateral settings, and that the government will raise these cases at the UN Security Council in October 2015.
The cabinet maintains that the murderers of Libyan human rights activist Salwa Bugaighis must not go unpunished and has pressed for a thorough investigation within the EU framework.
Het kabinet blijft van mening dat de moordenaars van de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis niet ongestraft mogen blijven en heeft in EU-kader aangedrongen op een gedegen onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Kerstens over de conclusie in een Europese rapport dat er wijdverbreid in de EU ernstige uitbuiting van werknemers plaatsvindt

MPs Maij and Kerstens asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an EU FRA report finding widespread severe labour exploitation, and what the government will do about enforcement, victim protection, the Posted Workers Directive and EU action. The minister accepts the risk sectors, declines to estimate prevalence, and outlines training, prevention, enforcement, victim support and planned EU initiatives, including the Dutch EU Presidency priorities.
The report, however, makes no statements about the extent of labour exploitation.
Het rapport doet echter geen uitspraken over de omvang van arbeidsuitbuiting.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over toenemende gewelddadigheden in Macedonië tussen gewapende groepen en de politie

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about violent clashes between police and armed groups in Kumanovo, Macedonia, and what the government would do about the political crisis, EU accession prospects and de-escalation. The minister answered that the government is deeply concerned about the violence and about democracy and rule of law, supports calls for independent investigation and EU-led mediation, and has raised the issue in the EU Foreign Affairs Council.
The Netherlands endorses Commissioner Hahn's call after the events in Kumanovo that further escalation must be prevented, also with a view to domestic stability.
Nederland onderschrijft de oproep van Commissaris Hahn na de gebeurtenissen in Kumanovo dat verdere escalatie moet worden voorkomen, ook met oog op binnenlandse stabiliteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Recourt over de inzet van Nederland bij de bijeenkomst in Riga tussen de EU en de VS over o.a. terrorismebestrijding, databescherming en migratie

PvdA MPs Maij and Recourt asked why Parliament was not informed in advance about the Dutch and EU position at the June 2015 EU-US Justice and Home Affairs ministerial in Riga, and about a draft agreement on counterterrorism, migration and data protection. The Minister replied that the meeting is a routine twice-yearly ministerial consultation, that the non-binding Riga statement was negotiated under a Council mandate Netherlands could accept, and that Parliament will be informed via the JBZ Council agenda and report.
Your House will be informed about this, as is customary, through the annotated agenda of the JBZ Council and the report of the Council.
Uw Kamer wordt, zoals te doen gebruikelijk, hierover geïnformeerd middels de geannoteerde agenda van de JBZ-Raad en middels het verslag van de Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de suggestie van de Hongaarse premier om in de EU een debat te voeren over het herinvoeren van de doodstraf

The MP Maij asked the Foreign Minister whether the Hungarian Prime Minister's suggestion to reopen the death penalty debate in the EU is serious and how the government will respond. The minister answered that the remark is not a concrete proposal, that the Netherlands opposes the death penalty, and described existing EU procedures and the annual rule-of-law dialogue for handling rule-of-law threats.
The Dutch government is a fervent opponent of the death penalty.
De Nederlandse regering is fervent tegenstander van de doodstraf.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Maij over de uitspraak van het gerechtshof van Den Haag over het Europese Octrooibureau

MPs Kerstens and Maij asked the Justice Minister about the Hague Court of Appeal ruling on labour conditions at the European Patent Office and whether the government would enforce it. The minister answered that the EPO's immunity from execution is absolute under its protocol, so the government has issued a notice barring bailiffs from enforcing the ruling, and that it will raise the matter with the EPO's Administrative Council and the Dutch-hosted EPO without ruling out further steps.
The Minister of Security and Justice can then notify the bailiff that enforcement of the judgment would violate the Kingdom's international legal obligations.
De Minister van Veiligheid en Justitie kan vervolgens de gerechtsdeurwaarder aanzeggen dat tenuitvoerlegging van het vonnis in strijd is met volkenrechtelijke verplichtingen van het Koninkrijk.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Marcouch over Kamervragen ECRI rapport over Griekenland

MPs Maij and Marcouch asked the Foreign Minister about the Council of Europe ECRI report on rising hostility toward migrants in Greece, including violence and whether the EU should act. The minister confirmed the report's findings on rising racist incidents linked to Golden Dawn, described the Greek government's response and that the new government had not yet formulated migration policy, and said the Netherlands supports EU rule-of-law and anti-discrimination initiatives without seeing a broad EU-wide rise in xenophobia.
Non-discrimination forms part of the fundamental EU values as laid down in Article 2 of the Treaty on European Union.
Non-discriminatie maakt onderdeel uit van de fundamentele EU-waarden zoals neergelegd in artikel 2 van het Verdrag betreffende de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Kuiken en Maij over het bericht dat Griekenland 300.000 migranten zou willen laten doorreizen naar de rest van de EU

Two PvdA MPs asked the State Secretary whether Greece would issue travel documents to 300,000 to 500,000 migrants, and how the EU and the Netherlands would respond. The government said no such formal announcement had been made, called any such move unacceptable, reminded Greece of its EU obligations, and described EU support and Dutch contributions.
The cabinet considers the statements by this Greek official about opening the borders unacceptable.
De door deze Griekse bewindspersoon gedane uitspraken over het openstellen van de grenzen acht het kabinet onacceptabel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over politisering van staatsorganen en de beperking van persvrijheid in Macedonië

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about the Macedonian prime minister accusing the opposition leader of espionage and coup plotting, the prosecutor seizing his passport, a ban on publishing recordings, and rising political control over courts and media. The minister agreed the concerns are serious, said the Netherlands raised them with Macedonian authorities and the EU, and said the reform process is largely stalled while Netherlands' support for opening accession talks is being reconsidered.

As stated in the cabinet's appreciation of the 2014 enlargement package, the cabinet, like the European Commission, has serious concerns about increasing politicization and state control in Macedonia.

Antwoord 3 Zoals aangegeven in de kabinetsappreciatie van het uitbreidingspakket 2014 5 maakt het kabinet zich, net als de Europese Commissie, ernstige zorgen over toenemende politisering en overheidscontrole in Macedonië.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over Europese waarden in Hongarije

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Hungary's closer ties with Putin's Russia, Orbán's 'illiberal democracy' remarks, and what the Netherlands and the EU are doing to enforce European values and the rule of law in Hungary. The minister replied that Hungary has not been found to obstruct the EU's unanimous Russia sanctions, that Orbán's concept is largely economic and not a Russian alternative, and described EU rule-of-law instruments and Dutch bilateral and Council efforts, without committing to a new concrete step.
The cabinet is working on the following areas to emphasise European values and rules.
Het kabinet zet zich in op de volgende terreinen om de Europese waarden en regels te benadrukken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bouwmeester over de nieuwe transparantieregels van de Commissie

Two Labour MPs asked the Foreign and Interior Ministers about the European Commission's new rules requiring Commissioners and senior staff to publicly report meetings with lobbyists, and whether the Netherlands would follow suit. The minister supported the Commission's rules, said the Netherlands pushes for Council participation in the transparency register, and said Dutch ministers and officials are bound by integrity rules with consultation reported in explanatory memoranda, promising to further strengthen transparency of the legislative process.

The Cabinet encourages the growing use of internetconsultatie.nl and is examining how the visibility and predictability of the legislative process and the accountability for it can be further strengthened.

Het Kabinet stimuleert de groeiende inzet van internetconsultatie.nl en beziet op welke wijze de kenbaarheid en de voorspelbaarheid van het wetgevingsproces en de verantwoording daarover verder kan worden versterkt.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Yücel over de schending van vrouwenrechten in Hongarije

PvdA MPs Maij and Yücel asked the government about a Hungarian police video that appeared to blame victims of sexual assault, and about the state of women's rights in Hungary and the EU. The minister condemned the video's suggestion that victims are responsible, described Hungary's uneven legal protections, and pointed to EU rule-of-law initiatives and a planned discussion in the Council.
The cabinet is working on this within the EU along two tracks.
Het kabinet zet zich hiervoor binnen de EU in langs twee sporen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ypma en Maij over het onderwijs aan asielkinderen

MPs Ypma and Maij asked the state secretary about schools being overwhelmed by asylum-seeker children and whether education for them is adequate. The state secretary replied that no school signals were received, that the inspectorate found one weak location which improved, and that talks with support bodies on intensifying help are ongoing.

I am in discussion with the national working group on education support for asylum seekers and newcomers (Lowan), which supports schools in making education possible at the new locations, and with the PO-raad to consider how the support can be intensified.

Ik ben in gesprek met de landelijke werkgroep onderwijsondersteuning asielzoekers en nieuwkomers (Lowan) die ondersteuning levert aan scholen om het onderwijs op de nieuwe locaties mogelijk te maken, en met de PO-raad om te bezien op welke manier de ondersteuning kan worden geïntensiveerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over asielzoekers en andere vreemdelingen die zonder recht op basisvoorzieningen en onderdak in Nederland leven

An MP asks when the European Committee of Social Rights' collective complaint decision on Netherlands will be published, what safety-net shelter exists for asylum seekers and other migrants without rights to basic provisions, how the motie-Spekman medical shelter rules work and how many use them, and how many such people there are. The Secretary of State says the ECSR findings will be published after the Committee of Ministers acts, likely November 2014, describes a broad system of shelter and exceptions while refusing to offer unconditional housing to those not complying with return obligations, and states the size of the illegal group cannot be known.
Once the Committee of Ministers has pronounced itself on the ECSR findings, I will inform the House of Representatives.
Zodra het Comité van Ministers zich heeft uitgesproken over de bevindingen van het ECSR, zal ik uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerstens en Maij over de arbeidsomstandigheden bij het Europees Octrooibureau

MPs Kerstens and Maij asked the Minister of Social Affairs about alleged harsh working conditions at the European Patent Office in Rijswijk, including limits on strikes, communication with unions and suspensions. The minister said he could not confirm the characterisation, that the EPO has functional immunity and its own staff rules, and that the Labour Inspectorate cannot inspect the premises without the President's consent, so it held only a talk with management.
The European Patent Office is an international organisation with the corresponding diplomatic immunity.
Het Europees Octrooibureau is een internationale organisatie met de bijbehorende diplomatieke immuniteit.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Voordewind, Van der Staaij, Gesthuizen, Maij en Schouw over de opvang van Syrische vluchtelingen

MPs from five parties asked the State Secretary about the timing of resettling Syrian refugees from Amman and Beirut, whether pending refugees face unexplained delays, and whether a Article 1F exclusion risk affects some cases. The government answered that the arrivals fall under the regular quota, that the standard six-month preparation period applies, that more than 250 Syrians have been accepted, and that UNHCR nominations are assessed case by case for Article 1F risk.
It is the standard procedure in resettlement that refugees arrive in the Netherlands no later than 6 months after acceptance.
Het is de standaard procedure bij hervestiging dat vluchtelingen uiterlijk 6 maanden na acceptatie naar Nederland komen

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Servaes en Maij, Ten Broeke, Van Bommel, Sjoerdsma en Hachchi, Voordewind en Van der Staaij over het bericht dat de Libische mensenrechtenactiviste Salwa Bugaighis is vermoord

MPs from several parties asked whether the Minister had raised the murder of Libyan activist Salwa Bugaighis with Libyan authorities, requested a thorough investigation, and asked what the Netherlands could do to protect threatened women's rights activists in Libya. The Minister answered that the Libyan authorities bear primary responsibility, that the issue will be raised bilaterally and in EU channels, and that the Netherlands supports civil society programmes and is exploring support for a hotline.
This point will be raised both in bilateral contacts and within the EU with the authorities in Tripoli as well as with the Libyan embassy in The Hague.
Dit punt zal zowel in bilaterale contacten als in EU-verband met de autoriteiten in Tripoli alsook met de Libische ambassade in Den Haag worden opgebracht.

Vragen van het lid Maij (PvdA) aan de Staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over het terugsturen van minderjarige kinderen naar Italië op grond van de Dublin-verordening (ingezonden 5 juni 2014).

Ms Maij (PvdA) asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about returning minor children to Italy under the Dublin Regulation, following ECtHR interim measures against Denmark and the pending Tarakhel case. The State Secretary answered that transfers of families with children to Italy remain acceptable, that asylum seekers can seek interim relief in court, and that the government will await the Tarakhel judgment before considering any policy change.
In line with the situation in Denmark, I will not oppose the court granting an interim measure where the family includes a child under five.
In lijn met de situatie in Denemarken zal ik mij niet verzetten tegen een toewijzing van een voorlopige voorziening door de rechtbank, indien het gaat om een familie met een kind jonger dan vijf jaar
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Gesthuizen, Maij, Schouw, Voordewind en Voortman over het bericht dat scholen niet in staat zijn kinderen uit Somalië en Eritrea te onderwijzen

MPs asked whether Dutch schools can adequately teach asylum-seeker children from Somalia and Eritrea, many of whom have had no schooling, and what additional measures will prevent them falling behind. The State Secretary disagreed that schools are inadequate, pointed to extra funding and an inspection report showing improved quality, and said he would discuss with Lowan and the VNG and PO-Raad the municipalities and schools that fail to take their responsibility, with no detailed further measures given.
I will therefore enter into discussion with Lowan, the VNG and the PO-Raad on this matter.
Ik zal daarom samen met Lowan het gesprek met de VNG en de PO-Raad hierover aangaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over het bericht dat Slowakije het homohuwelijk uitsluit

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about Slovakia constitutionally defining marriage as between a man and a woman and whether the Netherlands would respond. The minister called it a disappointment, said the government would raise concerns with Slovakia's foreign minister, and noted that marriage law is a member-state competence.
Are you willing to address the Slovak government about the constitutional amendment and convey your disapproval to them?
Vraag 4 Bent u bereid de Slowaakse regering aan te spreken op de grondwetswijziging en uw afkeuring hierover bij de Slowaakse regering kenbaar te maken?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de hoeveelheid kinderen die in Nederland om migratieredenen in bewaring wordt gesteld

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about EU comparisons of children detained for migration reasons, the number of children detained in 2011-2013, and alternatives to detention. The government answered that the comparative figures are unverifiable and it draws no conclusions, gave detention numbers, and said children are only detained exceptionally and that the new policy and a bill will address this.
These figures are not known to me.
Deze cijfers zijn mij niet bekend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over boetes die vluchtelingen krijgen omdat zij niet aan hun verzekeringsplicht voldoen

An MP asked the State Secretary about fines imposed on refugees for failing to take out health insurance after receiving residence permits, including retroactive premium claims and loss of care allowance. The government acknowledged the problems, says most refugees comply within the deadline and COA pays fines when they do not, but rejects exempting refugees from the insurance obligation and only commits to faster municipal housing and a pilot.
I find it undesirable to adjust the basic principles of the insurance obligation for a small number of cases.
Ik vind het onwenselijk om voor een klein aantal gevallen de uitgangspunten voor de verzekeringsplicht aan te passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de permanente detentie van migranten in Griekenland

MP Maij asked the State Secretary of Security and Justice about reports of indefinite detention of migrants in Greece, including an advisory opinion on detention beyond 18 months and the Return Directive. The government replied that it is not aware of a Greek decision, that the Commission is monitoring compliance and will question Greece, and that the Netherlands will show restraint given the Commission's role.
However, I am not aware of any decision-making by Greece.
Ik ben echter niet bekend met besluitvorming door Griekenland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Servaes over het bericht dat het Litouwse parlement stemt over een anti-homowet

Two MPs asked the foreign minister about a Lithuanian parliamentary amendment penalising public expression of non-traditional family values, asking whether it was discriminatory, whether the minister had raised it with Lithuania, and whether he would raise it in the EU. The minister answered that the amendment was withdrawn from the agenda, that the Netherlands has raised LGBT issues with Lithuania and in EU working groups, and that the government will monitor the situation closely.
This concerns a proposal from the parliament and not from the government.
Het gaat hier om een voorstel van het parlement en niet van de regering.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Mei Li Vos en Maij over het niet benutten van mogelijkheden ter ondersteuning van bedrijven die de EU biedt

MPs Vos and Maij asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether the Netherlands is failing to use the room EU state aid rules offer, whether the Commission advises on designing aid measures, and what will be done about it. The Minister confirmed the Commission can advise confidentially, said the Netherlands uses this in cases such as Nedcar and Pallas, and promised to strengthen contacts with Commission services and internal coordination on state aid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Recourt en Maij over de gevolgen van het beperken van de rechtsbijstand voor de rechtsbescherming in vreemdelingenzaken

MPs Recourt and Maij asked State Secretary Teeven how the reduced legal aid fees for manifestly unfounded (kennelijke) decisions in immigration cases affect legal protection, and whether he will reverse them. Teeven answered that he will revisit the measure across the legal aid system and will restore the pre-October 2013 fee structure, while providing caseload figures for the Council of State and IND.
As I indicated in answer to questions 1 and 5, I intend to revise the measure under which a lower fee is awarded to legal aid providers in cases ending in a manifestly unfounded ruling.

Zoals ik in antwoord op vragen 1 en 5 heb aangegeven ben ik voornemens om de maatregel waarbij een lagere vergoeding aan de rechtsbijstandverlener wordt toegekend in zaken die met een kennelijke uitspraak eindigen te herzien.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bouwmeester over de 5 euro die onverzekerbare vreemdelingen moeten betalen voor medicijnen

MPs Maij and Bouwmeester asked why undocumented migrants must pay EUR 5 for medicines, how it was communicated, and what safeguards exist for those unable to pay. Minister Schippers answered that the charge restores the principle that the patient pays, that pharmacies and GPs were informed, that access is not blocked in urgent cases, and that the CVZ will monitor effects in its annual report rather than in a two-month inventory.
I have asked the CVZ to address the five-euro measure in this monitor where possible, and I will include it in the annual VWS Insured Monitor I send to your House.
Ik heb het CVZ gevraagd in deze monitor zo mogelijk in te gaan op de vijf-euromaatregel en zal dit meenemen in de VWS-Verzekerdenmonitor die ik jaarlijks aan uw Kamer zend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de intrekking van verblijfsvergunningen vanwege het verplaatsen van het hoofdverblijf voor studie

An MP asked the State Secretary why residence permits of sixteen Angolan and Nigerian youths were revoked after they moved their main residence to Portugal for study, and whether they could be offered an alternative. The State Secretary declined to discuss individual cases, restated the general policy that long stays abroad can lead to revocation, with an exception for circumstances beyond one's control, and did not address the other questions.
As you know, I do not go into individual cases when answering questions from your House.
Zoals u bekend is, ga ik in de beantwoording van vragen van uw Kamer niet in op individuele zaken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de veiligheidssituatie in Somalië en de terugkeer van Somalische asielzoekers naar Somalië

Labour MP Maij asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the security situation in Somalia after a deported Somali was injured in a bombing, the latest situation and whether the country report is current, the number of returns, the number of rejected Somali asylum seekers awaiting removal, NGO positions, and policies of neighbouring countries. The State Secretary answered that the government considers the situation concerning but does not classify Mogadishu or other areas under Article 15c; forced returns were briefly resumed but are now paused pending supplementary agreements with the Somali government, and he noted the differing positions of Amnesty, Vluchtelingenwerk and UNHCR.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Pieter Heerma over boetes die zijn opgelegd in verband met een stage van een vreemdeling bij een supermarkt

MPs Maij and Heerma asked why the Inspectie SZW imposed maximum fines in a case of an asylum-status foreigner's internship at a supermarket, despite no exploitation, and how mitigation and proportionality work. Minister Asscher explained the mitigation policy (about 20% of fines mitigated 2010-2012), that first offences can still be fined, and that the proportionality principle allows exceptions, while committing to report further on mitigation in the 2013 annual report.

As promised in my letter of 4 December regarding the budget debate, I will inform your House further on the current mitigation possibilities and their application in practice in the 2013 Annual Report.

Zoals toegezegd in mijn brief van 4 december jl. naar aanleiding van de begrotingsbehandeling, zal ik uw Kamer bij het Jaarverslag 2013 nader informeren over de huidige matigingsmogelijkheden en de uitwerking daarvan in de praktijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de wijze waarop Bulgarije omgaat met asielzoekers

An MP asked the State Secretary about a Bulgarian bill to detain asylum seekers on arrival, reports of Bulgaria sharing data on Syrian asylum seekers with the Syrian embassy, and whether Dublin transfers to Bulgaria are safe. The State Secretary answered that Bulgaria's parliament must judge the bill, that the Commission is responsible for checking EU directive implementation, that the Bulgarian ministry said the data concerned voluntary returnees, and that the situation is being monitored.
It is for the Bulgarian parliament to assess these bills and to approve or amend them through national processes.
Het is aan het Bulgaarse parlement om deze wetsvoorstellen te beoordelen en goed te keuren of te amenderen volgens de nationale processen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de mogelijkheid voor getraumatiseerde asielzoekers om in de verkorte asielprocedure hun asielrelaas volledig naar voren te brengen

An MP asked whether traumatised asylum seekers can fully present their claims in the accelerated asylum procedure, and what safeguards exist, given that later-raised traumatic experiences matter for repeat claims. The State Secretary said the reported signals cannot establish a problem's extent, pointed to MediFirst medical advice, correction rights, the expanded ex nunc review in appeal, and an evaluation due around summer 2014.
Naturally, the House will be informed about this.
Vanzelfsprekend wordt uw Kamer hierover geïnformeerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de “immediate measure” die het Europees Comité voor Sociale Rechten ten aanzien van Nederland heeft getroffen over het bieden van basale bestaansvoorzieningen aan burgers zonder r

The MP Maij asked the State Secretary about the European Committee of Social Rights' immediate measure on basic subsistence for migrants without lawful residence, and whether the Raad van State should be consulted on its legal effect. Teeven answered that the Raad van State's advisory division had been asked for advice, that the Charter's personal scope excludes unlawfully resident migrants, and compared other states' arrangements, while not stating a concrete change to Dutch policy.

Following your question, I have asked the Council of State's advisory division for advice on the scope of the immediate measure, its degree of legal binding, and its consequences for review by national courts.

In navolging van uw vraag heb ik de afdeling advisering van de Raad van State om voorlichting gevraagd over de reikwijdte van de «immediate measure», de mate van juridische binding en de gevolgen voor de toetsing door nationale rechters.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over overdrachten van vreemdelingen op grond van de Dublin-verordening

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about criteria for applying the humanitarian clause of the Dublin Regulation, including for elderly or dependent family members, and about detention of vulnerable migrants who are not cooperating with return. The State Secretary replied that individual cases are not discussed, outlined the Dublin humanitarian clause and relevant CJEU case law, and said detention is a last resort with attention to vulnerable persons.
As your House is aware, I do not consider it desirable to address individual aspects of a case in answering parliamentary questions.
Zoals uw Kamer bekend is, acht ik het niet wenselijk om in de beantwoording van Kamervragen in te gaan op individuele aspecten van een zaak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Van Laar over Wit-Rusland

MPs Maij and Van Laar asked whether EU development funds, via an integrated border management programme, trained and equipped Belarusian police and border forces who detain opposition activists, and whether the Minister would press the Commission to prevent such misuse. The Minister replied that the aid went to patrol boats, vehicles, night-vision equipment and customs/border training, not the police, that the practices against activists are worrying but not attributable to EU support, and that the Dutch embassy shared the report with the EU delegation, which said the aid cannot be linked to how authorities treat opponents.
The money the EU has spent in Belarus under integrated border management went to patrol boats, jeeps and night-vision equipment.
Het geld dat de EU in Wit-Rusland heeft besteed in het kader van geïntegreerd grensbeheer is ten goede gekomen aan patrouilleboten, jeeps en nachtkijkers.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Nijboer en Maij inzake de uitspraken van de president van de Europese Centrale Bank over het ontzien van junior obligatiehouders

Two PvdA MPs asked the Finance Minister whether the ECB president's letter urging that junior bondholders be spared losses in bank rescues conflicts with Dutch aims to push risks onto banks and markets, and whether the bail-in agreement, stress test and state aid exception would be weakened. The minister answered that he supports the Commission's state aid rules, that the BRRD bail-in agreement is unaffected, and that the exception would apply only in very exceptional circumstances.
I attach great importance to sparing taxpayers from the costs of problems at banks.
Ik hecht grote waarde aan het ontzien van de belastingbetaler van de kosten van problemen bij banken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over de naturalisatie van vreemdelingen die een verblijfsvergunning hebben op grond van het generaal pardon

An MP asked the state secretary about naturalisation applications from foreigners who received residence permits under the 2007 general pardon (RANOV), including how many were granted, refused for missing identity documents, and how often documentary evidence was waived. The state secretary reported 6,790 applications, 4,220 granted and 410 refused, said refusal reasons cannot yet be produced automatically, and noted a petition against the document requirement without committing to change it.
It is currently not yet possible to produce automated figures on the reason for refusal.
Het is nu nog niet mogelijk om geautomatiseerd cijfers over de reden van afwijzing te leveren.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij en Pieter Heerma over “boetes die zijn opgelegd in verband met een stage van een vreemdeling bij een supermarkt”

MPs Maij and Heerma asked the minister whether the Inspectorate SZW's fine for a refugee's unpaid internship at a supermarket, imposed after a police raid and a missing work permit, was proportionate and consistent with its enforcement practice. The minister defended the inspection as routine, said the fine policy allows mitigation only in limited cases, and saw no need for further measures.
In view of the answers to the previous questions, I see no need to take any measures.
Gelet op de antwoorden op voorgaande vragen, acht ik geen noodzaak aanwezig om maatregelen te nemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Schouw over de opvang van Syrische asielzoekers door Bulgarije

MPs Maij, Gesthuizen and Schouw asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reception conditions for Syrian asylum seekers in Bulgaria, including access to procedures, shelter, child provisions, EU minimum standards and other affected countries. The State Secretary answered that Bulgaria faces overcrowded centres and UNHCR criticism, that an EU/Frontex/EASO mission was planned, that the Commission monitors EU law compliance, and that Greece and Cyprus would also be visited.
It is not for me, but precisely for the European Commission, to monitor the correct application of EU law.
Het is niet aan mij, maar juist de taak van de Europese Commissie om over correcte toepassing van het EU-recht te waken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Laar en Maij over het besluit van Artsen zonder Grenzen om Somalië te verlaten

Two MPs (Van Laar and Maij, PvdA) asked the ministers how the government views Artsen zonder Grenzen' withdrawal from Somalia over security concerns, its consequences for humanitarian aid, attacks on aid workers and how the Somali authorities respond, and whether the Netherlands will raise the issue internationally. The minister answered that the government regrets the decision, that other organisations continue aid, that the Somali government has pledged to protect aid workers and that the security situation remains fragile without changing asylum policy.
The Netherlands will continue to press for a robust dialogue by the international community with the SFG on this subject.
Nederland zal blijven aandringen op een stevige dialoog van de internationale gemeenschap met de SFG over dit onderwerp.
Antwoord vragen Maij over de uitzetting van een asielgezin met een ernstig ziek kind naar Polen

MP Maij asks the State Secretary about the deportation of an asylum family with a seriously ill child to Poland under the Dublin procedure, requesting a factual account of the child's medical complaints and how they were handled, whether the handling was adequate, and whether a family with an acutely ill child may be deported. The State Secretary refers to earlier answers, cites medical confidentiality and an inspectorate investigation to decline substantive medical detail, states the family had access to care, and says acute treatment would be given in the Netherlands although a transfer may still occur depending on the treatment needed.

Because of the medical confidentiality that applies to medical records and because of the investigation announced by the Health Care Inspectorate (IGZ) and the Inspectorate of Security and Justice (IVenJ), I cannot at this time make statements about the substantive aspects of the medical handling in this case.

Vanwege het medisch beroepgeheim dat geldt voor medische dossiers en vanwege het door de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ) en Inspectie Veiligheid en Justitie (IVenJ) aangekondigde onderzoek, kan ik op dit moment geen uitspraken doen over de inhoudelijke aspecten van het medisch handelen in deze zaak.
Vragen van het lid Maij (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over ongedocumenteerde alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen (ingezonden 5 juli 2013).

An MP asks the State Secretary for Security and Justice whether undocumented unaccompanied minor asylum seekers should receive an identity document, how many there are, how they are protected against exploitation, and how other EU states handle this. The State Secretary declines to issue ID documents to unlawfully resident minors, states no statistics on undocumented minors are kept, and points to protective shelter, guardianship and return efforts.
No figures are kept on undocumented unaccompanied minors.
Er worden geen cijfers bijgehouden over ongedocumenteerde amv’s.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de veiligheidssituatie in Irak

Three MPs asked the state secretary for Security and Justice about the deteriorating security situation in Iraq, especially Baghdad and central Iraq, including civilian casualty figures compared with 2011-2012 and when a departure moratorium would be needed. The state secretary reported a rise in violence in April-June 2013 but argued the situation does not amount to a breach of Article 3 ECHR, and said a departure moratorium is not the appropriate instrument, with a general country report due in autumn.
In my view, however, the available information does not show that the situation in Iraq is so serious that return to that country would amount to a violation of Article 3 ECHR.
Naar mijn opvatting kan echter uit de beschikbare informatie niet worden opgemaakt dat de situatie in Irak zo ernstig is dat terugkeer naar dat land een schending van artikel 3 EVRM oplevert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Maij over De noodsituatie in de Centraal-Afrikaanse Republiek (CAR)

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the humanitarian and security crisis in the Central African Republic after the Seleka coup, including pressure on the UN and African Union, extra Dutch emergency aid, the treatment of local human rights organisations, and a malaria crisis. The minister answered that Nizerlands is pushing through the EU and UN for an active role, that existing contributions via CERF, EU and UN agencies are maintained without an extra contribution for now, and that the Netherlands cannot directly support local human rights groups.
For the time being I am not considering an extra contribution for emergency aid in the CAR.
Vooralsnog overweeg ik geen extra bijdrage voor noodhulp in de CAR.

Vragen van het lid Maij (PvdA) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie over de uitspraak van het Hof van Justitie van de Europese Unie over het terugsturen van alleenstaande minderjarige vreemdelingen naar een

An MP asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about the CJEU ruling on transferring unaccompanied minors under the Dublin Regulation, including its consequences for Dutch policy and timing. The State Secretary said the ruling was still being studied, promised to inform parliament as soon as possible, and instructed IND not to claim unaccompanied minors back to other states except where a lawfully present family member exists and transfer is in the child's interest.
After I have carefully analysed the judgment, also taking into account the analyses of other Member States, I will inform your House about this as soon as possible.
Nadat ik het arrest zorgvuldig heb geanalyseerd, waarbij ik ook de analyses van de andere lidstaten wil betrekken, zal ik uw Kamer hierover zo spoedig mogelijk informeren.
Antwoord vragen Maij, Servaes en Bonis over voorgestelde wetgeving in Litouwen en Macedonië die de toegang tot abortus zal beperken

Three PvdA MPs asked the Dutch government whether it is aware of proposed abortion restrictions in Lithuania and North Macedonia, whether it considers this worrying for women's health and rights, and whether it will raise concerns with those governments. The minister replied that reproductive rights are fundamental human rights and that Dutch concern is noted, that a Lithuanian bill is pending in committee and a Macedonian law is said by its government not to be more restrictive, and that the Netherlands will raise reproductive health policy in human rights reporting forums.

The Netherlands will raise the policy on Sexual and Reproductive Health and Rights, including abortion legislation and its implementation, in the appropriate forums during the review of human rights reports.

Nederland zal bij de behandeling van mensenrechtenrapportages het beleid omrent Seksuele en Reproductieve Gezondheid en Rechten, inclusief abortuswetgeving en de uitvoering daarvan aan de orde stellen in de daarvoor geëigende gremia.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij, Gesthuizen en Voordewind over de verslechtering van de veiligheidssituatie in bepaalde gebieden in Irak

MPs asked the state secretary about the worsening security situation in central Iraq and whether a new country report, a departure moratorium for asylum seekers, and asylum policy changes were warranted. The state secretary said an updated report on Iraq, including security by region and the position of ethnic and religious groups, is expected in autumn, and that a departure moratorium is not necessary at present while developments are monitored.
I have already asked the Minister of Foreign Affairs for an updated country report on the general situation in Iraq.
Ik heb reeds aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken een geactualiseerd ambtsbericht gevraagd over algehele situatie in Irak.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over de behandeling van homoseksuele asielzoekers

An MP from the Labour party asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice about reports that gay asylum seekers are poorly treated and whether the asylum procedure and reception centres can be made safer for LGBT people. The State Secretary replied that a COC-agreed action plan based on an independent Deloitte study is in place, that the IND trains staff and has received no complaints about questioning on sexual orientation, and that about 90 possible discrimination cases in 2012 were handled under the regular protocol.
All recommendations from the report have either been adopted or adjusted in consultation with the COC.
Alle aanbevelingen uit het rapport zijn of overgenomen of in overleg met het COC aangepast.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over slechte opvangomstandigheden van asielzoekers in Polen

An MP asked the State Secretary about reported poor reception conditions and inaccessible asylum procedures for asylum seekers in Poland, including a critical NGO report on guarded centres. The minister answered that Poland has announced reforms, that the government cannot judge the Polish system, that the Commission oversees EU law, and that Dutch Dublin transfers are checked against article 3 ECHR and article 4 of the EU Charter.
Of course I am willing to ask my Polish colleague on the margins of the Council about relevant developments.
Uiteraard ben ik wel bereid om mijn Poolse collega en marge van de Raad te vragen naar relevante ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Bonis over mensenrechtensitutatie in Colombia

MPs Maij and Bonis asked the government about the deteriorating situation of human rights defenders in Colombia, land restitution in Curvaradó, threats and killings, impunity, and implementation of court rulings. The minister answered that the Netherlands raises these concerns in dialogue with Colombian authorities, will press for investigation and prosecution at the Universal Periodic Review and in political dialogue, and will urge implementation of court rulings.
I will press the Colombian authorities for investigation, prosecution and punishment to prevent repetition.
Ik zal bij de Colombiaanse autoriteiten aandringen op onderzoek, berechting en bestraffing om herhaling te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Azmani over de uitvoering van de “koudweerregeling” die regelt dat uitgeprocedeerde vreemdelingen niet uit de opvang worden geplaatst als het vriest

Two MPs asked the State Secretary for Security and Justice how the informal 'cold weather arrangement' (vorstcoulance) for rejected asylum seekers is applied, including criteria, whether COA evicted people during recent cold periods, how it handles forecast frost, and whether it will consult municipalities. The State Secretary answered that it is an informal COA practice, denied evictions during frost periods, said forecast-frost cases are weighed case by case, and saw no reason for consultation now, though the topic could be raised in regular VNG meetings.
COA ensures that during the frost period foreigners are not put out on the street by COA.
Het COA draagt er zorg voor dat vreemdelingen tijdens de vorstperiode niet door het COA op straat gezet worden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over belastingontwijking door microkredietfondsen

An MP asks the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about reports that microfinance funds, with the Netherlands as an intermediary, avoid tax in developing countries, and asks whether the government will prevent this and quantify lost revenue. The minister answers that the MFIs pay local tax, that no data exist on Dutch intermediary use or lost revenue, that she will consult the sector and NPM and agree to tighten tax treaties and self-regulation, and that subsidy conditions do not include tax avoidance but OECD guidelines apply to companies.
In the short term I will consult representatives of the sector and the Platform for Inclusive Finance (NPM) to gain more insight into current practices.
Op korte termijn zal ik in overleg treden met vertegenwoordigers van de sector en het Platform for Inclusive Finance (NPM), om meer inzicht te krijgen in de huidige praktijken.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over bestrijding van verborgen honger in ontwikkelingslanden

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about hidden hunger in developing countries, the post-2015 hunger goal, and Dutch programmes and partnerships (including DSM) against micronutrient deficiency. The minister answered that hunger is a priority in the post-2015 agenda, listed Dutch-supported programmes, and described existing cooperation with private partners.
Hunger, food security and nutrition is one of eleven themes on which a vision and roadmap are being formulated for the High Level Panel advice.
Honger, voedselzekerheid en voeding is een van de elf thema’s waarop een visie en routekaart worden geformuleerd ten behoeve van het High Level Panel advies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Van Ojik, Maij en Jan Vos over de Nederlandse inzet aangaande financiële transparantie in de grondstoffensector

MPs Van Ojik, Maij and Jan Vos asked the minister whether Dutch policy supports EU rules on financial transparency in the extractive sector, including whether a carve-out for countries with secrecy laws should be allowed. The minister answered that the Dutch government supports the EU transparency directive, opposes any carve-out, and notes that no such exception exists in US Dodd-Frank rules.
The cabinet considers an exception clause undesirable, partly because regimes could otherwise use a reporting ban or confidentiality obligations to evade European transparency provisions.

Het kabinet acht een uitzonderingsclausule niet wenselijk, mede met het oog op de mogelijkheid voor regimes om met een verbod op rapportage of met geheimhoudingsverplichtingen te ontkomen aan Europese transparantiebepalingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Staaij, Voordewind, De Roon, Ten Broeke, Maij en Van Bommel over de marginalisatie van de Papua's in sociaal en economisch opzicht

Dutch MPs asked the foreign minister whether Papuans are marginalised in the exploitation of natural resources, whether large development programmes bring in immigrants, who benefits, how their land is legally protected, and how the Netherlands can help. The minister acknowledged the reports, said development is aimed at the whole population, admitted the Special Autonomy Law's consultation duty and local regulation are not consistently implemented or completed, and committed to pressing Indonesia for transparency and NGO access.
This consultation obligation is not always complied with in practice.
Deze consultatieplicht wordt in de praktijk niet altijd nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij en Jan Vos en het lid Klaver over mogelijke bijdrage van voedselproducenten aan mensenrechtenschendingen in ontwikkelingslanden

MPs Maij, Jan Vos and Klaver asked whether Dutch food and drink producers contribute to human rights abuses such as land grabbing, exploitation of women and farmers, and labour violations in developing countries, following an Oxfam report. The minister responded that she shares concerns, relies mainly on voluntary OECD guidelines, IFC standards and sector cooperation, will engage the industry federation, and will encourage companies to map gender and labour conditions in their supply chains.
From Dutch companies I ask that they comply with the OECD Guidelines for Multinational Enterprises, which include the responsibility to prevent human rights abuses.
Van Nederlandse bedrijven vraag ik dat zij de OESO richtlijnen voor multinationale ondernemingen naleven, waarin de verantwoordelijkheid tot het voorkomen van mensenrechtenschendingen is opgenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Maij, Bonis, Omtzigt en Sjoerdsma over sluiting van maatschappelijke organisaties door de regering van Sudan

MPs from PvdA, CDA and D66 asked the Dutch government whether it shares EU concerns about Sudan's closure of civil society organisations, whether it will press Khartoum to reverse this, and how it supports the closed groups and threatened rights defenders. The government answered yes to each point, said the EU and member states will raise the closures with Sudanese authorities, and described ongoing contact and programme support for civil society and rights defenders.
The closure of the civil society organisation will be raised with the Sudanese authorities shortly, jointly by the EU and a number of EU member states present in Sudan, including the Netherlands.

De sluiting van de maatschappelijke organisatie zal op korte termijn gezamenlijk door de EU en een aantal in Sudan aanwezige EU-lidstaten, waaronder Nederland, bij de Sudanese autoriteiten worden aangekaart.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over hulp aan Uganda

MP Maij asked whether the Netherlands would freeze aid to the Ugandan government after a corruption scandal over funds for northern Uganda, and how the EU decision was reached. Minister Ploumen answered that no Dutch funds were involved, that the Netherlands already stopped budget support in 2011 and aligns with donor conditions for resuming it, and that European donors coordinated their suspension.

The Netherlands aligns itself with the conditions set by these donors for Uganda, namely repayment of the missing money, legal action against suspects, and strengthening of the government's financial management.

Nederland sluit zich aan bij de door deze donoren aan Uganda gestelde voorwaarden, te weten – terugbetaling van het verdwenen geld; – gerechtelijke stappen tegen verdachten; – versterking van het financiële management van de overheid.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij en Jan Vos over bevorderen van duurzame biobrandstoffen

MPs Maij and Jan Vos asked about imports of biofuel feedstock, land grabbing in developing countries and the case for second and third generation biofuels. Minister Ploumen answered that the EU proposal limits food-crop biofuels and promotes advanced ones, that the government will press for responsible land governance, and that a national impact assessment and a Commission report are forthcoming.
The cabinet will also examine, together with industry and research institutions, how the innovation and production of advanced biofuels can be stimulated.
Het kabinet zal voorts samen met het bedrijfsleven en onderzoeksinstellingen bekijken op welke manieren de innovatie en productie van geavanceerde biobrandstoffen gestimuleerd kunnen worden.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Albert de Vries en Maij over het slopen van schepen op stranden in Azië

Two MPs asked the government about deaths during ship breaking on Asian beaches after a Nieuwsuur broadcast, and whether it would set minimum safety, environmental and labour conditions and engage shipowners and financiers. The minister said the Netherlands supports the Hong Kong Convention and an EU ship recycling regulation, notes voluntary industry initiatives, and sees no need to convene shipowners and financiers.
The Netherlands actively contributes to the adoption of this European regulation so that ship dismantling takes place in a safe and environmentally responsible manner.
Nederland draagt actief bij aan de totstandkoming van deze Europese verordening om het slopen van schepen op een veilige en milieuverantwoorde manier te laten plaatsvinden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over criteria voor het verstrekken van microfinanciering

An MP asked the minister for Foreign Trade and Development about concrete measures and criteria for supporting microfinance institutions, including after excesses at LAPO Microfinance Bank. The minister described instruments such as the Social Performance Assessment tool, MicroScore and the Interest Rate Traffic Light, said no absolute interest rate or profit ceiling is set, and indicated a planned EUR 10 million per year for rural microfinance in 2012–2015.
There is no deliberate steering towards reducing the budget.
Er is geen bewuste sturing op verlaging van het budget.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Voordewind, Thieme, Gesthuizen, Krol, Maij, Mulder en Van Ojik over kinderarbeid bij de productie van schoenen door grote ketens

MPs asked the government whether shoe companies using child labour in their supply chains should be held to account, excluded from state support and trade missions, and whether embassies and public procurement could be used to address it. The minister answered that due diligence duties under the OECD guidelines apply, that no shoe companies receive state support or joined trade missions, and that embassies raise labour standards where possible, while procurement social conditions already apply.
No, there are no shoe companies currently receiving government support or having previously joined trade missions.
Nee, er zijn geen schoenenbedrijven die momenteel overheidssteun ontvangen of in het verleden mee zijn geweest met handelsmissies.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Jasper van Dijk en Maij over landroof in Mozambique

MPs Van Dijk and Maij asked the government about land grabbing linked to tree plantations in Niassa, Mozambique, the GSFF investment, ABP pension fund oversight, and possible monitoring mechanisms. The minister answered that the report captures real problems but is incomplete, that the new GSFF management has taken steps, and that ABP's oversight body discussed the investment, while the ministry will raise the report's recommendations in the next consultation.

The Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations will, as sector employer for the central government, raise the report's recommendations at the next meeting between the Verantwoordingsorgaan and the ABP board where responsible investment is discussed.

Het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties zal – als sectorwerkgever Rijk – de aanbevelingen in het rapport in het eerstvolgende overleg tussen het Verantwoordingsorgaan en het ABP-bestuur waar over verantwoord beleggen wordt gesproken, inbrengen.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Maij en Hilkens over "het uithuwelijken van jonge meisjes en vrouwenrechten"

MPs Maij and Hilkens asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs whether he would press India to curb child marriage and protect girls' and women's rights, and how this fits Dutch policy. The state secretary answered that the Netherlands raised women's empowerment at India's UPR and in the EU-India human rights dialogue, cited the link between schooling and later marriage, and listed Dutch education and sexual health programmes, without committing to a new bilateral demand.
In addition, women's rights and children's rights are on the agenda of the annual EU-India human rights dialogue.
Daarnaast staan de onderwerpen vrouwenrechten en de rechten van het kind op de agenda van de jaarlijkse EU-India mensenrechtendialoog.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Maij over het programma KRO Reporter "Maxima's Microkrediet"

An MP asked the state secretary for Foreign Affairs about microfinance institutions turning to full-profit models that charge poor clients excessive interest, and about Dutch government support to LAPO and Compartamos. The government answers that profit is acceptable but usury is not, that only indirect support to LAPO (about 1.4 million euro in loans, all repaid) was given and none to Compartamos, lists funding to MFIs for 2009-2011, and points to existing sector initiatives while promising no concrete new measures.
That usurious interest rates are imposed on the poor in this way is not acceptable.
Dat hierbij woekerrentes worden opgedrongen aan armen is niet aanvaardbaar.

m: Motie Heijnen c.s. over geen nieuwe trouwambtenaren met gewetensbezwaren aanstellen
Motion asking the government to urge municipalities not to appoint new marriage officials with conscientious objections to same-sex marriage while pending legislation is considered.
call on municipalities in the meantime not to appoint new marriage officials with the said conscientious objections
gemeenten op te roepen intussen in ieder geval geen nieuwe trouwambtenaren met genoemde gewetensbezwaren aan te stellen
Motie van het lid Brinkman over een referendum
Asks the government to hold a national referendum on the ESM treaty alongside the 12 September election.
requests the government to organise, alongside the election on 12 September, a referendum among Dutch citizens for or against the ESM treaty
verzoekt de regering om, naast de verkiezing op 12 september, een referendum onder de Nederlandse burger te organiseren voor of tegen het ESM-verdrag
Motie Brinkman over informatie verstrekken aan burgers
Asks the government to study how lower authorities provide information to citizens and representatives under the Wet openbaarheid bestuur and whether binding rules are needed.
to examine whether binding rules are necessary
te bezien of dwingende regels noodzakelijk zijn
Motie Brinkman over onterecht gedeclareerde reis- en verblijfskosten
Asks the government to enforce residence requirements on mayors and provincial officials and to recover unlawfully claimed travel and accommodation costs from them.
requests the government to enforce these rules and to recover any wrongly claimed travel and accommodation costs from the officials concerned
verzoekt de regering handhaving van deze regels af te dwingen en eventuele onterecht gedeclareerde reis- en verblijfkosten te verhalen op de betreffende bestuurders
Motie Van der Burg c.s. over informatievoorziening ICT-projecten
Motion asking the government to give the House better information on ICT projects, including contract changes, system deliverables, and management and maintenance costs in money and staff.
to shape the information so that the House gains insight into changes to the contract form during the ICT project
zodanig vorm te geven, dat de Tweede Kamer inzicht krijgt in het wijzigen van de contractvorm gedurende het ICT-traject
Motie Brinkman over regels voor pps-constructies
Asks the government to set rules for public authorities entering public-private partnership constructions, which are seen as opaque.
requests the government to set rules for the government when entering public-private partnership constructions
verzoekt de regering regels te stellen voor de overheid bij het aangaan van pps-constructies
Motie Brinkman over beleid binnenlands bestuur

Asks the government to set a fixed policy sequence for municipal and provincial boundary changes: build public support, use referenda or equivalent surveys, and only then implement under democratic control.
requests the government, when organising internal administration, to make policy such that changes follow a fixed framework
verzoekt de regering bij het inrichten van het binnenlands bestuur zodanig beleid te maken dat bij wijzigingen een vast stramien moet worden gevolgd
Amendement van de leden Gerbrands en Brinkman over het brengen van zorgverzekeraars onder bijlage 3 en de zorgsector onder bijlage 1
Moves insurers from the list of bodies under the sectoral salary norm to the general salary maximum and adds several health-sector bodies to the list under the salary norm.
The health insurers that have registered as such under article 25 of the Health Insurance Act or article 33 of the General Exceptional Medical Expenses Act.
De zorgverzekeraars die zich overeenkomstig artikel 25 van de Zorgverzekeringswet of artikel 33 van de Algemene Wet Bijzondere Ziektekosten als zodanig hebben aangemeld.
Amendement van de leden Gerbrands en Brinkman over van toepassing verklaren van het bezoldigingsmaximum bij inhuur op grond van een arbeidsovereenkomst of aanstelling voor meer dan drie maanden
Lowers from twelve to three months the period after which the pay cap applies to interim or contracted top officials not employed under an employment contract or appointment.
the phrase 'for more than twelve months' is replaced by: for more than three months
wordt de zinsnede «voor meer dan twaalf maanden» vervangen door: voor meer dan drie maanden
Amendement van het lid Brinkman over onder andere een vereenvoudigde ontslagprocedure bij het niet voldoen aan artikel 171a
Lets the minister seek a mayor's dismissal by royal decree when the council finds the mayor has insufficiently met the safety plan duty, and requires the council to evaluate the safety plan annually.
the mayor may be dismissed by royal decree on the proposal of Our Minister
kan de burgemeester bij koninklijk besluit op voordracht van Onze Minister worden ontslagen
Motie-Brinkman over intrekking van het wetsvoorstel
Asks the government to withdraw the bill merging four municipalities and give Niedorp the chance to develop its preferred west variant.
requests the government to withdraw the bill on merging the aforementioned municipalities, document no. 32 677
verzoekt de regering het wetsvoorstel tot samenvoeging van voornoemde gemeenten, onder stuk nr. 32 677 in te trekken
Motie Van Raak c.s. over een visie op de waarborgfunctie van Nederland
Asks the government to prepare a policy vision on the Netherlands' guarantee function within the Kingdom under Article 43 of the Statute.
requests the government to prepare a policy paper on the Netherlands' guarantee function within the Kingdom
verzoekt de regering een visiestuk op te stellen over de waarborgfunctie van Nederland binnen het Koninkrijk
Motie Brinkman c.s. over het voorkomen van een herhaling van schuldsanering
Motion asking the government to ensure the College financieel toezicht can carry out its controls so that debt rescue of the new Kingdom countries is never needed again.
requests the government to do everything possible so that the College financieel toezicht can carry out its control work to such an extent
verzoekt de regering alles in het werk te stellen, zodat het College financieel toezicht haar controlewerkzaamheden dermate kan uitvoeren
Motie Çörüz c.s. over een veteranenbeleid voor uitgezonden politieambtenaren
Asks the government to consult the police field on creating a veterans policy for police officers deployed abroad, modelled on Defence's policy.
requests the government to consult the field to gauge the need for developing a veterans policy for deployed police officers
verzoekt de regering in gesprek te gaan met het veld om de behoefte te peilen aan de ontwikkeling van een veteranenbeleid voor uitgezonden politieambtenaren
Motie Brinkman c.s. over uniformiteit van competenties, taken, bevoegdheden en zichtbaarheid van de bestuurlijke toezichthouders
Asks the government to counter fragmentation of municipal enforcement by making competences, tasks, powers and uniform clothing of municipal supervisors uniform.
requests the government to counter this fragmentation of enforcement in the public domain
verzoekt de regering deze versnippering van de handhaving in het publieke domein tegen te gaan
Motie Elissen c.s. over erkenning van de Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers als officiële gesprekspartner
Asks the government to recognise the Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers as an official conversation partner.
requests the government to recognise the Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers as an official conversation partner
verzoekt de regering om de Vakvereniging Brandweer Vrijwilligers te erkennen als officiële gesprekspartner
Motie Brinkman en Elissen over spoeddebatten op maandag of vrijdag
Asks the Presidium to propose that urgent debates not scheduled within a week can be placed on the agenda on a Monday or Friday.
requests the Presidium to propose that urgent debates which cannot be placed on regular meeting days within a week may be placed on Monday or Friday
verzoekt het Presidium te komen tot een voorstel, waarbij spoeddebatten die binnen een week niet op de reguliere vergaderdagen geplaatst kunnen worden
Motie-Brinkman over opsporen van illegalen op de BES-eilanden voordat deze bij Nederland worden gevoegd
Asks the government to ensure all illegal residents on the BES islands are traced and removed before the islands become part of the Netherlands.
requests the government to ensure that, before the BES islands are joined to the Netherlands, all illegal residents on the islands are tracked down and removed
verzoekt de regering te bewerkstelligen dat, voordat de BES-eilanden bij Nederland worden gevoegd, alle illegalen op de BES-eilanden zijn opgespoord en van de eilanden zijn gezet
Motie van het lid De Krom c.s. over aanhouden van het wetsvoorstel
Asks parliament to postpone handling the BES immigration and expulsion bill until related Kingdom laws on personal movement and visas have been submitted and debated.

to hold the handling of the Amendment to the BES Admission and Expulsion Act in abeyance, at least until the Kingdom Act on movement of persons and the Kingdom Visa Act have been submitted and handled by the House

de behandeling van de Wijziging van de Wet toelating en uitzetting BES ( 32 282 ) aan te houden, in ieder geval totdat de rijkswet personenverkeer en de rijksvisumwet bij de Tweede Kamer zijn ingediend en behandeld
Motie-Brinkman over beëindigen van de strenge toelatings- en verblijfseisen op de Nederlandse Antillen en Aruba voor Europese Nederlanders
Asks the government to end strict entry and residence requirements for European Dutch nationals on the Netherlands Antilles and Aruba.
requests the government to give up this existing regime as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering zo snel mogelijk afstand te doen van dit bestaande regime
Motie-Brinkman over maatregelen tegen een verkapt generaal pardon van Curaçao en Sint-Maarten
Asks the government to take all legal and factual measures so the Netherlands does not suffer from a de facto general amnesty by Curaçao and Sint Maarten.
requests the government to take all legal and factual measures so that the Netherlands does not suffer the disadvantages of a disguised general pardon
verzoekt de regering alle juridische en feitelijke maatregelen te treffen waardoor Nederland niet de nadelen ondervindt van een verkapt generaal pardon
Amendement van het lid Brinkman houdende aanpassing van het facultatieve karakter van het huidige artikel 18, onderdelen b en c, van de Paspoortwet
Makes refusal or revocation of a passport mandatory, rather than optional, when the prosecution requests it for persons who face a serious sentence or who would evade prosecution abroad.
that at the request of the public prosecution service, a passport application must from now on be refused
dat op verzoek van het openbaar ministerie een verzoek tot verstrekking van een reisdocument voortaan geweigerd dient te worden
Motie Gerkens/Brinkman over het niet toestaan van afwijkingen van de vaste voertuigbezetting van brandweervoertuigen
Calls on the state secretary not to allow deviations from the fixed crew size of fire trucks where the listed use functions apply, and to write this into the decree.
not to allow deviations from the fixed vehicle crew of fire engines
geen afwijkingen van de vaste voertuigbezetting van brandweervoertuigen toe te staan
Motie Brinkman over stoppen met de staatkundige vernieuwing
Asks the government to stop preparing the Caribbean Netherlands constitutional reform and hold a referendum among the Dutch people instead.
requests the government to stop preparing and introducing legislation on this constitutional reform and to hold a referendum among the Dutch people
verzoekt de regering voorbereiding en invoering van wetgeving over deze staatkundige vernieuwing te stoppen en een referendum onder het Nederlandse volk te houden
Motie Brinkman over geen inhoudelijke besluiten door de gouverneur van de Nederlandse Antillen over een referendumverzoek
Asks the government to state that the Antilles governor must refrain from substantive decisions on a referendum request from an island council.
requests the government to clearly state that the governor of the Netherlands Antilles must refrain from substantive decisions on a referendum request
verzoekt de regering duidelijk uit te spreken dat de gouverneur van de Nederlandse Antillen zich in het vervolg dient te onthouden van inhoudelijke besluiten over een referendumverzoek
Motie Brinkman over niet verder in behandeling nemen van de wetsvoorstellen
Asks the government not to proceed with the bills on the constitutional reform of the BES islands until after the 2010 elections.
requests the government not to further process these bills in the context of the constitutional reforms
verzoekt de regering deze wetsvoorstellen in het kader van de staatkundige hervormingen niet verder in behandeling te nemen
Motie-Brinkman onderzoek naar de bezetting van brandweervoertuigen
Asks the government to study the pros and cons of merging fire-safety regions and report to parliament.
requests the government to conduct a study into the pros and cons of merging safety regions
verzoekt de regering een onderzoek te doen naar de voor- en nadelen van samenvoeging van veiligheidsregio's
Motie-Brinkman onderzoek naar de bezetting van brandweervoertuigen
Asks the government to study the advantages and disadvantages of reducing fire engine crew from six to four and inform the House.
requests the government to start a study into the advantages and disadvantages of reducing this vehicle crew
verzoekt de regering om een onderzoek te starten naar de voordelen en nadelen van het terugdringen van deze voertuigbezetting
Motie-Brinkman over wijziging van het Besluit veiligheidsregio's
Asks the government to amend the Besluit veiligheidsregio's so municipalities and safety regions cannot deviate from standard crew sizes or national response times.
requests the government to change the Besluit veiligheidsregio's so that municipalities and safety regions cannot be allowed to deviate
verzoekt de regering om het Besluit veiligheidsregio's dusdanig te veranderen dat gemeenten en veiligheidsregio's niet in staat worden gesteld om af te wijken
Gewijzigd amendement van de leden Brinkman en Knops ter vervanging van nr. 48 over het vrijmaken van staal gelden voor de KMAR
Shifts unspent Staal funds into the Royal Marechaussee budget by redistributing amounts across defence budget articles.
an amount of 4.149 million euros, the total of outstanding commander fund money within the Staal funds, be made available to the Royal Marechaussee

een bedrag van 4,149 miljoen euro, zijnde het totaal van de openstaande gelden van de commandantenfondsen binnen de Staal gelden, extra ter beschikking komen aan het krijgsmachtonderdeel Koninklijke Marechaussee

MP Brinkman asks the Minister of Security and Justice about the investigation into the murder of Marianne Vaatstra, including the handling of threats, the identification of suspect Ali H., the transfer of F.M., and DNA testing of a fellow inmate. An MP asked the Minister of Interior whether a Tilburg municipal subsidy for an election debate, conditional on exclusivity from the Brabants Dagblad and limited to certain parties, misuses public funds and violates press freedom. The minister replied that municipal subsidy policy is the municipality's responsibility, that no statutory rules are needed, and that the exclusivity condition does not violate press freedom since the newspaper may freely decline it.
Municipal subsidy policy is a competence and responsibility of the municipalities.
