Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman over het bericht dat de afkoopsom van de bestuurder van het Maasstad Ziekenhuis

MP Brinkman asks the minister whether it is objectionable that severance payments for hospital board members have risen sharply while the government cuts spending, and whether board members causing proven mismanagement should be prosecuted and excluded from such payments. The minister points to the pending bill capping executive pay and severance at EUR 75,000, and says boards can be held liable and that severance depends on contract terms and the supervisory board, which must take the initiative.
Whether a severance premium is paid depends on the contractual agreements (between the board member and the Supervisory Board).
Het al dan niet betalen van een vertrekpremie hangt af van de contractuele afspraken erover (tussen de bestuurder en de Raad van Toezicht)
Antwoord vragen Brinkman over het artikel “Meer meldingen mishandeling van ouderen”

MP Brinkman asked the State Secretary for Health, Welfare and Sport about a news report on rising elder abuse reports, asking whether more Inspectorate supervision and institutional protocols were needed and what measures would prevent it. The State Secretary answered that the Inspectorate will supervise via a reporting point and a new enforcement framework due 1 October 2012, that a guideline for care institutions is being accelerated, and pointed to the 'Ouderen in veilige handen' action plan.
One of the action points from the 'Ouderen in veilige handen' action plan is supervision by the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGZ).
Een van de actiepunten uit het Actieplan «Ouderen in veilige handen» is het toezicht van de Inspectie voor de Gezondheidszorg (IGZ).
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman over Nederlandse WAO’ers in Polen

MP Brinkman asked whether Dutch WAO recipients living in Poland were wrongly told they would not owe tax on their benefit and now face Polish tax claims. The state secretary answered that under the Netherlands-Poland tax treaty Dutch tax may be levied, Poland credits it so there is no double taxation, and the Tax Administration is not responsible for foreign tax rules.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, the Netherlands may levy tax on the WAO benefit.
Zoals bij antwoord 1 is aangegeven, mag Nederland belasting heffen over de WAO-uitkering.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman inzake de geplande reorganisatie in verband met de invoering van de nationale politie

Brinkman asks whether forensic assistants in Limburg will be cut in the reorganisation for the national police, whether this affects home burglary investigation, and how staffing changes nationally. Minister Opstelten answers that the inrichtingsplan is still being prepared with the kwartiermaker and consulted with authorities, so no figures can yet be given.
Statements on the size of the various parts of the organisation, per regional unit or nationally, are therefore premature.
Uitspraken over de omvang van de diverse onderdelen van de organisatie, per regionale eenheid danwel landelijk, zijn dan ook prematuur.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman over het onderzoek naar de moord op Marianne Vaatstra

An MP asked the Minister of Justice about the investigation into the 1999 murder of Marianne Vaatstra, including why reported threats and suspect-related leads (F.M., A.H., a Turkish arrest, a transfer of F.M. from an asylum centre) were not pursued and why DNA comparisons were not made. The minister answered that the information was assessed, referred to a public prosecutor's summary report, and that DNA evidence excluded F.M. and the cellmate identified by G.V., without committing to new investigative steps.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brinkman over het artikel “Grote schoonmaak binnen GVB-top”

MP Brinkman asked whether GVB Amsterdam mismanaged public funds, whether prosecution and the national police detective unit should be involved, whether pay supervision in public administration should be tightened, and what measures will prevent such practices. The state secretary answered that an independent audit commissioned by GVB's supervisory board found governance failures but not fraud, that the municipality and supervisory board are responsible for further steps, that no criminal report has been filed, and that the Wopt and forthcoming Wnt do not cover this public limited company.
It is up to the municipality of Amsterdam to take further steps if desired and to account for them to the Amsterdam municipal council.
Het is aan de gemeente Amsterdam om desgewenst verdere stappen te zetten en daarover verantwoording af te leggen aan de gemeenteraad van Amsterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Brinkman over het artikel “Grote schoonmaak binnen GVB-top”

An MP asked whether the GVB report on the company's top management could be kept confidential and whether it should be made public. The state secretary answered that the Amsterdam city council imposed confidentiality under the Municipal Act and that the decision on the report's status rests with the GVB supervisory board and the city of Amsterdam, not with him.
Since the GVB is an independent public limited company, it is not for me but for the supervisory board and the city of Amsterdam to determine the status of this report.
Aangezien het GVB een zelfstandige NV is, is het niet aan mij maar aan de RvC en de gemeente Amsterdam om de status van dit rapport te bepalen.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Brinkman over het feit dat in atoomschuilkelders maandelijks voor duizenden euro’s eten wordt weggegooid

MP Brinkman asked whether food in atomic fallout shelters is discarded monthly at a cost of thousands of euros, and whether it should instead be donated to food banks before expiry. The minister replied that shelters are a municipal matter, that he knows of no such practice, that the VNG is unaware of it, and that any such local policy is accountable to the municipal council.
If this were the case in a certain municipality, I see no role for myself.
Indien dit in een bepaalde gemeente toch het geval zou zijn, zie ik voor mijzelf geen rol weggelegd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brinkman en Çörüz over het artikel “Gemeente Haren verscheurde parkeerboetes van gezagsdragers”

MPs Brinkman and Çörüz asked the Minister of Interior about Haren municipality tearing up parking fines issued to public officials and councillors, asking how many cases there were, whether those responsible should pay, and whether the minister would start an integrity investigation. The minister answered that records only show plate numbers, time and place, so the number of official cases cannot be stated; that enforcement is a municipal responsibility; and that integrity is a local matter, with a municipal audit committee investigation already under way.
The parking ticket booklets record only the license plates of the cars and the time and place of the violation.
In die bonnenboekjes zijn uitsluitend de kentekens van de auto’s en het tijdstip en de plaats van de overtreding genoteerd.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman over het bericht dat een Serviër dreigt aanslagen te plegen op dijken in Nederland

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether reports of a Serbian man threatening to blow up Dutch dikes are credible and whether he has been arrested, and why action took long. The minister confirmed the videos, said an investigation is under way and declined to assess the threat publicly or give details, citing investigative and security reasons.
An investigation has been opened, about which I cannot make any further statements during this inquiry.
Er is een opsporingsonderzoek gestart, waarover ik gedurende dit onderzoek geen verdere mededelingen kan doen.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman en Helder over autodiefstal met stoorzender

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Security and Justice about car theft using signal jammers, including whether such devices should be banned and how police and justice tackle Eastern European theft gangs. The minister replied that jammers are already prohibited under the Telecommunications Act, that enforcement has been intensified with the Agentschap Telecom, and that stolen cars are flagged through Schengen and Interpol channels, though no figures on the scale of the problem are available.
It is known that this method is used. No figures are known about the scale of this problem.
Het is bekend dat deze methodiek wordt gebruikt. Er zijn geen cijfers bekend over de omvang van dit probleem.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman over de uitlating van de burgemeester van Almere over de dierenpolitie

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the Almere mayor refused to introduce an animal police unit, as quoted. The minister said the mayor denies the statement, that the Flevoland force supports the unit but wants it staffed by part-time task-accent holders, and that the minister will reiterate the national policy that animal police officers must be fully dedicated.
I will once again bring this line to the attention of the head of the Flevoland police force.
Ik zal deze lijn nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen van de korpsbeheerder van Flevoland.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Brinkman en Çörüz over het artikel ‘Gemeente Haren verscheurde parkeerboetes van gezagsdragers’

MPs Brinkman and Çörüz asked whether the municipality of Haren wrongly cancelled parking fines for officials and politicians, how many cases there were, and whether integrity investigations, repayment or punishment would follow. The minister answered that the cases were incidental, the practice was improper and has ended, but that the matter is local, so the municipality decides on integrity and sanctions.
This is a local matter. It is for the municipality to decide on this.
Het gaat hier om een lokale aangelegenheid. Het is aan de gemeente hierover te beslissen.
Vragen van het lid Brinkman (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Politietop wist van bevoordelen Pon» (ingezonden 23 november 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the police leadership knew of a tender for police patrol cars that favoured one importer, and posed nine questions on the tender's fairness and savings. The minister referred the MP to the independent Schouten/Telgen committee report, saying that the questions were answered in that report and in its accompanying letter.
I trust that with the sending of the research report, and the actions I announced in the cover letter, the written questions from Mr Brinkman have been answered to his satisfaction.

Ik vertrouw erop dat met het versturen van het onderzoeksrapport, en de door mij aangekondigde acties in de aanbiedingsbrief, de schriftelijke vragen van de heer Brinkman naar tevredenheid zijn beantwoord.
Antwoord vragen Van Klaveren, Helder en Brinkman over de zoveelste gewelddadige straatroof in Utrecht

MPs Van Klaveren, Helder and Brinkman asked ministers about repeated violent street robberies in Utrecht, whether they still trusted Utrecht mayor Wolfsen, what measures would be taken against him, and whether heavy sentences and denaturalisation of dual nationals would largely solve the problem. The government replied that the municipal council judges mayoral performance, referred to earlier answers on youth groups, stated that repressive and preventive measures are both needed, left sentencing to judges, and said a bill is being prepared so that Dutch nationality lapses after a final conviction within five years for offences carrying twelve or more years.
It is primarily for the municipal council to judge the functioning of a mayor.
Het is primair aan de gemeenteraad om te oordelen over het functioneren van een burgemeester.
Antwoord vragen Helder en Brinkman over het artikel “Man steekt twee agenten in gezicht”

MPs Brinkman and Helder asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a case in which a man stabbed two police officers in the face and headbutted a third, and asked whether the offender would stay in custody, receive a prison sentence rather than a community service order, and how prosecutors and judges would be pressed to punish such attacks harshly. The minister confirmed the facts, said the suspect remains in custody with a 90-day extension though the trial date is unknown, pointed to higher prosecution demands and a planned Raad voor de rechtspraak study for 2011 data, and declined to guarantee a prison sentence or abolish community service as a main penalty.
I have promised your House to send the results of this study before summer 2012.
Ik heb uw Kamer toegezegd de resultaten van dit onderzoek voor de zomer van 2012 toe te zenden.
Antwoord vragen Brinkman, Helder en Van Klaveren over slechts een taakstrafje na mishandeling van een agent

PVV MPs Brinkman, Helder and Van Klaveren asked why a community sentence was imposed for assaulting a police officer, whether such sentences undermine public trust, and whether the community sentence should be removed from the Criminal Code and denaturalisation used. Minister Opstelten said the prosecution regrets not demanding a partly unconditional prison term and has appealed, that the cabinet wants to keep the community sentence but restrict it for serious violent crimes, and that a bill on loss of Dutch nationality for serious offences is in preparation.
Following this case, the prosecution leadership spoke with all officials involved to learn lessons from this case.
Naar aanleiding van deze casus heeft de parketleiding gesproken met alle betrokken functionarissen om uit deze casus lering te trekken.
Vragen van het lid Brinkman (PVV) aan de ministers van Veiligheid en Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Vier ton voor Angels» (ingezonden 12 december 2011).

An MP asks the ministers of Security and Justice and of the Interior why Amsterdam settled with the Hells Angels clubhouse by paying 400,000 euros rather than terminating a lease, and whether the government will intervene. The minister explains that the club holds a building right (opstalrecht), not a terminable lease, so expropriation was required, that the municipality offered 400,000 euros on an independent valuation, and that the club accepted, so the statutory procedure was followed.
There is therefore no question of a terminable lease agreement.
Er is dus geen sprake van een opzegbare huurovereenkomst.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman (PVV) en Hennis- Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Burgemeester gezag kwijt» (ingezonden 29 december 2011).

MPs Brinkman and Hennis-Plasschaert asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the Flevoland Commissioner of the King really said mayors would lose all say over local policing once the national police is introduced, and whether the minister would brief him. The minister confirmed the reported concerns exist, rejected them as unfounded, stated the mayor retains authority over public order and police, and said he would explain his position to the Commissioners of the King at an opportunity.
The mayor is and remains responsible for public order and safety in his municipality and retains full authority over the police.
De burgemeester is en blijft verantwoordelijk voor de openbare orde en veiligheid in zijn gemeente en behoudt onverminderd het gezag over de politie.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de nieuwe politie applicatie (ingezonden 25 november 2011).

PVV MPs asked the ministers of Security and Justice whether the police app 'De Politie zoekt' is an unacceptable privacy intrusion, given its broad phone permissions and the principle of privacy-by-design, and whether the Cbp was consulted. The minister denied spying, listed the limited data stored (IP address, page visited, time, browser), and announced further research into necessary data and storage, with measures to follow if warranted.

Vragen van de leden De Mos en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie en aan de staatssecretaris van Infrastructuur en Milieu over het bericht «Sabotage rails kerntransport» (ingezonden 14 oktobe

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Infrastructure ministers about reports of sabotage on nuclear fuel transport rails and why police initially described the transport as unremarkable. The minister replied that police never used that wording, that a suspect was arrested the same day, and that whether the law was broken is for the courts to decide.
It is for the court to judge whether there has been a violation of the law.
Het is aan de rechter om te oordelen of er sprake is van het overtreden van de wet.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over de tekortschietende beveiliging van de Koningin (ingezonden 6 september 2011).

MPs Elissen and Brinkman asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether the protection of Queen Beatrix was adequate, given reports of individuals known to police getting close to her, including a disruption at a public concert. The minister replied that the security concept is based on threat analysis before each appearance, that the event was publicly accessible and not in danger according to the DKDB, and that checks on firearm permits were not part of the concept.
I have no reason to doubt their judgment.
Ik heb geen aanleiding om te twijfelen aan hun oordeel.
Vragen van het lid Brinkman (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het artikel «Remkes feliciteert waterschap op zeeniveau» (ingezonden 11 oktober 2011).

An MP asks the Minister of Interior about a newspaper report on Commissioner Remkes praising a water board, and whether the water boards should be abolished and merged into the provinces as part of the reorganisation of local government. The minister replies that the Bestuursakkoord Water and the coalition agreement keep the water boards as elected functional bodies, and that Remkes's statements as a commissioner or IPO chair are a matter for the provinces.
In our decentralised unitary state, the sub-national governments have autonomous freedom.
In onze gedecentraliseerde eenheidsstaat beschikken de medeoverheden over autonome vrijheid.

Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Van Klaveren (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Archiefstukken homostel Hans en Ton vernietigd» (in

PVV MPs asked whether the destruction of 2009 driehoeksoverleg files about a harassed gay couple was deliberate, whether the Rijksrecherche should investigate, and whether the mayor should be dismissed. The minister explained the files were destroyed due to an expired archive authorisation rather than deliberately, saw no basis for a Rijksrecherche investigation, and said the municipal council must assess the mayor's conduct.
It is in the first place for the Utrecht municipal council to assess the conduct of Mayor Wolfsen.
Het is in de eerste plaats aan de gemeenteraad van Utrecht om de handelwijze van burgemeester Wolfsen te beoordelen.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman (PVV) en Hennis-Plasschaert (VVD) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het intact blijven van het salaris van de korpschefs (ingezonden 31 augustus 2011).

MPs Brinkman and Hennis-Plasschaert asked whether top police officers (korpschefs) keep their salaries and allowances after the police reorganisation, and whether these can be withdrawn. Minister Opstelten answered that a suitable function will be sought, that he intends to limit allowances and bring the police top under new pay policy, but that this requires an agreement with the police unions on transitional rules.
It is my intention to bring the entire police leadership under the new terms-of-employment policy within a foreseeable period.
Het is mijn voornemen om de gehele politietop binnen afzienbare tijd onder de werking van het nieuwe arbeidsvoorwaardenbeleid te brengen.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over juwelier Kamerbeek in Nijmegen (ingezonden 21 juli 2011).

MPs Brinkman and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice about repeated violent robberies of a jeweller in Nijmegen by allochtone offenders, and whether his refusal to admit certain young men was justified, plus when minimum-sentence and denaturalisation bills would be tabled. The minister answered that an investigation is ongoing and victim support was offered, that shop owners may apply a door policy, and that the minimum-sentence bill is with the Raad van State and a denaturalisation bill is being prepared.
In the interest of the criminal investigation, I cannot provide further information on this.
In het belang van het opsporingsonderzoek kan ik daarover geen verdere mededelingen doen.
Vragen van de leden Elissen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over fraude met DigiD (ingezonden 20 september 2011).

Two MPs asked the minister about DigiD fraude, including whether earlier claims of only a few cases were misleading, the number of cases, planned measures, whether DigiD is secure, and how victims will be helped. The state secretary answered that the fraud concerned benefit fraud enabled by the Tax Administration not checking DigiD ownership, that several hundred DigiD accounts were investigated, that a higher security level is under study with a decision promised later in the year, and that victims are supported through a single contact point and the CMI.
Measures are continuously being taken to prevent fraud with DigiD.
Er worden doorlopend maatregelen genomen om fraude met DigiD te voorkomen.
Vragen van het lid Brinkman (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Rouwterreur onbestraft, politie weigert aangifte» (ingezonden 30 juni 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether police wrongly refused to take a complaint about insults and disruption of a funeral procession. The government answered that police advised filing a complaint, that the citizen chose not to file for now, and that police repeatedly offered to take it.
It is up to the person(s) concerned themselves to decide whether to file a complaint.
Het is aan de betrokkene(n) zelf om te beslissen aangifte te doen.

Vragen van de leden Hernandez en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Defensie over het bericht dat onderzoek van de Nederlandse Defensie Academie (NLDA) stelt dat Nederlandse speciale eenheden vaker moeten worden i

PVV MPs asked the Defence Minister whether special forces should be deployed abroad more often and whether the armed forces were too passive in Uruzgan, and whether officers' calls for a more offensive posture and a warrior code should be adopted. The minister answered that special forces have already been deployed, that Uruzgan forces did act offensively where needed with protecting civilians central, and that an offensive code is an internal VIO matter not planned for Defence training.
In the mission in Uruzgan, protecting the Afghan civilian population was central and not eliminating the Taliban.
In de missie in Uruzgan stond de bescherming van de Afghaanse burgerbevolking centraal en niet het uitschakelen van de Taliban.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over de multiculti-gekte bij de Zeeuwse politie (ingezonden 6 juni 20

PVV MPs asked the ministers whether police should enforce the law without regard to foreign cultural views, criticised a training advice that Somali suspects be interviewed only by men, and asked about the cost of the course. The state secretary answered that all officers must enforce the law, that knowledge of cultures can help, referred to the integration vision for the broader question, and stated the course cost about 11,500 euros in 2010.
Every police officer in this country is expected to enforce the law.
Iedere politie ambtenaar in dit land wordt geacht de wet te handhaven.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Verbijstering na politiepromotie» (ingezonden 26 april 2011).

PVV MPs Brinkman and Elissen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports of a police promotion controversy involving officers linked to an OLAF investigation into a Europol selection procedure, asking whether promotions while investigations were ongoing were acceptable and what measures would be taken. The minister confirmed an internal KLPD investigation led to consequences for the officers concerned, declined to disclose OLAF's confidential findings or explain its duration, and said a prior transfer was a horizontal management measure rather than a promotion.
Given its confidential nature, the findings of the investigation carried out by OLAF cannot be made public.
Gezien het vertrouwelijke karakter kunnen de bevindingen van het door OLAF uitgevoerde onderzoek niet openbaar gemaakt worden.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren, Helder en Brinkman (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over een weggepest gezin uit Utrecht (ingezonden 3 mei 2011).

PVV MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reports that a family was driven out of a Utrecht neighbourhood by street harassment, and whether the mayor should be removed. The minister says all possible measures were taken, rejects removing the mayor, and lists existing tools such as area bans, behavioural orders and planned restraining measures while ruling out a lifelong area ban.
Inquiries with the municipality of Utrecht have shown that all possible efforts were made to reduce the nuisance.
Navraag bij de gemeente Utrecht heeft opgeleverd dat alle mogelijke inspanningen zijn verricht om de overlast te doen verminderen.

Vragen van de leden Hernandez en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Defensie en van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat militairen en marechaussees die in Kunduz lokale agenten gaan opleiden veel minder v

MPs Hernandez and Brinkman asked whether military and police personnel training Afghan police in Kunduz face a pay gap of about 100 euro per day, and whether EU police should be made to contribute their hotel and meal allowances to Dutch base costs. The minister confirmed a gap of about 100 euro per day, explained differing EU and NATO arrangements, and rejected equalising pay or claiming the EU allowances.
The difference in allowance is approximately 100 euro per day.
Het verschil in vergoeding is ongeveer € 100 euro per dag.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman (PVV), Hennis Plasschaert (VVD) en Çörüz (CDA) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht «Moord Hillis gefilmd» (ingezonden 27 april 2011).

MPs Brinkman, Hennis Plasschaert and Çörüz asked the Minister of Security and Justice about reports that the murder of a criminal figure was filmed by police, including whether evidence was lost, whether police had prior knowledge, and whether the case compares to the IRT affair. The minister confirmed a police helicopter filmed the attack during an unrelated wiretap operation, declined to discuss the footage or the ongoing investigation, denied friction between the national and Amsterdam police, and rejected any comparison with the IRT affair.
I will not go into the content of the footage or conclusions that may or may not be drawn from it while the investigation is ongoing.
Op de inhoud van de beelden en conclusies die daaraan al dan niet kunnen worden verbonden, ga ik lopende het onderzoek niet in.
Vragen van de leden De Roon en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over de vestiging van een Al Qaeda emiraat in Yemen (ingezonden 8 april 2011).

PVV MPs De Roon and Brinkman asked the ministers of Foreign Affairs and Defence whether Al Qaeda had proclaimed an emirate in Abyan, Yemen, whether it controls the province, and whether it threatens anti-piracy operations in the Gulf of Aden. Minister Rosenthal answered that the emirate claim was unconfirmed, that Al Qaeda elements are present but without territorial control, and that no current threat to anti-piracy efforts or piracy links to Abyan were identified.
This report was, however, not subsequently confirmed, not even by AQAS itself.
Dit bericht is daarna echter niet bevestigd, ook niet door AQAS zelf.

Vragen van de leden De Roon, Bontes en Brinkman (allen PVV) aan de ministers van Buitenlandse Zaken en van Defensie over verkoop van chemische wapens door Libische rebellen aan Hamas en Hezbollah (ingezonden 8 april 2011

The PVV MPs asked whether Libyan rebels sold chemical weapons from Gaddafi's stocks to Hamas or Hezbollah, and whether Dutch forces enforcing the Libya arms embargo could detect and report such exports to Israel. The ministers answered that there are no indications of such sales, and explained that Dutch ships and F-16s in the NATO embargo operation identify, follow and report suspect vessels to the UN sanctions committee.

Vragen van de leden Helder en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Veiligheid en Justitie en de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Slachtoffers in de kou» (ingezonden 11

PVV MPs asked whether victims of crime miss out on Slachtofferhulp aid because the police BVH system malfunctions and the consent question defaults to 'no'. The state secretary denied a system fault, said consent is not defaulted to 'no', and committed to have victim data forwarded automatically to Slachtofferhulp, with police asked to implement this quickly.
To ensure that victims consistently receive victim support offers from now on, it is necessary that victims' data are by default forwarded to Slachtofferhulp Nederland.
Om ervoor te zorgen dat slachtoffers voortaan consequent slachtofferhulp krijgen aangeboden is het nodig dat standaard de gegevens van slachtoffers naar Slachtofferhulp Nederland worden doorgestuurd.
Vragen van lid Brinkman (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat de Friese politie agenten wil verhuren aan gemeenten (ingezonden 24 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether it is undesirable that the Friesland police wants to rent out officers to municipalities for financial reasons and whether this creates a de facto municipal police. The minister said there is no decision to rent out officers, that renting police to municipalities is undesirable, that funding is a national responsibility and no operational officers need to be dismissed for budget reasons, and that no municipal police is being created.
Renting out police officers to municipalities is, in my view, undesirable.
Het verhuren van politieagenten aan gemeenten vind ik onwenselijk.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Elissen (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het artikel «Beroering om beloning Joustra» (ingezonden 11 februari 2011).

MPs Brinkman and Elissen asked the Minister of Security and Justice about a newspaper report on the pay, car with driver and office renovation of the new chair of the Dutch Safety Board. The minister said the chair receives a fee equal to a salary at DG level (scale 19) based on three working days, a company car with driver is functional for this role, and he has no signals of an office renovation.
The chair is not employed by the council or the ministry, so there are no employment conditions.
De voorzitter is niet «in dienst» van de raad of het ministerie, waardoor geen sprake is van arbeidsvoorwaarden.
Vragen van het lid Brinkman (PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het bericht dat misdrijven niet kunnen worden opgelost door computerfalen (ingezonden 21 januari 2011).

An MP asked the Justice Minister about reports that computer failures in the BVH police system left hundreds of crimes unsolved in Zuid-Holland-Zuid, and whether crucial suspect data was lost. The minister confirmed the outages, said no data was lost because a separate system backs up the BVH, and described short-term fixes plus a longer-term upgrade pending an Algemene Rekenkamer report.
No crucial data has been lost, because the BVH is supported by a separate system in which data is stored.
Er zijn geen cruciale gegevens kwijt geraakt, omdat de BVH wordt ondersteund door een apart systeem waarin gegevens worden opgeslagen.

Vragen van de leden Lucassen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht: «Jachten vast op Curaçao door limiet in haven» (ingezonden 15 februari 2011).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of the Interior and Kingdom Relations about reports that yachts were stuck in Curaçao's harbour because of a new limit, and whether the customs had blocked the boats of dozens of Dutch owners. The minister confirmed the reports but said he was unaware of the claim about dozens of boats, that the matter is a dispute between a private party and the Curaçao government, and that he sees no role for himself and will not take it further.
This concerns a dispute between a private individual and the Curaçao government.
Het gaat hier om een dispuut tussen een privépersoon en de Curaçaose overheid.
Vragen van het lid Brinkman (PVV) aan de minister van Defensie over een filmpje, waarin Eupol trainers Afghaanse politiemensen aan het trainen zijn (ingezonden 19 januari 2011).

An MP asked the government whether a viral video showing EUPOL trainers teaching Afghan police to fold paper water bombs was genuine and what its purpose was. The government confirmed the video, explained it was an exercise in giving clear instructions within a Train-the-Trainer course, and said origami was only incidental to the instruction material.
Folding paper water bombs was not the aim of the instruction.
Het vouwen van papieren waterbommetjes was niet het doel van de instructie.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over het niet aanwezig zijn van een bedrijfsbrandweer bij het bedrijf Chemie Pack. (Ingezonden 18 januari 2011)

MPs Elissen and Brinkman asked the Minister of Safety and Justice why chemical company Chemie Pack Moerdijk had no company fire brigade despite the alleged legal obligation, and whether other firms comply and sanctions apply. The minister answered that a company fire brigade is a discretionary power rather than a formal obligation, that the company was never designated, that the safety region started a review in autumn 2010, and that a national list of firms would be sent by 1 May 2011.

Vragen van de leden Elissen en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Veiligheid en Justitie over burgers in nood die onnodig wachten op hulp wanneer zij 112 bellen (i

Two PVV MPs asked why mobile 112 emergency calls are routed through the national control room in Driebergen before reaching the regional control room, unlike fixed-line calls, and whether this wastes time. The minister replied that mobile location cannot be determined precisely enough automatically, that the centralised process serves efficiency, misuse filtering and service quality, and that the meldkamer process will be made more efficient in consultation with the Veiligheidsberaad, promising to report further.
I share your view that every second counts and that citizens in distress must receive professional help as quickly as possible.
Ik deel uw mening dat elke seconde telt en dat de burger in nood zo snel mogelijk professionele hulp dient te krijgen.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over halal-lunch bij de politie (ingezonden 21 december 2010).

PVV MPs Brinkman and Wilders asked the Minister of the Interior whether police lunches served only halal food, calling it unacceptable Islamisation, and whether he would end it. The minister answered that lunch packages without pork were an organisational measure given the number of people who do not eat pork, and refused to end it.
Here it is a matter of providing lunch packages without pork because it is organisationally easier to carry out.
Hier is sprake van het verstrekken van lunchpakketten zonder varkensvlees omdat het organisatorisch beter uitvoerbaar is.

Vragen van de leden Van Klaveren en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bizarre idee banen exclusief beschikbaar te stellen voor niet-westerse allochtonen (ingezon

Two PVV MPs asked the Interior Minister about a reported proposal to reserve senior municipal civil-service posts in Amsterdam for non-Western migrants, asking whether the minister finds it absurd, what action will be taken, and how it fits the coalition agreement ending ethnicity-based preference policy. The minister corrected the article date and referred the MPs to answers given a year earlier by another minister on the same article, without addressing the substance.

I refer you to the answers given by the Minister for Housing, Neighbourhoods and Integration, on behalf of the minister and state secretary of Interior and Kingdom Relations, to the questions the PVV asked a year ago about this same article.

Ik verwijs u naar de beantwoording van de minister voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie, mede namens de minister en staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties, op de vragen die de PVV een jaar geleden over ditzelfde artikel gesteld heeft

Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Wilders (beiden PVV) aan de minister van Veiligheid en Justitie over uitlatingen van de korpschef van de politie Amsterdam-Amstelland over handhaving van het boerkaverbod (ingezonden 5 jan

PVV MPs Brinkman and Wilders asked the Minister of Security and Justice whether a police chief's public statement that he would not enforce a possible face-covering ban, and would be civilly disobedient, was acceptable. The minister replied that the law applies and is enforced throughout the country including Amsterdam, that the government will propose a general ban with sanctions, and that the Amsterdam triangle has publicly confirmed enforcement.
Laws are enforced throughout the entire country.
Wetten worden gehandhaafd in het hele land.

Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Fritsma (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie over een iftarmaaltijd in Slotervaart (ingezonden 9 september 2010).

PVV MPs asked the ministers about the cost, attendance and justification of a police-organised iftar meal in Slotervaart, questioning whether such events fit the police core tasks and whether the Amsterdam regional head discriminates against the native population. The minister answered that the meal cost over EUR 60,000 borne by the force, that about 250 staff attended, that the event serves community contact, and that the claims of discrimination are rejected; no registry of such meals across regions is kept.
We do not keep records of iftar meals organised by police regions.
Wij houden geen registratie bij van Iftar-maaltijden die door politieregio's worden georganiseerd.

Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over de warme banden van een Rotterdamse topambtenaar met een jihadistische organisatie

PVV MPs asked the Justice and Interior ministers about a Rotterdam senior official's close ties to a jihadist organisation, and whether he should be prosecuted or dismissed and whether other officials have similar ties. The minister answered that the municipality found no reason to doubt the official's integrity, referred all questions to that conclusion, and described general integrity screening, while not committing to a new investigation.
We have confidence in the judgement of the Rotterdam municipality and therefore endorse this conclusion.
Wij hebben vertrouwen in het oordeel van de gemeente Rotterdam en sluiten ons daarom aan bij deze conclusie.
Vragen van de leden Helder, Brinkman en Elissen (allen PVV) aan de minister van Justitie over het bericht «Geen cel voor agent die spioneerde voor Marokko» (ingezonden 10 september 2010).

PVV MPs asked the Justice Minister whether a former police detective who passed secret police information to Morocco was really given only a 240-hour community sentence, whether that undermines the credibility of the justice system, whether community sentences should be available for such offences, and whether he also leaked information about an SP MP. The minister confirmed the sentence, declined to judge the independent court, said the sentence reflects the statutory framework and personal circumstances, noted a pending bill restricting community sentences for serious sex and violence offences, and declined to name the persons whose information was passed on, citing privacy.
For privacy reasons I make no statements about the persons about whom the convicted person provided information.
Uit privacyoverwegingen doe ik geen mededelingen over de personen over wie de veroordeelde informatie heeft verstrekt.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Wilders (beiden PVV ) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over een uitspraak over de PVV door een politiechef (ingezonden 2 september 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the Minister of Interior whether a police chief who tweeted that the PVV is fascist should have been dismissed, and why she received only a reprimand. The minister said the force's employer found the remark unfortunate, that dismissal was disproportionate, and that he sees no reason to push for dismissal.
However, the force manager considers a disciplinary measure such as dismissal disproportionate in this case.
Een rechtspositionele maatregel als ontslag acht de korpsbeheerder echter in deze zaak disproportioneel.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Lucassen (PVV) aan de staatssecretaris van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over aanpassing van de casinoregels op Sint Maarten (ingezonden 6 september 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the state secretary whether the sudden change of casino rules on Sint Maarten, which may allow a casino linked to alleged organised crime to open, undermines integrity and warrants a prosecutorial investigation of officials. The state secretary answered that casino policy is an autonomous island competence, that the Public Prosecutor's office cannot be instructed by the Netherlands, and that he will ask the commissioner for an explanation of the motives, but has no information warranting a criminal investigation.
I can therefore assure you that I will ask Mr Marlin to explain the underlying motives for amending the casino rules on Sint Maarten.
Ik kan u dan ook toezeggen dat ik de heer Marlin zal vragen een toelichting te geven op de achterliggende motieven om de casinoregels op Sint Maarten te wijzigen.
Vragen van de leden Brinkman en Helder (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en van Justitie over homo’s in zelfde straat aangevallen (ingezonden 20 juli 2010).

Two PVV MPs asked the Interior and Justice ministers about reported anti-gay attacks in an Amsterdam street, whether police should prosecute without a complaint, and whether a mobile police post should be opened. The ministers replied that prosecution can proceed without a complaint if evidence exists, that the Amsterdam-Amstelland force has a discrimination approach and two complaints led to arrests, and that no mobile post is warranted because the facts do not amount to street terror.
Without a complaint, facts are often hard to prove, but the police can also draw up a report without a complaint if evidence is obtained by other means.
Zonder aangifte zijn feiten vaak moeilijk bewijsbaar, maar de politie kan ook zonder aangifte een proces-verbaal opmaken als er langs andere weg bewijs kan worden verkregen.
Vragen van de leden Helder en Brinkman (PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Beroving winkels neemt toe» (ingezonden 15 juli 2010).

The PVV MPs asked the ministers of Justice and Interior about a report that shop robberies are rising, including claims about a 9% increase, a 1 billion euro cost, police lacking time for complaints, and calls for minimum sentences. The minister disputed the figures, noted a 12% fall in shop theft in the business crime monitor, said police are mapping complaint-intake bottlenecks, and rejected minimum sentences citing lack of evidence of their effectiveness.

Vragen van de leden De Roon en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers van Justitie en van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht «Eenderde aangiften blijft op de plank» (ingezonden 4 juni 2010).

PVV MPs De Roon and Brinkman asked the Justice and Interior ministers whether roughly a third of serious police complaints (aangiften) are left unaddressed due to capacity shortages, and what will be done for victims and to simplify the reporting procedure. The minister said he takes the signal seriously, has asked the Public Prosecution Service and police chiefs for a report before deciding on measures, and pointed to prioritisation rules and crime declines while noting the procedure may be simplified.
I have asked the Public Prosecution Service and the Police Chiefs' Council to report to me to substantiate the numbers cited, so that I can consider whether and what measures are needed.

Ik heb het Openbaar Ministerie en het Korpsbeheerdersberaad gevraagd om mij bericht uit te brengen ter onderbouwing van de genoemde aantallen, zodat ik mij kan beraden over de vraag of en welke maatregelen nodig zijn.
Vragen van het lid Brinkman (PVV) aan de minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties over het bericht dat de politie discrimineert in een personeelsadvertentie (ingezonden 16 juni 2010).

An MP asked the Interior Minister about a police recruitment advertisement reserving a divisional chief post for female candidates with an immigrant background, excluding native men, and whether the vacancy would be reopened to all. The minister said the vacancy text is the responsibility of the regional forces, that excluding people by origin or sex is undesirable, and that the korpsbeheerders will reopen the vacancy in line with applicable law.
The korpsbeheerders of the regional police forces concerned have meanwhile indicated that they will reopen the vacancy in a manner that adequately takes applicable legislation into account.

De Korpsbeheerders van de betreffende regiokorpsen hebben inmiddels laten weten dat zij de vacature op zodanige wijze opnieuw open zullen stellen dat adequaat rekening wordt gehouden met de vigerende wetgeving.
Vragen van de leden Fritsma en Brinkman (beiden PVV) aan de ministers voor Wonen, Wijken en Integratie en van Defensie over de islamisering van de Nederlandse krijgsmacht (ingezonden 15 april 2010).

PVV MPs Fritsma and Brinkman asked the Ministers for Housing and Defence whether the appointment of two Islamic chaplains in the armed forces amounts to Islamisation and whether they would stop it, and whether Muslim soldiers could be exempted from duty during Ramadan. The government answered that the chaplains add expertise, that Islamisation means society organised along Islamic principles which does not apply to the military, that integration requires effort from newcomers, and that only Eid holidays may be swapped under an existing rule, not Ramadan as a whole.
Therefore, since 1981 there has been a scheme for Jewish, Muslim and Hindu feast and commemoration days.
Daarom bestaat er sinds 1981 een regeling voor joodse, moslim en hindoe feest- en gedenkdagen.

Motion asks the government to investigate a national travel-cost allowance for 16- and 17-year-old vocational students and inform the House before the spring memorandum.
requests the government to investigate what is needed to resolve the identified implementation problems
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken wat nodig is om de geconstateerde uitvoeringsproblemen op te lossen

requests the cabinet to submit to the House proposals for supporting policy on education quality in 2010
verzoekt het kabinet in 2010 voorstellen voor flankerend beleid voor de kwaliteit van educatie aan de Kamer voor te leggen

Standardises school truancy reporting so headteachers notify the municipality after 16 hours of unexcused absence over four school weeks, replacing the previous mixed deadlines.
One rule creates more clarity and helps prevent early school leaving.
Eén regeling schept meer duidelijkheid en draagt bij aan het voorkomen van schooluitval.
Amendement van het lid Biskop over verkorting van de termijn verzuim te melden
Amends the truancy reporting rule to require schools to report absence after one school day or a quarter of lesson hours in one week.
the phrase 'on three consecutive school days, or absence over four consecutive teaching weeks exceeding 1/8 of lesson or practice hours' is replaced

wordt de zinsnede «op drie achtereenvolgende schooldagen, danwel het verzuim gedurende een periode van vier opeenvolgende lesweken meer dan 1/8 deel van het aantal uren les- of praktijktijd bedraagt» vervangen
Motie Depla en Biskop over het overplaatsen van kinderen die zich ernstig misdragen hebben op school naar een andere school

to place the perpetrator at another school without parental consent.
de dader zonder toestemming van ouders op een andere school te plaatsen
Amendement van de leden Depla en Biskop om duidelijkheid te scheppen over wanneer schoolverzuim gemeld dient worden
Amends the truancy reporting rules so one uniform trigger (three consecutive school days or one-eighth of lesson time over four weeks) applies to schools reporting to mayors.
At present there are different reporting deadlines.
Op dit moment is er sprake van verschillende meldtermijnen.
Motie Biskop over de leerplicht voor Nederlandse leerlingen die in België onderwijs genieten
Asks the government to arrange supervision of compulsory schooling for Dutch pupils attending school in Belgium so that truancy is reported.
requests the government to arrange supervision of compliance with compulsory schooling for Dutch pupils attending school in Belgium so that truancy is reported
verzoekt de regering om het toezicht op naleving van de leerplicht voor Nederlandse leerlingen die in België onderwijs genieten te regelen, zodat verzuim gemeld wordt

Amendement van de leden Biskop en Depla om iemand die beschikt over een geschikheidsverklaring zoals geregeld in de Wet educatie en beroepsonderwijs, een assistentopleiding in het vmbo te laten verzor
Allows persons holding a suitability declaration under the adult education act to teach in a VMBO assistant training programme if they also hold a teaching certificate.
This amendment makes it possible for the competent authority of a secondary school offering a VMBO assistant training to assign teaching to a person with a suitability declaration
Dit amendement maakt het mogelijk dat het bevoegd gezag van een school voor voortgezet onderwijs die een assistentopleiding in het VMBO verzorgt
Amendement van het lid Biskop c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 22 om het werkleerwerkaanbod uit te breiden naar jongeren die in een penitentiaire inrichting verblijven
Amendment extending the work-learning offer under the youth employment act to young people held in penitentiary institutions, with details possibly set by general administrative order.
Motie Biskop c.s. over een programma om niet-melders alsnog een werkleeraanbod te doen
Asks the government to make agreements with municipalities to develop a programme reaching young non-registrants outside the Youth Investment Act so they can be offered a work-learning placement.
calls on the government to conclude covenants with all municipalities to develop a programme for the group of non-registrants
roept de regering op om met alle gemeenten convenanten af te sluiten, individueel of regionaal, om voor de groep niet-melders
Motie Ortega-Martijn c.s. over mogelijke meerwaarde van voorbereidingsscholen
Asks the government to examine whether preparatory schools add value for young people in the work-learning scheme and include this in its response to the WRR report.
requests the government to examine whether such preparatory schools add value
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken of dergelijke voorbereidingsscholen een meerwaarde hebben
Amendement van het lid Spekman c.s. om de wet na twee jaar te evalueren
Shortens the statutory evaluation period of the Wet Investeren in Jongeren from four years to two, so Parliament receives an effectiveness report sooner.
In Article 90, 'four years' is replaced by two years.
In artikel 90 wordt «vier jaar» vervangen door: twee jaar.
Motie Ortega-Martijn c.s. over banen voor jongeren met een minimale duur van zes maanden
Asks the government to encourage municipalities to offer young people work placements lasting at least six months.
requests the government to promote that municipalities offer young people jobs with a minimum duration of six months
verzoekt de regering te bevorderen dat gemeenten bij het werkleeraanbod banen aan jongeren bieden
Motie Biskop c.s. over met gemeenten, werkgevers en roc's organiseren van het werkleeraanbod
Asks the government, with municipalities, employers and roc's, to organise a work-learning offer for young people and report to the Chamber each quarter.
requests the government, together with municipalities, employers and roc's, to organise the work-learning offer and to report on it to the Chamber each quarter
verzoekt de regering samen met gemeenten, werkgevers en roc's het werkleeraanbod te organiseren en hierover de Kamer per kwartaal te rapporteren
Amendement van het lid Ortega-Martijn c.s. om ervoor te zorgen dat jongeren altijd hun wensen en ideëen ten aanzien van het werkleeraanbod kenbaar kunnen maken
Amends the youth work-placement law so young people can always state their wishes and municipalities must explain whether they considered them.
and thereby gives the young person the opportunity to make known their wishes regarding the work-learning offer, in writing or orally
en stelt hierbij de jongere in de gelegenheid om schriftelijk of mondeling zijn wensen omtrent het werkleeraanbod kenbaar te maken
Motie Spekman c.s. over bevorderen van een juiste, tijdige en volledige diagnosestelling
Asks the government to take concrete measures to ensure timely, correct and complete diagnosis of young people's barriers under the youth employment law.
requests the government to take concrete measures promoting correct, timely and complete diagnosis of young people
verzoekt de regering concrete maatregelen te treffen die een juiste, tijdige en volledige diagnosestelling van jongeren bevorderen
Amendement van het lid Biskop c.s. over leerwerkaanbod bij verblijf in of buiten een penitentiaire inrichting
Extends the work-learning offer for youth to those detained inside a penal institution, not only those outside it.
In article 23, paragraph 3, the phrase 'takes place outside a penal institution' is changed to 'takes place inside or outside a penal institution'
In artikel 23, derde lid, wordt de zinsnede: «plaatsvindt buiten een penitentiaire inrichting» gewijzigd in: plaatsvindt binnen of buiten een penitentiaire inrichting.
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Ortega-Martijn c.s. over wensen van jongeren ten aanzien van het werkleeraanbod
Requires the municipality to record in a report the wishes young people express about the work-learning offer and how these were considered, and to give youth the chance to state their wishes.
The college records in a report the young person's wishes regarding the work-learning offer
Het college legt in een rapportage de wensen van de jongere ten aanzien van het werkleeraanbod vast
Motie Depla c.s. over schakel- en voetklassen
Motion asking the government to develop proposals enabling school and bridge classes, shifting six-year vmbo decisions to school boards, and easing inspectorate assessment of schools.
requests the government to develop proposals to
verzoekt de regering om voorstellen uit te werken om
Motie Depla c.s. over continuering van de financiële ondersteuning van de invoering van competentiegericht onderwijs
Asks the government to continue financial support for competence-based education in vocational schools into 2009/2010, possibly via FES innovation box funds.
expresses that it is desirable to continue the financial support for introducing competence-based education also in school year 2009/2010
spreekt uit dat het gewenst is om de financiële ondersteuning van de invoering van het competentiegericht onderwijs ook in het schooljaar 2009/2010 te continueren
Motie Biskop c.s. over middelen ten behoeve van het restauratie-opleidingsproject
Asks the government to structurally fund the restoration training project within its own budget, in consultation with provinces and branches, and report to the Chamber before the spring memorandum.
requests the government to make structural funds available within its own budget in consultation with provinces and branches
verzoekt de regering om in overleg met provincies en branches structureel middelen binnen de eigen begroting beschikbaar te stellen
Motie Depla c.s. over brede toegankelijkheid van het tweedekansonderwijs
Asks the government, with VNG and MBO Raad, to develop proposals guaranteeing broad accessibility of second-chance education and inform the House.
requests the government, in consultation with VNG and MBO Raad, without prior restrictions, to develop proposals
verzoekt de regering in overleg met de VNG en de MBO Raad, zonder beperkingen vooraf, voorstellen uit te werken
Motie Biskop c.s. over leerhulpmiddelen voor visueel beperkte en dyslectische studenten
Asks the government to send the House an overview of problems obtaining learning aids for visually impaired and dyslexic students, and then a plan to address them.
to send the House a note giving an overview of the bottlenecks
een notitie aan de Kamer te sturen waarin een overzicht wordt gegeven van de knelpunten
qa: Antwoord vragen van het lid Biskop over het bericht dat Nederlandse schoolexamens op Curaçao op een marineschip afgenomen kunnen worden

An MP asked whether Dutch state exams could be taken on a navy ship in Curaçao, and about costs and procedures. The minister answered that a navy ship is not Dutch territory in international-law terms, that Dutch education law does not apply on Curaçao, and gave cost figures for the Bonaire exams while noting that no ship-based option is feasible.
No, on board a navy ship the jurisdiction of the flag state applies, but that does not yet make it the 'territory' of a state in the sense of international law.
Neen, aan boord van een marineschip geldt de rechtsmacht van de vlaggenstaat maar daarmee is er nog geen sprake van «grondgebied» van een staat in volkenrechtelijke zin
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Biskop inzake schoolkosten mbo

The CDA MP Biskop asked the Minister of Education whether MBO institutions still send students bills for non-mandatory costs despite the ban on such charges, and whether she will intervene immediately. The minister replied that schools must follow the law as explained in her May 2012 guidance, that the Inspectorate will tighten supervision and re-inspect the twelve schools on the Zwartboek list this autumn with possible sanctions, and that she will not report separately to the House.
The Inspectorate will publish the individual assessment reports of the examined programmes in the usual way and report the outcomes of the institutional analysis in the annual Education Report.

De inspectie zal op de gebruikelijke wijze de afzonderlijke rapporten met beoordelingen van de onderzochte opleidingen openbaar maken alsook in het jaarlijkse Onderwijsverslag rapporteren over de uitkomsten van de instellingsanalyse.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Biskop en Uitslag over de werkinstructie indicatiestelling voor jeugd -GGZ 2012

Two CDA MPs asked why the 2012 youth mental health (jeugd-GGZ) assessment guideline was changed so that AWBZ care is only possible with full school exemption, and whether children living at home lose the combination of school and care. The state secretary answered that the guideline was corrected to 'full' exemption to match the CIZ indicator, that children can still receive personal care, nursing and individual support during school hours, and that exact numbers affected are not registered.
No, neither the CIZ nor youth care records which children use AWBZ or youth care during school hours, and in what way.
Nee, noch het CIZ, noch jeugdzorg registreren welke kinderen op welke wijze gebruikmaken van AWBZ- of jeugdzorg tijdens dagdelen onderwijs.
Antwoord vragen Biskop over het artikel ‘slechte economie kost mbo’ers stage’

An MP asked the education minister about a report that the number of vocational (mbo) students starting internships fell 23% in early 2012, and about sectors where internship places are declining. The minister acknowledged the concern, attributed the drop to the economic downturn and government spending cuts, and called on employers and social partners to keep offering internships without committing to a concrete government measure.
I share this view. That is why in the mentioned article I call on the business community to continue offering internships.
Ik deel deze mening. Vandaar dat ik in het genoemde artikel een oproep doe aan het bedrijfsleven om stages te blijven aanbieden.
Antwoord vragen van het lid Biskop over het artikel 'Leraren Frans klagen over examens'

An MP asked the education minister about reports that French exam teachers complained that correct student answers were not in the marking model, and whether teachers risk their jobs for approving such answers. The minister said the College voor Examens handles such complaints, corrects errors where needed, found no error in the French exam, and that teachers must follow the marking rules.
I agree that it must not be possible for final exam candidates to be disadvantaged by giving the correct answer.
Ik deel de mening dat het niet mogelijk moet zijn dat eindexamenkandidaten gedupeerd worden door het geven van het juiste antwoord.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Biskop over het bericht dat gebruik van de rekenkaart voor leerlingen met een rekenstoornis niet is toegestaan bij de eindexamens

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Biskop asked why the rekenkaart (calculation aid) is banned in exams for pupils with dyscalculia, whether a one-year postponement was possible, why the ERWD protocol arrives late, and whether schools must be exempted under equal-treatment law. The minister refused postponement, said pupils had ample notice via the College voor Examens, noted the protocol supports schools, and argued that allowing the aid would lower exam requirements.
Postponing the tightening of the exam requirements is not an option.
Uitstel van de aanscherping van de exameneisen is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord vragen van de leden Ortega-Martijn en Biskop over het bericht dat gebruik van de rekenkaart voor leerlingen met een rekenstoornis niet is toegestaan bij de eindexamens

MPs Ortega-Martijn and Biskop asked why a student with dyscalculia may not use a formula card in the final exams, despite a Commissie Gelijke Behandeling ruling against the school, and whether exam rules should be changed. The minister declined to follow the ruling, citing exam requirements known in advance, risk of inequality and timing, while promising a possibly adapted formula card and further guidance and research.
I have decided not to give the school room to deviate from the applicable rules for the central exam.
Ik heb besloten de school geen ruimte te geven om van de geldende regels voor het centraal examen af te wijken.
Antwoord vragen Biskop inzake het bericht “Twee miljoen voor ondernemende scholieren”

An MP asks the education minister about a subsidy for entrepreneurship projects in schools, questioning the choice of subsidy over classroom role models and whether effects can be measured. The minister defends the ONO 2012 scheme as funding proven best-practice projects being rolled out to other schools, with monitoring by AgentschapNL.

These are therefore successful projects, so-called best practices, in entrepreneurship education in primary and secondary education and senior vocational education, which are being rolled out and further developed at other schools or educational institutions.

Het gaat hier dus om succesvolle projecten, zgn. best practices, op het gebied van ondernemerschapsonderwijs in het funderend onderwijs en middelbaar beroepsonderwijs die worden uitgerold en doorontwikkeld naar andere scholen c.q. onderwijsinstellingen.
Antwoord vragen Ferrier en Biskop over de brief van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs aan VCO Heerenveen

MPs Ferrier and Biskop asked the Minister of Education why school margedagen (extra free days) at VCO Heerenveen conflict with the Leerplichtwet while the hours norm is met, and why they differ from the planned flexible-schedule experiment. The minister replied that the school abolished the margedagen after consulting the Inspectorate, so no sanctions are needed, that she is bound by existing law and will not make exceptions before the experimentation law takes effect.
Once a law has been adopted, I am bound to comply with it.
Op het moment dat een wet is aangenomen, ben ik gehouden aan de naleving ervan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Biskop en Joldersma over een tekort aan stageplekken in het mbo

MPs Biskop and Joldersma asked the ministers about a reported shortage of internship places in vocational education (mbo), particularly in care and welfare, and how the government would stimulate more places. The minister answered that enrolment and placements have risen, cited the Stagefonds funding, and said existing instruments are considered sufficient, without committing to new measures.
At present, according to SBB, the existing instruments of the knowledge centres are sufficient to keep the national supply of internship places and apprenticeships at the desired level.
Op dit moment volstaat volgens de SBB het bestaande instrumentarium van de kenniscentra om het landelijke aanbod van stageplaatsen en leerbanen op peil te houden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Biskop over groot tekort bij Amarantis

An MP asked the education minister about a large deficit at Amarantis, a school group, including its size in 2009, whether it grew under intensified supervision, why it was not reduced, and what instruments the Inspectorate has. The minister replied that Amarantis had a surplus in 2009 and 2010 but its finances worsened in 2011, that the Inspectorate tightened supervision in January 2012 after the board failed to act, and listed the Inspectorate's and minister's intervention powers.

Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de aanvraag van de Stichting Voortgezet Onderwijs Kerkrade voor stichting van het College Nova Rolduc te Kerkrade (ingezonden 23 d

An MP asks the education minister why a request by the Stichting Voortgezet Onderwijs Kerkrade to found a new school, College Nova Rolduc, was rejected despite strong local interest, and whether a school could instead be transferred from another foundation. The minister confirms the rejection under the statutory formula, which counts existing schools and projected enrolment rather than expressed interest, and says a transfer is legally possible only if the initiating school board takes the step.
Expressed "interest" is not a scientifically tested method for establishing the pupil potential of a new school.
Getoonde «belangstelling» is geen wetenschappelijk beproefde methode om het leerlingenpotentieel voor een nieuwe school vast te stellen.

Vragen van de leden Biskop en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap en de staatssecretaris van Buitenlandse Zaken over «Elke Dag een Werelddocent» (ingezonden 7 oktober 2011).

Two CDA MPs asked the education and foreign affairs ministers whether they endorse the added value of teacher experience abroad, what initiatives exist for primary and secondary teachers, and what their effects are. The ministers answered yes, pointed to EU Comenius, the national BIOS programme, and Learn4Work, reported participation numbers, and said a Comenius evaluation was positive and BIOS will be evaluated in 2012.
The BIOS programme will be evaluated in 2012.
Het BIOS programma zal in 2012 worden geëvalueerd.
Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het bericht «Onderwijsassistent kan niet begrijpend lezen» (ingezonden 22 juli 2011).

An MP from the CDA asked the Minister of Education about an Amsterdam study showing fewer than half of primary-school education assistants passed a reading comprehension test, and about whether national lessons and mbo language policy would address this. The minister found the results worrying, pointed to ongoing mbo language and arithmetic reforms with central exams from 2013-2014, and said school boards are responsible for retraining staff.
Because the study was conducted only in Amsterdam, I cannot make any statements about its representativeness.
Omdat het onderzoek alleen in Amsterdam is uitgevoerd, kan ik over de representativiteit geen uitspraken doen.
Vragen van de leden Omtzigt en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Financiën over de btw-vrijstelling voor het beroepsonderwijs (ingezonden 4 maart 2011)

Two MPs from the CDA asked the State Secretary of Finance whether the 2010 change to the VAT exemption for vocational education created uncertainty for guest teachers, and whether the exemption should be drawn as broadly as EU rules allow. The State Secretary replied that the change only concerns non-statutory vocational education, that guest teachers can be exempt via the RKBO register under a lighter audit, and that the available EU room is already used.

Because the change in VAT rules from 1 July 2010 relates only to non-statutory vocational education, I am not aware that the change has caused uncertainty about the VAT obligations of self-employed teachers and guest teachers in statutory vocational education.

Omdat de wijziging in de BTW-regelgeving per 1 juli 2010 uitsluitend betrekking heeft op het niet wettelijk erkende beroepsonderwijs is mij niet bekend dat die wijziging aanleiding is geweest voor onduidelijkheid
Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over thuisonderwijs (ingezonden 14 februari 2011).

An MP asked the education minister about home schooling after a Muslim school closure in Amsterdam, including tensions between the Compulsory Education Act's exemption for religious objections and the constitution, and oversight of quality. The minister said there is no tension, that quality supervision is not required, and that she is reconsidering the religious exemption ground and will report in autumn.
I have serious doubts about whether this exemption ground is in the interest of all those involved and of society as a whole.
Ik heb serieuze twijfel in hoeverre deze uitzonderingsgrond in het belang van alle betrokkenen en de samenleving als geheel is.
Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het melden van spijbelen (ingezonden 6 december 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks the Minister of Education whether school truancy reporting is adequate, notably in Amsterdam, and whether Rotterdam's plan to impose administrative fines on parents of truants is acceptable. The Minister finds reporting insufficient, prefers the criminal-law approach over fines on parents, and says she does not intend a nationwide administrative fine for parents, while pointing to her bill to fine schools.
The use of administrative fines aimed at parents is not something I consider desirable.
Het gebruik van de bestuurlijke boete gericht op ouders acht ik niet wenselijk.

Vragen van de leden Sterk en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid en de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over de gevolgen van de wijze van bekostiging van het Voor

Christian Democrat MPs asked whether Vavo (adult secondary education) counts as education funded from the national treasury, which under the WIJ would bar young people from a work-learning offer and the related income support, and whether the law is unclear on this. The state secretary replied that Vavo is funded from the Rijkskas and so carries no right to a work-learning offer, and said the ambiguity in implementation will be addressed in an upcoming letter to municipalities.
I intend to pay attention to this in the upcoming collective letter to municipal executives.
Ik ben voornemens om hier aandacht aan te besteden in de eerstkomende Verzamelbrief aan colleges van burgemeester en wethouders.

Vragen van de leden Ferrier en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het rapport «Van vmbo naar havo: tweestrijd over tweesprong?» (ingezonden 26 november 2010).

CDA MPs asked the education minister about an ECBO report finding that vmbo students moving up to havo do worse partly because havo schools bar them from repeating year four, and whether schools' rules and the transition policy should change. The minister said schools set their own repeat and transition rules, called inconsistent treatment of former vmbo pupils objectionable, and declined to change the transition policy, which is left to schools.
The transition policy is entirely up to the school and I am leaving it that way.
Het overgangsbeleid is volledig aan de school en dat laat ik zo.

Vragen van de leden Knops en Biskop (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Defensie en aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over het aansmeren van verzekeringspolissen aan scholieren (ingezonden 20 mei

Two CDA MPs asked whether insurance policies were being pushed on pupils during lessons at vocational colleges (ROCs), whether companies may collect pupil data for commercial approaches, and whether this fits the Veiligheid & Vakmanschap curriculum. The state secretary answered that no signs were found of insurance sales during lessons, that commercial activity at ROCs is not acceptable, and that data collection for commercial purposes does not fit the curriculum.
The Ministry of Defence also sent a letter to all ROCs with a defence training programme asking them to ensure the programmes are not used for commercial purposes.

Voorts heeft het ministerie van Defensie naar alle roc's met een defensieopleiding een brief gestuurd met daarin het verzoek erop toe te zien dat de opleidingen niet gebruikt worden voor commerciële doeleinden.

Vragen van de leden Biskop en De Rouwe (beiden CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over mbo’ers die bevreesd zijn voor hun toekomst op de arbeidsmarkt (ingezonden 23 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the state secretary for Education about a newspaper report on vocational students fearing for their labour-market future, including criticism of their training and links to youth unemployment in Friesland. The secretary answered that the crisis effects are temporary, that the individual student criticism cannot be generalised, and that the government is taking quality-supervision and governance measures.
Since the cited article does not make clear which course(s) or which vocational institution are involved, I cannot make general statements about this.
Aangezien uit het genoemde artikel niet duidelijk wordt om welke opleiding(en) en/of welke mbo-instelling het gaat, kan ik hierover geen (algemene) uitspraken doen.
Vragen van het lid Biskop (CDA) aan de staatssecretaris van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap over bezuinigingen op het volwassenenonderwijs (ingezonden 31 mei 2010).

An MP from the CDA asks the state secretary whether cuts to adult education, and municipal budget choices, undermine second-chance education and lifelong learning, and whether care pupils are left out in the cold. The state secretary replies that municipalities must spend the full education share of the participation budget on education, that care pupils are not disadvantaged, and that consultation with the VNG and MBO Raad is ongoing.
Municipalities are obliged to spend the full amount they receive within the participation budget for education on education at a roc.
Gemeenten zijn verplicht het volledige bedrag dat zij binnen het participatiebudget voor educatie ontvangen bij een roc aan educatie te besteden.
Vragen van de leden Biskop en Ferrier (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Buitenlandse Zaken over materialen voor de herbouw van een school in Haïti (ingezonden 18 mei 2010).

CDA MPs Biskop and Ferrier asked the foreign minister about a container of building materials for a Haiti school that was reportedly blocked at the border, and whether Haiti still only needs cash. The minister replied that the container has now reached Port-au-Prince, that Haiti still has great need for emergency aid, and that the Netherlands funds relief through the UN, the Red Cross and SHO rather than the Haitian government.
This container has now nevertheless reached Port-au-Prince.
Deze container heeft Port-au-Prince inmiddels alsnog bereikt.

m: Motie van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie verlaten
Asks the government to withdraw Netherlands from the World Health Organization as soon as possible.
requests the government to ensure that the Netherlands leaves the World Health Organization as soon as possible
verzoekt de regering ervoor te zorgen dat Nederland zo snel mogelijk de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie verlaat
Amendement van het lid Flach c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 4 over het doorschuiven van middelen voor de woningbouwimpuls
Amendment increasing the housing budget by 57 million euro so unspent Woningbouwimpuls funds remain available for housing construction in 2026.
This amendment ensures that the 57 million euro that threatens to lapse remains available for the WBI in 2026.
Dit amendement zorgt ervoor dat de 57 miljoen euro die vrij dreigt te vallen, beschikbaar blijft te houden voor de WBI in 2026.
Motie van het lid Van Houwelingen over uitleg over het uitonderhandelen van een regeerakkoord in relatie tot geheime NAVO-doelstellingen

qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het aantal spoedritten van Ambulance Oost

An MP asked the Minister of Health why ambulance urgent-ride and care-consult figures for Ambulance Oost rose sharply from 2021 and whether the cumulative percentages were correct. The Minister confirmed the figures broadly, attributed the A1 jump to a 2021 change in how multiple-dispatch vehicles were prioritised, and noted the consult increase is a national trend.
This results in an increase in the number of A1 deployments and a decrease in the number of A2 deployments.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Eurobarometer

A Freedom Party MP asks the Foreign Minister whether the Eurobarometer systematically overstates positive views of the EU due to sample bias and question framing, whether the Rijksoverheid should stop using it as a source, and how the government views the contact between the authors and the commissioning and fieldwork bodies.
