The minister replies that the government values quality polling, that the methodology is documented, that it is not for the cabinet to judge how the survey is conducted, and that official sources are verified independently, without committing to any action.
It is further not for the cabinet to pronounce on the implementation of this opinion research.
Het is verder niet aan het kabinet om zich uit te spreken over de uitvoering van dit opinieonderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van Van Houwelingen over het medeondertekenen door de minister van Defensie van de beantwoording op vragen van het lid Dekker

An FVD MP asked the Minister of VWS for all messages exchanged between VWS and Defence about Defence co-signing the answers to Dekker's questions on NATO obligations. The Defence Minister answered that officials disagreed on which ministry should primarily answer, and gave a description of the exchange rather than the messages themselves, citing the need for free official deliberation.
For that reason I provide a description of the exchange of views that took place
Om die reden geef ik een beschrijving van de uitwisseling van inzichten die heeft plaatsgevonden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het artikel 'Kippenboeren zitten klem door vogelgriep en stikstof

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture whether eggs from a Dutch poultry farm vaccinated against bird flu carry a label, and whether consumers can be told if eggs come from vaccinated hens. The minister answered that the vaccine is a licensed vector vaccine rather than mRNA, that eggs from vaccinated hens are safe, and that packaging does not state which vaccines were administered, consistent with practice for decades.
Packaging of eggs and meat does not state which vaccines have been administered.
Op verpakkingen van eieren en vlees staat niet welke vaccins zijn toegediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Verenso

An FVD MP asks the health minister about a 2022 Verenso guidance note advising caution with booster vaccination of very frail nursing-home residents, which Lareb adopted, and why this warning was not shared publicly and why the Hipra protein vaccine was not promoted more widely. The state secretary confirms awareness of the documents, states the Hipra vaccine is available on the RIVM website for people who cannot receive mRNA vaccines, and says a leaflet with a QR code was enclosed with the invitation letter.
Through various (online) channels people can find information about the COVID-19 vaccines and the possible side effects that may occur.
Via verschillende (online) kanalen kunnen mensen informatie vinden over de COVID-19-vaccins en de mogelijke bijwerkingen die kunnen optreden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bericht 'Na coronaprik melden duizenden vrouwen zware menstruatieklachten'

An MP asked whether reports of severe menstrual complaints after COVID-19 vaccination, collected by Lareb, were accurate and whether further investigation was warranted. The state secretary confirmed the rise in reports, attributed it partly to mass vaccination and media attention, and declined to commission further research, saying Lareb monitors reports closely.
Lareb monitors the reports carefully and therefore I see no reason to commission additional research.
Lareb houdt de meldingen zorgvuldig in de gaten en daarom zie ik geen aanleiding om extra onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An MP asked the Finance Minister whether Finance Ministry units indirectly use Palantir software or data-sharing channels, and whether sharing data with partners discharges GDPR responsibilities. The minister replied that FIOD officers with police-provided workstations can access Palantir under police responsibility, no other indirect use was found, and sharing data does not transfer GDPR responsibilities; other ministries answer for RIEC/LIEC/iCOV.
In chain cooperation there may be shared or joint responsibility.
Bij ketensamenwerkingen kan sprake zijn van gedeelde of gezamenlijke verantwoordelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de 'politiehandleiding complotdenken'

An MP from FVD asks the Minister of Justice and Security about an internal police handbook on conspiracy thinking, questioning whether it wrongly criminalises critical citizens and whether conspiracy beliefs about elites or institutions are treated as radicalisation. The Minister confirms the handbook exists, says it was an internal aid not meant for publication, acknowledges some passages could cause confusion and will be adjusted, and largely refers to AIVD and NCTV reports without answering the substantive questions.
Moreover, the police have indicated that they acknowledge that some parts of the handbook could cause confusion without the proper context. They will therefore adjust the handbook on some points.

Overigens heeft de politie laten weten dat zij erkennen dat sommige onderdelen in de handreiking zonder de juiste context voor verwarring kunnen zorgen. Zij zullen de handreiking daarom op sommige punten aanpassen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the NCTV uses or has access to Palantir, which ketenpartners receive signals from the police's Palantir analysis environment, which datasets and algorithms are involved, and whether those algorithms are published in the Algoritmeregister. The minister answered that the NCTV neither uses nor has access to Palantir, that only signals at case level (not information products or datasets) are shared with partners such as municipalities or the Openbaar Ministerie under the Wpg, and that the basic Palantir algorithms are not AI systems and therefore not registered.
No datasets are shared with those chain partners.
Er worden geen datasets gedeeld met die ketenpartners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An MP from FvD asked the Health Minister whether VWS uses Palantir software and whether it shares data with the 'Raffinaderij' program or other Palantir-related initiatives. The minister answered that VWS does not use Palantir, that the Raffinaderij falls outside the VWS domain, and referred the MP to answers given by the Justice and Security Minister.
Regarding the so-called 'Raffinaderij', this is a programme that falls outside the domain of VWS.
Ten aanzien van de zogenoemde «Raffinaderij» geldt dat dit een programma betreft dat buiten het domein van VWS valt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Permanente Vertegenwoordiger bij de Europese Unie

An MP asked how often the Permanent Representative to the EU substituted for Dutch cabinet ministers in Council configurations over the past year, whether the PR negotiates on behalf of the Netherlands, and whether the Chamber can receive correspondence on the CSAM ('chat control') proposal before a committee debate. The minister answered that the PR substituted in 10 of 46 ministerial meetings, that the PR presents the cabinet's positions but cannot vote, and declined to share the confidential instructions and PR correspondence on the CSAM regulation, citing diplomatic relations and negotiating position, while stating no correspondence with the European Council or Council Secretariat is known.
The instructions are part of diplomatic correspondence. To protect the Dutch negotiating position and diplomatic relations, I cannot share these with the Chamber.
De instructies maken deel uit van het diplomatieke verkeer. Om de Nederlandse onderhandelingspositie en de diplomatieke betrekkingen te beschermen kan ik deze niet met de Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de NAVO-verplichtingen en pandemische paraatheid

An MP from FVD asks the Minister of Health whether former minister Agema linked NATO resilience obligations to pandemic preparedness in a 2024 budget debate, and why the current minister said no such statements were known. The minister confirms the quoted remarks, explains that NATO asks for resilient health systems but imposes no binding obligation on pandemic preparedness, and declines to give the requested briefing details.
There are no NATO obligations regarding pandemic preparedness.
Er zijn geen NAVO-verplichtingen met betrekking tot pandemische paraatheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Interior which BZK units use or access Palantir software, and whether other projects such as the 'Raffinaderij' use it. The Minister replied that BZK does not use Palantir software, declined to comment on the AIVD, and said the Raffinaderij falls outside BZK's domain, referring to the Justice Minister.
In addition, I refer you to the answers to written parliamentary questions given by the Minister of Justice and Security.
Daarnaast verwijs ik u graag naar de beantwoording van schriftelijke Kamervragen door de Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An FvD MP asked the Finance Minister which departments use or have access to Palantir software, including the 'Raffinaderij' project, and which bodies share data with it. The minister answered that no Finance units use or access Palantir directly, that data sharing with partners falls outside Finance's responsibility, and that partners select their own software.
Finance Ministry units receive and share information and signals with chain partners within the applicable legal framework, but this supply does not take place directly in Palantir.

Organisatieonderdelen van het Ministerie van Financiën ontvangen en delen informatie en signalen met ketenpartners binnen de geldende wettelijke kaders, deze levering vindt niet direct in Palantir plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de AIVD

An FVD MP asked the Interior Minister about the AIVD's website claim that spreading a 'malicious elite' narrative creates a factually incorrect worldview, and about the AIVD's historian and the 'anti-institutional extremism' framing. The minister confirmed the statements, declined to ask the AIVD to research when the elite became benign, said citizens criticising the rule of law are not targeted, and gave evasive answers on how the AIVD would detect a shift back to a malicious elite.
The AIVD explicitly does not target citizens who voice criticism of how the democratic rule of law functions.
De AIVD richt zich nadrukkelijk niet op burgers die kritiek uiten op het functioneren van de democratische rechtstaat.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de ‘NAVO-doelstellingen en Commissie voor de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten’

An MP from FvD asked the Defence Minister whether secret NATO resilience objectives, classified by NATO, are known to the parliamentary intelligence oversight committee and whether they can be shared confidentially with the full chamber. The minister declined to confirm what the committee knows, and said the document is non-public and NATO's consent is needed for disclosure, but promised the Justice Minister would consult NATO in autumn about providing additional information.
Because it is classified state secret what is discussed with the Intelligence and Security Services Committee, I cannot comment on this publicly.
Het staatsgeheim gerubriceerd is wat er met de Commissie voor de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten wordt besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over COA-locaties

The MP asks for a complete list of current and planned COA reception locations with resident numbers and opening years, the number of legal proceedings against asylum centres per year since 2020, and the legal costs of those proceedings. The minister points to the COA map and an attached list (no future resident numbers), gives annual procedure counts rising to 50 in 2024 with a caveat about changed registration, and states that legal costs are not recorded by case type, while noting that municipal agreements are not published.

Finally, I want to emphasise that COA is an independent administrative body (ZBO), and that the national government does not make public the administrative agreements concluded by ZBOs and municipalities.
Tenslotte wil ik benadrukken dat het COA een zelfstandig bestuursorgaan (ZBO) is, en dat het Rijk bestuursovereenkomsten die gesloten worden door ZBO's en gemeenten niet openbaar maakt.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over ‘intelligence gathered by the Dutch'

An FVD MP asked the Minister of the Interior to provide, possibly confidentially, the intelligence the AIVD allegedly shared with US intelligence services, referenced in an interview as 'intelligence gathered by the Dutch'. The minister answered that specific intelligence would only be shared with the Parliamentary Committee on Intelligence and Security Services if there is cause to do so.
If there is cause to inform the House of specific intelligence, this will happen through the Parliamentary Committee on Intelligence and Security Services.
Indien er aanleiding is om de Kamer op de hoogte te stellen van specifieke inlichtingen, dan gebeurt dat via de Commissie voor de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Pepijn van Houwelingen over ‘NAVO-doelstellingen, de resilience requirements’

An MP asked the Justice and Security Minister which of NATO's seven resilience requirements covers pandemic preparedness. The minister answered that pandemic preparedness is not itself a NATO objective, but that measures for it contribute to civil resilience against military and hybrid threats, and referred to two earlier letters to parliament.
Pandemic preparedness in itself is not a NATO objective.
Pandemische paraatheid is op zichzelf geen doelstelling van de NAVO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de NAVO ‘resilience objectives'

The MP asked whether the seven ministers responsible for policy areas covered by NATO's secret 'Resilience Objectives' knew of them, when and how they were informed, and whether the Schoof cabinet's coalition negotiators knew. The Minister replied that the objectives are known to the relevant ministers, that departments themselves elaborate them and inform new ministers through their own ministry, that it is not for the cabinet to comment on negotiators' knowledge, and that the objectives are referenced in the Vilnius communiqué and the coalition programme.
It is not for the cabinet to make statements about the (knowledge position of the) negotiators of the coalition agreement.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om uitspraken te doen over de (kennispositie van de) onderhandelaars van het hoofdlijnenakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de NAVO ‘Resilience Objectives’

An MP asked whether any ministries are not involved at all in meeting NATO's secret Resilience Objectives. The government answered that resilience policy is a cabinet-wide effort coordinated by the Justice and Security, Defence and State Secretary of Defence, and that the other relevant ministries are involved as needed.
Resilience policy is a cabinet-wide effort.
Het weerbaarheidsbeleid betreft een kabinetsbrede inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Programma Raffinaderij en gebruik Palantir software

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether any of the ministry's units use or have access to Palantir software or the 'Raffinaderij' program, and whether ministry units share data with it. The minister answered that no ministry units or agencies under its responsibility use Palantir, that other initiatives are not applicable to the ministry, and that questions on the Raffinaderij should be directed to the Minister of Justice and Security.
Inquiries with the units of the Ministry of I&W, including the agencies falling under this department, show that Palantir is not and has never been in use there.
Navraag bij de onderdelen van het Ministerie van IenW inclusief de onder dit departement vallende ZBO's leert dat Palantir daar niet in gebruik is of is geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over ‘Palantir’

An FvD MP asked the Defence Minister which units use Palantir software, whether other projects like the 'Raffinaderij' share data with it, and whether the answers could come within three weeks. The State Secretary declined to name the Defence units for confidentiality reasons, said Palantir is used only for NATO interoperability in military operations, and stated that Raffinaderij falls outside Defence and that the answers would be sent after the summer recess.
Due to confidentiality, I cannot share which specific organisational units within Defence use the Palantir software.
Vanwege de vertrouwelijkheid kan ik niet delen welke specifieke organisatieonderdelen binnen Defensie gebruik maken van de Palantir-software.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het artikel 'Rates of succesful conceptions according to COVID-19 vaccination status: Data from the Czech Republic'

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Health about a Czech study linking COVID-19 vaccination to lower rates of successful conceptions, and whether pregnancy-related informed consent and further research should follow. The state secretary answered that the study did not adjust for confounders, that no scientific evidence shows vaccination lowers pregnancy chances, and that existing safety research is considered sufficient, so no additional study or new warnings are planned.
There is currently no scientific evidence that COVID-19 vaccination lowers the chance of a successful pregnancy.
Er is op dit moment geen wetenschappelijk bewijs dat COVID-19-vaccinatie de kans op een succesvolle zwangerschap verlaagt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vaccineffectiviteit en vaccinveiligheid

An MP asks the State Secretary about a RIVM-co-authored study suggesting COVID-19 vaccine effectiveness may be overestimated, and about the government's earlier dismissal of an excess-mortality report by Meester, Bakker and Walk. The State Secretary rejects that the RIVM figures were too rosy, states the bias issues were already acknowledged, says the excess-mortality report was not decisive because it is not peer-reviewed, and declines to publicise the study's findings beyond the existing consensus.
I trust that the advice given to me will be adjusted if studies show this to be necessary.
Ik vertrouw erop dat de adviezen aan mij worden aangepast als dat uit studies noodzakelijk blijkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Palantir

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security about the use of Palantir software within the ministry's bodies, the secrecy surrounding its acquisition and the reasons for not tendering it. The minister answered that only the police use Palantir, within the 'Raffinaderij' analysis environment for serious organised crime and attack prevention, that the acquisition was exempted from tendering under art. 2.23(1)(e) Aanbestedingswet for security reasons, and that the questions were answered as quickly as possible.

The reasons for the covert acquisition were: a. The themes for which the 'Raffinaderij' analysis environment and thus Palantir is deployed are very sensitive and carry a high risk of harm to operations.
De redenen voor het heimelijk verwerven waren: a. De thema's waarop de analyseomgeving «de Raffinaderij» en daarmee Palantir wordt ingezet zijn zeer gevoelig en kennen een hoog afbreukrisico
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de antwoorden op schriftelijke vragen 'NAVO-verplichtingen' met betrekking tot 'pandemische paraatheid'

An FvD MP asks the health minister why her predecessor repeatedly described NATO obligations on pandemic preparedness as binding, and how and when she was informed of such NATO goals. The minister replies that no NATO obligations on pandemic preparedness exist, that NATO asks allies to make health care crisis-ready, and that the cabinet is politically committed to NATO agreements; she also admits the answers could not be given within three weeks.
As also indicated in an earlier answer to questions from MP Van Houwelingen, there are no NATO obligations regarding pandemic preparedness.
Zoals ook aangegeven in een eerdere beantwoording van vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen 4 , zijn er geen NAVO-verplichtingen met betrekking tot pandemische paraatheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de effectiviteit van mRNA vaccins

The MP asks whether the US health ministry has said mRNA vaccines pose more risk than benefit and cancelled 22 mRNA vaccine projects, and whether Dutch mRNA COVID-19 vaccines are currently safe and effective. The state secretary confirms the US statements accurately reflect the video, declines to comment on US policy, and states that the Dutch COVID-19 vaccines are safe and effective per global scientific consensus.
I am not a commentator nor a political interpreter and will therefore not comment on the views and policy of the US Department of Health.
Ik ben geen commentator noch politiek duider en ga de standpunten en het beleid van het Amerikaanse Ministerie van Volksgezondheid dan ook niet becommentariëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over briefings op het Ministerie van Algemene Zaken

An FVD MP asked the Prime Minister who took the initiative for briefings held at the Ministry of General Affairs, given that it was not the Prime Minister himself. The government answered that civil servants are tasked with actively informing ministers and that the involved ministries jointly took the initiative.
It is the task of the civil service to actively inform ministers about relevant matters.
Het is de taak van de ambtelijke dienst bewindslieden actief te informeren over relevante aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het IPCC-rapport en weersextremen

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth to explain IPCC statements on low confidence in long-term trends in tropical cyclones and in human influence on high river flows, and whether the minister still holds that weather extremes are increasing and human-caused. The minister confirmed the quoted passages, explained that low confidence reflects limited data and studies rather than absence of trends, and reaffirmed that human-caused climate change has increased extremes, as the IPCC AR6 states.
Yes, and that is entirely in line with what the IPCC states.
Ja en dat is geheel in lijn met wat IPCC stelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de permanente vertegenwoordiger bij de Europese Unie

An MP from FVD asked the Foreign Minister about the role and tasks of the Permanent Representative to the EU, who may stand in for the Prime Minister at the European Council, and asked for correspondence between the Permanent Representative, the cabinet and the European Council for the past year. The minister explained the PV's coordinating role and that the PV cannot replace the Prime Minister, but declined to supply the correspondence on short notice, citing the time needed to review it for state-confidential content while promising to reassess targeted requests.

It is unfortunately not feasible to inventory, within a short timeframe, all documents that played a role in this and to check them for information whose disclosure must be withheld in the interest of the state.

Het is helaas niet haalbaar om alle stukken die daarbij een rol hebben gespeeld op korte termijn te inventariseren en te toetsen op de aanwezigheid van informatie waarvan de openbaarmaking gelet op het belang van de staat achterwege moet blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over NAVO-doelstellingen

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Climate and Green Growth whether the Netherlands is bound by NATO objectives, whether those obligations can be sent to parliament, and why a VWS answer named her ministry among those bound by NATO Resilience Objectives. The minister replied that these resilience objectives are non-binding guidelines that each member state implements through national policy, and that the ministry contributes to the whole-of-government resilience effort set out in a December 2024 letter.

These resilience objectives are, as the Minister of Health, Welfare and Sport indicated in her answer 17 of the same parliamentary document, guidelines for member states, which each country fills in through national policy.

Deze weerbaarheidsdoelen zijn, zoals de Minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport aangaf in haar antwoord 17 van datzelfde Kamerstuk 4 , richtlijnen voor lidstaten, die elk land zelf invult middels nationaal beleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Europese Raad over vreemdelingen- en asielbeleid op 12 en 13 juni

An FVD MP asked why the Minister of Asylum and Migration skipped the EU Justice and Home Affairs Council on migration in Luxembourg on 13 June 2025 in favour of attending the Bilderberg meeting, and asked for the dates and purpose of his attendance. The minister answered that the state secretary represented the Netherlands at the Council, that Bilderberg offers informal high-level dialogue on geopolitical issues, and that the questions were answered separately and within the usual three-week term.
The State Secretary for Legal Protection represented the Netherlands at the JBZ Council.
De Staatssecretaris Rechtsbescherming was namens Nederland aanwezig tijdens de JBZ-Raad.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de nationale crisisstructuur

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether the National Crisis Structure is active, for each activation since 2016 the reason, period and decision-makers, whether the Chamber was informed, whether ICCb and MCCb minutes exist, and whether NCC, NKC and LOCC are operational. The minister answered that the structure is not active, listed six activations with dates and reasons, confirmed the Chamber was informed by letter each time, said minutes are confidential and only decision lists are published, and confirmed the staff bodies are standing organisations.
Minutes and decision lists of the MCCb are not made public.
Verslagen en besluitenlijsten van de MCCb worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op een vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over de 'NAVO-verplichtingen' met betrekking tot 'pandemische paraatheid'

An MP asked the Health Minister when and how she was informed of alleged NATO obligations on pandemic preparedness. The minister answered that no such NATO obligations exist, while noting NATO asks allies to make health systems resilient for crises and conflict, in line with a cabinet letter on resilience.
There are no "NATO obligations" regarding "pandemic preparedness".
Er zijn geen «NAVO-verplichtingen» met betrekking tot «pandemische paraatheid».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over wachttijden binnen de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning 2015 (Wmo) en de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (ggz)

An MP asked the state secretaries about long waiting times in Wmo and mental health care (ggz) and how these relate to the Integraal Zorgakkoord and GALA targets. The government acknowledged long ggz waiting times, listed measures under the IZA and noted that effects are not yet visible, and said there is no national picture for Wmo waiting times.
For the Wmo there is no national picture of waiting times.
Voor de Wmo bestaat er geen landelijk beeld van wachttijden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de beantwoording van Kamervragen over de NAVO Resilience Objectives

An FVD MP asks the Defence Minister why he refused to co-sign answers to earlier written questions, even though a health ministry decision note said Defence handled most of those answers. The Defence Minister replies that questions are normally signed by the minister they are addressed to, that interdepartmental coordination is customary, and that Defence contributed where possible.
Parliamentary questions are as a rule signed by the Minister to whom the questions are addressed.
Kamervragen worden in de regel ondertekend door de Minister aan wie de vragen zijn gesteld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de NAVO Resilience Objectives

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether NATO set the classification level of the NAVO Resilience Objectives, whether the Netherlands could publish them without NATO consent, and who set the classification if not NATO. The minister confirmed NATO set the classification and that the Netherlands cannot publish them without NATO's consent.
No, the Dutch state cannot decide without NATO's consent to make the NATO Resilience Objectives public at the request of the House of Representatives.
Nee, de Nederlandse staat kan niet zonder toestemming van de NAVO besluiten om op verzoek van de Tweede Kamer de NAVO Resilience Objectives openbaar te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het aantal inzetten van ambulances, rapid responders en first responders

An MP asked the Minister of Health for totals of ambulance, rapid responder and first responder deployments from 2017 to 2024 and an explanation for rising numbers. The minister supplied figures up to 2023, attributed the rise in rapid responders to more mobile care consultations, admitted no clear explanation yet for the 2023 jump in first responders, and promised data for 2024 after the summer.
These figures are available up to and including 2023.
Deze cijfers zijn beschikbaar tot en met 2023.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het voornemen van Extinction Rebellion om winkels te bestoken met boterzuur

An MP from FVD asked ministers about Extinction Rebellion's announced plan to disrupt shops with butyric acid, the scope of past XR damage, municipal shifting of costs onto businesses, investigation of XR's structure and funding, equal treatment of demonstrations, and the AIVD/NCTV focus on right-wing versus left-wing extremism. The government called the butyric acid plan unacceptable, declined to compile an overview or damage figures, said municipal mayors decide on demonstration measures, refused to investigate XR, denied unequal treatment, and said the AIVD monitors left-wing extremism but XR's actions are currently seen as activism.
Such an overview cannot be generated.
Een dergelijk overzicht is niet te genereren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de toekomst van de Nederlandse garnalenvisserij

An FVD MP asked the state secretary about the planned exit of about fifty shrimp trawlers, the earlier VisWad buy-out and reduction of fishing hours, and whether the current fleet shrinkage will again be used to cut shrimp fishers' hours. The state secretary said a voluntary decommissioning scheme is planned and the sector wants it, that the reduced hours were agreed with fishing and nature groups earlier, and that the new permit already reflects 10% fewer requested hours, with a future shrimp fishery vision still being prepared.
I am currently working on a future vision for the shrimp fishery, which will also examine how fishing hours are allocated.
Momenteel werk ik aan een toekomstvisie garnalenvisserij waarin ook gekeken zal worden naar de invulling van de visuren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over onderzoek naar oversterfte

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Health whether she would ask Lareb to release data requested by Professor Meester for research into excess mortality. The Minister answered that she will pass the question to Lareb but that Lareb, as an independent foundation, decides for itself how to respond, and noted privacy and data-suitability concerns.
I am willing to share the question from MP Van Houwelingen with the foundation Lareb.
Ik ben bereid de vraag van lid Van Houwelingen te delen met stichting Lareb.
Antwoord op op de vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over het artikel ‘Kanker door mRNA-prikken’

An FVD MP asked the Health Minister about a media article and several studies linking mRNA COVID-19 vaccines to cancer, immune effects and calls to halt vaccination, and asked for independent research and more public information. The state secretary answered that there is no scientific evidence for a link to cancer, that the cited studies are hypotheses or do not show what is claimed, that no further independent research or halt is planned, and that existing information will be kept transparent and updated.
I see no reason to commission additional research.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om extra onderzoek te laten uitvoeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over herstelopdrachten van de Inspectie van het Onderwijs

The MP asked how many remedial orders the Inspectorate of Education issued to primary schools over five years, and how many concerned arithmetic and language teaching. The State Secretary answered that 1,440 orders were issued in 2024, that earlier totals are not centrally available, and that orders are not broken down by subject in general, though 18 arithmetic and 48 language orders arose from sampled inspections in 2024.
For the years before 2024 the full figures are not available, because the total number of remedial orders has no function in accountability at system level.
Voor de jaren voor 2024 zijn de volledige cijfers niet beschikbaar, omdat het totale aantal herstelopdrachten geen functie heeft in de verantwoording op stelselniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de ‘concrete weerbaarheidsdoelen’

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Defence whether the NATO resilience objectives, which the AIV advisory body reportedly saw, should be made available to the House and if so, when. The minister confirmed the AIV had seen them, said they are not public and that the underlying NATO documents were not shared, and promised only a later letter with concrete national resilience policy.
No, the AIV was not able to inspect the underlying documents of the NATO resilience objectives.
Nee, de AIV heeft de onderliggende documenten van de NAVO weerbaarheidsdoelen (NAVO Resilience Objectives) niet kunnen inzien.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitspraak van de Minister tijdens de plenaire vergadering van donderdag 24 oktober 2024 'Kort na mijn aantreden ben ik gebriefd over weerbaarheid'

MP Van Houwelingen asked the Minister of Health about a briefing on resilience she mentioned in plenary, the NATO obligations involved, and an inventory led by the NCTV, with 12 questions. The Minister answered that the briefings were held in July 2024 by the AIVD and NCTV, that presentations are classified and not shared, that the NATO Resilience Objectives are non-binding political commitments, and that the cabinet-wide resilience inventory will be sent to parliament at the end of 2024.
Question 7: Were presentations given and/or minutes made during this briefing? If so, can the House receive them? Answer 7: The presentations given cannot be shared because of their classification.

Vraag 7 Zijn er presentaties gegeven en/of notulen gemaakt tijdens deze briefing? Zo ja, kan de Kamer deze presentaties/notulen ontvangen? Antwoord 7 De gegeven presentaties kunnen vanwege de rubricering niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over NAVO-verplichtingen

An FVD MP asked the Climate minister about references to NATO obligations on pandemic preparedness by a health minister, the One Health concept linking climate and health, whether the minister was briefed by NATO, and whether climate duties bind the Netherlands under NATO. The minister confirmed awareness of the references and the One Health concept, denied any NATO briefing, and said NATO's 2021 climate action plan imposes no binding obligations on allies.
Where there are guidelines for allies on countering climate change, these are not binding.
Waar er richtlijnen zijn voor de bondgenoten voor het tegengaan van klimaatverandering, zijn deze niet verplicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over de Digital Servies Coördinator

Van Houwelingen (FVD) asked about the Digital Services Coordinator role (ACM), its tasks and staffing, whether any trusted flaggers were designated, and for correspondence with the European Commission. The minister confirmed ACM is the coordinator (provisionally designated, pending the implementing act), outlined its tasks and 49 fte budget, said no trusted flaggers yet exist, and declined to release the Commission correspondence citing confidentiality under article 84 DSA and the coordinator's independence.
Article 84 of the Digital Services Regulation provides that information obtained or exchanged under the regulation that falls under professional secrecy may not be made public.
Artikel 84 van de digitaledienstenverordening bepaalt dat informatie die krachtens de verordening is verkregen of uitgewisseld en die onder het beroepsgeheim valt, niet openbaar mag worden gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het EU Internet Forum

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the government contacts social media companies through the EU Internet Forum, what requests it sends them, for the correspondence over the past year, and for the list of violent right-wing extremism groups compiled by the Forum. The Minister answered that the Forum is a voluntary cooperation platform, that the government sends no requests to social media firms there, that no correspondence exists, and that the list is held on a secure Commission website, so documents must be requested from the Commission.
It is not for the cabinet to make public documents of the EUIF that also contain information from other member states.
Het is niet aan het kabinet om documenten van het EUIF openbaar te maken die ook informatie van andere lidstaten bevatten.
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Houwelingen over Oekraïne als atoommacht

The MP Van Houwelingen asked the Foreign Minister whether Zelensky threatened nuclear weapons development, whether Ukraine is pursuing nuclear weapons, and related questions on consequences for the Netherlands and the likelihood of Russian nuclear retaliation. The minister answered that Zelensky explicitly denied pursuing nuclear weapons, that the government has no indication of Ukrainian nuclear efforts, and declined to speculate on hypothetical scenarios.
The cabinet has no indication whatsoever that Ukraine is attempting to develop or acquire nuclear weapons.
Het kabinet heeft geen enkele aanwijzing dat Oekraïne poogt om kernwapens te ontwikkelen of in handen te krijgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitrusting van de speciale troepen

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence why special forces commanders buy their own equipment because central procurement is slow, and whether they should get an individual equipment budget. The government admits longer delivery times, calls self-purchase undesirable for safety and quality reasons, and rejects an individual budget while pointing to projects such as DOKS and a boot-choice concept.
To improve the quality, comfort and delivery time of the equipment, several projects are underway.
Om de kwaliteit, het draagcomfort en de levertijd van de uitrusting te verbeteren lopen er verschillende projecten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over uitlatingen van de secretaris generaal van de NAVO

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the NATO Secretary General's claim that Ukraine will inevitably join NATO, 'we decided in Washington', is accurate and who 'we' refers to, including whether the Netherlands is part of it. The minister answered that 'we' means all NATO allies, that the Bucharest 2008 statement and the Washington 2024 summit declaration reaffirmed Ukraine's path to NATO membership, and that the Netherlands agreed to that declaration.
The 'we' in this statement refers to all NATO allies together.
De «we» in deze uitspraak verwijst naar alle NAVO-bondgenoten gezamenlijk.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Integrated Political Crisis Response (IPCR)

Van Houwelingen (FVD) asked the Foreign Minister who represents the Netherlands in the EU's IPCR crisis mechanism, whether any binding IPCR decisions were taken this year, and whether the Chamber can receive IPCR minutes since 2020. The minister answered that Netherlands is usually represented at official level, that IPCR produces no binding decisions, and that the Operational Conclusions carry a Limité classification so they cannot be published, though they will be made available for confidential inspection.
The minutes of the IPCR round tables, the Operational Conclusions, carry the distribution code Limité.
Antwoord 3 De notulen van de IPCR ronde tafels, de Operational Conclusions , hebben een verspreidingscode Limité.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vrouwensporten

An MP from FVD asked the state secretary for health, welfare and sport whether biological differences justify separate women's sports categories and whether biological men should be excluded from women's sport. The state secretary said separate categories should be kept, but left eligibility rules and exclusion decisions to the individual sports federations and the IOC.
It is up to the national federations and the international sports federations to make agreements about this per sport.
Het is aan de nationale bonden en de internationale sportfederaties om hier per sport afspraken over te maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitvoering van de motie Snoeren (2021)

An FVD MP asks why the government-commissioned evaluation of the Sint Pancras and Koedijk municipal merger does not ask residents whether they would prefer to belong to Alkmaar, as required by the 2021 Snoeren motion, and whether the research bureau will add that question. The Minister replies that the province of Noord-Holland and Dijk en Waard run the evaluation through an independent bureau and a steering group, that BZK sits on that group, that the bureau drafted the survey participatively, and that the outcome will be awaited before any judgement is made.
I would prefer to await this information before going into more detail on your questions.
Ik wacht graag deze informatie af, alvorens meer in detail op uw vragen in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het platform DBDAAP

An FVD MP asked the State Secretary of Defence about the usage, number of developers, applications, data volume, costs and ongoing development of the DBDAAP defence big data platform. The State Secretary answered that it has been in use since September 2022, with about 90 users, 34 applications and over 20 terabytes of data, that about 8.2 million euros has been spent, and that development continues in the defence data lab, though application names are withheld for confidentiality.
Due to the confidential nature of these applications, it is not possible to share their names.
Vanwege het vertrouwelijke karakter van deze applicaties is het niet mogelijk de namen hiervan te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het uitspreken van een voorkeur voor een presidentskandidaat door een Nederlandse universiteit

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Education whether it is appropriate for a Dutch university to express a preference for a US presidential candidate. The minister said it was unclear whether such a statement was made, stressed freedom of expression and academic freedom, said judging such statements is not his responsibility, and that the supervisory board oversees the executive board.
I can also state that, in general, it is not part of my systemic responsibility to assess the statements by a university's executive board that you cite for desirability or appropriateness.

Ook kan ik aangeven dat het in zijn algemeenheid niet tot mijn stelselverantwoordelijkheid behoort om de door u aangevoerde uitspraken van een college van bestuur van een universiteit op wenselijkheid of gepastheid te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een mogelijke relatie tussen COVID-19-vaccinaties en oversterfte in Nederland

An MP asked whether the CBS refused to respond to a critical report by Meester and Jacobs on COVID-19 vaccination and excess mortality, and whether the minister would ask the CBS to respond. The minister answered that the CBS has received a proposal for a discussion and will write a short substantive response to the report.
The CBS indicates it will accept this and will also prepare a brief substantive response to the report.
Het CBS geeft aan daarop in te gaan en zal bovendien een korte inhoudelijke reactie op het rapport opstellen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het opblazen van de Nord Stream

The MP asks whether Ukraine was involved in the Nord Stream sabotage, whether Dutch infrastructure was attacked, whether it is an act of aggression, and why the Ukrainian flag was raised at the Defence Ministry. The minister declines to speculate on the cause pending German investigation, states Nord Stream 1 is not Dutch infrastructure, and explains the flag as solidarity with Ukraine.
The cabinet does not speculate on the cause of the explosions at the Nord Stream pipelines and awaits the results of the German investigation into the cause.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nord Stream pijpleidingen en wacht de resultaten van het Duitse onderzoek naar de toedracht af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het reizen van Nederlandse militairen met civiele vluchten naar conflictgebieden

An MP from FVD asked the Minister of Defence whether Dutch soldiers flew to Iraq on a Turkish Airlines civil flight on 2 August 2024, whether using civil flights to conflict zones is usual, and why no military aircraft (including MRTT capacity) was used. The Minister confirmed the flight, said civil transport is common for rotations and individual travel when security allows, and noted MRTT tankers were engaged in a major exercise elsewhere at the time.
For the transport of military personnel, civil flights are more often chosen, provided security allows it.
Voor de verplaatsing van militairen wordt, mits de veiligheid dit toestaat, vaker gekozen voor civiele vluchten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over uitspraken van president Poetin

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the cabinet knows of statements by President Putin aiming to restore the old Soviet borders, following a German government reply denying such statements. The minister declined to share any such statements, saying the cabinet sees increasingly aggressive Russian rhetoric and that Russia's aggression against Ukraine reflects a broader pattern of undermining neighbours' sovereignty.

No. What is clear is that President Putin feels close to the ideology of the 'Russian World' and the cabinet sees increasingly aggressive rhetoric from Russian government representatives, including President Putin.
Nee. Wel is duidelijk dat president Poetin zich verwant voelt met de ideologie van de «Russische Wereld» en het kabinet ziet dat er sprake is van steeds agressievere retoriek
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Houwelingen over de status van het Duitse onderzoek naar de aanslag op Nord Stream

An FVD MP asked the Dutch Foreign Minister whether the German investigation into the Nord Stream attack will stay secret, when it will conclude, and what the Netherlands will do to find the perpetrators. The minister replied that the German government has said preliminary results will not be published to protect the investigation, that the Netherlands cannot speak for Germany and is waiting for the German findings, and that it will not speculate on the cause of the explosions.
The cabinet is awaiting the results of the investigation by the German authorities.
Het kabinet wacht de resultaten van het onderzoek van de Duitse autoriteiten af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over Nord Stream

An FVD MP asked the Defence Minister whether Russia blew up Nord Stream, whether Ukraine was involved, when intelligence knew, and whether Netherlands would treat the attack as aggression. The government repeatedly declined to speculate on the cause, said it awaits the German investigation, and would not disclose intelligence sources or knowledge levels, only saying the House is informed through proper channels.
The cabinet makes no public statements about the knowledge level, methods or sources of our services.
Het kabinet doet in het openbaar geen uitspraken over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van onze diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over politiek gemotiveerd geweld

An FVD MP asked the Justice Minister for a list of all publicly known incidents since 2020 of physical political violence against members of parliament or cabinet. The minister replied that no such overview exists, that threats are tracked by the Den Haag prosecutor's team but physical violence cases are handled by the local district, and that protection is the responsibility of security authorities and the NCTV.
No overview is available of incidents since 1 January 2020 involving political (motivated) violence against members of the First or Second Chamber or members of the cabinet.
Er is geen overzicht beschikbaar van incidenten sinds 1 januari 2020 waarbij sprake is van politiek (gemotiveerd) geweld gericht tegen leden van de Eerste of Tweede Kamer of leden van het kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de status van Koningin Maxima bij het World Economic Forum

A Freedom Party MP asked the Prime Minister about Queen Máxima's current status at the World Economic Forum. The government answered that she has been a member of the WEF's Edison Alliance since 2021 in her role as UN special advocate for inclusive finance, and referred to earlier answers on roles of cabinet members and royals at the WEF.
Queen Máxima, in her role as special advocate of the UN Secretary-General for inclusive finance for development (UNSGSA), has been a member of the WEF's Edison Alliance since 2021.

Koningin Máxima is in haar functie van speciale pleitbezorger van de secretaris-generaal van de Verenigde Naties voor inclusieve financiering voor ontwikkeling (UNSGSA) sinds 2021 lid van de Edison Alliance van het Wereld Economisch Forum (WEF).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Volkskrant-artikel ‘AIVD en MIVD rekruteerden journalisten als agent, ‘ondermijning geloofwaardigheid’ van het vak’

An FVD MP asked the Defence and Interior Ministers about a Volkskrant report that the AIVD and MIVD recruited journalists as agents, including how many, whether it continues, and whether the public may know their names. The government confirmed the legal possibility under the Wiv 2017 with extra safeguards, but refused to disclose numbers, current use, or any list of journalists citing source protection and secrecy duties.
The heads of the services are, under Article 23 of the Wiv 2017, responsible for keeping their sources and the safety of agents secret.
De diensthoofden zijn, conform artikel 23 van de Wiv 2017, verantwoordelijk voor de geheimhouding van hun bronnen en de veiligheid van agenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Nord Stream gasleiding

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch government supports China's call for a UN-led international investigation into the Nord Stream pipeline sabotage, and why it has not, given that Danish and Swedish probes were closed without naming a culprit. The government answered that it does not support the call, that German authorities are investigating and have received Danish and Swedish evidence, and that it will not speculate on the outcome.
German authorities are already conducting an investigation into the explosions at the Nord Stream pipeline.
Er wordt door de Duitse autoriteiten reeds onderzoek gedaan naar de explosies bij de Nord Stream pijpleiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over correspondentie tussen IGJ en een huisarts

An FVD MP asked for the full email correspondence between the health inspectorate (IGJ) and a GP, and any correspondence with Twitter about the GP's account, referenced in a February 2021 ministry email as 'this man'. The minister answered that the IGJ had no correspondence with the person referred to as 'this man' and no correspondence with Twitter about the GP's account.
After inventory, it turned out that the IGJ had no correspondence with the person referred to as 'this man'.
Na inventarisatie is gebleken dat de IGJ geen correspondentie heeft gehad met de persoon waarnaar werd gerefereerd als «deze man».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over uitspraken van Koningin Máxima inzake de digitale euro

MP Van Houwelingen (FVD) asked the Prime Minister whether Queen Máxima had advocated for the digital euro, citing two statements she made. The Minister of Finance answered that the Queen did not argue for or against a digital euro, that her remarks concerned financial inclusion within her UN role, and that the questions could not be answered within three weeks.
Queen Máxima has neither advocated for nor against a possible digital euro.
Koningin Máxima heeft niet voor of tegen een mogelijke digitale euro gepleit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Nord Stream-gasleiding

An MP from FVD asked the Prime Minister whether the state responsible for blowing up Nord Stream should be treated as hostile, why the government would not call a sabotage act of aggression regardless of perpetrator, and about Gasunie's investment and state ownership. The government declined to speculate on the perpetrator, which the German authorities are investigating, and answered the financial questions largely factually, saying Gasunie's net investment was lower and had been recovered through dividends.
German authorities are conducting an investigation into the circumstances of the explosions at the Nord Stream pipelines.
Er wordt door de Duitse autoriteiten onderzoek gedaan naar de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nordstream pijpleidingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over of Oekraïne lid kan worden van de NAVO

Van Houwelingen (FVD) asks the Foreign Minister, in eight questions, whether Ukraine can join NATO while still at war with Russia and whether accession would automatically draw NATO into war under Article 5, and why the government's earlier answer was not a simple yes or no. The government answers that allies reaffirmed Ukraine will join once conditions are met and all allies agree, that Article 5 is not automatic and would be decided by allies in context, and that Article 5 would apply to Ukraine upon unconditional accession.
To provide the proper context for the issue, the answer to the questions is served by substantive explanation.
Om het vraagstuk van de juiste context te voorzien, is het antwoord op de vragen gediend bij inhoudelijke toelichting.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de inzet van weerbeïnvloedingstechnieken / geo-engineering

An FVD MP asked the climate minister about geoengineering and weather modification, including WEF ambitions, international regulation, monitoring, and private-sector and research projects. The minister answered that the Netherlands applies no such techniques, opposes SRM deployment, works toward international governance, and is not involved in the cited projects.
The Netherlands does not apply techniques to influence precipitation patterns.
Nederland past geen technieken toe om het neerslagpatroon te beïnvloeden.
Antwoorden op vraag van het lid van Houwelingen over documenten van de MIVD inzake de ‘Nord Stream-gasleiding

An MP asked the Minister of Defence for all MIVD documents from 2022 onward mentioning the Nord Stream pipeline. The minister refused, citing the statutory secrecy duties of the Intelligence and Security Services Act 2017, and pointed to the parliamentary intelligence committee (CIVD) as the channel for confidential information.
No, this given the safeguards in the Intelligence and Security Services Act 2017 concerning, among other things, the statutory duty of secrecy regarding the services' methods of working.
Nee, dit gelet op de waarborgen die de Wet op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten (Wiv) 2017 bevat over onder meer de wettelijke plicht tot geheimhouding van de werkwijze van de diensten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het blokkeren van een Twitter account van een arts

An FVD MP asked whether a VWS official emailed Facebook asking it to forward to Twitter a doctor's posts about COVID so the account might be blocked, and whether VWS requested blocking of social media accounts. The government confirmed the email was sent to Facebook and the IGJ, said it only asked Twitter to be alerted to the doctor's statements rather than requesting a block, and that VWS handles reports like any other user and has no power to request account blocks.
The Ministry of VWS has no authority to make a request to block social media accounts.
Het Ministerie van VWS heeft geen bevoegdheid om een verzoek te doen tot blokkeren van socialmedia-accounts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een tweet van de Letse president

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about a Latvian president's tweet saying 'Russia delenda est' and whether it threatens Russia, raises conflict risk, and whether the ambassador would be raised. The minister answered that the government does not target destruction of any state, that preventive force is not permitted under Article 51 of the UN Charter, that Russia started an unprovoked war, and that raising the matter with the ambassador is not warranted.
The policy of the Dutch government is not aimed at the destruction of any country or state whatsoever.
Het beleid van de Nederlandse regering richt zich niet op de vernietiging van welk land of welke staat dan ook.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Houwelingen over de dreiging van een nucleaire oorlog tussen Nederland en Rusland

MPs Baudet and Van Houwelingen asked the government about the risk of nuclear war with Russia, including whether troops would be sent to Ukraine, the effects of nuclear weapons, and whether Ukraine could join NATO and the EU. The ministers answered that Russia's invasion is illegal, that Nederland is not at war with Russia, that deterrence is maintained, and that no decision on troop deployment can be anticipated, while several questions were answered jointly or left to later decisions.
The cabinet cannot elaborate further on the nature of the discussions due to confidentiality.
Het kabinet kan in verband met vertrouwelijkheid niet verder op de aard van de besprekingen in gaan.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een tweet waarin beweerd wordt dat “Ambassadeurs van EU-landen in Rusland een ontmoeting met de Russische minister van Buitenlandse Zaken hebben geweigerd”

An MP from FVD asked the Foreign Minister whether a claim by Medvedev that EU ambassadors in Russia refused a meeting with Lavrov is correct, whether the Dutch ambassador also refused, and whether the ambassador is working to bring Russia and Ukraine to the negotiating table. The minister confirmed the EU ambassadors, including the Dutch one, collectively declined a meeting they judged to be a propaganda exercise, and explained the Dutch role in supporting Ukraine's peace formula.
Jointly it was decided that, as EU ambassadors, they would not accept the invitation.
Gezamenlijk is besloten om als EU-ambassadeurs niet op de uitnodiging in te gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over maatregelen in het kader van het asiel en migratiebeleid

An FVD MP asked the State Secretary for a list of migration measures the cabinet would favour but cannot implement because of the Refugee Convention, and for a list of the Convention's benefits to the Netherlands. The State Secretary declined both lists, stating the Convention is the cabinet's starting point and pointing to a 2020 review by Donner and Den Heijer on the Convention's limits.
For that reason, there are no such measures outside the Refugee Convention, and no overview of them can be provided.
Om die reden is van maatregelen die niet binnen het Vluchtelingenverdrag geen sprake en kan daarvan geen overzicht worden geboden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de KNMG-gedragscode

An FVD MP asks the Minister for Medical Care whether it is correct that she cannot say with certainty if a doctor publicly denying that climate change threatens health breaches the KNMG code, how doctors can know this, whether this violates lex certa, and how doctors can still speak freely. The minister replies that the code's core rule allows justified deviation, that doctors must judge this themselves, that the code is self-regulation not binding on disciplinary judges, and that the IGJ acts only when statements pose a public health danger.
Self-regulation does not have the same legal status as legislation or court rulings.
Zelfregulering heeft niet dezelfde juridische status als wetgeving of rechterlijke uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het inzetten van mensen met het syndroom van Down

An MP from FVD asked the Foreign Minister whether videos showing people with Down syndrome deployed and abused as soldiers by Ukraine are authentic, whether this breaches the laws of war, and whether the government will question the Ukrainian ambassador. The minister said the government cannot verify the videos, which Ukrainian authorities call inauthentic, that international humanitarian law contains no such ban, and declined to speculate or to answer within three weeks.
The cabinet has not received any verified reports of such deployment.
Het kabinet heeft geen geverifieerde berichten ontvangen van een dergelijke inzet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Baudet en Van Houwelingen over de Kamerbrief betreffende de staat van de oorlog in Europa d.d. 23 februari jl

Two MPs from FVD asked the government to substantiate claims in its letter on the war in Europe, including Russian territorial ambitions, Ukraine's role in peace talks, and whether the 2022 talks failed due to Boris Johnson. The government answered that Russian officials' statements and past conduct support its assessment, that Ukraine decides when conditions for negotiations exist, that the Johnson claim is Russian disinformation, and that NATO enlargement strengthens deterrence.
Questions 3 and 4 follow on from each other, and are therefore answered together.
Vragen 3 en 4 liggen verder in het verlengde van elkaar, en zijn daarom gezamenlijk beantwoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het testverslag 'AcceptatieverslagMinimum Viable Product Defensie Big Data Advanced Analytics Platform'

An MP from FVD asked the Defence Minister about an acceptance test report on the Defence Big Data Advanced Analytics Platform, including who commissioned it, whether it reached the steering group, and whether it could be sent before a debate. The state secretary answered that the report was a limited snapshot shared with the steering group via integrated results on 14 February 2022, that the project was paused and re-scoped, and that the report was sent with names and operational details redacted.
In the test report, the names of defence employees and information related to operational deployment have been redacted for confidentiality.
In het testverslag zijn de namen van defensiemedewerkers en informatie gerelateerd aan operationele inzet gelakt in verband met vertrouwelijkheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de publicatie van De Andere Krant ‘Werkte Bellingcat samen met NCTV voor aanval op MH17-journalisten?’

An FVD MP asked the Justice and Security Minister whether the NCTV or other Dutch government bodies collaborated with Bellingcat on an article about the Bonanza Media project, and about Bellingcat's ANBI status, lottery donations and US funding. The minister denied any commissioning, contribution, or structural contact, said the NCTV only prepared a press line, and saw no reason to doubt the desirability of contact with Bellingcat.
Bellingcat did not provide the article to the NCTV for review before publication, and as far as I am aware not to any other government body either.
Bellingcat heeft het artikel voor publicatie niet ter inzage gegeven aan de NCTV en voor zover mij bekend ook niet aan een andere overheidsinstelling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bekend zijn van uitspraken Poetin waarin hij dreigt met het (militair) binnenvallen van één of meer landen van de Europese Unie

An MP from FVD asked the Foreign Minister whether the government knows of statements by President Putin threatening military invasion of one or more EU member states, and if so, asked for exact quotes with sources. The minister replied that the government is not aware of direct threats by Putin of that kind, while noting increasingly aggressive rhetoric and hybrid actions by Russian officials and pointing to the invasion of Ukraine as evidence of willingness to use force.
The government is not aware of direct statements by President Putin threatening military invasion of one or more European Union countries.
Het kabinet is niet bekend met directe uitspraken van president Poetin, waarin gedreigd wordt met het militair binnenvallen van een of meer landen van de Europese Unie.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitlevering van Julian Assange

An MP from FVD asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch government shares the German chancellor's hope that Julian Assange will not be extradited to the United States. The minister replied that press freedom matters, but that extradition between two democratic states is not Dutch business and Dutch government should not interfere in another country's legal process.
This concerns an extradition request between two democratic constitutional states without Dutch involvement.
Het betreft hier een uitleveringsverzoek tussen twee democratische rechtsstaten zonder Nederlandse betrokkenheid.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over lesmateriaal voor seksuele voorlichting en vorming op basisscholen

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Education whether the Chamber could receive all sex education teaching material for primary schools developed by Rutgers, and if not, why not. The minister answered that the ministry does not own the material, that Rutgers' lesson packages are largely available online, and that the Chamber can request access itself, with Rutgers deciding how to provide it.
The Ministry of Education, Culture and Science does not own teaching material or lesson packages.
Het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap is geen eigenaar van lesmateriaal of lespakketten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het CBS-rapport inzake aanvullende sterftecijfers

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Health whether a CBS report on additional mortality figures supports claims that vaccination raises short-term death risk and that the 2021 COVID death decline was due to natural immunity, and why a new vaccination campaign is planned. The Minister rejected these readings, stating the CBS finds vaccination associated with lower COVID death risk and that no meaningful conclusions can be drawn for early 2021, and referred to an earlier letter for the campaign decision.
I see no reason to doubt this.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om hieraan te twijfelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de KNMG-gedragscode

An FVD MP asked the Minister for Medical Care whether a doctor who publicly denies that climate change increasingly harms health acts against the KNMG code of conduct, which states that climate change and pollution increasingly affect health. The Minister declined to answer with a simple yes or no, repeating an earlier position.
As reported on 13 February and 28 February, I cannot answer this question with a yes or no.
Zoals op 13 februari jl. 1 en op 28 februari jl. 2 gemeld kan ik op deze vraag niet met ja of nee antwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een overzicht van de functies of rollen die leden van het kabinet en het Koningshuis op dit moment vervullen bij het World Economic Forum

An FVD MP asked the cabinet for an overview of cabinet members' and the Royal House's roles at the World Economic Forum, and who has access to the 'Great Reset Portal'. The government listed the Minister of SZW's membership of the Jobs Consortium and the Queen's roles in the Edison Alliance and a now-dissolved board, and said the Great Reset portal no longer exists, with access previously held by three ministers.
The Minister of SZW is a member of the Jobs Consortium.
De Minister van SZW is lid van het Jobs Consortium
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over bouwvergunningen die de afgelopen jaren (versneld) zijn afgegeven aan (drink)waterbedrijven

An MP asked the minister for examples of building permits recently granted, possibly expedited, to drinking water companies under water-and-soil-guiding policy. The minister replied that no national overview exists because municipalities issue these permits, and that the policy affects them only indirectly, while noting drinking water interests may need greater weight in decisions on new sources.
There is no national overview of these environmental permits, because they are issued by municipalities.
Er is geen landelijk overzicht van deze omgevingsvergunningen, omdat ze worden uitgegeven door gemeenten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Duurzame Ontwikkelingsdoelen

An MP from FVD asked the minister what the non-binding political commitment to the SDGs means for the Netherlands, whether parliament explicitly approved it, whether it is a political obligation, and whether the government could unilaterally withdraw from it. The minister answered that it is a political commitment shared with all UN members via resolution 70/1, that parliament was informed in 2015 and discussed it, that annual and five-yearly reporting follows, and that the government and parliament decide how to follow up.
Ultimately, it is up to the government and parliament to decide how to follow up on this.
Het is uiteindelijk aan de regering en het parlement om te bepalen hoe hieraan opvolging wordt gegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over uitspraken van president Poetin waarin hij luidkeels en openlijk “filosofeert over een invasie van EU-landen”

An FVD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether Putin has openly speculated about invading EU countries and requested exact quotes with sources. The minister declined to comment on a social media post by another MP, said Russia's invasion of Ukraine shows Putin's willingness to use force, and did not provide any quotes, referring back to that answer.
It is not my role to interpret the post by MP Dassen.
Het is niet mijn rol om het bericht van het lid Dassen te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de KNMG-gedragscode

An MP asks the Minister of Health whether a doctor who publicly denies any link between climate change and health problems acts against the KNMG code of conduct, and asks for a simple yes or no. The minister does not give a yes or no, saying the code's rules are not absolute and may be departed from with justification, and that in principle doctors must follow the code including the climate-health link.
As indicated in the answer to question 1, deviation is possible, but such deviation will have to be well justified.
Zoals in het antwoord op vraag 1 aangegeven is afwijking wel mogelijk, maar deze afwijking zal dan goed onderbouwd moeten worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de SDG’s.

An MP asked whether the Netherlands is legally obliged to achieve the UN Sustainable Development Goals by 2030, and whether that is an obligation of effort or of result. The minister replied that the SDGs stem from a non-binding UN General Assembly resolution, a political commitment that creates no legal obligations.
Such a resolution of the UN General Assembly is a political commitment. It is not legally binding and therefore no legal obligations arise from it.
Een dergelijke resolutie van de Algemene Vergadering van de VN is een politiek commitment. Deze is niet juridisch bindend en er vloeien derhalve geen juridische verplichtingen uit voort.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de KNMG-gedragscode voor artsen

An MP asked whether a doctor publicly denying climate-health links or the harm of CO2 would breach the KNMG code and face action by the Inspectorate for Health and Youth Care (IGJ). The minister answered that the code applies to doctors' statements, that doctors must give correct information but retain freedom of expression, and that the IGJ acts only where statements pose a threat to public health, with discipline a matter for the disciplinary tribunal.
It is not for the IGJ to remove a doctor from the profession. It can initiate a disciplinary procedure, but the judgment on that rests with the disciplinary tribunal for health care.
Het is overigens niet aan de IGJ om een arts uit het beroep te zetten. Zij kan een tuchtprocedure inzetten, echter het oordeel hierover is aan het tuchtcollege voor de gezondheidszorg.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Zwitserse regering die het World Economic Forum, op basis van de Zwitserse 'Host State Act' (HSA), formeel erkent als een 'internationale organisatie'

The MP asks whether Switzerland formally recognised the World Economic Forum as an international organisation under its Host State Act, with immunity and tax privileges, and why the Prime Minister called the WEF a non-governmental organisation. The minister confirms the Swiss agreement (recognising the WEF as another international body, granting foundation status and direct federal tax exemption but no immunity), describes the WEF as an international NGO without political decision-making, and says the questions can be answered separately within three weeks.
No political decision-making takes place there.
Er vindt geen politieke besluitvorming plaats.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bericht 'Ziekenhuistop Maastricht declareert: privéchauffeurs en strandyoga in San Diego'

An FVD MP asked the health minister whether hospital board executives' expense claims (private drivers, a retreat in San Diego) are morally acceptable and whether an annual public overview of board declarations should be published. The minister answered that it is up to the supervisory board to judge individual conduct, that the MUMC+ board is reviewing its policy, and that declarations are already public under the Governance Code for hospitals, so no separate annual overview is planned.
It is not within my remit to publish an annual overview of this.
Het ligt niet op mijn weg hier een jaarlijks overzicht over te publiceren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bericht van Wouter Aukema geplaatst op 29 november 2023 op X

An MP asked the health minister whether the reported sharp rise in SGLT-2 inhibitor use since 2021, based on an X post by Wouter Aukema, is correct and why it occurs. The minister answered that the rise follows the 2021 extension of reimbursement conditions to high-risk diabetes and heart failure patients, supported by the NHG and NIV, and declined further research as no grounds were seen.
For now, an increase in use is in line with expectations after an extension of the conditions, and there are no indications that justify an investigation.
Vooralsnog ligt een stijging van het gebruik in de lijn der verwachting na een uitbreiding van de voorwaarden en zijn er geen aanwijzingen die een onderzoek rechtvaardigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over ‘Het gesprek met Klaus Schwab over kunstmatige intelligentie’ aan

An MP from FvD asked the Prime Minister why he and the government withhold substantive information about a 2023 informal meeting with Klaus Schwab (WEF) on artificial intelligence, who attended, and whether AI was linked to One Health, digital identity, biometric identification, CBDC or online information control. Rutte answered that the discussion was informal and focused on AI opportunities and risks, that One Health, digital ID, biometrics, CBDC and information control were not discussed, and that inviting people to parliament is for parliament itself to decide.
The conversation had an informal character and was intended to exchange views freely.
Het gesprek had een informeel karakter en was bedoeld om vrij met elkaar van gedachten te wisselen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Nederlandse vlag

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister whether the national flag is the most inclusive flag, whether government buildings may fly partisan flags such as pride or SDG flags, and whether such flags exclude many citizens. The government repeatedly answered that it is not for the Prime Minister to judge which flag is most inclusive, that flag rules for other flags are the responsibility of the relevant minister or local authorities, and that it will not speculate about ideological associations.
The flag instruction does not apply to other flags. There are no general statutory rules for flying other flags.
Voor andere vlaggen geldt de vlaginstructie niet. Er zijn geen algemene wettelijke regels voor het vlaggen met andere vlaggen.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een dagboekverslag van een patiënt

An MP asked whether patients are sometimes denied needed care because an insurer's budget ceiling has been reached, and whether that is acceptable. The minister answered that insurers have a statutory duty of care supervised by the NZa, so care must be available elsewhere, and that providers and insurers should communicate in advance; complaints go to the insurer and then SKGZ.
If a particular hospital has no capacity available or a budget ceiling has been reached, the health insurer must ensure that the care is available or reimbursed elsewhere.
Als er in een bepaald ziekenhuis geen capaciteit beschikbaar is of een budgetplafond bereikt is, moet de zorgverzekeraar ervoor zorgen dat de zorg elders beschikbaar is of vergoed wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Oekraïne

An MP asked the Defence Minister about remarks at the Warsaw Security Forum describing support for Ukraine as a very cheap way to keep Russia from threatening NATO, and about the phrase 'they are fighting this war, we are not fighting it'.
