The minister confirmed the statements, explained that Ukraine's war is vital for European security and that the Dutch contribution is modest relative to Ukraine's sacrifices, and identified 'they' as the Ukrainian armed forces and 'we' as Dutch military personnel.
The Netherlands and other allies are not a party to this war.
Nederland en andere bondgenoten zijn geen partij in deze oorlog.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een amendement op de Internationale Gezondheidsrichtlijnen van de Wereldgezondheidsorganisatie

An MP asked whether proposed WHO IHR amendments to delete 'non-binding' in Article 1 and to drop the explicit reference to human rights and fundamental freedoms in Article 2 (India's proposal) would make WHO advice binding. The minister answered that deleting 'non-binding' would not change the advisory nature of recommendations, that the Netherlands and EU oppose the change, and that India's proposal was not meant to disregard human rights and is expected to be withdrawn.
The European Union as well as the Netherlands follow this reasoning of the Review Committee and will continue to speak out against deleting the term 'non-binding' as indicated above.
De Europese Unie alsook Nederland volgt deze redenering van de Review Committee en zal zich blijven uitspreken tegen het schrappen van de term « niet-bindend » zoals hierboven aangegeven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het handelen volgens de coronarichtlijnen

An FVD MP asked the Minister of Health how many doctors the Health and Youth Care Inspectorate (IGJ) had contacted since 2020 for allegedly not following corona guidelines. The Minister answered that 21 doctors were approached about possible measures, and about 50 other healthcare workers were contacted over social media or media statements, about 70 in total without distinguishing doctors from other registered professionals.
No distinction was made in this between doctors and other BIG-registered professionals.
Daarin is geen onderscheid gemaakt tussen artsen en andere BIG-geregistreerden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd

An FvD MP asked the minister for sick-leave rates, staff turnover figures and the 2022 staff satisfaction survey of the Inspectorate for Health Care and Youth (IGJ). The minister provided five-year sick-leave and turnover tables and the top strengths and weaknesses from the survey, but declined to share the full survey report, saying staff were promised internal confidentiality.
When the survey was conducted, it was not stated that the results would be shared outside the organisation.
Bij de uitvraag van het MTO is niet aangegeven dat de uitkomsten gedeeld zouden worden buiten de organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bericht 'Stress en zenuwen maken eigenaar haringkraam Binnenhof kapot: ‘Met herseninfarct in ziekenhuis’'

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Interior about the owner of a herring stall near the Binnenhof whose business has suffered from renovation works, asking what happened to his objections, why his suggestions (distance of hoarding, walkway through the stall, transparent hoarding) were not adopted, and whether a viewing tower for tourists outweighs his wellbeing. The minister answered that consultation continues, that some suggestions were adopted (relocated entrance, transparent hoarding facing the stall), that further relocation is not possible for construction safety, and that the viewing tower is part of agreed measures to keep visitor numbers up.
At the request of Mr Buutveld, the construction hoardings placed opposite his stall will be made transparent.
Op verzoek van de heer Buutveld worden de bouwschuttingen die geplaatst worden tegenover zijn kraam transparant gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over dat de gemeentevlag, de provincievlag en de Nederlandse vlag alle inwoners van respectievelijk de gemeente, provincie en Nederland representeren

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister whether municipal, provincial and national flags represent all residents, whether government bodies may display other flags such as Pride and SDG flags, and whether such flags conflict with ideological neutrality. The Prime Minister answered that the flag instruction covers only the Dutch flag, that no general legal rules govern other flags (responsibility lies with ministers and local authorities), that government must be inclusive, and that Pride flags signal support for the LHBTIQ+ community.
There are no general legal rules for flying other flags.
Er zijn geen algemene wettelijke regels voor het vlaggen met andere vlaggen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het coronavirus

An MP from FvD asked the health minister about an Israeli cohort study claiming natural immunity protects better than BNT162b2 vaccination against Delta infection, and whether breakthrough infections were 13 times more likely among vaccinated people. The minister confirmed the translation but argued the study is outdated (2021, Delta and original-strain vaccine) and not representative of the current omicron situation, so it cannot support the conclusion; the questions were answered jointly.
No, this is not correct, because the study is not representative of the current situation.
Nee dit is niet correct, omdat de studie niet representatief is voor de huidige situatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de inzet van de door Nederland geleverde F-16 gevechtsvliegtuigen

An FvD MP asked whether the Netherlands, like Denmark, restricts how Ukraine may use the F-16s it supplies, including whether attacks on Russian territory are allowed. The minister answered that delivery depends on training, infrastructure, coalition coordination and US approval, that Ukraine must respect international humanitarian law and sign end-user declarations limiting use to self-defence, and that Parliament will be informed later about the timeline.
Your House will be informed in due course about the envisaged delivery timeline.
Uw Kamer wordt op termijn nader geïnformeerd over het beoogde tijdpad van levering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de levering van clustermunitie door de Verenigde Staten aan Oekraïne

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Netherlands, as a signatory to the Convention on Cluster Munitions, condemns the US supply of cluster munitions to Ukraine. The government confirmed the treaty is binding on the Netherlands and said it does not endorse Ukraine's use of cluster munitions while stressing Ukraine's right to self-defence, and that it discourages any use or transfer of such munitions.
Without approving Ukraine's use of cluster munitions, the cabinet emphasises that Ukraine is defending itself against ongoing Russian aggression, in line with Article 51 of the UN Charter.

Zonder de Oekraïense inzet van clustermunitie goed te keuren, hecht het kabinet eraan te benadrukken dat Oekraïne zich verdedigt tegen de voortdurende Russische agressie, in lijn met artikel 51 van het VN-Handvest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over accounts die mogelijk nepnieuws verspreiden

The MP asked the minister to share correspondence with Twitter about a 2020 request to review accounts spreading fake news about 5G and Covid-19. The minister shares the email, explains the context of arboning 112 risks from 5G arson, and stresses that Twitter alone decided whether to act, with some account names redacted for privacy.
I have redacted some of the reported account names for the privacy of the people behind those accounts.
Een aantal van de gemelde accountnamen heb ik omwille van de privacy van de mensen achter die accounts gelakt.
Antwoord op vragen van de lid Van Houwelingen over 'politieboot Pride 2023'

An FvD MP asked the Justice Minister whether police officers in uniform flying the rainbow Pride flag on a police boat at Amsterdam's 2023 Canal Parade conflicts with the constitutional principle of ideological neutrality of civil servants. The minister answered that the presence expresses that the police are for everyone, that uniforms follow ministerial rules, that Pride flags symbolise inclusion, and that the answers could not be given within three weeks.
Police participation in a Pride boat expresses that the police are there for everyone and that there is room within the police for everyone.
Het meevaren van de politie op een Pride -boot geeft uitdrukking aan het feit dat de politie er voor iedereen is en dat binnen de politie er ruimte voor iedereen is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerseboom en Van Houwelingen over het vrijgeven van alle documentatie met betrekking tot de omroep Ongehoord Nederland

Two FvD MPs asked the Minister for all government documents mentioning broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland since August 2022, including NPO correspondence, and asked for them before any debate on withdrawing its recognition. The Secretary of State confirmed the documents exist and will be released in one batch only after a final decision on the NPO's request to withdraw the provisional recognition.

I will release the requested documentation regarding Ongehoord Nederland at the moment I have taken a final decision on the NPO's request to withdraw the provisional recognition of Ongehoord Nederland.

Ik zal de gevraagde documentatie met betrekking tot Ongehoord Nederland vrijgeven op het moment dat ik een definitief besluit op het verzoek van de NPO tot intrekking van de voorlopige erkenning van Ongehoord Nederland heb genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over e-mailverkeer van en naar het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport dat onlangs is vrijgegeven

An MP from FvD asked the Ministers of VWS and BZK about released emails in which a VWS official suggested asking Twitter to block a person, whether the IGJ was involved because he is a BIG-registered care provider, and about Facebook and Twitter attending BZK meetings. The government answered that identifying details are withheld, the IGJ shared disinformation signals and advised formal reports where law might be broken, and that no official minutes of the meetings with social media platforms exist.
Data that could lead to the identifiability of a specific individual will not be made public.
Gegevens, die kunnen leiden tot herleidbaarheid van een specifiek individu, worden niet openbaar gemaakt.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over ‘brieven die professor Klaus Schwab heeft verzonden naar de premier’

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister whether the Chamber could receive the replies sent by or on behalf of him to four letters from Klaus Schwab (WEF). The Prime Minister answered yes and attached the formal and informal replies.
Yes, in the annex you will find the (in)formal replies sent by or on behalf of me to Mr Schwab or the WEF.
Ja, in de bijlage vindt u de (in)formele antwoorden die door of namens mij aan de heer Schwab of het WEF zijn gestuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Deense studie 'Batch-dependent safety of the BNT162b2 mRNA COVID-19 vaccine'

An MP asked the minister whether a Danish study showed vaccine adverse event reports varying by batch, and whether the Netherlands had studied this. The minister replied that the study does not show batch-related safety differences, citing its methodological limits, and that Lareb monitors batches without signals of difference, so no additional research is planned.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het informeren van de Kamer over de Bilderbergconferentie 2023 in Lissabon

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister whether he and Minister Kaag attended the 2023 Bilderberg conference on government authority and why the government refuses to disclose positions they put forward there, citing the Chatham House Rule. The Prime Minister answered that no government positions are tabled at the conference, that quoting publicly known views of Henry Kissinger is not a breach of the rule, and that the questions were answered separately, though late.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de verplichte arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering voor ZZP’ers

Van Houwelingen (FvD) asked about the mandatory disability insurance for self-employed workers: how many self-employed people are on welfare due to long-term disability, expected early inflow, why the waiting period became one year, the opt-out for private coverage, and the size of the solidarity levy. Minister Van Gennip answered that welfare data on self-employed people are not registered and will be investigated with CBS, that early inflow is expected to be high, that a one-year waiting period balances personal responsibility with income protection, that an opt-out is being designed with equivalent coverage, and that the levy amount depends on pending research.
It is currently not known how many self-employed people are on welfare.
Het is op dit moment niet bekend hoeveel zelfstandigen in de bijstand zitten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het openbaar maken van (de onderhandelingen over) de aanpassing van het aankoopcontract van de coronavaccins van BioNTech/Pfizer

An FvD MP asked the Health Minister why negotiations with BioNTech/Pfizer on amending the COVID vaccine purchase contract were held and why Parliament is only informed confidentially, and whether the process will be made public. The minister answered that the talks aimed at more flexibility in order volumes and delivery timing, and that EU-level confidentiality agreements and the contract's secrecy obligation prevent public disclosure of this commercially sensitive information, so Parliament is informed only confidentially.
For this reason, I can only inform your House confidentially about the process and content of the negotiations concerning the purchase contract with BioNTech/Pfizer.
Om deze reden kan ik uw Kamer alleen op vertrouwelijke wijze informeren over het proces en de inhoud van de onderhandelingen aangaande het aankoopcontract met BioNTech/Pfizer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het artikel 'De denktank van Rob de Wijk heeft een heldere visie op de wereld, maar is er ook transparantie in eigen huis?

An MP asked the Foreign Minister about transparency at The Hague Centre for Strategic Studies after a newspaper article, requesting the framework contract, tender documents, individual commissions since 2020, and secondments. The minister said the EUR 2 million per year framework contract is co-funded with Defence and is public via a WOO decision, listed smaller commissions since 2020, and stated no Foreign Affairs officials are seconded to HCSS.
The Programme of Requirements and the PROGRESS 2.0 framework contract can be found on open.overheid.nl; they were made public in a recent WOO decision.
Het Programma van Eisen en de raamovereenkomst van PROGRESS 2.0 zijn te vinden via open.overheid.nl, deze zijn in een recent WOO-besluit openbaar gemaakt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het gepubliceerde AIVD-rapport over 'anti-institutioneel-extremisme'

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Interior whether the AIVD has ever investigated an alleged 'malicious elite' mentioned in its anti-institutional extremism report, and whether a hypothetical foreign private organisation with close ties to cabinet and the royal house should be investigated. The minister confirmed the remark, said the AIVD sees no indication of such a malicious elite, and declined to comment on the hypothetical, saying no threat to national security is apparent.
The AIVD does not go further into hypothetical examples.
De AIVD gaat verder niet in op hypothetische voorbeelden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over het debatcentrum de Balie

An FvD MP asked the Culture minister about the Ministry's funding relationship with debate centre De Balie, a Russian tank exhibit, a director's assault on a journalist, and whether the subsidy should be reconsidered. The state secretary confirmed BIS subsidies and COVID support, called programming and the director's conduct matters for others to assess (the Raad voor Cultuur and the supervisory board), and declined to reconsider the subsidy relationship.
It is not for me to assess the programming of a cultural institution.
Het is niet aan mij om de programmering van een culturele instelling te beoordelen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over kwalificaties van een journalist door een woordvoerder van het ministerie van Defensie

An MP asked the Defence Minister whether a Defence ministry spokesperson was right to describe a Telegraaf journalist as a 'nasty agitator' who spreads hatred, and whether this harms press functioning and fits civil service rules. The minister answered that the official posted in a personal capacity on social media, which civil servants may do under the Ambtenarenwet, that the official is a civil servant and the remark was personal, and declined to give a personal view on the journalist.

Civil servants have, under the Civil Servants Act 2017, the right to express themselves on social media as long as this, in short, does not impede the proper performance of their duties or the proper functioning of the public service.

Ambtenaren hebben op basis van de Ambtenarenwet 2017 het recht zich op social media te uiten zolang dit, kortgezegd, niet in de weg staat aan de goede vervulling van hun functie of de goede functionering van de openbare dienst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Wet publieke gezondheid

An FvD MP asked the health minister whether he knows of two recent podcast discussions criticising the Public Health Act, whether he recognises public unrest over it, and whether he will reflect on critics' concerns and engage their experts in debate. The minister says he noted the discussions, sees only understandable critical voices rather than widespread unrest, and states the concerns were already thoroughly debated during the bill's passage, without committing to new action.
The topics you mention were already discussed extensively and carefully during the passage of the bill, first in the House of Representatives and then in the Senate.
De door u genoemde onderwerpen zijn reeds gedurende de wetsbehandeling uitvoerig en zorgvuldig achtereenvolgens in de Tweede Kamer en de Eerste Kamer aan de orde geweest.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Volkskrant artikel omtrent HCSS, met als titel 'De denktank van Rob de Wijk heeft een heldere visie op de wereld, maar is er ook transparantie in eigen huis?'

Member Van Houwelingen (FvD) asked the Minister of Defence about a Volkskrant article on HCSS's transparency, requesting an overview of all Defence contracts awarded to HCSS since 2020 and the number of seconded Defence staff. The Minister confirmed a full overview: PROGRESS framework research with BZ, separate Defence research contracts with confidential offers withheld, and one Defence employee currently seconded to HCSS.
The underlying tenders and contracts cannot be shared because they contain business-confidential or commercially confidential information.
De onderliggende offertes en contracten kunnen niet worden gedeeld omdat daar of bedrijfsvertrouwelijke- of commercieel vertrouwelijke gegevens in staan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Bilderbergconferentie in Lissabon

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister about their attendance at the 2023 Bilderberg conference in Lisbon, including whether they attended in a personal capacity, why travel costs were borne by the state, and whether the Chamber could receive the invitations and a summary of positions put forward. The government confirmed both attended, that invitations would not be made public like other diplomatic correspondence, that costs are publicly disclosed under the travel-cost regulation, and that the conference is informal under Chatham House Rules with no summary of positions provided, referring to the conference website.
These invitations will, as is usual with diplomatic correspondence with other states or international organisations, not be made public.
Deze uitnodigingen zullen, net als gebruikelijk met diplomatieke correspondentie met andere staten of internationale organisaties, niet openbaar worden gemaakt.
Vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over AIVD

The MP asked whether the AIVD's reported violent 'anti-institutional extremists' have led to prosecutions or convictions, and why the cases were not sent to parliament if they are public. The minister answered that the AIVD does not comment publicly on individual cases, described the threat of the 'malicious elite' narrative in general terms, and cited one foiled assassination plot against then-prime minister Rutte as an example.
As is known, the AIVD does not make public statements about casuistry regarding persons or organisations under investigation.
Zoals bekend, doet de AIVD geen uitspraken in het openbaar over casuïstiek omtrent personen of organisaties die in onderzoek zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het artikel 'Twee jaar wachttijd maakt 'verplichte AOV' uitvoerbaar en betaalbaar'

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether a self-organised cooperative of freelancers (SharePeople) shows that self-employed people can insure long-term disability without an insurer, and whether the minister will revisit her opposition to motion Van Houwelingen. The minister acknowledges private initiatives and says they can serve as an opt-out vehicle only if they match the public insurance premium and coverage, but argues non-insurers cannot reliably meet such long-term obligations, so she maintains her advice against the motion.
Therefore I consider it unlikely that a non-insurer can sufficiently reliably meet such long-term obligations.
Daardoor acht ik het onwaarschijnlijk dat een niet-verzekeraar dergelijke langjarige verplichtingen voldoende zeker kan nakomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over betalingen aan de Rutgers Stichting.

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how much the ministry paid the Rutgers Stichting between 2016 and 2022 and for what services. The minister answered that an exact overview of individual payments could not be produced, that at least €305,110 was transferred, and described payments for WODC research and for behavioural interventions such as So-Cool.
It has not proven possible to obtain an exact overview of all individual payments from the systems for this period.
Het is niet mogelijk gebleken om over deze periode een exact overzicht van alle individuele betalingen uit de systemen te halen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over volumenormen voor kinderhartchirurgiecentra

An FvD MP asks the minister whether the Kansy et al. 2015 study on paediatric heart surgery volume supports the claim that larger centres give safer care, and questions the minister's decision to close two of four centres under volume norms. The minister answers that the professional body's analysis of the wider literature supports a norm of about 300 operations, that the single study cited does not show the lower-volume conclusion the MP draws, and that the questions are answered in writing.
I align myself with the analysis the professional group makes of this article in the vision document, in conjunction with the other relevant scientific literature.
Antwoord 2 Ik sluit mij aan bij de analyse die door de beroepsgroep in het visiedocument 1 over dit artikel, in samenhang met de andere relevante wetenschappelijke literatuur, wordt gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de tweet 'Wat zóu het helpen als dit soort kwaadaardigheid geen podium meer zou krijgen'

An FvD MP asked Minister De Jonge whether his tweet calling for a critical Telegraaf journalist to be denied a platform meant he wanted her dismissed or cancelled, and whether this was government policy given press freedom. The minister denied calling for dismissal, said he was urging responsibility in public speech, and affirmed press freedom is untouchable.
I want to emphasise that in the tweet, as you can read, I did not call for the dismissal of a journalist.
Ik wil benadrukken dat ik in de tweet, zoals u kunt lezen, niet heb opgeroepen tot het ontslag van een journaliste.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een mogelijk verband tussen vaccinaties en de hoge sterfte

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about ZonMw's delayed handling of Professor Meester's objection to rejection of a study on a possible link between vaccination and excess mortality, and whether other ZonMw-funded studies examine this link. The Minister answered that ZonMw exceeded the legal deadline due to consultation and internal sign-off, that the decision was issued on 7 April 2023 with the rejection unchanged but better motivated, that such delays occur incidentally, and that six of nine funded excess-mortality studies examine a vaccination link.
I note that this is a matter for ZonMw itself.
Ik merk op dat dit een kwestie is van ZonMw zelf.
Antwoorden op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over voorbeelden van gewelddadige uitwassen,

An FvD MP asked the Interior Minister to confirm an AIVD annual report sentence describing a limited number of violent excesses by anti-institutional extremists, and to give concrete examples leading to prosecutions. The minister confirmed the sentence but declined to give examples, saying the AIVD does not comment publicly on such matters and its wording reflects its investigative mandate.
As is known, the AIVD does not make public statements about this.
Zoals bekend doet de AIVD hier in het openbaar geen uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de effectiviteit en de bijwerkingen van de (mRNA-)coronavaccins

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Health about the effectiveness and side effects of mRNA COVID-19 vaccines, including claims by US senator Rand Paul, the interpretation of a Tuvali et al. study, the benefit-risk balance, and number-needed-to-vaccinate estimates. The Minister rejected the claims that vaccines harm public health, cited studies showing SARS-CoV-2 infection carries higher myocarditis risk than vaccination, gave NNV references and RIVM hospitalisation estimates, and declined to commission new studies on serious adverse event rates.
I do not have such an estimate and see no reason to commission specific additional research into it.
Ik beschik niet over een dergelijke schatting en zie geen aanleiding om hier gericht aanvullend onderzoek naar te laten doen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de reactie op het verzoek van de vaste Kamercommissie voor Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over de veiligheid van mRNA-vaccins en de bevoegdheden van de Wereldgezondh

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Health about mRNA vaccine safety, citing case reports and studies on persistent spike protein, mRNA biodistribution, IgG4 class switching and repeated booster doses, and questions the minister's earlier claims. The minister maintains that the case reports do not show uncontrolled antigen production, that the vaccines were adequately assessed, and that repeated boosters pose no evident additional safety risk, while acknowledging that further research is needed.
From the report referred to, it cannot be concluded that uncontrolled antigen production occurs after vaccination.
Uit het rapport waarnaar verwezen wordt, kan niet geconcludeerd worden dat er ongecontroleerde antigeenproductie optreedt na vaccinatie.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over documenten in het kader van het Digital Currency Governance Consortium

An MP asked the Minister of Finance for all written documents from the past three years concerning the World Economic Forum and the Ministry of Finance in relation to the Digital Currency Governance Consortium. The Minister replied that the only documents are an advice on Queen Máxima's participation as UN special advocate in the consortium's steering group and talking points for one meeting, and that these will not be shared because ministerial deliberation with the Queen and internal documents of an international organisation must remain confidential.
In line with established policy on this matter, the cabinet will not share the relevant documents with your House.
Conform het staande beleid hieromtrent zal het kabinet de betreffende documenten niet met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitgaven van het ministerie aan ‘anonieme bedrijven’

The MP asks why the Justice ministry's spending on 'anonymous companies' rose sharply from about 210 thousand euro in 2018 to about 238 million euro in 2021. The minister confirms the figures and attributes the rise to the GDPR, which led payments to identifiable individuals such as interpreters and experts to be published as anonymous from mid-2018.
After the introduction of the GDPR in mid-2018, all procurement spending on identifiable persons was published as 'anonymous'.
Na de invoering van de AVG, medio 2018, zijn alle inkoopuitgaven aan herkenbare personen als «anoniem» gepubliceerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kerseboom en Van Houwelingen over de houding van Nederland wat betreft Europese strategische autonomie ten opzichte van de Verenigde Staten

Two FvD MPs asked the Foreign Minister to define 'strategic autonomy' and state Dutch and EU positions relative to the United States, including reactions to remarks by Rutte, Macron and Michel. The minister gave a substantive but largely policy-restating reply, defining open strategic autonomy as an EU concept, stressing continued NATO and US cooperation, and declining to interpret the remarks of other leaders.
The cabinet is not in a position to further interpret the statements made by the President of the European Council.
Het kabinet is niet in de positie om deze door de voorzitter van de Europese Raad gedane uitspraken nader te duiden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de macro-financiële bijstand van Moldavië

An MP from FvD asked the Finance Minister whether the EU-level case for macro-financial assistance to Moldova is justified and whether IMF support is sufficient, asking seven questions. The Minister answered that EU-level assistance is more efficient than separate member-state aid, that the IMF programme does not cover the full financing gap, and that the EU's additional support is therefore needed.

The Commission can borrow more cheaply than most member states individually, and administrative burdens on the Moldovan authorities are limited as much as possible because they deal with only one party (the European Commission).
De Commissie kan namelijk goedkoper lenen dan de meeste lidstaten afzonderlijk en daarnaast worden de administratieve lasten voor de Moldavische autoriteiten zo veel mogelijk beperkt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over communicatie tussen Nederlandse ministeries

An MP asked whether the cabinet would release all communications between Dutch ministries and Twitter from June 2019 to September 2022. The minister answered that no integrated overview exists, listed the contacts found (mostly on account verification, privacy, hacked accounts and features), and did not release the full communications.
There is no integrated overview of contact between Twitter and the ministries, even within the ministries.
Er bestaat, ook binnen de ministeries, geen integraal overzicht van contact tussen Twitter en ministeries.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de training door de Europese Unie van het Oekraïense leger

An MP asked whether the EU trains the Ukrainian army, whether there is or will be a European army, and whether the Dutch army is involved in training. The ministers answered that no European army is being formed, that EU missions use contributions from member states, and that the Netherlands has contributed to training Ukrainian soldiers via EUMAM since its creation in late 2022.
There is no question of forming a European army.
Er is geen sprake van de vorming van een Europees Leger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitspraak dat (ook) de politie bij sociale mediabedrijven de status heeft van ‘trusted flagger’

An MP asked the Justice Minister why police records of 'trusted flagger' notices sent to social media companies since 2020 cannot be retrieved for parliament, and whether this conflicts with the Archiving Act and Open Government Act. The minister answered that no legal duty currently requires police to register these notices retrievably, sees no reason to impose one, and pointed to upcoming EU Digital Services Act reporting obligations for platforms.
At this moment I see no reason to oblige the police to ensure that the requested data can easily be extracted from its systems.
Op dit moment zie ik geen reden om politie te verplichten ervoor te zorgen dat de gevraagde gegevens eenvoudig uit haar systemen kunnen worden gehaald.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over de toestemmingsprocedure

An MP asked why the Ministry of Health did not make the research purpose in the consent procedure more concrete, despite advice from the Dutch Data Protection Authority. The minister answered that the advice concerned vaccination data sharing with the RIVM, that the research purpose was later specified in the RIVM privacy statement, and that identifiable data would require individual consent from researchers.
The AP advised to formulate that purpose more concretely.
De AP adviseerde om dat doel concreter te verwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een mogelijke oorzakelijke relatie tussen de (mRNA-)coronavaccins en de oversterfte in Nederland

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Health whether a scientific study exists or is underway on a possible causal link between mRNA COVID-19 vaccines and excess mortality in the Netherlands. The minister pointed to a CBS/RIVM study finding no signs of increased risk of non-COVID death shortly after vaccination, and to ongoing ZonMW-funded research on vaccination and excess mortality.
I informed your House on 22 June about the results of the study by Statistics Netherlands (CBS) and RIVM into excess mortality in 2020 and 2021.
Ik heb uw Kamer op 22 juni jl. 1 geïnformeerd over de resultaten van het onderzoek van het Centraal Bureau voor de Statistiek (CBS) en het RIVM naar oversterfte in 2020 en 2021.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over het World Economic Forum

An MP asked the Minister of Health for all written documents of the past three years concerning the World Economic Forum and its cooperation with the ministry, specifically on the Global Coalition for Value in Healthcare. The minister sent documents but anonymised them, citing WEF consent and Swiss data protection rules barring release of personal and confidential business data.
To make the requested data public I had to ask the WEF for permission, because the meeting documents were shared confidentially.
Voor het openbaar maken van de gevraagde gegevens heb ik toestemming moeten vragen aan het WEF, omdat de vergaderstukken vertrouwelijk zijn gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de studie 'Past SARS-CoV-2 infection protection against re-infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis'

An MP asks the health minister how to read Figure 4 of a Lancet meta-analysis on protection from past SARS-CoV-2 infection versus vaccination, and whether the government still stands by its 2021 statement that superiority of natural immunity is unknown. The minister answers that prior infection gives at least comparable protection against reinfection but that protection against omicron is lower after pre-omicron infection, so it cannot yet be said with certainty whether infection protects better than vaccination against new variants.
As a result, it cannot currently be said with certainty whether prior infection protects better against new variants of the virus than vaccination does.
Hierdoor kan op dit moment niet met zekerheid worden gezegd of een eerdere infectie beter beschermt tegen nieuwe varianten van het virus dan vaccinatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitspraak dat (ook) de politie bij sociale mediabedrijven de status heeft van ‘trusted flagger’

Van Houwelingen asked the Justice Minister whether the police holds 'trusted flagger' status with social media companies and for all notices the police sent in that capacity since 2020. The minister confirmed awareness of the statement and said the police does not record the requested information in a retrievable way, pointing to a forthcoming public-private framework for reporting harmful content.
the police does not record the requested information in such a way that it can be retrieved from police systems.
registreert de politie de gevraagde informatie niet op zodanige wijze dat de informatie uit de politiesystemen gehaald kan worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over overlijdens met de diagnose corona

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health whether CBS figures showing 8,415 deaths with a corona diagnosis versus 1,589 excess deaths in Q1 2021 are correct, and whether most previously non-COVID deaths now carry that diagnosis. The minister confirmed the figures, explained that excess deaths are measured against expected deaths so COVID deaths can exceed excess deaths, and denied that causes of death are later reclassified.
Causes of death are established at the time of death and are not adjusted later.
Doodsoorzaken worden bij overlijden vastgesteld en niet later aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over cijfers volgens het Coronadashboard

The MP asked the Minister of Health how many of the 399 hospital patients and 25 ICU patients on the Coronadashboard on 17 February 2023 were unvaccinated, and to send these numbers within a week. The minister answered that the dashboard counts occupied beds, not patients, so vaccination status is unavailable, referred to the monthly RIVM report, and said the requested numbers could not be sent within a week.
This is not data at patient level (it concerns beds, not persons), so there is no information on vaccination status.
Dit is geen data op patiëntniveau (het gaat immers over bedden, niet over personen), waardoor er geen informatie over de vaccinatiestatus is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de opmerkingen van de Duitse minister van Buitenlandse Zaken, ’we are fighting a war against Russia’’ en ‘’We can fight this war only together’

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether German minister Baerbock's remarks that 'we are fighting a war against Russia' mean the Netherlands is at war with Russia, and how article 96 of the Constitution is safeguarded if the conflict escalates. The minister answered that neither Germany, NATO nor the Netherlands is a party to the armed conflict, that the Netherlands supports Ukraine at its request, and that the cabinet respects the Constitution.
No, the Netherlands is not a party to the armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine.
Nee, Nederland is geen partij bij het gewapend conflict tussen Rusland en Oekraïne.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de aanslag op de Nord Stream pijpleidingen

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the government itself holds evidence or indications about who may be responsible for the Nord Stream pipeline attack, and if so, whether and when it will share this with the House. The government replied that it is awaiting the outcomes of the German, Danish and Swedish investigations, will share information in a timely and complete manner, but will not comment publicly on intelligence services' knowledge, methods or sources.
Regarding the level of knowledge, the working methods or the sources of the Intelligence and Security Services, the cabinet, as you know, makes no public statements.
Over het kennisniveau, de werkwijze of de bronnen van de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten doet het kabinet, zoals bij u bekend, in het openbaar geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over communicatie tussen de NCTV en het bestuur van de NPO inzake de omroep Ongehoord Nederland

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security for all communication from February 2022 to February 2023 between the NCTV and the NPO board about broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland. The Minister answered that, as far as she knows, no such communication took place.

As far as I am aware, no communication took place between the National Coordinator for Counterterrorism and Security and the board of the Dutch Public Broadcaster about the broadcaster Ongehoord Nederland.

Er heeft, voor zover mij bekend, geen communicatie plaatsgevonden tussen de Nationaal Coördinator Terrorismebestrijding en Veiligheid en het bestuur van de Nederlandse Publieke Omroep over de omroep Ongehoord Nederland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de bewering dat “Oekraïne de facto een lid van de NAVO is”

An FvD MP asked the Defence Minister whether she agrees with Ukraine's claim that it is de facto a NATO member, and whether Russia could lawfully attack military material transported through Dutch ports to Ukraine. The government answered that Ukraine is not a NATO member and can only join with unanimous approval of allies, and that international law gives Russia no justification for attacking Dutch territory even if military equipment bound for Ukraine is present there.
Ukraine is not a member of NATO and can only become a member once a membership application has been approved by all NATO allies.
Oekraïne is geen lid van de NAVO en kan pas lid worden van de NAVO wanneer een lidmaatschapsvraag is goedgekeurd door alle NAVO-bondgenoten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de aanslag op de Nord Stream pijpleidingen

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether, given a Seymour Hersh report, the government considers US involvement in the Nord Stream sabotage plausible, and whether the US should withdraw from the ongoing investigation. The minister declined to speculate, pointing to the Swedish, Danish and German investigations, which are responsible for the inquiry.
The cabinet does not speculate on the cause of the explosions at the Nord Stream 1 and 2 pipelines and awaits the results of the investigation by the Swedish, Danish and German authorities.
Het kabinet speculeert niet over de toedracht van de explosies bij de Nord Stream 1 en 2 pijpleidingen en wacht de resultaten af van het onderzoek van de Zweedse, Deense en Duitse autoriteiten
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over myocarditis

An MP from the FvD asked the Minister of Health to justify the claimed scientific consensus that myocarditis risk is much higher after SARS-CoV-2 infection than after vaccination, questioning whether it rests on a 2020 two-page letter and how it squares with a 2022 Israeli study finding no increased myocarditis after infection. The Minister maintains the consensus rests on many studies rather than one source, and that the Israeli study compares infected with uninfected people, which does not contradict the consensus.
The conclusion that the risk of myocarditis is considerably higher after SARS-CoV-2 infection than after vaccination is not based on a single source, but on many scientific studies on this subject.
De conclusie dat de kans op myocarditis aanzienlijk hoger is na infectie met SARS-CoV2 dan na een vaccinatie is niet gebaseerd op één bron, maar op vele wetenschappelijke studies naar dit onderwerp.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over ‘Het World Economic Forum (WEF)’

An MP asked the Prime Minister whether he spoke at the World Economic Forum in Davos in January 2023 and, if so, asked for the text of his speech. The Prime Minister confirmed participation in three panel discussions, all livestreamed and available on YouTube, and referred to those recordings instead of providing a speech text.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de vraag of er een correlatie bestaat tussen vaccinatiecampagnes en oversterfte

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health whether a significant positive correlation between COVID-19 vaccination campaigns and excess mortality exists, citing blog posts and YouTube videos by Schetters and Meester, and asked whether the minister is worried about a causal link. The minister answered that the sources are not scientific publications, stressed the difference between correlation and causation, pointed to CBS/RIVM excess-mortality research and Lareb monitoring showing no raised death risk, and referred to planned independent research; question 6 was not answered separately.
Only when a causal link has been demonstrated can one speak of a cause-and-effect relationship.
Pas wanneer een causaal verband is aangetoond kan men spreken van een oorzaak-gevolg relatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Wob-besluit Data Protection Impact Assessment (DPIA)

An MP asked the Minister of Health about an error in the CBS DPIA on excess mortality research, specifically whether deceased persons and unvaccinated persons are excluded from the study, which would impair the control group. The Minister answered that the wording was an error, that both groups are included in other datasets in the secure CBS environment, and that CBS and RIVM will amend the passage.
CBS and RIVM have indicated that they will amend this passage in the DPIA.
Het CBS en het RIVM hebben aangegeven deze passage in de DPIA aan te zullen passen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een digitaal reisdocument en digitale gezichtsherkenning

An MP asked whether the new EU digital travel credential pilot with facial recognition is a continuation of the earlier KTDI pilot involving the World Economic Forum, KLM and the Canadian government, and about the WEF's role. The Secretary of State answered that the DTC pilot is not a continuation of KTDI, differs in technology and partners, and that the WEF is not involved.
The DTC pilot now announced is not a continuation of the KTDI pilot.
De nu aangekondigde DTC-pilot is geen voortzetting van de KTDI-pilot.
Antwoord op vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over betalingen aan de heer Johan Vollenbroek (voorzitter van Mobilisation for the Environment)

An FvD MP asked whether Johan Vollenbroek, chair of Mobilisation for the Environment, was paid by the ministry for advice, including on a 'goat path' for construction. The minister answered that Vollenbroek was not paid, that he sent an unsolicited letter advising a building exemption based on an ADC-test, which the minister considered and decided against, and described further measures on nitrogen permitting.
No, Mr Vollenbroek was not paid for his advice.
Nee, de heer Vollenbroek heeft niet betaald gekregen voor zijn advies.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security which 'partners' were referred to as sources for the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57. The Minister answered that sources include intelligence services, police, open sources, foreign partners and embassy analyses, and repeated that no internet monitoring was used.

As stated in the answer to the parliamentary questions from MP Van Houwelingen (FvD) about the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57 dated 14 December 2022, the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland is based on information from the intelligence and security services and the police, open source information (including media and scientific sources), information from foreign partners and analyses by embassy staff.

Zoals gesteld in de beantwoording van de Kamervragen van het lid Van Houwelingen (FvD) over het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57 d.d. 14 december 2022, is het Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland gebaseerd op informatie van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten en van de politie, open bronneninformatie (waaronder media en wetenschappelijke bronnen), informatie van buitenlandse partners en analyses van ambassadepersoneel.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de studie 'Autopsy-based histopathological characterization of myocarditis after anti-SARS-CoV-2-vaccination'

The MP asked the minister about an autopsy study on mRNA-vaccine myocarditis, including whether a translation was accurate and whether the minister accepts the conclusion that vaccine myocarditis can be fatal. The minister confirmed the translation, noted the study cannot establish causation or frequency, and stated that the benefits of vaccination outweigh the small risk, pointing to ongoing monitoring by Lareb and the CBG.
The study shows that autopsy examinations of four of the examined persons found myocarditis to be the most likely cause of death.
Het onderzoek laat zien dat uit autopsie-onderzoeken bij vier van de onderzochte personen is gebleken dat myocarditis de meest waarschijnlijke doodsoorzaak is
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over het World Economic Forum

Van Houwelingen (FvD) asked how many Dutch civil servants have a @weforum.org email account. The minister answers that one civil servant has such an account, on secondment for the Global Coordinating Secretariat for the Food Innovation Hubs, and refers to a parallel answer from the Minister of Economic Affairs.
There is one civil servant with a personal email account with the extension @weforum.org, in the context of a secondment to staff the Global Coordinating Secretariat for the Food Innovation Hubs.

Er is een rijksambtenaar met de beschikking over een eigen mailaccount met de extensie «@weforum.org», in het kader van een detachering voor de invulling van het Global Coordinating Secretariat voor de Food Innovation Hubs.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57

An FvD MP asked whether the Minister knows a sentence from the Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 57 describing right-wing extremists as an amorphous group blending unclear ideas with personal grievances and psychological problems, and whether underlying analyses exist and can be shared. The Minister confirmed knowing the sentence, said the assessment is based on a shared view of NCTV and partners drawn from current casuistry, and declined to share the underlying analyses, citing risk to national security and investigative methods.
Further disclosure would give too much insight into the investigative methods of these partners.
Verdere inzage geeft teveel kijk in de onderzoeksmethodiek van deze partners.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de acute zorg

The MP asks the minister for five years of call counts from the six ProQA ambulance dispatch centres, broken down by year and by the 32 main complaint protocols. The minister answers that the data has been requested from Ambulancezorg Nederland but cannot be delivered before the Christmas recess because the LMS is still transitioning systems and one centre's data is missing; the data is promised for January.
Unfortunately, retrieving the data takes more time than was initially anticipated.
Helaas vraagt het ophalen van de data meer tijd dan op voorhand werd voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Sectorkompas Ambulancezorg 2021

Van Houwelingen (FvD) asked the minister whether he knew of the 2021 Sectorkompas Ambulancezorg and why rapid and first responder deployments rose sharply in 2021. Minister Kuipers answered yes, gave the deployment figures for 2017-2021, and explained the rise through care differentiation, new solo PA/VS roles, GP home-visit pilots, and more RAV data submissions and HartslagNu, having asked Ambulancezorg Nederland to explain the trends.
I asked Ambulancezorg Nederland (AZN) to explain the developments.
Ik heb aan Ambulancezorg Nederland (AZN) gevraagd om de ontwikkelingen te verklaren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over geavanceerde atoombommen op de vliegbasis Volkel

An FvD MP asked the Defence Minister whether new, advanced US nuclear bombs would be stationed at Volkel air base, how many and what type, and whether the Netherlands should oppose nuclear deployment and Ukraine arms supplies. The government declined to confirm numbers or locations for security reasons, pointed to the ongoing US B61 life-extension programme, and defended NATO's nuclear deterrence and continued support for Ukraine.
As the House is aware, under allied and legally binding agreements no statements can be made about the numbers and locations of US nuclear weapons present in Europe.

Zoals uw Kamer bekend, kunnen op grond van bondgenootschappelijke en juridisch bindende afspraken geen mededelingen worden gedaan over aantallen en locaties van in Europa aanwezige Amerikaanse kernwapens.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een besluit op Wob-verzoeken op 7 november 2022

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a July 2021 email from a civil servant using a World Economic Forum address, and about secondment, email archiving and staffing of a WEF food innovation hub project. The minister confirmed the facts, pointed to an earlier letter for the secondment details, and said WEF-domain email is outside government archives and not requestable under Woo or Article 68 of the Constitution, except in limited cases.
Email traffic between @weforum.org addresses falls outside the archives the cabinet manages because this email traffic concerns an external organisation.
Mailverkeer tussen @weforum.org-mailadressen vallen buiten de archieven die het kabinet beheert omdat dit mailverkeer betreft van een externe organisatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een ‘speciale portal’ bij techbedrijven

An MP asked whether the Dutch state has access to a special 'portal' at tech companies for flagging disinformation, as reported for the Biden administration, and whether the state keeps contact with these companies. The minister answered that BZK has no access to such a Content Request System but holds trusted flagger status at Meta, Google, Twitter, TikTok and Snapchat, used sparingly and only around elections, and that the ministry maintains contact with these companies in various ways.
The Ministry of BZK does not have access to a Content Request System as described in the articles in the appendices.
Het Ministerie van BZK heeft geen toegang tot een Content Request System zoals beschreven in de artikelen in de bijlagen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de ‘escalatie kanalen’ en het ‘desinformatieteam BZK’ naar aanleiding van een Wob-verzoek

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Interior about the government's 'trusted flagger' escalation channels with Facebook, Google and Twitter, their use, and how the disinformation team distinguishes deliberate from unintentional misleading information. The Minister answered that BZK uses trusted flagger status sparingly around elections, has made few reports, cannot order content removal, does not itself establish intent, and attached the requested correspondence.
The ministry has no authority through these channels to have particular content removed.
Het ministerie heeft via deze kanalen geen bevoegdheid bepaalde content te laten verwijderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het WEF

An MP asked the minister whether the Dutch Permanent Representation in Geneva acts as intermediary for other private foreign foundations besides the World Economic Forum, and asked for all communication from 2020 onward about inviting and supporting ministerial visits to the WEF. The minister listed other Geneva-based organisations the Permanent Representation serves as first contact for, and pointed to earlier answers and the invitations for the January 2023 Davos meeting attached as an annex.
Necessary information has already been shared with the House in response to earlier requests regarding recent participation of Dutch ministers in past annual meetings of the World Economic Forum.

Er is in reactie op eerdere verzoeken al de nodige informatie met de Kamer gedeeld inzake recente deelname van Nederlandse bewindspersonen aan eerdere jaarlijkse vergaderingen van het World Economic Forum
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de dieselprijs

An FvD MP asked the government whether diesel is now more expensive than petrol, whether the lower historic diesel price explains higher motor vehicle tax on diesel cars, and whether diesel drivers will be compensated for high diesel prices. The State Secretary confirmed diesel is more expensive, denied that motor vehicle tax compensates for lower diesel excise, and pointed to the Belastingplan 2023 package of energy-price measures including excise cuts until 2024.
It is not correct that the low diesel price is compensated by the motor vehicle tax (mrb) on diesel vehicles.
Het klopt niet dat de lage dieselprijs wordt gecompenseerd door de motorrijtuigenbelasting (mrb) voor dieselvoertuigen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bericht “Maxima: digitaal geld via centrale banken kan veel voordelen hebben.”

An MP asked the government about a news report on Queen Máxima's views on digital central bank money, whether such money is politically contested, and whether political statements by royals fit the constitutional role of the Crown. The minister confirmed awareness, described the Dutch parliament's critical-constructive stance on a digital euro and the EU legislative route, and answered the royal question only by noting ministerial responsibility for royal family members.
The cabinet characterises the general Dutch position as constructive-critical.
Het kabinet kwalificeert de algemene Nederlandse houding hiermee als constructief-kritisch.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het artikel dat de inlichtingendiensten AIVD en MIVD journalisten ronselen

An MP asked whether the AIVD and MIVD recruit journalists, both abroad and in the Netherlands, and whether they may pay journalists, provide them information, or give them favours in return. The minister rejected the word 'recruit', said cooperation with sources is voluntary, confirmed the services may approach anyone including journalists and may give background interviews, and said any payment to sources is possible but not aimed at influencing public opinion, with oversight by the CTIVD.
Publicly, I cannot go into the sources and methods of the AIVD and MIVD.
In het openbaar kan ik niet ingaan op de bronnen en werkwijze van de AIVD en de MIVD.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het World Economic Forum (WEF)

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Finance whether the cabinet ignores World Economic Forum letters and invitations, and whether answers were sent to the WEF. The minister replied that invitations were answered via the Permanent Representation in Geneva rather than directly, and that the communication with the PV can be requested.
Invitations from the WEF were not answered directly to the WEF organisation. This went through the Permanent Representation (PV) of the Netherlands in Geneva.
Uitnodigingen van het WEF zijn niet rechtstreeks beantwoord aan de organisatie van het WEF. Dit verliep via de Permanente Vertegenwoordiging (PV) van Nederland te Genève.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de recente aanslag op Nord Stream 1 en 2

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister about the sabotage of Nord Stream 1 and 2, including possible state actors, Russia's ability to cut gas, and remarks by Sikorski and Biden. The minister declined to speculate on perpetrators while the Swedish, Danish and German investigation is ongoing, and said Nord Stream was not in use so the sabotage had no direct effect on EU supply security.
While this investigation is ongoing, I do not wish to speculate about possible perpetrators or stakeholders.
Lopende dit onderzoek wil ik niet speculeren over mogelijke daders of belanghebbenden.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over het onderzoek naar de (oorzaak van de) oversterfte

An MP asked the Minister of Health for correspondence between RIVM and CBS about their joint study into the causes of excess mortality. The minister answered yes and attached the correspondence, which is also available for inspection at the Tweede Kamer information point.
Yes. The requested correspondence is attached to this letter.
Ja. De verzochte correspondentie is bij deze brief gevoegd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over content op websites

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security how often police contacted companies such as Twitter about criminal or terms-violating content, which companies were approached, how Twitter responded, and related questions. The minister answered that police do not contact companies to have accounts removed, may notify companies in self-regulation (leaving assessment to the company), that police keep no records retrievable in the requested form, and that police have no task to inform companies about terms violations.
The police do not record these kinds of reports in such a way that the requested information can be retrieved from police systems.
De politie registreert dit soort meldingen niet op zodanige wijze dat de gevraagde informatie uit de politiesystemen kan worden gehaald.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over oversterfte en vaccinaties

An MP asks the Health Minister about excess mortality in 2020-2022, the limits of the CBS/RIVM report on vaccination links, and access to anonymised data for independent researchers. The minister maintains that no causal link between vaccination and death was shown, says the government is working on an investigation into causes of excess mortality, and commits to facilitating data access within legal limits without giving a firm timetable.
I endorse the importance of data availability for scientific research in general, and for excess mortality research in particular.
Ik onderschrijf het belang van de beschikbaarheid van data voor wetenschappelijk onderzoek in het algemeen, en het oversterfteonderzoek in het bijzonder.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het nieuws dat Europese Commissie voorzitter Von der Leyen op eigen houtje met Pfizer onderhandeld heeft over de aanschaf van 1,8 miljard coronavaccins

An FvD MP asks the health minister whether she will challenge Commission President von der Leyen over reported side-deals with Pfizer on 1.8 billion COVID vaccine doses, the refusal to hand over texts, and whether a probe into the procurement will be sought. The minister answers that the deal was endorsed by member states, that the European Parliament is primarily responsible for oversight of the Commission, and that the Netherlands supports transparency and an independent review of procurement.
It is therefore up to the European Parliament to judge the conduct of the European Commission or to call the (President of the) European Commission to account.
Het is dus aan het Europees Parlement om een oordeel te vellen over het handelen van de Europese Commissie of om de (voorzitter van de) Europese Commissie ter verantwoording te roepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over biologische oorlogsvoering en DNA-specifieke wapens

An FvD MP asked the Health Minister whether personalised biological weapons based on DNA are feasible, how DNA data held by companies and the state is protected, and whether COVID test samples retained DNA. The minister answered that feasibility is not for him to judge, pointed to GDPR safeguards and the DNA databank, said no human DNA is kept from COVID tests, and described existing outbreak and biosecurity arrangements.
It is not for me to make statements about the feasibility of this.
Het is niet aan mij om uitspraken te doen over de haalbaarheid hiervan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over oorlogsmisdaden gepleegd door het Oekraïense leger

An FVD MP asked whether Ukrainian forces committing war crimes by using residential areas, schools and hospitals for military purposes, and whether Dutch-supplied weapons used in such ways, should lead the government to halt arms deliveries or confront Ukraine's ambassador. The minister said the government had no report underlying Amnesty's press release, that international humanitarian law binds all parties, that every export is checked against EU criteria with end-user certificates, and that it would not stop deliveries or summon the ambassador, while raising legal frameworks in routine contacts.
Every supply of Dutch equipment to Ukraine is tested against the EU arms export criteria.
Elke leverantie van Nederlands materieel aan Oekraïne wordt getoetst aan de EU wapenexportcriteria.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Known Traveller Digital Identity (KTDI) project van het World Economic Forum (WEF)

An MP asked the government about the current status of the WEF Known Traveller Digital Identity project, whether it had been reconsidered by Canada and the Netherlands, whether it was registered with the IC-toetsing advisory college, and when promised documents would be sent. The government replied that there are no concrete plans to implement the pilot, that no government IT investment above €5 million is foreseen so it was not registered, and that the documents will be sent before the Christmas recess.
No, this project has not yet been registered with the Adviescollege IC-toetsing since no government IT investment above €5,000,000 is foreseen.
Nee, dit project is nog niet aangemeld bij het Adviescollege IC-toetsing aangezien er geen IV-investering vanuit de overheid boven de € 5.000.000 is voorzien.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het rapport van Nils Melzer

An MP asked the Justice and Foreign Affairs ministers for all written communication between the two ministries about UN rapporteur Nils Melzer's report. The minister provided a selection of inter-ministerial correspondence as an annex and noted that the rapporteur's letter has since been answered, with the government's reply sent separately.
Based on those parliamentary questions, I have made a selection of the written communication between my ministry and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
Op basis van die Kamervragen heb ik een selectie gemaakt van de schriftelijke communicatie tussen mijn ministerie en het Ministerie van Buitenlandse Zaken
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het schorsen van een Twitteraccount

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security whether the state requested suspension of neurologist Jan Bonte's Twitter account and how often it had requested account suspensions in the past year. The minister answered that neither the police nor the ministry contact platforms to have accounts removed or suspended, that police may only point out possibly unlawful content as anyone can, and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
Neither the police nor the Ministry of Justice and Security contact companies with the aim of having an account removed or suspended.
Zowel de politie als het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid nemen geen contact op met bedrijven met als doel een account te verwijderen of te schorsen.
Antwoord op een vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over een e-mail van het College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Health to provide the text of a July 2021 email from the College ter Beoordeling van Geneesmiddelen cancelling a meeting. The Minister answered that no recipient worked at the ministry, so the email is not in his possession and cannot be provided.
None of the addressees of this email worked at the Ministry of VWS.
Geen van de geadresseerden van deze e-mail was werkzaam bij het Ministerie van VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de jaarvergadering van het World Economic Forum

An MP asked for an overview of all sessions and informal meetings at the WEF annual meeting in Davos (22-26 May 2022) attended by cabinet members, and which followed Chatham House Rules. The government listed the ministers and the Queen who attended, referred to their programmes in annexes, and said no minutes were kept and Chatham House Rules generally applied, with many sessions streamed online.
No minutes were made of the WEF meetings.
Van de WEF-bijeenkomsten zijn geen notulen gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de relatie van het kabinet met het WEF

An FvD MP asked the minister whether cabinet members attend WEF events in an official capacity, whether the cabinet suggests invitees, and asked for full release of all WEF-government communications. The minister confirmed WEF invitations go to official addresses, could not rule out cabinet suggestions of invitees, and pointed to previously sent correspondence while answering each question separately.
No, I cannot rule that out.
Nee, dat kan ik niet uitsluiten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het World Economic Forum (WEF)

An FvD MP asked the minister whether many earlier questions on the World Economic Forum were left unanswered, why a 'close cooperation' with Dutch officials on the WEF annual meeting was not documented, and why a meeting readout would not be shared. The minister maintains all questions were answered, declines to share the special agenda and documentation citing privacy, and says the WEF objects to publishing the readout because discussions are confidential.
This special agenda cannot be shared for privacy reasons.
Deze special agenda kan uit privacyoverwegingen niet worden gedeeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over communicatie tussen Ministers, Staatssecretarissen en ambtenaren en het WEF

An FvD MP asked the government to provide all communication between ministers, state secretaries, officials and the central bank president on one side and the World Economic Forum on the other. The minister pointed to correspondence attached to an earlier letter and an invitation to the 2022 WEF meeting, but said inventorying all official contacts was not feasible, while promising to act on specific, targeted document requests.
It is not feasible to inventory all documents that played a role in those contacts and to check them for information whose disclosure should be withheld in the interest of the state.

Het is niet haalbaar om alle stukken die daarbij een rol hebben gespeeld te inventariseren en te toetsen op de aanwezigheid van informatie waarvan de openbaarmaking gelet op het belang van de staat achterwege moet blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Koningin Maxima en het WEF

An MP from FvD asks the minister whether notes, minutes or agendas exist of WEF meetings and of a 2020 conversation between the Queen, the Prime Minister, Minister Kaag and Klaus Schwab, and questions the Queen's role in WEF stewardship bodies. The minister replies that minutes are generally not made, the conversation was an exchange of views with no agenda or notes, and the Queen's roles stem from her UNSGSA and related functions with ministerial responsibility, while denying the Great Reset is a government-committed WEF programme.
Because of the nature of the conversation, no report of it was made.
Vanwege de aard van het gesprek is hiervan geen verslag gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over juridisch bindende overeenkomsten tussen het kabinet en het WEF

An MP asked the government for a list and full documentation of legally binding agreements between the Dutch state and the World Economic Forum, and for the meetings that led to them. The minister replied that only four named agreements exist, that the relevant subsidy documents and implementation agreement have been made public, and that no agreements were concluded at ministerial or civil-servant meetings.

Besides the mentioned legal agreements (Sustainable Investment Policy; Tropical Forest Alliance; Food Systems Initiative; Food Innovation Hubs), no other legally binding agreements have been made with the WEF.

Naast de genoemde juridische afspraken (Sustainable Investement Policy; Tropical Forest Alliance; Food Systems Initiative; Food Innovation Hubs) zijn er geen andere juridisch bindende afspraken gemaakt met het WEF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Koninklijk Huis en het WEF Young Global Leader programma

An FvD MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether members of the Royal House took part in the WEF Young Global Leaders programme, why, who decides invitations, and whether the Prime Minister is accountable for such activities. The minister confirmed some members participated, referred to a public overview, said the WEF decides invitations, and noted the Prime Minister's general ministerial responsibility for the Royal House while members of the Royal Family not in the Royal House carry no such responsibility.
For members of the Royal Family who are not also members of the Royal House, no ministerial responsibility applies as such.
Voor leden van de Koninklijke Familie, niet tevens lid van het Koninklijk Huis, geldt geen ministeriële verantwoordelijkheid als zodanig.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitnodiging per email aan minister Kaag voor de virtuele meeting van de Regional Action Group for the Middle East and North Africa van het World Economic Forum (WEF)

An MP asks whether the minister should have noticed that a WEF invitation sent on US election day anticipated a major change in global trade and presumed the outcome of the election, and whether the 2000 Mules documentary proves fraud. The minister answers that the WEF's intention is unknown, that the US ambassador was not informed, that the email has no predictive value, and that the documentary is unknown to her.
I am not aware of the underlying intention of this WEF sentence in the email you cite.
Ik ben niet bekend met de achterliggende bedoeling van deze zin van het WEF in de door u aangehaalde email.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het WEF-tasje van de premier

An FvD MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Prime Minister carrying a World Economic Forum bag, including whether he was a candidate to succeed Klaus Schwab and whether the bag signals endorsement of the WEF. The minister answered briefly: she was unaware of any succession candidacy, the PM received the bag at a WEF event, the PM likes it, the WEF is an inspirational platform not comparable to companies, and no signal is intended.
The WEF aims to offer an inspiring platform for exchanging ideas on solving global issues, and cannot be compared with the companies you mentioned.
Het WEF wil een inspirerend platform bieden voor de uitwisseling van ideeën over de oplossing van wereldwijde vraagstukken, en kan niet vergeleken worden met de door u genoemde bedrijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Mark Rutte en Klaus Schwab

An FvD MP asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development about the Prime Minister's contacts with WEF founder Klaus Schwab, including the Great Reset, meetings, the Young Global Leaders programme and phone contact. The government answered that correspondence concerned a book on COVID-19, that Davos welcome talks and a 2018 Catshuis session were informal and not minuted, and that there were two phone contacts in 2015 and 2016.
Because of the informal and non-conclusive nature of these conversations, no minutes are made of them.
Vanwege het informele en niet-conclusieve karakter worden van deze gesprekken geen verslagen van gemaakt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het ‘Memorandum of Understanding’ tussen het WEF en Denemarken

An MP from FvD asked the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development whether she knew of the Memorandum of Understanding between the World Economic Forum and Denmark, whether the Netherlands had a similar agreement, and whether the Chamber could receive any such memoranda the WEF may have concluded with the Dutch state. The minister answered that she knows of the Danish MoU, that the Netherlands has no comparable agreement, and that no such memoranda exist.
No, the Netherlands has not concluded a similar Memorandum of Understanding.
Nee, Nederland heeft geen dergelijk Memorandum of Understanding afgesloten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitspraak van de premier inzake de oorlog in Oekraïne

The MP asked whether the Prime Minister's statement that the war in Ukraine is also 'our war' means the Netherlands is in a state of war with Russia. The Prime Minister answered no, explaining the remark was meant figuratively and describing Dutch military, sanctions and accountability support.
No, the Netherlands is not at war with Russia.
Nee, Nederland is niet in oorlog met Rusland.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de relatie van kabinetsleden met het WEF

An MP from FvD asks the minister why the government's answer about cabinet members' status at the WEF is inconsistent with other answers and with documents showing former minister Kaag attended several WEF meetings, and requests a complete overview of Dutch officials' WEF attendance since 2014. The minister defends the earlier answer as limited to formal status, points to the December 2021 letter for the full overview, lists ministers attending the May 2022 annual meeting, and points to WEF website livestreams.
Can you finally come back with an answer to question two, clearly listing which WEF meetings (online and offline) Dutch ministers and officials have attended from 2014 to date?

Kunt u alsnog met een antwoord op vraag twee komen, waarbij (nu eindelijk eens) overzichtelijk op een rijtje wordt gezet welke WEF-bijeenkomsten (online en offline) door Nederlandse bewindspersonen en ambtenaren zijn bezocht vanaf 2014 tot heden?
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het rapport van VN-rapporteur Melzer

An MP asked the Justice Minister about UN rapporteur Melzer's report criticising police conduct at COVID demonstrations, and whether the government had answered his questions within the 60-day deadline. The minister replied that the letter was misplaced on receipt, so the response was delayed, and that a reply to the UN is being prepared and will be sent shortly.
A response is currently being prepared.
Een reactie is op dit moment in voorbereiding.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het apenpokkenvirus

An MP from FvD asked the health minister why Dutch guidance requires 21 days of quarantine for high-risk monkeypox contacts when WHO advice does not, and questioned the Group A classification, test assays and mRNA vaccine effects. The minister acknowledged the Dutch approach goes further than WHO, explained it as precautionary given uncertain transmission, said the quarantine has been replaced by leefregels, and denied proven vaccine immune suppression.
It is true that the current Dutch advice for high-risk contacts goes further than the WHO advice prescribes.
Het is juist dat het huidige Nederlandse advies ten aanzien van de hoogrisicocontacten verder gaat dan het WHO-advies voorschrijft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het jaarverslag van de AIVD
