An FvD MP asked the Minister of Interior about the AIVD 2021 annual report, questioning its focus on right-wing over left-wing extremism, its definitions and evidence for 'anti-government extremists' and disinformation, and whether an arts-spitting remark was 'hostile thinking'. The Minister answered that all extremism is a threat, right-wing extremism shows growth, the AIVD does not publicly discuss specific complot theories or actors, and the AIVD's mandate and public reporting are explained.
The AIVD does not make statements about this in public.
De AIVD doet hier in het openbaar geen uitspraken over.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het apenpokkenvirus

An FvD MP asked the health minister about changes to RIVM monkeypox web information, the reasons for the A-disease status from 21 May 2022, and whether the virus had become more lethal or transmissible. The minister confirmed the website text was revised for clarity and public questions, explained A-status as needed for early detection and isolation, and said mortality and transmissibility data were still being collected.
Before 21 May 2022 there was no notification requirement for the monkeypox virus; only the classic smallpox virus had one.
Er was voor 21 mei 2022 geen meldplicht voor het apenpokkenvirus, alleen voor het klassieke pokkenvirus bestond een meldplicht.
Antwoord op de vraag van het lid Van Houwelingen over artikel 42 lid 7 van het Verdrag van Lissabon van 22 juni jl.

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Defence whether, under Article 42(7) TEU, Ukraine's accession to the EU would automatically place the EU and the Netherlands in a state of war with Russia. The minister answered that the clause obliges member states to assist a member under armed attack with all available means, and that no such automatism exists.
Therefore, the automatism described in your question does not exist.
Derhalve is van geschetst automatisme in uw vraag geen sprake.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de aanwezigheid dit jaar bij de Bilderbergconferentie

An MP from FvD asked the Prime Minister and Foreign Minister why they attended the 2022 Bilderberg conference, which sessions they joined, what was discussed, and whether minutes could be released. The government confirmed attendance for the full conference, deferred to the conference secretariat for invitation policy and reasons, and refused to share Nederlandse input or minutes, citing Chatham House Rules that Rutte said he accepted by attending.
No, see the answer to question 6.
Nee, zie het antwoord op vraag 6.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een uitspraak van de heer Bonten bij WNL

An FvD MP asked the Health Minister whether patients in the Netherlands can be intubated against their will, after a claim by MP Bonten on WNL, and what would be done to prevent forced medical treatment. The minister answered that patients can decline ICU treatment like resuscitation, and that in acute situations without prior treatment limits patients are treated without informed consent, which the minister says is not against their will.
In acute situations where treatment limitations have not yet been discussed and can no longer be, patients are treated without informed consent.
In acute situaties waar nog niet over behandelbeperkingen is gesproken en waar dat ook niet meer kan, worden patiënten zonder informed consent behandeld.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over het interview van 9 mei 2022 met vaccinoloog Geert Vanden Bossche

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about claims by vaccinologist Geert Vanden Bossche on mass COVID-19 vaccination, including risks to children, immune escape and variant emergence. The Minister rejected the claims as unsupported or speculative, cited the Health Council and RIVM advice, and said the questions could not be sent before the debate.
The advice of the Health Council, the RIVM and the OMT is leading in policy-making.
De advisering van de Gezondheidsraad, het RIVM, het OMT is leidend in de beleidsvorming.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de kosten van deelname aan WEF-bijeenkomsten

An FvD MP asked the minister whether cabinet members paid WEF membership fees in 2018-2020 and which special duties required Minister Kaag to stay longer at WEF meetings. The minister confirmed that cabinet members paid no WEF membership fee and explained that Kaag's BHOS portfolio overlapped with WEF themes, so she had a relatively extensive programme in Davos.

Given the duties of the Minister for Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation, which have many points of contact with the themes discussed at WEF annual meetings in recent years, such as the SDGs, Minister Kaag as Minister for FTDC had a relatively extensive programme in Davos.

Gelet op de taken van de Minister voor Buitenlandse Handel en Ontwikkelingssamenwerking, die veel raakvlakken vertonen met de thema's die gedurende de afgelopen jaren in de jaarvergaderingen van het WEF aan de orde zijn gekomen, zoals de SDG's, had Minister Kaag als Minister voor BHOS een relatief uitgebreid programma in Davos.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de medicatie hydroxocobalamine van Takeda

An MP asked the health minister about expected supply shortages of hydroxocobalamine from Takeda until October 2022, whether patients are left without needed medication, and whether the IGJ could urgently look at importing equivalent foreign alternatives. The minister confirmed the shortage, said Takeda's version is the only registered product without benzyl alcohol needed for neonates, and pointed to an IGJ shortage decision published in May that allows temporary use of foreign alternatives.
The IGJ already published a shortage decision on 11 May in the Staatscourant allowing field parties to temporarily use comparable registered alternatives (without benzyl alcohol) from abroad.

De IGJ heeft reeds een tekortenbesluit gepubliceerd op 11 mei in de Staatscourant waardoor veldpartijen tijdelijk vergelijkbare geregistreerde alternatieven (zonder benzylalcohol) uit het buitenland kunnen inzetten.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de grenseffecten van het tabaksbeleid

MP Van Houwelingen asked the State Secretary of Finance about reports that a growing share of tobacco smoked in the Netherlands comes from abroad, the effect of excise differences on border-region businesses, and the RIVM study on price sensitivity of smokers. The government answered that the industry-funded figures are unreliable, that Empty Pack Surveys show foreign-bought cigarettes at about 15% without a clear trend, and that the RIVM and other evidence do not justify changing tobacco policy, while promising to keep monitoring cross-border effects and to report on fuel-excise support on Prinsjesdag.
The Cabinet considers it important to monitor whether cross-border effects undermine tobacco excise policy.
Het Kabinet vindt het belangrijk om te monitoren of grenseffecten het beleid rondom tabaksaccijns ondermijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over onderzoeks- en adviesinstellingen

An MP asked the Minister of Health which written press questions from NRC and de Volkskrant were submitted to the ministry and its research and advisory bodies between November 2019 and January 2022. The minister replied that no complete overview exists because there is no central registration of incoming media questions, and attached an indicative overview with personal data removed.
I wish to inform you that it is not possible to provide a complete picture of the questions posed by NRC and/or de Volkskrant during the requested period.
Ik hecht eraan u te melden dat het niet mogelijk is een compleet beeld te geven van de door NRC en/of de Volkskrant gestelde vragen gedurende de gevraagde periode.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over kosten die de rijksoverheid per jaar uitgeeft aan de inhuur van externe consultants

An MP asked the Minister of the Interior how much central government spent yearly from 2017 to 2021 on hiring external consultants, broken down by five named consultancy firms. The minister reported total external hiring rising from 1.29 to 2.29 billion euros, and per-firm figures for 2017-2020 from spend data, noting 2021 is not yet broken down by firm.
The annual financial reports contain aggregated information and therefore not at supplier level.
De financiële jaarverslagen bevatten geaggregeerde informatie en dus niet op leveranciersniveau.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het vaccinatiestatuslogo in het patiënten informatiesysteem ‘HiX’

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health whether vaccination status icons in the HiX patient record system exist, what they mean, why they were introduced, and whether they affect treatment or research. The Minister answered that the icons are an optional display feature chosen by hospitals, serve only as a visual reminder without linked protocols or treatment consequences, and are visible only to care staff with a treatment relationship.
No, the EHR does not determine who receives which treatment; that is decided by the treating physician.
Nee, het EPD bepaalt niet wie welke behandeling krijgt, dat bepaalt de behandelend arts.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de WEF Alliantie

An FvD MP asked the Health Minister about a 2020 World Economic Forum proposal for a 'MANAGE-COV Alliance' for COVID-19 vaccines, including whether the ministry had discussed it, who led the Inclusive Vaccine Alliance, and for documents. The minister answered that the WEF idea was received and assessed but not pursued because the ministry was already working within the Inclusive Vaccine Alliance, and that the WEF concept note would be sent to parliament once the ministry finished talking to the WEF about releasing it.
We are still in discussion with the WEF about sending this document to your House.
Wij zijn nog in gesprek met het WEF over toezending van dit stuk aan uw Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de banden van leden van het Nederlandse kabinet met het World Economic Forum

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Foreign Affairs about cabinet members' ties to the World Economic Forum, including the Great Reset, the Covid Action Platform, and the Global Action Group, and asks whether the government shaped policy in these fora and why documents were redacted. The Minister answers that participation was a prerogative of the minister, that the WEF does not set policy or agenda, that the government is not bound by WEF principles, and that some documents cannot be shared for privacy or confidentiality reasons.
The WEF offers a platform for the exchange of ideas and knowledge.
Het WEF biedt een platform voor ideeënvorming en kennisuitwisseling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de gevolgen van de zware sancties voor Nederlandse ondernemers die naar Rusland exporteren

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs whether she knows that Dutch exporters dependent on Russia are badly hit by sanctions, including payment problems, and what she will do to help them. The minister confirmed the impact and pointed to existing RVO support instruments such as state-backed loans, guarantees, trade finance and energy-transition subsidies, without announcing new measures.
For entrepreneurs in need, such as the senders of the open letter the MP enclosed, I would like to point to the existing support we offer through RVO.
Ondernemers in nood, zoals de verzenders van de brandbrief die het lid Van Houwelingen heeft meegestuurd, zou ik graag willen wijzen op de bestaande ondersteuning die wij aanbieden via RVO.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over WEF vs vaccin alliantie

An MP from FvD asked the Health Minister about an internal ministry email linking the World Economic Forum's COVID vaccine proposal to the Inclusive Vaccine Alliance, and asked for the related memorandum and documents. The minister confirmed the email exists and that the MoU and WEF proposal were provided to parliament or attached, explaining the proposal was separate from the Inclusive Vaccine Alliance and set no framework for it.
Yes. For completeness, I note that it concerns an internal VWS email and not an email to the Ministry of VWS.
Ja. Volledigheidshalve merk ik op dat het een interne VWS mail betreft en geen mail aan het Ministerie van VWS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het subsidiëren van een oppositiekrant in Hongarije door de Nederlandse ambassade

An FvD MP asked the Foreign Minister whether the Dutch embassy in Hungary subsidised an opposition newspaper and whether this amounts to foreign interference, and also raised press freedom and disinformation in the EU. The minister replied that the EUR 10,000 per year support went to an independent NGO project printing news articles for distribution, not an opposition newspaper, and that the government sees press freedom as fundamental.
So it is not an opposition newspaper.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de implicaties van het afsluiten van een nieuw WHO-verdrag gebaseerd op artikel 19 van de WHO-Constitutie

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health whether a new WHO pandemic treaty under Article 19 of the WHO Constitution, and existing obligations under the WHO tobacco convention and EU directives, could bind the Netherlands against its sovereignty and autonomy. The Minister answered that the content and legal form of the pandemic instrument are not yet decided, that Parliament will have ratification and implementation oversight, and that the Netherlands is bound by EU law on shared competences.
At that point, attention will be paid to this in the explanatory memorandum accompanying parliamentary approval of the instrument, and your House can then give its judgment.
Hier zal bij de parlementaire goedkeuring in de toelichting op het instrument aandacht aan worden besteed en uw Kamer kan dan een oordeel daarover geven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de Gezondheidsraad

An MP from FvD asked the minister about the independence of the Health Council (Gezondheidsraad), including ministerial nomination of its chair and overlapping experts with the OMT COVID-19. The minister answered that the council advises independently under the Kaderwet adviescolleges, that the chair is appointed by royal decree on ministerial proposal after open selection, and that the council and OMT have different roles and manage conflicts of interest through declarations.
The Health Council advises independently on the basis of the state of scientific knowledge.
De Gezondheidsraad adviseert onafhankelijk op basis van de stand van wetenschap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de GGD GHOR en de stichting Landelijke Coördinatie COVID-19 Bestrijding

An MP asked the Health Minister about the governance of GGD GHOR, its chair's authority and selection, and the newly founded LCCB foundation that runs national COVID-19 coordination. The minister answered that GGD GHOR is a private association outside government responsibility, declined to detail internal arrangements, and confirmed the 2021 binding order and the LCCB's financial-only link to VWS.
GGD GHOR Nederland is a private-law association that the central government is not a member of, is not involved in, and has no responsibility for its internal decision-making processes.

GGD GHOR Nederland is een privaatrechtelijke organisatie (vereniging) waar de rijksoverheid geen lid van is en ook bij niet betrokken is en ook geen verantwoordelijkheid heeft bij de interne besluitvormingsprocessen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de brief van de Inspectie Gezondheidszorg en Jeugd die op 7 oktober 2021 is verstuurd naar een huisarts

MP Van Houwelingen asked the minister about an IGJ letter to GP Van Veen, asking which statements were deemed incorrect or intimidating and how the distinction between critical remarks and disinformation works, and whether doctors can speak freely as 'critical citizens'. The minister answered that the inspectorate does not normally comment on individual cases, that the terms came from the complainant, and that doctors' speech is limited by professional norms, with the inspectorate able to warn of the effects of incorrect statements.
First of all, I would note that the inspectorate generally does not make public statements about individual cases and generally does not provide substantive information about them.
Allereerst hecht ik eraan te vermelden dat de inspectie in de regel niet naar buiten treedt over individuele casuïstiek en daarover in de regel ook geen inhoudelijke mededelingen doet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Outbreak Management Team (OMT) COVID-19 en de verhouding tot het RIVM

An FvD MP asked the Health Minister whether the Outbreak Management Team (OMT) COVID-19, which is run by the RIVM's Centre for Infectious Disease Control, can be considered independent of the RIVM and the Ministry, given shared staff, chairmanship and publication arrangements. The Minister answered that the OMT is an independent advisory body facilitated by the RIVM's Landelijke Coördinatie Infectieziektebestrijding, that RIVM staff participation does not affect its independence, and that the RIVM's scientific independence is set out in the RIVM Act.
An independent advisory body can advise without having to account substantively for that advice to the party that requested it.
Een onafhankelijk adviesorgaan kan adviseren zonder over dat advies inhoudelijk verantwoording af te hoeven leggen aan degene die het advies gevraagd heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Bestuurlijk Afstemmingsoverleg

An FvD MP asked the Minister of VWS about the structure, membership, working method and transparency of the Bestuurlijk Afstemmingsoverleg (BAO) that advises on COVID-19 measures, including whether BAO advice is recorded and whether the minister bears final responsibility. The minister answered that the BAO has fixed members and is chaired by the DG Volksgezondheid, that no votes are taken, that BAO advice is published in letters to parliament instead of minutes, and that the cabinet, not the advisers, is responsible for decisions.
The BAO advice must be included in the letter to the House so quickly after the BAO that this advice effectively replaces the minutes.
Het advies van het BAO moet zodanig snel na het BAO in de Kamerbrief worden opgenomen dat dit advies als het ware de notulen vervangt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over het OMT COVID-19 en eventuele belangenverstrengeling

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about the composition, criteria, confidentiality and conflict-of-interest rules of the COVID-19 Outbreak Management Team (OMT), including members' outside financial ties and the role of their declarations. The Minister answered most questions in substance, explaining membership, confidentiality as necessary for frank advice, and that members' interests are declared and checked, while refusing to make OMT deliberations public and declining to intervene in members' media appearances.
The confidentiality of the OMT consultations is necessary so that members can speak freely.
De vertrouwelijkheid van het OMT-overleg is nodig zodat de leden vrijuit kunnen spreken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over testen voor toegang en amateursporten

An MP asked the health minister about the impact of COVID certificate requirements on amateur sport, the treatment of unvaccinated staff and visitors, and alleged vaccination fraud at GGD. The minister pointed to studies showing limited disruption to competitions, explained which activities require the certificate, and said a police investigation into staff fraud was ongoing, declining to share details.
In the interest of the investigation, GGD GHOR Nederland shares no further information.
In het belang van het onderzoek deelt GGD GHOR Nederland geen verdere informatie.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over Known Traveller Digital Identity (KTDI) van het World Economic Forum (WEF) van 12 januari 2022

MP Van Houwelingen asked whether the Dutch government is a KTDI pilot partner of the World Economic Forum and requested all related documents. The state secretary confirmed the Netherlands was approached in 2018, joined a public-private consortium with a 2019 letter of intent signed by the ambassador to Canada, and that the pilot is now very uncertain; documents were promised before summer.
This request is extensive and takes time. I aim to send you these documents before the summer.
Dit verzoek is omvangrijk en kost tijd. Ik streef ernaar u deze documenten voor de zomer te doen toekomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bericht COVID-19 in Groep A van de Wet publieke gezondheid (Wpg) en de COVID-19 IHR Emergency Committee van de World Health Organisation

An FvD MP asked the health minister whether COVID-19's WHO PHEIC status and EU decision 1082/2013 make national ministerial coordination necessary and justify placing COVID-19 in group A of the Public Health Act, and asked about notification duties, the case definition, criteria for de-escalation, and capacity. The minister answered that group A placement depends on whether national coordination is deemed necessary and on individual-targeted measures, rejected the claim that EU law is decisive or makes decentralised work impossible, and said that national coordination lets Parliament hold the cabinet to account, while promising a later letter on de-escalation criteria.
If there is no national coordination, there is also no role for the First or Second Chamber to call the cabinet to account for the policy pursued and the measures taken to combat COVID-19.

Indien er geen landelijke regie is, is er ook geen rol voor de Eerste of Tweede Kamer om het kabinet ter verantwoording te roepen voor het gevoerde beleid en de genomen maatregelen ten aanzien van de bestrijding van COVID-19.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over nevenactiviteiten

An MP asked the Minister for Climate and Energy about his listed side activities, including a fellowship in the Trilateral Commission's David Rockefeller Fellows, and whether it conflicts with the handbook rule requiring office-holders to relinquish such activities before cabinet is sworn in. The minister confirms the activities were listed on an independent website, describes the commission's work briefly, and states he ended the membership before being sworn in.
I am no longer a member of the Trilateral Commission of the David Rockefeller Fellows.
Ik ben geen lid meer van de Trilateral Commission van de David Rockefeller Fellows.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Janssen covid-19 vaccin en aansprakelijkheid

An MP from FvD asked the health minister about the phone line for booking Janssen COVID-19 vaccinations, the call script, the age-based policy change after June 2021, informed consent, and who is liable for thrombosis-related harm. The minister answered in detail that the script exists and is described, that the Janssen vaccine remained available on request after informed consent, and that people who chose it after being informed cannot hold others liable for the disclosed side effects.

For people who contacted the Janssen choice line, which only started after June 2021, and chose to be vaccinated with Janssen, it applies that they repeatedly declared before administration that they were aware of the possible side effects of the Janssen vaccine.

Voor mensen die contact opnamen met de Janssen-keuzelijn, die pas na juni 2021 startte, en ervoor hebben gekozen om zich te laten vaccineren met Janssen, geldt dat zij voor de toediening van het vaccin meermaals verklaard hebben zij bekend waren met de mogelijke bijwerkingen van het Janssen-vaccin.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Paul Ehrlich Institute en de kwaliteit van de Pfizer vaccins

MP Van Houwelingen (FvD) asked whether the Paul Ehrlich Institut checks only batches supplied by Pfizer rather than randomly selected ones, why it does not select samples itself, and whether it will share its test results for Pfizer batches delivered to the Netherlands. The minister replied that every batch for the EU market is sampled and tested by an independent authority, that inspectorates supervise the sampling, and that test results are not shared because mutual recognition applies, with the certificate implying compliance with specifications.
When the Paul Ehrlich Institut issues an OCABR certificate, this is recognised by the other European member states without any results being shared.
Wanneer het Paul Ehrlich Institut een OCABR-certificaat afgeeft, wordt dit erkend door de andere Europese lidstaten zonder dat er resultaten gedeeld worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de booster en de medische onderbouwing voor de combinatie van Janssen met een mRNA-vaccin

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Health, in 37 numbered questions, to justify the medical basis for offering mRNA boosters after a Janssen primary vaccination, given the absence of EMA registration and the cited sources being preprints or UK statements. The Minister replies that the Health Council's advice rests on multiple sources pointing the same way, that boosters are offered by age-based preference, and that the questions are answered by reference to Health Council advice and public information channels.
Advice from the Council is based on an independent weighing of the scientific data, facts and expert views available at the time from the committee members.
Advisering van de raad is gebaseerd op een onafhankelijke weging van de op dat moment beschikbare wetenschappelijke gegevens, feiten en deskundige opvattingen van de commissieleden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de grafieken die zijn getoond gedurende de persconferentie coronavirus van 14 januari 2022

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Health why a Covid chart shown at the 14 January 2022 press conference for the UK appeared to omit the latest days' falling case numbers, and why recent data was not used. The minister explained the chart was simplified for the public, used data available a day or two earlier, and that the rise had levelled off, while promising to weigh recency against clarity in future presentations.
I consider it important that the information in the press conference is complete and understandable to a broad public.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat de informatie in de persconferentie volledig en voor een breed publiek begrijpelijk is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over Antibody-Dependent Enhancement

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) risks for COVID-19 vaccines, citing Pfizer's FDA submission and the Dengvaxia precedent, and questioned the adequacy of animal challenge studies and the advisory role of the Health Council and OMT. The Minister replied that ADE has not been observed in real-world data, that waning immunity does not show an ADE pattern, that challenge studies serve efficacy rather than duration, and that no additional animal studies are needed, while defending the advisory bodies.
As I indicated in the answer to question 4, the decline in immunity is a gradual process.
Zoals ik in het antwoord op vraag 4 heb aangegeven is de afname van immuniteit een geleidelijk proces.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over oversterfte

An MP asked the Minister of Health whether there is an explanation for higher excess mortality in provinces with high vaccination rates (Limburg, Gelderland, Noord-Brabant) and lower excess mortality in provinces with low rates (Noord-Holland, Zuid-Holland, Friesland). The Minister answered that explaining excess mortality requires rigorous research and that speculation without evidence is unwise, pointing to factors such as age structure and health, and to the RIVM and CBS study announced following a motion by MP Omtzigt.
Explaining excess mortality requires rigorous scientific research.
Het verklaren van oversterfte vergt gedegen wetenschappelijk onderzoek.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over mogelijke verwarring die recent is ontstaan op een antwoord op eerdere vragen over het karakter van, en de relaties van kabinetsleden met, het World Economic Forum (WEF

An MP asked whether the minister's role in the World Economic Forum was clarified after confusion arose over a cabinet answer, and requested an overview of WEF meetings and initiatives the minister attended, with documentation. The minister replied that the Rutte III minister never attended a WEF meeting, the ministry is involved in WEF-initiated Food Innovation Hubs, and additional documentation was attached.
The Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality (Rutte III) has never attended a meeting of the World Economic Forum (WEF).
De Minister van Landbouw, Natuur en Voedselkwaliteit (LNV) (Rutte III) is nooit bij een bijeenkomst van het World Economic Forum (WEF) geweest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vaccinatieschade, het voorzorgsbeginsel en informed consent

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about reported COVID-19 vaccine adverse events and deaths, the precautionary principle, antibody-dependent enhancement and informed consent. The minister rejected the claimed link between reported deaths and vaccination, said the precautionary principle was correctly applied by the EMA, and denied that informed consent had been breached, pointing to ongoing monitoring and information materials.
The figures you refer to concern the number of reports made. This is not the number of people who have died as a result of COVID-19 vaccination.
De cijfers waar u naar verwijst betreffen het aantal meldingen dat is gedaan. Dit is niet het aantal mensen dat door COVID-19 vaccinatie is komen te overlijden.
Antwoord vragen op het lid Van Houwelingen over antwoorden op eerdere vragen over het karakter van, en de relaties van kabinetsleden, met het World Economic Forum

Van Houwelingen (FvD) asked how much time former minister Kaag spent on World Economic Forum meetings and projects, who took over her WEF coordination role, for WEF documents and the Great Reset Portal, whether WEF blocked disclosure, and what the 'Great Reset' means. The minister replied that Kaag's time was limited to attending a few meetings, that time spent by officials is not recorded, that no formal coordinating role exists, that no minutes are kept and the portal is not public, that no WEF approval was needed, and that the Great Reset was not discussed as a theme in the Tweede Kamer.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de kwaliteitscontrole van Covid-19-vaccins

An FvD MP asked whether the Netherlands independently checks the quality and composition of purchased Covid-19 vaccines, and why fabricants with past court convictions are considered reliable, and requested test results or doses for independent analysis. The minister answered that each batch is independently tested by the national OMCL laboratory (RIVM) before release, that the US court cases concern fraud and marketing rather than vaccine quality, and that test results are commercially confidential and no doses will be provided.
Because of the commercially confidential nature of this information, test results and production details cannot be shared with a wider public.
Vanwege de commercieel vertrouwelijke aard van deze informatie zijn testuitslagen en productiedetails niet met een breder publiek te delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de modellering (en sterftekans) bij de omikronvariant van het coronavirus

An FvD MP asked the Health Minister whether the RIVM model underlying the lockdown accounted for omicron's milder severity, shorter hospital stays and lower hospitalisation risk, and what the current fatality risk of omicron is compared with delta and seasonal flu. The minister confirmed the model assumes higher transmissibility but not the milder severity, calling the assumptions highly uncertain, and said there is too little data yet for a sound judgement on omicron's fatality risk.
The data on the possibly milder nature, smaller chance of hospital admission and shorter length of hospital stay are not yet included in this modelling.
De gegevens over eventueel mildere aard, kleinere kans op ziekenhuisopname en kortere verblijfsduur in het ziekenhuis zijn in deze modellering nog niet meegenomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over motie van het lid Pouw-Verweij c.s. inzake een snelle toelaatbaarheid van serologische testen (Kamerstuk 25295-1436)

An MP asked why the unanimously adopted motion on recognising serological tests for COVID certificates has not yet been implemented and when such tests might be allowed. The minister answered that the OMT advised against using serological tests as a basis for a coronavirus certificate, citing the inability to date infection, lack of internationally accepted protection thresholds and EU disagreement, and said the motion is being implemented with further analysis including the omicron variant.
In short, the motion is being implemented.
Kortom de motie is in uitvoering.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de VASCO-studie

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Health about the VASCO vaccine effectiveness study, questioning its independence from the OMT and RIVM, the exclusion of care home residents, and the scope of side-effect monitoring. The Minister defends RIVM's independence, states the protocol was approved by the METC, and explains that the study focuses on effectiveness with side effects handled by other studies.
The Outbreak Management Team (OMT) is not part of the RIVM, but an independent advisory body.
Het Outbreak Management Team (OMT) is géén onderdeel van het RIVM, maar een onafhankelijk adviesorgaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over grootschalige fraude in het onderzoek naar het Pfizer-vaccin

An FvD MP asked the Health Minister about alleged data fraud, unblinding and inadequate adverse-event follow-up in a Pfizer vaccine trial site, and whether the vaccine rollout should be suspended. The minister answered that EMA and FDA reviewed the site, found shortcomings that did not compromise data integrity or the benefit-risk balance, and saw no reason to suspend use.

The European Medicines Agency (EMA), following this article, together with the FDA (the US regulator), examined the reported course of events and concluded that the shortcomings at this research centre do not endanger the quality and integrity of the research data from this location.

Het Europees Medicijnagentschap (hierna: EMA) heeft naar aanleiding van dit artikel samen met de FDA (de toezichthouder in de Verenigde Staten) naar de gerapporteerde gang van zaken gekeken en heeft geconcludeerd dat de tekortkomingen in dit onderzoekscentrum de kwaliteit en integriteit van de onderzoeksgegevens uit deze locatie niet in gevaar brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over mondkapjes

An MP asks the Minister of Health why a mask mandate in public transport and indoor spaces remains in force despite studies questioning mask effectiveness, and asks RIVM to review and respond to numerous cited studies. The Minister replies that the mandate follows OMT, WHO and ECDC advice, that OMT (not RIVM) advises on masks, and declines to ask RIVM for new research or a study list, while noting OMT advice and documents are already public.
I see no added value in additionally asking the National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) to conduct research into the usefulness of face masks.
Ik zie geen meerwaarde om het Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) daarnaast te vragen onderzoek te doen naar het nut van mondkapjes.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het karakter van, en de relaties van kabinetsleden met het World Economic Forum (WEF) naar aanleiding van antwoorden hierover van het kabinet

An opposition MP (FvD) asked the Prime Minister detailed questions about ministers' ties to the World Economic Forum, including invitations, attendance, costs, communications and a meeting involving Queen Máxima. The government answered that ministers take no WEF training, that invitations are decided by the ministers themselves, that no minutes are usually kept, and that it cannot provide all documents or the full communications at short notice, but will honour specific requests and promises a letter on costs in Q1 2022.
Unfortunately it is not feasible to inventory, in the short term, all documents that played a role and to check them for information whose disclosure should be withheld in the interest of the state.

Het is helaas niet haalbaar om alle stukken die daarbij een rol hebben gespeeld op korte termijn te inventariseren en te toetsen op de aanwezigheid van informatie waarvan de openbaarmaking gelet op het belang van de staat achterwege moet blijven.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over serologische tests

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about serological (antibody) tests, the EU's position on them, whether vaccination willingness played a role in excluding them, and whether natural immunity offers better long-term protection. The Minister answered that the government has not yet concluded serology can play a role in the coronavirus access pass, citing the lack of a known protective antibody level, the inability to date infection, and test variability, and denied that vaccination willingness influenced the decision.
Whether or not serological tests are used for access is not influenced by a possible effect on vaccination willingness.
Het wel of niet inzetten van serologische testen voor toegang wordt niet beïnvloed door een mogelijke invloed op de vaccinatiebereidheid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een onlangs verschenen pro-vaccin campagnefilmpje van de Minister van VWS

An FvD MP asked the Minister of VWS about a pro-vaccination campaign video aimed at young people, questioning its cost, the absence of information on long-term risks and natural immunity, and why YouTube comments were disabled. The minister answered that production cost about 159,000 euros and media about 205,000 euros, that the videos give evidence-based information with more detail on a dedicated website, that pretests were positive, and that YouTube serves mainly as a landing page with commenting available on other platforms.
Our YouTube channel is mainly used by us as a landing page.
Ons YouTube-kanaal wordt door ons vooral gebruikt als landingspagina.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over corona

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about how many people use the corona access certificate, ten years of ICU admission figures, and how many cabinet members are vaccinated. The minister said exact CTB usage is not tracked for privacy reasons but gave download and QR-code figures, provided ICU admissions for 2013–2020 from Stichting NICE, and declined to share cabinet members' medical data.
I cannot share the medical data of cabinet members.
Medische gegevens van kabinetsleden kan ik niet delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een slogan (‘wijk voor wijk, deur voor deur, arm voor arm’) die de minister gebruikte tijdens de (afgelopen) persconferentie

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Health why his slogan 'wijk voor wijk, deur voor deur, arm voor arm' resembles phrasing used abroad in COVID vaccination campaigns, and requested all documents about the slogan's origin. The minister answered that any similarities are coincidental and that no documents exist beyond draft press-conference texts.
Apart from drafts of the text spoken during this press conference, there are no documents referring to the statement you refer to.
Anders dan concepten voor de uitgesproken tekst tijdens deze persconferentie zijn er geen documenten refererend aan de uitspraak waar u op doelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de nieuw in te kopen vaccins volgend jaar

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Health why fewer Novavax doses were ordered than the Sanofi and Valneva vaccines were not ordered at all, why new vaccines are bought for 2022, and whether this signals the pandemic is not over. The minister explained a portfolio approach based on mRNA, vector and protein vaccines, citing ample supplies and booster needs, and called the purchases a precautionary measure.
I view the purchase of these vaccines as a precautionary measure that helps us face this pandemic for as long as necessary.
De aankoop van deze vaccins zie ik als een voorzorgsmaatregel die ons helpt deze pandemie zo lang als nodig is het hoofd te bieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Houwelingen over het EMA-rapport inzake onder andere de beoordeling en voorlopige goedkeuring van het Pfizer-vaccin

An MP from FvD asks the Minister of Health about an EMA assessment report on the conditional marketing authorisation of the Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine, questioning its legal basis, safety and efficacy evidence, quality control location, and the continued grounding of the vaccine and of COVID-19 A-status in Dutch public-health law. The Minister rejects most premises, states the vaccine meets EU legal requirements, reports on the status of specific obligations and safety follow-up, and says EU rules since 2001 govern the authorisation and controls are now carried out within the EU.
Yes, I am aware of the assessment report you refer to.
Ik ben bekend met het beoordelingsrapport waar u naar verwijst.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over recente NPO-uitzendingen waarin ongevaccineerden bedreigd zouden worden

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether NPO broadcasts threatening or calling for violence against unvaccinated people, and whether the minister would intervene as system responsible for the NPO. The minister answered that public broadcasters are independently responsible for their content under the Mediawet, that prior government review of programme content is constitutionally prohibited, and that courts decide afterwards whether limits were crossed.
Prior supervision of the content of television programmes is, as Article 7, paragraph 2, of the Constitution provides, never permitted.
Toezicht vooraf op de inhoud van tv-programma's is, zoals artikel 7, tweede lid, van de Grondwet bepaalt, nooit geoorloofd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een ‘satirisch’ filmpje dat afgelopen vrijdag is uitgezonden door de NPO

An MP asked the Justice Minister whether a satirical NPO broadcast showing unvaccinated people being shot was criminal, and whether the NPO should be acted against. The minister answered that broadcasters independently decide content, prior content control is not permitted, satire is protected speech, and whether a crime occurred is for the courts, not the minister.
Nor is it for me, as Minister of Justice and Security, to take action against the makers and/or distributors of the video in question.
Evenmin is het aan mij, als Minister van Justitie en Veiligheid, om actie te ondernemen tegen de makers en/of verspreiders van het onderhavige filmpje.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE)

An MP asks the Minister of Health about antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) risks for COVID-vaccinated people, citing scientific articles and expert warnings, and asks whether OMT discussed it and whether further animal studies are needed. The Minister answers that ADE has not been observed in vaccinated people, the risk is theoretical, the Health Council advises on vaccination, no OMT documents on ADE exist, and no new animal studies are considered necessary.
The OMT has not discussed ADE.
Het OMT heeft niet gesproken over ADE.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over infecties versus injecties

An MP from the FvD asked the Minister of Health about the comparative protection of natural COVID-19 infection versus vaccination, referencing various studies and a newspaper interview, and questioned continued vaccination. The Minister answered at length, stating that natural infection carries serious risks, that vaccination is the safest route to lasting immunity, and rebutting the cited studies and claims point by point.
Vaccination is therefore the safest option for building long-lasting immunity and preventing serious illness and death.
Vaccineren is daarom de veiligste optie om langdurige immuniteit op te bouwen en ernstige ziekte en sterfte te voorkomen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een recente opmerking van de Minister-President in Brussel d.d. 25 oktober 2021

An FvD MP asked the Prime Minister why he declined to answer a Dutch journalist's question about Dutch children placed in care while he was in Brussels, and whether this showed EU matters outweighing domestic accountability. The Prime Minister answered that he is accountable on domestic affairs in Brussels too, admitted his first reaction was wrong and that he should have answered directly, and said he speaks to the press mainly on the summit's agenda items.
No, I am also accountable in Brussels for domestic affairs.
Nee, ook in Brussel ben ik aanspreekbaar op binnenlandse aangelegenheden.
Antwoord op vragen van lid van Houwelingen over over ivermectine, hydroxychloroquine en testen op antilichamen

Van Houwelingen (FvD) asks the Health Minister whether treatment guidelines on ivermectin, hydroxychloroquine and antibody testing rest on scientific consensus, and whether critical doctors are being silenced by warning letters and complaint channels. The minister says guidelines are set by professional bodies weighing the literature, that critique belongs in those bodies, and declines to ask RIVM for substantive responses to the submitted articles.
As I have indicated in earlier answers, RIVM does not lead in drafting the treatment guidelines; the professional groups are leading in weighing the information in relation to these guidelines.

Zoals ik heb aangegeven in eerdere antwoorden, is het RIVM niet leidend in het opstellen van de behandelrichtlijnen, maar zijn de beroepsgroepen leidend in het wegen van de informatie in relatie tot deze richtlijnen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de vaccinatiegraad

An FvD MP asked the Minister of Health about a claim of 75% first-dose and 50% full vaccination coverage, and how it squares with other figures. The Minister answered that the quote dates from 6 July 2021 rather than 15 October, that current RIVM figures are given, and that the discrepancies follow from the wrong date.
The fragment the Algemeen Dagblad cites on its website dates from 6 July 2021.
Het fragment dat het Algemeen Dagblad aanhaalt op zijn website dateert van 6 juli 2021.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over ic-capaciteit en opleiding van ic-verpleegkundigen

An FvD MP asks the health minister why ICU capacity is being cut due to staff shortages, why UMC Maastricht trained far more ICU nurses than other hospitals, and what is being done on pay, retention, a COVID-only short ICU training and whether questions can be answered one by one. The minister lists investment, training programmes, retention and wage measures, rejects a COVID-only short training as harmful to care quality, and answers each question in turn.
Training ICU nurses is a top priority.
Het opleiden van IC-verpleegkundigen is topprioriteit.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een Bloedtest

The MP asked whether GPs may perform antibody blood tests to issue a recovery certificate and, if not, why, when that might change, and on what criteria the validity of recovery and vaccination certificates is reviewed. The minister answered that serologic tests cannot currently be used for individual certificates, citing the inability to date infection, lack of accepted protection thresholds, and test diversity, and said the cabinet will consider OMT advice on extending recovery certificate validity in early November.
No, it is currently not (legally) permitted for doctors or others to issue a recovery certificate based on a serological blood test.
Nee, het is momenteel niet (wettelijk) toegestaan voor artsen of anderen om een herstelbewijs aan te maken op basis van een serologische bloedtest.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de begroting van het ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport voor het jaar 2022 en het financieel beheer

An MP from FvD asked the health minister about the validity of a guarantee for the Landelijk Consortium Hulpmiddelen, unusable corona goods, improvements to financial management, procurement rules at the consortium and ministry, the Deloitte investigation timeline, and large severance payments to hospital directors. The minister answered that the guarantee ran until 24 June 2021, promised a separate letter on financial management, explained exemptions from procurement rules for storage contracts, said the Deloitte research would take longer than planned, and noted that the WNT regulator has started an investigation into the hospitals.
I will inform the House with a separate letter about the progress of the programme 'Improving Financial Management VWS'.
Ik zal uw Kamer met een separate brief informeren over de voortgang van het programma «Verbetering Financieel Beheer VWS».
Antwoord op vragen van lid van Houwelingen over Ivermectine, hydroxychloroquine en testen op antilichamen

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about the effectiveness of ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine against COVID-19, the availability of antibody tests and recovery certificates, and free home medicine kits. The minister declined to ask RIVM for a new literature review, deferred to professional bodies and EMA on drug assessment, and said serological tests are not sensitive enough for individual immunity certificates.
The OMT has not advised on ivermectin as a COVID medicine, since the OMT does not deal with treatments.
Het OMT heeft niet geadviseerd over ivermectine als coronamedicijn, aangezien het OMT niet gaat over behandelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vaccinatiestatus van diegenen die zijn overleden

An MP asked the health minister why the RIVM is reluctant to publish the vaccination status of people who died from COVID-19, and about privacy, employer vaccination questions and data completeness. The minister answered that COVID deaths are not reportable to the RIVM so the data is incomplete, that privacy plays no role in that decision, and that employers may ask about vaccination status only with a good reason, while promising to explore data linkage and to review whether the certificate exemption for workers can be lifted.
The RIVM is indeed reticent about making statements on the vaccination status of deceased persons.
Het RIVM is inderdaad terughoudend met het doen van mededelingen over de vaccinatiestatus van overleden personen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de uitgelekte contracten met Pfizer

An MP from FVD asked the health minister about leaked Pfizer supply contracts with Albania and Brazil, including confidentiality, liability, quality control and prices. The minister answered that he had not analysed the leaked documents, that the Dutch contracts are confidential, and that the state would bear any liability as usual.
The agreements are subject to confidentiality.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het karakter van, en de relaties van kabinetsleden met, het World Economic Forum naar aanleiding van antwoorden op eerdere vragen

An MP asked the Prime Minister how cabinet members come to be involved with the World Economic Forum, whether they are invited, how long involvement lasts, and for communication and records. The minister answered that the WEF selects and invites participants, that not all ministers are approached, that the government will provide correspondence and participation overviews by the BHOS budget debate, and that WEF goals are not government goals.
The cabinet is willing to grant access to the written communication between the cabinet and the WEF.
Het kabinet is graag bereid inzage te verlenen in de (schriftelijke) communicatie tussen het kabinet en het WEF.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Europese Handvest inzake Lokale Autonomie

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Interior whether the Netherlands recognises Article 11 of the European Charter of Local Self-Government, whether the Wet arhi complies with it, and whether municipalities can challenge a forced merger before a Dutch judge on that basis. The Minister answered yes to recognising the article, but explained that the Netherlands has a reservation excluding Article 11, so municipalities cannot invoke it and the Council of State confirmed this in 2011.
However, the Netherlands has made a reservation regarding, among other things, Article 11 of the Charter.
Nederland heeft echter bij onder andere artikel 11 van het Handvest een voorbehoud gemaakt
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vaccinatiedrang, het vaccineren van jongeren en het ‘trolleyprobleem’

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about pressure to vaccinate youth, claims that unvaccinated teens become second-class citizens, reported myocarditis risks from mRNA vaccines, long-term auto-immune risks, and the ethics of exposing minors to risk for others. The Minister answered that vaccination is voluntary for young people, that the Health Council advised vaccinating those aged 12 and over for their own health benefit, and that the government will avoid restricting choice while monitoring side effects through Lareb and the CBG.
vaccination against COVID-19 is voluntary for everyone, including young people
vaccinatie tegen COVID-19 voor iedereen vrijwillig is, dus ook voor jongeren
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het karakter van, en de relaties van kabinetsleden met, het World Economic Forum

Member Van Houwelingen asked the government about rumours of ties between cabinet members and the World Economic Forum, whether combating disinformation on this is important, what the exact relationship is, what the WEF's character is, and how its agenda fits Dutch interests. The government answered that the WEF is an independent public-private platform, that cabinet members' involvement follows from their policy responsibilities, and that such contacts can help achieve cabinet goals.
Involvement in WEF activities can help achieve parts of cabinet policy.
Betrokkenheid bij activiteiten van het WEF kan helpen bij het verwezenlijken van onderdelen van het kabinetsbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het bron- en contactonderzoek van de GGD

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health whether GGD contact tracing for positive COVID-19 cases is voluntary and whether staff are told this only when asked. The Minister confirmed contact tracing is voluntary, said the GGD work instructions do not require informing people only upon request, and promised to further publicise the voluntary nature on the government website.
Participation in contact tracing is voluntary. I will again bring this to attention on www.rijksoverheid.nl.
Deelname aan het bron- en contactonderzoek is vrijwillig. Dat zal ik op www.rijksoverheid.nl nogmaals onder de aandacht brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de ICcapaciteit

An MP asked the Minister of Health how much IC capacity was added since January 2020, how many beds may be needed in future, and why no large pandemic centres or emergency IC nurse training were set up. The minister answered that IC capacity rose to 1,700 beds (1,550 used at peak), that future bed needs are still being considered, and that separate COVID-only centres were rejected by hospitals as unworkable.
Decision-making on this is up to the new cabinet.
Besluitvorming hierover is aan het nieuwe kabinet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Houwelingen en Van Haga over de succesvolle toepassing van Ivermectine, het mogelijk beperkte effect van vaccineren en de prijs van uitgestelde zorg

MPs asked the minister about reported success of ivermectin for COVID-19, why GPs do not prescribe it, customs seizures, the threatened fine for off-label prescribing, trends in ICU admissions and deaths, and years of life lost from postponed non-COVID care. The minister answered that studies are for professional bodies to assess, that customs seizures follow the lack of licence, that fines follow the off-label rules, and that a reliable estimate of lost life-years is not possible.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de mogelijke herindeling van de gemeente Scherpenzeel

MP Van Houwelingen asked the Minister of Interior whether the Gelderland provincial executive's lobbying for a Scherpenzeel municipal merger had been sent to or discussed with the ministry. The minister confirmed awareness of the article, said the position paper was not sent to or discussed with the ministry, and noted that ministry contact with the municipalities and province has not covered it.
No. The document referred to in the article – the position paper on the Scherpenzeel/Barneveld merger process – was not sent to me nor discussed with me.
Nee. Het document waar in het artikel aan wordt gerefereerd – position paper herindelingstraject Scherpenzeel/Barneveld – is niet naar mij gestuurd of met mij besproken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het dragen van mondkapjes en de mondkapjesverplichting

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about harms of face masks, the litter they create, possible unintended behavioural effects, and why the mask obligation was introduced despite earlier advice against it. The minister replied that masks contribute together with other measures, that the obligation was chosen for clarity and enforceability, and that no further research on side effects is planned, though mask use is being phased back.
I see no reason for further research into side effects and/or the dangers of bacterial growth on face masks after prolonged use.
Ik zie geen aanleiding voor nader onderzoek naar neveneffecten en/of de gevaren van bacteriële groei op mondkapjes na langdurig gebruik.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over "de relatie van de regering met het FNV"

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether he condemns an FNV vice-chair's tweet suggesting that FvD was excluded from a union demonstration, and whether he will cease cooperation and subsidies with the FNV. The minister replied that the FNV is a private organisation that sets its own policy, that he has no role in its disagreements with political parties, and that he sees no reason to change his stance toward the FNV.
As Minister of SZW I have no role in that.
Als Minister van SZW heb ik daar geen rol in.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de website ‘Fit op jouw manier’

An MP from the FvD asks the State Secretary for Health about the 'Fit op jouw manier' lifestyle campaign website, including its cost, visitor numbers, and an overview of government information campaigns of the past three years. The State Secretary gives the campaign budget and media spend, the visitor count, and refers to the government's website and annual reports for campaign evaluations, without listing all campaigns.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de CoronaCheck-app en ‘testen voor toegang’

An MP from FvD asked the Minister of Health about the CoronaCheck app, whether paper certificates would remain available, DigiD requirements, the cost of 'testing for access', and whether the RIVM should advise on it. The Minister said paper proofs remain available, DigiD is needed only for GGD and vaccination data, costs are justified by faster reopening, and the OMT has already advised repeatedly on the policy.
The cabinet has not calculated what the costs per life-year gained would be.
Het kabinet heeft hierbij niet berekend wat de kosten per gewonnen levensjaar zouden zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het vaccinatieregister en (indirecte) vaccinatiedrang in de zorg

An MP from FvD asked the health minister whether the RIVM vaccination register holds data only with explicit consent, whether employers may require or pressure staff to be vaccinated, and whether care institutions may force unvaccinated staff to wear masks. The minister answered that data is registered only with consent, that vaccination is voluntary and employers may not require or pressure it, and that unvaccinated staff must wear masks like vaccinated staff in high-risk settings.
Yes, the RIVM only registers personal data if the person concerned has given consent for this.
Ja, het RIVM registreert alleen persoonsgegevens als daar toestemming voor is gegeven door de betrokken persoon.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over een dreigende gedwongen herindeling van de gemeente Scherpenzeel

An FvD MP asked the Minister of the Interior whether the proposed forced merger of Scherpenzeel lacks democratic support (over 80% of residents oppose it), whether it is unacceptable and conflicts with the European Charter of Local Self-Government, and which statutory or non-statutory tasks Scherpenzeel cannot perform. The Minister replied that she is following the case and will assess the merger advice once the provincial council decides on 7 July 2021, that municipalities can initiate mergers but remain dependent on legislation, and that she sees no conflict with the Charter if a proper process with consultation occurred, while the province must show evident capacity problems.
Only after the merger advice has been adopted by the provincial council and presented to me will I assess the advice against the substantive criteria of the Municipal Reorganisation Policy Framework.

Pas nadat het herindelingsadvies is vastgesteld door PS en aan mij is aangeboden, zal ik het advies beoordelen aan de hand van de inhoudelijke beoordelingscriteria van het Beleidskader gemeentelijk herindeling.
Antwoord op vragen het lid Van Houwelingen over het 'Jaarverslag VWS'

An FvD MP asked the health minister, medical care minister and state secretary about the 2020 VWS annual report: requests for Auditdienst Rijk audits, vaccine pricing under the Emergency Support Initiative, escalation procedures, a pending external accountant review of stocks, WNT pay-norm exceedances, correspondence with a public health foundation, and irregularities records. The answer is a cover letter referring the questions to a separate letter and attached report, without answering the questions in the text provided.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over vermelding van ‘Uitgeverij de Blauwe Tijger’ in het ‘Dreigingsbeeld Terrorisme Nederland 53’ van de NCTV en de mogelijke schending van de grondwettelijke vrijheid van d

An MP asked the Justice Minister why the NCTV threat assessment named the publisher De Blauwe Tijger, whether this threatens press freedom, and whether it could justify monitoring or detaining its journalists after an arrest. The minister replied that the publisher is mentioned only as an illustration of polarisation linked to anti-government sentiment, not as violent or dangerous, and declined to comment on individual cases or on whether the mention could trigger surveillance.
I do not make statements about individual cases.
Over individuele zaken doe ik geen uitspraken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de wachtlijstproblematiek in de jeugdpsychiatrie naar aanleiding van de mondelinge vraag van het lid Westerveld

An FvD MP asked whether youth psychiatric care use has risen over ten years and whether research should be commissioned into why. The State Secretary reported that youth care use grew about 3.2% a year but fell in 2020, that youth mental health care is not tracked separately, and that further research on outpatient youth care will be reported before summer, without a new study now.
Because the Youth Act aims to provide integrated help, no separate data is kept on youth mental health care.
Omdat de Jeugdwet beoogt integraal hulp te bieden, wordt er geen afzonderlijke data bijgehouden over de jeugd-ggz.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over registratie etniciteit universitair personeel

An FvD MP asked the ministers whether ethnicity is registered for university staff, how the CBS Barometer Culturele Diversiteit defines and operationalises it, and what data universities use. The minister answered that the barometer uses only pseudonymised existing records (birth date, sex, postcode, salary scale and similar) to derive migration background in aggregate, that employees are not asked to answer questions, and that employees can opt out by email.
Employees do not have to answer any questions for the Barometer Culturele Diversiteit, in line with the answer to your question 2.
Medewerkers hoeven, in lijn met het antwoord op uw vraag 2, in het kader van de Barometer Culturele Diversiteit geen vragen te beantwoorden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over de 43 zorgmedewerkers die door Nederland naar Curaçao zijn gestuurd

An MP asked whether healthcare in the Netherlands is short-staffed and overburdened, and why 43 Dutch healthcare workers were sent to Curaçao instead of being deployed at home. The Secretary of State said the Curaçao situation is very serious, that the staff volunteered via Extra Handen voor de Zorg, and that the deployment has no significant effect on Dutch care, while declining to say how the NVZ views it.
I would like to point out that the Netherlands does not 'send' people, but facilitates this deployment.
Ik hecht eraan op te merken dat Nederland geen mensen «stuurt», maar deze inzet faciliteert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen ver vaccinatiedwang en vaccinatiedrang, met name in relatie tot de invoering van de ‘Digital Green Pass’

Van Houwelingen (FvD) asked the health minister to define vaccination coercion and pressure, and how a proposed EU Digital Green Pass could create pressure on unvaccinated people through travel restrictions. The minister answered that vaccination must remain a free choice, that the government steers against both coercion and pressure, and that the EU certificate's use is left to member states, with no concrete definition or note promised.
I think it is important that it is and remains a free choice for people to be vaccinated.
Ik vind het belangrijk dat het een vrije keuze is en blijft voor mensen om zich te laten vaccineren.
Antwoord op de vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over het Vaccinatiebeleid

An MP from FvD asked the Health Minister about vaccine transmission, variant effectiveness, long-term side effects and whether vaccinating the whole population is wise, citing a newspaper interview with two doctors. The minister answered that transmission is reduced but not eliminated, vaccines appear effective against current variants, and the Health Council advice on transmission is pending.
I expect the GR to advise me on this in the second half of May.
Ik verwacht dat de GR mij hier in de tweede helft van mei over adviseert.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Houwelingen over (deels) opgeven Nederlands veto met betrekking tot het buitenlandbeleid van de EU

An MP from FvD asked the Foreign Minister about a Dutch-Spanish non-paper on EU open strategic autonomy that proposes extending qualified majority voting, and whether this amounts to giving up Dutch sovereignty and requires a referendum. The minister replied that the non-paper has no formal status, that QMV would be explored only in limited foreign policy areas such as human rights declarations and sanctions, and that no referendum or sovereignty-related study is planned.
The cabinet does not aim to switch from unanimity to QMV in other policy areas as well.
Het kabinet zet er niet op in ook op andere beleidsterreinen over te stappen van unanimiteitsbesluitvorming naar QMV.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Houwelingen en Van Haga over het vrijwillig laten vaccineren van mantelzorgers en de (geestelijk) gehandicapte personen die zij verzorgen

MPs Van Houwelingen and Van Haga asked why family caregivers are not given priority COVID-19 vaccination like care workers, and whether caregivers authorised to act for mentally disabled persons should decide on their charges' vaccination. Minister De Jonge answered that vaccination follows age and medical risk on Gezondheidsraad advice, and that a legal representative, never the caregiver, decides for incapable clients.
No, when a client is incapable of making such decisions, there is a legal representative who makes these decisions for the client.
Nee, op het moment dat een cliënt wilsonbekwaam ter zake is voor dergelijke beslissingen, is er een wettelijk vertegenwoordiger die deze beslissingen voor de cliënt neemt.

m: Motie van het lid Van der Velde over een expliciete diploma-eis voor de algemene rijksarchivaris
Van der Velde motion asks government to add an explicit diploma requirement for the national chief archivist in the Archives Act.
requests the government to amend the Archives Act 20XX so that an explicit diploma requirement is included
verzoekt de regering de Archiefwet 20XX zodanig te wijzigen dat er een expliciete diploma-eis wordt opgenomen
Motie van het lid Van der Velde over een duidelijke scheiding tussen de rol van archivaris en de rol van toezichthouder
Asks the government to examine separating the archivist's role from the supervisory role, so that an archivist does not supervise his or her own organisation's archive.
declares that it is undesirable for an archivist to simultaneously be the supervisor of his or her own archive within their own government body
spreekt uit dat het onwenselijk is dat een archivaris tegelijkertijd toezichthouder is op zijn of haar eigen archief binnen het eigen overheidsorgaan
Motie van het lid Van der Velde over het structurele (over)bieden van de NPO bij sportrechten tegengaan
Asks the government to curb NPO overbidding for sports broadcasting rights by promoting cooperation with commercial broadcasters and sublicensing.
requests the government to counter the structural overbidding by the NPO on sports rights
verzoekt de regering om het structurele (over)bieden van de NPO bij sportrechten tegen te gaan
Motie van het lid Van der Velde over bij de hervorming van het mediabestel actief alle relevante partijen betrekken om te komen tot een zo integraal en toekomstbestendig mogelijk mediabestel
Asks the government to involve all relevant parties, including commercial media firms, when reforming the media system and to support Dutch media.
requests the government to actively involve all relevant parties, including commercial media companies and other stakeholders, when reforming the media system
verzoekt de regering om bij de hervorming van het mediabestel actief alle relevante partijen, waaronder commerciële mediabedrijven en overige stakeholders, te betrekken
Motie van de leden Van der Velde en Van Zanten over termen als "moeder" en "vader" in wetsteksten behouden wanneer deze bijdragen aan de duidelijkheid en maatschappelijke herkenbaarheid van de wet
Asks the government to keep terms like 'moeder' and 'vader' in legal texts where they aid clarity and recognisability.
requests the government to retain terms such as 'mother' and 'father' in legal texts where this contributes to clarity and recognisability of the law
verzoekt de regering om in wetsteksten termen zoals «moeder» en «vader» te behouden wanneer dit bijdraagt aan de duidelijkheid en maatschappelijke herkenbaarheid van de wet
Motie van de leden Van der Velde en Van Zanten over terughoudend omgaan met zogenoemde inclusieve taal in regelgeving
Asks the government to use inclusive language in legislation sparingly, favouring neutral and generally applicable rules.
requests the government to be restrained in using so-called inclusive language in regulation
verzoekt de regering om terughoudend om te gaan met zogenoemde inclusieve taal in regelgeving
Motie van de leden Van der Velde en Emiel van Dijk over maatregelen treffen die de veiligheid bij culturele bijeenkomsten en uitingen die vallen onder immaterieel erfgoed waarborgen
Motion asking the minister to take measures to guarantee safety at cultural gatherings and expressions of intangible heritage, such as Sinterklaas processions, against threats.
requests the Minister, together with the Minister of Justice and Security, to take measures that safeguard safety at cultural gatherings and expressions falling under intangible heritage
verzoekt de Minister, in samenwerking met de Minister van JenV, maatregelen te treffen die de veiligheid bij culturele bijeenkomsten en uitingen die vallen onder immaterieel erfgoed waarborgen
Motie van de leden Van der Velde en Van Zanten over vestiging van culturele instellingen buiten de Randstad aantrekkelijker maken bij de volgende herverdeling van de BIS-middelen
Asks the government to consider population and per-capita funding, not only the number of cultural institutions, when redistributing BIS culture funds, to attract institutions outside the Randstad.
requests the government, at the next redistribution of BIS funds, to take into account not only the number of cultural institutions per region
verzoekt de regering om bij de eerstvolgende herverdeling van de BIS-middelen niet alleen rekening te houden met het aantal culturele instellingen per regio
Motie van de leden Van der Velde en Wilders over ervoor zorgen dat uitingen van de schutterijcultuur in Limburg en Brabant uitgevoerd kunnen blijven worden
Asks the government to do everything possible so that Limburg and Brabant shooting-guild cultural expressions can continue to be carried out.
requests the government to do everything to ensure these cultural expressions can continue to be carried out
verzoekt de regering er alles aan te doen om ervoor te zorgen dat deze culturele uitingen uitgevoerd kunnen blijven worden
qa: Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Velde over het bericht 'AVROTROS en NPO willen gesprek met EBU over 'basisprincipes' Songfestival'

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Israel's Eurovision delegation complied with EBU rules and whether its participation in 2026 should be opposed or boycotted. The Minister repeatedly declined to judge compliance, saying this is for the EBU and public broadcasters, and said the Netherlands would not rule out a boycott, as the decision lies with the broadcasters.
It is not for me as Minister to determine whether the Israeli delegation complied with the EBU rules during the Eurovision Song Contest.
Het is niet aan mij als Minister om vast te stellen of de Israëlische delegatie zich aan de EBU-regels heeft gehouden tijdens het Eurovisie Songfestival.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Emiel Van Dijk, Van der Velde en Wilders over het bericht ‘Ongehoord Nederland zoekt man of vrouw, ’geen X’, OM doet onderzoek naar discriminatie’
