Het Openbaar Ministerie stelt op eigen gezag en op basis van kenbare uitgangspunten strafrechtelijke onderzoeken in.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon en Van der Velde over de weigering van de Joods-Israëlische comedian Yohay Sponder door Amsterdamse club Boom Chicago en de toenemende onveiligheid voor Joodse artiesten in Nederland

PVV MPs asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether Boom Chicago should have reported threats and cooperated with police instead of cancelling Yohay Sponder's shows, whether the venue's antisemitic remark was shocking, and how the government will keep the cultural sector safe for Jewish artists. The minister agreed cancelling was regrettable, called the remark an unfortunate utterance, pointed to a VSCD incident protocol and inter-ministerial talks, and noted a Kunsten '92 project against antisemitism.

Further talks have been held between the Ministry of Education, Culture and Science, the Ministry of Justice and Security and the Association of Dutch Municipalities to guarantee access to the local triangle.

Er zijn verder gesprekken gevoerd tussen het Ministerie van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap, het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid en de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten om de toegang tot de lokale driehoek te waarborgen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Boon, Van der Velde en Heutink over ‘de onacceptabele uitsluiting van PVV-bewindspersonen door UN Women bij de aftrap van een campagne tegen geweld tegen vrouwen en meisjes in Enschede.’

PVV MPs asked whether UN Women excluded PVV state secretaries from a campaign launch against violence against women in Enschede because of their party affiliation, and whether this is acceptable. The government condemned unequal treatment on political grounds, said UN Women Nederland is an independent Dutch foundation rather than a UN body, and noted the Enschede municipality has withdrawn from the event.
If ministers are excluded because of their political affiliation, that is completely unacceptable.
Indien bewindslieden omwille van hun politieke affiliatie worden uitgesloten is dat volstrekt onaanvaardbaar.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van der Velde over Flock Together

An MP asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science whether a literary festival's walk and interview restricted to people of colour, funded with 357,659 euro in subsidy, is compatible with the constitutional non-discrimination clause and whether it will be prevented. The Minister answered that constitutional questions are not his to decide, that the event was open to all and merely encouraged participation by people of colour, and that the festival had revised its wording.
How organising an activity only for people of colour relates legally to the Constitution is not for me as Minister of Education, Culture and Science to determine.
Hoe het organiseren van een activiteit alleen voor mensen van kleur zich juridisch verhoudt tot de Grondwet, is niet aan mij als Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap om te bepalen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Palmen, White, Ceder, Bamenga, Van der Plas, Vedder, Van Nispen, Ergin, Van Houwelingen, Stoffer, Koekkoek, Eerdmans,Van der Velde en Martens-America over het rapport 'Geen afgesl

MPs asked the government to respond to the ACOI report on opening the Bijlmer air disaster archives, including timelines, a balancing-test commission, and whether oversight should sit with a single minister. The minister answers that 27 dossiers are being checked for release within about ten weeks, that a commission is proposed but not yet set up, and that the current division of responsibility between BZK and OCW is retained.
The aim is to complete the review of the 27 dossiers within 10 weeks.
Het streven is om het onderzoek naar de 27 dossiers binnen 10 weken af te ronden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Velde en Boon over het bericht 'WO II-voorstelling afgelast vanwege antisemitisme'

Two MPs asked whether cancelling a WWII performance due to antisemitism signals capitulation to anti-Jewish hatred and what role government plays in safeguarding cultural events. The State Secretary condemned such cancellations, said culture must remain free, and outlined cooperation with the sector, local security triangles and a forthcoming broader antisemitism approach.
It has been agreed that parties in the cultural sector will, in consultation with me, develop a general guideline and specific protocols with a clear directive.
Afgesproken is dat partijen in de cultuursector in overleg met mij komen tot een algemene handreiking en specifieke protocollen met een eenduidige richtlijn.

MPs asked whether the cancellation of Holocaust commemoration concerts due to antisemitic threats is unacceptable and what measures will be taken to keep such events going, and whether the sector's exposure to antisemitism will be mapped. The Staatssecretaris condemns antisemitism, says cultural events must not be cancelled over Jewish themes, and reports sector agreements on protocols and a round-table, while committing to inform parliament further on the antisemitism approach.
It has been agreed that parties in the cultural sector will, in consultation with me, develop a general guideline and specific protocols with a uniform directive.
Afgesproken is dat partijen in de cultuursector in overleg met mij komen tot een algemene handreiking en specifieke protocollen met een eenduidige richtlijn.

The state secretary replied that museums are independent institutions that set their own content, that the costs of the meet-up are not available at the ministry, and that subsidy conditions do not govern content, so no action was committed.
Museums are independent institutions that make their own choices about the content and manner of exhibiting.
Musea zijn zelfstandige instellingen die eigen keuzes maken over de inhoud en wijze van tentoonstellen.

No. Naming of streets is a matter for the municipality.
Nee. Naamgeving van straten is een zaak van de gemeente.

to give residents of municipalities outside the current noise contours the same rights and options

Motie van het lid Kröger c.s. over beleidsdoelen voor de vliegtaks
Asks the government to set policy goals with the House for the planned aviation tax before designing it.
requests the government to set policy goals for this measure together with the House
verzoekt de regering om, met de Kamer beleidsdoelen vast te stellen voor deze maatregel

Met dit amendement worden de 30%-regeling en het Lage Inkomens Voordeel (LIV) afgeschaft.

Abolishes the tax on tap water by removing the relevant chapter and tax provisions from the bill.

requests the government to map broadly the effectiveness and efficiency of national and municipal income support and the adequacy of the social minimum

in the usual purchasing power reports also include the median purchasing power development of pensioners by birth cohort
in de gebruikelijke rapportages over de koopkracht óók de mediane koopkrachtontwikkeling van gepensioneerden op basis van geboortecohorten op te nemen

requests the government to take off the table the 500 million cut on people with disabilities

requests the government to slow the increase of the AOW age and bring it back in line with the agreements made before the acceleration act

to fully uphold the property right of existing pension claims of workers and pensioners, as laid down in article 83 of the Pensioenwet
het eigendomsrecht van bestaande pensioenaanspraken van werkenden en gepensioneerden, zoals vastgelegd in artikel 83 van de Pensioenwet, integraal te handhaven

requests the government to freeze the AOW age at 67 in 2021
verzoekt de regering om, de AOW-leeftijd in 2021 te bevriezen op 67 jaar

calls on the government to refrain entirely from the cost-sharing norm
roept de regering, op geheel af te zien van de kostendelersnorm
Motie van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over bevriezen van de AOW-leeftijd op 66 jaar
Asks the government to freeze the AOW pension age at 66 in 2018.
requests the government to freeze the AOW age at 66 in 2018
verzoekt de regering, om de AOW-leeftijd in 2018 te bevriezen op 66 jaar

requests the government to lower the AOW age to 65

Asks the government to reconsider and lower the maximum interest rate on municipal social credit for financially vulnerable people.
calls on the government to reconsider and lower the maximum interest rate for municipal social credit for people who are financially vulnerable
roept de regering op, de maximale rentetariefstelling voor gemeentelijke sociale kredietverlening te heroverwegen en te verlagen voor mensen die financieel kwetsbaar zijn

not to allow the linking of the AOW age to life expectancy from 2022 to proceed
de koppeling van de AOW-leeftijd aan de levensverwachting vanaf 2022 geen doorgang te laten vinden

Asks the government to evaluate the adequacy, accessibility, efficiency and effectiveness of minimum-income policy and report to the House before Budget Day 2018.
broadly evaluate the adequacy, accessibility, efficiency and effectiveness of the minimum-income policy
toereikendheid, toegankelijkheid, efficiëntie en effectiviteit van het minimabeleid breed te evalueren
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over het afspiegelingsbeginsel bij doorstart van ondernemingen
Asks the government to examine how the seniority-based selection principle could play a larger role when companies are taken over in a restart after bankruptcy, and report within six months.
calls on the government to examine how the afspiegelingsbeginsel could play a more prominent role in restarts of businesses
roept de regering op, na te gaan hoe het afspiegelingsbeginsel bij doorstart van ondernemingen een meer prominente rol kan krijgen
Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Jasper van Dijk c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 16 over het ongedaan maken van de korting op de Wajong
Amendment reversing the 5% cut to Wajong benefits for disabled young people by shifting 50 million euro from the unallocated budget item to the Wajong item.
This amendment reverses the cut to the benefit for disabled young people receiving Wajong benefits.
Dit amendement maakt de korting op de uitkering voor jonggehandicapten met een Wajong uitkering ongedaan.
Motie van het lid Van Brenk c.s. over het budget voor de bijstand
Asks the cabinet, in consultation with the VNG, to offer structural and one-off solutions for municipal shortfalls in welfare budgets and report to the House within six months.
in good consultation with the VNG to offer one-off and structural solutions for the financial shortfalls
in goed overleg met de VNG incidentele en structurele oplossingen te bieden voor de financiële tekorten

Asks the government to consult social partners and interest groups on a workable alternative to wage-cost dispensation that preserves pension and unemployment benefit rights.
requests the government to consult social partners and interest organisations to arrive at a workable alternative to wage dispensation for everyone
verzoekt de regering, in overleg te gaan met sociale partners en belangenorganisaties om tot een voor iedereen werkbaar alternatief voor loondispensatie te komen
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over de generieke sollicitatieplicht voor 55-plussers
Calls on the government to reconsider the generic job-search obligation for unemployed people aged 55 and over and propose better tailored rules within six months.
calls on the government to reconsider the generic job-search obligation for people aged 55 or older and unemployed for more than a year
roept de regering op, de generieke sollicitatieplicht voor mensen die 55 jaar of ouder zijn en méér dan een jaar werkloos, te heroverwegen

Asks the government to let the strong economic growth translate more into disposable income growth, balancing workers, pensioners and benefit recipients.
requests the government to let the current spectacular economic growth be expressed much more in growth of disposable incomes
verzoekt de regering om, de huidige spectaculaire groei van de economie aanzienlijk meer tot uitdrukking te laten komen in groei van besteedbare inkomens
Motie van het lid Voortman c.s. over categorale bijstand voor arme gezinnen
Asks the government to discuss with VNG whether categorical assistance for poor families could reduce bureaucracy and reach target groups.
requests the government to discuss with the VNG whether the option of categorical assistance for families could reduce problems and bureaucracy
verzoekt de regering, met de Vereniging van Nederlandse Gemeenten te bespreken of de mogelijkheid om voor gezinnen categorale bijstand in te kunnen zetten
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over een persoonlijke ontwikkelrekening voor iedereen
Asks the government to develop the individual learning account into a personal development account open to everyone, regardless of having a starting qualification.
calls on developing the individual learning account proposed in the coalition agreement into a personal development account for everyone
roept op de in het regeerakkoord voorgestelde individuele leerrekening uit te werken als een persoonlijke ontwikkelrekening voor iedereen
Motie van het lid Van Brenk over certificering van scootmobielen
Asks the government to examine whether certification of mobility scooters would improve road safety.
requests the government to examine, for example in the SWOV study, whether some form of certification improves road safety
verzoekt de regering te onderzoeken, bijvoorbeeld in het onderzoek van de SWOV, of een vorm van certificering de verkeersveiligheid bevordert
Motie van het lid Van Raan c.s. over het uniformeren van milieuzones
Asks the government, when harmonising environmental zones, to follow the German model with nationally set emission classes and locally set zone size.
requests the government, when harmonising environmental zones, to take the German system as an example.
verzoekt de regering, bij het uniformeren van milieuzones een voorbeeld te nemen aan het Duitse systeem
Motie van het lid Van Raan c.s. over de luchtkwaliteitsnormen
Asks the government to remove all remaining bottlenecks on air quality norms by the end of Q1 2018, in compliance with the court order.
requests the government to remove all remaining bottlenecks as soon as possible, by the end of Q1 2018
verzoekt de regering, zo snel mogelijk, uiterlijk voor het einde van eerste kwartaal van 2018, alle resterende knelpunten te hebben weggenomen
Amendement van de leden Brenk en Van Rooijen over het terugdraaien van de 5% korting voor Wajongers
Amendment reverses a 5% benefit cut for Wajongers with limited work capacity, adding about 45 million euro to the budget for youth disability benefits.
This amendment reverses the 5% cut on benefits for Wajongers with limited work capacity from 1 January 2018.
Dit amendement maakt de korting per 1 januari 2018 met 5% op de uitkering voor Wajongers (met beperkt arbeidsvermogen) ongedaan.
Amendement van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over structurele verhoging van de AOW met 2%
Amendment raises the departmental budget for Rijksbijdragen by 700,000 thousand euro so that AOW pensions rise about 2% in 2018, structurally, leaving the method to the minister.
This amendment provides that the AOW is increased by about 2.0% for the whole of 2018 and in that year.
Dit amendement regelt dat de AOW voor en in het jaar 2018 met ongeveer 2,0% voor het hele jaar wordt verhoogd.
Motie van het lid Laçin c.s. over de aanpak van opkomende stoffen in relatie tot (drink)waterkwaliteit
Asks the government to address emerging substances in drinking water quality in the coalition agreement and to draw up an action plan with milestones.
requests the government to include the problem of emerging substances for drinking water quality in elaborating the coalition agreement
verzoekt de regering, de problematiek van opkomende stoffen ten aanzien van de (drink)waterkwaliteit te betrekken bij de uitwerking van het regeerakkoord
Motie van de leden Van Brenk en Laçin over verbetering van de kennisdeling over gevaarlijke stoffen
Asks the government to work toward better sharing of knowledge about hazardous substances, preferably at EU level.
that it is currently not mandatory for companies to share relevant knowledge about hazardous substances
dat het momenteel niet verplicht is voor bedrijven om relevante kennis over gevaarlijke stoffen te delen
Motie van het lid Van Brenk over verlengen van de green deal Grondstoffen
Asks the government to extend and where possible tighten the green deal on raw materials with the water boards, which expires at the end of 2017.
requests the government to extend this green deal and, where possible, tighten it
verzoekt de regering, deze green deal te verlengen en zo mogelijk aan te scherpen
Motie van het lid Yeşilgöz-Zegerius c.s. over een transparante effectiviteitsmeting inzake het programma Aanpak schijnconstructies en cao-naleving
Asks the government to set up a transparent effectiveness measurement for the programme against sham constructions and collective agreement compliance.
requests the government to set up a transparent effectiveness measurement so the programme's progress can be monitored
verzoekt de regering, een transparante effectiviteitsmeting in te stellen zodat gemonitord kan worden hoe het programma verloopt
Motie van het lid Raemakers c.s. over voor de SZW-begrotingsbehandeling de Kamer informeren over de UWV-kandidatenverkenner
Asks the government to inform the Chamber, before the SZW budget debate, about the status of releasing the UWV candidate-explorer application to municipalities and its use.
requests the government, before the budget debate for Social Affairs and Employment, to inform the Chamber about the state of affairs
verzoekt de regering, voor de begrotingsbehandeling van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid de Kamer te informeren over de stand van zaken
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Struijs over het artikel 'Schrijnend beeld: gepensioneerden zien inkomen al jaren achterblijven ten opzichte van anderen'

Members Van Brenk and Struijs (50PLUS) asked the Minister of Social Affairs about an article showing pensioners' income lagging behind workers, the self-employed and benefit recipients, and about indexation of pensions compared with other EU countries. The minister confirmed the CBS figures but argued the article overstates the gap, attributed the lag mainly to limited indexation of supplementary pensions under the old system, rejected the age-discrimination claim, and promised a balanced purchasing-power outlook.
It is not possible to provide the requested information on the basis of publicly accessible data.
Het is niet mogelijk om op basis van publiek toegankelijke data de gevraagde informatie te verstrekken.
Antwoord op vragen de leden Laçin, Paterenotte, Kröger, Van Brenk, Öztürk en Gijs van Dijk over de openstelling van de coronateststraat op Schiphol voor werknemers

MPs from SP, D66, GroenLinks, 50PLUS, DENK and PvdA asked why Schiphol workers who develop symptoms cannot be tested at the airport's test facility, whether the government will talk with the GGD and Schiphol, and how often the labour inspectorate checks Covid measures at Schiphol. The answer is a reference to a separate letter on the Covid situation, so the substance is not answered in this document.
The written questions ... have been answered by means of the letter <Status of COVID-19> (Parliamentary paper 25 295, no. 1422).
De schriftelijke vragen ... zijn beantwoord middels brief <Stand van zaken COVID-19> (Kamerstuk 25 295, nr. 1422 ).
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de uitzending van Zembla inzake financiële ouderenmishandeling

An MP from 50PLUS asked the health minister about a Zembla broadcast on financial elder abuse, including its prevalence, whether it rises with Covid, prosecution rates, and why not every municipality has an active local alliance. The state secretary answered that municipalities hold the legal responsibility, that no national steering is planned, that local alliances are valued and will be encouraged, and that a consultation with municipalities and elderly organisations is planned.
I am therefore not intending to take specific actions aimed at realising alliances in all municipalities, or to set up actions as part of national steering of the approach.

Ik ben dan ook niet voornemens om specifieke acties in te zetten gericht op het realiseren van allianties in alle gemeenten, of om acties op te zetten als onderdeel van landelijke aansturing van de aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel 'Leiding Waternet probeert verantwoordelijkheid voor digitaal wanbeleid te lozen'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that Accenture, Waternet's long-time IT consultant, and a later IT architect produced reviews of Waternet's digital security that lacked independence and found serious weaknesses. The Minister declined to judge the advisers' independence, said the ILT inspection is examining Waternet's governance and drinking-water aspects and is expected to report in March 2021, and deferred questions on the EUR 28 million digitalisation spending to Waternet and its board.
From my system responsibility, it is not appropriate for me to judge the engagement of advisers by Waternet and the Foundation board.
Vanuit mijn systeemverantwoordelijkheid past het mij niet een oordeel te geven over het inschakelen van adviseurs door Waternet en het Stichtingsbestuur.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Pensioenfondsen vrezen verlaging van pensioenen in de komende jaren'

MP Van Brenk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about pension funds fearing pension cuts after 2021, including the discount rate, monetary policy effects and the transition to the new pension system. The minister answered that transition rules may require cuts for some funds but aim to ease them, and defended the current discount-rate framework while acknowledging the trade-offs.
My main starting point for the transition FTK is the move to the new pension system.
Mijn belangrijkste uitgangspunt bij het transitie-ftk is de overstap naar het nieuwe pensioenstelsel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk, Stoffer en Gijs van Dijk over reisbeperkingen

MPs from several parties asked the Infrastructure and Water Management and Justice ministers about travel restrictions on non-essential trips, including how Finland and Belgium's border measures fit EU law, whether Dutch legal frameworks allow similar restrictions, and whether the OMT should be asked for advice. The government answered that it considers a ban on non-essential travel disproportionate, legally vulnerable and hard to enforce, has already adopted other measures, and that the OMT judged additional flight bans unnecessary, providing a country overview in an annex.
The cabinet therefore considers it currently not proportionate, legally vulnerable and difficult to enforce to prohibit non-essential travel.
Het kabinet acht het derhalve op dit moment niet proportioneel, juridisch kwetsbaar en moeilijk uitvoerbaar om niet-noodzakelijke reizen te verbieden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Pensioenen AVH toch naar PGB, ondanks tweede rechtszaak'

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the collective transfer of AVH pension fund to PGB despite a negative advisory council opinion and court rulings, questioning the handling of participants' rights and the works council's role. The minister answers that the legal safeguards and court review functioned as intended, that the board may depart from a negative advice if it motivates the decision, and that the Ondernemingskamer found the board acted reasonably.
The system of protective norms and judicial review has, in my view, worked.
Het systeem van beschermende normen en toetsing door de rechter heeft wat mij betreft gewerkt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de notitie 'Position paper juridische aspecten pensioenakkoord deel II'

Van Brenk (50PLUS) asked the minister whether the compulsory participation scheme for Dutch sector pension funds, and its EU-law justification, is discriminatory, and whether a separate EU-law test should be done. Minister Koolmees rejected the discrimination and EU-violation claims, said the Lutjens analysis was a research assignment, and declined an extra EU-law test, pointing to the Council of State advice.
The Council of State's advice will be taken into account in the bill that will be submitted for parliamentary consideration.
Het advies van de Raad van State zal worden betrokken in het wetsvoorstel dat voor parlementaire behandeling zal worden ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn stapt na miljardenverlies uit oliemarkt'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether pensioner fund PFZW speculated on oil prices through futures and whether reports of it exiting the oil market were accurate. The minister answered that pension funds may use derivatives only for hedging or efficient portfolio management, that speculation is not allowed, that PFZW was already winding down its commodity holdings, and that DNB supervises this.
Speculative use of derivatives is not allowed.
Speculatieve inzet van derivaten mag niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte, Kröger, Bruins, Remco Dijkstra, Amhaouch, Gijs van Dijk, Van Brenk, Laçin, Stoffer, Krol, Van Kooten-Arissen en Van Raan over een overvol Schiphol

Opposition MPs asked the government about overcrowding and queues at Schiphol, adherence to COVID-19 distancing rules, travel advice, the Brexit and testing effects on arrivals, and whether flight bans or test facilities would be used. The ministers answered that Schiphol is required to prevent queues and enforce rules, that a flight ban is currently undesirable, and that testing and an air corridor pilot are being developed, with several questions combined.
We asked Schiphol for clarification and said they must take action to ensure the measures are complied with.
Wij hebben Schiphol om opheldering gevraagd en gezegd dat zij actie moeten ondernemen om te zorgen dat de maatregelen worden nageleefd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het Internationaal Certificaat voor Pleziervaartuigen (ICP)

An MP asked the minister about misuse of the Dutch ICP pleasure-craft certificate by criminals and foreigners to evade tax, and whether a lighter alternative to the zeebrief could be introduced. The minister agreed misuse is unacceptable, promised tighter application checks and an end to issuing ICPs to non-Dutch non-residents from 2021, and said the ICP cannot be used for tax evasion since it is not an official registration, while keeping the certificate itself and exploring alternatives only for countries that do not accept it.
To counter misuse, I have been in consultation with the associations that issue the ICP and the police since May of this year on tightening the procedures.
Om misbruik tegen te gaan ben ik met de bonden die het ICP afgeven en de politie sinds mei van dit jaar in overleg over een aanscherping van de procedures.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel 'Leiding Waternet verzwijgt vernietigende veiligheidstest'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why Waternet did not inform the ILT of a critical penetration test, whether the board was informed, and whether the incident was reported to the NCSC. The minister answered that the ILT was not informed before publication, that it would have been appropriate to inform it, that an ILT investigation is underway, and that pen-tests are not reportable under the Wbni.

However, given the current circumstances, it would have been appropriate for the ILT to have been informed in good time by Waternet, even though there was at that time no legal obligation or specific request from the ILT to do so.

Het was echter, gegeven de actuele omstandigheden, passend geweest als de ILT tijdig was ingelicht door Waternet, ook al was er op dat moment geen wettelijke verplichting of concreet verzoek vanuit de ILT om dat te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Sazias over de ontwikkelingen rondom het coronavirus in verpleeghuizen

MPs Van Brenk and Sazias asked about ventilation checks in nursing homes, compliance with standards, repairs, and wastewater surveillance for coronavirus. The minister answered that institutions are responsible for their own ventilation, that no national figures on checked or repaired systems exist, and that wastewater sampling was increased to twice weekly with pilots underway.
I cannot give an estimate of how many ventilation systems have or have not been adapted and what period is still needed for this.
Ik kan geen inschatting geven van hoeveel ventilatiesystemen wel of niet zijn aangepast en welke periode hiervoor nog nodig is.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden van Brenk en Laçin over de piek in legionellabesmettingen

MPs Van Brenk and Laçin asked the minister about a July 2020 peak in Legionella infections, whether the RIVM's weather explanation was sound, and whether the government would fund research, campaigns and clinician awareness. The minister answered that the peak is linked to weather conditions, that no common source cluster was found, and that existing prevention and testing guidance is adequate, while committing to continued monitoring and expanded source-tracing.
There are no indications that Legionella infections are being overlooked more often at this time.
Er zijn geen aanwijzingen dat legionellabesmettingen in deze tijd vaker over het hoofd worden gezien.
Antwoord op vragen van leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk en Van Esch over het bericht ‘Onnodig veel gevaarlijke stoffen in rivieren: lozingsvergunningen flink verouderd’

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that hazardous substances such as benzene, lead and vinyl chloride still enter rivers under outdated discharge permits, asking about drinking water effects, how many permits are outdated, BBT compliance, monitoring, and Rijkswaterstaat's capacity and priorities. The minister answered that the three substances did not exceed EU water norms in 2017-2019, that about three quarters of roughly 800 permits need adjustment, that a multi-year structural approach with periodic review every 4 to 8 years will be implemented, and that the advisory report is attached.
In about 50% of the permits reviewed in the pilot, there were discharges of ZZS.
Bij circa 50% van de vergunningen die in de pilot zijn bezien, was er sprake van lozingen van ZZS.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel 'Strengere controle coronaregels in het OV'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management how a public transport campaign aiming for 80% of pre-corona ridership fits with government advice to work from home and avoid crowds, and about ventilation and mask measures. The State Secretary answered that the campaign was halted on 25 September, that the 80% target was about ridership rather than vehicle occupancy and is no longer realistic, and that ventilation problems would lead to vehicles not being deployed.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid van Brenk over de staat van onderhoud van het Kanaal van Gent naar Terneuzen en wateroverlast in Sluiskil

An MP from 50PLUS asked why the Stichting Wateroverlast Sluiskil received no timely replies to its letters about water nuisance from the Ghent-Terneuzen canal, and what action would be taken. The minister acknowledged the delays, said Rijkswaterstaat will meet the foundation and the municipality, but stated that the canal's water level is set by a treaty unchanged since the 1960s and that no further maintenance measures are available or planned.
Rijkswaterstaat invites the foundation for a conversation.
Rijkswaterstaat nodigt de stichting uit voor een gesprek.

Antwoord op vragen van de van de leden Kröger, Laçin, van Raan, Gijs van Dijk van Brenk over reizigers die vanuit Nederland met het vliegtuig naar gebieden vertrekken waarvoor een oranje reisadvies geldt

MPs asked how many travellers fly from the Netherlands to orange-advice destinations, how many are non-essential, and whether low fares undermine the advice. The minister reported about 39,928 non-transfer passengers from Schiphol in one week, said travel purpose is not recorded, and wrote to airlines and travel associations urging them not to promote such trips.
Under privacy regulations, transport companies do not record the intention or purpose of the traveller's journey.
Op grond van de privacyregelgeving registreren vervoersbedrijven niet de intentie dan wel het doel van de reis van de reiziger.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de buurtbussen die niet rijden

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management why neighbourhood buses remain suspended in sparsely populated areas during COVID-19, and whether protective measures, alternatives and urgent action are possible. The State Secretary acknowledged the problem, said operators and TNO are testing protective measures subject to RDW approval, and pointed to regional alternatives while leaving the responsibility for these services with decentralised authorities.
The decentralised governments are, among other things through concessions, responsible for deploying neighbourhood buses.
De decentrale overheden zijn, onder andere via concessies, verantwoordelijk voor de inzet van buurtbussen.
Antwoord op ragen van de leden Kröger, Paternotte, Gijs van Dijk, Van Raan, Öztürk, Bruins, Amhaouch, Laçin, Van Kooten-Arissen, Van Brenk en Stoffer over de teststraat op Schiphol

Eleven MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the Schiphol COVID-19 test facility should be scaled up and extended to match arrivals from orange-code countries such as Spain and France, and whether all travellers from those areas could be tested on arrival at Dutch airports. The answer, sent via a letter from Minister De Jonge, refers to the broader testing and tracing letter and does not address the specific questions.

The written questions from the eleven MPs to the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management, submitted 27 August 2020, have been answered by a letter titled 'Testing and tracing: together strategically combating the Corona pandemic'.

De schriftelijke vragen van de leden Kröger (GroenLinks), Paternotte (D66), Gijs van Dijk (PvdA), Van Raan (PvdD), Öztürk (Denk), Bruins (ChristenUnie), Amhaouch (CDA), Laçin (SP), Van Kooten-Arissen (Van Kooten-Arissen), Van Brenk (50PLUS) en Stoffer (SGP) aan de Minister van Infrastructuur en Waterstaat ingezonden 27 augustus 2020, zijn beantwoord middels brief «Testen en traceren: samen strategisch de Corona-pandemie bestrijden».
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het omwisselen van rijbewijzen in de nieuwsbrief van de Stichting Nederlanders Buiten Nederland

MP Van Brenk asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a Dutch resident in France whose licence, exchanged from a non-EU (Indonesian) licence, could not be re-exchanged, and how many others may be affected and whether EU acceptance rules will be synchronised. The minister confirmed the case, estimated that about 1.4% of Dutch licences carry the non-EU annotation without knowing how many are affected, said the RDW will inform holders on its website, and said the issue has been raised with the European Commission seeking more harmonisation in the upcoming directive review.
I have asked the RDW to inform licence holders via its website about the possibility that an exchanged licence will not in all cases be accepted in other EU countries.
Ik heb de RDW gevraagd om rijbewijshouders via haar website te informeren over de mogelijkheid dat een omgewisseld rijbewijs in andere EU-landen niet in alle gevallen wordt geaccepteerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Van Brenk over het protocol Veilig Zorgvervoer

Two 50PLUS MPs asked why scootmobiles were excluded from care transport under the sector protocol 'Veilig Zorgvervoer', citing extra contact moments and reduced mobility. The Minister explained the exclusion was a temporary safety measure to limit contact, noted that scootmobiles were allowed again from 1 July 2020, and said the protocol is a living document.
Owing to the easing of corona measures from 1 July 2020, the sector protocol for care transport now allows scootmobiles to be taken again in care transport, including the regiotaxi.

Mede door de versoepeling van coronamaatregelen per 1 juli 2020 is in het sectorprotocol voor zorgvervoer opgenomen dat scootmobielen weer in het zorgvervoer, waaronder de regiotaxi, meegenomen kunnen worden
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Meer ontslagen na invoering nieuwe Arbeidsmarktwet'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether the rise in dismissal applications in early 2020, linked to the new WAB labour market law, disproportionately affects older workers and whether it was intended. The minister answered that the increase is likely a temporary anticipation effect, that data on age is not kept, and that the WAB aims to make permanent contracts more attractive, while pointing to existing support programmes for older jobseekers.
For dismissal applications on economic grounds or long-term incapacity, UWV does not keep statistics on age.
Bij de ontslagaanvragen wegens bedrijfseconomische redenen of langdurige arbeidsongeschiktheid worden door UWV geen statistieken bijgehouden over leeftijd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht dat een groep externe deskundigen zich niet serieus genomen voelt

An MP asked the Minister of Justice and Security to respond to external experts who feel ignored after the government adopted the Fire Safety Institute's (IFV) position on fireworks, and whether he would reconsider, conduct additional research on subclass 1.4, or re-examine the fire adviser's expertise. The minister stood by the IFV-based report, said the dissenting experts' view was insufficiently substantiated, and refused further research or talks.
The researchers concluded that this opinion was insufficiently substantiated.
Door de onderzoekers is geconcludeerd dat die mening onvoldoende is onderbouwd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de brief van Pensioenfonds PFZW aan de voormalige deelnemers van de Accent-regeling

MP Van Brenk asks the minister about a PFZW letter to former Accent-scheme members reporting a recalculation of pensions with a retirement age of 67 and a correction, and whether this is lawful and consistent with prior commitments. The minister answers that the collective actuarially neutral recalculation raises pensions, that the correction was not caused by it and has been reversed, that administrative errors may be corrected, and that disputes belong with the fund, the Pensions Ombudsman or the courts.
It is not for me to intervene in this.
Het is niet aan mij om hier te interveniëren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over "mogelijke ondersteuning van AOW-gerechtigde zelfstandig ondernemers die in de knel komen door de coronacrisis"

An MP asked why self-employed people who have reached the AOW pension age are excluded from the Tozo income support and whether this age distinction is justified. The Staatssecretaris answered that a pension-age safety net (AOW and AIO) guarantees income up to the social minimum, so the age distinction is justified, while such entrepreneurs may still access business-capital loans.
Self-employed persons who have reached the AOW-entitled age therefore do not qualify for living-cost assistance under the Tozo.
Zelfstandige ondernemers die de AOW-gerechtigde leeftijd hebben bereikt, komen om die reden niet in aanmerking voor bijstand voor levensonderhoud op grond van de Tozo.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de beheersing van legionellarisico’s in verband met de opstart van bedrijven en instellingen na de coronacrisis

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management how public buildings reopening after COVID-19 closures will prevent Legionella contamination in water systems, and what agreements and communication channels exist. The minister answered that the Inspectorate has informed priority and non-priority sectors, that responsibility lies with owners and operators, and that communication will continue.
It is the responsibility of the owners and operators of the locations to control the risk of Legionella contamination.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de eigenaren en exploitanten van de locaties om het risico op legionellabesmetting te beheersen
Antwoord op vragen van lid Van Brenk vragen over het artikel ‘Openbaar Vervoer Nederland: richtlijnen nodig voor wie met ov mag reizen’.

Van Brenk (50PLUS) asked the state secretary about OVNL's proposals for passenger capacity and rules on who may travel by public transport during COVID-19. The government answered that it has agreed a public transport protocol with the sector, is seeking spreading of travel times, and will work out cost compensation and further arrangements in the coming weeks.
The cabinet has asked the public transport sector to run the full timetable in the Netherlands, while passenger numbers are limited.
Het kabinet heeft de OV-sector verzocht in Nederland de volledige dienstregeling te rijden, terwijl de reizigersaantallen beperkt zijn.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Vewin: Indicatieve Niveaus voor Ernstige Verontreiniging voor PFAS bieden onvoldoende bescherming voor drinkwater’

An MP asked the minister whether the RIVM's higher indicative serious-contamination levels (INEVs) for PFAS in groundwater, which exceed drinking water standards, were justified and whether they undermine drinking water protection. The state secretary replied that INEVs and drinking water standards serve different protection goals, that the INEVs will be revised after EFSA's evaluation, and that a hotspot inventory and action plan are underway with results promised by year-end.
I will share the outcomes with you before the end of the year, together with the definitive PFAS action framework and the agreements with decentralised governments on possible financial consequences.
De uitkomsten hiervan deel ik voor het einde van het jaar met u gelijktijdig met het definitieve handelingskader PFAS en de afspraken met decentrale overheden over eventuele financiële consequenties.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over tolheffing bij de Westerscheldetunnel in Zeeuws-Vlaanderen

An MP asked the minister about toll collection at the Westerscheldetunnel during the COVID-19 crisis, whether it should be toll-free, and about cross-border emergency care and ambulance passage at the Liefkenshoek tunnel. The minister answered that the Westerscheldetunnel remains the access route and that toll decisions rest with the province and the tunnel directorate, while describing existing rules for emergency vehicles and cross-border care.
The Provincial States of Zeeland, as shareholder of the Westerscheldetunnel, decides on the toll framework.
Provinciale staten van de Provincie Zeeland besluit als aandeelhouder van de Westerscheldetunnel over het tolheffingskader.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Nieuwe coronavirus aangetroffen in rioolwater‘

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports of the new coronavirus found in sewage, including worker protection, water treatment, and whether wastewater plants were classed as vital infrastructure. The minister answered that existing protective measures apply, that there is no evidence of transmission via water, and that wastewater plants were not designated vital after a vitality assessment, with further RIVM research requested.
To confirm this and gain more certainty, I have asked the RIVM to conduct research on this.
Om dit te bevestigen en meer zekerheid te krijgen heb ik het RIVM gevraagd om onderzoek hier naar te doen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Nabestaandenpensioen in gevaar door coronavirus‘

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether negative travel advice over COVID-19 could lead insurers to refuse survivors' pensions and other policies, and whether uncertainty about this was acceptable. The minister replied that employers must follow RIVM and travel advice, that the insurers' association confirmed deaths from the virus will not affect payouts, and that the association's website addresses these questions.
The Verbond van Verzekeraars has confirmed that a death caused by the coronavirus has no consequences for payouts under life insurance, funeral insurance and survivors' pensions.

Door het Verbond van Verzekeraars is bevestigd dat het feit dat iemand overleden is door het coronavirus geen gevolgen heeft voor de uitkeringen uit hoofde van levensverzekeringen, uitvaartverzekeringen en nabestaandenpensioen.
Antwoord op de vragen van de leden Krol, Sazias, Van Brenk en Van Otterloo over alle berichtgeving omtrent het coronavirus

Four 50PLUS MPs asked a range of questions about COVID-19 coverage, care for the elderly and family carers, unemployment benefits, the economy and EU financing, and emergency powers and enforcement. The government answered most questions substantively, commits to several concrete steps, and declines to say whether a state of emergency will be declared, pointing instead to ordinary crisis structures.
The cabinet took a decision on this on Tuesday 31 March.
Het kabinet heeft hier op dinsdag 31 maart jl. een besluit over genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin en Van Brenk over granuliet

MPs Kröger, Laçin and Van Brenk asked the Minister for Environment and Housing about the classification of granuliet as soil and the use of granuliet with flocculant (polyacrylamide) in the Over de Maas project, including ecological and environmental risks. The minister answers that granuliet has been classed as soil since 2009 under the Soil Quality Decree, that tests show no harmful effects, and that an independent review will be carried out with the municipality and province.

To remove this concern, I will, in consultation with the municipality and province, have an independent study carried out into the consequences for people and the environment of using granuliet in the Over de Maas project.

Om deze ongerustheid weg te nemen zal ik, in overleg met de gemeente en provincie, een onafhankelijk onderzoek laten uitvoeren naar de gevolgen voor mens en milieu van het gebruik van granuliet in het project Over de Maas.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over legionellapreventie bij afvalwaterzuiveringsinstallaties

An MP asks the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about RIVM reports on Legionella spread from wastewater treatment plants, including whether measures, inspection and worker risks are adequate. The minister answers that prevention is primarily the responsibility of water boards and operators, that current measures and inspections are sufficient, that the Labour Inspectorate's risk-based planning did not rank Legionella highly, and that no binding new measures are planned.
It is up to the water boards and companies operating wastewater treatment plants themselves to determine which preventive measures are taken.
Het is aan de waterschappen en bedrijven met AWZI's zelf om te bepalen welke preventieve maatregelen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Van Otterloo over het bericht ‘Ouderen onwetend over huurtoeslag; ANBO schiet te hulp’

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the ministers about reports that many seniors do not claim housing and care allowances and whether the government has acted on the 2018 Krol motion. The minister says non-take-up is being addressed through information campaigns with pensioner organisations, expects a reaction to the IBO report in Q1 2020, and says CPB models do not account for non-take-up.
From the Ministry of BZK an information text will be distributed to various organisations with the request to pay attention to it via their own websites and magazines.

Vanuit het Ministerie van BZK zal een voorlichtingstekst naar verschillende organisaties worden verspreid met het verzoek hier via bijvoorbeeld de eigen websites en magazines aandacht aan te besteden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan, Van Brenk en Gijs van Dijk over het bericht 'Minister houdt poot stijf: Zonder nieuwe vluchten geen Lelystad'

MPs asked the minister whether she was right that Lelystad Airport could never take over all flights from Schiphol, and why she only acknowledged unavoidable autonomous growth in December 2019 after earlier stating growth would be prevented. The minister replied that the European Commission's objections to the original scheme were known, that she withdrew the notification in December 2018 and resubmitted a more selective scheme, and that she informed parliament of the independent analysis on growth in December 2019.
From the very beginning it was clear that approval from the European Commission was necessary before a VVR could be deployed.
Vanaf het begin af aan is duidelijk geweest dat goedkeuring van de Europese Commissie (EC) noodzakelijk was alvorens een VVR in te kunnen zetten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Brenk over het plenaire debat inzake het bericht dat het UWV ten onrechte uitkeringen verstrekt aan gevangenen (d.d. 4 september 2019)

MPs Krol and Van Brenk asked why fully non-accountable tbs patients in forensic care can keep their social security benefits, how many receive them, and whether the government will fix this. The minister says current law and Centrale Raad van Beroep case law require continuation in such cases, the number is not recorded, and the absence of a co-payment will be included in the evaluation of the Wfz, with a possible solution if unjust situations are found.
This is not known / cannot be determined.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Waterschap wil sterke visie op rivierverruiming na weer een afgeblazen project’

MP Van Brenk asked the minister why the Oosterhout dike relocation was dropped, what considerations drove that decision, and whether keeping a land reservation hinders area development. The minister explained the joint decision by the water board, province, municipality and the state to reinforce the existing dike, cited roughly 25 million euro extra cost and limited benefits, and said the reservation is kept for the long term with a Rijk-led river management programme under way.
Water board Rivierenland (project lead), the province of Gelderland, the municipality of Overbetuwe and the state jointly decided after the exploration to stick with reinforcing the current dike.

Het waterschap Rivierenland (trekker van het project), de provincie Gelderland, de gemeente Overbetuwe en het Rijk hebben na afronding van de verkenning gezamenlijk besloten om vast te houden aan het versterken van de huidige dijk

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het persbericht van Divosa van 1 oktober jl., over de Budgetten gebundelde uitkeringen 2019 en 2020 en over de middelen voor re-integratie en minimabeleid

Van Brenk (50PLUS) asks the state secretary about Divosa's warnings on the BUIG welfare budget, recurring municipal deficits and budget fluctuations, the shrinking re-integration budget, and the adequacy of minimum-income funding. The secretary rejects the claim that structural deficits dominate, says the budget model is sound and under review, and promises further research and talks with the VNG without committing to new funding.
I do not share Divosa's concerns.
Ik deel de zorgen van Divosa niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel 'NS schrapt korting in de avondspits vanaf 2021'

Van Brenk (50PLUS) asks the minister about NS removing the evening-peak discount and changing senior rail subscriptions from 2021, arguing it worsens travel options and costs for older travellers. The minister replies that NS acts within its concession, that the 7 choice days for seniors are abolished for new customers and replaced by 3 flex days at EUR 39, and that the changes spread demand without disadvantaging one group.
Under the concession for the main rail network, NS has the responsibility to ensure a subscription offering that meets the wishes of different traveller groups.
Op grond van de concessie voor het hoofdrailnet heeft NS de verantwoordelijkheid om te zorgen voor een abonnementenaanbod dat aansluit bij de wensen van verschillende reizigersgroepen.
Antwoord op vragen van het  lid Van Brenk over  de sociale staat van Nederland 2019

An MP asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the SCP finding that objective and subjective quality of life stagnated despite economic growth since 2008, and what the government will do about it. The minister acknowledges the findings, points to existing policies and measures on opportunity, housing and tax relief, and largely refers back to earlier answers without attributing the trends to policy.
The SCP does not make a statement on the extent to which policy is responsible for these developments.
Het SCP doet geen uitspraak over de mate waarin beleid verantwoordelijk is voor deze ontwikkelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Ouderen komen amper uit de bijstand’

Member Van Brenk (50PLUS) asks whether the small decline of over-45s on welfare and their low exit to work signal failure of labour market policy for older workers, and whether the government will intensify support. The ministers answer that the decline is lagged behind the economic upturn, point to existing plans (Perspectief voor vijftigplussers, Perspectief op Werk, STAP budget) and to a planned exploration of non-voluntary offers by municipalities, but reject calling it a defeat or a lost generation.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Gepensioneerden metaalfondsen gaan korting sneller voelen’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs about metal-sector pension funds (PME and PMT) cutting pensions faster rather than spreading cuts over ten years, asking about costs, the FTK's purpose, and whether the government would intervene. The minister declined to intervene, saying funds have discretion, gave the requested financial figures, and said the pension agreement's adjustment mechanism will be worked out by a steering group.
The board of a pension fund has discretionary authority over how pension cuts are implemented.
Het bestuur van een pensioenfonds heeft een discretionaire bevoegdheid wat betreft de wijze waarop pensioenkortingen worden doorgevoerd.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de toekomst va het pensioenstelsel in relatie tot zijn uitspraak ‘Als de rente heel lang nul blijft, hebben we met zijn allen een probleem in een kapitaalgedekt stelsel’

MP Van Brenk (50PLUS) asks the Minister of Social Affairs about the sustainability of Dutch funded pensions under prolonged low interest rates, comparing EU member states, reserves, discount rates, indexation, macroeconomic stabilisation and the current account. The minister answers at length with EIOPA comparisons, explains that funded and pay-as-you-go systems have trade-offs, defends prudent valuation rules, and commits to researching a hybrid system and to informing the House via a roadmap.
I want to examine the advantages and disadvantages of a hybrid system.
Ik wil de voor- en nadelen van een hybride stelsel onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het SCP-rapport ‘Armoede in kaart 2019’

MP Van Brenk (50PLUS) asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about SCP poverty figures for 60-64 year olds, 90-plus, pensioners and social assistance recipients, and about take-up of allowances. The State Secretary answered that the government is taking measures for older unemployed and high care costs, notes the SCP data are from 2017 and omit later measures, and promises an interdepartmental review of allowances.
An interdepartmental policy review (IBO) on allowances is also currently underway.
Tevens loopt op dit moment het interdepartementaal beleidsonderzoek (IBO) toeslagen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Van Raan, Laçin, Gijs van Dijk, Paternotte, Bruins, Stoffer en Van Brenk over  het  bericht 'L’UE refuse d’abandonner sa souveraineté sur  les émissions de CO2 de l’aviation'.

Eight MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about a report that the EU refuses to give up sovereignty over aviation CO2 emissions, and about the Dutch position and a draft ICAO resolution making CORSIA the only permitted global aviation emissions system. The minister confirmed Dutch support for the EU line, said the Netherlands will enter a reservation if the text could limit EU climate measures (including via the EU ETS), and said a kerosene excise is a fiscal measure outside the resolution's scope.

At the same time, the Netherlands will make a reservation against texts in the final resolution if they could politically limit the freedom in Europe to take the measures needed to achieve the climate goals.

Tegelijkertijd zal Nederland een voorbehoud maken tegen teksten in de uiteindelijke resolutie, wanneer die politiek gezien een beperking zouden kunnen betekenen van de vrijheid om in Europa de maatregelen te nemen die nodig zijn om de klimaatdoelstellingen
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over "Buffereisen Nederlandse CDC-fondsen onwettig"

MP Van Brenk asks whether Dutch CDC pension funds are exempt from buffer requirements under the IORP directive, and whether the Dutch government implemented the directive wrongly. The minister replies that Dutch funds always cover biometric risks, so the IORP minimum own-funds rules apply to CDC funds too, with no exemption, and that the implementation is correct.
I do not share the claim that the article puts forward.
Ik deel de stelling die in het artikel wordt ingenomen niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol, Van Otterloo, Van Brenk en Sazias over "de Augustusraming van het CPB"

Four 50PLUS MPs asked the Prime Minister and Finance Minister why the CPB's August forecast cut pensioners' purchasing-power gains sharply, whether pension cuts were included, why the share of households gaining or losing was dropped from the table, and the size of interest-rate windfalls. The Minister answered that the changes stem from updated inflation and interest-rate assumptions, that the presentation was changed to avoid misreading, and that interest windfalls feed into the budget decision on Budget Day.
The percentage of households with a positive or negative purchasing-power development has been removed from the boxplot.
Het percentage huishoudens met een positieve of negatieve koopkrachtontwikkeling is geschrapt uit de boxplot.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Krol en Van Brenk over de grenseffecten van de Wet normalisering rechtspositie ambtenaren (Wnra)

MPs Krol and Van Brenk asked about cross-border social security effects of the Wnra civil service law reform, including how many civil servants would switch social security regimes, sick-pay obligations, Article 16 agreements, and notification of Belgian and German authorities. The minister answered that effects depend on individual circumstances, estimated 450 to 550 university staff might face a switch, explained the applicable rules, and said the SVB will handle Article 16 requests under existing policy and foreign authorities will be informed via the Administrative Commission.
The Minister of Education, Culture and Science is in contact with the employers' organisations and will follow developments.
De Minister van Onderwijs, Cultuur en Wetenschap is in contact met de werkgeversorganisaties en zal de ontwikkelingen volgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht ‘ABP ontdekt deelnemers met recht op arbeidsongeschiktheidspensioen’

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether other pension funds face the same problem as ABP, which found members entitled to unpaid disability pensions, and whether all funds should actively search for such members. The minister said similar issues may exist elsewhere, called on all pension administrators to adopt active search policies, and noted the Ombudsman's recommendation on reparation, while stating no immediate measures of his own were needed.
I call on all pension administrators, insofar as still necessary, to adopt an active search policy.
Ik roep voor zover nu nog nodig alle pensioenuitvoerders op een actief zoekbeleid te hanteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over "gepensioneerden met een lager inkomen die arm zijn of moeilijk rond kunnen komen"

An MP asked the State Secretary about low-income pensioners who are poor or struggle to make ends meet, including AOW-only households, rent and care costs, municipal relief, IOAW rules and migrant elderly. The minister answered that the AOW is generally sufficient for basic needs, that municipalities handle case-by-case support, and promised to review some measures such as the IOW age limit and the minimum wage evaluation.
On average, national schemes are sufficient to cover basic needs, with room for savings and social participation.
Gemiddeld genomen zijn landelijke regelingen voldoende om in de basisbehoeften te voorzien, waarbij ook ruimte is voor reserveringsuitgaven en sociale participatie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk, Geleijnse en Krol over leeftijd-onderscheid bij verzekeringen

Three MPs from 50PLUS asked the Justice and Finance Ministers about a 75-year age ceiling in an American Express travel insurance policy linked to Flying Blue, and whether it amounts to age discrimination and insufficient disclosure. The government declined to judge the contracts, noted that American Express has removed the age ceiling, and pointed to complaint routes and the AFM's supervisory role over information duties.
It is not for me to pass judgement on the assessment of contracts.
Het is niet aan mij om te treden in de beoordeling van overeenkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over de berichtgeving betreffende dry-misting-apparaten in supermarkten

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the Minister of Medical Care about media reports on dry-misting devices in supermarkets, including legionella risks, the lack of independent control, and the lack of clear rules and responsibility. The minister answered that operators and suppliers are responsible for legionella management, that existing rules apply, that NVWA and ILT provide general oversight, and that he will consult departments and supervisors to clarify who is responsible for independent oversight.
I am consulting with the most relevant departments and supervisors to quickly create clarity on how independent supervision of the use of misting devices in supermarkets can best be organised.

Ik ga in overleg met de meest betrokken departementen en toezichthouders om snel duidelijkheid te scheppen over de vraag hoe onafhankelijk toezicht op het gebruik van mistapparaten in supermarkten het beste kan worden vormgegeven
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de berichten ‘Werkgevers investeren te weinig in ouderen’ en ‘Oudere werkende genegeerd’

An MP from 50PLUS asks the Minister of Social Affairs about press reports and a NETSPAR study finding employers invest less in older workers in training, and whether this amounts to age discrimination and what policy follows. The minister acknowledges lower training participation among older workers, attributes it to both employer and employee factors, and points to the lifelong learning approach, the STAP budget and the Wet Arbeidsmarkt in Balans, without committing to new concrete measures beyond ongoing consultation.
With the cabinet's LLO approach we want to encourage and support employers and employees to shift from repairing to looking ahead.
Met de kabinetsaanpak LLO willen wij werkgevers en werknemers stimuleren en ondersteunen om de omslag te maken van repareren naar vooruitkijken.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de artikelen 'Rivieren over de hele wereld vervuild met antibiotica' en 'Antibiotics found in some of the world’s rivers exceed 'safe' levels, global study finds'

An MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that antibiotics pollute rivers worldwide, including the proposed remedies, Nederland's role, the Blue Deal, and the European approach to medicine residues. The minister answered that the problem is tackled internationally via WHO and a one-health approach, that the EU initiative is welcomed, and referred to existing programmes and to the Minister for medical care for further detail.
It is likely that discharges from production sites that do not operate in line with GMP guidelines (Good Manufacturing Practices) contribute to the problem.
Het is waarschijnlijk dat lozingen uit productielocaties die niet conform GMP guidelines werken (Good Manufacturing Practices), bijdragen aan het probleem.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over het bericht ‘De Autoriteit Consument en Markt heeft geen gelijk, wettelijke bescherming geldt voor meer zzp’ers’

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked the ministers whether the competition authority ACM applies EU competition rules to self-employed workers too strictly, preventing them from negotiating collective rates, and whether this fosters social dumping. The state secretary answered that the ACM follows the Court of Justice's FNV KIEM ruling, that it is preparing a revised guideline on collective tariff agreements for self-employed workers around summer 2019, and that the Commission on the regulation of work will report by 1 November 2019.
The ACM has indicated that it aims to consult on the new guideline around summer 2019.
De ACM heeft aangegeven dat zij ernaar streeft om de nieuwe leidraad rond de zomer van 2019 te consulteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Ambtenaren met AOW mogen niet langer doorwerken'

MP Van Brenk asks whether the government is ending post-AOW-age working for civil servants, citing an ageing workforce, a NIDI study on labour displacement, and low-income pensioners who must keep working. The minister replies that from 2020 continued work after the AOW age will only be possible by mutual agreement under the cao Rijk, a change framed as consistent with the SPB 2025 policy, and that the affected group is small and the measure will not substantially rejuvenate the workforce.
The cao Rijk 2018–2020 agreed that continued work after the AOW-entitlement age from 1 January 2020 will only be possible in specific cases, based on agreement between employer and employee.

In de cao Rijk 2018–2020 is afgesproken dat doorwerken na de AOW-gerechtigde leeftijd vanaf 1 januari 2020 alleen mogelijk is in specifieke gevallen op basis van overeenstemming tussen de werkgever en de medewerker.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het onderzoek ‘Overstappen op de arbeidsmarkt’ Een onderzoek naar van Werk Naar Werk-beleid en - trajecten

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a study of the Van Werk Naar Werk (work-to-work) transition programmes, including its findings on older, low-educated and training-related outcomes, and what policy changes would follow. The minister answered that he cannot generalise the study's conclusions, outlined existing lifelong-learning and transition measures, and committed to no new concrete reform.

On the basis of these conclusions I cannot establish in general that redundant workers under 55 fare better than older redundant workers in Van Werk Naar Werk programmes, or that higher-educated workers make the transition to new work better than lower-educated ones.

Op grond van deze conclusies kan ik niet in zijn algemeenheid vaststellen dat in Van Werk Naar Werkbeleid en -trajecten boventalligen jonger dan 55 jaar beter af zijn dan oudere boventalligen en dat hoger opgeleiden de transitie naar nieuw werk beter maken dan lager opgeleiden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over koopkrachtcijfers van het Nibud

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether half of the Dutch population would lose purchasing power in 2019, whether the CPB's standard inflation figure fits all households, and whether Nibud should translate it into household-level impacts. The minister rejects the claim, citing CPB forecasts of about 95-96% of households gaining, and defends using representative averages and Nibud's example households as an appropriate approach.
The purpose of the purchasing power forecast is to make the effects of government policy on citizens' wallets visible, given the general economic picture.
Het doel van de koopkrachtraming is om de effecten van overheidsbeleid op de portemonnee van de burger inzichtelijk te maken, gegeven het algemeen economische beeld.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Geleijnse over het artikel 'Schadelijke lekkage dreigt bij duurzame aardwarmte'

MPs Van Brenk and Geleijnse asked about press reports that geothermal wells risk leakage, that three installations were already halted, and about contamination, monitoring and upcoming safety rules. The minister acknowledges the sector is young, says three operators voluntarily halted wells, notes no confirmed contamination yet, and promises new legislation, SodM requirements and forthcoming RIVM and SodM reports.
I therefore also endorse SodM's position that additional requirements for well design and monitoring must be implemented as soon as possible.
Ik onderschrijf daarom ook het standpunt van SodM dat extra eisen voor putontwerp en monitoring zo snel mogelijk geïmplementeerd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over legionellabesmettingen

Mr Van Brenk (50PLUS) asked the minister about legionella risks from cooling towers and whether elderly residents of senior complexes and service flats are adequately protected, since such complexes fall outside the list of priority locations. The minister replied that a cooling tower map exists and oversight is adequate, but committed to amending regulations to add care dwellings to the priority list, instructed the ILT to act in the meantime, and to examine registration of housing types.
This means that I will shortly initiate a change in regulations to add such locations to the list of priority locations.
Dit betekent dat ik op korte termijn een wijziging van de regelgeving in gang zal zetten, om dergelijke locaties aan de lijst met prioritaire locaties toe te voegen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk, Van Rooijen en Geleijnse over berichten dat de Scandinavische schuldenindustrie zich met woekerrentes richt op de Nederlandse zzp'er

Three 50PLUS MPs asked the ministers whether Scandinavian lenders charging 18% to 200% interest to Dutch self-employed people (zzp'ers) are a problem requiring a rate cap, a duty of care, AFM supervision and standard creditworthiness checks. The Finance Minister answered that the government takes such signals seriously but that the scale of the problem is unclear, so it will first map the issue and rely on the industry's self-regulatory code for now, with no concrete measures yet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan en Van Brenk over kritiek op motie Lelystad Airport

MPs Kröger, Laçin, Van Raan and Van Brenk asked whether completing the airspace redesign by 2023 is realistic, whether low-flying routes from Lelystad Airport will be gone by then, how low-flying routes are defined, and whether a plan MER is needed. The minister says the 2023 target stands, a start decision follows in spring 2019 and a preferred variant in 2020, but gives no guarantee that low-flying routes disappear by 2023, offers no definition, and leaves the plan MER question open.
As agreed in the Coalition Agreement, the Cabinet will implement the planned adjustment of the airspace by 2023.
Zoals is afgesproken in het Regeerakkoord gaat het Kabinet de voorgenomen aanpassing van het luchtruim per 2023 realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de uitzending van Radar inzake een 93-jarige dame die in de schulden is gekomen door een fout van het CAK

An MP asked the Minister of Health about a Radar broadcast in which a 93-year-old woman fell into debt after a CAK administrative error on her care contribution. The minister admitted errors, offered a settlement, shortened retroactive recovery to twelve months, and promised a general administrative order and a letter to the CAK.
In response to this undesirable situation, I have decided to shorten the retroactive effect of revisions arising from a serious shortcoming or serious delay on the part of the CAK to twelve months.

Naar aanleiding van deze onwenselijke situatie heb ik besloten de terugwerkende kracht van herzieningen, die ontstaan naar aanleiding van een ernstige tekortkoming of ernstige vertraging aan de kant van het CAK, te verkorten naar twaalf maanden.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel 'De keerzijde van 100.000 zzp’ers in de bouw: ‘Meer dan tien procent is fake, arm en kwetsbaar’'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Social Affairs about a Cobouw report that 10,000 to 20,000 of the 100,000 construction freelancers are disguised employees, mostly older, uninsured workers, and about enforcement, insurance age limits and pensions. The minister cited research estimating 3 to 5% disguised self-employment in construction, said the Tax Authority and Labour Inspectorate handle reports without naming individuals, and promised talks with insurers and a pension reform.
I do not make any statements about possible ongoing investigations by the Inspectorate.
Over eventuele lopende onderzoeken van de Inspectie doe ik geen mededelingen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Mooi maar gevaarlijk’

An MP asked the government whether wish balloons pose a fire hazard, especially in dry periods, and whether a national ban should be imposed following fire brigade warnings. The minister answered that product safety is regulated and users are responsible, that local municipalities may decide on bans, and that no national prohibition is needed because municipalities already have legal options.
I see no reason to legally prohibit the release of wish ballons at national level, since municipalities already have legal options.
Ik zie geen aanleiding om het oplaten van wensballonnen op landelijk niveau wettelijk te verbieden, aangezien er reeds wettelijke mogelijkheden zijn voor gemeenten.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de artikelen ‘Brandbrief na heftige ziektegevallen in Brabant: niemand controleert waterzuivering op legionella’ en ‘Man uit Boxtel doodziek door legionella uit een waterzuiv

An MP asked the minister whether municipalities and provinces have ordered inspections of biological wastewater treatment plants for Legionella after illnesses in Boxtel, and who is responsible for acting. The minister answered that no Legionella standards exist yet, that the competent authorities and companies are responsible and are acting, and that the omgevingsdiensten will start a risk study with RIVM.
In addition, the omgevingsdiensten, as indicated above, will shortly start a study into risk factors and approach.
Daarnaast zullen de omgevingsdiensten, zoals hierboven ook aangegeven, op korte termijn starten met een onderzoek naar risicofactoren en aanpak.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over het bericht dat bijna een kwart miljoen senioren het risico lopen zorg- of huurtoeslag te missen

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked whether a Regioplan report showing that many seniors may be missing out on healthcare or rent allowances is accurate, and what the government will do about it. The state secretary says the percentages cannot be confirmed, names causes of non-take-up and promises an interdepartmental policy study of the allowance system, without committing to specific measures.
The cabinet recognises that there are citizens who do not use allowances although they may be entitled to them.
Het kabinet herkent en onderkent dat er burgers zijn die geen gebruik maken van toeslagen terwijl ze er mogelijk wel recht op hebben.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Rooijen en Van Brenk over het artikel ‘Verhoog de BTW op drinkwater niet’

Two opposition MPs asked the State Secretary of Finance about a press piece opposing a VAT increase on drinking water, asking about the price effect, the tax structure, exempting drinking water, and cutting the water levy. The State Secretary confirmed the VAT rise from 6% to 9% would raise water prices by three percentage points, rejected exempting water from the single reduced rate, and said the government will not lower or abolish the water levy.
The cabinet does not intend to lower or abolish the levy on tap water.
Het kabinet is niet voornemens om de belasting op leidingwater te verlagen dan wel af te schaffen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het loonbod van 7% voor de CAO-Rijk (2018-2020) en de ontwikkeling van het Wettelijk minimumloon

Independent MP Van Brenk asked the Minister of Social Affairs about the 7% wage offer for the civil service CAO and whether the statutory minimum wage (WML) should be adjusted faster to contract wage growth, asking about its history and evaluation. The minister replied that the WML is indexed twice yearly to contract wage developments under existing rules, that no delay in indexation exists, that the next evaluation is in 2019, and that past evaluations found no reason for a special adjustment.
The next evaluation of the WML under Article 14, thirteenth paragraph, is foreseen in 2019.
De eerstvolgende evaluatie van het WML conform art. 14, dertiende lid wordt voorzien in 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Krol over de berichten: 'Discriminatie ouderen in vacatureteksten' en 'vacature sluit ouderen uit'

Two MPs from 50PLUS asked the government about reports that job advertisements still exclude older workers through age-related wording, and about enforcement, sanctions and possible criminal law. The State Secretary answered that age-related wording can be direct or indirect discrimination, pointed to the Inspectie SZW review, the 2018-2021 action plan and voluntary tools, and declined to commit to criminal prosecution or to a separate letter before Prinsjesdag.

As announced in my letter on tackling labour market discrimination in the temporary employment sector of 1 May 2018 and in the outline letter on the 2018-2021 Action Plan of 19 July 2018, among other effective alternatives, the possibilities to strengthen the enforcement role of the Inspectorate SZW in supervising discrimination in recruitment and selection are being explored.

Zoals is aangekondigd in mijn brief «Aanpak arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie in uitzendsector» 7 van 1 mei 2018 en in de «Hoofdlijnenbrief Actieplan Arbeidsmarktdiscriminatie 2018–2021» 8 van 19 juli 2018, wordt, naast andere effectieve alternatieven, verkernt wat de mogelijkheden zijn om de handhavende rol van de Inspectie SZW met betrekking tot toezicht op discriminatie bij werving en selectie te versterken.
