Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Voeding krijgt plek in opleiding geneeskunde Amsterdam’

Two 50PLUS MPs asked the health minister about a report that medical students receive under 30 hours of nutrition education and whether nutrition should get a firmer place in medical training. The minister acknowledged nutrition's importance, said curricula already meet the Raamplan, noted the government cannot dictate curricula due to freedom of education, and committed to raising nutrition in the planned Raamplan revision and ongoing talks with stakeholders.
The Raamplan mentions nutrition under prevention and nutrition and health under nutrition-related diseases.
In het raamplan wordt onder preventie «voeding» en onder voedingsgerelateerde ziekten «voeding en gezondheid» genoemd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel in Trouw van 18 mei jl. “UWV onthield werkzoekenden begeleiding, om effect te testen”

MP Van Brenk asked the Minister of Social Affairs whether UWV withheld personal guidance from unemployed people with a 'wrong' BSN to test effects, and whether this amounts to genuine tailored service rather than cuts. The minister replied that tailoring is based on the Werkverkenner assessment, not the BSN; a random 20 percent control group is used only for a temporary effect evaluation, that cuts are not the reason, and that additional funding is planned from 2019.
Only for that temporary effect evaluation is the BSN used.
Alleen voor die – tijdelijke – effectmeting wordt het BSN gebruikt.
Antwoord op  vragen van de leden Kröger, Laçin, Van Brenk, Gijs van Dijk en Van Raan over geluidsnormen op Schiphol

MPs asked the minister whether the Schiphol noise criteria (the 'huizennorm' of 10,000 severely affected homes) were stretched to about 12,300 homes without justification, and whether enforcement uses flown routes. The minister acknowledges the criteria were actualised in 2007/2008 and 2013 after new insights, says enforcement now uses flown routes, and rejects the claim that the original limits were breached, while not fully explaining why the figure rose.
If an actualisation is carried out, the House of Representatives will be informed of it.
Indien een actualisatie wordt uitgevoerd, wordt Uw Kamer daarover geïnformeerd.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Britse bedrijven gaan onnodig plastic aanpakken'

A 50PLUS MP asked the State Secretary for Infrastructure and Water Management about a UK Plastics Pact and how Netherlands could follow it, including whether a similar pact is feasible. The State Secretary called the UK initiative a good example to monitor, noted Dutch plastic packaging recycling of 51% already leads the EU, and said a Dutch pact would be part of the circular economy transition agendas.
I see such a Pact as part of the transition agendas and the cabinet's concrete plans to achieve a circular economy.
Ik zie zo’n Pact als onderdeel van de transitieagenda’s en de concrete plannen van het kabinet om te komen tot een circulaire economie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Krol over het bericht ‘Rijbewijs honderden ouderen onterecht ingenomen’

MPs Van Brenk and Krol asked the Minister of Justice and Security how licences could be seized on the spot and how a driver found fit after examination could have had his licence taken, and about the marechaussee making medical judgements. The minister answered that the listed grounds for on-the-spot seizure are alcohol, speeding, dangerous driving and suspected insufficient fitness, but declined to address the specific case because it is an ongoing criminal investigation.
The case mentioned in the reporting concerns an ongoing criminal investigation.
De in de berichtgeving genoemde casus betreft een lopend strafrechtelijk onderzoek.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Van Brenk over het bericht ‘Proef met OV-chip op mobiel mislukt’

Two MPs (Jetten and Van Brenk) asked the state secretary why the mobile OV-chip pilot failed and what consequences follow for mobile payment in public transport. The state secretary answered that the pilot was ended because the Mifare-based system was too complex for large-scale rollout, that the NOVB is preparing a switch to an open standard, and that mobile payment remains a goal, though no concrete follow-up is yet agreed.
The pilot is not being ended because of insufficient technical cooperation between the parties, but because OV-chip mobile in its current form is too complex for large-scale rollout.
De proef wordt niet beëindigd vanwege onvoldoende technische samenwerking tussen de partijen, maar omdat OV-chip mobiel in de huidige vorm te complex is voor grootschalige uitrol.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht 'Gemeenten: laat ons discrimineren op leeftijd'

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary about municipalities wanting exemption from the ban on age-based rejection of applicants, the legal basis for youth-unemployment age measures, generatiepact limits, and preferential hiring rules. The state secretary answered that age distinctions were permitted only under a legally anchored labour-market policy, that municipalities could target the 18-27 age group in vacancy texts until 1 January 2018, and that the government would invest in attracting young employees.
Selecting on age is, however, as I already indicated in my answer to question 2, only possible where there is statutorily anchored employment or labour-market policy.
Selecteren op leeftijd is evenwel, zoals ik reeds heb aangegeven in mijn antwoord op vraag 2 – alleen mogelijk als sprake is van wettelijk verankerd werkgelegenheids- of arbeidsmarktbeleid.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over “langdurige werkloosheid werklozen van 55-67 jaar"

The MP asks the minister about long-term unemployment among workers aged 55-67, including how WW exits split between work, maximum duration and other reasons, and about IOW/IOAW benefits and the job-search requirement for older workers. The minister answers with UWV data, states that the job-search obligation stays because it aids reemployment, and points to the action plan 'Perspectief voor vijftigplussers' and its 2019 evaluation.
The measures will then be evaluated in 2019, so that we better understand what works best to improve the labour market position of workers aged 50 and over.
Vervolgens worden de maatregelen in 2019 geëvalueerd, zodat we beter weten wat het beste werkt om de arbeidsmarktpositie van vijftigplussers te verbeteren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de toenemende langdurige armoede in Nederland

An MP from 50PLUS asked the State Secretary for Social Affairs about rising long-term poverty, the vulnerability of the 55+ group, the effects of the Participatiewet on income protection, and the link between the minimum income and municipal policy. The government answered that poverty is a priority, that the sociaal minimum is adequate for basic needs, that work is the way out of poverty, and that it will consult municipalities to reduce the poverty trap.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het artikel ”Kinderen kunnen voortaan – zonder medisch dossier – slecht rijgedrag van ouders melden”.

A 50PLUS MP asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether unverified reports of bad driving, including by children about parents, can lead to suspension of a driving licence without evidence, and whether this risks arbitrariness and misuse. The minister answered that the CBR assesses reports against statutory criteria and filters them substantively before any investigation, and that the procedure serves road safety, but gave limited detail on the criteria, the source relationship and the protections.
The CBR is responsible for checking whether the information submitted in a report gives substantive and legal grounds to further investigate suitability or driving competence.
Het CBR heeft de verantwoordelijkheid om te toetsen of de aangedragen informatie in de melding inhoudelijk en juridisch aanleiding geeft om de geschiktheid of rijvaardigheid nader te onderzoeken
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sazias en Van Brenk over het onderzoek 'De schaduwzijden van Graniet'

MPs Sazias and Van Brenk asked the government about a report on modern slavery, child labour and dangerous conditions in South Indian granite quarries, including what the government is doing with importing firms, procurement and the multi-stakeholder natural stone covenant. The Minister says a covenant is being negotiated with the sector, will raise the issue in the EU-India human rights dialogue and with the ILO, expects companies to carry out due diligence under the OECD guidelines, and notes that public procurement and decentralised governments are being engaged, though no mandatory transparency rules are planned.
Are you prepared to require companies to be fully transparent about their supply chain policy regarding their duty of care to promote human rights?
Bent u bereid bedrijven te verplichten volledig transparant te zijn over hun keten (beleid) op het gebied van hun zorgplicht voor het bevorderen van mensenrechten?
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Brenk en Van Rooijen over het bericht “aantal afgekeurde ouderen stijgt sterk; voor zware beroepen komt pensioen te laat”

Two MPs asked the Minister of Social Affairs about reports that disability awards among older workers have risen sharply, especially in heavy occupations where retirement is delayed, and about the lack of progress on a heavy-occupations scheme from the 2011 pension agreement, plus CPB projections and the net fiscal effect of raising the AOW age. The State Secretary answered that the rise reflects more older workers and higher average age rather than a failure of policy, that a heavy-occupations definition has proven difficult and is being explored with social partners, that the AOW age increase still improves public finances, and that flexibility and employer-employee solutions are to be encouraged.
It is known that the chance of entering the WIA disability scheme increases as an employee gets older.
Het is bekend dat de kans om de WIA in te stromen, toeneemt naarmate een werknemer ouder is.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over de gang van zaken bij sociale werkbedrijven

An MP from 50PLUS asks the State Secretary about reports that sheltered workshops use Eastern European temporary agency workers for work meant for people with disabilities, the closing of sheltered places, financial deficits, dumping prices, and government's own quota compliance. The State Secretary answers that use of agency workers is only incidental, that the Participation Act volume is lower than forecast, that the government is on track on quota commitments, and that placement decisions lie with municipalities.
Cedris states there is no structural use, but that agency workers (including Eastern European) are used incidentally when the client's demand cannot be met on time.

Cedris geeft aan dat geen sprake is van een structurele inzet, maar dat incidenteel gebruik wordt gemaakt van (Oost-Europese) uitzendkrachten als niet tijdig aan de vraag van de opdrachtgever kan worden voldaan.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht “Bezetting ambulances in steden in de knel”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the state secretary for Health about reports that ambulance staffing shortages in Utrecht, Rotterdam and The Hague threaten continuity of care, and whether each ambulance crew should include a permanent employee. The government answered that providers and insurers are responsible for continuity, that AZN reports sufficient staff in all regions, and it outlined training funding and an experiment with the Bachelor Medisch Hulpverlener, without committing to structural changes to employment rules.
It is the responsibility of the care provider to deliver good care and to safeguard continuity in doing so.
Het is de verantwoordelijkheid van de zorgaanbieder om goede zorg te leveren en daarbij de continuïteit te waarborgen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Van Brenk over het bericht “Laaggeletterdheid kost 1 miljard”

An MP from 50PLUS asked the Minister of Education, Culture and Science about a report that low literacy costs 1 billion euro, the rising number of low-literate youths, and whether more earmarked funding is needed. The minister answered that the cost increase reflects a broader target-group definition, noted the budget increase to about 75 million euro per year, and promised a progress report and further studies later in the year.
In the autumn I will inform you of the results and in a letter address the follow-up approach to low literacy.
In het najaar zal ik u informeren over de resultaten en in een brief ingaan op de vervolgaanpak van laaggeletterdheid.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Agnes Mulder c.s. ter vervanging van nr. 33 over de doorzettingsmacht en de beleidsvrijheid van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen

Amendment making the minister the contact point and decision-maker for Groningen reinforcement, with the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen given a mandate and wider discretion to decide reasonableness and cost allocation, and letting the minister set cost-sharing for owners.
to write into the law and explain the enforcement power and policy discretion that the National Coordinator Groningen has in carrying out the reinforcement operation
om de doorzettingsmacht en de beleidsvrijheid die de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG) heeft in de uitvoering van de versterkingsoperatie in de wet op te nemen en toe te lichten
Amendement van het lid Dik-Faber c.s. over het verkorten van de termijnen voor het versterkingsbesluit
Allows a general administrative order to set cases where the reasonable decision period for reinforcement decisions is at most six months, with a one-time extension of six months.
By or pursuant to a general administrative order, cases are designated for which the reasonable period referred to in the first paragraph is at most six months
Bij of krachtens algemene maatregel van bestuur worden gevallen aangewezen waarvoor de redelijke termijn, bedoeld in het eerste lid, maximaal zes maanden bedraagt
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber c.s. over geen onomkeerbare stappen rondom mijnbouwactiviteiten in het Waddengebied
Motion asks the government not to take irreversible steps in mining activities in the Wadden area until the investigations requested by Parliament have been submitted to it.
requests the government not to take irreversible steps as long as the investigations requested by the House have not been submitted to the House
verzoekt de regering, geen onomkeerbare stappen te zetten zolang de door de Kamer gevraagde onderzoeken niet aan de Kamer zijn voorgelegd
Motie van de leden Aukje de Vries en Sienot over gebouwen met veiligheidsrisico's niet als laatste aan de beurt laten komen
Asks the government to ensure that buildings with high safety risks are not reinforced last, including rural single homes.
requests the government to promote that this type of building with safety risks does not come last in line
verzoekt de regering, te bevorderen dat dit type gebouwen met veiligheidsrisico's niet als allerlaatste aan de beurt komt
Motie van de leden Sienot en Agnes Mulder over geen kerncentrale realiseren in de provincie Groningen
Declares that no nuclear power plant will be built in the province of Groningen.
declares that for the above considerations no nuclear power plant will be realised in the province of Groningen
spreekt uit dat om bovengenoemde overwegingen geen kerncentrale wordt gerealiseerd in de provincie Groningen
Motie van de leden Aukje de Vries en Sienot over een oplossingsgerichte aanpak en cultuur bij het IMG en de NCG
Asks the government to agree with the Groningen damage institute and the National Coordinator on a solution-oriented approach and culture so residents are not sent from pillar to post.
requests the government to consult and make agreements with the Groningen Mining Damage Institute and the National Coordinator Groningen to achieve a solution-oriented approach and culture

verzoekt de regering, om in overleg te gaan en afspraken te maken met het Instituut Mijnbouwschade Groningen en de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen om te komen tot een oplossingsgerichte aanpak en cultuur
Motie van de leden Sienot en Dik-Faber over verduurzaming koppelen aan de versterkingswerkzaamheden
Asks the government to link sustainability upgrades of homes to reinforcement works, with one contact point for residents.
requests the government to link sustainability measures to the reinforcement works with a single point of contact for residents

Asks the government to use alternatives before tree felling for road and rail safety and to fell trees only as a last resort, consulting provinces, municipalities, ProRail and Rijkswaterstaat.

requests the government to make an inventory and risk analysis of all unguarded railway level crossings

Motie van het lid Remco Dijkstra c.s. over prioritering in de aanpak van N-wegen

verzoekt de regering, in het kader van het programma Meer Veilig een prioritering aan te brengen van aanpak van N-wegen
Motie van het lid Sienot c.s. over innovatieve oplossingen voor bereikbaarheid

requests the government, in 2018 within the MIRT cycle, to enable an innovative pilot in each province
verzoekt de regering, in 2018 in het kader van de MIRT-cyclus in iedere provincie een innovatieve pilot mogelijk te maken
Motie van het lid Van der Graaf c.s. over de sluis bij Kornwerderzand
Asks the government to actively support the region in developing a new project and financing proposal for the Kornwerderzand lock and to inform the House by mid-2018.
requests the government to actively support the region in working on a new project and financing proposal, and to inform the House about this by mid-2018

Motie van de leden Remco Dijkstra en Sienot over de doorstroming na incidenten
Asks the government to clear lanes faster after incidents by moving broken-down vehicles aside before a tow truck arrives.
requests the government to apply this method where possible to improve traffic flow after incidents
verzoekt de regering, deze werkwijze waar mogelijk toe te passen om zo de doorstroming na incidenten te verbeteren
Motie van  de leden Van Tongeren en Sienot over chauffeur-ondersteunende opties van auto's
Asks the government to agree with the sector and driving schools to educate drivers about driver-assistance features in new cars.
requests the government, together with the sector, to make agreements to familiarise drivers with driver-support options
verzoekt de regering om, samen met de sector afspraken te maken om bestuurders wegwijs te maken met de chauffeur-ondersteunende opties
Motie van het lid Remco Dijkstra c.s. over sancties op appen achter het stuur
Asks the government to focus more on prevention, targeted enforcement and sanctions against phone use while driving, and to include it in the reckless driving bill.
requests the government to focus more strongly on prevention, targeted enforcement and sanctioning of phone use while driving
verzoekt de regering sterker in te zetten op preventie, gerichte handhaving en sanctionering van appen achter het stuur
Motie van de leden Sienot en Dik-Faber over een initiatievenloket en een overheidsloket in het kader van waterveiligheidsprojecten

Asks the government to set up an initiatives counter in the exploration phase of water safety projects and a single government counter for citizens and firms afterwards, with well-justified permit fees.
requests the government to ensure this by setting up an initiatives counter in the exploration phase
verzoekt de regering, hiervoor zorg te dragen door in de verkenningsfase een initiatievenloket in te richten
Motie van de leden Dik-Faber en Sienot over eerder aanpakken van veelvoorkomende stoffen
Asks the government to start pilots earlier in the medicine supply chain and examine the most effective instrument for common substances.
requests the government to also start pilots earlier in the chain and support knowledge sharing
verzoekt de regering om, ook eerder in de keten pilots te doen starten en kennisdeling te ondersteunen
Motie van de leden Sienot en Dik-Faber over de apotheek als vooruitgeschoven post van kca-inzameling
Asks the government to ensure via VNG that all municipalities have pharmacies act as collection points for unused medicines and to inform the House before summer 2018.
requests the government, through VNG, to ensure that in all Dutch municipalities the pharmacy functions as an outpost for medicine collection
verzoekt de regering om, in VNG-verband te zorgen dat in alle Nederlandse gemeenten de apotheek gaat functioneren als een vooruitgeschoven post
qa: Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Weyenberg en Sienot over de postcoderoosregeling

Two D66 MPs asked whether the conversion of the postcoderoos tax scheme into a subsidy scheme was meant to cut back support, and why the transitional arrangement does not let new members join and avoids cooperative bankruptcies when members leave. The State Secretary denies that a cutback was intended, admits the transitional rule may not achieve its aim, and says the government is studying an additional transitional rule in the next tax package.
That is why we are examining whether it is possible to introduce additional transitional arrangements in the upcoming Tax Plan package.
Daarom laten wij uitzoeken of het mogelijk is om aanvullend overgangsrecht te introduceren in het komende Belastingplanpakket.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Beckerman, Agnes Mulder, Sienot, Bromet, Nijboer en Dik-Faber over het rekenmodel waardedalingsregeling dat gedupeerden benadeelt

MPs asked whether the IMG's depreciation model disadvantages the hardest-hit Groningen homes and whether the minister would intervene to apply an individual-level alternative proposed by De Kam and Blanken. The minister replied that the IMG independently sets its own method under the Tijdelijke wet Groningen, that it chose the variant giving the highest average outcomes, and that intervening would undermine its independence, though objections and appeals remain available.
It is not for me but for the IMG to determine, within the legal framework, which method it uses to handle all types of damage, including depreciation damage.
Het is niet aan mij maar aan het IMG om binnen de wettelijke kaders te bepalen welke werkwijze zij hanteert voor de afhandeling van alle schadevormen, waaronder schade door waardedaling.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht 'EU-akkoord over klimaat: 55 procent minder uitstoot in 2030'

An MP asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the EU agreement to cut emissions 55% by 2030, the implications for the Netherlands, the gap with the national climate target, and green recovery investment. The minister welcomes the EU target, says the Klimaatakkoord is progressing, commits to an inter-ministerial study group report and to leaving the remaining gap to the next cabinet.
The study group's report was sent to your House on 29 January.
Het rapport van de studiegroep is op 29 januari jl. aan uw Kamer verstuurd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Van Raan over het artikel 'Stukken bos kaalgekapt in Estland voor Nederlandse biomassacentrales'

MPs Sienot, Dik-Faber and Van Raan asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about press reports that whole forests in Estonia were clear-cut to supply Dutch biomass plants, and about controls and sustainability. The minister disputed that this reflects the picture, pointed to strict Dutch sustainability criteria, certification and verification by conformity bodies, and promised to investigate the signal further and discuss it with Estonia.
I want to investigate this signal further and enter into discussion with the authors of the report 'The dark side of the wood pellet'.
Ik wil dit signaal verder onderzoeken en in gesprek gaan met de opstellers van het rapport «De duistere kant van de houtpellet».
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van der Lee over het rapport van ENCO

MPs Sienot and Van der Lee ask the minister about the ENCO report on nuclear energy, questioning its quality, independence, assumptions about renewables and costs, and how it was commissioned. The minister answers that the study followed proper procurement and transparency rules, will release the related documents after the Wet Openbaarheid van bestuur procedure, and defends the report's assumptions while declining a separate review before the roundtable.
Once the procedure has been carefully completed, I will send the documents to your House.
Nadat de procedure zorgvuldig is doorlopen, zal ik de stukken aan uw Kamer zenden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht 'Nieuwe studie: elektrische auto gaat langer mee dan gedacht'

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked the ministers how the TU Eindhoven study showing longer EV lifespans and lower battery CO2 emissions affects climate policy and the cost-effectiveness calculations of the Klimaatakkoord. The Staatssecretaris largely endorsed the study, defended the cost-effectiveness estimates with sensitivity analyses, said the models are kept up to date, and promised to improve consumer information on used EVs.
The ministry will continue to monitor these developments.
Het ministerie blijft deze ontwikkelingen monitoren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Paternotte over het artikel ‘Losser wil pilotgebied worden voor uitwisseling duurzame energie met Duitsland’

MPs Sienot and Paternotte asked whether cross-border medium-voltage electricity exchange between Dutch, German and Belgian border municipalities could be enabled, and whether Losser, Emmen and Kerkrade could be designated pilot Local Energy Communities. Minister Wiebes answered that EU rules on interconnection must be kept, that he will not change them, and that he will not designate pilot areas because communities can be set up by residents and municipalities themselves.
These European rules and principles I cannot and will not change.
Deze Europese spelregels en principes kan en wil ik niet veranderen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Kernenergie volgens Wiebes betaalbaar, experts twijfelen’

MP Sienot (D66) asks the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the ENCO report on nuclear energy costs conflicts with TNO and Kalavasta/Berenschot studies, and challenges ENCO's independence, model transparency, assumptions (50% wind/solar in 2040, 100% capacity factor, LCOE) and the risk of delaying regional energy plans. The minister defends the study's different scope and assumptions, says the models' sources are public, commits to asking researchers in the Dijkhoff motion market consultation to consider all relevant reports, and maintains the Climate Agreement targets.
I intend, when carrying out the Dijkhoff et al. motion, to ask the researchers in the market consultation to take all relevant reports into account.
Ik ben voornemens om bij het uitvoeren van de motie Dijkhoff c.s., bij de marktconsultatie de onderzoekers te verzoeken alle relevante rapporten te betrekken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht ‘Sloop dreigt voor onafgebouwd testcentrum getijde-energie bij de Grevelingendam’

Two D66 MPs asked whether the unfinished tidal energy test centre at the Grevelingendam should be revived given its innovation potential, and whether the permit withdrawal could be postponed. The minister answered that the sector offers limited innovation potential, a market scan will show by 31 December 2020 whether a new party will complete the centre, and otherwise Rijkswaterstaat will demolish it so sluicing can resume.
By 31 December 2020 it will be known whether there is interest and under what conditions parties want to participate.
Uiterlijk 31 december 2020 zal bekend zijn of er belangstelling is en onder welke voorwaarden partijen willen instappen.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Nog altijd miljarden euro’s subsidie naar fossiele energiesector’ naar aanleiding van het onderzoek van Oil Change International en Milieudefensie

An MP asked the government about a report claiming fossil-fuel subsidies in the Netherlands are rising and slowing the energy transition, and asked for the government's definition, its progress on phasing out such subsidies, and its total climate spending. The minister acknowledged the report but disputed its figures, said the government uses the WTO definition, committed to phasing out fossil incentives in line with international agreements, and listed the climate and energy funds available in this cabinet period.
The cabinet agrees that no subsidies or financial incentives for fossil fuels belong in the transition.
Het kabinet deelt de mening dat in de transitie geen subsidies of financiële prikkels voor fossiele brandstoffen passen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over de oproep van de Burgemeester van Loppersum voor een andere aanpak voor de versterkingsoperatie in Groningen

MPs asked whether the government will act on the Loppersum mayor's call for a crisis team and an emergency law to speed up the Groningen earthquake reinforcement operation. The minister says the government is pursuing faster implementation, is in talks with the mayor and regional administrators, and will inform parliament on outcomes, while the reinforcement bill is still being revised after the Council of State's advice.
In line with our commitment in the General Consultation on Mining/Groningen of 24 June, we will inform the House of the outcomes as soon as possible.
Conform onze toezegging in het Algemeen Overleg Mijnbouw/Groningen van 24 juni jl. informeren wij uw Kamer zo spoedig mogelijk over de uitkomsten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en De Groot over stikstofuitstoot

D66 MPs asked why provinces permitted two power plants to switch to biomass with higher nitrogen emissions by using intern salderen on old permits, and whether this conflicts with the government's nitrogen reduction goals. Minister Schouten defends the permits as lawful and within existing rules, says the new permits set lower maximum emissions, and declines to reopen or tighten permits or launch wider investigations.
I see no possibility to apply stricter policy or to further restrict permits that have become final in law.
Bovendien zie ik geen mogelijkheid om een strenger beleid te hanteren of in rechte vaststaande vergunningen verder in te perken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden De Groot en Sienot over de aanhoudende droogte, natuurbranden en het verband met het snel opwarmende klimaat

Two D66 MPs asked the ministers about recurring drought, forest and nature fires in the Netherlands and Europe, their link to rapid warming, economic damage, prevention measures and whether the climate targets should be tightened. The minister answered that fire statistics only exist since 2017, that drought risk grows with warming, that prevention runs through regional fire-risk programmes and drought and adaptation policy, that the Copernicus report confirmed known trends without prompting a new European meeting, and that the Netherlands supports a higher EU 2030 target.
The Copernicus report has not given rise to organising a European meeting or to accelerating climate measures.
Het Copernicus-rapport is geen aanleiding geweest voor het organiseren van een Europees overleg of klimaatmaatregelen versneld kunnen worden genomen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, De Groot, Van Eijs, Paternotte en Schonis over het bericht ‘Dutch spell out green ideas for EU recovery fund’

D66 MPs asked the ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of Agriculture about a Dutch non-paper proposing a green EU recovery, including conditioning state aid on the national climate plan, early energy and circular investments, and an exclusion list for the Just Transition Fund. The government said the non-paper was an informal civil-servant document, declined to share such papers routinely, and gave largely non-committal answers, deferring concrete national plans until after the Commission's proposals and an August decision.
However, the cabinet considers sharing all such informal civil-servant lobbying documents at all times neither opportune nor desirable for effective Dutch advocacy in Brussels.
Echter, het kabinet acht het te allen tijde delen van al deze ambtelijke beïnvloedingsdocumenten niet opportuun noch wenselijk voor effectieve Nederlandse belangenbehartiging in Brussel.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het bericht ‘Dik half jaar wachten voor plaatsen snellader geen uitzondering’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked about reported waits of up to half a year to connect fast-charging points to the grid, and how businesses can be supported. The Staatssecretaris answers that the National Agenda for Charging Infrastructure, regional partnerships, grid operator planning and guidance documents are being used to speed up rollout, without committing to a new concrete measure beyond existing plans.

Specifically for speeding up fast chargers at motorway service areas, I have asked Rijkswaterstaat to explore how many fast chargers could be added at service areas (up to 2030) and how the government can facilitate this.

Specifiek voor het versneld plaatsen van snelladers op verzorgingsplaatsen langs de snelweg heb ik Rijkswaterstaat gevraagd om te verkennen hoeveel snelladers er op de verzorgingsplaatsen bijgeplaatst zouden kunnen worden (tot 2030) en op welke wijze de overheid dit mogelijk kan faciliteren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over onduidelijke tarieven bij laadpalen voor elektrische auto’s

MPs Sienot and Schonis asked the government about unclear and non-transparent charging tariffs at public EV charge points, and whether the price-transparency agreements with the sector would be met in 2020. The minister acknowledged the need for transparency, described the existing pricing structure and agreements with the sector and ACM, and declined to impose a standard tariff, while committing to further steps such as a legislative change and a sector-wide data exchange by 1 June 2020.
I have made further agreements on price transparency with the industry associations of operators and service providers within the National Agenda for Charging Infrastructure (NAL).
Ik heb met de brancheverenigingen van exploitanten en serviceproviders in het kader van de Nationale Agenda Laadinfrastructuur (NAL) nadere afspraken gemaakt over prijstransparantie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Paternotte en Sienot over het bericht “CO2-compensatie is misleidend en ‘nattevingerwerk’” gepubliceerd in Trouw van 13 februari 2020

MPs Paternotte and Sienot asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that CO2 offsetting is misleading and unreliable, and whether this distorts aviation emissions claims and consumer choices. The minister answered that CORSIA's internationally set eligibility criteria and the Technical Advisory Board govern certificate quality, that the voluntary market is not supervised, and referred consumer and voluntary-market questions to a separate letter from the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate.
No supervision takes place over the quality of certificates that airlines voluntarily buy on the market.
Op de kwaliteit van certificaten die luchtvaartmaatschappijen vrijwillig kopen in de markt vindt geen toezicht plaats
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel 'Klimaatsceptisch Nederland profiteert nog altijd van netwerk en geld uit fossiele industrie'

An MP from D66 asked the minister about a Follow the Money article on the climate-sceptic foundation Clintel, its links to the fossil industry, and whether the government used or had contact with climate sceptics. The minister answered that the government is not aware of using Clintel, that climate policy rests on IPCC and Dutch knowledge institutes, and that the influence of past contacts cannot be determined.
Not that I am aware of.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Dik-Faber en Harbers over de organisatie van de Nationaal Coördinator Groningen

Four MPs asked the Minister about reported internal chaos at the Nationaal Coördinator Groningen (NCG), its absorption of the CVW, staff turnover and whether this threatens reinforcement work. The Minister denied chaos, called reorganisation necessary, said public execution is now with the NCG and the TCMG/IMG handles compensation, and promised further attention to staff retention and continued contact.
The image that there would be chaos, as the headline above the cited report suggests, I do not recognise.
Het beeld dat er sprake zou zijn van chaos, zoals de kop boven het aangehaalde bericht suggereert, herken ik niet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Graaf, Sienot en Kröger over berichten dat containerschepen ook tijdens de storm de zuidelijke Waddenzeeroute hebben genomen en containers hebben verloren

MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about reports that container ships, including the OOCL Rauma during storm Ciara, took the southern Wadden Sea route and lost containers, and what the Coast Guard, liability and route closure options involved. The minister answered that the Coast Guard warned nine ships, that the owner was held liable for clean-up under the Wet bestrijding maritieme ongevallen, that the OVV and MARIN investigations are pending, and that closing the southern route requires IMO decision-making, with further steps to follow after the OVV report.
I will respond to the report as soon as possible and inform your House about it.
Ik zal zo spoedig mogelijk reageren op het rapport en uw Kamer hierover informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber, Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Van der Lee en Van Raan over de Gedragscode Zon op Land

Five MPs from different parties asked ministers about the industry-drafted Gedragscode Zon op Land (code of conduct for ground-mounted solar), its alignment with the solar-ladder motions, protection of Natura 2000 and national park areas, guidance to local authorities and RES regions, use in rijksgronden tenders, and PBL's landscape report. The government welcomed the code as consistent with the voorkeursvolgorde zon, said it will be promoted via the Nationaal Programma RES and monitored, and deferred the landscape-policy questions to a forthcoming NOVI letter.
Through the National Programme RES we will bring this code of conduct to the attention of the RES regions.
Via het Nationaal Programma RES (NP RES) brengen we deze gedragscode onder de aandacht van de RES’en.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Nederland zal veel eerder en veel meer gas moeten importeren dan tot nu werd gedacht’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report warning that Dutch small gas fields will decline and the country must import more gas earlier, including questions on nature and safety protections, CO2 emissions, Norwegian gas and reducing gas dependence. The minister acknowledged lower future production from small fields, said permits follow safety and environmental assessments, promised to stimulate domestic production via a Mining Act amendment, and rejected accelerating gas phase-out beyond the Climate Agreement.
A permit is required under the Mining Act for the exploration and extraction of minerals.
Voor opsporing en winning van delfstoffen is een vergunning vereist krachtens de Mijnbouwwet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sienot over het artikel ‘Nederland zit niet te wachten op geld uit groene subsidiepot van de EU’

MPs Jetten and Sienot asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate why the Netherlands would not take part in the EU Just Transition Fund given its high emissions and low renewable generation, and whether it would press for funding for gas-extraction regions such as Groningen. The minister answers that the cabinet supports the mechanism but wants its size limited within the Dutch MFK position, and will argue for objective criteria that include employment effects in hard-hit regions; details are referred to a separate BNC-fiche.
The cabinet will then argue for the use of objective criteria, which should also take into account employment in the regions hardest hit by the climate transition.

Het kabinet zal vervolgens pleiten voor het gebruik van objectieve criteria, waarbij ook de werkgelegenheid in regio's die het hardst worden geraakt ten gevolge van de klimaattransitie moet worden meegewogen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Omtzigt, Bruins, Sienot en Lodders over het bericht dat de prijs van elektriciteit van snelladers wordt verhoogd naar 79 cent/kWH voor passanten

MPs asked whether the government will investigate market power and cartel formation among fast-charger operators after Ionity raised guest charging prices to 79 cent/kWh, and whether a maximum price should be set. The government answered that ACM is independent and has heightened attention for the sector, that the market is open and competitive, and that a maximum price is not currently under consideration.
The Netherlands Authority for Consumers and Markets (ACM) is an independent regulator.
De Autoriteit Consument en Markt (ACM) is een onafhankelijke toezichthouder.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over de publicatie van het tarievenbesluit warmteleveranciers 2020

An MP asked the minister why 2020 maximum heat tariffs rose sharply for fixed charges, connection fees and disconnection costs, and how consumers are protected from heat monopolies. The minister explained that the increases follow the new cost-based methodology set by ACM under the amended Warmtewet, that total annual costs at 35 GJ fell slightly, and that cost-based regulation will be pursued further in Warmtewet 2.
This year the maximum tariffs are based for the first time on the most recent amendment of the Heat Act (adopted in 2018) and the underlying regulations.
Dit jaar worden de maximumtarieven voor de eerste maal gebaseerd op de meest recente wijziging van de Warmtewet (aangenomen in 2018) en de onderliggende regelgeving.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van der Lee over het artikel 'Overheid hielp tuinders Europese CO2-prijs te ontwijken'

MPs Sienot and Van der Lee asked whether the government helped greenhouse growers escape the EU ETS carbon price by splitting firms and classifying gas boilers as backup, and whether this undermines climate targets. The minister denies any evasion: the firms left the ETS legitimately, the NEa supervises misuse, and the sector remains subject to the CO2 sector system with compensation for overshoot.

There are three reasons why companies no longer participate in the ETS: 1. companies reduced the capacity of their installations; 2. companies split up; 3. companies no longer meet the ETS criteria based on the 'back-up scheme'.

Er zijn drie redenen dat bedrijven niet meer deelnemen aan het ETS: 1. Bedrijven hebben het vermogen van hun installaties verminderd; 2. Bedrijven hebben zich opgesplitst; 3. Bedrijven voldoen op basis van de «back-up regeling» niet langer aan de ETS-criteria.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over de uitspraak van minister-president na afloop van de ministerraad op 29 november 2019 ‘de treinen rijden op steenkool, en ik ga dan vliegen’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked about the Prime Minister's remark that trains run on coal while he flies, and whether the claim is accurate, plus the energy mix on the Den Haag–Madrid route and European high-speed rail coordination. The minister answered with 2017 Eurostat energy-mix figures for Belgium, France and Spain, said Dutch trains run on wind power, admitted other countries' electricity may partly be coal-based, and pledged to push international rail on the EU agenda.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Milieuorganisaties: stroom wordt nauwelijks groener’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report finding that electricity is hardly becoming greener, covering business demand for green power, purchase contracts, reporting obligations and CO2 pricing. The minister largely defended current market arrangements, pointed to full disclosure from 2020 and the Climate Agreement, and promised further information to parliament on energy saving obligations by mid-2020.
The cabinet considers it important that more information, transparency and standardisation on climate is introduced in all links of the financial chain.
Het kabinet vindt het van belang dat er meer informatie, transparantie en standaardisering komt op het gebied van klimaat in alle schakels van de financiële keten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Van Eijs en Schonis over het artikel ‘Duurzaamheid blijft ondergeschoven kind bij aanbestedingen in de bouw’

D66 MPs asked whether sustainability plays too small a role in public construction tenders and whether this jeopardises the 2050 climate goals. The government answers that sustainability can be included in many tender criteria, outlines Rijksoverheid purchasing strategy, Klimaatakkoord measures, CO2-Prestatieladder and MKI/MPG instruments, and the status of motion Schonis on smart maintenance pilots.
For central government this has led to drafting a new procurement strategy for Rijk purchasing, aimed at sustainable, social and innovative purchasing.
Voor de rijksoverheid is dit aanleiding geweest voor het opstellen van een nieuwe inkoopstrategie voor de inkoop van het Rijk, gericht op duurzaam, sociaal en innovatief inkopen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over het artikel ‘Groene Wende op Duitse Wegen: Wat betekent dat voor Nederland?’

MPs Sienot and Schonis asked the minister whether a large German shift to electric cars would hurt the Dutch economy and auto sector, and whether the Dutch market and supply of EVs are at risk. The minister answered that the transition offers opportunities for Dutch firms, that the government's Klimaatakkoord measures and annual monitoring aim for 100% zero-emission new sales by 2030, and that suppliers will need to adapt.
That is why the market and sales of electric cars are monitored annually and the incentive package will be adjusted if necessary.
Daarom wordt de markt en verkoop van elektrische auto’s jaarlijks gemonitord en zal het stimuleringspakket zo nodig worden aangepast.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van der Lee over het bericht 'Nederland verontwaardigd: 'onze' Clauscentrale wil stroom gaan leveren aan België'

MPs Sienot and Van der Lee asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a plan by RWE to supply electricity from the Clauscentrale directly to Belgium, raising concerns about security of supply and CO2 emissions. The minister agreed the supply should go via the interconnector rather than a direct connection, said he has raised this with RWE and his Belgian counterpart, but declined to commit to shifting CO2 emissions to Belgium, citing the ETS point-source rules.

However, I am of the view that the supply of electricity to the Belgian grid should take place via the Dutch-Belgian interconnection capacity and not via a planned direct connection to the Belgian grid

Ik ben echter van mening dat de levering van stroom aan het Belgische elektriciteitsnet dient plaats te vinden via de Nederlands-Belgische interconnectiecapaciteit en niet via een voorgenomen rechtstreekse aansluiting op het Belgische net
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Dik-Faber en Sienot over de gaswinning onder de Waddenzee

MPs Dik-Faber and Sienot asked the minister about gas extraction under the Wadden Sea, including whether the NAM study on long-term subsidence is independent, the timing of results, the Auditcommissie's role, sea-level rise, Natura 2000 nitrogen effects, the permit procedure, and whether decisions should wait for a debate. The minister answered that the NAM study was commissioned by him, results go to the Auditcommissie with advice expected late 2019 or early 2020, the NAM has commercial interests, and gas extraction may continue within existing permits and the Mijnbouwwet/Wet natuurbescherming framework.
I expect the advice of the Auditcommissie at the end of 2019 or the beginning of 2020. I aim to send this advice and my response to your House in the first months of 2020.
Het advies van de Auditcommissie verwacht ik eind 2019 of begin 2020. Ik streef er naar dit advies van de Auditcommissie en mijn reactie daarop in de eerste maanden van 2020 aan uw Kamer te sturen.
Antwoord op de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber en Agnes Mulder over het gebruik van biomassa als energiebron

MPs Dik-Faber, Sienot and Agnes Mulder asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the DNV-GL report on biomass emissions, subsidy amounts, sustainability criteria, planned plants and the RES regional energy strategies. The minister responded that a TNO study on tighter emission limits for small and medium biomass plants is underway, that a sustainability framework is being prepared with an SER advisory report expected in early 2020, and that subsidies for biomass plants continue for now.
I cannot disclose the origin of the wood pellets of a specific company, because this information is commercially confidential.
De herkomst van de houtpellets van een specifiek bedrijf kan ik – in verband met bedrijfsvertrouwelijke aard van deze informatie – niet openbaar maken.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ’Elektriciteitsnet op steeds meer plekken vol’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that the electricity grid is full in more places, blocking connections for large businesses, long permit procedures, greenhouse growers forced to switch off lights, the need for a national masterplan, technical staff shortages, and why grid investment lagged behind renewable expansion. The minister acknowledged the congestion, described procedural shortening and regional energy strategies, said a masterplan would be a coordination effort rather than spatial zoning, announced a programme startnotitie and appraisal due in 2020, and explained the lag by faster-than-planned renewable growth.
At the beginning of 2020 I will adopt a starting note for the energy main structure programme and send it to the House, setting out the precise scope and planning of the programme.
Begin 2020 zal ik een startnotitie voor het programma energiehoofdstructuur vaststellen en naar de Kamer sturen, waarin staat wat de precieze reikwijdte en planning van het programma wordt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Nederland achter met hernieuwbare energie’

An MP asks why the Netherlands lags on renewable energy targets, what steps the government takes, and whether biomass dependence is a concern. The minister answers that the 14% 2020 target will be missed (about 11.6%), cites growth in renewable output, subsidy schemes, a SDE+ round in 2020, grid congestion, project delays and a possible statistical transfer, and says biomass use will be prioritised toward 2050.
On top of that, the cabinet is making a final push with a package of additional measures to achieve the 14% renewable energy target for 2020.
Daarbovenop zet het kabinet de eindsprint in met een pakket aan aanvullende maatregelen om het doel voor 14% hernieuwbare energie in 2020 te realiseren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Chili toch geen gastheer klimaattop’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate whether the Netherlands could host the UN climate summit after Chile withdrew as host. The minister answered that Spain will take over hosting COP25 in Madrid on the planned dates, with Chile remaining chair.
As already communicated in the media, the UNFCCC has decided that Spain will take over Chile's duties as host of COP25.
Zoals reeds gecommuniceerd in de media heeft de UNFCCC besloten dat Spanje de taken van Chili als gastheer van COP25 zal overnemen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee en Sienot over het bericht ‘Toezicht op energiebesparingsplicht bedrijven faalt’

MPs Van der Lee and Sienot asked why the energy-saving obligation for businesses is poorly enforced, because regulators do not know which firms are covered and grid operators may not share consumption data, and asked about capacity and use of a EUR 3 million amendment. The minister answered that the scope was known to be unclear, that a court case on data sharing is pending, that a legal duty for grid operators to share data is being considered, and that reporting and extra funds are improving oversight.
A court case is currently pending between a municipality, on behalf of an environmental service, and a grid operator over providing the consumption data.
Er loopt op dit moment over het verstrekken van de verbruiksgegevens een gerechtelijke procedure tussen een gemeente, namens een omgevingsdienst, en een netbeheerder.

Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot naar aanleiding van een artikel in de Volkskrant van 9 september jl. waarin werd betoogd dat subsidies op fossiele brandstoffen dubbel zo hoog zijn als voor duurzame energie

An MP asked the minister whether Dutch fossil fuel subsidies are double those for renewables, whether the state uses the same definition as the European Commission, and what measures will phase out fossil subsidies. The minister disputes the cited figures, says an IEA review and a stock-take are underway, and promises to inform parliament once the report is ready.
Once this report is ready, I will inform your House further.
Wanneer dit rapport gereed is, zal ik uw Kamer nader informeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht: ‘Deelautoproject botst op taaie Woningwet’

An MP asked whether the Housing Act blocks a shared electric car project with housing corporations and whether rules should be changed to let corporations send surplus solar power to shared cars. The minister said the Act already allows corporations to lease roofs to third parties, but will not widen corporations' remit to energy production, while promising to examine further cooperation options.
However, I am willing, when elaborating the policy intention, to examine how the options for corporations to cooperate with such initiatives can be further expanded.
Wel ben ik bereid om bij de uitwerking van het beleidsvoornemen te bezien hoe de mogelijkheden voor corporaties om met dergelijk initiatieven samen te werken verder kunnen worden vergroot.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Industrie vreest streep door waterstofambities Klimaatakkoord’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about industry concerns that hydrogen production may not qualify for SDE++ subsidies, and about the emission factor used in PBL's draft advice. The minister replied that the advice is still provisional, that a decision will follow the final PBL advice in November, and that hydrogen projects are supported through other schemes and a phased programme, with stakeholder consultation ongoing.
Following the final advice, I will decide which technologies will be opened up under which conditions in 2020.
Naar aanleiding van het definitieve advies zal ik een besluit nemen over welke technieken tegen welke condities worden opengesteld in 2020.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over de berichtgeving ‘Canadees bedrijf zou veel meer gas winnen uit veld Diever dan toegestaan’

MP Sienot asks whether the minister knows of a Canadian company extracting three times the permitted gas from the small Diever field, the reason for the criminal investigation, and what is being done about possible safety risks and overshoot of permits. The minister confirms SodM enforced against overextraction, says the criminal investigation was triggered by SodM's standard referral to the prosecutor, and states SodM knows of no current permit overshoots, with existing enforcement tools deemed sufficient.
Neither SodM nor I are substantively informed of the mentioned criminal investigations.
SodM noch ik zijn inhoudelijk op de hoogte van de genoemde strafrechtelijk onderzoeken.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs en Sienot over het bericht ‘Huizenkopers haken af, omdat nieuwbouw te duur wordt’

MPs Van Eijs and Sienot asked the Minister of Interior about rising new-build home prices, the role of sustainability measures such as heat pumps, land prices, municipal incentives for housing sites, and support for gas-free homes. The minister answered that causes are still unclear, promised research on costs and benefits of gas-free new build by early 2020, and outlined housing deals, a climate-agreement innovation programme, and a public campaign.
In doing so, I also want to have the costs and benefits of gas-free new construction mapped out.
Daarbij wil ik ook de kosten en baten van aardgasvrije nieuwbouw in kaart laten brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Van Eijs over het bericht ‘Gevaarlijke gasleidingen in Nederland versneld vervangen na explosie Den Haag’

MPs Sienot and Van Eijs asked the Ministers of Economic Affairs and Climate and of the Interior about the accelerated replacement of risky grey cast-iron gas pipes after an explosion in The Hague, why some network operators acted slowly, and whether gas-free housing could help. Minister Wiebes answered that SodM supervises an accelerated plan, that the cause of the third incident is not yet explained, that safety is leading, and that he will support network operators where needed.
Now that the precise underlying cause of the third incident, a crack in the gas pipe in The Hague, cannot be explained, it is (still) not possible to establish a link with the earlier incidents.

Nu de precieze achterliggende oorzaak van het derde incident, een scheur in de gasleiding in Den Haag, niet kan worden verklaard, is het (nog) niet mogelijk een relatie te leggen met de eerdere incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Schonis en Sienot over het artikel ‘Energie voor elektrische auto superduur, rijden toch het goedkoopst’

MPs Schonis and Sienot asked whether electric car charging, though costlier per kWh than fuel, is cheaper per kilometre than diesel, and what the government will do about fiscal incentives for business drivers and charging prices. The state secretary answered that efficiency offsets the higher per-kWh price, rejected the claim that diesel is generally cheaper, and pointed to Klimaatakkoord measures such as lowering the energy tax on electricity and raising the diesel excise.
No, I do not share that conclusion.
Nee, ik deel die conclusie niet.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel 'The hidden subsidy of fossil fuels'

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an article on hidden global fossil fuel subsidies, including the Netherlands' share, domestic costs and the timeline for the motion-Van Raan study on subsidy definitions. The minister answered that no consistent definition or Dutch share is available, pointed to international reform efforts and Dutch carbon pricing, and said the study will be reported after an IEA review expected later.
I cannot provide insight into the Netherlands' share of direct subsidies and tax benefits within an estimated total European amount.
Ik kan geen inzicht geven in een aandeel van Nederland in directe subsidies en belastingvoordelen in een totaal ingeschat Europees bedrag.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Agnes Mulder, Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, en Dik-Faber over het artikel ‘Gedupeerden gaswinning moeten twee keer zo lang wachten op afhandeling schade’

MPs asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about a report that Groningen gas-damage claimants face a total wait of about 30 months, as the TCMG postponed its decision deadline by fifteen months. The Minister acknowledged the delay, attributed it to a backlog inherited by the TCMG, and announced a one-off stuwmeer scheme offering a fixed compensation of 5,000 euro to all claims received up to 12 June 2019, with variable compensation up to 11,000 euro for claims from 1 January 2019.
I have decided to enable the TCMG to apply the fixed compensation of 5,000 euro from the stuwmeer scheme to all applications received by the TCMG up to and including 12 June 2019.
Ik heb besloten het de TCMG mogelijk te maken de vaste vergoeding van € 5.000,– uit de stuwmeerregeling te laten gelden voor alle aanvragen die door de TCMG zijn ontvangen tot en met 12 juni 2019
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Sneller over het bericht 'ING en milieuorganisaties bepleiten klimaatrichtlijnen voor financiële sector'

Two D66 MPs asked whether the government will act on an NGO and ING call for climate guidelines for banks, including requesting IEA scenarios and a single carbon measurement method. The minister answered that the IEA Sustainable Development Scenario already suffices, that the Dutch financial sector's commitment to Paris-aligned targets is welcomed, and that a single measurement method is premature while harmonisation proceeds.
However, in my view it is still too early to introduce a single standard measurement method for the climate impact of investments at this time.
Het is echter wat mij betreft nog te vroeg om op dit moment één standaard meetmethode in te voeren voor de klimaatimpact van investeringen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘EU eist van Den Haag nieuw plan voor duurzame energie’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an EU demand that the Netherlands present a new renewable energy plan and about the risk of a fine for missing the 2020 renewable target. The minister acknowledged the Netherlands lags the 14% target (projected 12.2%), blamed delays in onshore wind and rising energy consumption, declined to estimate any fine, and promised a letter before the summer recess on Joint Project Mechanism options and domestic measures.
I cannot make any statements about the amount of a possible fine; this is not currently at issue and there are still many uncertain factors.
Over de hoogte van de eventuele boete kan ik geen uitspraken doen; dit is nu niet aan de orde en er zijn nog veel onzekere factoren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Energiesystemen minder betaalbaar en niet duurzamer’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about an article on energy systems becoming less affordable and less sustainable, including global transition stagnation, falling renewable costs, Paris Agreement implementation, and the Netherlands' transition readiness ranking. The minister answered substantively, describing national and EU climate targets, cost trends, the Klimaatakkoord's flexibility and innovation agenda, and why Sweden is a useful comparator.
I will therefore continue to work within the EU and, where possible, beyond it to further accelerate the energy transition
Ik blijf mij dan ook binnen de EU en waar mogelijk daarbuiten inzetten voor een verdere versnelling van de energietransitie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Groothuizen over het artikel ‘Tweede ondernemer zwicht na dreigbrief van windmolenactivisten: 'U krijgt 48 uur'’

MPs Sienot and Groothuizen asked the Justice and Economic Affairs ministers about a newspaper report of a second entrepreneur giving in to threats from wind-turbine activists, and what the government does against intimidation and to protect businesses. Minister Grapperhaus answered that intimidation is unacceptable, that police do not record wind-related offences separately, that local protest is largely lawful, and that businesses are primarily responsible for their own security with local authorities adding measures when risk warrants, while pointing to regional energy strategies and co-ownership to build support.
As previously indicated in answers to parliamentary questions, offences committed in relation to wind turbines are not registered by the police under a separate code.
Antwoord 3 Zoals eerder aangegeven in de beantwoording van Kamervragen 2 , worden delicten die worden gepleegd in relatie tot windmolens door de politie niet geregistreerd onder een aparte code.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot, Dik-Faber, Agnes Mulder, Nijboer en Beckerman over het bericht ‘Stress door gasellende in bevingsgebied neemt toe’

MPs asked the minister about reports that gas-extraction stress in the Groningen earthquake area is rising, the need for psychological care funding, and NAM liability for immaterial damage. The minister acknowledged the mental health problem, pointed to ending gas extraction, independent damage and reinforcement processes, regional support programmes, and said he will await the outcome of pending court proceedings on immaterial damage.
I am awaiting the outcome of the court proceedings.
Ik wacht de uitkomst van de gerechtelijke procedures af.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het artikel ‘Nederland onderaan EU-lijst duurzame energie’

MP Sienot asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about the Netherlands ranking last on EU renewable energy, proposals to add SDE+ subsidy for asbestos-roof solar, support for collective solar, grid capacity limits, foreign projects via the Joint Project Mechanism, and accelerating Climate Agreement measures. The minister acknowledged the gap to the 14% target, rejected a separate subsidy and some proposals while promising a letter on foreign projects and reporting on grid measures.
I am positive about that, provided it leads to a lower required subsidy per kWh and therefore less subsidy.
Ik sta daar positief tegenover, mits dit leidt tot een lagere benodigde subsidie per kWh en daardoor minder subsidie.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Dik-Faber, Sienot en Agnes Mulder over het bericht dat de metingen van het KNMI in de Groninger bodem niet kloppen

Four MPs asked the minister about reports that KNMI seismic acceleration measurements in Groningen were miscalibrated, covering the cause, when officials and SodM were informed, effects on hazard maps and damage assessment, and whether trust and oversight are affected. The minister answered in detail on the timeline and the KNMI error, said data are usable after correction, and committed to an SodM audit and an evaluation of KNMI's internal processes.
SodM is having an independent audit carried out on the quality of the KNMI's measured ground accelerations.
SodM laat een onafhankelijke audit uitvoeren op de kwaliteit van de gemeten grondversnellingen van het KNMI.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ziengs, Dik-Faber, Sienot en Von Martels over het bericht dat de metingen in de Groninger bodem niet kloppen

Four MPs asked the State Secretary of Infrastructure and Water Management how KNMI measurement errors in Groningen went unreported from August 2018 until February 2019, and what will prevent recurrence. The government answered that the KNMI delayed reporting, announced an evaluation, a working group, and an additional SodM audit, while stating the hazard models and damage decisions are not affected.
We regret that the KNMI did not report the identified deviations in a timely manner.
Wij betreuren het dat het KNMI niet tijdig een melding heeft gemaakt van de geconstateerde afwijkingen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het bericht ‘Ministerie erkent blunder met energierekening: Tweede Kamer boos’

MPs from VVD, D66, ChristenUnie and CDA asked why the government had used outdated 2017 PBL projections of household energy bills, which underestimated rising prices, and what the consequences are for the 2019 budget, koopkracht and the Klimaatakkoord analysis. Minister Wiebes acknowledges the government should have been less categorical and that the PBL did not update its outlook in 2018, attributes the price rise to market developments and existing policy, and promises a new PBL estimate within weeks.
The cabinet should have been less categorical at the end of last year and should have stressed more that this was a 2017 estimate.
Het kabinet had zich eind vorig jaar minder stellig moeten uitlaten en meer moeten benadrukken dat het hier ging om een raming uit 2017.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Yeşilgöz-Zegerius en Sienot over het bericht 'Zakt het warmtetarief als het losgekoppeld wordt van gas?'

Two MPs asked the minister whether heat tariffs rise with gas prices, whether decoupling them from gas would lower prices, and what alternatives exist. The minister answered that tariffs are capped by a gas reference but not mandatory, that decoupling would likely raise prices on average for now, and that no clear alternative has been identified yet, with further study planned in the Warmtewet 2.0 process.
As part of preparing the next amendment of the Heat Act, I am having possible alternatives to the gas reference mapped out.
In het kader van de voorbereiding van de volgende wijziging van de Warmtewet laat ik mogelijke alternatieven voor de gasreferentie in kaart brengen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Plannen voor zonne-energie smelten als sneeuw voor de zon omdat het net volstroomt’

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about grid congestion threatening solar energy projects and the risk that SDE+ subsidised projects cannot connect in time. The minister acknowledges that grid reinforcement takes time, explains RVO's feasibility checks, and points to joint work with grid operators, ACM and regional energy strategies (RES) as remedies.
I am examining with ACM and the grid operators which solution is appropriate for timely investment and whether the regulations should be amended for that.
Ik onderzoek met ACM en de netbeheerders welke oplossing passend is voor tijdig investeren en of de regelgeving daarvoor gewijzigd moet worden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van der Lee, Agnes Mulder, Sienot en Dik-Faber over het stimuleren van kleinschalige windprojecten

MPs from GroenLinks, CDA, D66 and ChristenUnie asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about decommissioning of small wind turbines, municipal refusals to allow replacement of solitary mills, subsidy levels for medium-sized turbines and uncertainty around the postcode rose scheme. The Minister responded that some decommissioning is planned and monitored, that location decisions rest with provinces and municipalities, that he does not favour a separate SDE+ tariff for medium turbines, and that the successor to the net-metering scheme is still being worked out.
I note that in its report ECN calculated base amounts for hub heights of 40 to 50 metres and 50 to 60 metres respectively.
Ik teken hierbij aan dat ECN in haar rapport basisbedragen heeft berekend voor ashoogten van respectievelijk 40 tot 50 meter en 50 tot 60 meter.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht dat de Zandtsters het wachten beu zijn

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Economic Affairs and Climate about reports that residents of Zandt are tired of waiting, and about unclear timing and amounts of budgets for damage and reinforcement operations in Groningen, including reporting by the National Coordinator Groningen. The minister acknowledged the problems, said the NAM will bear all reinforcement costs under an agreement, that budget availability must not delay safety work, and that a progress letter will follow in January.
On the precise form of this, I will enter into discussion with the NCG.
Over de precieze vormgeving hiervan ga ik met de NCG in gesprek.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht 'Drijvende zonnepanelen wekken de meeste stroom op - alleen jammer van dat subsidiefoutje'

An MP asked the Minister of Economic Affairs about a proposal to devote part of the IJsselmeer to floating solar panels and about the SDE+ subsidy not accounting for higher yields of sun-tracking systems. The minister acknowledged the idea, said the Rijk is studying potential on state lands and waters, and committed to allowing extra subsidy for large sun-tracking installations from SDE+ 2019.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Remco Dijkstra over het artikel 'Lightyear in Helmond wil lage bijtelling zonne-auto’s'

MPs Sienot and Remco Dijkstra asked whether the government supports solar-powered cars such as Lightyear's, whether a workable legal definition is possible, and whether the zero-emission company-car tax exemption for hydrogen cars could be extended to them. The state secretary answered that the government supports the innovation through several channels, that a definition is feasible but needs further study, and that the tax treatment will be reviewed and reported to parliament by mid-2019.
It is too early to attach concrete criteria to this yet.
Het is te vroeg om hier nu al concrete criteria aan te hangen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over het bericht ‘Roep om geluidsschermen langs snelwegen in 't Gooi: ‘Elke nacht wakker’’

Two D66 MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management about noise from the A1 motorway near Naarderbos in Gooi, a local news report on residents' complaints, and possible solar noise barriers. The minister answered that the site is in a sanitation backlog but not in the first phase of the noise programme, that a noise barrier is still under study, that solar panels can be considered, and that Rijkswaterstaat would meet residents and the municipality.
I therefore gladly want to consult with the residents about this.
Ik ga daarom graag met de bewoners hierover in overleg.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Schonis over het bericht ‘TenneT zegt miljoenencontract 380kv-lijn met Heijmans op, project loopt vertraging op’

Two D66 MPs asked the minister of Economic Affairs about reports that TenneT terminated a multi-million euro contract with Heijmans for 380kV pylons, causing delays, and what this means for offshore wind connections. The minister replied that TenneT, not the state, is the contracting party, that only the Zuid-West 380kV West project faces at least a one-year delay with no effect on wind farm connections, and that he has asked TenneT for clarification and urged it to resume construction quickly.
Of course I have asked TenneT for clarification and I urge that the realisation of the relevant connections be resumed as quickly as possible.
Uiteraard heb ik TenneT om opheldering gevraagd en dring ik erop aan dat de realisatie van de betreffende verbindingen zo snel mogelijk wordt hervat.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Sienot en Von Martels over het bericht 'Minister geeft geen extra geld voor Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht'

Two MPs asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management whether the government will honour the coalition agreement and earlier commitments on the Noordelijke Randweg Utrecht and the Utrecht ring road, and why no extra funding is provided. The minister answered that the state contribution of 168 million euro is sufficient, that extra non-statutory measures must be financed by the region, and that the municipality has committed to implementing the existing plan in 2020-2025.
Since IenW already contributes substantially (168 million euro) to this municipal project, I have indicated that I see no further possibility to supplement this amount.
Aangezien IenW al substantieel bijdraagt (€ 168 mln) aan dit gemeentelijk project, heb ik aangegeven geen verdere mogelijkheid te zien om dit bedrag verder aan te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over ‘Vierde keer in deze eeuw komt het droogte-crisisteam in actie’

An MP from D66 asked the Minister of Infrastructure and Water Management why drought crisis measures were needed again after earlier reassurances, whether Dutch water policy neglects drought, and what will be done to anticipate dry and wet periods and to build larger freshwater reserves. The minister answered that a national actual water shortage now exists, the drought management plan is active, the Delta programme is preparing for dry and wet extremes, and an evaluation will follow only after the shortage ends.
I cannot now commit to sending you an evaluation of this drought period before the 2019 budget, because the water shortage is still in full swing.
Ik kan nu niet toezeggen om u voor de begroting van 2019 een evaluatie van deze droogteperiode toe te sturen, omdat op dit moment het watertekort nog volop speelt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Slechts 3 procent nieuwe auto's elektrisch: de schuld van autodealers?’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about the low share of electric car sales in the Netherlands, dealer behaviour reported in Scandinavian research, and what government will do to support the transition. The secretary confirmed roughly 3% EV registrations in 2017, said she knows of the Nature Energy study but not whether it applies in the Netherlands, and committed to discussing the issue with the sector and the mobility table, with a joint measures package to be agreed in the climate agreement by year end.
By the end of this year I want to record a joint package of measures with them in the climate agreement.
Eind dit jaar wil ik met hen een gezamenlijk maatregelenpakket vastleggen in het klimaatakkoord.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Sienot over het bericht ‘Ander reisgedrag vermindert files’

An MP from D66 asked the state secretary about a report that changed commuting behaviour reduces traffic jams, including whether behaviour-change schemes like Low Car Diet are cheaper than infrastructure and how they are factored into budgeting and the NMCA. The state secretary answered that behaviour-change measures are a promising method, that further research is being explored, that Beter Benutten and employer programmes are being continued, and that alternative non-infrastructural solutions are considered in MIRT studies.
Yes, together with those involved I am currently exploring the possibilities for a follow-up to the CPB note.
Ja, samen met de betrokkenen onderzoek ik momenteel de mogelijkheden voor een vervolg op de notitie van het CPB.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Eijs, Sienot en De Groot over het bericht 'Onderzoekers: plasticsoep in Stille Oceaan komt vooral van visserij en scheepvaart'

D66 MPs asked whether the government shares researchers' view that cleaning up the Pacific plastic soup is futile and that production should be tackled, and what Dutch fishing and shipping sectors contribute and what agreements exist nationally, in the EU and globally. The minister answered that prevention via a circular economy is the primary policy, cites national green deals with the fishing and shipping sectors, EU port reception facility revision, and international initiatives, while noting the Pacific findings cannot be directly transferred to the North Sea.
Results of beach litter surveys on North Sea beaches in OSPAR's 2017 Intermediate Assessment show that in the southern North Sea in 2014/2015 packaging material had the largest share of items found.

Uit de resultaten van zwerfvuilmetingen op Noordzeestranden in het Intermediate Assessment 2017 van OSPAR blijkt dat in de zuidelijke Noordzee in 2014/2015 de categorie verpakkingsmateriaal het grootste aandeel heeft.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Jetten en Sienot over geluidshinder van de A50 in Niftrik
