MPs from VVD, SGP, ChristenUnie and CDA asked the ministers about the Landsadvocaat's advice on whether shrimp fishing licences under the Visserijwet can count as existing use (bestaand gebruik) for Wet natuurbescherming permits, and whether the 1994 licences should be investigated. The minister answered that the legal route is highly complex, that the sector must itself reconstruct licence and emission data via AIS and logbooks, and that the sector remains responsible for the nitrogen deposition calculations.
I share that observation and gladly give these fishers the opportunity and room to demonstrate this.
Ik deel die constatering en biedt deze vissers graag de kans en ruimte om dit aan te tonen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Valstar over de bedreiging van de inheemse natuur door het rode gevaar: ‘de Amerikaanse rivierkreeft’

Two VVD MPs asked the government about the threat posed by the American crayfish to native nature, including the status of a strategy and pilots, the feasibility of large-scale culling, dike safety, and the legal framework for fishing gear. The minister answered that the strategy is still being developed, large-scale eradication in open waters is not feasible, pilots and a new selective trap are underway, and broader non-professional fishing would need careful weighing.
Antwoord op vragen vragen van de leden Brekelmans, Koerhuis, Rajkowski en Valstar over het bericht ‘‘Verdachte’ Chinese kranen staan ook in Nederlandse havens: zorgen om spionage’

The VVD MPs asked the ministers whether Chinese ZPMC cranes in Dutch ports could enable Chinese digital access, espionage, or disruption of military transports, and about Logink data links and subsidies. The government answered that the risks are being investigated in an interdepartmental review due in autumn 2023, that port facilities are responsible for securing their systems, that no Logink cooperation exists in Rotterdam, and that EU rules and NIS2/CER directives may address the risks.

Whether it is possible for the ZPMC facilities in China to gain digital access to the cranes, or whether they are connected in any way or have access to information in the port of Rotterdam, is being investigated in consultation with the Port of Rotterdam Authority.

Of het mogelijk is om vanuit de ZPMC-faciliteiten in China digitale toegang te krijgen tot de kranen, of dat deze op enigerlei wijze verbonden zijn of toegang hebben tot informatie in de Rotterdamse haven, wordt onderzocht in afstemming met het Havenbedrijf Rotterdam.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het artikel Chinees staatsbedrijf bouwt onze pantservoertuigen

An MP asked the government about reports that Visser B.V., a defence contractor building armoured vehicle components, is owned by a Chinese state-owned company, and whether a required security check and notification after the takeover took place. The State Secretary answered that Visser had not notified a November 2022 change in ownership despite holding an ABDO authorisation, that Defence is in discussion with the firm about consequences, and that a sectoral investment screening law and the Wet vifo are planned.
Visser BV did not do this; Defence is in discussion with the company and is considering what consequences should be attached to it.
Visser BV heeft dit niet gedaan; Defensie is hierover met het bedrijf in gesprek en beziet welke consequenties daaraan verbonden worden.
Antwoord op vragen die door het lid Valstar over het Zwitserse exportcontrole-regime in relatie tot het artikel ‘German ammunition plant to sidestep Swiss re-export ban’ in de Zwitserse media

An MP asked the Defence ministry about Swiss-made ammunition in Dutch stocks, Swiss re-export restrictions affecting supplies to Ukraine, and EU defence funding access for Swiss-linked firms. The government confirmed Swiss-produced 35mm and 30mm ammunition, declined to disclose stock levels as NATO-confidential, and said Switzerland's re-export policy is a sovereign matter while it urges Swiss producers to act in the Ukraine situation.
Because the NATO stock requirements for these ammunition types are confidential, I cannot inform you publicly about the stock of these munitions.
Omdat de opgedragen NAVO-voorraadnormen voor deze munitiesoorten vertrouwelijk zijn, kan ik u niet in het openbaar informeren over de voorraad van deze munitieartikelen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over de vergunningsaanvragen in de visserijsector

MPs Valstar and Van Campen (VVD) asked about expiring Wnb nature permits for the shrimp fishing sector, the late deadline for new permit applications, the Brexit adjustment subsidy, the existence of an acquired right, and the delayed emissions-reduction subsidy. The minister answered that permits expire on 1 January 2023, applications were submitted on 30 June 2022 but required supplementation, the Landsadvocaat advised that no acquired right exists, and a subsidy is expected to open in January 2023 with a possible nine-month tolerance arrangement.
The Landsadvocaat considers it highly uncertain whether the specific requirements for claiming such an acquired right can be met.
De Landsadvocaat acht het uiterst onzeker of de specifieke vereisten voor het kunnen claimen van een dergelijk bestaand recht zijn in te vullen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over de subsidieregeling Energie-efficiëntie Glastuinbouw

An MP asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about the Energy Efficiency in Greenhouse Horticulture subsidy: why no new applications are possible in 2022, and why the maximum LED lighting wattage requirement exists and should be relaxed. The minister said the 2022 budget is exhausted, the scheme will reopen in 2023, and the wattage cap is needed to ensure energy savings, rejecting any relaxation.
I intend to reopen the EG subsidy scheme in 2023.
Ik ben voornemens om de subsidieregeling EG in 2023 opnieuw open te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens en Valstar over versnelling geothermie

MPs Grinwis, Bontenbal, Erkens and Valstar asked how to accelerate geothermal heat projects amid the gas crisis, including exceptions to SDE++ deadlines, a correction scheme for glasshouse horticulture, and simpler permitting and risk frameworks. The Staatssecretaris answered that retroactive SDE++ changes are unfair to other bidders, that a temporary correction scheme is being explored with a decision expected soon, and that permitting and risk rules will change in spring 2023 with a taskforce being set up.
An adjustment after the tender has closed, with retroactive effect, affects equal treatment of projects for two reasons and therefore also the government's reliability.
Een aanpassing na afloop van de tender – met terugwerkende kracht – raakt om twee redenen aan de gelijke behandeling van projecten en daarmee ook aan de betrouwbaarheid van de overheid.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Brekelmans over het bericht ‘UK to issue ‘threat alert’ over China’s attempts to recruit RAF pilots’

MPs Valstar and Brekelmans asked whether the Dutch government knows of former military pilots training Chinese forces, whether Dutch personnel are linked to a South African flight school, and whether current law can prosecute former military personnel who work for foreign states. The minister answered that the matter is concerning and under investigation by the MIVD, that details cannot be given publicly, that the government is in contact with UK authorities and is considering further measures, and that existing laws (including Articles 101 and 205 of the Criminal Code) offer possibilities.
Because of the classified nature of this investigation, no statements can be made publicly about its nature and content.
Vanwege het gerubriceerde karakter van dit onderzoek kunnen over de aard en inhoud in het openbaar geen uitspraken worden gedaan.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Erkens, Brekelmans over het bericht 'Norway oil safety regulator warns of threats from unidentified drones'en het bericht 'Duitse media: lek Nord Stream vrijwel zeker sabotage 'do

MPs Valstar, Erkens and Brekelmans asked the government about reports of unidentified drones near Norwegian offshore gas infrastructure and reports that sabotage by a state actor was likely behind the Nord Stream leak, including questions on Russian vessel activity and NATO protection. The Foreign Minister answered that a real threat to vital undersea infrastructure exists but declined to disclose suspicious activity, said the Baltic and Nordic investigations must determine responsibility, and described NATO and Norwegian protective measures and Dutch work on mapping vulnerabilities.
For security reasons, the Netherlands in principle never makes statements about suspicious activities.
Nederland doet vanuit veiligheidsoverwegingen in principe nooit mededelingen over verdachte activiteiten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Strien over het bericht ‘Scheepsbouwer IHC in zwaar weer: zo’n 250 personeelsleden ontslagen en werf in Krimpen tijdelijk dicht’

MPs Valstar and Van Strien asked about IHC's shipyard layoffs and whether closer cooperation with industry could speed up naval maintenance backlogs. The government answered that about half of naval maintenance is already outsourced to industry, that a backlog is manageable, and that talks with the maritime sector are ongoing.
Defence is exploring, within procurement rules, ways to further simplify and improve cooperation with and between maritime industry companies.
Defensie verkent de mogelijkheden om – binnen de aanbestedingsregelgeving – te komen tot verdere vereenvoudiging en verbetering van de samenwerking met en tussen bedrijven uit de maritieme industrie
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Boswijk over het artikel 'Munitie-tekort explodeert: problemen met locaties en vergunningen voor kogelfabrieken'

MPs Valstar and Boswijk asked the Defence and Economic Affairs ministers about Dutch dependence on imported ammunition, the lack of domestic munitions factories, and permitting barriers for new production sites. The government acknowledged the strategic dependence and the value of European cooperation, but said it will not pursue active policy to restart domestic munitions production, that no Defence sites are available, and that the timeline is unknown.
There are no more ammunition factories in the Netherlands. If they were to come, that would be good, but we will not pursue active policy on this.
Er zijn geen munitiefabrieken meer in Nederland. Als die er zouden komen is dat goed, maar we gaan hier geen actief beleid op voeren.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het nieuwsbericht ‘Poland will lease MQ-9A Reapers to fill the UAV capability gap’

An MP asked the State Secretary for Defence whether the acquisition of four extra MQ-9A Reapers was delayed, why the order was not placed by late August despite parliamentary approval, and why parliament was not informed via the Defence Projects Overview. The government denied any delay, said the purchase was postponed only to renegotiate financial conditions with the US, and said the contract can now be signed in 2023 without delivery delay.
Since there is no delay in the acquisition process, this was not reported in the Defence Projects Overview.
Aangezien er geen sprake is van vertraging in het verwervingstraject, is dit niet gemeld in het Defensie Projecten Overzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het bericht ‘Pentagon suspends F-35 deliveries over Chinese alloy in magnet’

MP Valstar asked the government about reports that the Pentagon suspended F-35 deliveries over a Chinese alloy in a magnet, and whether countries with offensive intelligence programmes against the Netherlands should be excluded from defence supply chains. The government answered that Dutch rules exclude companies via the ABDO security screening and cited refusal counts, declined to name specific cases, and described US and EU supply-chain restrictions while noting Dutch law does not exclude countries in advance.
Specific cases I cannot share with your House via this route because of the sensitive and confidential nature of this information.
Specifieke casussen kan ik vanwege het gevoelige en vertrouwelijke karakter van deze informatie niet langs deze weg met uw Kamer delen.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het advies ‘keuzes voor de krijgsmacht’ van de Adviesraad Internationale Vraagstukken

Valstar (VVD) asked ministers of Defence and Foreign Affairs ten questions on the AIV advisory report on defence choices, covering NATO strengthening, defence spending of two percent of GDP, readiness, specialisation and legal embedding of defence budgets. The government broadly agreed with the AIV's analysis, pointed to a structural 5 billion euro extra for Defence and a forthcoming Defensienota, and committed to responding to the AIV advice after that.
The AIV advice comes at a relevant moment and contains good starting points.
Het advies van de AIV komt op een relevant moment en bevat goede aanknopingspunten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Grinwis over de technische correcties van de CO2-doelen voor de glastuinbouwsector

MPs Valstar and Grinwis asked about technical corrections to CO2 emission ceilings for the greenhouse horticulture sector for 2018 to 2020, including delays and financial consequences. The ministers confirmed a correction for 2018 in line with the covenant criteria, said 2019 and 2020 ceilings would also be corrected and published, and committed to a new individual system and covenant 2021–2030.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Grinwis en Boswijk over het bericht 'Hoge gasprijzen dwingen vier van de tien glastuinders definitief of tijdelijk te stoppen'

MPs Valstar, Grinwis and Boswijk asked the ministers for Climate and Energy and for Agriculture about reports that high gas prices may force many greenhouse growers to stop, and about job losses, timelines for switching to sustainable heat, and support. The ministers acknowledge the sector's serious concerns and possible bankruptcies, say sustainability transitions take time, but refuse to compensate high gas prices and promise a letter at the end of April.
We cannot rule out that companies will go bankrupt.
Tegelijk kunnen wij niet uitsluiten dat er bedrijven failliet zullen gaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over het bericht 'waanzinnige regels dreigen garnalenvisser Eddy Sinke de nek om te draaien'

MPs Valstar and Van Campen (VVD) asked the ministers of Agriculture and of Nature and Nitrogen about shrimp fishers facing new Nature Conservation Act permit requirements by 1 January 2023, including nitrogen rules, unclear assessment methods, monitoring of engine hours, and the absence of a phased path to compliance. The ministers answered that the sector must apply for permits itself with LNV support, that the 1 January 2023 date will not be moved, that provinces are not parties, and that a subsidy scheme and a fisheries vision are being developed.
I am therefore not willing to make an exception for the fishers regarding the date of the new nature permit.
Ik ben dan ook niet bereid een uitzondering te maken voor de vissers als het gaat om de datum van de nieuwe natuurvergunning.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het bericht 'Riesen- Zoff um Asyl-Plan von Innenministerin Faeser'

An MP asked the government about a German plan to admit more asylum seekers and whether the Netherlands would join a coalition of receptive member states. The state secretary declined to comment on the German idea, confirmed regional reception and GEAS reform remain policy, and said joining such a coalition is not on the agenda.
Joining a 'coalition of receptive member states' aimed at admitting more asylum seekers is not under consideration.
Het aansluiten bij een «coalitie van ontvankelijke lidstaten» dat tot doel heeft meer asielzoekers op te vangen, is niet aan de orde.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over de gedragscode natuurbeheer

An MP asked the minister about the lapsing Gedragscode Natuurbeheer, its consequences for nature management, and interim measures to avoid extra burdens. The minister confirmed the code expires 19 December 2021, said the new code is under assessment with a six-week consultation required, and said talks with the provinces and LNV are ongoing on handling exemptions.
The VBNE is currently consulting with the IPO and LNV on how exemption granting can proceed quickly and adequately in the period until approval of the new code.
De VBNE voert op dit moment overleg met het IPO en LNV over de wijze waarop de ontheffingverlening in de periode tot goedkeuring van de nieuwe gedragscode snel en adequaat kan verlopen.

Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Aukje de Vries over het bericht 'Weigermigranten buiten corona uit: 'Dit blijft een grote frustratie'' en 'GGD’s mogen binnenkort vaccinatiebewijzen afgeven aan mensen zonder BS

MPs Valstar and Aukje de Vries asked about asylum seekers refusing COVID tests, vaccination coverage in reception centres, and GGD-issued vaccination certificates for undocumented people. The government answered that all arrivals are tested but refusal has no sanction, that roughly half of centre residents are recorded as vaccinated, and that deportations were cancelled for test refusals, with the government exploring legal options for compulsory testing.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Campen en Valstar over de berichten ‘Dode en gewonde schapen in Vlijmen, waarschijnlijk door wolf’ en ‘Duitsland pleit voor intensievere jacht op wolf’

Two VVD MPs asked the agriculture minister about reports of sheep killed by wolves in Vlijmen, calls for more farmer support, compensation levels, the 2023 end of the compensation scheme, and hunting wolves as in Germany. The minister replied that prevention is primary, the existing compensation procedure is adequate, attack figures rise with wolf numbers, the scheme is extended to 2022 pending a new wolf plan, and lethal culling has little proven effect.
The coming year will therefore focus on more information and communication about the wolf in the Netherlands and on prevention methods.
Het komende jaar zal daarom worden ingezet op meer voorlichting en communicatie over de wolf in Nederland en over preventiemethoden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Minhas over het bericht 'Meer incidenten met asielzoekers in trein Emmen-Zwolle, personeel ziek thuis'

MPs Valstar and Minhas asked about rising incidents involving asylum seekers on the Emmen-Zwolle train line, sick leave among staff, and measures taken, including bodycams, travel bans, guards and funding for a shuttle bus. The State Secretary confirmed the increase, described measures such as limited enforcement powers for supervisors and the HTL placement option, but said incident data do not record residence status and that individual cases cannot be discussed.
The police and transport operators do not register the residence status of persons involved in incidents.
De politie en vervoerders registreren niet op verblijfsstatus van personen die betrokken zijn bij incidenten.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Erkens over het bericht 'Gerberakweker Simon stopt acuut vanwege torenhoge gasprijs: ‘Het is niet meer te betalen’'

Two VVD MPs asked the government about a flower grower stopping production due to high gas prices and what support glasshouse growers could get. The minister said problems are limited to a small number of firms, prices are expected to fall, a tax cut for 2022 is proposed, and no additional compensation is planned for now.
Additional measures are not currently on the table, since high prices are not expected to persist for long.
Aanvullende maatregelen zijn op dit moment niet aan de orde, aangezien het niet de verwachting is dat de huidige hoge prijzen langdurig aanhouden.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Koerhuis over het bericht 'Asielzoekerscentra bomvol: 'We zitten tegen crisisnoodopvang aan'' en 'Afghanen de druppel'

Two VVD MPs asked the State Secretary for Justice and Security and the Minister of the Interior about the overcrowding of asylum reception centres, the causes of the shortage, and the government's plans to expand capacity and speed up the outflow of status holders. The government answers that all regular reception places are full, attributes this to rising inflow, slow housing of status holders by municipalities and reception capacity pressures, and describes efforts to add temporary places, flexible housing pilots and IND backlog measures.
With this, all regular reception places are occupied and various forms of emergency reception are now being used.
Daarmee zijn alle reguliere opvangplekken bezet en wordt nu verschillende vormen van noodopvang ingezet.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar, Brekelmans en El Yassini over het bericht 'FBI raids ZPMC delivery vessel'

MPs Valstar, Brekelmans and El Yassini (VVD) asked about reports of FBI raids on ZPMC (a Chinese state-owned shipbuilder) over suspected espionage, whether Dutch authorities had contact with US and Chinese authorities, how work-residence permits via recognised sponsor status are vetted for firms from China, Russia and Iran, and whether that status should be reconsidered. The State Secretary declined to comment on intelligence knowledge or diplomatic contacts, said fewer than five work permits were issued to ZPMC Netherlands staff since 2015 with none revoked, described the IND's sponsor vetting and the limited role of intelligence services, and said the government is critically reviewing the sponsor scheme with a later update promised.
No public statements are made about the knowledge level of the intelligence and security services.
Over het kennisniveau van de inlichtingen- en veiligheidsdiensten worden in het openbaar geen uitspraken gedaan.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Rudmer Heerema over het bericht ‘Dijk gaat schuiven, weilanden in Reeuwijk onder water’

MPs Valstar and Rudmer Heerema asked the government about a dike subsidence in Reeuwijk that farmers attribute to American crayfish burrowing, and about control of invasive crayfish. The minister answers that the cause is not yet established and that crayfish burrowing seems unlikely to be the main cause, that a national strategy process is underway, and that recreational or volunteer fishing for crayfish is not advisable.
According to the water manager, Hoogheemraadschap van Rijnland, it is currently unclear what caused this dike subsidence.
Het is volgens de waterbeheerder, het Hoogheemraadschap van Rijnland, op dit moment niet duidelijk wat de oorzaak is van deze dijkverzakking.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen en Valstar over het bericht ‘Frankrijk ziet Taliban-banden bij gevluchte Afghanen’

Members Van Wijngaarden, Michon-Derkzen and Valstar asked the ministers whether evacuated Afghans with Taliban, Al Qaeda or IS ties could enter the Netherlands, how security screening was done before and after evacuation, and whether the Taliban can be treated as a terrorist organisation. The State Secretary answered that all asylum applicants are screened under standard procedures, that pre-evacuation screening was largely not possible given the time pressure, and that individuals can be excluded under article 1F or prosecuted, while the Taliban as an organisation is not on UN or EU terrorism lists.
For other persons who did not work directly for Dutch officials as part of an international military or police mission, such screening was in most cases not carried out by the Netherlands in advance.

Voor de andere personen die niet rechtstreeks voor (een) Nederlandse functionaris(sen) als onderdeel van een internationale militaire of politiemissie werkten is een dergelijke screening in de meeste gevallen niet vooraf door Nederland uitgevoerd.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over het bericht ‘hartenkreet van boeren: ‘Alsjeblieft, pak het jacobskruiskruid aan!’

Two VVD MPs asked the Minister of Agriculture, Nature and Food Quality about farmers' complaints over the toxic ragwort (jacobskruiskruid), its spread, inconsistent local management and a possible eradication duty. The minister acknowledged the toxicity and said the number of affected animals is probably small and the species is native and valuable for biodiversity, so no national policy or eradication duty is planned, with management left to local managers.
I regret that, but this is no reason to draw up policy for it.
Dat betreur ik, maar dit vormt geen aanleiding om hier beleid voor op te stellen.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Erkens en Valstar over het ontwerp-weigeringsbesluit omtrent het aardwarmteproject Californië Lipzig Gielen Geothermie (hierna: CLG)

MPs Erkens and Valstar asked the government about the draft refusal decision on the CLG geothermal project, regional geothermal use and seismic risk, future capacity, licensing statistics, the Roer Valley rift, German comparisons and follow-up on SodM contacts. The State Secretary answered each question, explained that the refusal was based on safety uncertainties, and committed to a letter on geothermal risk policy within months.
The Climate Agreement, Built Environment section, sets an ambition of 40 PJ of sustainable heat.
Het Klimaatakkoord, onderdeel Gebouwde Omgeving, is een ambitie van 40 PJ duurzame warmte
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Ellian, De Neef en Valstar over de mishandeling en het dumpen van huisdieren

MPs Ellian, De Neef and Valstar asked the Justice and Agriculture ministers about rising animal abuse and dumping of pets during the coronavirus crisis and what the government would do. The minister answered that reports rose in 2020 but shelters saw no national increase in intake, outlined existing reporting and expertise arrangements, and said the animal-abuse ownership ban bill had been submitted to parliament.
The bill was submitted to your House on 15 July.
Het wetsvoorstel is op 15 juli jl. bij uw Kamer ingediend.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over de aangenomen resoluties 74 en 76 bij stemmingen in het Europees Parlement over de EU Biodiversiteitstrategie

An MP asks the minister about European Parliament resolutions calling for limits on bottom trawling and super trawlers and what this means for the Dutch cutter fleet. The minister answers that the North Sea Accord governs, that the fleet must adapt and become more sustainable through the kottervisie, and that the EU fisheries policy is based on MSY rather than vessel size.
For me, the agreements in the North Sea Accord are leading.
Voor mij zijn de afspraken in het Noordzee Akkoord leidend.
Antwoord op vragen van de leden Valstar en Van Campen over het bericht ‘Nederland raakt met landbouw-innovaties achter op China’

MPs Valstar and Van Campen asked whether Dutch agricultural biotechnology (CRISPR-Cas) is falling behind China and the US due to outdated EU rules, and what the government is doing to relax EU GMO regulation for plants. The ministers answered that CRISPR-Cas patent publications are lower in Europe, that the Commission study confirms current GMO rules need adapting, that the Netherlands is lobbying for a derogation, though the EU has not granted one.

The cabinet will continue to stress the urgency of this subject and continue to advocate for future-proof European regulation that leaves sufficient room for innovation while safeguarding human and environmental safety.

Het kabinet zal de urgentie van dit onderwerp blijven benadrukken en blijven pleiten voor toekomstbestendige Europese regelgeving die voldoende ruimte biedt voor innovatie en tegelijkertijd de veiligheid voor mens en milieu borgt.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Valstar over het bericht 'Pulsvisserij blijft verboden, Europees Hof veegt Nederlandse bezwaren van tafel'

An MP asked the agriculture minister whether the EU Court ruling upholding the pulse fishing ban could be appealed, whether the July 2021 deadline could be extended, and whether compensation was possible. The minister answered that appeal is not possible, the transition deadline is fixed in law, and compensation from Europe is not considered realistic, while pointing to innovation support.
No, it is not possible to appeal against this ruling.
Nee, het is niet mogelijk tegen deze uitspraak in beroep te gaan.

m: Gewijzigd amendement van het lid Tichelaar ter vervanging van nr. 10 over de mogelijkheid om werkgevers premiekorting te geven voor 50-plussers die recht hebben op een algemene nabestaandenuitkering
Allows employers to get a premium discount for hiring 50-plus people who receive an ANW survivors' benefit.
This amendment allows employers to also use a premium discount when they hire a 50-plusser
Met dit amendement wil de indiener het mogelijk maken dat werkgevers ook gebruik kunnen maken van een premiekorting als zij een 50-plusser in dienst nemen
Motie Van Hijum / Tichelaar over het effect van de premiekorting op het arbeidsmarktperspectief voor ouderen
Asks the government to inform the House, at the planned evaluation, about the effect of the wage-cost discount on the labour market prospects of older workers.
calls on the government to inform the House at the planned evaluation about the effect of the premium discount on the labour market prospects of older people
roept de regering op om de Kamer bij de voorziene evaluatie te informeren over het effect van de premiekorting op het arbeidsmarktperspectief van ouderen
Amendement van het lid Tichelaar die ertoe strekt dat loonkostensubsidies voor mensen tot 50 jaar ook kunnen worden uitbetaald voor mensen die 50 jaar of ouder zijn
Allows the UWV, via a ministerial regulation, to pay wage-cost subsidies to workers aged 50 and over in an experiment, with a report to parliament on effects and continuation.
may be determined by ministerial regulation that the UWV may, as an experiment, grant the wage-cost subsidy
kan bij ministeriële regeling worden bepaald dat het UWV bij wijze van experiment de subsidie voor loonkosten kan verstrekken
Amendement van het lid Tichelaar over het indexeren van de premiekortingen in 2015 met terugwerkende kracht vanaf 2009
Amends the premium discount rules so the discount amounts are indexed from 2009 onward using the income tax table correction factor, funded by reducing the Awf premium cut.
The amendment aims to index the premium discount too, in a cost-neutral way
Het amendement strekt ertoe ook de premiekorting kosten- en lastenneutraal te indexeren
Amendement van het lid Tichelaar over de mogelijkheid om werkgevers premiekorting te geven voor 50-plussers die recht hebben op een algemene nabestaandenuitkering
Extends the employer premium discount for hiring 50-plus benefit recipients to include recipients of the ANW survivors' benefit.
employers can also use a premium discount when hiring a 50-plus person entitled to a general survivors' benefit
werkgevers ook gebruik kunnen maken van een premiekorting als zij een 50-plusser in dienst nemen die recht heeft op een algemene nabestaandenuitkering

qa: Vragen van de leden Koppejan en Schermers (beiden CDA) aan de minister van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport over mogelijke verdwijning van de ambulancepost in Oostkapelle (ingezonden 19 april 2010).

Two CDA MPs asked the health minister about news that the ambulance post in Oostkapelle might disappear and whether efficiency would outweigh access for residents and tourists on Walcheren. The minister replied that the regional emergency care partners must apply the 45-minute norm carefully, that the norm will be reviewed, and that the regional ambulance service decides how its posts are distributed.

It will be examined whether the structure of this norm, 15 minutes ambulance response time, 5 minutes stabilising the patient and 25 minutes driving time to the hospital, gives cause for possible new insight given the high quality of Dutch ambulance care.

Gekeken wordt of de opbouw van deze norm, 15 minuten aanrijdtijd voor de ambulance, 5 minuten stabiliseren patiënt en 25 minuten rijtijd naar het ziekenhuis in relatie tot de hoogstaande kwaliteit van de Nederlandse ambulancezorg aanleiding vormt voor mogelijk nieuw inzicht.
Antwoord op vragen van het lid Podt en Den Hollander over het uitblijven van een verbod op stroomstootapparatuur in de veehouderij

MPs Podt and Den Hollander asked why the promised ban on electric livestock prods has not been sent to parliament and what the obstacles are. The minister says the ban is being implemented by general administrative order after Council of State advice, with no legal obstacles, and that enforcement by the NVWA is limited because loading of animals in national transport is not reported to it.
There is no bill that will be sent to the House.
Er is geen wetsvoorstel dat naar de Kamer zal worden verstuurd.
